job.title: Momentum Functional Test Lead
job.description:
Job Title: Momentum Functional Test LeadJob Category: Information TechnologyTime Type: Full timeMinimum Clearance Required to Start: NoneEmployee Type: RegularPercentage of Travel Required: NoneType of Travel: None* * *

The Opportunity:

CACI is seeking an experienced Momentum Functional Test Lead to support the Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) Integrated Financial and Acquisition Management System (iFAMS) Operations & Maintenance (O&M) contract.

  • This individual will serve as a functional lead, bridging business requirements, system functionality, and testing to ensure Momentum Financials solutions effectively meet VA business needs.
  • The ideal candidate will have extensive experience with Momentum Financials, federal financial management processes, business and systems analysis, and functional solution design.
  • This individual will work closely with government stakeholders, functional teams, developers, and end users to gather and define requirements, analyze business processes, develop functional specifications, and design solutions while leading testing activities to validate system functionality and ensure quality delivery.

Responsibilities:


  • Collect, analyze, and document client requirements, translating business needs into functional and system requirements.
  • Analyze existing business processes, workflows, and system functionality to identify gaps, improvement opportunities, and recommended solutions.
  • Develop functional design specifications, business process documentation, and requirements traceability artifacts.
  • Collaborate with government stakeholders and end users to understand business needs, define requirements, and recommend functional solutions.
  • Maintain subject matter expertise in COTS applications, particularly Momentum Financials, including system capabilities, configurations, and functional processes.
  • Design and support functional solutions involving Momentum configurations, reports, interfaces, workflows, and business processes.
  • Lead and coordinate functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT) activities.
  • Develop test strategies, plans, scenarios, and scripts to validate requirements, configurations, enhancements, and production fixes.
  • Coordinate testing resources, manage priorities and deliverables, and ensure comprehensive test coverage across functional areas.
  • Manage defect identification, documentation, prioritization, and resolution in collaboration with functional and technical teams.
  • Support release readiness, production deployments, and ongoing system enhancements.
  • Communicate requirements, solution recommendations, testing progress, risks, and issues to program leadership and government stakeholders.

Qualifications:

Required:


  • Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent professional experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in functional analysis, business systems analysis, software testing, or quality assurance within complex ERP environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Momentum Financials and federal financial management processes.
  • Demonstrated experience gathering and defining business requirements and translating them into functional specifications and system solutions.
  • Experience analyzing business and system processes, identifying gaps, and recommending functional improvements.
  • Experience designing and supporting functional solutions, including system configurations, reports, interfaces, and workflows.
  • Experience leading functional, integration, regression, and UAT testing activities.
  • Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Agility, and Agile methodologies.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder collaboration skills.
-

What You Can Expect:

A culture of integrity.

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

An environment of trust.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers - every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.

A focus on continuous growth.

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

Pay Range:

There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. At CACI, you will receive comprehensive benefits such as; healthcare, wellness, financial, retirement, family support, continuing education, and time off benefits.

Since this position can be worked in more than one location, the range shown is the national average for the position.

The proposed salary range for this position is:

$75,200-$158,100

CACI is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

job.title: Test Engineer - QA Consultant (m/w/d)
job.description:
Du bringst Erfahrung im Software Testing, in der Testautomatisierung und im API-Testing mit und möchtest dein Know-how in spannenden Kundenprojekten einsetzen?

Dann werde Teil von Nelta, einem wachsenden IT-Beratungshaus mit Fokus auf Qualitätssicherung, Automatisierung und moderne Softwarearchitekturen.

Wir bei Nelta bieten unseren Kunden ein erstklassiges Leistungsportfolio, bestehend aus innovativen Lösungen sowie integrierten und ganzheitlichen Services. Darüberhinaus agieren wir als strategischer IT Partner für diverse, internationale Projekte. Dabei legen wir ein großes Augenmerk auf unsere Unternehmenswerte – Vision, Verbindlichkeit, Fokus, Transparenz und Respekt – und gestalten danach unseren Alltag!

Aufgaben

Als Test Engineer / Consultant bist du in externen Kundenprojekten im Einsatz und verbindest fachliche Testkompetenz mit einem starken Consulting-Mindset.
Du arbeitest hands-on im Testing, analysierst komplexe Systemlandschaften und trittst beim Kunden souverän und lösungsorientiert auf.

Deine Aufgaben als Testautomation Engineer (w/m/d):

  • Einsatz als Test Engineer / Consultant in externen Kundenprojekten

  • Durchführung automatisierter und manueller Softwaretests auf unterschiedlichen Teststufen

  • Erstellung, Pflege und Weiterentwicklung von Testfällen, Testszenarien und Testplänen

  • Testen von Schnittstellen und Integrationen in komplexen Systemlandschaften

  • Durchführung automatisierter API-Tests (z. B. REST, GraphQL, HTTP)

  • Analyse von Fehlerbildern in verteilten Systemen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden, Entwicklung, Testmanagement und angrenzenden Teams

  • Aktive Kommunikation von Testergebnissen, Risiken und Handlungsempfehlungen gegenüber Kunden

Unser Teck Stack
Je nach Projekt nutzen wir folgende Technologien: Selenium, Tosca, Ranorex, Confluence, JIRA, Postman, Silk Central Manager, HPALL, Java, JUnit, REST, Jenkins, Docker, Maven, AWS, Microservices, Cucumber, Gherkin.

Qualifikation

Was Du dafür schon mitbringst:

Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Software-Testing (ca. 2–3 Jahre oder mehr)

  • Erfahrung in manuellen und automatisierten Tests

  • Praxis in der Erstellung von Testfällen, Testplänen und idealerweise Testkonzepten

  • Erfahrung mit Testmanagement-Tools wie Xray, Zephyr, SAP Solution Manager oder vergleichbaren Tools

  • Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierungs-Frameworks wie
    Selenium, Cypress, Robot Framework, Playwright oder ähnlichen Technologien

  • Gute Kenntnisse im API-Testing (REST, GraphQL, HTTP)

  • Grundverständnis verteilter Systeme

  • Gute Kenntnisse in mindestens einer Programmiersprache (z. B. Java, Python oder C#)

  • Ausgeprägte kommunikative Fähigkeiten und sicheres Auftreten

  • Consulting-Mindset: Du kannst deine Arbeit, Testergebnisse und Empfehlungen verständlich und überzeugend vertreten

  • Keine Scheu vor direkter Kundenkommunikation (Abstimmungen, Workshops, Interviews mit Fach- und IT-Ansprechpartnern)

  • Teamfähigkeit, Eigeninitiative und proaktive Arbeitsweise

  • Bereitschaft, bei Bedarf im Hamburger Office zu arbeiten

  • Reisebereitschaft für externe Kundenprojekte

Nice-to-have:

  • Erfahrung im Banking- oder Finanzumfeld

  • Erfahrung in der fachlichen Unterstützung oder Einarbeitung von Teammitgliedern

  • Erste Erfahrungen mit KI-gestützten Ansätzen oder automatisierten Workflows
    (z. B. n8n, Zapier oder vergleichbare Tools)

  • ISTQB Certified Tester – Foundation Level

  • Interesse an neuen Technologien und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung

Benefits

Neben einer selbst bestimmten und agilen Arbeitsweise bieten wir Dir:

  • Eine attraktive Vergütung und Bonuszahlung bei Erreichung von individuellen Zielen.

  • 28 Urlaubstage zum Start mit jährlicher Staffelung sowie Möglichkeit für Workation.

  • Du gestaltest Deinen Workflow ganz flexibel und individuell, bist aber bereit Dich wichtigen Terminen und Meetings anzupassen.

  • Individuelle Rabatte durch Corporate Benefits.

  • Wellpass Mitgliedschaft mit über 5.140 Sport- und Wellnesseinrichtungen deutschlandweit.

  • Lohnoptimierungsbausteine ( Internetzuschuss, Kindergartenzuschuss, etc.) durch unseren Partner Finstein

  • Investition in Deine Zukunft durch Sprach- und Persönlichkeitstrainings.

  • Auswahl modernster Hardware (MacOS, Linux oder Windows).

  • Ein überdurchschnittlich familiäres und freundliches Arbeitsklima mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

  • Individuelle Einarbeitung (vor Ort) mit eigenem Mentor.

  • Ein idyllisches Büro an der Hamburger Alster, damit Du auch in stressigen Phasen zur Ruhe kommen kannst.

Bei Nelta wird Kommunikation großgeschrieben und kreative Ideen und Lösungsvorschläge sind sehr willkommen und werden mehr als wertgeschätzt.

Wie wir Dich weiterentwickeln?
Wir legen großen Wert auf Weiterbildung unserer Mitarbeiter, d.h. konkret wir bieten Dir Freiraum für Weiterbildung und spendieren Dir Teilnahmen an Workshops, Konferenzen o.ä. Hauptsache Du hast Lust was zu lernen und sprichst mit uns darüber! Regelmäßige Weeklies mit Deinem Lead helfen Dir und uns dabei zu erkennen, wo und wie wir Dich individuell am besten unterstützen und fördern können. Abgerundet wird das Ganze mit internen Coachings und Trainings zu aktuellen aber auch Business relevanten Themen. Zudem stecken wir gerade aktiv in der zweiten Wachstumsphase und bieten jedem der sein Potenzial ausschöpfen will die Möglichkeit seine Zukunft und die von Nelta aktiv voranzutreiben. Bei uns wird jeder gefördert und keiner überhört!

Klingt gut soweit?
Dann freuen wir uns sehr darauf Dich kennenzulernen! Teil uns am besten gleich mit, wann Du starten könntest und wo Dein Gehaltswunsch liegt. Ein Anschreiben hingegen brauchst Du nicht. Wir tauschen uns mit Dir lieber persönlich bei einem virtuellen Kaffee oder einem Besuch vor Ort in unserer Bürovilla aus.
‍
Be Nelta. Be more.

job.title: QA Manual Engineer
job.description:
We are looking for a Quality Assurance (QA) engineer to develop and execute exploratory and automated tests to ensure product quality. QA engineer responsibilities include designing and implementing tests, debugging and defining corrective actions. You will also review system requirements and track quality assurance metrics (e.g. defect densities and open defect counts.) The QA technician role plays an important part in our company’s product development process. Our ideal candidate will be responsible for conducting tests before product launches to ensure software runs smoothly and meets client needs, while being cost-effective. If you hold an engineering background and enjoy providing end-to-end solutions to software quality problems, we’d like to meet you. Ultimately, you should monitor all stages of software development to identify and resolve system malfunctions to meet quality standards.

Responsibilities

  • Review requirements, specifications and technical design documents to provide timely and meaningful feedback
  • Create detailed, comprehensive and well-structured test plans and test cases
  • Estimate, prioritize, plan and coordinate testing activities
  • Identify, record, document thoroughly and track bugs
  • Develop and apply testing processes for new and existing products to meet client needs
  • Liaise with internal teams (e.g. developers and product managers) to identify system requirements
  • Track quality assurance metrics, like defect densities and open defect counts

Requirements

  • Proven work experience in software development
  • Proven work experience in software quality assurance
  • Strong knowledge of software QA methodologies, tools and processes
  • Experience in writing clear, concise and comprehensive test plans and test cases
  • Hands-on experience with both white box and black box testing
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process
  • Experience with performance and/or security testing is a plus
  • BS/MS degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related subject

Benefits

How we work

Our engineers build with AI every day. Claude Code, Codex, and similar tools are part of the standard toolchain here, not an experiment. We run an automated audit across the whole codebase on day one and every day after, grading security, cost, and architecture findings by severity with the exact file and line, so a small team can move quickly without quality drifting. We stay vendor-neutral across OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-weight models, and we run Valkyrie, our own production layer, when a single interface to any model is the right call.

About Azumo

Azumo is a San Francisco based software development company that has been building intelligent applications since 2016. We provide nearshore AI engineering teams to organizations that need production AI faster than they can hire for it: as an embedded engineering team, as AI staff augmentation alongside an existing team, or as a full project build. Our engineers work from Latin America, aligned to United States time zones, and have delivered for Twitter, Meta, Discovery Channel, Omnicom, UnitedHealth, and CENTEGIX.

We hire for seniority and test for it before anyone joins a client team. We support engineers in going deep on the modern AI stack, and we give time back to open-source work, community teaching, and philanthropy.

Apply at or write to us at .

The QA Engineer will be based remotely. Compensation commensurate with experience and candidate potential.

Company benefits include:

  • Paid time off
  • U.S. Holidays
  • Training
  • Udemy free Premium access
  • Mentored career development
  • $US Remuneration
  • Profit Sharing

job.title: Community Game Tester (Paid, On-Call)
job.description:
Department: GBTN

Location: Remote (Work from Home)

About GBTN

GBTN is a community of gamers who help shape the future of video games. We partner with developers to test unreleased and in-development titles from the comfort of our members' homes.

Our community is essential for testing multiplayer games, verifying online infrastructure, and providing critical feedback on the user experience. If you are passionate about gaming and want a behind-the-scenes look at how games are made, this is a perfect opportunity for you.

The Role: What You'll Do

As a GBTN Community Tester, you will be invited to participate in paid, "on-call" test sessions. This is a highly flexible role with no set hours—you participate when you are available for an invited session.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Participating in scheduled game tests using your own personal hardware (PC, console, mobile device, VR headset, etc.) and internet connection from the comfort of your home
  • Stress-testing multiplayer servers and online features.
  • Evaluating games for user experience (UX), gameplay feel, and balance.
  • Identifying and clearly reporting bugs, glitches, and other technical issues.
  • Providing detailed, constructive feedback through surveys and written reports.

Please Note: This is Not a Job

This is not a full-time or part-time position. It is a flexible, paid, on-call role.

  • You will be paid for the specific test sessions you are invited to and choose to participate in.
  • This is an ideal role for students, gaming enthusiasts, retirees, or anyone looking to earn extra income while contributing to the gaming industry.

Confidentiality is Critical

Due to the sensitive, pre-release nature of the projects you will test, all GBTN members are required to sign a strict Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA).

  • You must not discuss any aspect of the tests, games, or materials with anyone outside of the GBTN program.
  • Breaching the NDA will result in immediate removal from the program and potential legal action.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking reliable, discreet, and passionate gamers to join our community.

Requirements:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Access to a stable, high-speed internet connection.
  • Own at least one gaming device (e.g., a PC, game console, mobile device, or VR headset).

job.title: Testing Strategy Manager
job.description:
Peraton Overview

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees do the can’t be done by solving the most daunting challenges facing our customers. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

Responsibilities

The Testing Strategy Manager (TSM) leads the development and execution of a comprehensive testing strategy for the Peraton CMS Fee‑for‑Service (FFS) healthcare program. This role focuses on advancing Agile testing practices, expanding test automation, and improving overall quality outcomes across three large, complex, mainframe‑based systems. The TSM collaborates closely with account leadership, delivery teams, and technical stakeholders to drive quality excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement.

Key Responsibilities

Testing Strategy & Planning

  • Develop and implement a holistic testing strategy aligned with Agile/DevOps methodologies and prioritizing automation across all testing phases.
  • Create, maintain, and execute detailed test plans, test cases, and test schedules across hardware and software platforms.
  • Define and communicate requirements for test environments, test data, and test cycles, collaborating with Infrastructure/Data Center teams.
  • Ensure adequate testing coverage prior to production releases and support production checkout planning through risk identification and mitigation.

Leadership & Team Management

  • Lead, mentor, and coach a team of 10–15 technical and business analyst resources, including performance monitoring and annual evaluations.
  • Provide technical leadership to Testing Engineers and promote a culture of collaboration, growth, and quality-minded thinking.

Automation & Process Improvement

  • Develop and champion strategies for increasing automation across the program, including test data automation approaches.
  • Implement and refine processes and procedures that enhance efficiency, productivity, and reduce redundancy.
  • Assist in establishing and measuring quality metrics to support process adoption and continuous improvement.

Risk, Defect, and Quality Management

  • Identify and communicate risks related to testing strategies, ensuring clear visibility into business impacts.
  • Analyze defects to support triage, drive resolution, and determine technical and business impacts.
  • Support and participate in design reviews, requirement walk‑throughs, quality assessments, and post‑release reviews.
  • Administer the problem management process, monitoring and reporting on problem resolution activities.

Cross‑Functional Collaboration

  • Work with account and program leadership to align testing strategy with system roadmaps, transformation efforts, and software development priorities.
  • Collaborate with Release PMs, Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Technical Leads on implementation planning and issue resolution.
  • Participate in requirements/user story reviews to ensure clarity, feasibility, and testability.

Strategic Insight & Recommendations

  • Provide recommendations on tools, technologies, and testing practices to improve efficiency and quality outcomes.
  • Help shape Quality Assurance policies, goals, and objectives in partnership with QA leadership.

Qualifications

Education & Experience

  • 10+ years of combined experience in software testing, automation, technical analysis, and business analysis.
  • 5+ years managing teams of 10+ resources.
  • Strong verbal and written communication and presentation skills.
  • CMS contract experience preferred.

Knowledge & Skills – Must have

  • Experience developing use cases, process flows, and related documentation.
  • Expertise in automated testing practices and tools, including TestRail, Open Text UFT, MS Scheduler, and WFTP Script Editor/Debugger.
  • Experience working in Agile environments and working with Confluence and Jira.
  • Strong relationship‑building abilities across QA, business, and technical teams.
  • Excellent analytical, diagnostic, and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent priorities.
  • Knowledge of mainframe testing and Automated testing.
  • Demonstrated success implementing test automation within Agile/DevOps environments.
  • Ability to translate between business and technical concepts and work independently or within distributed teams.
  • Proven ability to exercise sound judgment and influence teams toward common goals.

Knowledge & Skills – Nice to have

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • Knowledge of testing within mid-tier and cloud environments desired.
  • Mid‑tier and cloud testing experience desired.
  • Knowledge of AI Testing tools and Methodologies desired.
  • Prior CMS or Federal Government contract experience desired.
  • Prior health insurance experience desired.

Target Salary Range

$104,000 - $166,000. This represents the typical salary range for this position. Salary is determined by various factors, including but not limited to, the scope and responsibilities of the position, the individual’s experience, education, knowledge, skills, and competencies, as well as geographic location and business and contract considerations. Depending on the position, employees may be eligible for overtime, shift differential, and a discretionary bonus in addition to base pay.

Benefits Statement

Peraton offers eligible employees a variety of benefits including medical, dental, vision, life, health savings account, short/long term disability, EAP, parental leave, 401(k), paid time off (PTO) for vacation, and company paid holidays. A full listing of available benefits can be viewed at

Application Statements

The application period for the job is estimated to be 30 days from the job posting date. However, this timeline may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. By applying to this job, you are expressing interest in the role and the Company. During the review of your application, you may be required to participate in an on-camera interview, as well as participate in a process to verify your identity. Use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools of any kind during Peraton interviews is strictly prohibited unless the candidate has obtained prior written authorization. All interview responses must be the candidate’s own.

job.description:
Mobeta est une société de cybersécurité offensive qui combine pentesters humains, agents IA et éditeur de Rigma (plateforme de sécurité offensive continue).

Nous réalisons des tests d’intrusion ponctuels ou continus sur les surfaces externes et les environnements internes, avec Rigma pour piloter les vulnérabilités, suivre leur remédiation et revérifier les corrections dans le temps.

Nous recherchons un/une pentester senior afin de diriger techniquement notre équipe de pentest.

Selon le profil, ce poste peut permettre d'accéder au capital de la société via des BSPCE.

Vos missions

Missions pentest / Red Team

  • Réaliser de nombreux pentests sur divers environnements et applications : externes, web, internes, Cloud, etc. (vous n'aurez pas d'audit organisationnel) ;

  • Réaliser et encadrer nos campagnes de Red Team ;

  • Automatiser vos attaques dans notre plateforme Rigma.

Management de l'équipe pentest

  • Encadrer et faire monter en compétence les pentesters de l'équipe ;

  • Participer au recrutement des pentesters afin de construire une équipe cohérente avec notre ADN.

Rayonnement technique de Mobeta

  • Encadrer les sujets R&D de l'équipe pentest (blog posts, outils, recherche de 0-day) ;

  • Représenter Mobeta en conférences (talks).

Outillage technique & IA

  • Industrialisation et automatisation des phases répétitives du pentest ;

  • Veille active, capitalisation ;

  • Exploitation maximale de l'IA ;

  • Collaborer étroitement avec l’équipe produit et participer aux développements à intégrer dans Rigma.

La partie Missions Pentest / Red Team est prioritaire et indispensable, elle représentera, surtout au début, la majorité de votre temps de travail.

Les autres tâches seront intégrées au fur et à mesure de la montée en responsabilité.

Vos compétences

  • Expérience confirmée en pentest / Red Team ;

  • Maîtrise d’un langage de scripting ainsi que des principes de développement sécurisé ;

  • Capacité à encadrer et faire progresser une équipe ;

  • Passionné par la sécurité informatique et le pentest (challenges, CTF, etc.) ;

  • Utilisation intense de l'IA pour les usages concrets, notamment appliqués au pentest ;

  • Sens de l'organisation et de la rigueur, avec de fortes capacités d'analyse et rédactionnelles ;

  • Capacité à apprendre rapidement ;

  • Aisance à l’oral et capacité à restituer clairement des sujets techniques ;

  • Humble et fiable ;

  • Présence physique au moins partielle dans nos locaux à Paris.

  • Selon le profil, ce poste peut permettre d'accéder au capital de la société via des BSPCE ;

  • Monter en compétence dans un environnement stimulant, axé vers la performance des pentesters ;

  • Participer activement au développement d’une startup avec un produit innovant ;

  • Avantages classiques (mutuelle, prévoyance, transport, tickets restaurant) ;

  • Télétravail possible.

Requirements

  • Ability to understand complex systems, identify risk areas, and define effective testing approaches.

Considered an Advantage

  • Professional development – books, trainings, certifications, etc.;

job.title: QA Engineer (Remote locations)
job.description:
About Halborn Inc

Our mission is to provide value-add security services and products to the world’s most cutting edge technology firms and that starts with blockchain tech. Founded in 2019, Halborn is an elite cyber security company focused on solving complex adversarial problems unique to the cryptocurrency and fintech industries. From breaches and social engineering to stolen private keys and economic hacks, Halborn solves it. Our clientele are the exclusive blockchain companies as well as new startups with high growth trajectories.

Our Culture

Halborn is a globally distributed team of 100+, looking to grow our elite team of white hat hackers, sales professionals, security engineers and DevSecOps specialists who value independence, want to make their own hours, work for themselves and have a passion for the ever evolving cryptocurrency industry.

Our Commitment to Diversity

Halborn Inc is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, education, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics and celebrates the diversity of its growing team.

We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas at this time.

Recruitment agencies and consultants may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Halborn does not accept unsolicited agency resumes, and will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Halborn Inc.

Responsibilities

  • Own the test strategy for Halborn's internal engineering platforms and client-facing products, from unit and integration coverage through end-to-end and regression suites.
  • Design, build and maintain automated test suites in code — UI, API, and data-layer — and keep them fast, deterministic, and trusted by the engineers who depend on them.
  • Use LLM-assisted tooling to accelerate test authoring, generate edge cases from specs and diffs, triage failing runs, and summarize regressions for the team.
  • Build and tune quality gates in CI/CD so that broken builds never reach a client environment, and so that the feedback loop stays measured in minutes.
  • Identify manual QA processes and automate them out of existence — release checklists, environment setup, test data generation, smoke verification, reporting.
  • Reproduce, isolate, and file defects with unambiguous repro steps, expected versus actual behavior, and enough context for an engineer to fix it without a follow-up conversation.
  • Partner with security engineers to fold security regression checks — authentication, authorization, input handling, secrets exposure — into the standard pipeline.
  • Run performance, load, and reliability testing against services handling sensitive audit and engagement data.
  • Define and report the quality metrics that matter: escaped defect rate, flake rate, coverage of critical paths, and time to detection.
  • Contribute to release readiness decisions and act as an informed voice on whether something ships.

Qualifications

  • 3 to 5 years in QA engineering, SDET, or test automation, with a demonstrated shift from manual execution toward automated coverage.
  • Strong programming ability in at least one of TypeScript, JavaScript, or Python — you write test code that other engineers are willing to read and maintain.
  • Hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, pytest, or equivalent.
  • Practical API testing experience, including contract, integration, and negative-path testing against REST or GraphQL services.
  • Working knowledge of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, or similar) and comfort owning pipeline configuration yourself.
  • Daily, deliberate use of AI coding assistants and LLM tooling in your own workflow, with a clear point of view on where they help and where they must be verified.
  • Comfort with Git, containerized local environments, and reading application code to understand what you are testing rather than testing blind.
  • Excellent written communication — in a distributed, asynchronous team, a well-written bug report or test plan is the deliverable.
  • High autonomy and strong self-direction in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift.
  • Willingness to learn the technical aspects of blockchain, smart contracts, and cybersecurity.

Bonus Points

  • Experience testing Web3 applications — wallet flows, testnets, RPC interactions, or smart contract tooling such as Foundry or Hardhat.
  • Experience building evaluation harnesses for LLM-powered features, including regression testing of non-deterministic output.
  • Background in security testing, OWASP methodology, or hands-on time with tools like Burp Suite.
  • Performance and load testing with k6, Locust, JMeter, or similar.
  • Experience with observability tooling and using production telemetry to find gaps in test coverage.
  • Open source contributions to testing frameworks or developer tooling.
  • Knowledgeable of the latest trends in Blockchain and DeFi.

job.description:
About Fello:

Fello is a profitable, hyper-growth, VC-backed B2B SaaScompany building the AI Operating System for relationship-driven growth. Our platform combines data intelligence, marketing automation, and conversational AI to help businesses engage smarter, move faster, and scale effortlessly. We turn complex data into simple, intelligent actions — automating everything from outreach to follow-up. Fello isn’t another tool in the stack. It’s the system that powers them, learning, adapting, and executing in real time so professionals can focus on growth, not guesswork.

If you’re fired up about building the backbone of an AI-driven product that’s changing how professionals work, you’ll fit right in.

About You:

As a Senior QA Engineer (3 to 6 years of experience) at Fello, you will be responsible for ensuring quality across an AI-powered platform used by thousands of professionals. This is not typical web app testing. You will validate experiences where AI is embedded directly into workflows, from conversational systems to deep automation. You will partner closely with product and engineering teams to guarantee that every feature we ship is accurate, reliable, intuitive, and safe for real-world use. This role is ideal for someone who values ownership, attention to detail, and building a strong quality culture in an AI-first environment.   • Comfortable with issue tracking tools (Jira, Linear or similar)

  • Comfortable with context switching: our apps and projects move at different speeds, and you will often work on more than one at a time

Nice to have:

  • Wellness reimbursement: to help you live your healthiest life, we reimburse eligible wellness expenses such as subscriptions wellness apps, gym memberships, diet counseling and much more
  • Annual bonus based on company profit: when we have a good year, eligible employees receive a yearly bonus from the profit we made together

job.title: Test Manager (SAP S/4HANA Transformation)
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Test Manager with strong SAP S/4HANA transformation experience to lead the end-to-end testing workstream for a large-scale SAP S/4HANA transformation program.

The candidate will be responsible for defining the testing strategy, establishing governance frameworks, managing testing activities across business and IT teams, and ensuring quality delivery throughout the implementation lifecycle, including cutover, go-live, and hypercare.

The ideal candidate should have successfully managed at least one complete SAP S/4HANA transformation testing lifecycle, from test strategy and planning through execution and post-go-live support.

Roles & Responsibilities:

    • Define and own the end-to-end testing strategy for the SAP S/4HANA transformation program.

    • Establish testing governance, standards, processes, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms.

    • Lead and manage all testing phases, including:

      • System Integration Testing (SIT)

      • End-to-End Testing (E2E)

      • User Acceptance Testing (UAT)

      • Regression Testing

      • Cutover and Go-Live Validation

      • Hypercare Support

      • Coordinate testing activities across business teams, IT teams, system integrators, and third-party vendors.

      • Manage test scope, schedules, risks, dependencies, defects, and overall test readiness.

      • Monitor testing progress and provide regular status reports to senior management and key stakeholders.

      • Define and drive the test automation strategy for SAP S/4HANA implementation and post-go-live operations.

      • Establish and maintain an automation backlog, including identifying and prioritizing automation opportunities.

      • Collaborate with the Test Factory team to improve automation coverage and testing efficiency.

      • Drive continuous improvement in testing processes, quality standards, and delivery methodologies.

      • Provide testing progress, quality risk assessments, and recommendations to support Go/No-Go decisions.

      • Lead stakeholder discussions and ensure alignment between business, IT, and delivery teams.

Key Skills – Mandatory

    • 10+ years of overall experience in Software Testing and Test Management.

    • Strong experience in SAP S/4HANA Transformation Testing.

    • Must have led the testing workstream for at least one complete SAP S/4HANA implementation/transformation program.

    • Hands-on experience managing the complete testing lifecycle, from test strategy and planning to execution, cutover, go-live, and hypercare.

    • Strong expertise in Test Strategy, Test Planning, Test Governance, and Test Management.

    • Experience managing SIT, E2E, UAT, Regression, and Cutover Testing.

    • Experience managing testing teams, system integrators, third-party vendors, and cross-functional stakeholders.

    • Strong knowledge of defect management, risk management, test metrics, KPIs, and reporting.

    • Experience defining test automation strategies and managing automation backlogs.

    • Ability to work with Test Factory teams to improve automation coverage and efficiency.

    • Excellent stakeholder management, leadership, communication, and decision-making skills.

Key Skills – Preferred

    • Azure DevOps (ADO).

    • qTest.

    • Tricentis Tosca.

    • ISTQB Test Manager certification or equivalent testing certifications.

    • Experience working on global SAP transformation programs.

    • Experience with Agile methodologies and continuous improvement practices.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
job.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Identity Security Pillar

Our Identity Security organization keeps Okta customers safe by detecting, preventing, and responding to identity-based attacks in real time, at the scale of the world's largest Identity Cloud. We have multiple open positions across teams that own:

  • Identity Threat Protection (ITP) and Identity Security Posture Management (ISPM), including the integration of Permiso's non-human identity and cloud entitlement risk detection into Okta's threat detection stack
  • Essential Security, the core threat detection and protection capabilities every Okta customer relies on, including Threat Insight, the Orbit detection engine, enriched proxy/anonymizer intelligence, breached-credential detection (SpyCloud), Attack Protection, and Adaptive OIE

You'll work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineers who care deeply about shipping high-quality, resilient detection systems that hold up under real-world attack traffic and that customers can trust to keep their organizations safe.

Senior Software Engineer in Test - Identity Security (Multiple Positions)

We seek experienced Senior Software Engineers in Test to join our Identity Security engineering teams. You'll own test strategy and automation for real-time detection pipelines, risk signal correlation, and third-party integrations, and ensure new capabilities ship with zero-debt quality across every new cell and platform upgrade. Team placement will be based on experience and business needs.

Job Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Review requirements and design specs to develop test plans and test cases for detection, protection, and posture management features
  • Own end-to-end test coverage for complex signal and product integrations, including data ingestion, risk signal correlation, and detection pipelines (e.g., ITP-Permiso integration)
  • Automate API, end-to-end, and reliability/scale tests for real-time detection pipelines (Kafka → KDA → DynamoDB & BigTable)
  • Simulate real-world attack vectors, generate synthetic load, and benchmark latency for detection pipelines
  • Validate new cell rollouts across OIE orgs (e.g., Orbit enforcement, Threat Insight detection, ITP/ISPM features, data-lake IP allowlists)
  • Own test support for platform-wide initiatives (e.g., Monolith Spring library upgrades) affecting Identity Security surfaces
  • Triage and drive resolution of P0 defects, working cross-functionally with product engineering and integrated partner teams
  • Continuously improve automated regression coverage, in partnership with development teams
  • Review application code, identify bugs and other areas of weakness, and architect tools for future coverage
  • Own release sign-off and respond to production issues, P0/P1 alerts, and customer issues during on-call rotation
  • Be a strong customer advocate with a strong quality DNA

Requirements:

  • Minimum of a Bachelor's degree in software engineering (or related)
  • 4+ years of SDET experience, with a deep focus on enterprise SaaS backend distributed systems, REST APIs, and asynchronous data pipelines
  • Experience in test engineering for enterprise-level software, ideally in the identity or security domain
  • Strong programming proficiency in Java or Python (TypeScript a plus)
  • Familiarity with automation and observability tools like Playwright, Selenium, TestCafe, API (Rest Assured, Karate, etc.), Postman, JMeter, Runscope, Splunk, Grafana, and AWS toolset
  • Hands-on experience testing event-driven or streaming platforms (e.g., Apache Kafka, Kinesis, KDA) and distributed databases/caches (e.g., DynamoDB, Redis, BigTable)
  • Experience with automation and testing of complex signal and product integrations
  • Expertise in test planning and cross-team collaborative efforts, including across integrated third-party or acquired tech stacks
  • Experience with continuous integration/continuous deployment (CI/CD) practices
  • Experience working with distributed systems at large scale
  • Able to write and review designs and code with other team members
  • Able to deliver well-designed, high-quality code on time

Nice to have:

  • Experience with threat detection, fraud, or attack/bot mitigation systems
  • Experience with cloud security posture management (CSPM) or identity security posture management (ISPM) concepts
  • Familiarity with non-human identity or entitlement risk models
  • Familiarity with third-party threat-intel integrations (e.g., breached credential feeds)
  • Experience integrating an acquired company's tech stack into an existing platform
  • Good understanding of IAM solutions along with SAML/OIDC protocols
  • Experience with AI-native Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) standards and practices

  • In enger Abstimmung mit Hardware- und Softwareentwicklern integrierst du einzelne Komponenten und Module zu vollständigen Flugfunkgeräten
  • Gemeinsam mit Hardware- und Softwareteams führst du Fehlersuchen und Root-Cause-Analysen durch
  • Testfälle definierst du, erstellst Testprozeduren und wertest Testergebnisse aus. Die Ergebnisse dokumentierst du in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Hardware- und Softwareteams
  • Messgeräte wie Oszilloskope, Signalgeneratoren oder Spektrumanalysatoren bindest du an Testumgebungen an und automatisierst deren Einsatz

Dein Profil

Folgende Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten solltest Du auf jeden Fall mitbringen:

  • Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Informatik, Elektrotechnik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Erfahrung in der hardwarenahen Softwareentwicklung sowie im Testen komplexer Systeme (z. B. Mikrocontroller, SoCs oder RF-/Funktechnik), idealerweise im militärischen oder sicherheitskritischen Umfeld, bringst du mit
  • Im Bereich Mobilfunk, insbesondere Datenübertragung, Netzwerke und ISO/OSI-Referenzmodell, verfügst du über fundierte Kenntnisse
  • Idealerweise konntest du bereits Erfahrungen in der Testautomatisierung sowie in der Entwicklung von Testframeworks sammeln
  • Fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau von CI/CD-Pipelines mit GitLab CI/CD sowie Kenntnisse in Container-Technologien (z. B. Docker oder Podman) zeichnen dich ausGute Programmierkenntnisse in C/C++ sowie Erfahrung mit CMake runden dein Profil ab
  • Mit Linux und Versionsverwaltungssystemen wie Git gehst du sicher um
  • Für die effektive Kommunikation im Projektumfeld sowie mit unseren deutschsprachigen Kunden ist ein sehr gutes mündliches und schriftliches Deutsch erforderlich.

Das bieten wir Dir

Wir sind der Überzeugung, dass folgende Rahmenbedingungen die besten Voraussetzungen für Effizienz und kreative Lösungsfindungen bieten:

  • Aktives Mitwirken an innovativen Zukunftstechnologien
  • Flexibles New-Work-Modell mit hybriden Arbeitsmöglichkeiten
  • Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag
  • Givve-Card als steuerfreier Unternehmensbenefit
  • Maximale Entscheidungs- und Gestaltungsspielräume
  • Individuelle Karriereplanung und Entwicklungsperspektiven
  • Wissenstransfer und Synergieeffekte durch ein starkes Team
  • Technologische Vielfalt mit spannenden Einblicken in sicherheitsrelevante Systeme

Und: Herausforderungen, die wirklich Spaß machen!

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
About us:

 

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

Since our launch, Proxify's developers have successfully worked with 1200+ happy clients to build their products and growth features. 5000+ talented developers trust Proxify and its network to fulfill their dreams and objectives.

Proxify is shaped by a global network of supportive, talented developers interested in remote full-time jobs. Our Glassdoor (4.5/5) and Trustpilot (4.8/5) ratings reflect the trust developers place in us and our commitment to our members' success.

 

The Role:

 

We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join one of our high-growth client teams as the primary architect of their quality assurance strategy. In this role, you will move beyond manual validation to build robust, scalable automation frameworks that ensure software reliability at high velocity.

You will be responsible for the entire testing lifecycle—from defining test strategies and selecting the right tools to integrating automated suites into modern CI/CD pipelines. This is a role for a "Developer in Test" who is passionate about building invisible safety nets that empower development teams to ship code with total confidence.

 

 

What we are looking for:

  • 5+ years of experience in test automation, with deep expertise in modern frameworks like Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium.
  • Strong ability to write clean, maintainable test code in TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, or Java.
  • Proven track record of building and scaling automation frameworks from scratch (Page Object Model, Screenplay Pattern, etc.).
  • Extensive experience testing RESTful and GraphQL APIs using tools like Postman, SuperTest, or RestAssured.
  • Hands-on experience integrating automated tests into pipelines using GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Jenkins.
  • Experience with mobile automation using Appium or Maestro is a significant advantage.
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools like k6 or JMeter to identify system bottlenecks.

 

Nice-to-Have:

  • Knowledge of Docker for containerized testing environments.
  • Experience with Visual Regression testing tools (Percy, Applitools).
  • Familiarity with Cloud Testing platforms (BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, AWS Device Farm).
  • Background in Security Testing (OWASP principles).

 

Responsibilities:

  • Define the overall automation roadmap and select the appropriate tools to match the client's technical stack.
  • Write, maintain, and optimize complex end-to-end (E2E) integration and regression test suites.
  • Partner with Developers and Product Managers to define "Definition of Done" and ensure testability is considered during the design phase.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects, working closely with the dev team to ensure rapid resolution.
  • Act as the "Quality Evangelist" within the team, conducting code reviews for test scripts and sharing best practices in automated testing.

job.title: Profee ED Auditor/QA Specialist
job.description:
GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is a leading provider of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Risk Adjustment services, helping healthcare organizations optimize operations, improve financial performance, maintain compliance, and enhance the patient experience. Recognized as a KLAS® Top Performer, GeBBS combines innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence to deliver measurable results for clients across the healthcare industry. We are dedicated to being a trusted healthcare partner by upholding the highest standards of quality, information security, and compliance.

At GeBBS, we foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture where employees are empowered to develop their skills, advance their careers, and make a meaningful impact in transforming healthcare.

Remote (United States) | Full-Time | Monday–Friday | Flexible Schedule

Position Overview

GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is seeking an experienced Professional Fee (ProFee) Emergency Department Coding Auditor / QA Specialist to join our remote team.

This position is responsible for conducting comprehensive audits of professional Emergency Department coding, with a strong emphasis on ED Evaluation & Management (E/M) leveling, procedure coding, documentation accuracy, and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate will have a proven background in ProFee ED auditing, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to identify coding discrepancies, provide actionable feedback, and support ongoing quality improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform detailed audits of Professional Fee Emergency Department encounters, ensuring accurate E/M leveling, procedure coding, and appropriate code assignment.
  • Conduct onboarding coding reviews and quality assessments to support client-specific requirements and standards.
  • Review medical documentation for compliance with ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, and applicable payer guidelines.
  • Identify coding discrepancies, documentation deficiencies, missed charges, and opportunities for improved accuracy and compliance.
  • Apply current and historical E/M documentation guidelines, including 1995, 1997, and updated 2021 and subsequent guidelines, as applicable to the services being audited.
  • Prepare accurate audit reports, summarize findings, and provide recommendations for corrective action.
  • Collaborate with coding teams, leadership, and clients to communicate audit findings and support quality improvement initiatives.
  • Assist with coder and provider education, including clarification of coding guidelines, documentation requirements, and audit findings.
  • Maintain established quality and productivity standards while meeting client deadlines.
  • Stay current with regulatory updates, coding changes, and Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional coding auditing experience, specifically involving ProFee Emergency Department services.
  • Active CEMC and/or CPC certification required.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Professional Fee ED E/M leveling and procedure coding — both are required.
  • Strong understanding of Emergency Department documentation, medical necessity, modifier usage, and appropriate code assignment.
  • Comprehensive knowledge of ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, and applicable coding and billing regulations.
  • Knowledge of E/M documentation guidelines and current coding requirements.
  • Experience conducting detailed coding audits, identifying discrepancies, and providing constructive feedback.
  • Ability to independently complete manual or technology-assisted coding audits.
  • Excellent analytical, organizational, written, and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, including Excel and Word.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities, maintain accuracy, and consistently meet productivity expectations.
  • Must reside in the United States and be available to work Monday through Friday.

Preferred Qualifications

  • CPMA certification.
  • Additional AHIMA credentials such as CCS-P, RHIA, or RHIT.
  • Experience with Revenue Integrity and Charge Capture.
  • Experience providing coder or physician education and communicating audit findings to stakeholders.
  • Familiarity with client-specific onboarding reviews, quality assurance processes, and performance reporting.

Schedule & Performance Expectations

  • Employment Type: Full-Time, 40 hours per week.
  • Work Location: 100% Remote (United States).
  • Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8 hours per day.
  • Flexible Working Hours: Following completion of client onboarding, employees may work their daily 8-hour schedule between 5:00 AM and 9:00 PM, based on applicable scheduling requirements. A consistent daily start time is not required.
  • Productivity Requirement: Minimum 10 encounters per hour (EPH).

Why Join GeBBS?

At GeBBS Healthcare Solutions, you'll have the opportunity to apply your specialized auditing expertise while contributing to coding accuracy, compliance, and continuous quality improvement. We offer a collaborative remote environment where your knowledge and attention to detail make a meaningful difference.

If you are an experienced ProFee Emergency Department Auditor with strong E/M leveling and procedure coding expertise, we encourage you to apply!

job.title: Regional Quality Assurance Lead (Korea)
job.description:
Job Description

Agilent Korea. The statutory and operational responsibilities associated with the Korea Quality Manager role will be the primary responsibility of this position. Additional regional responsibilities may also be performed to provide oversight, processes, and tools to the operating companies and channel partners (importers, distributors, sellers/resellers, dealers, service providers, sales & marketing agents) who execute commercial quality activities for Agilent in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region.

This role involves working with cross-functional teams to execute, improve, maintain and monitor these regional quality activities. The Manager will report directly to the International Quality Lead. The candidate must meet the applicable statutory qualification requirements to serve as the registered Quality Manager for IVD medical devices in South Korea.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Overview

The Manager, Regional Quality Assurance (QA) will serve as the registered IVD Medical Device Quality Manager(품질책임자) for Agilent Korea. The statutory and operational responsibilities associated with the Korea Quality Manager(품질책임자) role will be the primary responsibility of this position. Additional regional responsibilities may also be performed to provide oversight, processes, and tools to the operating companies and channel partners (importers, distributors, sellers/resellers, dealers, service providers, sales & marketing agents) who execute commercial quality activities for Agilent in the Asia Pacific (APAC) region.

This role involves working with cross-functional teams to execute, improve, maintain and monitor these regional quality activities. The Manager will report directly to the International Quality. The candidate must meet the applicable statutory qualification requirements to serve as the registered Quality Manager(품질책임자) for IVD medical devices in South Korea.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Main Responsibilities (as South Korea Registered Medical Device and IVD Quality Manager(품질책임자))

  • Manage and strengthen governance and quality systems of Agilent Korea IVD Import License Model against the MFDS regulations. Current model: warehouse (storage) and testing (inspection/lab) activities are outsourced.
  • Responsible for key commercial quality activities: outsourced warehouse oversight, contractual agreement, testing review, product quality inspection, product release approval, inspection/audit readiness, deviation/CAPA management, and post market activities.
  • Maintain Korea QMS documentation and records: procedures, document change records, communication records, facility maintenance records, equipment maintenance/calibration/repair records, customer complaints, deviations, corrective/preventive actions, training records, test and inspection records, and product release records.
  • Perform and/or host audits and inspections, including MFDS Audits for various licenses, Warehouse Audits, and KGMP Audit on registered Agilent manufacturing sites.
  • Provide training to relevant Korea personnel on Commercial Quality requirements, procedures and responsibilities.
  • Receive the mandatory 8-hour training annually per MFDS requirement.
  • Prepare Medical Devices reports, including Import Annual Reports(의료기기 실적보고) and Pre-Import Reports (표준통관예정보고).

Additional Regional Responsibilities

  • Establish QMS processes and tools systems to ensure consistent execution of commercial quality activities across APAC region.
  • Negotiate quality agreements and/or the quality elements of contracts with the APAC operating companies and channel partners to ensure accountability.
  • Direct customer-reported quality signals and feedback related to commercial activities to the International Quality to coordinate the correct QMS processes for issue management and escalation.
  • Support regional audits/inspections, and internal reviews related to commercial quality processes.
  • Partner with regulatory and regional teams to identify quality activities performed by other functions and establish communication channels and community of practice.
  • Enable consistent quality execution across markets and commercial organizations in APAC through processes and training programs.
  • Assist in a risk-based approach for oversight of compliance and the health of the commercial quality processes.
  • Track APAC regional commercial quality issues, trends, and risks.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor of Science (BS or BSc) degree in Engineering, Science, Life Science, Medical, Clinical Laboratory Science, or another relevant technical discipline is required, or directly equivalent experience in Quality Assurance. The candidate must meet the applicable statutory qualification requirements to serve as the registered Quality Manager (품질책임자) for IVD medical devices in South Korea. Eligibility must be verified before appointment.
  • Advanced degrees, including an MBA or a relevant professional certification in Quality Management, Engineering, Life Sciences, Medical Devices, or Regulatory Affairs are preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum of 8 years’ experience in Quality Assurance, Regulatory Affairs, and Commercial Quality, including substantial hands-on experience in medical device or IVD Quality Assurance and import quality operations.
  • Prior experience serving as, or directly supporting, a registered Quality Manager (품질책임자) for a medical device or IVD manufacturer or importer in South Korea is strongly preferred.
  • Experienced in Regulated Product Environments, such as Medical Devices, In-Vitro Diagnostic Devices (IVDs), BioPharma, or other related Life Science industry, with medical device or IVD experience strongly preferred.
  • Experienced in conducting and/hosting audits and inspections, with strong knowledge of applicable Korean medical device and IVD requirements, KGMP, and relevant international standards and regulations, including US FDA CFRs, EU IVDR, MDSAP requirements, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, ISO 9001, and the application to establish a strong QMS.

Essential Skills

  • Professional proficiency in Korean and English, including the ability to read, interpret, and prepare regulatory and quality documentation.
  • Strong understanding of both International and APAC country-specific compliance considerations, including and not limited to South Korea, Japan, Australia/New Zealand, Singapore, Malaysia, and Thailand.
  • Experience working cross functionally with Marketing, Sales, Commercial Compliance, Legal Compliance, Field Service, Regulatory, and Quality teams.
  • Proven ability to manage risks and ensure consistency across regional organizations. Escalate issues promptly and concisely into the International Quality Lead.
  • Proven ability to take independent actions to initiate process improvement. Align actions accordingly with the International Quality.
  • Ability to engage, influence, and negotiate with stakeholders, including business group leaders and peers, in a matrixed environment.
  • Able to lead and manage the execution of processes, projects and programs within the APAC region.
  • Well-organized, able to multitask and prioritize competing tasks.
  • Advanced MS Office skills (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Basic AI knowledge to facilitate efficiencies in day-to-day responsibilities (e.g. custom reports/dashboards, visualizations in analytical tools, metrics and data presentation).

Additional Details

This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: Technologies Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other protected categories under all applicable laws.

job.title: Software QA Manager
job.description:
Why is Health Advocate a great place to work? For starters, Health Advocate employees enjoy helping people every single day. Employees are given the training they need to do their jobs well, and they work with supervisors and staff who are supportive and friendly. Employees have room to grow, and many of Health Advocate's supervisors are promoted from within the company. Join our award winning team!

2025:

  • Stevie® Awards for Sales & Customer Service: Customer Service Department of the Year – Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, and Related Industries, Bronze Winner

2024:

  • Excellence in Customer Service Awards: Organization of the Year (Small)

  • Stevie® Awards for Sales & Customer Service: Customer Service Department of the Year – Healthcare, Pharmaceuticals, and Related Industries, Bronze Winner

  • Best in Biz Awards: Most Customer-Friendly Company of the Year – Medium and large category (Silver)

As part of Teleperformance in the US, we were also named #95 in the 2024 ‘Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For®’ in the USA by Great Places to Work (GPTW®)

Help People. Grow a Team. Build Better Software.


Do you enjoy using technology to make a difference in people’s lives? Are you a hands-on technical leader who enjoys developing others and continuing to learn? At Health Advocate, you can help build software that makes it easier for people to navigate healthcare and access the support they need.


We’re looking for a Software QA Manager who can balance business priorities with technical improvements and innovation. You’ll lead our company-wide QA team, including offshore employees, and shape how we test and improve our applications and services. You’ll bring the judgment to decide where automation adds value, where deeper investigation is needed, and how to make the best use of the team’s time.


This role combines people leadership with hands-on engineering. You should be comfortable discussing product risks with business leaders, coaching a QA engineer, reviewing automation code, and investigating an issue across the full application stack.


Experienced SDETs and QA technical leads with demonstrated experience leading technical staff are encouraged to apply.


Key Responsibilities


Lead and Develop the QA Team

· Manage all QA employees, including offshore resources, with clear expectations, work assignments, feedback, and accountability.

· Assess individual and team capabilities, identify skill gaps, and establish training and development plans.

· Mentor staff in testing techniques, automation, troubleshooting, and effective collaboration.

· Conduct performance reviews and support hiring, onboarding, and career development.

· Coordinate work across locations and time zones, establishing effective communication and handoffs.


Set Strategy and Balance Priorities

· Lead QA planning across Health Advocate’s software portfolio.

· Evaluate and prioritize requests for QA support based on business value, product risk, delivery commitments, and available capacity.

· Balance immediate delivery needs with investments in automation, technical improvements, and new testing approaches.

· Review existing test cases, automated suites, environments, test data, and documentation to identify gaps, duplication, and maintenance needs.

· Develop a long-term QA improvement plan with clear priorities, resource needs, and measures of progress.

· Communicate staffing constraints and technical tradeoffs, recommending practical options to leadership.


Guide Full Stack Testing and Automation

· Create and review test strategies and test plans covering the full application stack, including user interfaces, APIs, services, databases, servers, connectivity, and integrations.

· Validate complete user workflows, data integrity, and interactions between systems—not just individual components.

· Design and guide maintainable automation for web, API, Windows desktop, and mobile products, drawing on team expertise where needed.

· Write, review, debug, and maintain automation code to establish sound practices and support staff development.

· Guide functional, exploratory, integration, regression, performance, and load testing.

· Investigate failures across application layers using logs, database queries, service responses, and other diagnostic evidence.

· Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and improve the reliability and usefulness of test results.

· Oversee the availability, reliability, and maintenance of test environments, test data, and testing infrastructure, including automation frameworks and test execution systems for cloud-hosted and other applications.

· Evaluate and apply AI tools to improve testing, automation, analysis, and documentation, reviewing their outputs for accuracy and usefulness.


Partner on Product Quality and Release Readiness

· Work with product, design, and engineering teams throughout development to clarify expected behavior and identify risks early.

· Promote shared responsibility for quality, including developer-owned testing and close collaboration with QA.

· Execute tests and perform exploratory testing to understand products, investigate issues, and guide the team.

· Ensure test coverage reflects realistic usage, failure conditions, and business-critical workflows.

· Communicate defects, coverage gaps, dependencies, and release risks clearly.

· Review regression, performance, and load test results, assess unresolved risks, and provide evidence-based release readiness assessments and actionable recommendations.


Required Qualifications

· Must reside in the United States.

· A completed bachelor’s degree or higher.

· Substantial software QA experience, including hands-on automation design and implementation.

· Experience managing technical employees or serving as a technical team lead responsible for work assignments, mentoring, and delivery accountability.

· Experience managing or leading offshore technical resources and coordinating work across time zones.

· Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, with the ability to write, review, debug, and maintain automation code.

· Full-stack testing experience spanning user interfaces, APIs, backend services, databases, and system integrations.

· Ability to investigate issues involving application servers, connectivity, data flow, and dependencies.

· Experience designing and executing performance and load tests and interpreting the results.

· Experience testing cloud-hosted applications or services; no specific cloud provider is required.

· Working knowledge of database querying and data validation.

· Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, defect management, and software delivery practices.

· Practical experience using AI tools professionally, including prompting AI assistants to support coding, testing, analysis, or documentation.

· Ability to assess technical capabilities, prioritize competing needs, and balance business commitments with technical improvements.

· Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with technical teams and business leaders.


Preferred Qualifications

· A degree in a technical or quantitative field, such as Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Physics, or Chemistry.

· Formal people-management experience, including performance reviews, hiring, and career development.

· Experience working with Git repositories and version control workflows.

· Experience testing and automating Windows desktop applications.

· Mobile application testing and automation experience.

· Security and privacy testing experience.

· Familiarity with HIPAA and practices for handling protected health information (PHI).

· Experience improving QA practices across multiple products or teams.

· Experience with Selenium, Cucumber or other BDD frameworks, TestNG, Appium, BrowserStack, Postman, or comparable testing tools is preferred.


Initial Priorities

· Assess QA staff capabilities and identify training and development needs.

· Evaluate active and incoming requests for QA support and recommend priorities and staffing assignments.

· Review existing test cases, automation, environments, and other testing assets.

· Develop a long-term plan that balances near-term delivery needs with improvements in quality, automation, and team effectiveness.


Why Health Advocate?

At Health Advocate, technology is at the heart of how we help people navigate healthcare and get the support they need. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to lead and develop a QA team while directly influencing the quality, reliability, and performance of software that supports our members and clients.


You’ll join an environment where you can stay close to the technology while also shaping people, processes, and strategy. Whether you’re improving automation, strengthening testing practices, exploring how AI can make the team more effective, or helping determine whether a product is ready to release, your work will have a direct connection to the experience we provide to the people who rely on us.


If you’re looking for a leadership role where you can help people, grow a technical team, and build better software, Health Advocate offers the opportunity to do all three.


Salary Range: Up to $140,000 annually based on experience and education.


Physical Requirements:
This position is primarily sedentary, requiring prolonged sitting while performing administrative tasks. The role involves extensive use of a computer for typing, mouse navigation, and reading information on a screen for extended periods. Frequent phone use is required for communication with team members, clients, or external parties. Essential physical functions include fingering, grasping, pulling hand-over-hand, and repetitive motions necessary for navigating software, entering data, and interacting with electronic documents.


Mental and Cognitive Requirements:
The role requires strong concentration, attention to detail, and the ability to complete tasks accurately. Critical thinking and problem-solving skills are essential to address issues that may arise in day-to-day duties. Effective verbal and written communication skills are needed for responding to inquiries and collaborating with others.


Work Environment:
This position is fully remote and requires a home office environment with appropriate lighting, a computer, and phone access. The workspace should be free from distractions to ensure effective focus and productivity during work hours.

Company Overview

Health Advocate is the nation’s leading provider of health advocacy, navigation, well-being and integrated benefits programs. For 20 years, Health Advocate has provided expert support to help our members navigate the complexities of healthcare and achieve the best possible health and well-being. Our solutions leverage a unique combination of best-in-class, personalized support with powerful predictive data analytics and a proprietary technology platform to address nearly every clinical, administrative, wellness or behavioral health need. Whether facing common issues or an unprecedented challenge like COVID-19, our team of highly trained, compassionate experts work together to go above and beyond expectations, making healthcare easier for our members and ensuring they get the care they need.

Learn more
