job.title: Senior QA Engineer
job.description:
Skylight is a technology startup building the OS of the family. We make Skylight Calendar, the smart calendar loved by millions of families (plus Wired and the Wirecutter). Our latest product is Calendar 2, which just launched to rave reviews.

Our mission is to connect loved ones by creating the world’s simplest products and services that improve family life. Our founders are former venture capitalists and serial entrepreneurs who have scaled this business to $300M+ in annual revenue while being completely bootstrapped and profitable. We get to grow a happy, healthy company focused on making products our customers love without investors breathing down our necks.

Smart, hardworking people who care about making actually meaningful products love working here. People like you. We’re busy inventing new ways to simplify family life and help parents raise great kids – and we need your help! Come invent something new with us.

About the Role:We’re seeking a Senior QA Engineer to lead quality efforts across in-app purchasing and subscription lifecycles, while also contributing to the quality of our broader mobile app experience. You will be performing exploratory testing, automated testing, and bug reporting within a cross-functional team. This is a highly collaborative role and requires excellent verbal and written communication.

This might be the perfect role for you if you are excited by:

  • Working within a team that values feedback and gives it openly and regularly.
  • Being embedded in an engineering team where quality is a shared responsibility.
  • Having a valued and sought after opinion when it comes to project scope and design.
  • Developing a deep empathy for our users and advocating for their experience.
  • Contributing to a product that our customers genuinely love because it solves real, everyday problems for busy families and neurodiverse kids and adults (the ADHD and Autism communities are among our biggest fans).

Responsibilities:

  • Collaborating with product and engineering during project scoping and refinement to identify risk and establish test plans.
  • Validating in-app purchase flows, subscription lifecycles and integrations with third-party payment systems on Android + iOS devices.
  • Performing exploratory testing of mobile app features and user experiences beyond subscriptions and payments.
  • In partnership with engineering, define, design, implement, and maintain automated tests across and between our tech stacks (mobile, hardware, and web).
  • Testing Android-based software running on custom hardware and firmware.
  • Collaborating with QA team members across domains to improve testing efficiency and foster a sustainable workload amongst the team.

Requirements

  • Extensive experience (5+ years) in independently assessing quality risks, making informed testing decisions, and influencing product outcomes
  • Experience testing in-app purchases, subscription lifecycle management, and third-party payment integrations on Android + iOS devices
  • Strong understanding of the SDLC, Agile testing, and software testing methodologies
  • Clear and effective verbal and written communication
  • Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills
  • Proven ability to apply systems-level thinking to business requirements through the lens of the customer experience
  • History of contributing to automated tests on Android + iOS platforms

Benefits

Our competitive compensation package includes:

  • Competitive Salary + Equity Package
  • 401K matching
  • Wellness, learning, and home-office budgets
  • Health, Dental & Vision Medical Plans
  • Tremendous autonomy to set the direction of your work
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Company holidays on the first Friday of every month (Except November & December)

Equal opportunity employer

Skylight is committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other factor protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws. If you’re the best person for the job, we want you on board!

We hire across the U.S., but for legal reasons, we have to list NY and CO separately.

For Colorado-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $150-$170K based on experience and for California-based candidates, the range being offered for this role is $150-$170K based on experience. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider employment for qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of this law.

This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training.

job.title: Senior Manager, Software Quality Assurance
job.description:
As a global medtech company, we are driven by our Vision of changing the trajectory of lives for a new day and our Mission to create ingenious solutions that ignite patient turnarounds. Our relentless commitment to patients and strong legacy of innovation in healthcare are the foundation of our future. If you're looking for a new chance, a new beginning, a new trajectory, LivaNova is where your talent can truly thrive. Join our talented team members worldwide to become a pioneer of tomorrow—because at LivaNova, we don’t just treat conditions — we aspire to alter the course of lives.


Senior Manager, Software Quality Assurance

Pay Transparency: A reasonable estimate of the annual base salary for this position is $150,000 - $175,000 plus discretionary annual bonus. Pay ranges may vary by location.


As our Senior Manager, Software Quality Assurance, you will lead the software quality function while applying hands-on software development knowledge to ensure product software, firmware, and digital health platform services are designed, developed, verified, validated, and released in compliance with applicable quality system procedures. You will provide strategic and operational leadership to software quality engineers, drive continuous improvement in software quality processes, and ensure robust risk management throughout the software lifecycle.


You and your team will partner with key stakeholders to provide cross-functional support, contribute to design history file content, and, where applicable to you areas of expertise, lead post-market product investigations, CAPAs, and provide audit support.. This is a full-time, remote position and may include up to 25% travel.


This is an opportunity to directly impact product quality and the improve user experience. LivaNova is a growing, cutting-edge, medical device company specializing in neuromodulation product the enrich patients lives.


What You'll Do

  • Team Leadership and Development: Recruit, mentor, coach, and develop software quality engineers. Lead the software and firmware quality function for product software and cloud infrastructure, including the digital health platform.
  • Design Control Oversight: Ensure the completeness and sufficiency of design requirements, architecture specifications, detailed design specifications, code review evidence, verification and validation evidence, risk management files, and traceability.
  • Change Control Governance: Chair or oversee software change control boards and defect management processes. Communicate V&V results to management, including summaries of outcomes and known software anomalies.
  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Build strategic alignment with partner organizations, including R&D, Regulatory, Operations, Security, Marketing, and Clinical.
  • Risk Management Stewardship: Maintain working knowledge of program hazard analyses, FMEAs, security risk assessments, risk management reports, and post-market lifecycle risk documentation.
  • Technical Decision-Making: Approve complex investigations, technical assessments, code-related quality conclusions, and quality-critical decisions. Manage the team to ensure on-time delivery of investigations, CAPAs, and audit responses.
  • Quality Management System Ownership: Maintain and improve software development, test, and change management procedures, as well as best practices for digital health platform management.
  • Manufacturing Software Validation: Demonstrate a deep understanding of validation requirements and processes. Ensure team members support compliant validation of manufacturing and test system software as part of new product development programs.
  • Audit and Inspection Readiness: Serve as a senior SME during internal audits and external regulatory inspections. Ensure the team delivers efficient, complete design history files with the elements necessary to demonstrate compliance.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate software quality status, risks, and mitigation strategies to senior leadership. Organize and support cross-functional efforts in the event of field actions.
  • Continuous Improvement: lead initiatives that strengthen software quality processes, tools, and metrics.

Your Background and Experience

The following represent the minimum qualifications:

  • Engineering Degree — BS in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. Advanced Degree Preferred — MS or higher in engineering or a software-related discipline preferred.
  • 8+ years of medical device experience and 3+ years of prior team management experience.
  • Medical Device Software and Quality Expertise: Deep knowledge of software development principles, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, FDA QMSR, ISO 14971, and cybersecurity requirements.
  • Demonstrated experience developing software or firmware in the medical device industry, combined with software quality leadership experience and demonstrated proficiency with IEC 62304 requirements. Candidates must possess technical capability in software development, preferably C or C#, including the ability to assess code reviews, software defects, verification results, and CAPA conclusions.
  • Strategic Quality Planning; Risk Management Leadership; Audit Expertise; Ability to lead strategy and provide technical direction for complex software investigations, CAPAs, quality decisions, and development-related risk assessments.

What We Can Offer You

At LivaNova, you'll help change the trajectory of lives for a new day while working alongside passionate teams dedicated to delivering impactful innovation for patients worldwide.


We offer:

  • A role in an innovative medical technology environment that supports professional growth and development.
  • Opportunities to collaborate with international partners and cross-functional teams to bring life-changing solutions to patients.
  • A culture grounded in Empowered Accountability, Curious Mindset, Constructive Collaboration, and Thoughtful Humility.
  • Competitive compensation and an inspiring place to work.

If you're inspired by purpose-driven work, meaningful innovation, and the opportunity to bring New Life in Action every day, we encourage you to apply. We look forward to hearing from you.

Valuing different backgrounds:

LivaNova values equality and diversity. We are committed to ensuring that our recruitment process is fair, transparent and free from unlawful discrimination. Our selection process is driven by the key demands/requirements for the role rather than bias or discrimination on the basis of a candidate’s sex, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, non-job-related disability/handicap or medical condition, family status, sexual orientation, religion, color, ethnicity, race or any other legally protected classification.


Notice to third party agencies:

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters or employment agencies. In the absence of a signed Recruitment Services Agreement, we will not consider, or agree to, payment of any referral compensation or recruiter fee. In the event that a recruiter or agency submits a resume or candidate without a previously signed agreement, we explicitly reserve the right to pursue and hire those candidate(s) without any financial obligation to the recruiter or agency.


Beware of Job Scams:

Please beware of potentially fraudulent job postings or suspicious recruiting activity by persons posing as LivaNova recruiters or employees. The scammers may attempt to solicit confidential, personal information, such as a social security number, or your financial information. LivaNova will never ask for fees prior/during/after the application process, nor will we ask for banking details or personal financial information in return for the assurance of employment. If you are concerned that an offer of employment might be a scam or that the recruiter is not legitimate, please verify by searching for “See Open Jobs” on , and check that all recruitment emails come from an @livanova.com email address.

job.title: Automation Test Engineer
job.description:
Overview

  • Tier One Technologies has an immediate need for a Test Automation Engineer to support our US Government client.
  • This will be a 100% remote position.
  • SELECTED CANDIDATES WITHOUT REQUIRED CLEARANCE WILL BE SUBJECT TO A FEDERAL GOVERNMENT BACKGROUND INVESTIGATION TO RECEIVE IT.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated testing solutions to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of complex applications and services.
  • Define automation test strategy and plans for products, systems, components, and major modifications, aligned with enterprise goals and delivery timelines.
  • Design, implement, and maintain robust UI, API, and integration test automation frameworks and suites.
  • Create, document, execute, and analyze complex test scenarios, including edge cases and failure-mode coverage, and communicate results to stakeholders.
  • Participate in final system integration and validation activities to identify functional, performance, and reliability issues.
  • Establish and maintain internal quality control standards, including reliability and regression programs, test data management, and traceability where needed.
  • Ensure testing procedures comply with required industry or organizational standards (security, accessibility, performance, SDLC controls, etc., as applicable).
  • Identify chronic or systemic issues in test coverage, tooling, environments, or process; propose and implement measurable improvements.
  • Provide actionable feedback and recommendations for product and design changes based on test outcomes and defect trends.
  • Collaborate across engineering teams to improve testability, observability, and defect prevention (shift-left quality).
  • Coordinate as needed with vendors or suppliers to support component-level test approaches, tooling, or test data requirements.
  • Provide technical leadership within the quality/testing domain through mentoring, best practices, and contributions to shared frameworks and standards.

Qualifications

  • A degree from an accredited College/University in Software Engineering, Computer Science, or related discipline is preferred.
  • 8+ years of experience in software quality assurance/control, software development and/or related field.
  • Strong experience building automated tests using TypeScript/JavaScript (and/or Java or C#) for modern application stacks.
  • Hands-on expertise with front-end frameworks such as React, Next.js, or Angular, including component and UI testing.
  • Proficiency with modern testing tools and patterns (for example, Testing Library, UI automation approaches, API testing, contract testing, and reliable test design).
  • Experience testing backend services and microservices, including Spring Boot, and managing dependencies and builds using tools such as Maven.
  • Experience with container-based integration testing (for example, Test containers) and designing repeatable test environments.
  • Ability to design maintainable automation frameworks with sound engineering practices (clean code, modularity, version control, CI/CD integration).
  • Strong troubleshooting and defect isolation skills, with the ability to interpret test results and identify root causes across multiple layers (UI, API, data, environment).
  • Demonstrated ability to improve quality processes, define standards, and drive adoption across teams.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including translating findings into clear recommendations for engineering and product partners.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and testing workflows using tools such as OpenCode, Claude Code, and Gemini Vertex AI to accelerate test creation, analysis, and triage while maintaining code quality and security expectations.
  • Prior experience with multiple defect tracking tools (e.g. Rational, Mercury) is a PLUS.
  • Strong analytical skills for test case design and result interpretation.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Must be a US Citizen or have permanent residence status (Green Card).
  • Must be able to obtain Public Trust Clearance.
  • Must have lived in the United States for the past 5 years.
  • Cannot have more than 6 months travel outside the United States within the last 5 years. Military Service excluded.

job.title: Senior QA/SDET
job.description:
About Vouched

At Vouched we are building a powerful identity verification platform to provide worldwide access to life’s most critical services, including healthcare, financial services, rentals, and more. Companies use Vouched to verify identity while onboarding and authenticating users. We make identity verifi cation easy with a combination of machine learning and data checks. Our customers leverage our APIs, integrations, and no-code solution to onboard customers to their systems.

What We Do

  • Verify thousands of people every day across multiple countries and industries providing access to critical services
    • Serve fast-growing startups, unicorns, and large enterprises, with a focus on providing fast, easy integration for developers
    • Run on a modern cloud infrastructure powered by automated integration and unit testing, provisioning, deployments, monitoring, and notifications
    • Operate in a highly regulated, security-sensitive space. Safeguarding personal and identity data is core to everything we ship
    • Drive to own the market and deliver a world-changing client and end-user experience

We are a small but mighty team looking for people who align with our values and have a strong sense of hustle, creative problem solving, grit and energy to help us scale! We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

We are seeking a Senior QA/SDET who thrives in a fast-paced startup environment and is passionate about building quality into every release alongside a talented team. The ideal candidate blends a tester's instinct for finding what breaks with strong software engineering skills, partnering closely with engineering, product, and ML stakeholders to ensure the platform that powers identity verification for customers around the world works correctly, every time.

You will own quality across the full product lifecycle, from reviewing requirements and designs through test planning, automation, release validation, and production verification. You will build and maintain the test frameworks, automated suites, and quality gates that let our team ship quickly and with confidence across our APIs, web capture SDK, mobile SDKs, and customer dashboard.

Security and compliance are central to this role. Because Vouched handles sensitive personal and identity data, we expect you to treat security, privacy, and regulatory compliance as first-class, non-negotiable quality requirements. You will design tests that verify access controls, data handling, and auditability, help produce test evidence that supports our compliance posture across frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, etc., and ensure that test environments and test data never expose real personal information.

You should be someone who is deep into the details, who partners with teammates to make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Correctness matters at Vouched: a missed edge case can block a real person from accessing healthcare or financial services. We expect our Senior QA/SDET to foster a culture of shared ownership of quality by championing testability, facilitating open conversations about release risk, and working with the team to catch issues long before they reach customers.

A critical component of this role is the fluent use of modern AI-powered tooling to accelerate test development. You will be expected to leverage tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, and GitHub Copilot, and similar platforms, to rapidly produce test plans, automated tests, test data, and quality tooling. We expect AI-accelerated workflows that turn product knowledge into reproducible, maintainable, and trustworthy automated coverage rather than manual, one-off regression passes. The ability to use AI tools to scaffold test suites, generate edge-case scenarios, accelerate failure triage, and build internal tooling that engineering can rely on is essential and not optional.

Experience working with distributed teams, strong written and verbal communication skills, and a bias toward action are essential. While knowledge of AI-based identity verification products is a plus, a passion for working with innovative technologies and helping to scale a dynamic team is key.

Key Responsibilities

  • Define and own the test strategy for the Vouched platform, balancing unit, integration, API, end-to-end, and exploratory testing to maximize risk coverage and release speed.
    • Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks for our REST APIs, web capture SDK, mobile SDKs (iOS and Android), and customer dashboard.
    • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines as quality gates, keeping suites fast, reliable, and free of flaky tests so every change ships with confidence.
    • Validate identity verification flows end to end across real devices, browsers, cameras, and network conditions, including document capture, selfie and liveness checks, and webhook delivery.
    • Build and curate safe, synthetic test data (ID documents, selfies, and identity records) that exercises edge cases across countries and document types without using real personal data.
    • Test for security and privacy: authentication and authorization, input validation, PII handling and redaction, and data retention, partnering with security on vulnerability findings.
    • Support compliance readiness by producing traceable test evidence and change-validation records for frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR (HIPAA a plus).
    • Drive performance, load, and reliability testing to ensure our APIs and processing pipeline meet latency and throughput targets as we scale.
    • Partner with ML engineers to validate model and pipeline changes using regression datasets and accuracy benchmarks before they reach production.
    • Own release validation and sign-off ; triage, reproduce, and root-cause defects, including production issues reported by customers, and turn every escaped bug into lasting automated coverage.
    • Define and report on quality metrics (defect escape rate, automation coverage, flakiness, time-to-detect) and use them to drive continuous improvement.
    • Leverage AI-powered tooling (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others) to accelerate test creation, test data generation, and failure triage.
    • Champion a culture of quality across engineering by reviewing designs and pull requests for testability and mentoring engineers on testing best practices.
    • Continuously evaluate and adopt emerging AI-powered tools and workflows to improve test speed, coverage, and reliability.

Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in software quality engineering, including at least 3 years as an SDET or test automation engineer within a software engineering organization.
    • Strong programming skills in at least one language used for test automation (TypeScript/JavaScript, Python, Java, or Kotlin/Swift) and a track record of writing clean, maintainable test code.
    • Hands-on experience building and scaling test automation frameworks for web UIs and APIs (Playwright, Cypress, WebdriverIO, Selenium, Jest, Postman, or similar).
    • Experience testing mobile applications or SDKs on iOS and Android (Appium, XCUITest, Espresso, or similar), including real-device clouds such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs.
    • Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar) and working with containerized and cloud environments (Docker, GCP preferred).
    • Experience with performance and load testing tools (k6, Gatling, JMeter, or similar) and using observability tools (Datadog or equivalent) to investigate failures.
    • Solid understanding of security and privacy testing: authentication and authorization, OWASP Top 10, input validation, and safe handling of PII in test environments.
    • Experience working in regulated environments and supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, including test evidence and audit readiness.
    • Proficiency with AI-powered development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent; demonstrated ability to accelerate test development with them.
    • Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills across the stack, from client to API to database.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write clear test plans, bug reports, and quality reports.
    • Experience working in a startup environment is required.
    • Experience managing or collaborating with distributed teams is essential.
    • Familiarity with identity verification, computer vision, or AI/ML-based solutions, or with testing ML model quality, is a plus.

Benefits

Our Commitment

We are committed to providing an environment where everyone receives equal consideration and treatment regardless of gender, gender identity, gender expression, sex, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, HIV/AIDS/Hepatitis C status, genetic information, marital status, domestic partner status, military or veteran status, height, weight, and any other protected category under the law. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Compensation

Base salary range: $180,000 – $210,000 USD annually, depending on experience and leveling. This role is also eligible for equity compensation and company benefits.

Benefits

  • Equity compensation

• Remote working environment

  • Self-managed paid time off• 11+ annual company holidays
    • 401(k)
    • Health Care Benefits: Medical, Vision, Dental
    • Wellness benefits: EAP, LifeHealth Online, One Medical, Perkspot

• Parental leave

This is a remote role. However, you must be based in the US (US work authorization is required).

Resolves complex problems and failures that occur in assigned products and technical facilities. job.title: Automation QA Engineer (Golang / Java)
job.description:
Overview:

FinteqHub is hiring an Automation QA Engineer (Golang / Java) to join our Backoffice team. We’re considering both Mid-Level and Senior professionals who can help improve integration test coverage and reliability across Backoffice services, supporting stable releases and the transition from Java-based testing to Go.

About Product:

Finteqhub

А PCI DSS certified payment gateway for online businesses, providing integration with payment systems via a single software platform.
Learn more

Purpose of the Role:

You will take part in shaping the testing strategy and coverage for Backoffice services, including which checks are maintained alongside Go services, which remain in the Java suite, how tests are executed, and how results are reported. You’ll work within the team’s established processes, test harness, CI pipelines, and reporting systems to develop integration tests in Go within the service repositories. You’ll migrate relevant checks from the Java suite closer to the service code, ensure test results remain visible, and maintain the remaining Java tests throughout the transition.

Tech Stack: Go, PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, Docker, testcontainers, and GitHub Actions. The existing regression coverage also includes a Java test suite (TestNG, Maven), with reporting in ReportPortal.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain Go integration tests for Backoffice services using real infrastructure dependencies and the team’s existing test harness.

  • Own the testing backlog for Backoffice services, prioritising coverage, selecting the appropriate testing level, and determining which checks should remain in the Java suite.

  • Migrate selected test scenarios from Java to Go within the service repositories, preserving relevant checks and removing those that are no longer needed.

  • Integrate tests into existing CI pipelines and maintain reliable test execution, ensuring clear visibility of results, investigating failures, and fixing or explicitly retiring flaky tests.

  • Maintain the remaining Java tests until they are migrated or removed.

  • Collaborate with Backoffice engineers to improve service testability while following existing testing patterns and reporting standards.

Required Experience:

  • Solid hands-on experience with Go, including writing maintainable tests and reusable helpers within existing services, rather than one-off scripts.

  • Practical experience with integration testing using real dependencies (databases, caches, or message brokers) via Docker or testcontainers.

  • Ability to determine when unit testing is sufficient, when integration testing is needed, and when end-to-end testing is unnecessary.

  • Experience testing HTTP APIs, including API clients, contracts, and behavioural assertions.

  • Experience running automated tests in CI and investigating failures through logs and data, rather than simply rerunning tests.

  • Experience taking ownership of testing end to end, including coverage, test execution, and failure triage.

  • Ability to read Java code, maintain existing tests, and migrate relevant checks to Go.

  • Ability to work effectively within established testing frameworks and processes.

  • English proficiency at B1 level or higher.

  • Native-level proficiency in Russian.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience migrating automated test suites between programming languages or frameworks.

  • Familiarity with TestNG, OpenFeign, ReportPortal, and Kafka clients.

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, Kafka, etcd, and testcontainers-go.

  • Understanding of fintech or payment systems, including payment flows, operation statuses, and idempotency.

  • Experience using AI tools to generate or migrate tests, with the ability to evaluate the accuracy and reliability of generated checks.

  • Experience with UI test automation using JavaScript, TypeScript, or Playwright.

Our Benefits:

  • Full-time remote work opportunities and flexible working hours

  • Private insurance

  • Additional 1 Day Off per calendar year

  • Sports program compensation

  • Comprehensive Mental Health Programme

  • Free online English lessons with a native speaker

  • Generous referral program

  • Training, internal workshops, and participation in international professional conferences and corporate events.

job.title: Senior Ballistic Armor Acquisition & Test Engineer SME
job.description:
Senior Ballistic Armor Acquisition & Test Engineer SME

A government contract requires that this position be restricted to U.S. citizens or legal permanent residents. You must provide documentation that you are a U.S. citizen or legal permanent resident to qualify.

This position requires an active Secret clearance or the ability to obtain a Secret clearance to be considered.

Position Summary:

The NSWC PCD S24 Anti-Terrorism Afloat Equipment (ATAE) Team is seeking a dedicated, highly qualified contractor Subject Matter Expert (SME) with deep technical expertise in both soft and hard ballistic armor systems. This role will directly support the S24 Program Manager (PM) in managing the full lifecycle development, testing, qualification, and sustainment of ATAE body armor and personal protective systems.

Compensation & Benefits:

Starting Salary Range for Senior Ballistic Armor Acquisition & Test Engineer SME: Pay commensurate with experience.

Benefits That Set Us Apart

When considering your next opportunity, compensation is only part of the picture. We offer a benefits package designed to invest in your future and support your life outside of work.

Highlights include:

  • Up to a 6% 401(k) company match to help you build long-term financial security
  • Paid time off as part of our comprehensive benefits package, so you have the flexibility to rest, recharge, and enjoy what matters most
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus prescription drug coverage
  • Basic life and AD&D insurance, with supplemental life options
  • Short-term and long-term disability coverage

•Paid holidays

•Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA) and Health Savings Account (HSA) options
  • Professional development, training, and certification support
  • Voluntary benefits including accident, critical illness, and identity theft protection

Because taking care of our employees isn’t just a promise, it’s part of who we are.

Benefits are subject to change and eligibility requirements apply.

Essential Functions, Duties & Responsibilities:

Includes the following:

  • Test Documentation Review: Thoroughly analyze and evaluate ballistic test plans and protocols generated by ATC and commercial test facilities against applicable DoD specifications and military standards (e.g., MIL-STD-662, NIJ standards, specific Purchase Descriptions).
  • Test Witnessing: Witness First Article Testing (FAT) and Lot Acceptance Testing (LAT) on-site at Aberdeen Test Center (ATC) and qualified commercial ballistic laboratories (e.g., Element/NTS, Chesapeake Testing/Oregon Physics).
  • Report Analysis: Review, validate, and summarize test results and ballistic test reports produced by ATC and commercial facilities.
  • Failure Analysis & Resolution: Lead technical root-cause investigations following any FAT/LAT ballistic or environmental non-conformances, formulating corrective and preventive actions with contractors and labs.
  • Commercial Lab Advisory: Evaluate, recommend, and advise the Government on the technical capabilities, accreditation, and utilization of commercial testing laboratories.
  • Evaluation of Engineering Change Proposals (ECPs) and Requests for Variance (RFVs) in coordination with DCMA and the TWH.
  • Ensure full traceability and strict configuration control of ballistic soft armor packages, hard armor inserts/plates, and carrier systems throughout the acquisition lifecycle
  • Event Planning & Execution: Plan, coordinate, and execute user evaluation events, including Limited User Evaluations (LUEs), Fleet/Follow-on User Evaluations (FUEs), human factors assessments, and human buoyancy/water ingress testing.
  • Collect, synthesize, and report user feedback and performance data to guide design iterations and procurement decisions.
  • Purchase Descriptions (PDs): Formulate authoritative engineering inputs, performance parameters, and verification requirements for system-level Purchase Descriptions and solicitation packages.
  • Technical Manuals & Maintenance Data: Author and edit technical and operational documentation, including Operator Manuals, Equipment Handbooks, Use and Care Manuals, and Maintenance Requirement Cards (MRCs) in support of Planned Maintenance System (PMS) requirements.
  • Represent the NSWC PCD S24 ATAE Program in inter-service working groups, including the Joint Service Body Armor Working Group (BAWG).
  • Coordinate technical requirements and lessons learned across naval and joint-service stakeholders (APM, TWH, NCTRF, and Army counterparts).
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

No supervisory/management authority

Basic Qualifications:

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Science, Textile Engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent military/contractor technical experience) with 7+ years of progressive experience in personal armor, PPE, or tactical life-support systems.
  • Ballistic Expertise: Proven hands-on background in ballistic testing methodologies, performance standards, and test range protocols for both soft
  • armor (flexible aramid/UHMWPE packages) and hard armor (ceramic, metallic, composite inserts/plates). • Range & Quality Oversight: Demonstrated experience witnessing and evaluating FAT/LAT ballistic test events at Aberdeen Test Center (ATC) or certified commercial ballistic testing facilities.
  • Technical Writing: Proven track record authoring or contributing to military Purchase Descriptions (PDs), technical manuals, and Maintenance Requirement Cards (MRCs).

•Must be a US Citizen.

  • This position requires an active Secret clearance or the ability to obtain a Secret clearance to be considered.
  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer; may occasionally require standing or moving about the office for extended periods.
  • Must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Direct experience supporting Navy acquisition programs, particularly NSWC PCD, NAVSEA, or PM-ICE / Soldier Protective Services.
  • Familiarity with naval buoyancy and maritime survivability constraints for body armor (human buoyancy testing, salt-water exposure, neutrally buoyant plates).
  • Active participation in the Body Armor Working Group (BAWG) or multi-service personal protective gear forums.
  • Strong working knowledge of DCMA quality oversight, FAR/DFARS compliance, and CMPRO/Configuration Management toolsets.

Work Environment:

Work is performed primarily in a climate-controlled environment.

Company Information:

Behind every government mission stands skilled, mission-driven talent: people whose expertise and dedication turn complex challenges into successful outcomes. Cherokee Nation Government Solutions, part of Cherokee Federal, the federal contracting division of Cherokee Nation Businesses, is that team. We modernize aging systems, deliver care where it’s needed most, and keep missions supplied, staffed, and moving across defense, intelligence, and civilian agencies. For more than 60 federal clients, we take on the work others won’t, and deliver where it counts. If that’s the kind of work you’re looking for, you’ve found your team. Learn more at cherokee-federal.com.

#CherokeeFederal #APPC2

Cherokee Federal is a military friendly employer. Veterans and active military transitioning to civilian status are encouraged to apply.

Legal Disclaimer: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected veteran status, disability or any other status protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

Many of our job openings require access to government buildings or military installations. Candidates must pass pre-employment qualifications of Cherokee Federal.

For applicants located in Colorado, New York, California, Washington, Illinois, Hawaii, Massachusetts, or other states with pay transparency requirements: the estimated annual salary range for this position is available upon request. Actual compensation varies based on qualifications, experience, and location.

Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement

Cherokee Federal is a federal contractor subject to the Vietnam Era Veterans’ Readjustment Assistance Act (VEVRAA). As required by VEVRAA, we take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified protected veterans. Protected veterans are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Cherokee Federal takes affirmative action to employ and advance in employment qualified individuals with disabilities in compliance with Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. Qualified individuals with disabilities are encouraged to self-identify during the application process.

Reasonable accommodations are available to qualified individuals with disabilities or those with sincerely held religious beliefs. To request an accommodation in the application or interview process, please contact Human Resources at .

job.description:
Role Title: Electronics Assembly Quality Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Electronics Assembly Quality Engineers to contribute their expertise on a customer project focused on electronics manufacturing quality and reliability. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity is suited to process and quality engineering professionals with hands-on experience in reviewing X-ray images of area-array solder joints (BGA, CGA, LGA), analyzing solder defects, optimizing reflow processes, and laboratory specialists skilled in counterfeit electronic component screening. Cases span voiding, head-in-pillow, bridging, open joints, reflow profile adjustments, Class 3 acceptance, and component authenticity detection. Contributors may have strengths on either process quality or counterfeit analysis—please indicate your focus.

Scope of Work

  1. Analyze and interpret X-ray images of BGA, CGA, and LGA solder joints, identifying defects such as voiding, head-in-pillow, bridging, and opens.
  2. Review and suggest improvements to reflow soldering profiles to address process-related solder defects.
  3. Provide detailed root cause analysis and recommendations for solder joint anomalies and reliability concerns.
  4. Assess real-world cases for IPC Class 3 acceptance, documenting critical observations and decision criteria.
  5. Evaluate and outline test laboratory flows for counterfeit electronic component detection and screening.
  6. Deliver comprehensive written and verbal summaries of findings, ensuring clarity and actionable guidance.
  7. Contribute technical insights that enhance AI training data quality in the field of electronics assembly and component validation.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Extensive hands-on experience in electronics manufacturing process or quality engineering, particularly with area-array packages.
  2. Advanced proficiency in interpreting X-ray images and diagnosing solder joint failures.
  3. Strong expertise in reflow soldering process optimization and process troubleshooting.
  4. Familiarity with IPC acceptance standards, especially Class 3 requirements for critical applications.
  5. Experience with counterfeit component detection test methodologies and laboratory practices in component authentication.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills for technical documentation and cross-functional knowledge sharing.
  7. Background as either a process engineer, quality engineer, or laboratory analyst in electronics assembly or component screening (specify your strength area).

job.title: Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineer
job.description:
Role Title: Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineer

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Dimensional Metrology Quality Engineers to contribute to a customer's project focused on advanced inspection and measurement solutions. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. This opportunity involves evaluating and producing first-article inspection deliverables using 3D scanning and advanced metrology software, ensuring accuracy in scan-to-CAD comparisons, datum setups, and profile and position callouts. Your insight will help determine whether deviations arise from true part discrepancies or fixturing and alignment artefacts, supporting critical sign-off decisions on FAI reports.

Scope of Work

  1. Review and validate first-article inspection (FAI) reports derived from 3D scan data.
  2. Conduct detailed scan-to-CAD comparisons, analyzing measurement deviations and their sources.
  3. Set up, interpret, and document datum structures, profiles, and position callouts as per industry standards.
  4. Utilize CMM measurement techniques and perform uncertainty analysis for dimensional integrity.
  5. Differentiate between actual part deviations and artefacts caused by fixturing or alignment issues.
  6. Deliver clear, comprehensive written and verbal feedback to support decision-making on FAI sign-off.
  7. Contribute nuanced, high-quality metrology input to inform and enhance AI system development.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Expertise in Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing (GD&T) and FAI processes within manufacturing or quality environments.
  2. Proficiency with 3D scanning devices and inspection software (e.g., PolyWorks, GOM Inspect, or similar).
  3. Strong background in CMM measurement techniques and uncertainty analysis.
  4. Proven ability to interpret engineering drawings, CAD models, and technical specifications.
  5. Experience producing or approving FAI reports backed by practical metrology knowledge.
  6. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with a keen attention to explanatory detail.
  7. Analytical mindset for discerning true quality issues versus artefacts introduced by measurement setup.

job.title: Software Engineer in Test
job.description:
Software Engineer in Test

US REMOTE (AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, MA, MD, NC, NJ, NH, NV, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX)

About VivoSense

VivoSense is a science and technology company specializing in digital health technologies (DHTs), including wearable sensors, mobile applications, and connected monitoring tools. We partner with pharmaceutical sponsors, healthcare providers, and academic groups to develop and deliver real-world digital clinical measures backed by rigorous scientific and analytic expertise.

Job Description

We are looking for a Software Engineer in Test who combines strong software testing and automation skills with experience working within a regulated software quality environment.

This role will help ensure that VivoSense software products are reliable, traceable, and appropriately verified and validated for their intended use. You will work closely with Software Engineering, Product Management, DevOps, and Quality to define test strategies, develop automated and manual tests, maintain validation evidence, investigate defects, and support software releases through established quality gates.

The ideal candidate understands that testing in a regulated environment goes beyond identifying software defects. It requires disciplined documentation, requirements traceability, risk-based testing, repeatability, controlled processes, and objective evidence demonstrating that software meets its intended requirements.

As part of a small and collaborative organization, you will also have significant ownership in improving our testing processes, automation frameworks, and overall software quality practices.

What You'll Do

  • Develop and maintain software test strategies, test plans, test cases, test procedures, and validation documentation for new features and software releases.
  • Design, implement, and maintain automated test suites covering application workflows, APIs, integrations, regression testing, and other critical system functionality.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and build-triggered quality processes.
  • Perform risk-based testing, focusing verification effort on functionality that presents the greatest product, data integrity, security, or clinical risk.
  • Review product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical designs to ensure they are clear, testable, and appropriately covered by verification activities.
  • Maintain traceability between requirements, risks, test cases, test execution, defects, and release evidence where required by the software lifecycle.
  • Execute formal and exploratory testing and accurately document test results and objective evidence.
  • Identify, document, investigate, and reproduce software defects and collaborate with developers to determine root cause and verify corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with Software Engineering, Science, Product Management, DevOps, and Quality to ensure releases successfully complete defined quality and validation gates.
  • Own software verification activities and ensure verification is appropriately planned, executed, documented, traceable, and completed in accordance with applicable quality procedures.
  • Support software validation activities for controlled releases and significant software changes, including validation planning, execution, documentation, and required evidence.
  • Ensure testing activities and documentation comply with VivoSense's Quality Management System, software development procedures, change-control processes, and applicable regulatory expectations.
  • Support investigations, nonconformances, corrective actions, or CAPA activities related to software quality when applicable.
  • Contribute to internal and external audit readiness by ensuring software quality records are accurate, complete, traceable, and reproducible.
  • Advocate for quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final release activity.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Technology, Science, or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3–8 years of software testing, software quality engineering, or software validation experience.
  • Experience working in a regulated industry such as pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, clinical research, digital health, healthcare, or medical devices.
  • Practical understanding of software quality and validation principles within a controlled Quality Management System.
  • Experience developing and executing documented software test cases, test procedures, and test protocols.
  • Experience maintaining requirements-to-test traceability and documented verification/validation evidence.
  • Experience with software defect management, investigation, root-cause analysis, and regression testing.
  • Experience developing and maintaining automated software tests.
  • Understanding Agile software development and how Agile practices can operate within a regulated software lifecycle.
  • Experience collaborating with distributed software engineering, science/clinical, DevOps, and quality teams.
  • Strong documentation skills and attention to detail.
  • Ability to work independently, identify gaps, propose solutions, and take ownership of software quality activities.
  • Working knowledge of Git or another modern version-control system.

Nice to haves:

  • Experience with regulated software frameworks or regulations such as 21 CFR Part 11, GxP, ISO 13485, IEC 62304, FDA software quality expectations, or comparable regulated software environments.
  • Experience with Computer Software Assurance (CSA), Computer System Validation (CSV), or risk-based software validation approaches.
  • Experience supporting software used in clinical trials or clinical research.
  • Experience testing cloud-native SaaS applications.
  • Experience testing REST APIs using tools such as Postman or automated API-testing frameworks.
  • Experience with AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Experience in integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience testing data-processing systems, analytics platforms, or applications that process scientific, physiological, or clinical data.
  • Experience with security, data integrity, audit trails, access control, or other regulated-system controls.
  • Experience helping establish or improve test automation frameworks and software quality processes within a growing organization.

Additional benefits and perks

  • Unlimited PTO
  • Board approved stock options
  • Board approved annual bonus
  • Direct access to senior leadership
  • Healthcare
  • Vision/Dental
  • Life Insurance
  • Professional growth training
  • 401K with Safe Harbor employer contribution
  • Remote work
  • Flexible working hours

Base Salary Range: $120,000 - $140,000 (Depending on experience and location)

VivoSense is an Equal Opportunity Employer and E-Verify participant.

Please note: Our hiring process includes, but is not limited to, a final round in-person interview, background check, employment verification, and professional reference checks.

This role is open only to candidates residing in the following states: AZ, CA, CO, FL, GA, MA, MD, NC, NH, NJ, NV, OH, OR, PA, TN, TX. If you do not reside in one of these states, you will not be eligible for consideration at this time. If you cannot work in the United States without sponsorship or extensions, we will not be able to accept your candidacy for this role.

Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque

nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada. Nous offrons aux Canadiens les taux les plus bas dès le départ, en toute transparence et sans négociation.

À propos de nous

Pionnier du financement hypothécaire en ligne au Canada, nesto transforme la façon dont les Canadiens financent leur propriété. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.

Les emprunteurs profitent de taux souvent plus avantageux que ceux offerts par les grandes banques, ainsi que d'une expérience hypothécaire exceptionnelle, simple et fluide, du début à la fin. Le tout est propulsé par une technologie d'intelligence artificielle de pointe.

Rapide, simple et entièrement numérique, nesto a été nommé Prêteur hypothécaire de l'année par la CLA pendant trois années consécutives. Voilà le côté brillant de l'hypothèque.

Groupe Nesto

Le Groupe Nesto est le principal fournisseur de technologies hypothécaires et de solutions de financement au Canada, avec plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration. Fort de la confiance de plusieurs des principales institutions financières du pays, le Groupe Nesto combine plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives pour transformer l'avenir du financement.

Grâce à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le financement résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers hypothécaires et le financement commercial multirésidentiel. Reconnue au palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, l'entreprise continue de faire progresser le secteur grâce à l'innovation, à la technologie et à des solutions axées sur les clients.

Grâce à sa famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, le Groupe Nesto a pour mission de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien de demain et de devenir un véritable chef de file canadien en technologies de financement et en services financiers.

Pour en savoir plus :

La vie chez nesto

Chez nesto, nous avons à cœur de remettre en question le statu quo, d'offrir une meilleure expérience hypothécaire et d'aider les Canadiens à économiser sur leur hypothèque. Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer.

Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

Votre rôle

  • Effectuer quotidiennement l'examen d'un échantillon de demandes hypothécaires (avant et après déboursement) pour assurer la conformité aux normes de souscription, aux politiques du Groupe nesto et aux exigences réglementaires.
  • Évaluer l'ensemble des éléments de données, documents financiers, renseignements clients, transmissions des courtiers et assureurs, et documents juridiques afin de noter tout écart par rapport aux politiques.
  • Repérer les tendances de comportement inhabituel, les transactions suspectes et la légitimité des documents via les « dossiers à surveiller » des assureurs et les références internes.
  • Effectuer des enquêtes préliminaires et prendre les mesures nécessaires sur les dossiers suspects afin de réduire le risque de perte et de fausse représentation.
  • Préparer des rapports d'assurance qualité détaillant les constatations et recommandations, et mener des analyses approfondies à la demande de la gestion des risques ou de l'AQ.
  • Soutenir les audits avec les partenaires, investisseurs et assureurs, de la préparation initiale jusqu'à la résolution des items problématiques.
  • Aider à la gestion, au contrôle périodique et à l'examen des listes approuvées (évaluateurs, notaires/avocats, courtiers, fournisseurs) et des listes de lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent (LBA).
  • Exécuter les examens d'assurance et de contrôle de la qualité de façon régulière, rapide, efficace et objective.
  • Fournir des conseils, opinions et recommandations au personnel de souscription et aux parties prenantes concernant les risques de crédit, la mitigation des pertes, les risques d'inondation/propriété et les opportunités de formation.

Qui nous recherchons

  • Expérience : Minimum de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en approbation/adjudication de prêts hypothécaires. Expérience dans le canal des courtiers hypothécaires, un atout.
  • Outils & Maîtrise technique : Maîtrise des applications Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, SharePoint), Google Workspace (GDrive, Sheets, Docs), des CRM et outils de flux de travail (Salesforce).
  • Connaissances du domaine : Solide compréhension des directives des assureurs, internes et externes, ainsi qu'une bonne connaissance des implications, méthodes de détection et de prévention de la fraude.
  • Compétences clés : Pensée analytique et compétences bien développées en négociation et résolution de problèmes pour repérer les tendances et anomalies dans les pratiques de souscription.
  • Autonomie & Prise de décision : Capacité à travailler de façon autonome avec une supervision limitée, à gérer et prioriser les demandes urgentes, et à formuler des recommandations impopulaires lorsque requis.
  • Langue & Communication : Bilinguisme fluide (français et anglais) requis pour soutenir les clients à l'échelle nationale, avec une excellente capacité à communiquer les constatations à la direction et aux souscripteurs.

Pourquoi vous aimeriez travailler ici

Nous croyons que les personnes de talent donnent le meilleur d'elles-mêmes lorsqu'elles sont soutenues sur les plans professionnel, personnel et financier. C'est pourquoi nous offrons un programme de rémunération globale complet, conçu pour vous aider à vous épanouir à chaque étape de votre carrière.

  • Rémunération concurrentielle — Salaire compétitif, primes de rendement (le cas échéant) et reconnaissance de vos contributions.
  • Santé et bien-être — Couverture complète pour les soins médicaux, dentaires et de la vue, comptes de gestion des dépenses santé et bien-être (le cas échéant), télémédecine, programme d'aide aux employés (PAE) et soutien en santé mentale pour vous et votre famille.
  • Du temps pour refaire le plein — Vacances généreuses (4 semaines), congés mobiles et jours fériés pour vous permettre de vous ressourcer.
  • Planification de l'avenir — Cotisation de contrepartie au REER pour soutenir votre bien-être financier à long terme.
  • Soutien aux familles — Prestations complémentaires bonifiées pour les congés de maternité et parentaux.
  • Apprentissage et perfectionnement — Aide financière aux études, mentorat, formations et occasions de faire progresser votre carrière au sein du Groupe Nesto.
  • Des outils pour réussir — Technologies modernes, équipes collaboratives et toutes les ressources nécessaires pour vous dépasser.

Diversité, équité et inclusion

Au sein du Groupe Nesto, nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait notre force. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent respecté, soutenu et habilité à réussir.

Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, y compris les membres des Premiers Peuples (Premières Nations, Inuit et Métis), les personnes en situation de handicap, les membres des communautés racisées, les femmes et les personnes de la communauté 2ELGBTQIA+.

Si vous avez besoin de mesures d'adaptation à n'importe quelle étape du processus de recrutement, nous nous engageons à collaborer avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins.

The bright side of mortgages

nestois Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS,nesto, andNesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services.

Learn more at:

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

About the Role

  • Review an adequate daily sampling of mortgage applications post-funding and pre-funding to ensure compliance with nesto Group policies, underwriting standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Assess file data elements, financial documents, client information, broker file transmissions, insurer transmissions, and miscellaneous legal documentation to identify policy deviations.
  • Identify patterns of unusual behavior, suspicious transactions, and documentation validity via "Heads up Files" from external insurers and internal referrals.
  • Conduct preliminary investigations and necessary actions on suspect files to mitigate misrepresentation risk and loss.
  • Prepare QA reports with findings and recommendations on suspicious or irregular activity files, as well as execute further analysis as directed by Risk or QA Management.
  • Support audits with partners, investors, and insurers, spanning from preparation to audit finding resolution.
  • Assist in the management, periodic control, and review of approved lists for Appraisers, Solicitors, Brokers, Vendors, and AML lists.
  • Execute QA/QC reviews regularly on a timely, efficient, and objective basis.
  • Provide guidance, opinions, and recommendations to underwriting staff and stakeholders on credit issues, loss mitigation, flood/property risk, and training opportunities.

Who we are looking for

  • Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of Mortgage/Lending Adjudication experience. Experience in the mortgage broker channel is preferred.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, SharePoint), Google Workspace (GDrive, Sheets, Docs), CRMs, and workflow tools (Salesforce).
  • Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of insurer, internal, and external guidelines, alongside working knowledge of fraud implications, detection methodologies, and risk mitigation.
  • Core Competencies: Analytical thinker with well-developed negotiation and problem-solving skills to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in mortgage underwriting.
  • Autonomy & Decision-Making: Ability to operate independently with limited supervision, prioritize urgent applications, and make unpopular recommendations when required.
  • Language & Communication: Bilingual fluency (English and French) is required to support nationwide clients, with an ability to effectively communicate findings to management and underwriting teams.

job.description:
About the Role

You'll join zerohash's growing QA function, working alongside engineers and SDETs. As a QA Engineer, you'll own test planning, functional and exploratory testing, and user acceptance testing (UAT) across zerohash's product stack. This is an opportunity to shape testing practices and quality standards as the team scales, with visibility into every product area and a direct line to release quality.

Responsibilities

  • Test coverage: Design, document, and execute functional and exploratory test cases for API- and SDK-based product flows.
  • Automation testing: Pick up automation work on an ad hoc or on-demand basis, addressing automation tech debt and critical-flow gaps, using tooling and frameworks built by SDETs.
  • Cross-functional planning: Partner with product managers, developers, and SDETs to translate acceptance criteria into concrete test scenarios, and proactively call out coverage gaps and edge cases.
  • Release quality: Own regression testing for your assigned area ahead of each release, and support the team's release-readiness process.
  • UAT: Help formalize and run User Acceptance Testing across product and engineering as zerohash standardizes this process company-wide.
  • Defect management: Log, triage, and track defects with clear repro steps, severity, and expected-vs-actual detail; follow issues through to resolution.
  • Automation collaboration: Flag coverage gaps that need deeper automated testing and route them to developers, who own unit and integration test automation.
  • Environments: Test across dev, cert, and prod environments, and participate in release readiness reviews.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of QA or test engineering experience, ideally in fintech, payments, or another regulated, API-driven environment.
  • Strong grasp of QA process across all phases of the SDLC: test planning, test data setup, execution, defect management, and release sign-off.
  • Strong test case design and exploratory testing instincts; comfortable reading API specs and testing REST/JSON APIs directly (e.g., Postman, cURL).
  • Experience with BDD-style test scenario writing (Gherkin/Cucumber or similar).
  • Comfortable writing and maintaining automated tests (e.g., Playwright, Selenium) for occasional ad hoc work and automation tech debt.
  • Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language used for test automation (e.g., JavaScript/TypeScript or Python).
  • Working knowledge of SQL for data verification and familiarity with Git-based workflows (GitHub).
  • Experience using Jira and Confluence, or equivalent tools, for test planning, tracking, and documentation.

  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, switching between competing priorities and projects.
  • Comfortable collaborating across time zones with a distributed engineering team.

Preferred

  • Experience testing financial transaction flows: ledgers, settlement, reconciliation, or payments.
  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests fit into them.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum environment (sprint planning, backlog grooming).

zerohash is the leading crypto and stablecoin infrastructure platform and the operating system for digital money, powering the next generation of financial services. Founded in 2017, zerohash enables banks, brokerages, fintechs, and payment companies to offer crypto trading, stablecoin payments, and tokenized assets without having to build or manage complex blockchain infrastructure on their own.

The zerohash platform supports three core pillars: Trade, Transact, and Tokenize. Through a single integration, customers can launch regulated crypto buy, sell, and custody services; enable 24/7 stablecoin-based funding, payouts, and settlement; and issue and manage tokenized assets with built-in compliance, risk controls, and reporting. By abstracting away technical, regulatory, and operational complexity, zerohash allows partners to treat digital assets as just another financial primitive: fast, programmable, and global.

zerohash is trusted by some of the world’s most recognized financial and consumer brands, including Interactive Brokers, Morgan Stanley, Stripe, Franklin Templeton, BlackRock, DraftKings, Gusto, Worldpay, Kalshi, One Pay, among others. Today, zero infrastructure supports millions of end users across brokerage, wealth, payments, and marketplace platforms globally.

The company is deeply regulated and compliance-first, operating across the U.S. and internationally with licenses and approvals that allow partners to enter crypto and stablecoins with confidence. zerohash has become a trusted partner for enterprises seeking to modernize financial products while meeting the highest standards for security, risk management, and regulatory oversight.

To date, zerohash has raised over $280 million in funding from a mix of leading venture firms and strategic investors, including Morgan Stanley, Interactive Brokers, SoFi, Point72 Ventures, Bain Capital Crypto, Lightspeed Venture Partners, and more.

zerohash has been featured in top-tier media outlets such as Bloomberg, CNBC, The Wall Street Journal, Financial Times, Reuters, Forbes, and CoinDesk, and its leadership team regularly contributes to global conversations on the future of payments, investing, and financial infrastructure.

At zerohash, we're building the infrastructure that makes digital money work securely, compliantly, and at global scale.

The zerohash Culture

All zerohash employees are guided by the following characteristics and core principles:

  • Independence/Ownership - An ability to work autonomously. Join zerohash, pitch ideas, and shape the work you do.

  • Empathy - An ability to listen, respect, and understand your co-workers, customers, and everyone you interact with no matter how different they are to you.
  • Adaptability - An ability to respond quickly. We are in a fast-paced industry and so we expect you to be creative when solving a new problem and comfortable under pressure.
  • Transparency - We believe that transparency is critical to empowering everyone to make the best decisions, both the company to its people and vice versa.
  • Integrity - Integrity creates trust. As both an organization collectively and as individuals, it is our most valuable asset.

job.title: QA Engineer — Web & Mobile
job.description:
QA Engineer, Web and Mobile

Individual contributor. Reports to the Director of QA. No direct reports.

Salary: €5000 per month

Location: Poland (Fully Remote)

The role

You test the web application, frontend and backend, and the mobile applications on iOS and Android. That is the surface of the job.

Underneath it, the point of this role is to understand how the product actually works: the data flow, the API contracts, the places where two systems meet and produce behaviour nobody specified. That understanding is what lets you improve a specification before code is written, catch the gap nobody else noticed, and give Support, Sales, Product and Engineering an answer they can rely on.

We are looking for extreme ownership, the person who picks up the task nobody else wants because it needs doing and they can see why it matters.

What you will do

Test the product properly. Web end to end, frontend behaviour and backend responses, not just the UI layer. Mobile on iOS and Android against an agreed device and OS matrix, with a real understanding of platform conventions and where the two diverge.

Own our automated coverage on web. Extend and maintain the Playwright suite and write new tests for the features you take through. Investigate failures and fix flakiness rather than muting it, and be honest about what automation is and is not covering.

Verify at the API and data layer. Requests, responses, payloads, status codes, backward compatibility for older clients. Query the database directly to confirm what actually happened, rather than what the screen says happened.

Prevent bugs, not just report them. Pressure-test specifications with Product, Design and engineers before development starts: happy paths, edge cases, error states, empty states. Point out the platform that was forgotten, the API version that will break, the migration nobody planned. Asking the awkward question early is part of the job.

Debug to root cause. "It doesn't work" is not a bug report. Narrow down where it breaks and what the system is actually doing, and hand the developer something they can act on.

Support the wider business. Reproduce and triage customer issues that reach engineering, and keep test plans and known-issue lists current so release decisions rest on evidence.

Use AI every day. Reduce your own repetitive work with it, build reusable AI skills the wider team can benefit from, make small fixes in the code yourself where that is reasonable, and bring ideas about where AI can raise our quality bar.

What we are looking for

  • Three to five years of hands-on testing of web applications, with a demonstrated ability to find root causes rather than symptoms.

  • Practical test automation experience. You have written and maintained UI or API tests in Playwright, or a comparable framework, and can work in a test codebase without hand-holding.

  • You can read and reason about API contracts and payloads, query a database in SQL to verify data, and are comfortable with traffic and API inspection tooling, or quick to pick it up.

  • Mobile testing in practice. You can tell a platform convention apart from a defect, and reason about the device and OS coverage a given change actually needs.

  • Proven collaboration with Design and Product. You have been in the room during specification work and made it better without owning it, with examples you can talk us through.

  • Excellent written and spoken communication, in Polish and English, both at C2 or native level.

Nice to have

  • Testing in a regulated or healthcare-adjacent domain.

  • Device farms or cloud device labs, such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.

  • Triaging from crash and error monitoring, such as Sentry or Crashlytics.

  • Accessibility testing (WCAG).

As part of our commitment to innovation, your role will involve implementing AI-powered testing methodologies to improve coverage and identify issues proactively. If you have hands-on experience with automation, cross-browser testing, performance testing, and industry-leading tools (including AI-based solutions), this is the perfect opportunity for your career growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Test Planning & Strategy

  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and define test objectives.
  • Develop and document comprehensive and efficient test plans, strategies, and exit criteria.
  • Ensure alignment with Agile frameworks for CI/CD processes to maintain quality standards throughout the software development lifecycle.

2. Manual Testing

  • Perform detailed manual testing on new features, functional flows, and regression cases.
  • Conduct comprehensive exploratory testing for edge-case scenarios to uncover potential issues early.
  • Ensure test data coverage for all features, workflows, integrations, and edge cases.

3. Automation Testing

  • Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks for both web and mobile applications using leading tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, and/or similar.

  • Perform cross-browser testing on modern browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge using tools like BrowserStack, Lambdatest, or CrossBrowserTesting.
  • Validate software compatibility across various operating systems and devices (desktop and mobile).

5. Performance Testing

  • Design and execute performance, scalability, and stress tests for high-traffic systems using tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
  • Monitor application response time, throughput, and behavior under heavy load scenarios.
  • Analyze performance bottlenecks and provide optimization recommendations to development teams.

  • Utilize AI-powered test case generation tools like Testim, Applitools, or Tricentis Tosca to design smarter and faster test cases.

  • Identify, document, and track bugs and defects found during testing using bug-tracking tools such as JIRA, Trello, and Azure DevOps.
  • Actively collaborate with development teams to troubleshoot and resolve defects, ensuring software efficiency and stability.

8. Documentation & Reporting

  • Create and maintain a repository of detailed test plans, test cases, and test execution reports.
  • Generate test metrics and quality reports to update stakeholders regarding system quality and testing progress.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

2. Technical Skills

  • Strong understanding of software QA methodologies, manual and automation testing standards, and testing tools.

  • Demonstrated expertise in cross-browser testing tools (e.g., BrowserStack, LambdaTest, Sauce Labs).
