job.title: QA Director
System Test Automation Engineer
job.description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Verification and Release Test Team

Wayve’s Verification and Release Test team sits at the intersection of hardware, embedded software and machine learning models. Our testing spans component, system and vehicle levels, and we build novel test automation in-house to identify issues earlier in development. We pride ourselves on finding the most efficient and effective ways to deliver the most valuable results for the company.

As a System Test Engineer, HIL, you’ll build robust, reusable automation and work across engineering disciplines to improve coverage, reliability and traceability. This is a hands-on delivery role with room to grow into broader areas of the system, including sensing and model-behaviour testing, as Wayve and your experience evolve.

🧠 Your day-to-day

  • Develop automation for system functionality tests at component, integration and system levels, working across software and hardware boundaries.

  • Lead root-cause investigations for failures identified during test campaigns, collaborating with hardware, software, infrastructure and DevOps teams to resolve issues.

  • Analyse test results, uncover software and hardware bugs, and report findings through Jira with clear evidence to support debugging.

  • Optimise Buildkite CI/CD-integrated test workflows for rapid, reliable and repeatable execution.

  • Review, create and follow risk assessments to ensure all testing activities are conducted safely and responsibly.

🧩 What you’ll be working on:

  • Independently owning the design and delivery of automated verification for a defined area of our embedded software stack, steadily raising the bar on coverage, reliability and traceability.

  • Building open-loop and closed-loop hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) replay tests, alongside reliability and fault-injection tests, to support verification, release and debugging.

  • Automating HIL test setups and improving test infrastructure to expand coverage, make failures easier to trace and strengthen compliance reporting.

  • Integrating requirements, coverage and compliance workflows, including Jama, MC/DC coverage analysis and MISRA checks, and managing test artefacts through Artifactory and Azure.

  • Developing traceability dashboards and defining KPIs and quality metrics that support data-driven validation and release decisions.

🙌 You should apply if:

  • You have hands-on experience with system-level verification and validation in robotics, embedded software or mechatronic systems, with a track record of independently delivering test automation.

  • You’re highly proficient in Python and have experience developing automation test frameworks using pytest.

  • You’ve worked with HIL testing and tooling, including interfaces such as CAN, Ethernet or GMSL, and tools from dSPACE, Vector, Xylon or similar providers.

  • You understand open-loop and closed-loop HIL replay testing using dSPACE or other emulators.

  • You’re familiar with automotive safety and process standards, including ISO 26262, ASPICE and SOTIF, and have experience integrating requirements and test-management tools such as Jama and Xray.

  • You’re proficient in CI/CD principles and related tooling, such as GitLab CI, Buildkite and Bazel.

  • You have experience developing or testing automotive software at embedded and system levels, including hardware/software interactions and interface-level testing, and have worked with L2+ hands-off, L3 or L4 automated driving systems.

  • You have knowledge of consumer safety-rating protocols such as Euro NCAP, including AEB and LSS/LKA scenarios; DCAS regulatory testing under UN R171; and automotive cybersecurity testing and standards, including ISO/SAE 21434 and UN R155.

  • You’ve worked with test automation dashboards, logging and reporting infrastructure, using tools such as Grafana, Looker, Datadog and Jira.

  • You’re a self-starter with a sharp eye for improvement who communicates clearly and works effectively across software, hardware, autonomy, DevOps and product teams.

  • Ideally, you’ve contributed to improvements in test methods, safety procedures or operational efficiency, and are familiar with data management and version control tools such as Git.

  • Experience using agentic AI coding tools such as Cursor or Claude Code to accelerate and improve test development, debugging and automation workflows would also be valuable.

🌱 Not ticking every box? That’s totally okay! If you’re passionate about autonomy and keen to learn, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every requirement.

More about Wayve:

🚀 Wayve is building the leading AI platform for autonomous driving. We are pioneering an end to end AI approach that enables vehicles to learn directly from real world experience, developing the ability to adapt, generalise and improve at scale. Instead of relying on hand coded rules or pre mapped environments, our AI Driver learns to drive by understanding the world around it. The result is technology that navigates complex urban environments with intelligence, precision and natural flow, unlocking meaningful advances in both safety and efficiency. We believe autonomy represents a once in a generation transformation in how people and goods move, comparable to the shift from horses to cars, and from human driven vehicles to intelligent machines.

Our ambition is to make autonomy universal. Wayve’s mapless and hardware agnostic AI platform integrates with global OEM partners, enabling continuous software evolution and unlocking advanced levels of automation from L2 plus through to L4 as our core AI model scales. In a race increasingly defined by intelligence and real world learning, Wayve is taking a distinct approach, building a generalisable driving intelligence that can power any vehicle, anywhere. By combining embodied AI with scalable deployment, we are creating technology that can be shaped to each OEM brand and driver experience, accelerating the transition to a safer, more intelligent future of mobility.

How we work 💻- Locations & Flexible Working:

Our main hubs are in London, Sunnyvale, Yokohama, Herzliya, Vancouver and Leonberg. We operate a hybrid working model that combines in-person collaboration in our dedicated office spaces with focused time working remotely. This gives our teams the connection and energy of working together, alongside the flexibility to do their best work in a way that fits their lives.

🔍 The Interview Process:

Our process is clear and respectful of your time:

  • Initial call / recruiter screen (30 minutes)

  • Competency Interviews (Programming and hiring manager interview; 1 hour 45 minutes total)

  • Deep-dive technical interviews (Cross-functional, system design; 1 hour 45 minutes total)

  • Final interview: mission & values alignment (45 minutes).

We’ll always explain the format and work around your availability.

What’s in it for you (Location dependant):

💰 Salaries benchmarked against the market annually
✅ Hybrid working, core hours and the chance to work hands on in vehicle workshops and labs
📚 Learning and development budgets with support for training, conferences and growth
🩺 Comprehensive benefits including health insurance, dental, enhanced maternity and paternity leave, retirement or pension where applicable, access to therapists, wellbeing partnerships, team socials and more

A quick, honest note before you apply.

Wayve is not a mature, fully-structured place with the playbook already written. Much of how we work is still being written, and if you join, you’ll help write it. That suits people who want real ownership more than people who need a settled structure from day one.

If that sounds like the kind of problem you want to spend your time on, we’d really like to hear from you.

At Wayve we're committed to creating a diverse, fair and respectful culture that is inclusive of everyone based on their unique skills and perspectives, and regardless of sex, race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, veteran status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding) or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

For more information visit Careers at Wayve. To learn more about what drives us, visit Values at Wayve

DISCLAIMER: We will not ask about marriage or pregnancy, care responsibilities or disabilities in any of our job adverts or interviews. However, we do look to capture information about care responsibilities, and disabilities among other diversity information as part of an optional DEI Monitoring form to help us identify areas of improvement in our hiring process and ensure that the process is inclusive and non-discriminatory.

job.title: Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer
job.description:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer to join our team full-time in India.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Automation QA (JavaScript) Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow. Ciklum is seeking a Senior AI Automation QA Engineer to join the client project, an ambitious initiative to build an enterprise-grade Agent Development Platform (ADP) that our client will commercialize to their own customers. This is quality engineering for a system that is non-deterministic by nature, where "expected output" is a statistical claim rather than a string match, and where the platform's reliability guarantees no lost workflow runs, strict tenant isolation, graceful degradation under provider outages are contractual commitments, not aspirations. You will build the automation that proves those guarantees hold, release after release.

You will own the test automation that spans the whole platform: the Frontend and Backend that agent developers depend on, the long-running Temporal workflows that must survive worker crashes and provider failures, the multi-tenant isolation boundaries that protect one customer's data from another, and the performance and concurrency targets defined in the platform's NFRs. Much of your craft is adversarial and failure-first injecting worker kills, retry storms, and malformed documents to verify the system recovers exactly as specified, and negative-testing disallowed tool calls and egress paths to confirm the sandbox holds. Where agent behavior must be judged rather than asserted, you will partner closely with the evaluation function, contributing the test infrastructure, synthetic-data pipelines, and CI integration that make quality measurable and repeatable.

This is a high-visibility role where we establish the production-ready foundation the rest of the program is built on. Your automated suites become release gates, and the evidence they produce feeds directly into client milestone sign-offs so your work must be reproducible, trustworthy, and defensible to a sophisticated client. As the platform scales toward an "agent-a-month" delivery cadence, you will build the reusable test scaffolds and harnesses that let quality keep pace with delivery, ensuring that month twelve ships as safely as month one. You will work shoulder-to-shoulder with AI engineers, platform engineers, and the evaluation team, embedding quality from the design stage rather than inspecting for it at the end.

Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for the platform, Frontend and Backend, including contract tests that protect the agent-developer experience as the SDK evolves
  • Build automated tests for long-running Temporal workflows including failure injection (worker kill, provider outage, retry storms) to verify durable-execution guarantees such as zero lost runs and correct compensation/saga behavior
  • Automate multi-tenant isolation verification cross-tenant data access, configuration bleed, and cost-attribution correctness executed per release as a platform acceptance criterion
  • Verify agent execution sandboxing and egress controls through negative testing of disallowed tool calls and network destinations
  • AI-Specific & Non-Deterministic Testing
  • Design test strategies for LLM-driven behavior: statistical assertions over repeated runs (pass^k consistency), semantic-similarity scoring, confidence-threshold validation, and flakiness quarantine that distinguishes model variance from genuine regression
  • Build and continuously extend adversarial test corpora document-borne prompt injection in lease PDFs, tool-call hijack, and data-exfiltration probes aligned to OWASP LLM Top 10 and recognized red-team taxonomies
  • Verify Human-in-the-Loop (HITL) escalation behavior confidence thresholds fire correctly and no gated/irreversible action completes without authorization
  • Partner with the evaluation function on golden-dataset-driven checks, contributing test infrastructure, synthetic-data (synthetic lease) pipelines, and CI integration that make agent quality measurable and repeatable
  • Performance, Reliability & NFR Verification
  • Automate verification of platform NFRs invocation overhead (p95), concurrency targets, queue backpressure behavior, and LLM provider failover time and surface trends per release
  • Use tracing data (Langfuse / OpenTelemetry spans) as a first-class test asset: assert on trace completeness, token/cost-accounting accuracy, and alerting behavior for anomalous runs
  • Process, Evidence & Collaboration
  • Wire test suites into CI/CD as hard release gates with automated, per-metric regression flagging on pull requests
  • Produce auditable, reproducible test-evidence packs that feed directly into client milestone sign-off
  • Embed with AI and platform engineers from the design stage making acceptance criteria, testability, and observability inputs to architecture, not afterthoughts
  • Maintain test environments, mocked LLM/provider layers, and synthetic data generators that keep test runs fast, deterministic where possible, and affordable
  • Mentor mid-level QA engineers, codify AI testing patterns into reusable internal frameworks, and contribute to Ciklum's quality engineering practice and AI Academy

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of test automation with API testing, and building test frameworks other engineers adopt, not just test cases
  • Hands-on experience testing LLM-powered or other non-deterministic systems statistical assertions, semantic scoring, and managing model variance (this is the differentiator; cite real examples)
  • Experience testing asynchronous, event-driven systems failure injection, idempotency verification, eventual-consistency assertions; Temporal or a similar workflow engine a strong plus
  • Strong CI/CD integration skills (GitHub Actions or equivalent) and the discipline to design release gates
  • Solid SQL and data-validation skills; comfort building synthetic test-data pipelines and measuring dataset quality
  • A security-testing and adversarial mindset; familiarity with prompt-injection techniques or a strong AppSec testing background with willingness to specialize fast
  • Demonstrated judgment on what "tested enough" means under milestone pressure, and the ability to defend quality evidence to non-engineering stakeholders
  • Strong proficiency in Playwright and TypeScript is mandatory for building automated test suites
  • QA Automation Core: Extensive experience in building automated test frameworks (Playwright/Typescript-based) and integrating them into high-security CI/CD pipelines
  • AI/LLM Literacy: Deep understanding of Large Language Model behaviors, prompt sensitivity, and the common failure modes of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems
  • Analytical Mindset: Strong capability in statistical analysis to interpret evaluation scores and provide actionable feedback to AI Engineers for prompt tuning

Desirable:

  • Performance/load tooling (k6, Locust) for concurrency and latency NFR verification
  • Prior testing of multi-tenant SaaS isolation
  • Exposure to eval/observability stacks (Langfuse, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval, Arize Phoenix)
  • Compliance evidence experience (SOC 2, GDPR) or accessibility testing (Section 508 / WCAG)
  • Familiarity with Commercial Real Estate workflows (lease accounting, CAM reconciliation) or document-extraction systems (OCR, layout parsing)
  • Experience using LLMs to generate test cases, adversarial payloads, or synthetic documents
  • Performance Testing: Experience testing high-concurrency background processing within agentic systems
  • Experience with qTest for test management

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Care: We’ve got you covered with company-paid medical insurance, mental health support, and financial & legal consultations

About us:

At Ciklum, we are always exploring innovations, empowering each other to achieve more, and engineering solutions that matter. With us, you’ll work with cutting-edge technologies, contribute to impactful projects, and be part of a One Team culture that values collaboration and progress.

India is a strategic innovation hub for Ciklum, with growing teams in Chennai and Pune leading advancements in EdgeTech, AR/VR, IoT, and beyond. Join us to collaborate on game-changing solutions and take your career to the next level.

Explore, empower, engineer with Ciklum!

Interested already? We would love to get to know you! Submit your application. We can’t wait to see you at Ciklum.

job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) (Remote, US-Based Only)

Build quality into software that matters.

At Pulsara, great testing requires more than finding defects or building automated tests. Our Senior Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) combine hands-on testing with software engineering expertise to build and sustain reliable automation, solve complex technical challenges, and mentor others while helping shape the team's approach to software quality.

And reliability matters here.

Pulsara is used by healthcare professionals coordinating care for time-critical patients. The defects you uncover, the automation you build, and the expertise you share help deliver software our customers can depend on when it matters most.

If you enjoy tackling complex testing challenges, improving how software is built and tested, and helping others succeed, keep reading.

What is Pulsara?

Pulsara connects people when seconds matter.

Pulsara is a secure, user-friendly software software solution that unites the entire care team, even across different departments or organizations. By replacing multiple phone calls, radio reports, faxes, and pagers with one unified patient channel, Pulsara streamlines workflows, leading to reduced treatment times, lower costs, and enhanced experiences for both patients and caregivers.

Who we are:

Pulsara is a 100% remote team made up of people with backgrounds in technology, healthcare, emergency services, business, and beyond, united by a common purpose: to improve the lives of people in need and those who serve them.

Working remotely gives us flexibility, but great remote work takes more than being able to work from home. We communicate intentionally, collaborate across teams, take ownership of our work, and depend on one another to follow through.

We are a company that continues to evolve. We value people who are curious, comfortable learning, willing to challenge how things have always been done, and interested in helping us make both our product and the way we work better.

🔗 Want to learn more? Explore our technology atPulsara.com and discover our team, culture, and benefits on our Careers page.

What You’ll Be Testing

Pulsara isn’t a single web application.

Our technology environment includes:

📱 Native iOS and Android applications

💻 Web-based patient care, administration, and reporting tools
☁️ A highly scalable AWS cloud environment

🔌 Internal and public APIs

🗄️ Relational databases and complex data workflows
🔐 Secure, HIPAA-compliant systems supporting communication across organizations

That means testing often requires looking beyond a single screen or expected workflow. A change in one area may affect workflows elsewhere, and understanding those relationships is an important part of becoming effective in this role.

Your Primary Job Focus and Day-to-Day Activities Will Include:

⚙️ Build and sustain reliable automation

Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks and test suites that perform reliably over time. Improve test coverage, execution performance, and maintainability while minimizing flaky tests.

🔄 Strengthen testing tools and environments
Create, maintain, and troubleshoot test environments and supporting tools. Integrate automated testing into CI/CD workflows to help identify issues earlier and support dependable releases.

🔍 Plan and execute effective testing across the Pulsara platform
Develop practical test strategies, plans, and reusable test cases based on requirements, technical complexity, risk, and customer workflows. Perform manual and automated testing across mobile and web applications, internal and public APIs, database migrations, and tools running in AWS to identify defects, risks, and unexpected behavior.

🤝 Lead through technical expertise and mentorship
Share your experience designing and maintaining reliable automation to mentor other Test Engineering team members, strengthen their technical capabilities, and help shape the team's approach to testing and automation.

🧠 Think beyond the happy path

Explore edge cases, complex system interactions, and real-world conditions. Apply technical expertise and sound judgment to determine where automation adds value and where hands-on testing is essential.

🐞 Investigate and communicate problems clearly
Troubleshoot complex defects and test failures, document reproducible findings, collaborate on solutions, and verify fixes.

🏥 Keep the customer in focus

Understand how healthcare professionals use Pulsara and recognize where technical issues, unexpected behavior, or workflow friction could affect their ability to coordinate care.

🚀 Help us continuously improve

Identify opportunities to improve testing practices, automation, and tools. Apply new technologies, including AI-assisted tools, where they meaningfully improve quality and efficiency.

What We Are Looking For

✅ Demonstrated expertise in software testing and quality assurance, including test planning, manual and exploratory testing, regression testing, and defect reporting

✅ A proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining reliable automation frameworks and substantial test suites over time, including unit, integration, and end-to-end testing across mobile, web, and API environments

✅ Experience mentoring other engineers or testers, sharing technical expertise, and helping guide testing and automation practices

✅ Hands-on programming or scripting experience with languages such as Swift, Java, Kotlin, Ruby, TypeScript, Bash, Python, or comparable technologies

✅ Practical experience testing mobile and web applications, internal and public APIs, database migrations, and complex system integrations

✅ Experience with mobile testing tools and frameworks such as Xcode/XCTest for iOS, Android Studio/Espresso/Jetpack Compose for Android, and Playwright for web

job.title: Global Quality Assurance Manager
job.description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe.

JOB SUMMARY


Overall responsibilities

The Global Quality Data & Systems Manager supports the delivery of assigned global Quality system initiatives, helping to improve compliance and promote consistent quality practices across sites. Working under the direction of quality leadership, the role partners with process owners and site teams to implement practical, risk-based processes that support customer satisfaction, product quality, and business growth.

The Manager works with cross-functional stakeholders to implement agreed quality improvements, support manufacturing excellence activities, and track system performance. Responsibilities include tracking project milestones, supporting process harmonization, assisting with change adoption, and reporting performance data with improvement suggestions. Issues affecting priorities, policy, compliance risk, or resources are escalated to the line manager and quality leadership for decision.


Position duties and responsibilities

Quality Management System: Support the development, implementation, and maintenance of assigned QMS procedures in line with applicable standards, regulatory requirements, and the direction established by quality leadership. Work with process owners and site quality teams to collect inputs for Management Reviews and follow up on assigned actions. Track key process indicators (KPI) and Quality Costs, highlight trends and improvement opportunities, and propose corrective actions for review.


Global Harmonisation and Best Practices: Support assigned harmonisation and standardisation activities across global healthcare sites. Share knowledge between sites, collect site-level feedback, and propose best-practice solutions for review and approval by process owners and quality leadership.


Process and Tool Development: Maintain and improve processes and tools within the assigned scope to support day-to-day quality and compliance activities. Collect plant and business requirements and work with process owners and Corporate IT on requirements definition, testing, implementation, and user support in line with approved plans.


Change Management and Stakeholder Communication: Support change management and communication activities for assigned initiatives in line with agreed stakeholder engagement plans. Prepare communications and training materials, track adoption of approved processes and tools, and escalate implementation issues to the relevant leads.


Documentation and Process Excellence: Support the standardisation, simplification, and harmonisation of assigned procedures and processes, and contribute to policy updates as requested by policy owners. Coordinate document reviews and implementation through established approval and change control processes to improve usability and ongoing adherence.


Leadership and Team Development: Manage and support assigned team members and project resources, setting clear tasks and objectives aligned with agreed priorities. Promote accountability, collaboration, continuous learning, and patient-focused quality. Plan day-to-day workloads within available resources, identify training needs, and escalate capacity constraints or decisions to the line manager.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
You’re more valuable than ever – And that’s just how we’ll make you feel.

Job Summary

The Quality Engineer plays a key role in the Company’s transition from traditional quality assurance

to a modern Quality Engineering model while retaining a strong foundation in hands-on manual

testing. The Quality Engineer will help build quality into the software development lifecycle by

partnering early with product, engineering, operations, clinical, and support stakeholders to

identify risk, clarify requirements, shape testability, execute thoughtful manual validation, expand

automation where appropriate, and improve release confidence before changes reach production.

Success in this role requires the ability to learn quickly, think critically, communicate clearly, speak

up when something does not make sense, connect details across systems and processes, become a

trusted expert on how the solution works, advocate for the end user, and validate whether software

truly supports the intended business outcome, not only whether it satisfies the written acceptance

criteria. The Quality Engineer must be technically capable, quality-driven, collaborative, and

committed to understanding the business, the workflows, and the purpose behind the applications

they support.

Qualifications

Education Required:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Healthcare

Informatics, or a related field.

  • Equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

Work Experience Required:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience performing manual, exploratory, regression, integration,

API, web-based, mobile, or enterprise application testing, or equivalent demonstrated

ability through software quality, engineering, automation, support, or technical product

work.

  • Demonstrated ability to create thoughtful test plans, execute detailed manual validation, ask

strong questions, connect business context to technical behavior, identify risk early, validate

end-to-end workflows, and explain defects clearly to technical and non-technical partners.

  • Experience with, or strong interest in growing into, quality engineering practices such as

test case management, test automation, API validation, CI/CD quality gates, accessibility and

ADA-informed testing, cross-browser validation, regression strategy, observability, and

production defect prevention.

  • Experience partnering throughout the full software development lifecycle to influence

quality up front, clarify requirements, assess testability, surface risks before development is

complete, and support informed go/no-go production readiness decisions.

  • Experience working within agile delivery teams using common planning, sprint, test

management, pipeline, and cross-browser testing tools to support story refinement, sprint

execution, test coverage, release readiness, and continuous delivery practices

Preferred Qualifications, Education, Licenses, Certifications, Experience, etc.:

  • Healthcare technology experience preferred, including familiarity with urgent care

workflows, patient registration, electronic medical records, HL7 integrations, Epic,

eClinicalWorks, payment workflows, or revenue cycle processes.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Azure DevOps, Jira, QMetry, BrowserStack, or comparable

platforms is preferred, with emphasis on applying the right quality practices rather than

relying on a specific toolset.

  • Familiarity with accessibility standards, ADA considerations, inclusive design principles,

and practical validation of accessible user experiences across web and mobile applications

preferred.

  • Quality engineering, automation, accessibility, cloud, healthcare technology, or securityrelated certifications.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • This role involves interaction and collaboration with other departments and requires

excellent judgment and interpersonal skills.

  • Professional Judgment and Quality Advocacy: Uses sound judgment, curiosity, and

critical thinking to understand system behavior, assess business impact, identify risks early,

and promote high-quality outcomes across cross-functional teams.

  • Business Process Understanding: Quickly develops an understanding of complex business

processes, recognizes workflow impacts, and explains expected system behavior in

practical, real-world terms.

  • Professional Communication: Asks thoughtful questions, raises concerns constructively,

challenges assumptions respectfully, and builds productive partnerships to support qualityfocused decision-making.

  • Business and Systems Understanding: Develops working knowledge of GoHealth’s

business model, operational workflows, product behavior, integrations, and user needs to

validate the purpose and impact of application changes.

  • End-User Advocacy: Evaluates software against practical workflows and use cases for

patients, providers, center staff, operations, and support teams.

  • Quality Engineering Mindset: Improves testability and validates beyond the happy path

across edge cases, exceptions, integrations, and operational scenarios.

  • Technical and Automation Capability: Applies automation, API testing, test data analysis,

logs, repeatable checks, test management practices, pipeline quality gates, and crossbrowser validation to improve speed, coverage, and confidence.

  • Accessibility Awareness: Applies ADA-informed and accessibility testing practices to

support usable, inclusive digital experiences.

  • Team-Oriented Quality Ownership: Treats quality as a shared responsibility by

partnering to prevent defects, resolve issues, improve processes, and support successful

delivery.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Supports scalable quality practices across product engineering delivery teams by improving

validation methods, identifying risks early, strengthening supporting release readiness, and

building practical understanding of the products and workflows they support.

  • Design, document, execute, and maintain manual, exploratory, regression, integration, endto-end, and risk-based test cases for web, mobile, API, integration, and back-end services.
  • Develop and maintain repeatable testing approaches, including automation where

appropriate, to support sprint delivery, regression coverage, release readiness, and

production quality.

  • Partner with product owners, software engineers, operations, clinical stakeholders, and

support teams to clarify requirements, assess risk, improve testability, investigate defects,

validate fixes, and strengthen quality controls before release.

  • Validate key urgent care workflows, including patient registration, insurance capture,

payments, EMR integration, messaging, operational tools, and related digital products.

  • Evaluate product changes against real operational workflows, end-user needs, and business

outcomes, identifying gaps where functionality may satisfy written requirements but not

practical use.

  • Build solution expertise to explain how features, data, integrations, and workflows operate

and where defects, design gaps, or missed edge cases may create downstream impact.

  • Perform API, accessibility, ADA-informed, cross-browser, integration, regression, smoke,

exploratory, and end-to-end testing using appropriate tools and techniques.

  • Use agile planning, sprint management, test case management, pipeline, and cross-browser

testing platforms to organize work, maintain traceability, monitor coverage, and support

release decisions.

  • Contribute to quality gates, release validation, defect trend analysis, root cause analysis, test

coverage reporting, and other metrics that support continuous improvement.

  • Support production readiness by validating critical workflows, communicating risk clearly,

confirming defects are resolved as intended, and helping teams determine deployment

readiness.

  • Identify opportunities to reduce repetitive manual validation, improve test coverage,

strengthen documentation, and make quality practices easier for engineering teams to

adopt.

  • Manage the support ticket queue by analyzing issues that arise, providing clear support to

end users, and participating in on-call and off-hours coverage as needed to support releases,

production validation, and critical quality support needs.


Base Salary Range: $83,500/year to $114,858/year

The range above reflects the good-faith compensation range the Company reasonably expects to pay for this position at the time of posting.

Actual compensation will depend on experience, skills, education, geographic location, and other business-related factors.It is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role.

GoHealth Core Values

GoHealth’s Core Values, listed below, are essential functions of this position:

  • Collaboration: Takes ownership for collectively establishing productive partnerships and

relationships and seek to gain joint understanding of priorities and objectives so that the

greater good of the organization and those we serve is always at the forefront.

  • Innovation: Consistently uses good judgment, applying creativity to overcome obstacles

and increasing effectiveness and efficiency through process and other forms of innovation.

  • Diversity & Inclusion: Fosters diversity and inclusion, to be able to better understand

team members, our customers and partners. Engages the strengths and talents of each

GoHealth team member, creating an environment of involvement, respect and connection

where the richness of ideas, backgrounds and perspectives are harnessed.

  • Courage & Integrity: Models and practices the highest ethical and professional standards;

demonstrates pride and personal interest in our patients, partners and fellow team

members, deeply engaging in the business. Makes decisions, with a focus on doing the right

thing; treats team members, our customers, partners and vendors with dignity,

consideration, open-mindedness and respect.

  • Accountability: Always shows initiative, demonstrates a bias to action and gets things

done. Actively accepts responsibility for diverse roles, obligations and actions that

positively influence patient and customer outcomes, our partnerships and the healthcare

needs of our communities.

Additional Requirements

  • Office Environment: Tasks may be conducted within a climate-controlled office setting.
  • Physical Activity: The role may require the ability to lift, carry, push, or pull materials,

supplies, and equipment up to 25 lbs. Duties typically involve a combination of sitting,

standing, and walking, with frequent changes in position.

  • Travel: Travel may be required on an occasional basis for team meetings, market launches,

site visits, training, or other business needs, typically once or twice per year, up to 5%.

  • Safety Equipment: May require the use of safety equipment for infection prevention.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

The Company and its affiliates, joint venture partners and entities under common management are

Equal Opportunity Employers. They do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national

origin, age, sex, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected

status under federal, state, or local law.

ADA Accommodation Statement

Reasonable accommodations are available for qualified individuals with disabilities upon request.

This role defines success by achieving essential function outcomes, not by the method of

completion.

Compliance Statement

This job will be performed consistent with ADA, FMLA, FLSA, and other applicable federal, state,

and local laws regulating employment


Set up email alerts as new job postings become available that meet your interest!

All qualified persons are granted an equal opportunity for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity or expression, age, national origin, citizenship status, disability, genetic information, medical condition, family care leave status, pregnancy or pregnancy-related condition, otherwise qualified disabled or veteran status. The company will comply with all fair employment laws in each of the jurisdictions where we conduct business.

job.title: Default Claims VA QA Analyst, I
job.description:
Come join our amazing team and work remote from home!

The Default Claims Quality Assurance (“QA”) Analyst is responsible for review and reconciliation of all default claims (i.e. Mortgage Insurance (MI) claims, etc.) for accuracy, certify as such and transmit the claim filing to the appropriate entity (FHA, USDA, PMI, VA, FNMA, and FHLMC). Perform all duties in accordance with the company’s policies and procedures, all US state and federal laws and regulations, wherein the company operates. The target pay for this position is $20.00 - $24.50/hr.

What you’ll do:

  • Review all FHA, VA, PMI, USDA, FNMA, and FHLMC claims within the investor/insurer timeframes for accuracy.
  • Validate that all expenses within the system have been reconciled and claimed in accordance to agency requirements
  • Identifies errors from the QA claim review and ensures corrections have been completed before submitting the claim for reimbursement
  • Document Mortgage platform with appropriate process tracking
  • Escalate trends or issues identified from the QA of the claim form
  • Verify taxes and insurance maintained and paid timely and cancelled/endorsed according to investor/insurer guidelines.
  • Ensure company/procedures around the curtailment of interest or advances are followed and enforced
  • Responsible for internal quality assurance of all departmental claim documents.
  • Complete monthly audits assigned.
  • Moderate knowledge of default claims processes for insurers and investors
  • Understanding of the default servicing process, to include foreclosure, Bankruptcy, Loss Mitigation and Claims process
  • Moderate understanding of Agency and investor guidelines
  • Strong interpersonal skills with a focus on teamwork and quality on loan evaluation
  • Excellent written and oral communication, organizational and time management skills
  • Ability to communicate effectively with all levels of staff and management both internally and externally
  • Ability to manage work in order to meet strict deadlines
  • Ability to handle multiple tasks under pressure and changing priorities

What you’ll need:

  • High School diploma required; some college preferred.
  • One (1) or more years’ mortgage servicing default experience, or QA/QC experience in another line of business, or College Graduate.
  • Able to work M-TH 7-5 and Friday 7:30-11:30 plus overtime as needed

What We Offer:

  • Comprehensive healthcare plans for you and your family. Plus, a discretionary 401(k) match of 50% of the first 4% of pay contributed.
  • Access to several fitness, restaurant, retail (and more!) discounts through our employee portal.
  • Customized training programs to help you advance your career.
  • Employee referral bonuses so you’ll get paid to help Carrington and Vylla grow.
  • Educational Reimbursement.
  • Carrington Charitable Foundation contributes to the community through causes that reflect the interests of Carrington Associates. For more information about Carrington Charitable Foundation, and the organizations and programs, it supports through specific fundraising efforts, please visit: carringtoncf.org.

Notice to all applicants: Carrington does not do interviews or make offers via text or chat.

job.title: QA Analyst, Credit Risk- Analyste AQ, risque de crédit
job.description:
*La version anglaise suivra // The english version will follow

Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque

nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada. Nous offrons aux Canadiens les taux les plus bas dès le départ, en toute transparence et sans négociation.

À propos de nous

Pionnier du financement hypothécaire en ligne au Canada, nesto transforme la façon dont les Canadiens financent leur propriété. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.

Les emprunteurs profitent de taux souvent plus avantageux que ceux offerts par les grandes banques, ainsi que d'une expérience hypothécaire exceptionnelle, simple et fluide, du début à la fin. Le tout est propulsé par une technologie d'intelligence artificielle de pointe.

Rapide, simple et entièrement numérique, nesto a été nommé Prêteur hypothécaire de l'année par la CLA pendant trois années consécutives. Voilà le côté brillant de l'hypothèque.

Groupe Nesto

Le Groupe Nesto est le principal fournisseur de technologies hypothécaires et de solutions de financement au Canada, avec plus de 80 milliards de dollars canadiens en prêts hypothécaires résidentiels et commerciaux sous administration. Fort de la confiance de plusieurs des principales institutions financières du pays, le Groupe Nesto combine plus de 50 ans d'expertise hypothécaire à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives pour transformer l'avenir du financement.

Grâce à ses technologies infonuagiques et d'intelligence artificielle exclusives, nesto est devenu l'un des prêteurs hypothécaires à la croissance la plus rapide au Canada, gagnant des parts de marché dans le financement résidentiel direct aux consommateurs (D2C), le réseau des courtiers hypothécaires et le financement commercial multirésidentiel. Reconnue au palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, l'entreprise continue de faire progresser le secteur grâce à l'innovation, à la technologie et à des solutions axées sur les clients.

Grâce à sa famille de marques — CMLS, nesto et Nesto Cloud —, le Groupe Nesto a pour mission de bâtir l'écosystème hypothécaire canadien de demain et de devenir un véritable chef de file canadien en technologies de financement et en services financiers.

Pour en savoir plus :

La vie chez nesto

Chez nesto, nous avons à cœur de remettre en question le statu quo, d'offrir une meilleure expérience hypothécaire et d'aider les Canadiens à économiser sur leur hypothèque. Nous cultivons une culture de collaboration, de transparence et de créativité, où chaque membre de l'équipe est encouragé à prendre ses projets en main, à avoir un impact concret et à évoluer.

Si vous souhaitez relever des défis stimulants et trouver des solutions à des enjeux importants aux côtés de collègues ambitieux, passionnés et toujours prêts à s'entraider, vous vous sentirez chez vous chez nesto.

Votre rôle

  • Effectuer quotidiennement l'examen d'un échantillon de demandes hypothécaires (avant et après déboursement) pour assurer la conformité aux normes de souscription, aux politiques du Groupe nesto et aux exigences réglementaires.
  • Évaluer l'ensemble des éléments de données, documents financiers, renseignements clients, transmissions des courtiers et assureurs, et documents juridiques afin de noter tout écart par rapport aux politiques.
  • Repérer les tendances de comportement inhabituel, les transactions suspectes et la légitimité des documents via les « dossiers à surveiller » des assureurs et les références internes.
  • Effectuer des enquêtes préliminaires et prendre les mesures nécessaires sur les dossiers suspects afin de réduire le risque de perte et de fausse représentation.
  • Préparer des rapports d'assurance qualité détaillant les constatations et recommandations, et mener des analyses approfondies à la demande de la gestion des risques ou de l'AQ.
  • Soutenir les audits avec les partenaires, investisseurs et assureurs, de la préparation initiale jusqu'à la résolution des items problématiques.
  • Aider à la gestion, au contrôle périodique et à l'examen des listes approuvées (évaluateurs, notaires/avocats, courtiers, fournisseurs) et des listes de lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent (LBA).
  • Exécuter les examens d'assurance et de contrôle de la qualité de façon régulière, rapide, efficace et objective.
  • Fournir des conseils, opinions et recommandations au personnel de souscription et aux parties prenantes concernant les risques de crédit, la mitigation des pertes, les risques d'inondation/propriété et les opportunités de formation.

Qui nous recherchons

  • Expérience : Minimum de 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en approbation/adjudication de prêts hypothécaires. Expérience dans le canal des courtiers hypothécaires, un atout.
  • Outils & Maîtrise technique : Maîtrise des applications Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, SharePoint), Google Workspace (GDrive, Sheets, Docs), des CRM et outils de flux de travail (Salesforce).
  • Connaissances du domaine : Solide compréhension des directives des assureurs, internes et externes, ainsi qu'une bonne connaissance des implications, méthodes de détection et de prévention de la fraude.
  • Compétences clés : Pensée analytique et compétences bien développées en négociation et résolution de problèmes pour repérer les tendances et anomalies dans les pratiques de souscription.
  • Autonomie & Prise de décision : Capacité à travailler de façon autonome avec une supervision limitée, à gérer et prioriser les demandes urgentes, et à formuler des recommandations impopulaires lorsque requis.
  • Langue & Communication : Bilinguisme fluide (français et anglais) requis pour soutenir les clients à l'échelle nationale, avec une excellente capacité à communiquer les constatations à la direction et aux souscripteurs.

Pourquoi vous aimeriez travailler ici

Nous croyons que les personnes de talent donnent le meilleur d'elles-mêmes lorsqu'elles sont soutenues sur les plans professionnel, personnel et financier. C'est pourquoi nous offrons un programme de rémunération globale complet, conçu pour vous aider à vous épanouir à chaque étape de votre carrière.

  • Rémunération concurrentielle — Salaire compétitif, primes de rendement (le cas échéant) et reconnaissance de vos contributions.
  • Santé et bien-être — Couverture complète pour les soins médicaux, dentaires et de la vue, comptes de gestion des dépenses santé et bien-être (le cas échéant), télémédecine, programme d'aide aux employés (PAE) et soutien en santé mentale pour vous et votre famille.
  • Du temps pour refaire le plein — Vacances généreuses (4 semaines), congés mobiles et jours fériés pour vous permettre de vous ressourcer.
  • Planification de l'avenir — Cotisation de contrepartie au REER pour soutenir votre bien-être financier à long terme.
  • Soutien aux familles — Prestations complémentaires bonifiées pour les congés de maternité et parentaux.
  • Apprentissage et perfectionnement — Aide financière aux études, mentorat, formations et occasions de faire progresser votre carrière au sein du Groupe Nesto.
  • Des outils pour réussir — Technologies modernes, équipes collaboratives et toutes les ressources nécessaires pour vous dépasser.

Diversité, équité et inclusion

Au sein du Groupe Nesto, nous croyons que la diversité des points de vue fait notre force. Nous nous engageons à favoriser un milieu de travail inclusif où chacun se sent respecté, soutenu et habilité à réussir.

Nous accueillons les candidatures de personnes de tous horizons, y compris les membres des Premiers Peuples (Premières Nations, Inuit et Métis), les personnes en situation de handicap, les membres des communautés racisées, les femmes et les personnes de la communauté 2ELGBTQIA+.

Si vous avez besoin de mesures d'adaptation à n'importe quelle étape du processus de recrutement, nous nous engageons à collaborer avec vous pour répondre à vos besoins.

The bright side of mortgages

nestois Canada’s leading digital residential mortgage lender, offering Canadians the lowest rates from the get-go — with total transparency and no haggling.

About Us

As Canada's pioneer in online mortgage lending, nesto is transforming the way Canadians finance their homes. Our mission is to offer a positive, empowering, and transparent property financing experience, simplified from start to finish.

Borrowers benefit from rates that are often lower than those offered by the big banks, along with an exceptional end-to-end mortgage experience powered by best-in-class AI technology. Fast, simple, and fully digital, nesto has been recognized as CLA Lender of the Year for three consecutive years. That's the bright side of mortgages.

Nesto Group

Nesto Group is Canada's leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, with more than CAD $80 billion in residential and commercial mortgages under administration. Trusted by many of the country's leading financial institutions, we combine over 50 years of mortgage expertise with proprietary cloud and AI technology to transform the future of lending.

Powered by our proprietary cloud and AI technology, nesto has become one of Canada's fastest-growing mortgage lenders, gaining market share across direct-to-consumer (D2C) residential lending, the broker channel, and multi-family commercial lending. Recognized as one of Deloitte's Fast 50 companies for three consecutive years, we continue to push the industry forward through innovation, technology, and customer-focused solutions.

Operating through our family of brands—CMLS,nesto, andNesto Cloud—our mission is to build Canada's mortgage ecosystem of the future and create a true Canadian champion in lending technology and financial services.

Learn more at:

Life at nesto

At nesto, we're passionate about challenging the status quo and building a better mortgage experience and saving money on their mortgages for Canadians. We foster a culture of collaboration, transparency, and creativity where every team member is empowered to take ownership, make an impact, and grow. If you're looking to solve meaningful problems alongside ambitious, supportive teammates, you'll feel right at home here.

About the Role

  • Review an adequate daily sampling of mortgage applications post-funding and pre-funding to ensure compliance with nesto Group policies, underwriting standards, and regulatory requirements.
  • Assess file data elements, financial documents, client information, broker file transmissions, insurer transmissions, and miscellaneous legal documentation to identify policy deviations.
  • Identify patterns of unusual behavior, suspicious transactions, and documentation validity via "Heads up Files" from external insurers and internal referrals.
  • Conduct preliminary investigations and necessary actions on suspect files to mitigate misrepresentation risk and loss.
  • Prepare QA reports with findings and recommendations on suspicious or irregular activity files, as well as execute further analysis as directed by Risk or QA Management.
  • Support audits with partners, investors, and insurers, spanning from preparation to audit finding resolution.
  • Assist in the management, periodic control, and review of approved lists for Appraisers, Solicitors, Brokers, Vendors, and AML lists.
  • Execute QA/QC reviews regularly on a timely, efficient, and objective basis.
  • Provide guidance, opinions, and recommendations to underwriting staff and stakeholders on credit issues, loss mitigation, flood/property risk, and training opportunities.

Who we are looking for

  • Experience: Minimum 3–5 years of Mortgage/Lending Adjudication experience. Experience in the mortgage broker channel is preferred.
  • Technical Proficiency: Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, SharePoint), Google Workspace (GDrive, Sheets, Docs), CRMs, and workflow tools (Salesforce).
  • Domain Knowledge: Strong understanding of insurer, internal, and external guidelines, alongside working knowledge of fraud implications, detection methodologies, and risk mitigation.
  • Core Competencies: Analytical thinker with well-developed negotiation and problem-solving skills to identify trends, patterns, and anomalies in mortgage underwriting.
  • Autonomy & Decision-Making: Ability to operate independently with limited supervision, prioritize urgent applications, and make unpopular recommendations when required.
  • Language & Communication: Bilingual fluency (English and French) is required to support nationwide clients, with an ability to effectively communicate findings to management and underwriting teams.

Why You'll Love Working Here

We believe great people do their best work when they're supported professionally, personally, and financially. That's why we offer a comprehensive rewards package designed to help you thrive at every stage of your career.

Competitive Rewards — Competitive compensation, performance incentives (where applicable), and recognition for your contributions.

Health & Wellness — Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, Health & Wellness Spending Accounts (where applicable), telemedicine, Employee Assistance Programs, and mental health support for you and your family.

Time to Recharge — Generous vacation (4 weeks), floater days, and statutory holidays to help you recharge.

Planning for the Future — RRSP matching to support your long-term financial wellbeing.

Family Support — Enhanced maternity and parental leave top-up programs.

Learning & Growth — Education assistance, mentorship, training, and opportunities to build your career across Nesto Group.

Tools for Success — Modern technology, collaborative teams, and the resources you need to do your best work.

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion

job.title: Software Quality Engineer
job.description:
Who we are:

Quavo is the industry leader in fraud and disputes management technology, offering the world’s only E2E cloud-based Disputes as a Service solution for issuing financial services organizations. Quavo is an organization of tenacious experts who are innovative and challenge complacency to continuously deliver cutting edge technology and AI. Our experts are passionate about delivering value in our solutions and empowering our client community to enhance and evolve industry standards in fraud and disputes management.

Who you are:

Quavo is looking for authentic and courageous professionals to join our team. If you are a driven, accountable, and innovative problem solver searching for a collaborative environment of like-minded teammates dedicated to improving the client experience…. Then you are going to love working at Quavo!

About the role:

As a Software QA Engineer at Quavo, you’ll ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of our products across the full development lifecycle. You’ll go beyond Acceptance Criteria, thinking like an end user to uncover issues in functionality, security, and UX, and catching problems early by reviewing requirements in refinement.

You’ll work AI-first with Quavo’s Claude Code QA skills for test planning, execution, and bug filing, while remaining accountable for every output you approve. You’ll test Pega/QFD workflows, validate data with read-only Snowflake SQL, and publish traceable evidence to Jira and BrowserStack. You’ll also verify regulatory coverage (Reg E, Reg Z, NACHA, PCI, UDAAP) and maintain audit-ready evidence for SOC2 and PCI-DSS.

Partnering with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Onboarding, Services, and Client Experience, you’ll be an active voice in Agile ceremonies, investigate customer issues, and contribute to Confluence. Over time, you’ll become a subject-matter expert on Quavo’s products, supporting release readiness and guiding clients with confidence.

This role is not sponsorship eligible. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without employer visa sponsorship, now or in the future.

Responsibilities include:

AI-Assisted Testing

  • Operate the QA skills framework. Use Quavo's Claude Code QA skills for board sync, test planning, execution, sign-off, kickbacks, and bug filing.
  • Own every AI-generated output.Review, correct, and approve all drafts before they post to Jira or BrowserStack. You are accountable for the result, not the tool.
  • Contribute product context, compliance dimensions, and reusable test procedures into skills to improve future performance.

Test Planning and Execution

  • Develop and execute test plans to Quavo's ten-point standard covering acceptance criteria mapping, traceability, compliance applicability, and known-gap disclosure that go beyond defined Acceptance Criteria.
  • Test Pega/QFD case lifecycles, flows, decision rules, and data transforms; inspect and compare branches and trace each branch to its Jira ticket.
  • Validate data with read-only SQL against QFD in Snowflake, following PII masking and tenant isolation rules.
  • Ensure product quality in all areas: functionality, reliability, performance, security, and UX. Think like an end user.
  • Publish test cases, runs, and evidence to BrowserStack Test Management to maintain full traceability.

Compliance and Release Readiness

  • Tag and verify regulatory coverage across Reg E, Reg Z, NACHA, PCI, and UDAAP.
  • Maintain test evidence that supports SOC2 and PCI-DSS audits; use synthetic or masked data and never commit secrets or PII.

Collaboration and Shift-Left

  • Participate in sprint ceremonies: standups, refinement, pointing, and retrospectives.
  • Find defects early by reviewing requirements in refinement and applying Quavo's Definition of Ready.
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, Onboarding, Services, Infrastructure, and Client Experience to drive quality.
  • Investigate customer complaints and product issues.
  • Contribute regularly to Confluence and become a Subject Matter Expert on Quavo's products.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or a related field, or equivalent industry experience with a proven track record.
  • ISTQB or other quality/testing certification.
  • 2+ years testing a low-code BPM platform.
  • Hands-on experience using generative AI tools in daily work, with the judgment to spot and challenge incorrect or unsupported results.
  • Basic SQL, Git, and command-line proficiency.
  • Understanding of the disputes and fraud domain (Reg E and Reg Z disputes, chargebacks, card network rules), or a demonstrated ability to learn it quickly.
  • Meticulous attention to detail and strong organizational skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication. Not afraid to ask questions; communicates with tact.
  • Works well on a team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and asks for help early.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Working knowledge of Pega (case types, flows, Tracer, Clipboard)
  • Pega CSA or CSSA certification.
  • Test automation experience, especially Playwright with TypeScript.
  • API testing experience (e.g., Postman).
  • Familiarity with AWS services such as CloudWatch, Lambda, and SQS.
  • Experience in FinTech or another regulated industry.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, BrowserStack, and SharePoint.

job.title: QA Automation Engineer (AI-First)
job.description:
QA Automation Engineer (AI-First)

Location: Bengaluru, India (remote), with daily overlap with our UK team

Engagement Type: Full-time contract, 3 months then ongoing

Experience: 2–4 years

Reports to: Technical Project Manager

Compensation: India-based, aligned to experience and location

About MarcoPolo Learning

MarcoPolo Learning is a leading provider of innovative content, technology, and instructional support for early childhood education. Since 2013, we’ve impacted thousands of classrooms and hundreds of thousands of families across North America. Our Emmy-nominated MarcoPolo World School app and The Polos TV series bring STEM and global discovery to life for young learners.

Backed by top-tier investors, we’re on a mission to transform early learning at scale. At the center of that mission is Audrey, our AI Teaching Companion & Coach for early-learning educators.

Role Overview

We ship fast. AI helps our engineers write code quicker than ever, and we’re about to launch two major web platforms used by thousands of educators. Speed only counts if what reaches teachers works beautifully, every time.

We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer who wants to own that quality. You’ll learn our products inside out, help us move from manual checks to smart, AI-assisted automated testing, and become the person the team trusts to say “this is ready.”

You’ll work directly with our technical project manager and engineers, get hands-on with the latest AI testing and agent tools, and have room to grow into a broader engineering role as you prove yourself.

Key Responsibilities

Quality and testing

  • Test new features end to end across our web platforms and mobile apps, thinking like a teacher, a director and an admin, and catch issues before they reach customers.
  • Write clear test cases and acceptance criteria, using AI to generate and expand them quickly.
  • Build and maintain automated regression suites (e.g. Playwright, Cypress or similar) so every release is checked consistently without repetitive manual work.
  • Evaluate and pilot new AI-forward QA testing platforms (self-healing, agent-driven and visual AI testing tools), measure what actually saves time, and help us adopt the ones that work.
  • Verify that reports, dashboards and data exports reflect real user activity accurately.
  • Test user journeys that span systems, such as course completion, certificates and automated customer emails.
  • Log bugs clearly in Jira, reproduce them reliably, and work with engineers until they’re fixed and verified.

Release and production support

  • Run pre-release and post-release checks, and help verify hotfixes quickly when something needs attention.
  • Be the first technical line for product questions from our customer-facing team: investigate, resolve what you can, and route the rest with the right detail.
  • Turn recurring questions into simple guides and self-serve answers, so the team can find solutions without waiting.

AI and automation

  • Work alongside our automation specialist to test and refine the AI agents and workflows we’re rolling out across the company.
  • Document how our products work, building shared knowledge that helps the whole team and our AI tools.

What We’re Looking For

  • A degree in Computer Science, IT, or a related engineering field (B.E./B.Tech, BCA/MCA or equivalent), or equivalent hands-on experience.
  • 2–4 years of experience in QA, test automation or software development on web applications.
  • Hands-on experience testing mobile apps on iOS, Android and Amazon (Fire OS) devices, including app store builds and testing across devices and screen sizes.
  • Experience building automated tests with Playwright, Cypress, Selenium or similar.
  • Working knowledge of at least one programming language (JavaScript/TypeScript or Python preferred) and comfort reading code.
  • An AI-native way of working: you use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor or Copilot daily, and you’re curious about AI agents and AI testing tools.
  • Openness to new AI-forward QA testing platforms (e.g. Mabl, Testim, testRigor, Applitools, or AI agents working with Playwright), and the curiosity to try them, compare them and bring the best into our workflow.
  • A sharp eye for detail: you notice when a number, a layout or a flow isn’t quite right, and you can explain exactly why.
  • Clear, structured bug reporting and documentation.
  • Comfort with web fundamentals: browser dev tools, APIs and testing across devices and screen sizes.
  • Ownership and follow-through: you see an issue through to resolution and speak up early when something is off.
  • Clear written and spoken English; comfortable working with technical and non-technical colleagues in the UK time zone.

Bonus points

  • Jira or Asana experience in an agile sprint setup.
  • Exposure to a headless CMS (e.g. Strapi), SQL, or tools like Postman.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (e.g. GitHub Actions) or AWS.
  • Experience with no-code automation tools (Zapier, n8n, Make) or email platforms like Customer.io.
  • An ISTQB Foundation certification or similar.
  • Interest in education, ed-tech or early childhood learning.

What Success Looks Like in the First 90 Days

  • First 30 days: learn our products and users, take on release checks, and log your first well-documented bugs.
  • By 60 days: own testing for a product area and ship your first automated regression tests.
  • By 90 days: run release QA independently, with automated coverage on our key user journeys and a recommendation on which AI testing tools we should adopt.

What to Be Ready to Demonstrate

Be ready to walk us through test automation you’ve built: what you chose to automate, how you structured it, and what you’d do differently. The process includes a short, paid practical exercise (AI tools encouraged). Sanitized examples are welcome; please don’t share confidential employer or customer information.

What We Offer

  • Experience with a growing international education company, working closely with our UK-based team.
  • Real ownership: what you test and automate goes straight to thousands of educators.
  • Daily exposure to AI agents, AI testing tools and modern engineering practices.
  • Mentorship and a clear path to grow into a broader engineering role.
  • Compensation benchmarked to the Bengaluru/India market, based on your experience and location.
  • Remote working, plus 15 days paid annual leave and Indian public holidays.
  • A collaborative, mission-driven team at the intersection of education, media and technology.

Why Join Us

If you’re curious about AI and want your work to matter, this is the role. You’ll help shape how a growing global education company builds and tests its products in the AI era, and grow your skills faster than you would almost anywhere else.

Note: This is an India-based engagement. Applicants must have the right to work in India; visa sponsorship is not available at this time.

MarcoPolo Learning is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

job.title: Senior Product QA
job.description:
Senior Product QA

About This Role

Saaf AI is building the infrastructure backbone for modern mortgage operations by combining advanced AI with scalable, reliable systems. As part of a top-10 private lender processing billions in loan volume, backed by leading asset managers and funds, we are growing fast, and product quality is central to how we build and operate.

As a Senior Product QA, you will own quality across the product lifecycle, going beyond traditional test execution to ensure our platform works the way users expect. You will shape requirements, ask the right questions to strengthen acceptance criteria, and use data and user insights to decide what to test and where risk lives. You will also validate AI-powered product features, ensuring outputs are accurate, consistent, and aligned with user expectations.

We are an AI-native engineering team, where AI-assisted tools are a regular part of how we build, test, and ship. From generating test cases to analyzing defect patterns and exploring edge cases, you will use these tools to improve testing coverage and efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

Product Quality Ownership

  • Own end-to-end quality for product features, from requirements review through release readiness.

  • Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to challenge and refine acceptance criteria by asking the right questions and identifying edge cases early in the development cycle.

  • Think like a user: design and execute tests grounded in real user journeys, not just isolated feature checks.

  • Define and maintain test plans, test cases, and quality benchmarks that evolve with the product.

Data-Informed Testing

  • Use product analytics, user feedback, and support data to prioritize testing efforts and focus on high-risk areas.

  • Identify patterns in defects and user-reported issues to drive systemic quality improvements.

  • Communicate quality status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders, not just bug counts, but what they mean for the user experience.

AI-Integrated QA

  • Leverage AI-assisted tools (test case generation, exploratory testing support, defect analysis) as a regular part of your testing workflow to accelerate coverage and reduce blind spots.

  • Validate AI-powered product features, ensuring model outputs, recommendations, and automated decisions meet accuracy and consistency standards.

  • Evaluate and integrate emerging AI tools and practices into the team's QA processes.

Testing Execution

  • Conduct regression, functional, and user acceptance testing (UAT) with a product-first mindset.

  • Verify that new features meet acceptance criteria and are working as expected across user flows.

  • Stay current with emerging QA practices, AI-assisted testing tools, and product quality frameworks.

Team & Process

  • Collaborate with product engineers, product managers, and founders to ensure quality supports rapid iteration and reliable delivery.

  • Document testing decisions, quality benchmarks, and known risk areas to support team knowledge sharing and onboarding.

  • Regularly review and improve testing workflows, coverage strategies, and defect triage processes.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of experience in a QA role, with meaningful exposure to product-oriented testing.

  • Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and modern testing methodologies.

  • Deep product thinking. You understand user behavior, can map complex user journeys, and know how to prioritize based on business impact.

  • Experience using data (analytics, logs, user feedback) to inform testing strategy and prioritization.

  • Proficiency with bug-tracking and project management tools (JIRA, Linear, Trello, or similar).

  • Excellent communication skills. You can articulate quality risks and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong analytical skills with sharp attention to detail.

  • Demonstrated, regular use of AI-powered tools (e.g., Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude, or similar) to accelerate testing workflows, documentation, or defect analysis.

  • Startup mindset: hands-on, resourceful, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred

  • Experience testing AI-powered product features, including validating model outputs, recommendation accuracy, or automated decision flows.

  • Familiarity with mortgage, lending, or fintech product domains.

  • Experience with exploratory testing techniques and risk-based testing approaches.

  • Understanding of how product analytics and observability tools can inform QA strategy.

  • Prior early-stage startup experience is highly preferred.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Remote-first with flexible hours

  • Yearly professional development budget

  • Home office setup stipend
