job.title: Pentester Senior / Red Team
job.description:
Ballpoint, c'est 7 consultants à Paris répartis en deux équipes : une équipe attaque pentest / Red Team, et une équipe défense avec le développement de Trapster. Nous sommes certifiés ISO 27001 et en cours de qualification PASSI.

Avec l'IA, notre métier a changé. Trouver une vulnérabilité n'a jamais été aussi accessible : les outils et la technique ne suffisent plus à faire la différence.

Ce qui compte aujourd'hui, c'est de comprendre l'entreprise qu'on attaque : son métier, ses actifs critiques, ce qui la mettrait vraiment à genoux. C'est pour ça que le Red Team est au cœur de ce qu'on fait : un attaquant réaliste, avec de vrais objectifs, face à une organisation et ses vrais enjeux.

Notre raison d'être : faire progresser durablement le niveau de sécurité de nos clients, pas seulement leur lister des failles.

Nous cherchons donc notre Responsable Pentest / Red Team : la personne qui construira notre pôle Red Team et fera grandir l'équipe.

Nos valeurs

Chez Ballpoint, on accompagne nos clients dans la durée : Red Team, pentest continu, retests. Nos consultants connaissent leur SI autant que leurs enjeux métier, et c’est ce qui guide notre façon de travailler.

1. Curiosité : l'art de creuser au-delà des outils

Nous cultivons la curiosité insatiable pour explorer des technologies inconnues et décortiquer les métiers de nos cibles, car c’est dans cette compréhension fine que se révèlent les chemins d’attaque les plus pertinents.

2. Chacun fait la différence

Chez nous, une bonne idée n’a pas de grade. Un script qui fait gagner une demi-journée sur chaque mission, une meilleure façon de présenter un finding au COMEX, une idée d’offre : chacun peut faire évoluer nos méthodes, nos outils et nos offres. Et on attend de chacun qu’il le fasse.

Le poste

Tu prends la responsabilité technique de toutes nos missions offensives, en restant sur le terrain. Rattaché directement au fondateur, tu travailles avec l'équipe pentest / Red Team.

  • Porter la qualité des missions : cadrage technique, méthodologie, relecture et validation des rapports avant livraison.

  • Mener les opérations Red Team de bout en bout : scénario, infrastructure d'attaque, évasion, débrief au COMEX.

  • Rester un pentester actif : web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel, sur une partie significative de ton temps.

  • Faire grandir l'équipe : montée en compétence des juniors, parcours de certification, partage des techniques.

  • Faire évoluer nos offres et nos outils : pentest continu, templates de rapport, outillage interne, veille.

  • Appuyer l'avant-vente : calls techniques avec les prospects et chiffrage des périmètres.

Ton profil

Tu as au moins 5 ans de pentest derrière toi, dont de vraies opérations Red Team, et l'envie de faire progresser une équipe.

Indispensable

  • Solide expérience en compromission Active Directory et en pentest web.

  • Opérations Red Team menées en conditions réelles : C2, contournement d'EDR, ingénierie sociale.

  • Un français écrit impeccable.

  • La capacité à expliquer une chaîne d'attaque à un RSSI comme à un directeur général.

  • Modalités de télétravail flexibles mais présence à Paris nécessaire.

  • Un bon feeling avec l'équipe : on passe beaucoup de temps ensemble, en mission comme au bureau, et l'ambiance compte autant que le niveau technique.

Un plus

  • Certifications offensives (OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, OSWE ou équivalent).

  • Expérience d'un cadre PASSI ou d'environnements sensibles.

  • CVE, articles, talks, outils open source.

Avantages

Tu rejoins une équipe de 7 consultants où tes choix techniques deviennent la norme, avec un accès direct au fondateur et une mission claire : faire évoluer notre pôle Red Team. Les missions sont variées (web, Active Directory, mobile, industriel…), et comme on suit nos clients dans la durée, tu vois l'impact réel de ton travail d'une année sur l'autre.

Ballpoint évolue vite, et tu en es un acteur direct. Tes idées ont un effet visible dès la semaine suivante, pas après six mois de comités.

  • Temps de R&D : du temps dédié à tes outils, à la recherche de vulnérabilités ou à la préparation d'un talk.

  • Formations et certifications : un budget annuel (OSEP, CRTO, OSWE…), passées sur ton temps de travail.

  • Télétravail : possible, avec 2 à 3 jours par semaine dans nos bureaux à Paris.

  • Les classiques : CDI cadre, mutuelle, prévoyance, transport, tickets restaurant.

Le process

C'est le fondateur qui gère ce recrutement de bout en bout. Pas de cabinet, pas de tri automatique : chaque candidature est lue et étudiée avec attention. Ça peut prendre un peu de temps, alors n'hésite pas à relancer.

job.title: Staff Quality Engineer - India
job.description:
All roles at JumpCloud® are Remote unless otherwise specified in the Job Description.

About JumpCloud®

JumpCloud® is the AI-powered unified IT management platform designed to secure the modern workforce. By consolidating identity, device, and access management, JumpCloud provides intelligent, secure IT that scales from human users to autonomous AI agents. We help organizations around the globe eliminate complexity and turn AI risk into an optimized advantage, ensuring the right people and agents have secure access to the right resources at all times.

JumpCloud is Intelligent, Secure IT.

About the role:

As a Staff / Principal Quality Engineer (Pillar Lead) on our Engineering team in India, you will serve as the primary quality coordinator and strategic anchor for one of our core product pillars. You will not just test software; you will act as an "Internal Product Manager for Quality." You will work closely with Engineering Directors and Product Managers to align quality initiatives with Pillar OKRs, ensure developers share accountability for automation, and guide the overarching test strategy for your domain. This role is designed for a highly experienced technical authority and proactive risk mitigator who thrives on driving cross-module alignment, adopting cutting-edge AI testing solutions, and ensuring every release meets the highest standards of enterprise excellence.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Serve as the local expert and ultimate technical authority for your Pillar's test processes, feature interactions, and quality standards.

  • Engage early in the SDLC, contributing significantly to refinement, planning meetings, and RFC/Design reviews. Challenge Product Managers and Engineering Leads to consider testability, competitive edge, and integration risks before a single line of code is written.

  • Review and influence Pillar OKRs (e.g., engineering velocity, reliability) to identify partnership opportunities where QE tactics directly drive business objectives.

  • Take accountability for the quality of your Pillar by proactively identifying weak spots, automation blockers, and resource gaps, and aggressively escalating these to leadership to request support.

  • Represent your Pillar in the Cross-Module Leadership Team to coordinate cross-team impacts, share industry-leading practices, and align on standardized test plans and tooling across all pillars.

  • Architect and lead non-functional testing strategies across the pillar, explicitly championing performance, load, and scale testing to ensure the platform reliably handles enterprise-level concurrency and data volumes.

  • Drive AI Adoption & Standardization: Champion the use of AI in the testing lifecycle. Collaborate with the Internal Tools (Autobots) team to contribute to, adopt, and standardize common AI-based testing solutions across your pillar (e.g., leveraging AI for test script generation, intelligent failure triage, and pipeline optimization).

  • Champion the philosophy that quality is a shared engineering goal, ensuring development teams are equally accountable for automation maintenance and preventing the anti-pattern of "throwing it over the wall to QA."

  • Intelligently allocate QE efforts within your Pillar, prioritizing high-value user journeys and guiding your team to swarm on the most critical initiatives.

  • Contribute test code, audit Developer Unit/Integration tests for coverage gaps, and actively write complex End-to-End (E2E) automation scripts alongside your team.

  • Establish and enforce best practices for unit and functional testing frameworks to ensure comprehensive component and flow validation.

  • Develop and execute strategies to consistently augment unit, functional, and acceptance test coverage across the pillar, tying coverage goals directly to release quality gates.

  • Partner closely with your Pillar’s dedicated Automation Enablement engineer to ensure framework gaps are closed and flaky tests are managed urgently.

  • Act as a strong mentor and teacher of nuanced testing principles to both Feature QEs and Developers, empowering others to do the work while continuing to deliver impact yourself.

We’re looking for:

  • 8–12+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test, or a related field, with a proven track record of leading quality initiatives across multiple teams.

  • Deep expertise in multiple technical disciplines, programming languages (Python, Pytest, Playwright and Typescript preferred), test tools, and automation frameworks.

  • Proven experience defining and executing performance, scale, and load testing strategies for complex distributed systems.

  • Demonstrated ability to evaluate "build vs. buy" decisions and develop entirely new implementations of industry solutions.

  • Strong strategic problem-solving perspective, with the ability to balance release risk vs. schedule to maximize test execution without sacrificing the speed of delivery.

  • High EQ and emotional maturity; an active listener who accepts feedback willingly, seeks opposing points of view, and prioritizes the best solution over being right.

  • Proactive and humble ownership, with a focus on raising the visibility of your team's work, sharing credit, and asking for help when facing insurmountable risks.

  • Excellent communication and influence skills, capable of representing the engineering organization internally and externally.

  • A collaborative, team-oriented mindset with the ability to unblock teams and coordinate actions across the organization.

Bonus Points:

  • Practical experience leveraging Generative AI or LLMs in the software testing lifecycle, or actively contributing to AI-driven test frameworks and internal AI tooling.

  • Deep domain expertise in areas relevant to the Pillar.

  • Experience driving large-scale organizational transformations or shifts in quality methodologies.

  • Prior experience in dynamic, fast-paced startup environments.

  • Experience with API and web app UI test automation tools like Gherkin, Cypress, or similar.

  • Experience deploying, installing, and configuring applications on cloud-based servers (AWS experience is a plus).

Where you’ll be working/Location:

JumpCloud is committed to being Remote First, meaning that you are able to work remotely within the country noted in the Job Description.
You must be located in and authorized to work in the country noted in the job description to be considered for this role.
Please note: There is an expectation that our engineers participate in on-call shifts. You will be expected commit to being ready and able to respond during your assigned shift, so that alerts don't go unaddressed.

Language:

JumpCloud has teams in 15+ countries around the world and conducts our internal business in English. The interview and any additional screening process will take place primarily in English. To be considered for a role at JumpCloud, you will be required to speak and write in English fluently. Any additional language requirements will be included in the details of the job description.

Why JumpCloud?

If you thrive working in a fast, SaaS-based environment and you are passionate about solving challenging technical problems, we look forward to hearing from you! JumpCloud is an incredible place to share and grow your expertise! You’ll work with amazing talent across each department who are passionate about our mission. We’re out of the box thinkers, so your unique ideas and approaches for conceiving a product and/or feature will be welcome. You’ll have a voice in the organization as you work with a seasoned executive team, a supportive board and in a proven market that our customers are excited about.
One of JumpCloud's three core values is to “Build Connections.” To us that means creating " human connection with each other regardless of our backgrounds, orientations, geographies, religions, languages, gender, race, etc. We care deeply about the people that we work with and want to see everyone succeed." - Rajat Bhargava, CEO
Please submit your résumé and brief explanation about yourself and why you would be a good fit for JumpCloud. Please note JumpCloud is not accepting third party resumes at this time.
JumpCloud is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Scam Notice:

Please be aware that there are individuals and organizations that may attempt to scam job seekers by offering fraudulent employment opportunities in the name of JumpCloud. These scams may involve fake job postings, unsolicited emails, or messages claiming to be from our recruiters or hiring managers. Please note that JumpCloud will never ask for any personal account information, such as credit card details or bank account numbers, during the recruitment process. Additionally, JumpCloud will never send you a check for any equipment prior to employment.
All communication related to interviews and offers from our recruiters and hiring managers will come from official company email addresses (@jumpcloud.com) and will never ask for any payment, fee to be paid or purchases to be made by the job seeker. If you are contacted by anyone claiming to represent JumpCloud and you are unsure of their authenticity, please do not provide any personal/financial information and contact us immediately at with the subject line "Scam Notice"

As a Senior Manual QA Engineer, you will take ownership of quality assurance across the company's web and mobile products, ensuring reliable and secure customer experiences throughout complex payment journeys.

This is a hands-on, independent role requiring proactive involvement throughout the product development lifecycle, from analysing requirements and preparing test plans to validating functionality and supporting releases.

You will work closely with developers and product stakeholders, identifying gaps, clarifying requirements and preparing testing scenarios while features are still in development.

Your work will directly impact customer trust across onboarding, KYC/KYB, cryptocurrency transactions, invoicing, payment tracking and settlement.

  • Own and independently plan QA activities, prioritising testing efforts based on product requirements, risks and release timelines.

  • Independently initiate requirements reviews and test-plan discussions with relevant stakeholders.

  • Contribute to improving QA processes, test documentation, release readiness and overall product quality.

🎓 Requirements

  • Strong hands-on experience in manual QA testing across web and mobile applications, preferably within a product development environment.

  • Proven ability to independently plan, organise and prioritise testing activities without detailed instructions or constant supervision.

  • Experience analysing incomplete requirements, reviewing specifications and proactively identifying missing information.

  • Ability to prepare test plans and scenarios during feature development, rather than waiting for completed functionality.

  • Strong understanding of software testing principles, defect lifecycles and functional, regression and exploratory testing.

  • Practical API testing experience using Postman and OpenAPI/Swagger specifications, including building test collections directly from API contracts.

  • Solid understanding of JSON structures, including data types, key-value relationships and case sensitivity.

  • Experience testing complex financial transactions, payment statuses or compliance-sensitive workflows.

🤝 Key Competencies

  • Ownership and independence: Takes responsibility for QA planning, prioritisation and execution without constant guidance.

  • Proactive mindset: Anticipates testing needs, identifies gaps early and engages stakeholders before development is completed.

  • Structured analytical thinking: Approaches requirements, documentation and testing systematically.

  • Technical understanding: Confidently works with API contracts, JSON structures and technical specifications.

  • Effective communication: Clearly explains defects, requirements gaps, testing risks and their business impact.

  • Product-oriented approach: Understands that quality assurance starts during product planning, not after development.

  • Direct influence on web and mobile products used for international financial transactions.

  • Close collaboration with an international product and engineering team.

  • Ownership of QA planning, processes and quality standards, beyond repetitive test execution.

  • Opportunities to deepen your expertise in FinTech, payments, crypto and compliance-sensitive products.

Overview

LMI is seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist to support Army Acquisition, Training, and Readiness (AT&R) and provide advanced technical support for the Army Contract Writing System (ACWS). ACWS is built on the Appian Platform. The Quality Assurance Specialist will plan, design, execute, and document software testing activities across the ACWS software development lifecycle.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

The successful candidate will work closely with end users, functional SMEs, developers, Appian specialists, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and other technical teams to maintain ACWS availability, reliability, and user support quality.

  • Develop formal test plans, test procedures, test reports, and other QA deliverables required by project and contract requirements.

  • Develop and execute test cases for functional, regression, integration, system, and user acceptance testing.

  • Log, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, expected-versus-actual results, screenshots, logs, and other supporting evidence.
  • Maintain traceability among requirements, test cases, defects, and test results and ensure QA documentation is complete and audit-ready.
  • Participate in defect triage activities and assist development teams with root cause analysis and defect resolution.
  • Communicate testing progress, risks, quality metrics, defect trends, and recommendations to project leadership, stakeholders, and government customers.
  • Support the development and continuous improvement of test strategies, procedures, tools, and QA processes.
  • Collaborate with Appian developers, Java developers, database administrators, DevSecOps engineers, functional SMEs, and stakeholders on requirements clarification and defect resolution.
  • Support release testing, regression testing, implementation activities, and release readiness or sign-off processes.
  • Participate in Scrum and other Agile ceremonies and provide QA input to sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and delivery planning.
  • Support manual testing and the transition toward automated testing where practical and appropriate.

Qualifications

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • 5+ years of professional software QA or testing experience.
  • Experience with Jira test management or an equivalent test management tool.
  • Experience working in Agile environments; Scrum or SAFe experience preferred.
  • Experience developing formal test plans, test procedures, test reports, status reports, and other project documentation.
  • Experience preparing professional contract deliverables and supporting documentation.
  • Experience developing requirements traceability matrices (RTMs) and ensuring end-to-end test coverage of business and functional requirements.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with technical teams, business stakeholders, and government customers.
  • Experience presenting testing results, risks, and recommendations to management, customers, and project stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
  • Active Secret clearance required.
  • U.S. citizenship required.

DESIRED SKILLS

  • Experience testing applications built on the Appian Platform, including Appian-based enterprise or contract writing applications.
  • Experience testing government procurement and acquisition systems, including data exchanges, interfaces, and business processes involving contract writing, financial, or related federal enterprise applications.
  • Familiarity with federal acquisition regulations and processes, including FAR and DFARS.
  • DAWIA T&E Level 2 or higher, ISTQB Advanced, or equivalent testing certification.
  • Familiarity with automated testing tools and frameworks and experience supporting the transition from manual to automated testing.
  • Experience supporting Army, DoD, Federal Government, or other regulated software programs.
  • Experience with Appian application testing, functional configuration, or Appian release validation.
  • Experience with defect tracking and collaboration tools such as Jira, GitLab, or comparable platforms.

  • Communicate testing status, risks, issues, and dependencies to project leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Validate that critical business processes, integrations, security requirements, reporting, and data scenarios have been appropriately tested.
  • Coordinate UAT sign-off with business process owners and project leadership.

job.description:
Help Build Europe's Hypersonic Capability
 
At Hypersonica, we’re redefining what’s possible in European defence technology. We exist to deliver speed, resilience, and technological independence at a pace that sets a new standard. We are a small, elite team working on problems that matter, and solving them fast.
 
By joining Hypersonica, you’re not stepping into a predefined role. You’re joining a talent dense environment where every individual shapes the direction of the company. Our philosophy is to hire a small number of exceptional people with broad, deep technical capability, strong judgement, and the ability to operate autonomously.
 
We hire for talent, not rigid boxes. This role represents a business need, but the way it evolves will be shaped by the individual. If you’ve achieved what others said was impossible, or you bring a unique combination of skills that doesn’t fit a traditional mould, we want to hear from you. The work you do here directly contributes to Europe’s technological independence.

What you'll do

  • Own the system architecture and system model for Hypersonica’s high‑speed flight vehicles, ensuring mission intent, vehicle dynamics, avionics, and GNC form a coherent, verifiable whole. 

  • Lead aerospace systems architecture design, taking responsibility for how the vehicle is defined across disciplines from early concept through Preliminary Design Review (PDR) and beyond. 

  • Build and maintain the authoritative system requirements model, decomposing mission‑level objectives into clear, testable system and sub‑system requirements. 

  • Define and own the end‑to‑end system V‑model, including requirements validation, verification strategy, and clear readiness gates for Kick‑off and PDR. 

  • Apply model‑based systems engineering (MBSE) as a practical engineering tool, not a documentation exercise, ensuring traceability between requirements, models, analyses, and tests. 

  • Develop and deliver a 6‑DoF Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) model to PDR standard, in close collaboration with flight physics and avionics engineers. 

  • Apply closed‑loop control theory in the context of high‑speed flight and military guidance, ensuring controllability, stability, and performance are understood at the system level. 

  • Integrate vehicle dynamics, control laws, sensors, and actuators into a coherent closed‑loop system representation. 

  • Identify system‑level risks early particularly around requirements gaps, controllability, observability, and verification — and drive mitigations decisively. 

  • Act as a technical authority across disciplines, keeping architectural decisions coherent as designs evolve at pace. 


Who you are

  • An experienced Systems Engineer with a strong track record in system architecture, requirements decomposition, and delivery in safety‑ or mission‑critical environments. 

  • Deeply fluent in model‑based systems engineering, with practical experience owning requirements models and using MBSE to drive real engineering decisions. 

  • Strong grounding in closed‑loop control theory, applied to high‑speed flight, guidance, and defence or military systems. 

  • Comfortable developing and working with 6‑DoF flight and GNC models, and understanding their implications at vehicle level. 

  • Experienced taking systems through early design gates (Kick‑off, PDR), not just theoretical or paper studies. 

  • Someone who thinks in system behaviours, interfaces, and failure modes, not isolated components. 

  • Confident operating in ambiguous, fast‑moving environments where decisions must be made with incomplete data. 

  • Technically credible across disciplines, able to challenge assumptions and close decisions without consensus theatre. 

  • Motivated by working on systems where performance, robustness, and national‑level impact genuinely matter. 


What we offer

  • A mission driven environment with the opportunity to work on one of Europe’s most consequential defence challenges, with direct impact on sovereign capability and security. 

  • Daily collaboration with top experts across engineering, operations, and defence, with real opportunity to learn from the best, contribute, and grow. 

  • High ownership and autonomy; no time tracking, no micromanagement, just clear objectives and accountability for outcomes. 

  • A fast paced environment where good ideas are implemented quickly, and feedback from test and flight drives real decisions. 

  • A culture that values clarity, integrity, and excellence, and supports people who take initiative and push boundaries responsibly. 

  • Competitive compensation and real share options aligned to responsibility and impact, not tenure or hierarchy. 


Security and Elgibility Requirement
Due to the nature of the work with the UK MOD, applicants must be a British Citizen (or Dual UK national with British citizenship) and eligible for UK Security Clearance (SC) and, where required, Developed Vetting (DV)

job.title: Power Platform Tester
job.description:
Description

About Our Team

Our employees thrive in a culture that's fast-paced and ego-free, where innovation and collaboration are encouraged at every turn. We are an organization that provides federal agencies instant access to experienced and talented professionals who understand their unique challenges and know the most efficient ways to address them. We are continually investing in resources and talent, so we stay prepared with specialized teams in place who are experts in creating tailored technologies. Our solutions empower Federal organizations to grow, modernize, and succeed in a rapidly evolving landscape.

We value all voices and want to attract talent from all backgrounds. We're on the lookout for individuals who are passionate about technology and thrive in environments where problem-solving is approached with creativity and enthusiasm. If you're someone who enjoys continuously expanding your skill set while tackling real-world business problems, you'll feel right at home with us. Veterans and military spouses are especially encouraged to bring your unique and valuable experience to our team.

About the Role

Our team is seeking a Power Platform Tester to join our fast-growing IT-project based consulting business. We need a team member who is ready to plan, execute, and automate testing of Microsoft Power Platform solutions that support the missions of our federal customers. This is a specialized role for a tester who knows the Power Platform inside and out — from canvas and model-driven apps to Power Automate flows, Dataverse, custom connectors, and the APIs that tie them together.

The successful candidate will be a detail-oriented, inquisitive problem solver who can quickly understand business requirements and translate them into thorough, repeatable test coverage. In this fully remote role, you will validate workflows and functionality across Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse, and Azure Government; build automated tests with Power Apps Test Studio, Power Apps Test Engine, and Playwright; and verify that every user persona sees and does exactly what their security role allows. Your work will give product owners clear, actionable reporting on quality and readiness for release.

You will work and collaborate on a team of project managers, business analysts, developers/engineers, and QA staff within an Agile environment. As a crucial member of our team, you will also be expected to interface with client representatives, including product owners, business owners, technical leads, and solution architects.

Responsibilities

•Validate requirements by testing workflows and functionality using Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power Automate, Azure Government, APIs, and Dataverse.

•Develop and execute test plans, test cases, scripts, and test results that provide actionable reporting to product owners and stakeholders.

•Execute testing activities for functionality, integrations, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT).

•Record, build, and run UI tests for canvas apps using Power Apps Test Studio and Power Fx expressions.

•Create and maintain automated test plans using Power Apps Test Engine (YAML/Power Fx test plans, connector mocking) with Playwright and the Power Platform CLI.

•Use Playwright and/or Selenium for deeper UI, browser-based, and model-driven app regression testing.

•Test custom connectors and validate Dataverse Web API endpoints using Postman or other REST clients.

•Use Power Platform Monitor to debug apps in real time and inspect network calls, formula errors, and data flow behavior.

•Test Power Automate cloud flows, including triggers, conditions, approvals, error handling, and connection behavior.

•Perform role-based persona testing to validate security roles, business units, team and field-level security, and access requirements.

•Validate functionality and data integrity during migrations from on-premises systems to cloud services.

•Document, track, prioritize, and drive resolution of defects in partnership with developers and product owners.

•Validate solution deployments across development, test, and production environments.

•Verify that applications meet Section 508 accessibility requirements.

•Participate in Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, and sprint reviews.

•Develop and maintain test documentation throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC).

TAG:

TAG: INDMJC

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related technical field, or four (4) years of relevant experience in lieu of a degree
  • Minimum of five (5) years of experience in software quality assurance and testing
  • Minimum of three (3) years of on-the-job experience testing Microsoft Power Platform solutions, including Power Apps (canvas and model-driven), Power Automate, and Dataverse
  • Hands-on experience with Power Apps Test Studio and/or Power Apps Test Engine
  • Experience with Playwright or Selenium for browser-based test automation
  • Experience testing REST APIs, custom connectors, and Dataverse Web API endpoints using Postman or similar tools
  • Experience using Power Platform Monitor to troubleshoot app behavior, network calls, and formula errors
  • Experience with role-based persona testing and security access requirements
  • Experience developing and executing test plans for functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing
  • Experience documenting, tracking, and managing defects in tools such as Jira or Azure DevOps
  • Familiarity with migration from on-premises to cloud services
  • Minimum two (2) years of experience working in an Agile framework
  • Ability to communicate complex concepts effectively to technical and non-technical audiences
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Military experienced candidates are encouraged
  • Candidates will need to obtain Security Clearance of Public Trust once hired
  • Work is full-time 100% remote

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing in Microsoft Azure Government cloud environments
  • Proficiency with Power Fx and the Power Platform CLI (pac)
  • Experience writing Playwright tests in JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps Pipelines, GitHub Actions)
  • Experience with Power Platform ALM, including managed solutions and environment strategy
  • Experience with Section 508 accessibility testing tools (e.g., ANDI, axe)
  • Microsoft certifications such as PL-200, PL-400, or PL-900; ISTQB certification
  • Experience with Federal government agencies

job.title: QA Engineer - Backend & Frontend
job.description:
At Qu you’ll find a fun, dynamic, and diverse culture that celebrates team and individual success. Our people are down to earth, trail blazin’ folks who value innovation.

While mostly virtual, we collaborate closely to produce leading-edge software solutions much needed in the restaurant industry.

Our technology team is a rapidly growing group of talented and experienced engineers building the leading enterprise software company focused on restaurant technology. We use modern technologies, automation, and AI-assisted engineering practices to build products that power restaurant operations at scale.

We are looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who is strong in both manual and automated testing, across backend APIs and frontend UIs. You'll test end-to-end flows that cross several Qu products, such as an order that starts in POS or web ordering and ends on the kitchen display. You'll make sure every case is tested at the right level, from API checks to end-to-end and manual tests.

You'll work inside QuDLC, Qu's AI-first delivery lifecycle. AI agents refine each story, propose its test cases, and write the tests before the code; people decide at review gates, on evidence. As the team's quality engineer, you own two of those gates: you approve the test cases before development starts, and you sign off the story when the test results are in.

What You'll Do Here

  • Review the test cases AI agents propose from each story's acceptance criteria: tighten vague steps, add missing negative and edge cases, and approve them in AIO Tests.
  • Review each story's test plan before development starts: the right test level for every case (unit, API, end-to-end or manual), and which existing tests to reuse, update or retire.
  • Review, debug and fix the backend API and frontend UI tests that agents write in TypeScript and Playwright. Keep the shared fixtures, page objects and API clients healthy, and the smoke suite focused on critical paths.
  • Run exploratory testing and the cases that stay manual, then sign off each story using the pipeline's results: smoke tests, the story's own tests and the AIO Tests run.
  • Test end-to-end flows across services, such as POS, web ordering, the in-store server and the kitchen display, including scheduled and multi-channel orders.
  • Investigate failing, flaky and blocked tests: read the pipeline's diagnosis, separate environment, test data and product issues, and fix the test plan or cases when they are the cause.
  • Give feedback that improves how the AI agents write test cases and tests.
  • Answer testing questions during story refinement, and partner with developers and product managers on release validation.

Long Wave Inc. is seeking a Senior Principal Quality Engineer – Program Quality Assurance (PRQA) to support program execution, contractual quality compliance, and Quality Management System (QMS) activities within an aerospace and defense environment.

Essential Responsibilities

Program Quality Assurance & Contractual Compliance

  • Serve as lead PRQA for assigned programs, providing quality oversight throughout program development, production, testing, integration, and acceptance.
  • Review and analyze contracts, Statements of Work (SOW), Supplier Quality Assurance Requirements (SQAR), purchase orders, specifications, and other customer requirements to identify quality obligations, compliance gaps, and risks.
  • Develop and maintain program quality plans, contractual quality requirements matrices, compliance documentation, and associated program quality records.
  • Identify contractual quality concerns and coordinate recommended clarifications, exceptions, or resolutions with Contracts, Program Management, and other responsible organizations.
  • Coordinate with program and functional teams to ensure quality requirements are incorporated into program planning, schedules, technical activities, and deliverables.
  • Review technical documentation, design changes, inspection and test requirements, and contractual deliverables for applicable quality compliance.
  • Support program design reviews, technical reviews, production readiness activities, verification, testing, and customer acceptance.

Join Scrive and be part of an international, fast-growing company headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Collaborate with smart, caring, and driven colleagues across Europe as we shape the Scrive story. 🚀

We are currently looking for a QA Engineer (1-year fixed term contract) to join our team and play a key role in our transition to an automation-first testing approach while ensuring the high quality of our SaaS web applications. This role is an exciting opportunity to help deliver secure, stable, and user-friendly solutions by uncovering hidden bugs and minimizing avoidable customer incidents.

📍 The role will be remotely within the EU, and you will report to Head of QA who is working remotely from Sweden. We offer a highly supportive team culture featuring daily developer syncs, weekly QA knowledge-sharing sessions, and annual psychical team meetups somewhere within Europe.

As a QA Engineer, you will:

  • Develop and maintain automated tests – Write and execute automated scripts using JavaScript or TypeScript and the Playwright framework to extend our test coverage.

  • Perform manual testing & feature validation – Balance your time with manual regression and exploratory testing to ensure full product validation where automation is not yet sufficient.

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional squads – work together with developers, product managers, and your QA peers to explore new features, clarify requirements early, and push the quality bar higher with each release.

  • Identify, log, and troubleshoot issues – investigate bugs using logs, browser dev tools, and test outputs, documenting clear steps to reproduce in Jira and contributing to shared knowledge bases.

  • Modern tech gear, ensuring you have the absolute best setup to succeed.

What we’re looking for

To succeed in this role, you should have:

  • 3-5 years of experience in testing web applications within a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) company.

  • Proven track record in balancing manual and automated testing, with a strong readiness to champion an automation-first mindset.

  • Strong debugging and analytical skills, with a proactive approach to exploratory testing and finding the root cause of issues.

  • Fluent English communication skills, allowing you to clearly convey test results, document findings, and provide structured updates to your team.

🌟 Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience with API and backend service testing using Python and pytest, expanding coverage beyond web UI applications.

  • Familiarity with performance or security testing tools to help identify bottlenecks and vulnerabilities early in the development lifecycle.

  • Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth working environment.

In this role, we see that you demonstrate strong skills in JavaScript/TypeScript & Playwright, Version Control (Git), CI/CD Integrations and Strong Debugging & Analytical Skills. These skills will play a key role in our assessment and discussions during the recruitment process.

job.title: Senior Reporting QA & Data Validation Analyst (RCM)
job.description:
About The Auctus Group LLC

Who we are: We’re big on people and culture at the Auctus Group. Our most important role as a company is to provide an amazing working environment for our team. We’ve been work-from-home-warriors since before it was cool. We support (like encourage and fund) continuing education. We match charitable donations. Our whole goal is: work to live not live to work. Oh and we’re weirdos too…we do remote happy hours and have a book club and goofy stuff like that.

Who we’re looking for: Smart, talented, tech-savvy, experienced, go-getter types. You’ll do well if:

  • you like a fast-paced environment,
  • you thrive with change and development,
  • you like giving feedback,
  • you’re a team player,
  • you love learning/sleuthing,
  • you’re big on accountability.

About The Role

The Senior Reporting Quality Assurance & Data Validation Analyst is responsible for ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of reports across healthcare practice management systems, electronic health records (EHRs), billing platforms, and internal reporting solutions.

This role works closely with the Reporting & Business Intelligence team, operations, and technical teams to validate reporting outputs, reconcile data across systems, investigate discrepancies, and strengthen reporting quality controls. Success requires strong SQL and Excel skills, sound analytical judgment, and the ability to trace reporting issues to their source and help drive them to resolution.

What You'll Do

  • Independently validate reports, dashboards, and datasets before they are shared with clients, leadership, or operational stakeholders.
  • Reconcile reported figures against source systems, including EHRs, practice management platforms, billing applications, internal databases, and automated extracts.
  • Perform record-level and aggregate-level checks to identify missing, duplicate, inaccurate, or inconsistent data.
  • Verify calculations, business rules, filters, date ranges, and metric definitions across financial, operational, productivity, and revenue cycle reports.
  • Investigate differences involving posting dates, transaction dates, adjustments, voids, refunds, and reporting cutoffs, distinguishing legitimate reporting differences from actual errors.
  • Trace discrepancies through data extraction, transformation, and reporting processes, working with analysts, developers, and data engineers to identify root causes and resolve issues.
  • Conduct regression testing when reporting logic, data pipelines, or source systems change.
  • Develop repeatable testing procedures, reconciliation templates, and validation checklists for recurring reports.
  • Create exception reports and identify opportunities to automate repetitive validation activities.
  • Document testing results, supporting evidence, business impact, recommended corrections, and resolutions to maintain clear records and support audit readiness.
  • Partner with operational stakeholders to clarify reporting requirements and expected results, and promptly escalate material inaccuracies.
  • Track recurring reporting defects and recommend improvements that strengthen data quality and reporting reliability.
  • Follow company policies for patient confidentiality, HIPAA compliance, and the secure handling of sensitive healthcare information.

Qualifications

  • 3+ years of experience in data analysis, reporting quality assurance, data validation, reconciliation, or a related analytical role.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, conditional formulas, and comparisons of large datasets.
  • Strong SQL skills for querying, comparing, aggregating, reconciling, and validating data.
  • Demonstrated experience investigating discrepancies across reports, databases, or business systems and identifying their underlying causes.
  • Ability to interpret complex business rules and translate them into practical validation scenarios.
  • Strong analytical thinking, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with consistent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Ability to independently investigate issues, follow through on findings, and manage multiple reporting validation assignments.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills, including the ability to explain findings and business impact clearly.
  • Reliable computer access and a stable, high-speed internet connection suitable for remote work.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare revenue cycle management (RCM), medical billing, or healthcare reporting, with an understanding of accounts receivable, charges, payments, adjustments, denials, collections, and financial reconciliation.
  • Familiarity with EHR or practice management platforms such as ModMed, Tebra, Nextech, DrChrono, AdvancedMD, athenahealth, or OpenPM.
  • Experience with Power BI, Tableau, or similar business intelligence platforms.
  • Familiarity with Python, Power Query, automated data validation tools, or data quality monitoring and exception reporting.
  • Experience validating ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, or database integrations.
  • Familiarity with HIPAA requirements and handling sensitive healthcare information.

Who We Are

At The Auctus Group, we help healthcare providers focus on patient care by supporting the revenue cycle operations behind their practices. We bring care, dependable service, and thoughtful problem-solving to our relationships with clients and teammates.

Our culture puts people first. We have long embraced remote work and make a deliberate effort to keep our team connected. We encourage continued learning, support community giving, and value a healthy balance between professional and personal life.

Who We’re Looking For

We’re looking for curious, dependable people who take ownership of their work and care about its impact on clients and colleagues. You’ll be a strong fit if you:

  • Ask thoughtful questions and verify assumptions.
  • Enjoy investigating complex problems and following the evidence.
  • Take responsibility for issues and help bring them to resolution.
  • Communicate openly and welcome constructive feedback.
  • Collaborate well with others and adapt as systems and priorities evolve.
  • Look for practical ways to improve accuracy, consistency, and efficiency.

If you enjoy finding the explanation behind the numbers and helping others make decisions with confidence, we’d like to hear from you.

job.description:

As a Technical Support Engineer, you will be the key technical point of contact for customers and internal teams, providing expert support across enterprise applications, automation, APIs, and system monitoring. Your role combines customer-facing troubleshooting with deep technical problem-solving, ensuring system reliability, efficient workflows, and high-quality software

What does a day in the life of a Technical Support Engineer like?

Customer Support & Issue Resolution:

  • Provide advanced technical support for complex enterprise software issues, including automation, integrations, exports, and UI behavior.
  • Investigate and resolve customer-reported issues via tickets (SUP cases), Slack threads, and direct communications, documenting findings and resolutions.
  • Identify root causes of recurring issues and escalate critical problems to engineering with full reproduction steps, logs, and analysis.
  • Respond to escalations, including system errors, automation failures, or workflow interruptions, ensuring timely and accurate resolutions.

API & Integration Support:

  • Assist with integration of APIs such as client's API, guiding teams and customer through record creation, updates, and custom workflows.
  • Troubleshoot API errors using tools like Insomnia, Postman, or custom Python scripts.

Automation & Scripting:

  • Develop, maintain, and debug automation scripts in Python and Playwright for testing, exports, app installations, and workflow orchestration.
  • Automate repetitive tasks such as app exports, installations, and record updates to improve team efficiency.
  • Ensure automation scripts are robust, reusable, and aligned with system rules and constraints.

Quality Assurance & Testing:

  • Conduct comprehensive testing of platform features, including display blocks, dynamic/static picklists, export/import workflows, record selections, and custom aspect and etc.
  • Identify, document, and track bugs with clear steps, screenshots, logs, and environment details.
  • Perform retests to validate fixes and ensure functionality across multiple scenarios.
  • Collaborate with engineering to implement enhancements and prevent regression issues.

Monitoring & Analytics:

  • Use monitoring tools such as Datadog to analyze system logs, track recurring errors, and identify performance bottlenecks.
  • Detect patterns in system failures or automation issues and propose preventive solutions.
  • Collaborate with engineering on data-driven troubleshooting and debugging initiatives.

Documentation & Knowledge Sharing:

  • Create clear, detailed technical documentation for workflows, API usage, automation scripts, and troubleshooting procedures.
  • Maintain internal cheat sheets, guides, and best practices for the support team.
  • Share insights and lessons learned from ticket resolutions to improve team knowledge and operational efficiency.

Cross-functional Collaboration:

  • Coordinate with Products and Engineering to address technical issues, reproduce bugs,and validate fixes.
  • Provide support and guidance to other teams implementing integrations, automation, or advanced workflows.
  • Assist in evaluating new features and identifying potential support challenges before release.

Customer Communication & Escalations:

  • Provide clear, professional, and technical communication to customers regarding system issues, workarounds, and resolutions.
  • Track critical escalations and ensure engineering and leadership are updated on progress.
  • Maintain high customer satisfaction by balancing technical detail with actionable guidance.

What are the required qualifications for a Technical Support Engineer?

  • 3+ years of experience in SaaS software support and troubleshooting or solution architecture/implementation of SaaS software solutions.
  • Proficiency in SQL, GraphQL, APIs, JSON, and Excel/Google sheet functions
  • Familiarity with Snowflake and API tools like Postman or Insomnia
  • Familiarity with developer tools on the browser (e.g. console errors and network requests)
  • Familiarity with Python and Playwright for testing
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools such as Datadog or similar to analyze system logs
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science or computer engineering is plus
  • B2B SaaS startup experience is a strong plus
  • Motivated, high energy, self starter that works well independently and as part of a team of company leaders, engineers, customer support analysts, and account managers
  • Ability to learn technology quickly through instruction and hands-on self-training
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with experience working with account managers, external customers, technical/non-technical users, engineers, leadership, etc.)
  • Possesses strong analytical and problem solving skills with experience in investigating and resolving complex software issues.
  • Thrives in a dynamic, fast paced, customer facing environment.

  • Life Insurance
  • HMO on day 1
  • Paid time off, birthday leave

About the Team

Our Robotics team is focused on unlocking general-purpose robotics and pushing towards AGI-level intelligence in dynamic, real-world settings. Working across the entire model stack, we integrate cutting-edge hardware and software to explore a broad range of robotic form factors. We strive to seamlessly blend high-level AI capabilities with the constraints of physical systems to improve peoples’ lives.

About the Role

As a Test Engineer on the Robotics team, you will help shape the next generation of embodied AI. You’ll design and run rigorous, exploratory and requirements-driven tests—building custom test equipment, analyzing results, and translating findings into actionable insights that drive design breakthroughs and mitigate risks across hardware and software. This role offers the opportunity to directly influence how our AI scales beyond simulation, ensuring that every design, test, and iteration brings us closer to truly adaptive, versatile robotic systems.

In this role, you will:

  • Design and build custom test benches to evaluate system performance under realistic operating conditions; proficient in CAD and familiar with GD&T.

  • Analyze and interpret test data to identify trends, anomalies, and root causes.

  • Develop and maintain comprehensive test plans that validate mechanical performance against product requirements.

  • Execute validation and verification testing, capturing both quantitative and qualitative data with high fidelity.

  • Author clear, actionable test reports that summarize results, highlight risks, and recommend design or process changes.

  • Partner with engineering, product, and leadership teams to inform design iterations and strategic decisions.

  • Design and execute compliance and regulatory testing campaigns, informing in-house vs 3rd party testing strategy

You might thrive in this role if you:

  • Have strong intuition for mechanical and electromechanical systems and how they fail, degrade, or vary in real-world operation.

  • Enjoy hands-on lab work designing, instrumenting, operating, and debugging test equipment and robotic hardware.

  • Can turn evolving requirements and ambiguous failures into repeatable tests, trustworthy data, and clear engineering decisions.

  • Balance rigorous validation, safety, and traceability with rapid hardware iteration.

  • Communicate clearly across mechanical, electrical, software, controls, and manufacturing teams, and build alignment on risks and corrective actions.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in hardware testing or validation, including at least 2 years working with robotics hardware components and systems.

  • Bachelor’s or graduate degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Experience designing test fixtures and stands using CAD, engineering drawings, and GD&T.

  • Hands-on experience integrating sensors, instrumentation, and data acquisition (DAQ) systems, including calibration and measurement traceability.

  • Experience developing automated or hardware-in-the-loop tests using Python, C/C++, or AI coding tools for test execution, data collection, and analysis.

  • Experience designing reliability, accelerated life, environmental, and hardware qualification tests for robotic or electromechanical systems.

  • Experience supporting EVT, DVT, PVT, pilot production, or sustaining hardware validation.

  • Experience using root cause analysis, FMEA, or FEA to guide design improvements.

  • Experience executing product standards compliance certification campaigns.

This position is within Fortrea’s Global Quality Assurance organization, responsible for providing regulatory expertise, leading complex GCP audits and inspections, and driving global quality initiatives. This position serves as a regulatory subject matter expert (SME), supporting internal teams, clients, and regulatory authority interactions to ensure ongoing compliance and inspection readiness.


The role contributes to global QA policy development, leads and/or participates in conduct of risk-based GCP audits, leads and/or supports end-to-end audit/inspection hosting and response activities, leads quality metrics reporting, and participates in continuous improvement initiatives across the QA organization. The position also acts as a backup to QA Management and supports operational reporting responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct and lead risk-based, end-to-end GCP audits, including process, service provider/vendor, clinical investigator site, study, and for-cause audits.

  • Maintain a strong working knowledge of the Quality Management System (QMS) and support the timely progression, tracking, escalation, and closure of quality issues and associated CAPAs.
  • Support QA-to-QA relationships with key strategic clients.
  • Lead or support quality metrics, trend reporting, Quality Reviews, and global Quality initiatives focused on compliance, consistency, and efficiency.
  • Contribute to the development and interpretation of global QA policies and ensure activities are conducted in accordance with applicable regulatory requirements and controlled documents.
  • Deliver audit-related training and provide cross-training, mentoring, and coaching to auditors, audit hosts, and audit support staff, as appropriate.
  • Maintain current professional and technical knowledge through continuing education, regulatory guidance, relevant publications, and professional networks.

job.description:
Na CI&T , ajudamos grandes empresas a transformar o potencial da AI em impacto real nos negócios com AI Deployment, execução AI-native e tech-integrated business solutions.

Com 30 anos de experiência em transformação tecnológica, aceleramos inovação com expertise em agentic SDLC, application modernization, Data & AI, martech e business strategy.

Somos 8.000 CI&Ters em mais de 25 países, colaborando para construir soluções com impacto real. AI já faz parte da forma como trabalhamos, evoluímos e inovamos todos os dias.

Importante: se você reside na Região Metropolitana de Campinas, sua presença nos escritórios da cidade será obrigatória, conforme a política de frequencia vigente.

Estamos evoluindo nosso SDLC para uma estrutura agêntica, com Spec-Driven Development (SDD) como base. Nesse modelo, a qualidade começa na especificação, não no fim do ciclo. Buscamos uma pessoa Tester que atue em shift-left: ajudar a escrever specs testáveis, definir critérios de aceite verificáveis e construir os guardrails que permitem usar IA com segurança e previsibilidade.

Responsabilidades:

  • Participar da escrita e do refinamento de especificações (SDD), garantindo que sejam claras, completas, sem ambiguidade e testáveis;
    - Transformar specs e critérios de aceite em cenários de teste (BDD/Gherkin ou equivalente) antes do desenvolvimento, usando IA como apoio;
    - Definir a estratégia de testes do time para fluxos com agentes de IA: o que é validado automaticamente, o que exige revisão humana e quais são os quality gates;
    - Revisar código e testes gerados por IA, identificando lacunas de cobertura, falsos positivos e testes frágeis ou que só "passam" sem validar comportamento;
    - Construir e manter suítes de testes automatizados (API, backend e mobile) integradas ao pipeline de CI/CD como mecanismo de feedback para humanos e agentes;
    - Criar prompts, instruções e contextos reutilizáveis (ex.: skills, templates, regras) para geração de testes, massa de dados e relatórios;
    - Preparar massa de testes, incluindo geração sintética assistida por IA;
    - Realizar a Análise de Causa Raiz (RCA) de falhas e incidentes, atuando estrategicamente na definição de planos de mitigação e soluções de longo prazo para garantir a estabilidade do produto.
    - Definir e acompanhar métricas de qualidade do fluxo agêntico (escape de defeitos, cobertura por requisito, taxa de retrabalho em código gerado por IA, estabilidade dos testes);
    - Disseminar boas práticas de qualidade e uso responsável de IA para o time, apoiando a mudança de cultura;
    - Atuar de forma colaborativa com devs, POs e arquitetos, ao longo de todo o ciclo.

    Requisitos:
    - Experiência sólida com qualidade de software em times ágeis, com atuação em shift-left (participação em refinamento, critérios de aceite, testabilidade);
    - Experiência com automação de testes de API/backend e mobile (iOS e Android), com frameworks como WebDriverIO, Playwright, Cypress, Appium, PactumJS, mocha, REST Assured, Postman ou similares;
    - Vivência com CI/CD (ex.: GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps) e uso de testes como quality gates;
    - Experiência com BDD/TDD e escrita de cenários a partir de requisitos;
    - Uso prático de ferramentas de IA generativa no trabalho (ex.: Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT) e noções de prompt engineering e engenharia de contexto;
    - Capacidade de análise crítica para validar saídas de IA e reconhecer alucinações, lacunas e riscos;
    - Experiência com ferramentas de gestão de tarefas (preferencialmente Jira) e gestão de testes (Zephyr ou similar);
    - Boa comunicação e capacidade de influenciar o time sem depender de hierarquia.

Diferenciais:

job.title: QA Analyst - 1518
job.description:
About Fetch:

Fetch is a venture-backed company redefining multifamily living through four core services: Package Delivery, Valet Trash, Fetch Market, and Fetch Storage. From secure, direct-to-door package delivery to community-wide valet trash, 24/7 essentials delivered through Fetch Market, and flexible storage solutions, Fetch streamlines operations for property teams while creating unmatched convenience for residents. Operating nationwide with rapid growth ahead, we combine logistics, technology, and hospitality to shape the future of multifamily living.

Our Opportunity:

Quality is what keeps our support teams trusted. We are hiring a QA Analyst to administer quality assurance for our support organization as part of the Learning and Development team, covering our three main support teams: Claims, Customer Support, and Partner Success. Beyond grading individual conversations, this role sets the course for what is going well and what needs attention, turning what we see in the conversations into the training and process changes that raise the quality of every support team.

What you’ll bring to this job:

    • Grade support conversations at scale using our QA software, applying a consistent standard across every support team.
    • Work through the grading data to identify the key trends and behaviors that signal whether an agent is struggling or a process is struggling.
    • Partner with the Learning and Development team to turn those findings into the right training and process changes, closing the loop between quality and learning.
    • Deliver feedback directly, either to the agent or to their supervisor, so the supervisor has a full picture of where the agent is strong and where they need support.
    • Help conduct live training for agents, supporting the team in delivering the onboarding and ongoing learning that Learning and Development develops.
    • Maintain the QA scorecard and scoring standards and take part in calibration, so grading stays consistent and fair across every reviewer and team.
    • Report QA results on a regular cadence and track how agents and teams are trending over time, so leadership and Learning and Development can see where to focus.
    • Apply strong critical thinking to get to the root of why quality issues are happening, not just what is happening, and propose the right fix.

What we'll deliver on:

    • Competitive Compensation – Your expertise and impact are recognized and rewarded

    • Comprehensive Benefits Package – Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for you and your family

    • Plan for Your Future – 401(k) plus AD&D, Short-Term, and Long-Term Disability coverage

    • Unlimited PTO – Take the time you need to recharge and bring your best self to work

    • Work That Makes an Impact – Help shape the future of our operations, teams, and growth

      • Fetch is an equal opportunity employer, all applicants will be considered without discrimination on the basis of race, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, disabilities, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, veteran status or any other characteristics protected by law.

job.title: Electronics Test Engineer (m/f/d)
QA Engineer - Quantum Computing (m/w/d)
job.description:
eleQtron develops and operates full-stack quantum computers based on trapped-ion technology. Quantum computing is a new computing paradigm rapidly approaching commercial viability. Our unique approach combines laser-cooled trapped ions with microwave control and tailored magnetic fields. Our next-generation computing machines under development will be able to find solutions to problems that are out of reach today, thus enabling new innovative products and services for a brighter future.

We are looking for a QA Engineer (m/f/d) to join us in Hamburg or Siegen.

You will take ownership of quality across our software platform, from compilation services and the public API to the interfaces used by our operators and customers.

This is a build-from-scratch role: there is no ready-made test suite waiting for you, and no expensive tool that does the thinking for you. You define what good testing looks like here, and then you build it.

You are as comfortable writing a test strategy on a blank page as you are writing the automation that implements it in code.

Responsibilities:

  • Own the testing approach for our platform end-to-end: define what to test, at which level, and why

  • Write test concepts from scratch — risk-based, covering unit, integration, system, and end-to-end levels, and turn them into running, maintained automation

  • Build and own our test automation frameworks in code, integrated directly into our CI/CD pipelines, using your defined tooling

  • Do the exploratory and manual testing that automation can't cover, and know where that line sits

  • Establish quality gates, coverage expectations, and clear bug-reporting practices the whole team can work with

  • Work closely with backend, platform, and hardware teams to test at the boundaries where software meets the machine

  • Raise the testing literacy of the engineering team, so quality is a shared habit rather than a gate at the end


Required Skills:

  • 3+ years in software quality assurance, with real ownership of test strategy, not only executing predefined test scripts

  • Ability to design a test concept for an unfamiliar system: choosing the right test levels, techniques, and priorities from first principles

  • Confident programming ability (Python preferred), enough to build and maintain automation yourself rather than depend on record-and-playback tools

  • Hands-on experience with open-source testing frameworks (e.g. pytest, Playwright, Selenium) and integrating tests into CI/CD

  • Solid grounding in testing fundamentals: test design techniques, the test pyramid, API testing, and when to automate versus test manually

  • A generalist, tool-agnostic mindset, you pick the right approach for the problem, not the one tool you already know

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with experimental physicists and engineers

  • Strong adaptability and a quick learning mindset

  • Good proficiency in English (written and spoken)

Nice to have (Bonus)

  • Experience setting up a QA function or test strategy in an early-stage or greenfield environment

  • Testing distributed systems, APIs, or cloud-native services

  • Performance, load, or security testing experience

  • Exposure to hardware-in-the-loop or lab/control-software testing

  • ISTQB certification, or an equivalent grounding in test theory you actually apply

  • Prior exposure to quantum computing or other deep-tech domains


What you can expect from eleQtron:

  • Competitive salary: We value our team members and therefore provide remuneration that reflects this, additionally rewarding achievements

  • Flexible working hours: We offer personal freedom through a variety of flexible work schedules

  • Team spirit: In our international and diverse team, and with our regular team events, having fun at work is simply part of the culture

  • Further development: We want to grow together, and so we offer our team members needs-based, individualised further training as well as plenty of room for personal development

  • Wellness Package: We offer health-promoting benefits such as fitness programs like UrbanSportsClub to support your well-being

  • Bike Leasing: Stay Mobile and Sustainable with Our Company Bike Leasing Program

  • Moving Benefits: A warm welcome! We are happy to support employees who move for us with a bonus

  • At the forefront: Work at the forefront of technology, where academic research meets commercial applications 

  • Modern workplace: We have a high-quality infrastructure with laboratory space, offices and meeting rooms

job.title: Staff Software Engineer in Test - mobile (m/f/n)
job.description:
We're looking for a Staff Software Engineer in Test to raise the quality bar across our mobile app and backend domain - not by owning a test suite, but by changing how the whole domain designs, ships, and trusts its software.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll shape architecture for testability and reliability, own the quality gates that let teams release with confidence, and build a culture where engineers own quality rather than hand it off. You'll operate as a true Staff Engineer: setting technical direction across several teams, going deep in the codebase when it matters, and framing quality as an engineering and business outcome - not a QA phase at the end.

If you've done this in a product with real mobile scale, even better.

Your scope of work will cover 3 areas.

I. Quality architecture & engineering

  • Set and own the quality and reliability strategy across the domain - from the API/contract layer through to native iOS (Swift/SwiftUI) and Android (Kotlin) clients.
  • Design for testability and release confidence: quality gates inside release and store-deployment pipelines, device and OS-version fragmentation coverage, and flakiness control at scale (BrowserStack + GitLab CI).
  • Keep the backend/API/contract layer strong and connect it cleanly to the mobile client layer.
  • Drive resolution of quality and reliability issues that cross team boundaries within the domain.
  • Get hands-on in the codebase where your depth moves the needle - prototypes, tooling, reference implementations, thorny incidents.

II. Technical leadership, coaching & culture

  • Shift quality ownership left into the engineering workflow - be the person teams pull in before implementation starts, not after.
  • Mentor senior engineers across the domain and accelerate real, visible growth.
  • Run knowledge-sharing across the org: tech talks, workshops, reusable documentation, pair sessions; co-lead the OneTech community.
  • Co-shape the domain's technical direction with the SEM, with full autonomy within the domain, and analyse quality trends from metrics to identify where to improve.
  • Define quality and reliability metrics and gates, and use them to frame risk in business terms for EMs, SEMs, and PMs.

III. AI governance in engineering

  • Define how AI is adopted for quality and engineering productivity in the domain — which tools, which workflows.
  • Design AI-assisted workflows and set governance and data-security standards across teams.
  • Assess and manage the risk of AI usage (including production-facing work), not just the productivity upside.
  • Mentor engineers on responsible, effective AI use and report on its ROI.

Must-have

  • 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a track record operating at Staff / Principal / Tech Lead / Architect level - proven impact beyond a single team (standards set for multiple teams, or a cross-team initiative led).
  • Proven experience in testing in at least one mobile platform (iOS or Android) using market standard approaches as well as commercial, working-level experience with testing native mobile apps.
  • Deep ownership of quality and reliability as an engineering discipline - you've set standards and designed testing/quality strategy (not just executed someone else's plan) and changed outcomes measurably.
  • Proven shift-left experience - entering the process before code is written and measurably moving the result.
  • A strong hands-on engineering foundation - you can read, review, and write production-quality code, and teams respect your technical depth.
  • Experience leading technical and process change directly with development teams.
  • A hands-on, critical relationship with AI - using it and assessing its risks, not just its benefits.
  • Fluent English.

Strong plus - this is where you'll stand out

  • Experience with BrowserStack and CI/CD (GitLab).
  • Snapshot testing experience (e.g. swift-snapshot-testing, Paparazzi) and introducing mock-based testing standards.
  • Experience in the logistics or e-commerce industry.
  • Fluency in Polish.

Nice-to-have

  • Familiarity with Appium (useful for understanding what we're migrating away from).
  • Experience applying AI in engineering / testing workflows.
  • ISTQB Advanced Level – Test Automation Engineer certification.

Why InPost?

  • An international, cross‑functional environment with experienced engineering leaders.
  • The opportunity to work on products used by millions of users across Europe.
  • Real ownership and influence over teams, technical direction, and long‑term solutions.
  • Flexible working model with remote options in Poland.
  • A strong engineering culture focused on quality, collaboration, and impact.
  • We offer a B2B contract.

InPost has revolutionised e-commerce parcel delivery in Poland and is now one of Europe’s leading out-of-home (OOH) e-commerce enablement platforms. Founded in 1999 by Rafał Brzoska.

InPost provides delivery services through a network of over 64,000 Automated Parcel Machines (APMs) and more than 30,000 pick-up and drop-off (PUDO) points across nine European countries: Poland, the United Kingdom, France, Italy, Spain, Portugal, Belgium, the Netherlands and Luxembourg, alongside to-door courier and fulfilment services for ecommerce merchants.

InPost’s extensive OOH network supports rapidly growing parcel volumes across its markets, with 1.4 billion parcels delivered in 2025. Its locker solutions offer consumers a delivery option that is cheaper, more flexible and convenient, environmentally friendly and contactless. As a leading OOH logistics provider, InPost is recognised for transforming parcel delivery economics in Europe, appealing to both consumers and merchants through its flexible, technology-driven solutions.
