job.description:
The Quality Manager position is key in fostering a culture of quality within the Company organization and acts as an ambassador for the QA department. The Quality Manager, Quality Assurance has an active role in the preparation, maintenance, and execution of the internal and vendor Strategic and Annual Audit Program as well as leading all aspects of the design, implementation and management of internal and vendor audits and corresonding quality risk management activities. Core responsibilities of the Quality Manager are

  • Audit Universe
    • Develops and maintains the internal Quality Risk Assessment methodology.
    • Develops and maintains a comprehensive Audit Universe.
    • Leads Quality Assurance activities in relation to procurement and vendor oversight.
    • Develops, maintains, and manages mechanisms that assure ongoing monitoring and compliance with all applicable laws and regulations including but not limited to EU GVP, USFDA CFRs, JMPA and ICH-E6.
    • Partners closely with Vendor Management and operations teams, driving risk-based and compliant audit strategy.
  • Auditing and Audit management
    • Coordinates and contributes to internal system and/or vendor audits initiated by the Company, according to the Company Audit Plan, including effective management of pre-audit and post-audit activities.
    • As required, and within their area of GxP expertise, conducts audits or coordinates audit documentation peer review and quality control activities.
  • Other
    • For Client contracted services within Quality Assurance area, undertakes activities in relation to the Quality as a Service, such as planning, coordinating or conducting audits, and providing GxP QA consultantcy in line with their expertise and experience.
    • Monitors compliance within the organization to ensure early identification and review its impact on audit strategy, audit plans and its execution.
  • Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in biomedical sciences, natural sciences, health sciences, or another relevant scientific discipline, or an equivalent combination of advanced education and relevant industry experience
  • Experience:
    • Experience with both GVP and GCP regulatory requirements, or a willingness to broaden your expertise
    • At least 3 years of direct auditing experience in GCP (e.g. investigational sites, TMFs, Vendors) and / or GVP area (e.g. safety case processing and reporting)
    • At least 2 years of experience in audit program management including the development and maintenance of risk-based audit plans
  • Skills: Organization skills, attention to details, excellent communication and facilitation skills within a global organization, proactive, fluent in English

When you join Ergomed Group, you make a difference by helping to bring safe and effective pharmaceutical treatment to patients around the world. You’ll join a passionate and collaborative team of experts in clinical research, pharmacovigilance, and quality consulting.

We are diverse in many ways, yet our values unite us. Our values are how we work, not words on a wall. If they sound like you, you will feel at home here.

  • Quality: we hold ourselves to the standard patients deserve.
  • Integrity and trust: we do the right thing, especially when it is hard.
  • Drive and passion: we care about the outcome, because someone is waiting on it.
  • Agility and responsiveness: we move quickly, because patients cannot wait.
  • Belonging: everyone is welcome, and every voice counts.
  • Collaborative partnerships: we go further by going together.

We look forward to welcoming your application.

Medicine moves forward here. So will you.

Ergomed is a specialist clinical research organization focused on rare disease and select oncology indications. We focus on the most complex trials, the studies where experience, judgement, and rigorous operational accountability make the biggest difference. We partner with small to midsize biotech companies to move promising therapies through early phase development, so they reach the patients sooner.

We choose complex work on purpose. Rare disease and oncology trials carry real operational risk, and our people are experts at reducing it, protecting timelines, data quality and the experience of sites and patients at the same time. It is demanding, meaningful work, and no one here forgets that patients cannot wait.

That is why culture matters to us as much as capability. We have built a collaborative, international team where people share ideas, grow their careers and are trusted to take ownership early. With colleagues across North America, South America, Europe, Asia and Australia, we value teamwork, flexibility and a real commitment to work-life balance, because good science comes from people who feel supported.

If you want work with purpose, the agility to make an impact and a team that cares about the people behind the work as much as the work itself, we would love to hear from you.

job.description:
🌎 Where: Argentina or Colombia - 100% Remote

🤝 Type: Full-time, via our employer of record

About MarketFully Group

MarketFully has InContent Marketing Agencies that specialize in the managed solutions for the platform: Key Content (multilingual and global content marketing), Social Element (global social media, moderation and community management), and MotionPoint (website translation and localization).

MarketFully pairs AI technology with real human expertise to help brands create, adapt, and distribute content that reaches the right people in the right way. The result: stronger connections with global audiences, more engaged communities, and better visibility - all leading to marketing results you can actually measure.

The role

MotionPoint makes websites work in every language. As a QA Analyst, you'll check that our customers' multilingual websites look and behave the way they should, before launch and in an ongoing basis through our proprietary technology.

You'll plan the testing for each project, test sites by hand, log and follow up defects, and work with internal teams to improve website quality. You'll also help build automated tests using our in-house tools.

What you'll do

  • Plan the testing for each project from its SOW: set the scope and identify the key risks, critical paths and priority areas.

  • Design and run manual functional, regression and user acceptance (UAT) tests on multilingual websites and web applications.

  • Analyse, document and track defects in Salesforce, and work with the teams involved to check fixes before release.

  • Carry out ongoing manual QA on customer websites, including releases after delivery.

  • Use MotionPoint's TCrawl and Automation Services tools to support testing and build automated tests.

  • Join client calls and work with internal teams to recommend usability improvements.

  • Support our QA Automation Analysts with testing requests and wider QA initiatives.

What we're looking for

You don't need to be a developer, but you should be comfortable looking under the hood of a website.

  • 2+ years of experience in QA or web testing, with strong hands-on manual testing experience.

  • A solid understanding of web technologies, HTTP and how websites are built.

  • A good understanding of HTML, JavaScript and CSS. No coding is required, but you know your way around page elements, selectors, browser developer tools, basic web design concepts and the common web browsers.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent attention to detail.

  • The ability to prioritise, use good judgement and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • An eagerness to learn new technologies and QA automation tools.

  • Excellent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

  • Experience with defect tracking tools such as Jira or Salesforce

  • Experience evaluating new tools

Why join us

  • Full training on our proprietary testing and automation tools

  • Hands-on exposure to test automation, working alongside our QA Automation Analysts

  • Fully remote

The Hiring Process

The hiring process for this position will be made up of the following stages:

  • ❤️ Culture + Connect Interview – with one of the talent team

  • ✨ Skills + Experience Interview – with Annarely Rodriguez, QA Lead.

  • 🤝 Final Chat – with Vanessa Lopez, VP of Delivery and Customer Experience

Our Diversity, Equality & Inclusion Commitment

We welcome applications from diverse and under-represented groups regardless of background.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates, so even if you feel you don’t fulfill all the requirements, we encourage you to apply. We’d love to hear from you.🙂

We value divergent thinkers who bring different experiences and viewpoints to MarketFully. We strongly encourage members of under-represented groups to apply.

We can also make reasonable adjustments throughout the recruitment process. Please let us know if there is any additional support you may need.

How To Apply 🖊️

If all this sounds like you, upload your CV or résumé and complete the application form. While a cover letter is optional, we welcome any other way for you to share what draws you to this role and MarketFully Group.

We’re excited to receive your application! ❤️

job.title: QA Lead
job.description:
About Baselane

Baselane is a rapidly growing banking and financial management platform for individual landlords and real estate investors. We are backed by leading FinTech investors, including Activant Capital, Collaborative Fund, Conversion Capital, Diagram Ventures, ThomVest, and many FinTech leaders from PayPal, eBay, Google, and more.
We are building the future of financial services for the 12+ million individual landlords and real estate investors who own over 25 million homes in the United States. Our mission is to empower landlords with financial services, automated tools, and actionable insights to help them save time, increase their returns, and grow their investment portfolios.
We are a seasoned team with deep experience in financial services and technology. We have previously worked at companies including The Boston Consulting Group, Morgan Stanley, Plaid, Harry’s, Better, WealthSimple, RBC Ventures, Affirm, NorthOne, RazorPay, and more.
Learn more at .

About the Role

We operate in an AI-first engineering environment, where AI-powered development is at the core of how we design, build, and deliver software. As our engineers ship faster with AI coding agents, quality has to keep pace, and that means automation.

We’re looking for a hands-on QA Lead who is equally comfortable writing Playwright tests and leading a team of both manual and automation testers. This is a player-coach role: you’ll spend a significant part of your time building automation yourself, while guiding our manual QA team as they grow into automation, and help the engineering team write better test cases.

Expect roughly half your time hands-on in the codebase, building new automated tests, healing flaky or broken ones, and helping our engineers write better tests for the features they ship. You’ll set the quality strategy, lead by example, and work closely with Engineering, Product, Design, and DevOps to help our engineers own quality end-to-end. The other half focused on building the QA team and practice.

Our stack: React, TypeScript, Node.js, NestJS, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, and AWS. Our test stack is built around Playwright.

Core Responsibilities

  • Build automation hands-on: Write, review, and maintain Playwright tests yourself, covering critical user flows, APIs, and regression suites. You’ll be one of the most active contributors to our test codebase.

  • Coach and grow the QA team: Lead our manual QA team through pairing, code reviews, and hands-on mentorship, upskilling team members into automation and setting clear expectations for quality ownership.

  • Own the automation framework: Define the architecture, patterns, and conventions of our test framework so it stays fast, reliable, and easy for both QA and engineers to contribute to.

  • Integrate quality into delivery: Embed automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every change is validated before it reaches production, and partner with DevOps on test environments and data.

  • Test with AI agents: Use tools like Claude Code and Cursor to accelerate test creation, maintenance, and debugging while owning the reliability of the output, and teach the team to do the same.

  • Define quality standards: Establish acceptance criteria, test plans, and release readiness standards with Product and Engineering, and track meaningful quality metrics (coverage, escaped defects, flakiness, cycle time).

We're looking for an accomplished Data Tester to validate data quality, transformation, migration, interfaces, and reconciliation across this large-scale SAP implementation. In this role, you'll partner with developers, data engineers, business analysts, functional teams, and product owners within a SAFe Agile environment.

  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with data engineers, developers, functional analysts, business stakeholders, and integration teams to resolve data issues and maximize test coverage

  • Agile Participation: Actively engage in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives, and other Agile ceremonies

  • Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to improve data-testing methods, reusable SQL validation, automation, reporting, and data-quality controls

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance (required)

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Analytics, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent professional experience)

  • Experience: Minimum 5 years in software testing with a minimum of 2 years dedicated data testing for large-scale enterprise or ERP systems

  • Data Testing Expertise: Hands-on experience with data validation, ETL/ELT testing, source-to-target reconciliation, data migration/conversion testing, and data-quality testing

  • SQL Skills: Strong SQL skills for querying, comparing, aggregating, reconciling, and troubleshooting data across relational databases

  • Agile Methodology: Strong working knowledge of SAFe Framework, SDLC, and Agile development practices

  • Core Competencies: Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities, attention to detail, strong written and verbal communication skills, and ability to work independently and collaboratively

Desired:

  • Technical Skills: Experience with data profiling, ETL tools, APIs, flat files, XML/JSON, and data comparison or reconciliation utilities

job.title: Analyste qualité intermédiaire en automatisation / Intermediate QA Automation An
job.description:
Analyste qualité intermédiaire en automatisation – Adhésion des marchands et acquisition

En tant qu'analyste qualité intermédiaire au sein de l'équipe d'adhésion des marchands (Merchant Onboarding), vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en garantissant la qualité, la fiabilité et la performance des intégrations qui permettent aux nouveaux marchands de rejoindre la plateforme PayFacto, tant dans notre application Web que dans nos API. Vous prendrez en charge les tests de vos fonctionnalités, de la planification jusqu'à la mise en production, en travaillant de façon autonome et en étroite collaboration avec les développeurs, les gestionnaires de produits et l'équipe de support à la clientèle.

Principales responsabilités :

  1. Planification et conception des tests : Analyser les exigences et les récits utilisateurs liés aux parcours d'adhésion des marchands, puis concevoir des plans de test, des cas de test et des scénarios couvrant l'application Web et les API, en appliquant des techniques reconnues (partitions d'équivalence, valeurs limites, tests basés sur les risques).
  2. Tests de l'application Web : Effectuer des tests fonctionnels, de bout en bout et exploratoires de l'application Web d'adhésion des marchands, notamment les formulaires, les validations, le téléversement de documents et les flux de statut.
  3. Tests d'API : Tester les API REST utilisées dans les intégrations d'adhésion des marchands à l'aide de Postman, en validant les requêtes, les réponses, les codes de statut, la gestion des erreurs, l'authentification et les contrats de données.
  4. Automatisation des tests : Concevoir, développer et maintenir des tests automatisés d'interface et d'API avec Playwright et TypeScript, et contribuer à leur intégration dans le pipeline CI/CD.
  5. Tests d'intégration et validation des données : Vérifier les flux de données de bout en bout entre l'application Web, les API et les systèmes internes ou tiers (p. ex. vérification d'identité, souscription, configuration du compte marchand) afin d'assurer l'exactitude et la cohérence des données.
  6. Tests de règlement et de rapprochement : Valider les flux d'acquisition (acquiring) afin de s'assurer que les transactions des marchands nouvellement intégrés sont réglées correctement, que les frais, les montants versés et les calendriers de versement correspondent à la configuration du marchand, et que les fichiers de règlement et les rapports de rapprochement concordent avec les données transactionnelles.
  7. Tests de régression : Maintenir et exécuter les suites de tests de régression, manuelles et automatisées, afin de détecter rapidement les problèmes introduits par les nouvelles versions, les correctifs ou les changements d'intégration.
  8. Gestion des défauts : Documenter, suivre et classer par ordre de priorité les défauts à l'aide d'outils de suivi, avec des étapes de reproduction claires, et collaborer avec les développeurs pour en assurer la résolution rapide.
  9. Autonomie et responsabilisation : Prendre en charge les tests des fonctionnalités qui vous sont assignées, gérer vos priorités et signaler de façon proactive les risques et les enjeux de qualité, avec un minimum de supervision.
  10. Collaboration et partage des connaissances : Participer aux cérémonies Agile, communiquer les résultats des tests et partager les meilleures pratiques avec l'équipe afin de favoriser une culture de qualité et d'amélioration continue.

Qualifications :

  • Baccalauréat ou diplôme d'études collégiales en informatique, en technologie de l'information ou dans un domaine connexe, ou expérience équivalente.
  • Au moins 3 ans d'expérience en assurance qualité ou en tests logiciels.
  • Solides connaissances théoriques et pratiques en assurance qualité : niveaux et types de tests, techniques de conception de tests, cycle de vie des défauts et stratégies de test. Une certification ISTQB est un atout.
  • Expérience pratique de l'automatisation des tests avec Playwright et TypeScript (ou JavaScript).
  • Solide expérience des tests d'API REST avec Postman (collections, environnements, scripts et assertions). La connaissance de Newman est un atout.
  • Capacité à travailler de façon autonome, à gérer ses priorités et à prendre en charge ses livrables du début à la fin.
  • Solides compétences en matière d'analyse et de résolution de problèmes, avec un grand souci du détail.
  • Excellentes aptitudes à la communication et à la collaboration au sein d'équipes interfonctionnelles. Le bilinguisme (français et anglais) est un atout.
  • Connaissance des méthodologies Agile, de Git et des pipelines CI/CD.
  • Connaissance du domaine de l'acquisition (acquiring), en particulier des processus de règlement et de rapprochement : cycle de vie d'une transaction (autorisation, capture, compensation, règlement, versement), frais d'interchange et de traitement, et rétrofacturations.
  • Une expérience en adhésion des marchands ou en technologies financières est un atout.

À propos de nous :

  • Nous fournissons des solutions de paiement et de points de vente entièrement intégrées aux restaurants, aux hôtels et aux bars.
  • Nous sommes reconnus pour nos systèmes de point de vente à la fine pointe de la technologie (Veloce et Maitre'D).
  • Nous avons des bureaux au Canada, aux États-Unis et en Europe

Nous offrons :

  • Une couverture médicale et dentaire dès le premier jour
  • Télémédecine 24/7
  • Cotisation REER
  • Des vacances et des jours personnels

Rejoignez-nous pour façonner l'expérience d'adhésion des marchands à notre plateforme de paiement, et contribuez à offrir une valeur inégalée à nos clients.

Vous souhaitez faire partie de l'ADN de PayFacto alors que nous atteignons de nouveaux sommets ? Postulez maintenant !

********************************

Intermediate QA Automation Analyst – Merchant Onboarding & Acquiring

As an Intermediate Quality Analyst on our Merchant Onboarding team, you will play a key role in ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of the integrations that bring new merchants onto the PayFacto platform, across both our web application and our APIs. You will own testing for your features from planning through release, working independently while partnering closely with software developers, product managers, and customer support.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Test Planning & Design: Analyze requirements and user stories for merchant onboarding flows, and design test plans, test cases, and scenarios covering the web application and APIs, applying sound techniques such as equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, and risk-based testing.
  2. Web Application Testing: Perform functional, end-to-end, and exploratory testing of the merchant onboarding web application, including forms, validations, document uploads, and status workflows.
  3. API Testing: Test the REST APIs used in merchant onboarding integrations with Postman, validating requests, responses, status codes, error handling, authentication, and data contracts.
  4. Test Automation: Design, build, and maintain automated UI and API tests using Playwright and TypeScript and contribute to integrating them into the CI/CD pipeline.
  5. Integration & Data Validation: Verify end-to-end data flows between the web application, APIs, and internal or third-party systems (e.g., identity verification, underwriting, merchant account setup) to ensure merchant data is accurate and consistent.
  6. Settlement & Reconciliation Testing: Validate acquiring flows to ensure transactions for newly onboarded merchants settle correctly, that fees, funding amounts, and payout schedules match the merchant's configuration, and that settlement files and reconciliation reports balance against transaction records.
  7. Regression Testing: Maintain and execute manual and automated regression suites to quickly catch issues introduced by new releases, patches, or integration changes.
  8. Defect Management: Document, track, and prioritize defects using defect tracking tools, with clear reproduction steps, and collaborate with developers to ensure timely resolution.
  9. Ownership & Autonomy: Take ownership of testing for assigned features, manage your own priorities, and proactively raise risks and quality concerns with minimal supervision.
  10. Collaboration & Knowledge Sharing: Participate in Agile ceremonies, communicate test results, and share best practices with the team to foster a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or college diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in quality assurance or software testing.
  • Solid grasp of QA theory and practice: test levels and types, test design techniques, defect lifecycle, and test strategy. ISTQB certification is an asset.
  • Hands-on experience automating tests with Playwright and TypeScript (or JavaScript).
  • Strong experience testing REST APIs with Postman (collections, environments, scripts, and assertions). Experience with Newman is an asset.
  • Ability to work independently, manage priorities, and own deliverables from start to finish.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with meticulous attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills in cross-functional teams. Bilingualism (French and English) is an asset.
  • Knowledge of Agile methodologies, Git, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Knowledge of the acquiring domain, particularly settlement and reconciliation processes: the transaction lifecycle (authorization, capture, clearing, settlement, funding), interchange and processing fees, and chargebacks.
  • Experience in merchant onboarding or fintech is a plus.

About us:

  • We provide fully integrated payment and point of sales solutions to restaurants, hotels and bars
  • We are known for our state-of-the-art point of sales systems (Veloce and Maitre’D)
  • We have offices in Canada, US and Europe

We offer:

  • Medical and dental coverage as of Day 1
  • Telemedicine 24/7
  • RRSP contribution
  • Vacation and personal days

Join us in shaping how merchants are onboarded to our payment platform and contribute to delivering unparalleled value to our clients and customers.

Are you looking to be part of our PayFacto DNA as we climb to new heights? Apply now!

job.description:
Be the last expert to look at a deliverable before it reaches the client. We promise our client that a senior reviewer who did not produce the work will approve every final deliverable. That reviewer needs to be someone who has seen enough analyses to know when a number looks too clean, a comparison is not fair, or a conclusion goes further than the data. You work only when there is something to review, and your sign-off carries real weight.

What you'll do

  • Review and approve final deliverables for analytical soundness, traceability to source data, material limitations, conformance with scope, and acceptance criteria.

  • Check that findings are supported, that data gaps and uncertainty are stated, and that AI-assisted results were validated by a person.

  • Document required corrections, confirm they were made, and record your approval.

  • Advise Task Leads on analytical approach when asked, before work reaches final review.

  • Stay independent: you never review work you helped produce.

Required qualifications

  • Advanced degree (master's or doctorate) in data science, statistics, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Finalists will be asked to sign a commitment letter so we can name them in our proposal, and their resume may be shared with the client.

  • Advanced degree (master's or doctorate) in data science, statistics, economics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

  • A record of reviewing other people's quantitative work and giving direct, specific feedback.

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Job Description

The Senior Software Design Assurance (Sr Software Design Quality) Engineer provides technical support and guidance to Software teams to ensure conformance to software development process and other applicable safety and quality system regulation and standards (e.g. IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971).


This role will be responsible for various aspects of Software Design Assurance with a focus on product improvement, new product development, and defect prevention. This position will interface with different cross functional groups (Software Engineering, Software Test, Regulatory Affairs, Marketing, Project

managers, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, and others). A positive attitude is important while working in a fast-paced environment and dealing with shifting priorities.


Where you come in:

  • You will actively participate as a core member of the R&D Quality Assurance Engineering team, supporting software design assurance for cloud‑based, data platform, and AI/ML‑enabled systems.
  • You will provide hands‑on technical guidance to cross‑functional teams on IEC 62304, 21 CFR 820, and other applicable global regulations for software‑as‑a‑service, data, and AI‑driven products.
  • You will lead the effective application, compliance, and continuous improvement of software development and validation practices for distributed systems, cloud services, and data platforms.
  • You will drive pre‑market risk management deliverables, including Software Hazard Analysis (SHA), design FMEA, and risk controls related to cloud infrastructure, data processing, and AI/ML functionality.
  • You will guide Software Design and Test teams on software design assurance activities such as requirements traceability, software configuration management, tool validation, and integration of cloud and data services.
  • You will review and approve software design control deliverables associated with cloud‑hosted services, data pipelines, and AI/ML components to ensure regulatory compliance and product quality.
  • You will support post‑market activities related to software anomalies, model behavior, data quality issues, risk assessments, and CAPA activities, as applicable.
  • You will author, review, and maintain technical documentation including Design History Files, SOPs, protocols, and reports for cloud‑based and AI/ML‑enabled systems.
  • You will assess change control activities related to infrastructure, data, or model changes to ensure no adverse impact to product performance and to maintain a compliant state.
  • You will effectively communicate plans, progress, risks, and design assurance considerations to cross‑functional teams and senior leadership.

What makes you successful:

  • • Nice to have: AI/ML experience or ASQ CSQE certification.
  • You bring strong experience in software design assurance for cloud‑based, data platform, API, and service‑oriented systems in a regulated environment.
  • You have demonstrated hands‑on knowledge of IEC 62304, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, ISO 13485, and their application to software‑as‑a‑service and data‑driven products.
  • Your proficiency includes applying software design assurance principles across the SDLC, including requirements analysis, architecture and design reviews, implementation oversight, integration, and verification.
  • You have experience performing and reviewing software risk management activities, including Software Hazard Analysis (SHA), design FMEA, and change impact assessments for cloud, data, and AI/ML components.
  • You are skilled at reviewing and approving software design control deliverables to ensure traceability, risk control implementation, and regulatory compliance.
  • You have experience supporting software configuration management, tool validation, and integration of cloud services, data pipelines, and platform components.
  • You communicate effectively with cross‑functional partners and can clearly present design assurance, risk, and compliance topics to technical teams and senior leadership.

What you’ll get:

  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.

Remote Workplace: Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.

job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
About Care Access

Care Access is working to make the future of health better for all. With hundreds of research locations, mobile clinics, and clinicians across the globe, we bring world-class research and health services directly to communities that often face barriers to care. We are dedicated to ensuring that every person has the opportunity to understand their health, access the care they need, and contribute to the medical breakthroughs of tomorrow.

With programs like Future of Medicine, which makes advanced health screenings and research opportunities accessible to communities worldwide, and Difference Makers, which supports local leaders to expand their community health and wellbeing efforts, we put people at the heart of medical progress. Through partnerships, technology, and perseverance, we are reimagining how clinical research and health services reach the world. Together, we are building a future of health that is better and more accessible for all.

To learn more about Care Access, visit .

How This Role Makes a Difference

The Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of software applications that support clinical research and participant pre-screening operations. This position collaborates with cross-functional product development teams to develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive manual and automated testing strategies, with a strong emphasis on end-to-end test automation using Playwright. The QA Engineer identifies, documents, and helps resolve software defects throughout the development lifecycle, contributing to the delivery of high-quality, compliant, and reliable software solutions that support organizational objectives and enhance the user experience.

How You'll Make An Impact

  • Design, build, and maintain automated end-to-end test suites using Playwright across web and API surfaces.
  • Perform exploratory and structured manual testing on complex user flows, edge cases, and regression scenarios.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to enable fast, reliable feedback on every pull request.
  • Collaborate closely with engineers and designers during development to shift quality left, writing tests alongside features, not after.
  • Triage, reproduce, and document bugs with clear steps and context that accelerate resolution.
  • Contribute to and improve QA processes, standards, and tooling across the engineering organization.
  • Participate in test planning, sprint ceremonies, and release readiness reviews.

The Expertise Required

  • Strong proficiency with Playwright (or a comparable framework like Cypress or Puppeteer) and the ability to write maintainable, reliable tests.
  • Solid manual testing instincts: you know when to automate and when hands-on exploration surfaces more value.
  • Experience integrating test suites into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar).
  • Familiarity with testing APIs alongside UI flows, including REST and GraphQL endpoints.
  • Strong communication skills: you can write a clear bug report, explain a test strategy, and advocate for quality with engineers and PMs alike.
  • Comfort working in a fast-moving environment where priorities shift and judgment matters.

Certifications/Licenses, Education, and Experience

  • Minimum Education:
    • Bachelor's or Master's degree or equivalent experience
  • Minimum Experience:
    • 3+ years of experience in software QA, with meaningful time spent in test automation.

How We Work Together

  • Location: Remote within the United States. This role requires 100% of work to be performed in a remote office environment.
  • Travel: This is a remote position with less than 10% travel requirements. Occasional planned travel may be required as part of the role.
  • Physical demands associated with this position Include: The ability to use keyboards and other computer equipment.

The expected pay range for this role is $80,000 - $110,000 USD per year for full time team members.

Benefits & Perks (US Full Time Employees)

  • Health Savings Account and Flexible Spending Accounts

job.title: Senior QA Engineer - US Remote
job.description:
What is PerfectServe?

PerfectServe is a leading provider of clinical communication and physician scheduling solutions in the health IT space. The company was founded in 1997 and has grown steadily since then, with a notable jump after several major acquisitions were announced in 2019. PerfectServe now has 400+ employees, 30,000+ customers — spanning medical practices, hospitals, and health systems — and $100 million+ in annual revenue.

PerfectServe’s mission is to accelerate speed to care by optimizing provider schedules and routing communications — including messages, pages, calls, and alerts — to the right place at the right time in any care setting. By facilitating real-time information sharing, building better schedules, and automating important clinical workflows, we believe we can help our customers advance patient care and improve the well-being of their clinicians.

Leading analyst firms like Gartner® and KLAS Research have consistently validated our approach:
  1. In 2026, PerfectServe was named highest in execution and furthest in vision in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Clinical Communication and Collaboration — the clear segment leader.
  2. PerfectServe also received two Best in KLAS awards in 2026 — one for physician scheduling and another for ambulatory clinical communications. That makes for 11 Best in KLAS awards over the past 9 years.
At PerfectServe, you'll have a unique opportunity to join a collaborative team with decades of experience that finds new ways to delight our customers every day. This involves consistent efforts to stay on the cutting edge of product development, which includes everything from implementing AI in new and existing solutions to brainstorming with customers about novel workflows. But you don't have to be in product to make in impact — everybody at PerfectServe contributes to important work that moves the business forward.

If you're looking for a well-established, tech-forward company full of smart people doing meaningful work, you've found the right place!

Role Overview

PerfectServe is seeking a Senior QA Engineer to ensure the quality, reliability, and safety of PerfectServe’s products through rigorous manual and automated testing. As a senior individual contributor, you will own complex work end-to-end, raise the quality bar, and mentor those around you.

The QA team is 100% manual today. This hire will build the test automation capability from the ground up and, over time, will be the sole QA engineer on the team, owning quality independently while working closely with developers.

In a healthcare SaaS environment where reliability and security affect patient care, this role is held to a high standard. Success means consistently demonstrating the responsibilities below, combining technical depth with collaboration, communication, and sound judgment, rather than excelling in any one area alone.

Core Responsibilities

Technical

  • Execute manual test cases
  • Document defects clearly
  • Write automation scripts
  • Apply API testing tools
  • Integrate tests in CI/CD
  • Build test frameworks
  • Conduct performance testing
  • Implement security testing

Architecture & Design

  • Understand system under test
  • Participate in design reviews
  • Design test architectures
  • Author test strategy docs

Delivery & Execution

  • Execute assigned test plans
  • Write own test plans
  • Manage test coverage
  • Manage QA environment integrity
  • Coordinate release readiness
  • Own QA for full feature

Quality & Standards

  • Follow test standards
  • Ensure HIPAA test coverage
  • Define quality metrics
  • Improve QA processes
  • Validate app/prod parity

Collaboration

  • Participate in ceremonies
  • Partner with dev engineers
  • Collaborate with product team
  • Partner across squads

Communication

  • Report defect status
  • Communicate test results
  • Write test documentation
  • Present quality metrics

Leadership & Mentorship

  • Learn QA best practices
  • Support junior QA engineers
  • Mentor automation skills

Strategy & Vision

  • Understand release goals
  • Contribute to QA planning
  • Shape test automation strategy

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of professional QA engineering experience, including ownership of complex work end-to-end.
  • Hands-on experience executing test cases and documenting defects clearly.
  • Experience with test automation, API testing, and CI/CD integration.
  • Experience building test frameworks from the ground up.
  • Python for test automation.
  • Hands-on experience building UI/end-to-end automation with Playwright, Selenium, or Cypress.
  • Understanding of QA methodologies and quality metrics.
  • Strong written and verbal communication; able to present status and risk to stakeholders.
  • Self-starter who can own QA independently, while still collaborating closely with devs and speaking up on quality.

Preferred

  • Experience testing in a HIPAA/HITRUST-regulated healthcare environment.
  • Performance and security testing experience.

Nice to Have

  • Twilio, telephony/VoIP, or call center software experience, especially automating real call flows.
  • Jira and Zephyr.
  • AWS, plus any Kubernetes or Argo CD exposure.
  • Performance testing with any tool (the team uses Locust)

Why This Role

This role offers the chance to grow both your impact and your craft. You will take on progressively harder problems, work alongside strong colleagues, and see your contributions matter beyond your immediate team — because quality engineering done well is a direct contribution to safer, more reliable care.

Why Join PerfectServe?

At PerfectServe, we are transforming healthcare communication and collaboration to help clinicians deliver better care. You’ll work with a dedicated and mission‑driven team in an environment that values growth, transparency, and innovation.

We offer a salary range of $100,000–$130,000 USD per year, with compensation tailored to your background, strengths, and growth potential. This range reflects our commitment to pay transparency and is based on market data, internal equity, and the scope of responsibilities. Compensation is determined by several factors, including experience, skills, and team impact. We regularly review compensation to ensure fairness and consistency. Current employees with questions are encouraged to connect with their manager or People Operations.

Benefits:

  • Remote first work environment
  • Health, Dental, Vision, Life and Disability Insurance options available day one.
  • 401K - with match and immediately vested.
  • 17 company holidays, 2 floating holidays plus competitive paid time off policy
  • Internal Advancement Opportunities

PerfectServe offers unified healthcare communication solutions to help physicians, nurses, and care team members provide exceptional patient care. PerfectServe’s cloud-based solutions enhance patient safety and reduce provider burnout by automating workflows, speeding time to treatment, optimizing shift schedules, empowering nurse mobility, and engaging patients in their own care.

job.title: Principal QA Engineer/ QA Manager
job.description:
About BTSE:

BTSE Group is a global leader in fintech and blockchain technology, anchored by three core business pillars: Exchange, Payments, and Infrastructure Development. Serving over 100 corporate clients worldwide, we provide white-label exchange and payment solutions. Our offerings encompass everything from exchange infrastructure hosting and development to custody, wallets, payments, blockchain integration, trading, and more. We are looking for talented professionals in marketing, operations, customer support, and other departments. The roles offered may be on-site, remote, or hybrid, in collaboration with our local partner.

About the Opportunity:
As Principal QA Engineer, you will own automated and performance testing for your product area(s) and set the technical standard for testing across them. You will develop test automation, design and execute stress and performance tests against high-volume trading systems, and apply AI tools to improve the speed and depth of testing, working with engineering, product, and DevOps to ensure that every release performs reliably.

Responsibilities

  • Own the testing lifecycle for new features and changes, including scoping, risk assessment, test depth, and release readiness.

  • Build and maintain automated tests covering API, UI, integration, and regression, and reduce flaky tests.

  • Design and run load, stress, and performance tests on high-risk areas (order flow, matching and settlement, balances, deposits/withdrawals), analyze results, and report bottlenecks to engineering.

  • Use AI tools to speed up test generation, analysis, and triage, and share what works with the team.

  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines with reliable quality gates.

  • Lead testing on complex or high-severity changes and make release sign-off recommendations.

  • Own the test automation architecture (frameworks, test data, environments) in line with QA standards set by the Director.

  • Mentor QA engineers through code reviews and pairing.

  • Report quality metrics (defect escape rate, critical-path coverage, release stability) to the Director and stakeholders, and raise quality and release risks early, backed by data.

Requirement

  • 7+ years in software QA/test engineering with a strong automation focus.
  • Must be fluent in Mandarin

  • Hands-on automation experience in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java, including designing or substantially owning a framework.

  • Hands-on performance/load testing experience (e.g., k6, JMeter, Locust, Gatling).

  • Experience testing APIs and backend/distributed systems.

  • Experience with CI/CD (e.g., GitLab CI, Jenkins, GitHub Actions) in an agile environment.

  • Ability to learn complex transactional or financial logic quickly, and clear communication with engineers and product.

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

job.title: Quality-Driven QA Engineer
job.description:
Technical QA Engineer

Location: Remote (Pakistan)

Job Type: Full-time

Work Schedule: 9:00 AM–5:00 PM Pacific Time

Base Salary: Competitive, based on experience

Role Overview

We're looking for a Technical QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and security of our software products! As we increasingly use AI and development agents to build and improve software, we need someone who can independently validate what those systems produce — both from a user perspective and at a technical level.

In this role, you'll test applications, APIs, databases, integrations, and new features; review and understand code well enough to identify potential quality, logic, and security issues; build and maintain automated tests; and investigate technical problems using logs, debugging tools, and application data.

We're in need of someone who's technically strong to understand how a system works, challenge assumptions, investigate failures, and independently determine whether software is behaving correctly.

Key Responsibilities

  • Test new features, improvements, integrations, and bug fixes across our software products.
  • Perform functional, regression, integration, API, database, exploratory, and edge-case testing.
  • Review and understand application code well enough to design better tests, identify likely failure points, investigate issues more deeply, and validate software behavior independently.
  • Build, maintain, and improve automated tests for critical functionality and regression coverage.
  • Use AI coding agents and AI-assisted tools to help create tests, expand test coverage, investigate failures, analyze logs, and improve QA efficiency.
  • Critically validate AI-generated software and tests rather than assuming generated output is correct.
  • Test APIs directly, including requests, responses, authentication, error handling, data validation, and unexpected inputs.
  • Validate application data and database behavior using SQL or similar tools.
  • Test integrations between internal and external systems and identify failure scenarios.
  • Investigate issues using logs, stack traces, browser developer tools, API responses, database queries, and other debugging information.
  • Help identify the root cause of defects rather than only reporting visible symptoms.
  • Reproduce and isolate software issues and provide developers with clear technical findings.
  • Create detailed bug reports with reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, environment details, and supporting evidence.
  • Verify fixes and perform regression testing before issues are closed or released.
  • Work closely with developers to improve testability, reliability, and overall product quality.
  • Continuously improve QA processes, test coverage, and automation.

Requirements

  • Atleast 2 years of experience as a Technical QA Engineer, QA Automation Engineer, Software Engineer, Software Developer, or another technical software testing role.
  • Programming or scripting experience with Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, or another relevant language.
  • Experience using logs, debugging tools, API responses, database queries, and other technical evidence to investigate failures.
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, pytest, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of web applications, APIs, HTTP, authentication, and browser technologies.
  • Hands-on experience testing APIs using Postman, curl, or similar tools.
  • Experience working with SQL and relational or NoSQL databases.
  • Comfortable using Git / GitHub or similar version control systems.
  • Comfortable using browser developer tools, logs, stack traces, and other debugging information to investigate problems.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to investigate issues beyond their visible symptoms.
  • Strong understanding of testing methodologies, regression testing, edge cases, and failure scenarios.
  • Ability to write clear, actionable bug reports with relevant technical evidence.
  • Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Good written English communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of quality validation and test coverage for assigned projects or features.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing AI-generated or agent-generated software.
  • Experience reviewing pull requests or performing basic code-level quality checks.
  • Familiarity with common web application security risks and security testing principles.
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and automated test execution.
  • Experience with performance or load testing.
  • Familiarity with Linux and command-line tools.
  • Experience with Docker or containerized applications.
  • Experience with web scraping or browser automation.
  • Experience designing test strategies for complex systems and integrations.

What We Value

We're looking for someone who approaches QA as a technical investigation.

When something fails, we want you to be curious about why. You should be comfortable moving between the application, API, database, logs, automated tests, and code to understand what is happening and provide developers with useful technical findings.

As more software is produced with the help of AI and development agents, independent validation becomes increasingly important. You should be comfortable testing AI-generated work critically rather than assuming that working code is necessarily correct code.

We value someone who can ask:

  • Does this actually meet the requirements?
  • What happens with unexpected or invalid inputs?
  • Are there logic or data integrity issues?
  • Could this change break something elsewhere?
  • Are there obvious security or reliability concerns?
  • What isn't being tested?
  • How can we automate this so we don't have to test it manually every time?

Your role is to provide an independent, technically capable quality layer that helps us ship reliable software with confidence.

Benefits & Perks

  • Fully Remote Work – Work from anywhere with a reliable internet connection.
  • Healthcare Coverage – Health benefits to support you and your family's well-being.
  • Leave Days, Vacation Time & Paid Holidays – Take the time you need to recharge.
  • Equipment Funds – Support for setting up or upgrading your home office.
  • Profit Sharing – Monthly and annual bonuses tied to company performance.
  • Long-Term Employment – We value team members who want to learn, grow, and build with us.
  • Collaborative Team Culture – Work with a supportive and globally distributed team.

About Us

AutoScale Ventures is a technology-driven company with 50+ team members across the Philippines, Pakistan, India, the U.S., China, and Canada.

We operate a group of businesses spanning technology, data services, recruiting, and real estate, including:

  • VinAudit – Vehicle history and market data provider
  • Proxy Services – High-speed private proxy solutions
  • EliteWork – Remote workforce platform and SaaS productivity tool
  • Voliplex – Long-term U.S. real estate investment firm

We're committed to building scalable, data-driven products and empowering a globally distributed team to take ownership, solve meaningful problems, and continuously improve how we work.

Interested in Joining Us?

If you enjoy breaking things, understanding why they broke, building automated ways to prevent them from breaking again, and critically validating software before it reaches users, we'd love to hear from you.

job.description:
About Welocalize

Welocalize, a Welo Global brand, serves localization teams through AI-enabled multilingual content solutions that enable enterprises to operate and scale globally. Welocalize combines AI, automation, and human expertise to support enterprises in more than 300 languages, enabling accurate, culturally aligned, and compliant multilingual content at scale.
Welocalize’s Opal Platform comprises patented technology designed to automate multilingual content and improve workflow performance for enterprises. Opal functions as an agentic system that orchestrates AI, automation, and human expertise to coordinate content workflows across the lifecycle, improving speed, scalability, and operational control for global enterprises. We are looking for a Kazakh Localization QA Tester / Proofreader to join a long-term.

Your main focus will be reviewing and refining localized content, making sure it reads smoothly and is free from errors. You’ll also work hands-on with products by executing test cases, identifying localization bugs, and reporting issues through internal bug-tracking systems. job.title: Lead Supplier Development, Industrialization & Quality Engineer - Exterior
job.description:
Role Summary

The Rivian Supply Chain team is looking for strategic technical leaders to drive the quality and reliability of our vehicle programs. As a Lead Supplier Development, Industrialization & Quality Engineer, you are an advanced individual contributor and subject matter expert responsible for the complete supplier quality lifecycle, from initial sourcing to ongoing business management. You act as a leader with minimal manager input, taking direct ownership of the most critical and highest-risk suppliers to ensure a seamless production ramp.

In this role, you lead the resolution of complex manufacturing issues and partner with cross-functional leadership to drive systemic change across the organization. You are responsible for identifying and mitigating high-impact risks, serving as a technical mentor, and providing the expert-level analysis necessary to influence critical sourcing and design decisions. We are looking for an expert who can drive accountability with suppliers at the executive level and advocate for the team’s needs in major program reviews.

This position is based remotely in Mexico with a 50–75% domestic and international travel requirement and reports to Sr SDIQ Manager Exteriors.

El equipo de Cadena de Suministro de Rivian busca líderes técnicos estratégicos para impulsar la calidad y confiabilidad de nuestros programas de vehículos. Como Ingeniero Líder de Desarrollo de Proveedores, Industrialización y Calidad (SDIQ), serás un colaborador individual avanzado y experto en la materia, responsable del ciclo de vida completo de la calidad de proveedores, desde el abastecimiento inicial hasta la gestión continua del negocio. Te desempeñarás como líder con una supervisión directiva mínima, asumiendo la responsabilidad directa de los proveedores más críticos y de mayor riesgo para garantizar una rampa de producción sin contratiempos.

En este puesto, liderarás la resolución de problemas complejos de manufactura y colaborarás con el liderazgo multifuncional para impulsar cambios sistémicos en toda la organización. Serás responsable de identificar y mitigar riesgos de alto impacto, fungir como mentor técnico y proporcionar el análisis de nivel experto necesario para influir en decisiones críticas de diseño y abastecimiento. Buscamos un especialista capaz de exigir rendición de cuentas a los proveedores a nivel ejecutivo y defender las necesidades del equipo en las revisiones principales de los programas.

Esta posición es remota con base en México, requiere entre un 50% y 75% de viajes nacionales e internacionales, y reporta directamente al Gerente Senior de SDIQ de Exteriores.

Responsibilities

  • Supplier Management: Own the complete "Cradle to Grave" supplier quality lifecycle to ensure seamless production ramps. Manage critical CL0 and CL1 suppliers, resolving failures to mitigate risks or delays.
  • Problem-Solving and Risk Mitigation: Lead the breaking down of complex problems and datasets to derive meaningful, actionable results. Apply standard, robust problem-solving tools to address systemic issues across the supply base.
  • Technical Skills: Lead high-complexity APQP/PPAP projects impacting major program milestones. Optimize supplier quality KPIs to predict and prevent future failures, aligning project efforts with long-term goals.
  • Organizational Influence & Outreach: Act as a key advisor to program leadership, presenting and defending strategic recommendations in high-stakes forums. Drive systemic cross-functional change using first principles to persuade other functions to adopt new processes.
  • Direction: Operate as a leader with minimal manager input, holding accountability for the performance of suppliers and cross-functional teams. Act instinctively to manage and prioritize complex workloads in high-pressure situations.

  • Gestión de proveedores: Asumir la propiedad de todo el ciclo de vida de calidad de proveedores de principio a fin ("Cradle to Grave") para garantizar arranques de producción (ramps) sin contratiempos. Gestionar proveedores críticos CL0 y CL1, resolviendo fallas para mitigar riesgos o retrasos.

  • Resolución de problemas y mitigación de riesgos: Liderar el desglose y análisis de problemas complejos y conjuntos de datos para generar resultados tangibles y accionables. Aplicar herramientas estándar y robustas de solución de problemas para atender fallas sistémicas en la base de proveedores.

  • Habilidades técnicas: Dirigir proyectos de alta complejidad de APQP/PPAP con impacto directo en los hitos principales del programa. Optimizar los KPIs de calidad de proveedores para predecir y prevenir fallas futuras, alineando los esfuerzos del proyecto con los objetivos a largo plazo.

  • Influencia y alcance organizacional: Fungir como asesor clave para el liderazgo del programa, presentando y defendiendo recomendaciones estratégicas en foros de alto impacto. Impulsar el cambio sistémico interfuncional aplicando primeros principios (first principles) para convencer a otras áreas de adoptar nuevos procesos.

  • Dirección y autonomía: Conducirse como un líder con mínima supervisión directiva, asumiendo la rendición de cuentas por el desempeño de los proveedores y de los equipos multifuncionales. Actuar de manera instintiva y proactiva para gestionar y priorizar cargas de trabajo complejas en entornos de alta presión.

Qualifications

  • Education and Experience: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related technical field and a minimum of 6 years of relevant supplier development experience.
  • Domain Expertise: Full understanding of the procurement end-to-end lifecycle and experience managing high-risk supplier portfolios.
  • Commodity-Specific Experience: Exterior components process as, Plastic Molding, Plastic Injection, Extrusion, Surface Finishing & Coating knowledge.

Exterior appearance topics as color control, color harmony

Appearance Approval Report, boundary books and all Craftsmanship topics called out from the plant.

job.title: QA Analyst, Mind
job.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

As a QA Analyst on the Mind team, you won't just validate what's built — you'll help shape what gets built. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Design, AI and Clinical teams, you'll be involved throughout the entire product development lifecycle, from feature discovery and definition to testing and release.
Mind combines AI-driven interactions, clinical logic and personalized care experiences, making quality, safety and usability essential. We're looking for someone with a strong analytical mindset, technical curiosity and the ability to understand how software works under the hood.
You'll help us build a proactive, shift-left quality culture, identifying potential issues early and ensuring we deliver reliable, safe and effective AI-powered healthcare experiences.

To get to know more about our Tech Stack, check here.

What you’ll be doing

  • Collaborate early: Participate in product discovery, requirements definition and feature design, helping identify potential issues before development begins.
  • Define quality: Translate product requirements into acceptance criteria, test scenarios and quality expectations.
  • Own testing activities: Design, execute and maintain test plans covering functional, regression, integration and end-to-end testing.
  • Work across the stack: Test mobile applications, backend services, APIs and AI-powered functionalities, leveraging your technical knowledge to investigate issues.
  • Drive defect management: Identify, document and track defects through resolution, collaborating closely with engineers.
  • Improve quality practices: Contribute to QA processes, documentation and test automation, identifying opportunities to improve testing efficiency and prevent issues.

What you need to have

  • 1–2 years of experience in QA, software testing or software development with hands-on testing responsibilities.
  • Experience designing, executing and documenting test cases and test scenarios.
  • Basic to intermediate programming knowledge and the ability to read and understand code.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, attention to detail and a proactive mindset.
  • Ability to work autonomously and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.

What would make you stand out
  • Academic or professional background in Psychology, Mental Health or related fields.
  • Genuine interest in mental health, behavioural science and digital healthcare.
  • Personal or professional AI projects that can be demonstrated, such as AI-powered applications, LLM integrations or AI-driven workflows.
  • Knowledge of APIs, HTTP requests and tools such as Postman.
  • Hands-on experience with test automation and tools such as Jira, Git and Android Studio.
  • Understanding of healthcare products, clinical workflows or safety-critical software.
  • Experience leveraging AI tools to improve development, testing or team workflows.

About the Role

We’re looking for a detail-oriented and professional Healthcare Quality Assurance & Onboarding Coordinator to support quality assurance, documentation compliance, and onboarding within a healthcare services environment.

The ideal candidate is organised, communicates confidently, and enjoys working with detailed processes that require accuracy and consistency. You’ll play an important role in ensuring that Registered Behavior Technicians (RBTs) submit accurate and complete session notes, follow the required documentation standards, and understand how to use the relevant software and systems.

While the primary focus will be quality assurance and onboarding, the role may also involve occasional HR and administrative support as needed. We’re looking for someone who is adaptable, takes initiative, and is comfortable stepping in to assist outside their core responsibilities when required.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

Quality Assurance & Documentation

  • Review session notes and clinical documentation to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with established standards.
  • Monitor documentation submissions and follow up with RBTs to ensure outstanding or incorrect session notes are addressed promptly.
  • Identify missing information, inconsistencies, and recurring documentation issues, escalating concerns where necessary.
  • Maintain accurate records and trackers to monitor documentation quality, outstanding items, and compliance deadlines.
  • Support the implementation and maintenance of quality assurance processes and procedures.

Onboarding & Software Training

  • Assist with onboarding new RBTs, ensuring they understand documentation requirements, internal processes, and relevant procedures.
  • Train new team members on how to navigate and use the relevant software and systems.
  • Provide guidance and ongoing support to RBTs who need assistance with documentation or system-related queries.
  • Follow up with new starters to ensure they are comfortable with the systems and are meeting the required standards.

Communication & Team Support

  • Communicate professionally with RBTs and internal team members regarding documentation requirements, outstanding tasks, and areas for improvement.
  • Provide clear instructions and constructive feedback to help maintain high standards of documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with relevant teams to resolve documentation issues and support smooth day-to-day operations.
  • Assist with occasional HR-related tasks and general administrative duties when needed.

Requirements

  • Previous experience in quality assurance, compliance, documentation review, onboarding, training, or a similar coordination role.
  • Experience in a healthcare environment is preferred, with healthcare quality assurance experience considered a strong advantage.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify errors, inconsistencies, and missing information.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • A professional, patient, and organised approach to following up with team members.
  • Comfortable with repetitive, detail-heavy tasks that require accuracy and consistency.
  • Confident using computer systems and learning new software platforms.
  • Strong organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple follow-ups and deadlines.
  • Flexible and willing to assist with responsibilities outside the primary scope of the role when needed.

Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is someone who takes pride in getting the details right. They are comfortable reviewing documentation, following up on outstanding tasks, and ensuring processes are completed correctly rather than simply ticking boxes.

They communicate professionally, can confidently hold team members accountable for completing required documentation, and enjoy helping others learn new systems and processes.

Someone with experience in healthcare administration, clinical documentation, quality assurance, compliance, or training and onboarding would be well suited to this role.

What Success Looks Like

  • Session notes are submitted accurately, completely, and on time.
  • Documentation errors and outstanding submissions are followed up on consistently.
  • New RBTs are onboarded effectively and can confidently use the required software.
  • Quality assurance processes are followed consistently, with issues identified and escalated appropriately.
  • The wider team receives reliable support with documentation, onboarding, and occasional administrative or HR tasks.
