job.title: Senior Salesforce QA Analyst
job.company: Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Rhode Island
job.description:
Pay Range:

$93,600.00 - $140,400.00

Please email if you are a candidate seeking a reasonable accommodation for the application and/or interview process.

At BCBSRI, our greatest resource is our people.

We come from varying backgrounds, different cultures, and unique experiences. We are hard-working, caring, and creative individuals who collaborate, support one another, and grow together. Passion, empathy, and understanding are at the forefront of everything we do—not just for our members, but for our employees as well.

We recognize that to do your best work, you have to be your best self.
It’s why we offer flexible work arrangements that include remote and hybrid opportunities and paid time off. We provide tuition reimbursement and assist with student-loan repayment. We offer health, dental, and vision insurance as well as programs that support your mental health and well-being. We pay competitively, offer bonuses and investment plans, and are committed to growing and developing our employees.

Our culture is one of belonging.
We strive to be transparent and accountable. We believe in equipping our associates with the knowledge and resources they need to be successful. No matter where you’re at in the organization, you’re an integral part of our team and your input, thoughts, and ideas are valued.

Join others who value a workplace for all.
We appreciate and celebrate everything that makes us unique, from personal characteristics to past experiences. Our different perspectives strengthen us as an organization and help us better serve all Rhode Islanders.

We’re dedicated to serving Rhode Islanders.
Our focus extends beyond providing access to high-quality, affordable, and equitable care. To further improve the health and well-being of our fellow Rhode Islanders, we regularly roll up our sleeves and get to work (literally) in communities all across the state—building homes, working in food pantries, revitalizing community centers, and transforming outdoor spaces for children and adults. Because we believe it is our collective responsibility to uplift our fellow Rhode Islanders when and where we can, our associates receive additional paid time to volunteer.

Why this job matters:

Working closely with product owners, scrum masters, developers, analysts, configuration admins, technical leads, architects, release management, integration, security, and data teams, this role directs the quality assurance strategy and execution for a Salesforce delivery pod supporting Sales, Service, and Configuration workstreams. Responsible for organizing all testing activities across day-to-day support and project delivery, defining test approach and coverage, coordinating QA work across agile/scrum ceremonies, validating Salesforce configuration and custom development, ensuring regression readiness, and driving quality practices that improve release confidence, production stability, and user outcomes.

Platform scope: Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Financial Services Cloud where applicable, Data Cloud integrations, Salesforce platform configuration, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, APIs, integration touchpoints, test data, automation frameworks, CI/CD validation, and connected enterprise systems.

What you will do:

  • Lead and coordinate all QA activities for a Salesforce pod that includes developers, QA analysts, business analysts, and configuration admins, ensuring testing work is organized, estimated, sequenced, reviewed, and completed within agile/scrum delivery cycles.
  • Define and maintain the Salesforce QA strategy for Sales, Service, and Configuration workstreams, including functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, user acceptance testing support, data validation, smoke testing, and release readiness validation.
  • Partner with product owners, scrum masters, analysts, technical leads, and developers to refine user stories, acceptance criteria, test scenarios, test data needs, dependencies, and definition of done expectations before sprint commitment.
  • Develop, maintain, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, traceability, regression suites, and quality metrics for both project delivery and day-to-day enhancement and support work.
  • Lead QA planning and execution across agile ceremonies, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, defect triage, sprint reviews, retrospectives, release planning, and post-release validation.
  • Coordinate with developers and configuration admins to validate Salesforce configuration, automation, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flow, APIs, security, integrations, reporting, and user experience changes against business and technical requirements.
  • Direct end-to-end testing across Salesforce and connected enterprise systems, including API, middleware, data synchronization, event-driven, batch, contact center, document management, identity, reporting, and downstream integration scenarios where applicable.
  • Establish and maintain regression testing practices that support reliable Salesforce releases, including core business process coverage, high-risk process coverage, automation candidates, release impact analysis, and reusable test assets.
  • Lead defect management activities, including defect logging, prioritization, triage, root cause analysis, retest coordination, closure validation, trend analysis, and communication of quality risks and release impacts.
  • Define and monitor quality metrics such as test coverage, defect leakage, escaped defects, regression pass rate, automation coverage, test execution progress, test data readiness, and release quality indicators.
  • Partner with release management and DevOps teams to support CI/CD validation, deployment verification, smoke testing, change control, rollback planning, environment readiness, and release signoff activities.
  • Coordinate test data management for Salesforce initiatives, including data setup, masking or privacy considerations, migration validation, reconciliation, data quality checks, and repeatable test data preparation.
  • Support compliance, privacy, security, accessibility, and auditability expectations by ensuring test coverage includes role-based access, field-level security, sharing, least-privilege access, data protection, reporting accuracy, and regulatory considerations.
  • Lead production validation and support root cause analysis for quality-related incidents, defects, integration failures, data issues, access issues, automation errors, regression gaps, and user-reported Salesforce issues.
  • Coach and mentor QA team members, analysts, developers, and configuration admins on quality practices, test case design, acceptance criteria, test automation opportunities, defect quality, risk-based testing, and agile QA discipline.
  • Maintain and improve QA documentation, including test strategy, test plans, test cases, automation notes, traceability, release validation checklists, defect reports, QA standards, and support handoff materials.
  • Continuously assess Salesforce platform releases, AppExchange changes, testing tools, automation frameworks, and QA practices to recommend improvements that increase test reliability, reduce manual effort, and improve delivery velocity.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

What you need to succeed:

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Five to seven years of quality assurance, quality engineering, or software testing experience with significant experience testing Salesforce platform solutions in enterprise environments.
  • Demonstrated experience leading QA execution for agile/scrum teams or pods supporting a mix of project delivery, enhancements, configuration, integration testing, regression testing, and operational support work.
  • Experience testing Salesforce Sales Cloud and Service Cloud capabilities, including business process validation, configuration validation, integration validation, security/access testing, reporting validation, and release readiness testing.
  • Strong knowledge of Salesforce platform testing practices, including functional testing, regression testing, integration testing, end-to-end testing, user acceptance testing support, production smoke testing, and release validation.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration and administration concepts, including objects, fields, page layouts, Lightning record pages, flows, validation rules, approval processes, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing rules, reports, and dashboards.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce development and technical capabilities, including Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL, Salesforce Flow, APIs, platform events, and integration patterns, with the ability to design appropriate test coverage for technical changes.
  • Ability to direct QA work across QA analysts, developers, analysts, and configuration admins, ensuring clear test planning, work breakdown, sequencing, estimation, dependency management, and delivery accountability.
  • Strong understanding of agile/scrum delivery practices, including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily standups, sprint reviews, retrospectives, definition of ready, definition of done, and test execution management.
  • Ability to interpret business requirements, technical designs, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, data mappings, and integration specifications and translate them into effective test scenarios and test cases.
  • Experience with test management, defect management, traceability, test evidence, test reporting, QA metrics, and quality risk communication to technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of risk-based testing and the ability to prioritize test coverage based on business impact, technical complexity, user impact, integration risk, production defect history, and release scope.
  • Experience validating Salesforce security and access models, including profiles, permission sets, role hierarchy, sharing rules, field-level security, object permissions, auditability, and least-privilege access expectations.
  • Experience testing integrations between Salesforce and internal or external systems using secure and governed approaches, including data synchronization, API-led, event-driven, batch, and middleware-based patterns.
  • Experience with test automation concepts and the ability to identify automation candidates, collaborate on automation frameworks, review automated test coverage, and balance automated and manual testing approaches.
  • Experience supporting CI/CD and release management practices, including deployment validation, environment readiness, source control awareness, build verification, change control, release signoff, and post-deployment verification.
  • Knowledge of Salesforce data concepts, including standard and custom objects, relationships, data quality, test data management, data migration validation, data reconciliation, and reporting accuracy.
  • Experience troubleshooting Salesforce defects and quality issues, including automation errors, integration failures, configuration defects, user access issues, data problems, regression gaps, and environment-related concerns.
  • Ability to develop and maintain QA documentation such as test strategies, test plans, test cases, regression suites, defect reports, traceability matrices, release validation checklists, and support handoff materials.
  • Ability to mentor and coach QA team members and cross-functional delivery team members on testing discipline, acceptance criteria quality, defect quality, regression practices, and continuous quality improvement.
  • Ability to partner effectively with product owners, business stakeholders, scrum masters, analysts, architects, technical leads, developers, configuration admins, security, integration, data, release management, and operations teams.
  • Knowledge of regulated environment expectations, including privacy, auditability, data protection, accessibility, retention, secure access, protected information handling, and evidence-based validation practices.
  • Proficient communication and presentation skills for technical and non-technical audiences, including the ability to explain quality risks, test progress, release readiness, defect trends, and delivery impacts clearly.
  • Comfortable working in agile/scrum delivery models and able to operate within waterfall, hybrid, or governance-driven processes when required.

The extras:

  • Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Business Information Systems, Quality Engineering, or a related field.
  • Salesforce certifications such as Administrator, Platform App Builder, Sales Cloud Consultant, Service Cloud Consultant, Experience Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer I, or other Salesforce certifications that demonstrate platform knowledge.
  • Quality or agile certifications such as ISTQB, Certified ScrumMaster, Professional Scrum Master, SAFe, Agile Tester, or similar certification.
  • Experience supporting Salesforce in a regulated enterprise environment, preferably healthcare, insurance, financial services, or another environment with strong privacy, auditability, accessibility, and data protection requirements.
  • Experience with Experience Cloud, Financial Services Cloud, Data Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Agentforce/Einstein capabilities, OmniStudio, or other Salesforce cloud capabilities relevant to customer/member-facing and internal service workflows.
  • Experience with Salesforce test automation, regression automation, API testing tools, CI/CD pipeline validation, test management tools, defect management tools, and reusable test asset management.
  • Experience testing data migrations, ETL processes, data quality remediation, integration workflows, and reconciliation across Salesforce and enterprise systems.
  • Experience working in a global delivery model or with blended internal, vendor, and offshore QA and development teams.

Location:
BCBSRI is headquartered in downtown Providence, conveniently located near the train station and bus terminal. We actively support associate well-being and work/life balance and offer the following schedules, based on role:

  • In-office: onsite 5 days per week
  • Hybrid: onsite 2-4 days per week
  • Remote: onsite 0-1 days per week. Permitted to reside in the following states, pending approval from the Human Resources Department: Arizona, Connecticut, Florida, Georgia, Louisiana, Massachusetts, North Carolina, Oklahoma, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Virginia

Our culture of belonging at Blue Cross & Blue Shield of Rhode Island (BCBSRI) is at the core of all we do, and it strengthens our ability to meet the challenges of today’s healthcare industry. BCBSRI is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: QA Manager
job.description:
About Knotch

Knotch is redefining the future of websites in the age of AI.

The way people discover, engage with, and consume content is fundamentally changing. Customers now find information and make decisions through AI, increasingly with an agent acting on their behalf. Most brand digital presences were never built for this journey. Knotch is the AI-native infrastructure that closes that gap, giving brands the ability to meet every customer, and every agent, with the right experience at the right moment, and to adapt as fast as AI and consumer behavior keep changing.

Our platform combines content intelligence, measurement, and agentic AI to show enterprises what content works, continuously optimize their sites, and deliver measurable business outcomes. At the center is ACE (Agentic Content Engine), which moves brands beyond static websites toward intelligent, adaptive ones that keep improving.

We work with some of the world’s most recognizable companies. Our culture is fast-paced, entrepreneurial, and highly adaptable. We move quickly, test ideas, and evolve with our customers. We’re looking for exceptional people who want to help shape how leading brands show up in an AI world.

About the role

We are looking for an exceptionally skilled hands-on QA Manager to join our engineering team. This person will be responsible for managing the automation suites across all products in a fast-paced environment. Creating, maintaining, executing scripts during regression, smoke, and sanity in various environments. In your first year, you will have built out our testing frameworks from scratch and have hired a QA team to help us in those efforts!

Responsibilities

  • Hands-on automation development that is AI native
  • Managing an offshore QA team and building out a US team as needed
  • Creating automated test and validation processes of APIs on cloud services
  • Building comprehensive test suites that will be utilized by overall engineering and product organizations
  • Recommending and maintaining appropriate frameworks to automate test scenarios
  • Define testing and evaluation strategies for AI-powered features, including regression testing, output quality, reliability, edge cases, and non-deterministic behavior
  • Analyzing and reporting on test automation progress
  • Performing manual, exploratory and performance testing
  • Analyzing test results, performing RCAs and file tickets as necessary in JIRA
  • Establishing test automation code coverage metrics
  • Collaborating closely with our product manager, project manager (agile), and software engineers to define best practices for testing our applications (both internal and external facing)

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of QA engineering experience, including 2+ years leading or managing a test automation team
  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and agents for test automation
  • Strong expertise in automation tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Watir, HeadSpin or similar
  • Proven ability to define tool strategy and build scalable test automation frameworks from the ground up
  • Experience writing scalable, reusable test scripts and running them in an Agile/Scrum environment
  • Solid experience with manual and automated API testing, including Postman
  • Experience setting up CI/CD pipelines and integrating automated tests into them
  • Practical experience with source control systems (e.g., Git)
  • Familiarity with AWS, GCP or similar cloud platforms, and working knowledge of SQL
  • Excellent communication and mentorship skills, with experience leading distributed teams

How to be Successful

  • Builder mentality: you’re energized by starting from zero. You can stand up frameworks, processes and a team from scratch without waiting for a playbook.
  • Hands-on and leading at the same time: you’re as comfortable writing and debugging automation scripts as you are mentoring engineers and setting direction for the team.
  • AI-native problem solving: you reach for AI tools and agents first to speed up test creation and maintenance, and you know how to test AI features whose outputs can change from run to run.
  • Quality as a mindset, not a phase: you push testing earlier in the development cycle and help engineering and product teams own quality alongside you.
  • Root-cause curiosity: you don’t stop at “it’s broken.” You dig into the “why,” run thorough RCAs and turn what you learn into lasting process fixes.
  • Data-driven reporting: you track coverage, defect trends and automation progress, and you use those numbers to show impact and guide decisions.
  • Pragmatic prioritization: in a fast-paced environment, you balance coverage, speed and risk. You know what to automate, what to test by hand and what can wait.
  • Precision and attention to detail: you catch the edge cases others miss and won’t sign off on a release until you trust the results.
  • Clear communication across time zones: you keep an offshore team aligned and productive, and you explain quality risks so non-technical stakeholders understand them.
  • Voice your opinions: how can we make our products, releases and engineering practices better based on what testing shows you?

Nice to Have

  • Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • QA or testing certifications (e.g., ISTQB) or cloud certifications (AWS/GCP)
  • Experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, k6, Locust)
  • Eastern Time Zone location for easier collaboration with the team and offshore partners

Why Join Knotch

You will be the founding leader of quality at Knotch, building our testing frameworks, automation suites and QA team from the ground up. Your work will shape how every product is built, tested and released, so our engineering and product teams can ship faster and with confidence. You’ll work with AI-native tools, cloud-based products and a talented team that values ownership, precision and impact.

The expected salary range for this opportunity is $136,000-163,000 CAD depending on skills and experience.

Our Benefits and Perks

Knotch is a fully remote company. Candidates may work from anywhere within Canada, with Eastern time zone preferred, through our employer of record. Some of our other great benefits include:

  • Comprehensive health benefits through our employer of record (EOR) relationship with Globalization Partners
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 10+ company-paid holidays
  • Wellness and work-from-home perks
  • Company and team offsites
  • A daily company-wide break, and more!

job.title: Director of Quality Engineering
job.description:
At Sword, we’re building AI to heal billions and unlock humanity’s full potential. In doing so, we’re pioneering AI Care, a fundamentally new approach to healthcare built for medical reasoning, safety, and real-time treatment, not generic technology applied after the fact. As both a clinical-centric frontier AI lab and an applied AI platform, Sword is reimagining how care is delivered at scale, removing traditional barriers like appointments, waiting rooms, and stigma so more people can access the care they need—and ultimately get back to lives lived in full.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. More than 700,000 members across three continents have completed over 10 million AI sessions, helping 1,000+ enterprise clients avoid more than $1 billion in unnecessary healthcare costs. Backed by 42 clinical studies, 44+ patents, and more than $500 million raised from leading investors including Khosla Ventures, General Catalyst, and Founders Fund, Sword is defining a new standard for healthcare.

AI Proficiency at Sword

AI fluency is a core expectation at Sword. Every candidate is assessed against our three-level framework — be ready to share real examples of how AI is already part of how you work.

  • Explorer (Level 1) — Uses AI daily to boost personal productivity

  • Builder (Level 2) — Creates workflows and tools that elevate the whole team

  • Integrator (Level 3) — Embeds AI into products and processes at scale

Every hire must demonstrate at least Level 1. The expected level will vary depending on the seniority of the role.

Role

We are looking for an experienced Director of QARA (Engineering) to define and lead our end to end quality strategy across our Software as a Medical Device (SaMD) software, AI/ML, and connected-device products. Reporting to the VP of QARA, you will own how we build confidence in what we ship, from test automation and release readiness to verification and validation evidence that satisfies regulators. You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and AI teams to make sure we can move fast and stay compliant.

What you’ll be doing

  • Help set the vision for quality in software/AI engineering across web, mobile, backend, firmware/hardware integration, and AI, where quality becomes a natural output of well-designed processes.
  • Own software verification and validation (V&V) strategy for Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), ensuring rigorous, bi-directional traceability from requirements and risk controls through to test evidence.
  • Help define how AI/ML systems are tested and monitored: model performance validation, dataset quality, bias and robustness testing, regression across model versions, and post-deployment drift and performance monitoring.
  • Embed quality into the SDLC: shift-left practices, CI/CD quality gates, automated regression, performance, security, and accessibility testing, with release processes that are fast and auditable.
  • Work within QARA to keep engineering processes aligned with the Quality Management System and serve as a technical authority during audits by notified bodies and authorities.
  • Drive risk-based thinking, working with product and clinical teams on risk analysis, hazard mitigation, and verification of risk controls under ISO 14971.
  • Evaluate and introduce tooling for test management, automation, and automated traceability, balancing build vs. buy.

What you need to have

  • 7+ years in software quality engineering, with 5+ years leading quality organizations (managers and ICs) in a regulated environment.
  • Hands-on experience with medical device software or comparable regulated domains, including working knowledge of IEC 62304, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, ISO/IEC 42001, IEC 81001-5-1 and FDA 21 CFR Part 820 / QMSR and/or EU MDR.
  • Proven track record building and scaling test automation and CI/CD quality practices across multiple product teams.
  • Experience defining V&V strategies and producing evidence that stood up to audits or regulatory submissions.
  • Strong technical credibility: able to review architectures, test frameworks, and code, and to coach engineers.
  • Demonstrated people management capability, with a proven track record as a Team Lead or manager directly hiring, mentoring, and steering technical quality teams.
  • Excellent communication and influence skills, with the ability to work with executives, engineers, clinicians, and regulators.

Job Description:

Epiq is looking for an experienced Senior QA Automation Engineer to help ensure the quality and reliability of our cloud-based applications.

This is a hands-on quality engineering role for someone who has strong experience with automated software testing, understands how modern web applications and APIs are tested, and can work closely with developers throughout the software development lifecycle.


You will help design and execute automated and manual testing strategies, identify issues before they reach production, and continuously improve how we approach software quality.


What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, maintain, and execute automated test suites for web-based applications.
  • Build and maintain automation using tools such as Selenium, SilkTest, CodedUI, QTP/UFT, or comparable test automation frameworks.

job.description:
We are Skyward.

That is, a love for people, for improvement, for human advancement through information technology. We are a people-centered business with a desire to serve others. We are diverse and unified; creative and collaborative; a collection of complementary, not competing talents. And though on the surface we remain relaxed, beneath, a torrent of energy links us to our civic tech mission.
We stand by our values, and we won’t compromise on any of them.
Integrity: We’re conscientious, intentional, and empathetic. Our words and actions align. That’s our character. Please don’t ask us to play another part, we’re poor actors.
Compassionate: If we may borrow a quote from Theodore Roosevelt: “No one cares how much you know until they know how much you care.” Because our team is thoughtful and supportive, caring deeply for each other, our clients, and our work, this comes naturally.
Inquisitive: We remain students by failing openly and turning lessons into solutions.
Unconventional: For us, life isn’t what happens outside of work. Work happens inside of life and our culture erases the line often dividing the two.
Authentic: Made possible only because we embody the values listed above. We’re relaxed and fun yet intensely curious and driven. Team members are placed with thought, care, and precision to ensure that Trust, Truth, and Transparency continue to represent our brand.
Because of that, we continue Onward, Upward, and Skyward.

We need an Automation Test Engineer.Are you the kind of person who can’t look at a machine learning model without wanting to test it six different ways (and then automate all six)? Do your friends sigh when you bring up responsible AI? Maybe they’ve stopped asking what you do for work because the last time you went on a 20-minute tangent about bias in training data and flaky CI pipelines for neural nets.

If that sounds familiar, you might be exactly who we’re looking for.

Come join us if you're motivated to learn from others, to learn from mistakes, to be part of a future-looking and growth-oriented team.

Let's go Skyward together.

What you’ll do:

  • Be part of a team supporting the development of an AI/ML platform that will leverage generative AI to relieve user burden across the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).
  • Design and maintain robust, scalable automated test frameworks for web apps, APIs, and AI-driven features.
  • Develop automated pipelines for model validation, bias detection, and drift monitoring in ML-based systems.
  • Define and execute test plans that include functional, regression, performance, and AI-specific testing strategies.
  • Partner with AI/ML engineers to create test datasets and simulate real-world user behavior and edge cases.
  • Implement CI/CD-integrated quality gates to ensure AI releases meet defined reliability and fairness metrics.
  • Mentor junior engineers and help establish best practices in intelligent automation and AI testing.
  • Advocate for ethical AI standards and contribute to cross-functional discussions about responsible AI.

What we'd like you to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in software QA/automation engineering, with at least 1 year focused on AI/ML product testing.
  • Strong proficiency in at least one automation framework (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and scripting language (Python preferred).
  • Hands-on experience with testing AI models, including validation metrics, dataset versioning, and model explainability.
  • Familiarity with tools like MLflow, TensorBoard, or similar for AI observability.
  • Understanding of model bias, fairness audits, and compliance considerations in government or regulated environments.
  • Experience working in Agile DevSecOps environments with modern CI/CD tooling (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab, etc.).
  • Strong collaboration skills with a knack for clear communication across engineering, data science, and product teams.

What would blow us away:

    • You’ve previously supported the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).
      • Even if you don’t meet 100% of the qualifications, we encourage you to apply. At Skyward, we’re focused on hiring individuals with the right skills and passion to grow, not just checking off every box.

And now the important part. What we offer you:

  • 15 days of paid leave
  • 7 days of sick leave
  • 2 days bereavement leave
  • 11 paid Federal holidays
  • Up to 40 hours for jury duty
  • 401K with 4% employer contribution (and no vesting period)
  • Up to 4 weeks of paid paternity and maternity leave
  • Company provided laptop
  • $5,000 per year for professional development
  • $600 per year for technical supplies and equipment
  • $2,000 referral bonus
  • Life and disability insurance
  • HSA and FSA
  • Legal Shield and ID Shield Voluntary Benefits
  • Opportunity to work in a collaborative, motivated team focused on modernizing government services with cutting-edge technology and innovative solutions. Who says government work can't be exciting!

job.description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    HighLevel is looking for a Sr. SDET with 5+ years of experience to play a crucial role in ensuring the quality, performance, and scalability of our products. We are seeking engineers who thrive in a fast-paced startup environment, enjoy problem-solving, and stay updated with the latest models and solutions. This is a great opportunity to work on cutting-edge performance testing strategies and contribute to the success of our products.

Responsibilities:

  • Performance baselines for critical services: SLIs, SLOs, and latency, throughput, and error-rate targets, plus workload models built from production traffic and real customer behaviour
  • A shared performance testing framework and production-like environments (Kubernetes and cloud, test data included) that product-team SDETs can use without starting from scratch, and the evaluation of new tools through PoCs
  • Automated performance regression checks in CI/CD, with trend reports that catch regressions before release
  • Load, stress, soak, and spike testing, and capacity planning ahead of peak events
  • Root cause analysis of bottlenecks across API, database, queue, and frontend layers, using traces, metrics, logs, and profiling, in partnership with development, DevOps, and infrastructure teams
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, microservices architecture, concurrency, rate limiting and common performance bottlenecks
  • Ability to interpret performance metrics, translate findings into actionable engineering recommendations, and influence technical decisions across engineering teams
  • Supervise and mentor junior team members and contribute to capability building initiatives to raise the performance bar across the team

Requirements:

  • 5+ years in performance, scalability, or reliability engineering or testing, with examples of finding and fixing bottlenecks in production-scale systems
  • Hands-on experience with at least one modern load-testing tool (k6, Gatling, or Locust), including realistic workload modeling and distributed load generation, and strong programming skills in Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, or Java
  • Experience using observability tooling (for example New Relic, Prometheus/Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to isolate root cause across API, database, and queue layers, with a solid grasp of REST service performance, concurrency, and caching
  • Experience integrating performance tests into CI/CD pipelines with pass/fail thresholds
  • Working knowledge of Kubernetes and at least one major cloud (GCP, AWS, or Azure) to deploy and debug test environments

Nice to Have:

  • Runtime profiling and thread or heap analysis on the JVM or Node.js (GC behavior, event-loop lag)
  • Frontend performance experience: Core Web Vitals, Lighthouse, real user monitoring
  • Experience applying AI-assisted tooling to test design or result analysis
  • Experience with NoSQL or search datastores and message brokers at scale
  • Chaos or resilience testing, and safe testing in production (canaries, shadow traffic)

job.title: Senior Manager QA Engineering
job.description:
Overview

The Senior QA Engineering Manager leads quality engineering strategy and execution across one or more product portfolios, owning both the technical direction of test automation and the people leadership of a QA engineering organization. This leader partners closely with engineering, product, and delivery teams to embed quality throughout the software lifecycle, builds and scales high-performing automation and QA team — including offshore and distributed talent — and drives a zero-defect culture through rigorous metrics, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement. The role blends hands-on technical leadership in test automation architecture, CI/CD, and AI-based testing with senior people-management responsibilities such as hiring, coaching, and career development.

Responsibilities

Quality strategy and automation leadership

  • Define and own the test automation strategy across multiple products and portfolios, architecting scalable API-first and UI automation suites built on shared, reusable test libraries.
  • Guide teams to evaluate and adopt new tools and technologies - including AI-based test automation frameworks, and RPA - to provide faster feedback to development teams.
  • Establish the test strategy covering data management, pre-production/staging environments, system integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Drive CI/CD practices and cloud-based tooling (Azure/AWS) across the QA function.
  • Oversee Quality Corrective Action Board (CAB) and Zero-Defect Planning (ZDP) processes; track defect leakage and lead root cause analysis (RCA) to continuously improve test coverage.
  • Actively participate in sprint planning and estimation, providing effort and timeline estimates for automation and QA deliverables to support predictable, on-time releases.
  • Define and report key quality metrics — including functional and automation test coverage, defect density, and test execution velocity — to drive data-driven quality decisions.

Team leadership and people management

  • Lead, coach, and grow a team of QA and automation engineers and QA leads — including offshore and distributed staff — fostering an inclusive, high-performing culture.
  • Own hiring, onboarding, performance management, career development, and retention for the QA engineering organization.
  • Set clear goals, provide regular feedback, and manage team knowledge-building and cross-training across key applications.
  • Act as a change agent, championing quality ownership and continuous improvement across the QA program.

Cross-functional partnership and reporting

  • Partner with product management, engineering, delivery, and operations to translate roadmap priorities into achievable, quality-driven engineering plans.
  • Develop effective relationships with key stakeholders — product owners, agile managers, business analysts, delivery teams, and technical working groups.
  • Produce sprint-level activity reports and quality metrics for senior management; support release-readiness reporting and relevant New Product Development (NPD) phases.
  • Communicate technical strategy, quality status, risks, and tradeoffs clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 12 or more years of overall IT/software experience, including 10 or more years leading automation or QA engineering teams and 5 or more years of direct people management.
  • Strong hands-on experience in Java and exposure to Python, with proven ability to architect and scale automation suites spanning API test automation (primary) and UI test automation, built on shared, reusable test libraries.
  • Proficiency with RestAssured, TestNG, Playwright, and BDD-Cucumber, along with CI/CD tooling such as Jenkins, Gitlab, Nexus, and Maven.
  • Experience with AI-based test automation and applying AI-driven development lifecycle (AIDLC) practices to accelerate test design, execution, and maintenance.
  • Exposure to AWS cloud technologies and modern DevOps practices.
  • Experience in healthcare, payer, or other regulated, data-intensive domains, including deidentified, HIPAA-compliant test data practices; US healthcare and EDI (e.g., X12/HIPAA transactions) knowledge is a plus
  • Familiarity with data analytics platforms or machine learning systems is a plus.
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodology and quality management best practices.

Skills and competencies

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to influence a wide range of audiences and win support without formal reporting authority.
  • Strong organizational skills and adaptive to rapidly changing priorities and workloads.
  • Comfortable partnering with remote and distributed team members across the US, India, and other geographies, within a matrixed organization.
  • Results-oriented, empowering leader with strong emotional intelligence and a demonstrated ability to coach and develop talent.
  • Innovative and self-motivated, with a strong sense of urgency and quality ownership.
  • Exhibits behaviours consistent with Cotiviti values: Customer Driven, Accountability, Open, Collaborative.

job.title: Product Quality Engineer
job.description:
About Menlo
Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role
Asimov gets built at scale on someone else's line. As Product Quality Engineer, you are Menlo's quality owner at our contract manufacturer, responsible for the final assembly and test of the robot from the first trial build through mass production. You make sure what comes off the CM line matches what our engineers designed, every unit, at rate.
You will own process yield, define and enforce final inspection criteria, and run the customer side of quality at the EMS partner. You will live in the phase gates, EVT, DVT, PVT, and into MP, catching the defects, drift, and process gaps that decide whether a ramp succeeds or stalls. This role sits between our design teams and the factory floor, and holds both to the standard.

What You'll Do

  • Own final assembly and test quality at the CM (Tier-1 / EMS), from trial production through mass production

  • Drive process yield: monitor first-pass yield and defect rates at each station, run the analysis, and lead the CM to close the gaps

  • Define, document, and maintain final inspection criteria, including inspection standards, limit samples, workmanship standards, and pass/fail criteria for the line

  • Own the customer inspection and acceptance process: OQC, outgoing quality gates, AQL sampling plans, and lot disposition before shipment

  • Represent Menlo through the NPI phase gates (EVT, DVT, PVT), driving build readiness, defining test coverage at final assembly and test, and signing off on quality exit criteria for each phase

  • Lead root cause analysis and corrective action on line failures and test escapes, using structured methods such as 8D, fishbone, and 5-whys, and verify the fix holds

  • Set up and audit the CM's process controls: FAI, in-process inspection, SPC on critical parameters, and change control on the line

  • Manage non-conformance at the CM: MRB, containment, rework and sorting decisions, and disposition of held material

  • Track and report quality metrics (yield, DPPM, defect Pareto, RTY) and drive continuous improvement reviews with the CM

  • Partner with mechanical, electrical, firmware, and manufacturing engineering to feed field and line failures back into design and process

What We Look For

  • 3 or more years in a product, supplier, or manufacturing quality role owning final assembly and test at a contract manufacturer or EMS partner

  • Direct experience taking a product through NPI phase gates (EVT / DVT / PVT) and into mass production

  • Strong command of yield analysis and defect reduction, and the discipline to chase a failure to its real source rather than its symptom

  • Hands-on ownership of final inspection and outgoing quality: inspection criteria, AQL sampling, limit samples, and lot acceptance

  • Fluency in core quality tools and methods: 8D, FMEA, SPC, control plans, FAI, and MRB / non-conformance handling

  • Comfort reading mechanical drawings and GD&T, electrical schematics, and test specs across a complex electromechanical product

  • Strong communication and influence skills to hold a CM accountable while keeping the ramp moving, working across engineering, manufacturing, and the supplier

  • Willingness to travel to and work on-site at manufacturing partners

Nice to Have

  • Experience with robotics, automotive, aerospace, medical devices, or other high-reliability electromechanical products

  • Experience managing quality at CMs in the region (for example Vietnam, China, or elsewhere in Asia)

  • Familiarity with quality systems and standards such as ISO 9001, APQP, PPAP, and IPC-A-610

  • Motor, actuator, or drivetrain assembly and test quality experience

  • Experience defining final assembly and test (FATP) test coverage and station-level test strategy

  • Scripting for quality data analysis and automation, for example Python or SQL

  • Experience standing up CM quality processes from near-zero at an early-stage hardware company

Why Join Menlo
You will own the quality of a humanoid robot as it moves from a handful of hand-built prototypes to real production volume, the phase where most hardware companies either learn to ship or quietly stall. You will define the inspection standards and yield discipline for a product that has to move in the real world, not pass a bench check, and you will hold both our engineers and our factory to them. On a small team, your sign-off is what stands between a design and a shippable robot.

A Note on AI

You don't need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect everyone at Menlo to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement. When that's the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don't treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity and Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you're excited about a role but don't meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Menlo Research is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Menlo provides reasonable accommodations during the application process. If you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Since 2020, Sword has expanded across physical therapy, women’s health, cardiometabolic, and mental health, and is now moving beyond the session to a fully AI-native, 24/7 care program that brings physical activity, therapeutic exercise, psychotherapy, nutrition, and behavior change into one connected experience. job.title: Quality Assurance Manager, International
job.description:
We're so happy you're here! Thank you for checking our job out and we hope to have the chance to meet you in our interview process!

About the role

We are hiring for our first dedicated international quality hire at Grüns. You'll own the quality system for every market outside the US: product release, specifications, complaints and adverse events, incident management, contract manufacturer oversight, stability, and transit qualification. For products sold in the EU, you'll build and run the Quality Management System processes that keep us compliant with EU and local market requirements across the product lifecycle.

Today these responsibilities sit informally with the US QA team. The job is to figure out where they should live, build the processes, and then run them. You'll work across Regulatory, Supply Chain, Operations, and our external manufacturing and 3PL partners, and you'll be the escalation point when something goes wrong in an international market.

Location:

While this role is part of our global remote HQ, we feel a candidate based in or around Germany or the United Kingdom will be most successful in this role.

The team members you’ll be working with most are in multiple countries and time zones, so we ask that you are comfortable working a way that allows for some overlap in working hours to collaborate.

More generally, we operate in a fully remote, high trust environment with teammates across multiple countries and time zones. While we work async by default, we come together in person twice a year for offsites that help us connect, align, and build real relationships IRL.

In this role, you will:

  • Release finished products only after verifying specs, COAs, manufacturing docs, deviations, and market-specific requirements
  • Own consumer complaint intake and triage across level 1, 2, and 3
  • Build and run traceability, recall/withdrawal, mock recall, complaint, adverse-event, and food safety incident processes for EU products
  • Own supplier and contract manufacturer qualification: Quality Agreements, audits, CAPAs/SCARs, deviations, change controls, investigations, ongoing performance monitoring
  • Run BMT testing and oversee microbiological, chemical, allergen, contaminant, nutritional, and stability testing, including OOS/OOT investigations and third-party labs
  • Assess quality and regulatory risk on any formulation, ingredient, supplier, process, spec, packaging, or labeling change before it ships. Even a packaging color update can get held at customs in markets like China without sign-off
  • Partner with Regulatory Affairs to keep formulations, specs, labels, claims, and packaging compliant by market
  • Own quality oversight of international manufacturing, packaging, warehousing, and distribution partners, including 3PLs
  • Set and monitor international quality KPIs and keep us audit-ready

We're looking for someone who:

  • Has a minimum of 5 years of quality assurance experience in food, beverage, dietary supplement, or consumer health, with meaningful time spent on products sold outside the US
  • Has hands-on EU and international quality experience. You've managed quality processes for food, dietary supplement, or consumer health products sold in the EU and across multiple regulatory jurisdictions, and you understand how quality and regulatory requirements differ by market
  • Has working knowledge of EU food and food supplement quality requirements, including GMP and food safety requirements, HACCP, traceability and recall, allergen management, specifications, supplier and contract manufacturer controls, analytical testing, stability, change control, product release, and labeling and claims oversight. Experience across multiple EU member states is a strong plus
  • Has real depth in core quality systems: you've owned CAPAs, investigations, root cause analysis, specification creation, document control, and change control, not just participated in them
  • Has qualified, audited, and managed external manufacturers and co-packers, and held them to account
  • Has owned or contributed materially to a recall, withdrawal, or market action, and knows what good looks like under pressure
  • Is comfortable owning stability protocols and managing third-party labs
  • Can work across US, UK/EU, and Asia time zones with a distributed team and external partners

Approach to the role:

  • You treat documentation as protection, not paperwork
  • You catch the small stuff, like a packaging color change, before it turns into a blocked shipment
  • You build with scale in mind, since we're small today and growing internationally fast
  • You bring high ownership and don't need to be micromanaged to move fast

Compensation & Benefits:

At Grüns, we are committed to offering a competitive total compensation package grounded in market data and aligned to our size, stage, industry, and geographic location. Compensation for this role will be benchmarked to the local market and may vary based on experience and country of hire. In addition to base compensation roles include a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance.

A bit about us...

At Grüns, we believe that foundational nutrition should be simple and convenient for everyone. We're dedicated to bringing comprehensive and real nutrition to you through our gummies, formulated from 60 nutrient-dense and whole-food ingredients. Simply enjoy a grab-and-go snack pack of gummies daily whenever fits best in your schedule and wherever life takes you.

Like you, we were disappointed. There’s an infinite number of “nutrition” companies, all focused on what’s best for them — not what’s best for you. Hundreds of products to sell you on, low-quality ingredients, and small nutrient doses. We’ve seen it all.

So we decided it was time to fix it. No more choking on and popping pills like a pharmacy. No more clean-up and disgust from gross powders. And no more cobbling together handfuls to dozens of supplements. Grüns is comprehensive nutrition, made convenient and delicious.

What we care about...

Be the Best: We hold ourselves, our teams, and our partners to an incredibly high standard - and we raise the bar constantly. "We've never done this before" isn't an excuse here. It's an invitation.

Own It: We act like our name is on the door. That means taking complete ownership of outcomes, collaborating deeply, working through roadblocks - not around them - and never waiting for someone else to solve the problem. Great owners are great partners.

Drive Impact, Urgently: We measure impact, not effort. We work smart and hard, move fast, and use every tool at our disposal - including AI - to focus our energy where it matters most.

Compensation & Perks:

For every role, we aim to have highly competitive compensation and opportunity for impact and career growth.

Everyone at Grüns works hard, but we believe in wellness and balance too. We have super strong benefits coverage -- for you and your family, generous PTO, free Grüns, and a few more perks centered around health and well-being that we can't wait to tell you about!

Who we are

Our customers — like Johnson & Johnson, GSK, Bristol Myers, UBS, FINRA and the US Navy — are using our software to solve some of the most important challenges in the world, such as developing new medicines, securing our financial markets, or protecting our country. Backed by Sequoia Capital, Coatue Management, NVIDIA, Snowflake and other leading investors, we have been in business for a decade but are still a small team operating with the spirit of a startup. Especially in the world of AI today, we believe that the future is still being invented — and we want to be the ones building it. For more information, visit www.domino.ai

What we are building

The Automation Team at Domino acts as a force multiplier for engineering, building the tools and systems that enable teams to ship code confidently and consistently. A core part of this mission is Tempest, an in-house platform that orchestrates realistic, long-duration workloads against live Kubernetes clusters and validates the results against real observability data. Today, when scale testing surfaces a bottleneck, a resource misconfiguration, or a regression in system behavior, the team can identify and report the issue — but we need someone who can take the next step: profiling services, tracing root causes through Prometheus and New Relic data, and partnering with platform engineers to drive durable fixes. Focused on iteration and continuous improvement, the team looks for targeted enhancements that create outsized impact, and this role will close the gap between detection and resolution at the infrastructure level.

What your impact will be

In your first year, you will:

  • Serve as the technical owner of Tempest, Domino's scale and reliability platform, ensuring it remains reliable, extensible, and aligned with evolving infrastructure needs
  • Diagnose and drive resolution of performance bottlenecks and resource misconfigurations surfaced by scale testing — working directly with platform and infrastructure teams to ship fixes, not just file tickets
  • Deliver accurate, data-driven sizing recommendations for customer-facing documentation based on rigorous empirical testing across deployment sizes
  • Strengthen observability across scale testing by improving Prometheus and New Relic instrumentation, making it faster to pinpoint root causes during and after multi-day load runs
  • Establish and operationalize scale testing on cloud platforms, ensuring appropriate sizing and configuration guidance for this increasingly divergent product line
  • Partner with platform teams to enable effective scale and reliability testing across additional cloud providers, helping position Domino for future multi-cloud success
  • Increase the efficiency and leverage of a small team by building infrastructure automation that scales operationally as the product and customer base grow

What we look for in this role

  • Background in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure with hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting distributed systems in production Kubernetes environments
  • Strong proficiency in Python and comfort working in a large, modular codebase that spans orchestration, infrastructure automation, and systems integration
  • Experience with observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic, or similar) — writing queries, building dashboards, and using metrics to diagnose performance and reliability issues at the systems level
  • Demonstrated ability to go beyond detection to resolution: profiling services, identifying resource bottlenecks, and working with engineering teams to ship durable fixes
  • Familiarity with performance and load testing methodologies (e.g., Locust, k6, or similar) as part of a broader infrastructure or reliability practice
  • Clear ownership mindset — self-directed, accountable, and able to communicate priorities and status effectively in a remote, async environment

What we value

  • We value a growth mindset. High-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and see the opportunities for success
  • We believe in individuals who seek truth and speak the truth and can be their whole selves at work
  • We value all of you that believe improving is always possible At Domino Everything is a work in progress – we can do better at everything

Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. The role

Airworthiness is a system-level requirement. We cannot certify an aircraft if the launcher or the control link hasn’t been rigorously de-risked. This role professionalizes our Ground-Side Engineering, moving our failure rate from the expensive flight-test phase to the low-cost laboratory phase. It is an investment in crash prevention and regulatory compliance.

The day-to-day

· Pre-Flight De-risking: Executing high-repetition "burn-in" tests on all new firmware and hardware configurations for the Ground Control Station and data links .

· Launch System Validation: Engineering tests for mechanical launch systems to ensure repeatable, safe exit velocities and structural integrity .

· The "Iron Bird" Connection: Acting as the link to the IRB Team by maintaining a ground-based "Iron Bird" to test system-wide reactions to simulated component failures .

· Regression Library: Building a library of ground-side edge cases and failure cases that must be passed before any new sub-system is cleared for flight integration .

· Documentation of Proof: Generating technical "De-risking Reports" and managing relevant testing cards in JIRA .

You should apply if you

· Infrastructure & GSE Mastery: Deep technical understanding of Ground Control Stations (GCS), pneumatic/mechanical launchers, tracking antenna arrays, and ruggedized power and control systems.

· HIL/SIL Setup: Experience building and maintaining Hardware-in-the-Loop (HIL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) environments to simulate flight triggers on the bench.

· Environmental & Stress Testing: Competence in vibration, thermal, and EMI (Electromagnetic Interference) "torture tests" on supporting hardware to ensure field survivability.

· Diagnostic Tooling: Skilled in the use of oscilloscopes, spectrum analysers, and network protocol analysers to perform root-cause analysis on ground-side hardware failures.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

job.title: Test Engineer - Environmental
job.description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

The role

As an Environment Test Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, execution, and analysis of environmental stress test campaigns across the full range of Interceptor sub-systems and Ground Support Equipment (GSE). As a generalist within the Environmental Cluster, you will apply your knowledge to mechanical, thermal, and environmental qualification—across multiple hardware domains. The Environmental Cluster is the "Physical Reality" team within the Test Department. Where other clusters validate functionality, the Environmental Cluster validates survivability and performance under real-world stress.

The cluster is organized around domain specialists—Launch Systems, Ground Communication Systems—but requires a generalist backbone to ensure test coverage continuity across all sub-systems, absorb campaign overflows from specialist engineers, and extend the cluster's capability into emerging and sensitive hardware domains.

The day-to-day

  • Vibration & Shock Campaigns: Designing and executing vibration test campaigns (sine sweep, random vibration, shock) on drone sub-systems and GSE hardware to simulate transport, operational, and launch-induced dynamic environments.
  • Thermal Soak & Cycling: Executing controlled thermal exposure tests across the full operational temperature range on any sub-system assigned by the Head of Testing or cluster lead.
  • IP & Ingress Testing: Executing dust and water ingress tests on drone enclosures, connectors, and GSE hardware to validate field survivability.
  • Humidity, Salt Spray & Corrosion: Running humidity-controlled and salt-spray campaigns to identify corrosion risks in connectors, structural joints, and electronic housings.
  • Altitude Simulation: Validating component behaviour under simulated low-pressure conditions relevant to the operational altitude range of the drone.
  • Fatigue & Endurance: Running high-cycle mechanical campaigns to characterize material and joint fatigue over the required operational life of any assigned sub-system.
  • Failure Mode Boundary Testing: Deliberately pushing hardware beyond its design limits to physically map the failure envelope and validate safety margins across all assigned sub-systems.

You should apply if you

  • Environmental Standards Literacy: Working knowledge of applicable standards as the primary frameworks for environmental test campaign design and execution.
  • Instrumentation & DAQ: Expert in physical instrumentation—strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, and load cells. Ability to configure and operate DAQ systems across a wide range of test scenarios.
  • Mechanical Systems Understanding: Solid understanding of structural mechanics, material fatigue, vibration dynamics, and shock response for both metallic and composite structures.
  • Thermal Testing: Experience with thermal chambers, thermal cycling rigs, IR cameras, and thermocouple mapping.
  • Environmental Test Equipment Operation: Hands-on experience operating vibration tables, shock rigs, thermal chambers, IP spray equipment, and salt-spray cabinets.
  • Metrology: Proficient with precision measurement tools (load frames, calipers, torque meters, dimensional gauges) for pre- and post-test validation.
  • Awareness of ITAR/EAR export control obligations when handling test data and reports related to lethality hardware.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing UAV's, UAS' or Rockets.
  • Bachelor's degree (B.Sc. or B.Eng.) in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Direct experience with environmental chamber operation, vibration testing, and physical instrumentation is mandatory.
  • Prior exposure to defense, dual-use, or regulated hardware in a test context is strongly preferred.
  • Basic familiarity with Weapons Hardware Constraints: Understanding of the physical and regulatory constraints that govern the environmental testing of defense-related hardware.
  • Experience in an aerospace or defense environment operating under ITAR/EAR or equivalent national defense export control frameworks is an advantage.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 

  • Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one

job.title: Senior SDET - Framework Team
job.description:
Senior SDET

Are you looking to impact and be part of something special, such as shaping the future of healthcare? Do you take pride in building and maintaining robust test automation frameworks? Are you passionate about improving deployment processes for high-impact products?

Boxes ticked? If so, read on.

At Semble, we are on a mission to enable health professionals to amplify their impact. We improve the way healthcare is delivered to millions of people by providing doctors and their teams with powerful, innovative, intuitive, and secure software. Our cloud-based clinical system is already used by thousands of clinicians, making their lives easier and saving them money, while structuring their health data to help research.

We are a passionate and driven team, lucky to unite under strong cultural drivers:

  • Impact - We do work that matters.
  • Collaboration – We are in it together.
  • Human touch – We care deeply.

This role can be fully remote in the UK and EU (with occasional travel to our London office) within +/- 2 hours of the GMT time zone. We are unfortunately not able to consider candidates located outside these locations and time zones at this stage.

What you will be doing

The Senior SDET, Frameworks role will lead the evolution of Semble’s test automation capability and help make quality a shared engineering discipline. You will:

  • Lead the transformation towards a Quality Agent System, using AI agents and deterministic automation to continuously identify coverage gaps, generate and maintain tests, detect flaky tests, support exploratory testing, and surface reproducible defects.
  • Design safe, maintainable agent workflows with clear responsibilities, isolated execution, human review, and appropriate controls. Agents should assist engineers and SDETs, not replace human judgement or merge their own changes.
  • Establish the foundations required for this system, including a stable Playwright framework, reliable CI integration, ephemeral test environments, test data management, quality observability, and structured test knowledge.
  • Set up meaningful quality gates in CI and PR workflows, including coverage validation, framework conventions, high-risk code checks, and actionable failure reporting.
  • Rationalise our overcrowded E2E suite by identifying tests that belong at unit, API, or integration level, keeping E2E focused on critical user journeys.
  • Build and maintain a cross-layer coverage map and risk-based defect view, helping teams understand where quality gaps exist and where automation investment will have the greatest impact.
  • Expand test coverage and surface quality gaps earlier in the development lifecycle, including through test scenario generation, mutation testing, and AI-assisted exploratory testing.
  • Conduct proof-of-concepts for non-functional testing, including performance, accessibility, security, and reliability testing.
  • Contribute to company-wide quality strategy, tooling decisions, quality metrics, and shift-left adoption alongside the wider SDET and Engineering teams.
  • Coach engineers and SDETs on effective test design, the testing pyramid, Playwright, and contributing to the shared framework.

What we are looking for

At a Senior level at Semble, we will expect you to be mostly autonomous in your scope and to own and solve complex tasks or lead projects independently. You will work with peers from different functions and have an impact across department. You may be in a mentoring role for more junior team members and should be able to influence effectively and lead by example throughout the company.

  • 5+ years of professional experience as SDET or Test Automation Engineer
  • A strong track record of designing, building, and evolving automation frameworks that are reliable, maintainable, and easy for engineers to adopt.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-augmented or agentic quality workflows, not only using tools such as Cursor or Claude to generate test code.
  • A pragmatic approach to AI adoption, with awareness of data privacy, security, clinical safety, cost, and false-positive risks.
  • Strong commercial experience with TypeScript-based automation frameworks. Playwright experience is highly desirable.
  • Experience with test coverage strategy and applying the testing pyramid to reduce unnecessary E2E testing.
  • Experience with write unit, component, API and integration tests.
  • Experience with performance testing tools, such as k6, is desirable.
  • Knowledge of non-functional testing, including performance, accessibility, security, and reliability.
  • Exposure to DevOps tools and cloud infrastructure, including Jenkins, Bitbucket, Datadog, and AWS.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the confidence to represent the SDET function, challenge assumptions, and defend quality in release discussions.

What you’ll get in return

  • The great feeling coming with knowing you do something that matters: shaping the future of healthcare!
  • £65-75k package (based on your experience and the value you can bring)
  • Autonomy and ownership – we’ll set the vision and share the context, then we trust you to run with things – that’s the reason we hire you!
  • 36 days off: 25 holidays +bank holidays +3 extra days (birthday and ‘feel good’ days) - that we will expect you to actually take so you can recharge and rest.
  • Private Health Insurance – covering physical and mental health, as well as dental and optical!
  • Get the tech you need - You will get the latest MacBook (unless you prefer Windows) and take your pick across a wide range of equipment to set up your home office ergonomically.
  • Work alongside an inspiring team – our two founders have started Semble after a successful startup exit, and your future colleagues are all knowledgeable and innovators in their field.
  • Fantastic office space in Central London, right outside Monument - with a roof terrace, weekly animations, loads of natural light, and cute doggies!
  • The usual free bits coming with nice offices (barista coffee, tea, fruits, happy hours and activities.
Salary: £75,000

About us

Rentman is a B2B SaaS scale-up building a smart, powerful operations management platform to support event and media production teams. Our users plan everything from small shoots to massive festivals in 70+ countries, and they all rely on Rentman to keep their gear, people, and timing perfectly in sync. Check out our public roadmap to see what’s coming next!

Mission of this role

Thousands of rental companies run their business on Rentman, and many of them depend on it talking smoothly to the rest of their stack: accounting packages, webshops, calendars, and our public API. When an integration breaks, invoices don’t sync, bookings go missing, and customers notice fast.

As Senior QA Specialist for the Integrations team, you make sure every release reaches those customers without regressions. You own the team’s test strategy and lead the move from manual release-day testing to an automated, shift-left suite. This is a role with real ownership: you shape how the team thinks about quality, and you grow the practice as our integrations platform grows.

What you'll do

  • Join refinement with the Integrations team and write Gherkin (Given/When/Then) acceptance specs that developers turn into tests

  • Test new integrations and API changes end to end: our side, the partner’s side, and everything that can go wrong between them (auth, rate limits, partial syncs, retries, data mapping)

  • Explore beyond the acceptance criteria to find edge cases, and file clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira

  • Build and maintain automated tests in TypeScript, with API and contract tests alongside Playwright E2E tests, and review the tests developers write in pull requests

  • Own the daily automated regression run in GitHub Actions: triage failures the same day and fix flaky tests at the root cause, including ones caused by unreliable third-party sandboxes

  • Run release-day regression and the OWASP ZAP security scan, and give a clear go / no-go call

  • Coach developers so they own their tests, and organise QA days with the other product teams

     

What we are looking for

  • 5+ years in QA on web applications

  • Hands-on experience testing REST APIs and integrations with external systems (Postman, Playwright API testing or similar), including authentication flows like OAuth and webhooks

  • At least 2 years writing and maintaining test automation in code (Playwright, Cypress or Selenium, ideally TypeScript/JavaScript), not only record-and-play tools
