job.title: Tax Software QA & Support Analyst
job.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.

A Different Kind Of Job Description

At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.

What's hard about this job

Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.

Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.

The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.

It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.

Why it might be the best career move you'll make

You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.

Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.

You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.

We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.

What You'll Own

  • Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use

  • Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away

  • Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox

  • Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving

  • Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases

  • Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread

Your Hard Skillset

  • Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team

  • Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk

  • A tax background, either at a tax or accounting firm, at a tax software company, or preparing returns yourself. You don't need to be a preparer, but you should know your way around a return.

  • Familiarity with at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem

  • Bonus if you've used Linear or Jira, browser developer tools or screen recording to capture issues

Your Soft Skillset

  • Methodical: you change one thing at a time until you find what breaks

  • Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion

  • Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did

  • Calm and patient with customers who are under deadline pressure

  • You take ownership and follow a problem through to the fix

Who This Suits

  • People who enjoy hunting down a problem more than answering the same question twice

  • Support professionals who want to move into QA and product

  • Tax professionals who want to move into tech without leaving their expertise behind

How We Pay

Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone sees everyone else's salary, and compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone at the same level receives the same three offers.

This role is assessed at Level 1. The salary and equity bandings are:

  • Most Equity: $66,000 per year + $100,020 of equity

  • Great Equity: $72,000 per year + $66,680 of equity

  • Good Equity: $78,000 per year + $33,340 of equity

We run performance reviews every four months, so strong work is recognized quickly.

Benefits

  • Platinum-level medical insurance, fully covered for you, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well

  • Dental insurance

  • Vision insurance

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

  • A minimum of 30 days of paid holiday every year

  • Your choice of the latest and greatest computers, plus a budget for your home office setup

  • Company-wide offsites every four months

The process

  • Quick intro call (30 minutes)

  • Bug reproduction exercise: we give you a real-style customer report, you reproduce the issue and write the ticket (60 minutes)

  • Final round with Rachel and the team (60 minutes)

About Filed

Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms. It works inside the software firms already use, and takes on the work surrounding the accountant so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and their clients. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog and Raine.

job.description:
Job Title: Associate Director, Quality Assurance & Governance

Job Location: Remote, USA

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

About This Role

The Associate Director, Clinical Quality & Compliance (CQC), serves as a strategic quality leader within R&D Quality & Compliance (RDQC), providing oversight, guidance, and expertise to support the effectiveness of the Quality Management System (QMS) across Research, Development, and Medical (RD&M).

This role is responsible for driving a culture of quality and compliance through leadership of Vendor Quality Governance activities, Functional Quality Representation (FQR) for clinical studies, quality risk management, investigations, CAPA oversight, inspection readiness, and continuous improvement initiatives. The Associate Director partners closely with cross-functional stakeholders to proactively identify quality risks, implement sustainable solutions, and ensure compliance with applicable global regulatory requirements and industry standards.

The incumbent plays a critical role in protecting study participants, preserving scientific integrity, and ensuring the quality and reliability of clinical data throughout the development lifecycle.

** While this is a remote-based role, it is strongly preferred that the employee is located within either the Eastern or Central Time Zones. **

What You’ll Do

  • Serve as the Clinical Quality & Compliance representative for assigned studies, programs, and functional areas, providing expert guidance on quality and compliance matters.

  • Support the development, maintenance, and continuous improvement of the Quality Management System by driving quality governance, process enhancement, and compliance initiatives.

  • Lead quality oversight activities for clinical studies and programs, including Study Risk Assessments (SRAs), quality health assessments, trend analyses, and risk mitigation planning.

  • Provide strategic leadership and consultation to study teams and functional stakeholders on GCP requirements, quality standards, and regulatory expectations.

  • Lead and approve investigations related to deviations, non-conformances, protocol compliance concerns, and other GCP-regulated quality events.

  • Oversee root cause analysis, CAPA development, implementation, and effectiveness verification to ensure sustainable issue resolution and continuous improvement.

  • Drive Vendor Quality Governance activities, including vendor qualification, performance oversight, quality risk assessments, issue management, and remediation activities.

  • Partner with vendor quality representatives and internal stakeholders to ensure vendor compliance with global regulations, industry standards, and contractual quality obligations.

  • Support internal audits, sponsor audits, investigator site audits, and regulatory inspections through preparation, risk assessment, response management, and inspection readiness activities.

  • Identify emerging compliance risks and recommend proactive mitigation strategies that strengthen quality performance and organizational readiness.

  • Lead cross-functional quality improvement initiatives that enhance operational effectiveness, inspection readiness, and regulatory compliance.

  • Monitor quality trends and metrics, providing insights and recommendations to support informed decision-making and continuous quality improvement.

Who You Are

You are a strategic and collaborative quality professional with deep expertise in clinical development, GCP compliance, and quality systems. You are comfortable operating independently, influencing cross-functional stakeholders, and providing practical solutions to complex quality and compliance challenges. You excel in risk-based decision making, foster strong partnerships across functions, and are passionate about advancing a culture of quality that supports both patient safety and business objectives. You bring strong leadership, analytical thinking, and communication skills, along with a commitment to continuous improvement and operational excellence.

Required Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in a scientific, healthcare, or related discipline.

  • Minimum 10 years of experience in Clinical Operations, Clinical Quality, Compliance, Quality Assurance, or related pharmaceutical/biotechnology functions.

  • Extensive knowledge of Good Clinical Practice (GCP) regulations and global clinical development requirements, including FDA regulations, ICH guidelines, and applicable international regulations.

  • Demonstrated experience supporting quality oversight within clinical development programs and studies.

  • Experience leading investigations, root cause analyses, CAPA development, implementation, and effectiveness verification.

  • Strong understanding of Quality Management Systems (QMS), risk management principles, quality metrics, and continuous improvement methodologies.

  • Experience supporting regulatory inspections, sponsor audits, and internal audit activities.

  • Experience with vendor oversight and Vendor Quality Governance activities.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making skills.

  • Excellent written, verbal, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Proven ability to influence without authority and effectively collaborate across multiple functions and organizational levels.

  • Ability to independently manage competing priorities while maintaining a high level of quality and attention to detail.

  • Clinical trial systems and process expertise required.

Preferred Skills

  • Master's degree or other advanced degree in Life Sciences, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Healthcare, or a related discipline.

  • Regulatory inspection management experience.

  • Experience serving as a Functional Quality Representative (FQR) for clinical studies.

  • Experience with Study Risk Assessments, quality governance frameworks, and quality-by-design methodologies.

  • Experience leading cross-functional quality transformation or process improvement initiatives.

  • Prior leadership, coaching, or mentoring experience strongly preferred.

  • Location within either the Eastern or Central Time Zones strongly preferred.

Why Biogen?

Our mission to find therapies for neurological and rare diseases is a unique focus within our industry and this shared purpose is what connects us as a team. We work together to overcome obstacles and to follow science. We are resilient as we strive to make an impact on our patients’ lives and on changing the course of medicine. Together, we pioneer. Together, we thrive.

Job Level: Management

Additional Information

The base compensation range for this role is: $148,000.00-$204,000.00

Base salary offered is determined through an analytical approach utilizing a combination of factors including, but not limited to, relevant skills & experience, job location, and internal equity.


Regular employees are eligible to receive both short term and long-term incentives, including cash bonus and equity incentive opportunities, designed to reward recent achievements and recognize your future potential based on individual, business unit and company performance.


In addition to compensation, Biogen offers a full and highly competitive range of benefits designed to support our employees’ and their families physical, financial, emotional, and social well-being; including, but not limited to:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, & Life insurances
  • Fitness & Wellness programs including a fitness reimbursement
  • Short- and Long-Term Disability insurance
  • A minimum of 15 days of paid vacation and an additional end-of-year shutdown time off (Dec 26-Dec 31)
  • Up to 12 company paid holidays + 3 paid days off for Personal Significance
  • 80 hours of sick time per calendar year
  • Paid Maternity and Parental Leave benefit
  • 401(k) program participation with company matched contributions
  • Employee stock purchase plan
  • Tuition reimbursement of up to $10,000 per calendar year
  • Employee Resource Groups participation

Why Biogen?

We are a global team with a commitment to excellence, and a pioneering spirit. As a mid-sized biotechnology company, we provide the stability and resources of a well-established business while fostering an environment where individual contributions make a significant impact. Our team encompasses some of the most talented and passionate achievers who have unparalleled opportunities for learning, growth, and expanding their skills. Above all, we work together to deliver life-changing medicines, with every role playing a vital part in our mission. Caring Deeply. Achieving Excellence. Changing Lives.


At Biogen, we are committed to building on our culture of inclusion and belonging that reflects the communities where we operate and the patients we serve. We know that diverse backgrounds, cultures, and perspectives make us a stronger and more innovative company, and we are focused on building teams where every employee feels empowered and inspired. Read on to learn more about Biogen.

Deine Rolle als Consultant

Davon profitierst du direkt, etwa durch frühen Zugang zu neuen Produkten und den Austausch mit UiPath-Expert:innen. Responsibilities

Highly skilled and experienced Automation Test Engineer with a strong background in both functional and automation testing of Salesforce applications built using OmniStudio and Lightning Web Components (LWC). The position will play a critical role in ensuring quality across the development lifecycle. This role places a strong emphasis on in-sprint automation, enabling rapid feedback and continuous delivery within Agile teams. Additionally, the position involves API testing for complex insurance applications, using tools like SoapUI and Postman to validate integrations and ensure seamless data flow across systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain robust, scalable, and reusable automated test scripts for Salesforce applications using tools such as Selenium, Java, Cucumber, and Playwright
  • Utilize AI capabilities for self-healing locators, test data generation, and root cause analysis
  • Utilize AI-powered testing tools to improve manual and functional testing efficiency by enabling automated test case generation based on business requirements and user workflows, capturing test evidence without manual intervention, auto-generating automation scripts wherever feasible, and intelligently identifying scenarios that require manual execution
  • Collaborate closely with developers, product owners, and QA team members to implement in-sprint automation, ensuring test coverage is aligned with sprint goals and delivered within sprint timelines
  • Perform manual and functional testing to validate new features, identify edge cases, and ensure comprehensive test coverage where automation is not feasible
  • Lead the planning and execution of functional, regression, integration, end-to-end and API testing across multiple platforms and environments
  • Develop and execute API test cases using tools like SoapUI and Postman to validate service integrations and data accuracy
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous testing and faster feedback loops
  • Analyze test results, identify root causes of failures, and work with development teams to resolve issues efficiently
  • Maintain and manage test environments, test data, and automation frameworks to support ongoing testing needs
  • Maintain the automation regression suites based on continuous enhancements or new features implemented
  • Mentor junior QA engineers and contribute to best practices in test automation and quality assurance
  • Explore/Innovate stable automation solutions to automate complex applications (Ex: salesforce)

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or other related field, or equivalent work experience

With thousands of dedicated professionals across an extensive network of over 60 offices around the world, we lead by offering innovative solutions that are at the forefront of the industry. job.title: Support & QA Specialist, Tax
job.description:
This role is fully remote, open to candidates based anywhere in the United States outside New York, with a preference for the Pacific or Mountain time zones. Based in New York? Apply to the New York posting of this role instead.

A Different Kind Of Job Description

At Filed, we believe in radical transparency. Everything is open: company finances, team salaries, stock options, anonymous team feedback. That extends to how we talk about this job. So instead of a list of perks, we'll start with what's genuinely hard about it, then tell you why it might be the best move you'll make.

What's hard about this job

Bugs don't arrive with instructions. A customer tells you "it didn't work." Your job is to work out exactly what they did, with which return, in which tax software, and make it happen again on your own screen. If you can't reproduce it, engineering can't fix it.

Your ticket is the fix's starting point. Engineers will build from what you write. Vague steps mean days of back and forth while a firm waits. You'll need to be precise every time.

The pace is fast. Our customers are tax firms in their busiest weeks. When something breaks, they need an answer today, and a workaround while the real fix is built.

It isn't fixed until you've checked. You'll retest every fix before telling a customer it's resolved, and you'll recheck after releases that nothing else broke.

Why it might be the best career move you'll make

You'll sit between customers and engineering. Few roles see both sides this clearly. You'll learn how real firms use tax software, and how software actually gets built.

Your work ships. A bug you reproduce on Monday becomes a fix every firm on Filed benefits from. A workaround you find saves a firm hours the same day.

You'll grow as fast as we do. Filed is adding millions of dollars of revenue every quarter, and the support and QA function is still small. People who start here move into QA, product and engineering-adjacent roles.

We've raised $17.2 million to date, led by Northzone, and we work with tax firms across the country, from regional practices to some of the biggest names in the profession.

What You'll Own

  • Reproducing customer-reported issues step by step, inside Filed and the tax software firms already use

  • Writing clear, complete Linear tickets with exact steps, expected versus actual results, screenshots and sample data, so engineers can act straight away

  • Answering customer tickets quickly and clearly in our support inbox

  • Troubleshooting technical issues and finding workarounds that keep firms moving

  • Verifying fixes before they go back to the customer, and regression testing after releases

  • Spotting patterns across tickets and flagging them before they spread

Your Hard Skillset

  • Hands-on QA or software testing experience: you've reproduced bugs and written them up for an engineering team

  • Customer support experience in a ticketing system such as Pylon, Zendesk, Intercom or Freshdesk

  • A tax background, either at a tax or accounting firm, at a tax software company, or preparing returns yourself. You don't need to be a preparer, but you should know your way around a return.

  • Familiarity with at least one major tax platform, such as CCH Axcess, UltraTax, Lacerte, ProConnect, Drake or GoSystem

  • Bonus if you've used Linear or Jira, browser developer tools or screen recording to capture issues

Your Soft Skillset

  • Methodical: you change one thing at a time until you find what breaks

  • Clear writing: your tickets and replies leave no room for confusion

  • Curious: you want to know why something broke, not just that it did

  • Calm and patient with customers who are under deadline pressure

  • You take ownership and follow a problem through to the fix

Who This Suits

  • People who enjoy hunting down a problem more than answering the same question twice

  • Support professionals who want to move into QA and product

  • Tax professionals who want to move into tech without leaving their expertise behind

How We Pay

Nothing at Filed is behind closed doors. Everyone sees everyone else's salary, and compensation isn't a negotiation. Depending on your location, everyone at the same level receives the same three offers.

This role is assessed at Level 1. The salary and equity bandings are:

  • Most Equity: $66,000 per year + $100,020 of equity

  • Great Equity: $72,000 per year + $66,680 of equity

  • Good Equity: $78,000 per year + $33,340 of equity

We run performance reviews every four months, so strong work is recognized quickly.

Benefits

  • Platinum-level medical insurance, fully covered for you, with 100% coverage for your dependents as well

  • Dental insurance

  • Vision insurance

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Paid maternity and paternity leave

  • A minimum of 30 days of paid holiday every year

  • Your choice of the latest and greatest computers, plus a budget for your home office setup

  • Company-wide offsites every four months

The process

  • Quick intro call (30 minutes)

  • Bug reproduction exercise: we give you a real-style customer report, you reproduce the issue and write the ticket (60 minutes)

  • Final round with Rachel and the team (60 minutes)

About Filed

Filed is the AI tax preparer trusted by America's accounting firms. It works inside the software firms already use, and takes on the work surrounding the accountant so tax professionals can spend their time on judgment, advice and their clients. We're backed by Northzone, Neo, Analog and Raine.

job.description:
Application close date:

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the requisition is closed.

At Blue Origin, we envision millions of people living and working in space for the benefit of Earth. We’re working to develop reusable, safe, and low-cost space vehicles and systems within a culture of safety, collaboration, and inclusion. Join our team of problem solvers as we add new chapters to the history of spaceflight! 

Blue Origin is pioneering the future of space-based connectivity with TeraWave, a revolutionary satellite communications network designed to deliver symmetrical data speeds of up to 6 Tbps anywhere on Earth. This network will service tens of thousands of enterprise, data center, and government users who require reliable connectivity for critical operations.

Job Description

Blue Origin is seeking a Principal ASIC Test Engineer to lead production test strategy for RF, mmWave, and mixed-signal integrated circuits within Silicon Systems.

This individual contributor role serves as the technical lead for final test of mmWave front-end ICs and converter-intensive ASICs, with focus on RF/mmWave performance, high-speed ADC and DAC testing, manufacturability, and cost of test.

The role leads test engagement with manufacturing and OSAT partners and mentors internal test engineers supporting front-end IC and digital beamformer programs.

Special Mentions

- Relocation provided

- Travel expected up to 15% of the time

- Interviews will include a technical assessment

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Define wafer sort and final test strategies, coverage targets, and production release criteria for RF and mixed-signal devices.
  • Develop and optimize ATE tests for RF signal chains, frequency conversion, PLLs, clocking, and high-speed ADCs and DACs.
  • Establish test approaches for packaged RF devices, including antenna-in-package calibration, fixture design, and correlation to laboratory measurements.
  • Partner with design and DFT teams to improve test access, observability, and production test efficiency during development.
  • Lead technical work with foundry, manufacturing, and OSAT partners on probe and final test implementation, throughput, and failure analysis.
  • Mentor test engineers and provide test domain guidance across front-end IC and digital beamformer programs.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field and 10 years of semiconductor test experience.
  • Experience developing wafer sort and final test programs on production ATE platforms, including Advantest V93000.
  • Demonstrated experience with RF or mmWave testing and high-speed ADC and DAC testing.
  • Experience taking test programs from silicon bring-up through manufacturing release with external partners.
  • Experience resolving yield and test correlation issues with foundry and OSAT manufacturing partners.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree or PhD in Electrical Engineering or a related field.
  • Experience with phased arrays, antenna-in-package designs, beamforming, or multichannel RF devices.
  • Knowledge of RF and converter measurements, including linearity, noise, dynamic range, phase noise, jitter, ENOB, and SFDR.
  • Experience optimizing multisite test configurations, test time, and overall cost of test in production.
  • Proficiency in Python, C, Java or similar languages for test automation and production data analysis.

Base Pay Range for:

CA applicants is $269,175.00 - $376,843.95

Other site ranges may differ


Culture Statement

Don’t meet all desired requirements? Studies have shown that some people are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single desired qualification. At Blue Origin, we are dedicated to building an authentic workplace, so if you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every desired qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.


Export Control Regulations

Applicants for employment at Blue Origin must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e. current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Background Check

  • Required for all positions: Blue’s Standard Background Check
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Defense Biometric Identification System (DBIDS) background check if at any time the role requires one to be on a military installation
  • Required for Certain Job Profiles: Drivers who operate Commercial Motor Vehicles with a Gross Vehicle Weight (GVW), Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) or combination of power unit and trailer that meets or exceeds 10,001 lbs. and/or transports placardable amounts of hazardous materials by ground in any vehicle on a public road while in commerce, may be subject to additional Federal Motor Carrier Safety Regulations including: Driver Qualification Files, Medical Certification (obtained before onboarding), Road Test, Hours of Service, Drug and Alcohol Testing, vehicle inspection requirements, CDL requirements (if applicable) and hazardous materials transportation/shipping training.
  • Required for certain Job Profiles: Ability to obtain and maintain Merchant Mariner Credential, which includes pre-employment and random drug testing as well as DOT physical

Benefits

  • Benefits include: Medical, dental, vision, basic and supplemental life insurance, paid parental leave, short and long-term disability, 401(k) with a company match of up to 5%, and an Education Support Program.
  • Stock Options for all regular employees (working at least 20 hours/week)
  • Paid Time Off: Up to four (4) weeks per year based on weekly scheduled hours, and up to 14 company-paid holidays.
  • Dependent on role type and job level, employees may be eligible for benefits and bonuses based on the company's intent to reward individual contributions and enable them to share in the company's results, or other factors at the company's sole discretion. Bonus amounts and eligibility are not guaranteed and subject to change and cancellation. Please check with your recruiter for more details.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Blue Origin is proud to be an Equal Opportunity/Affirmative Action Employer and is committed to attracting, retaining, and developing a highly qualified and dedicated work force. Blue Origin hires and promotes people on the basis of their qualifications, performance, and abilities. We support the establishment and maintenance of a workplace that fosters trust, equality, and teamwork. We provide all qualified applicants for employment and employees with equal opportunities for hire, promotion, and other terms and conditions of employment, regardless of their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin/ethnicity, age, physical or mental disability, genetic factors, military/veteran status, or any other status or characteristic protected by federal, state, and/or local law. Blue Origin will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Washington Fair Chance Act, the California Fair Chance Act, the Los Angeles Fair Chance in Hiring Ordinance, and other applicable laws. For more information on “Know Your Rights,” please see here.


Affirmative Action and Disability Accommodation

Applicants wishing to receive information on Blue Origin’s Affirmative Action Plans, or applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation in order to participate in the application and/or interview process, please contact us at . At TELUS Health, this role will bring the selected individual incomparable expertise in retirement calculation verification and pension plan administration on the Canadian and American market. In less than a year at TELUS Health, you will be able to gain incomparable diversity—something even seasoned professionals with years of experience in pension plan administration at our competitors cannot match.

We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. TELUS is proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to fair employment practices and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities, as required, during the recruitment process.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test, Android
job.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Android platform team is responsible for building Okta's Android Apps and SDKs. Okta Verify is a mobile app that allows users to securely access their apps via 2-step verification, ensuring that they, and only they, can access their app accounts. It integrates deeply with Android system features, communicating with our backend to grant proper application access across a wide variety of Android devices.

We are looking for an experienced Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join the Android platform team. The team is responsible for developing and maintaining Okta Verify and associated SDKs across the Android ecosystem (phones, tablets, and wearable devices). 

In this role, you will report to the Manager, Quality Assurance and be responsible for robust, secure releases and test automation of the Okta Verify application and SDKs on the Android platform. You will also be responsible for developing test scripts, building and expanding the test automation framework, and working collaboratively with application developers to execute tests, log, track, and validate test results.

Responsibilities

Technical Leadership

  • Define and own the Android test automation strategy and framework architecture for Okta Verify and its SDKs.
  • Mentor and technically guide engineers across quality and development teams; write and review designs and code in Java/Kotlin with colleagues of varying seniority.
  • Establish and drive quality metrics, including test coverage, flakiness rates, and CI pipeline health, holding teams accountable to targets.
  • Partner with Security to define and execute security and privacy test coverage for Android authentication flows.
  • Represent quality in architecture and design reviews for new Okta Verify app and SDK features.
  • Define and communicate quality plans for the Android platform and dependency scrum teams.

Testing and Automation

  • Design and build structured test automation frameworks using Espresso, UI Automator, and Jetpack Compose testing tools using Kotlin.
  • Develop and maintain high-quality functional, regression, performance, and end-to-end tests for Okta Verify across diverse Android form factors and OS versions.
  • Validate bug fixes and recommend product improvements across Android OS versions to ensure seamless user experiences for major and minor Android/Google operating system updates.
  • Leverage CI/CD tools (e.g., CircleCI, GitHub Actions), cloud device testing platforms (e.g., Digital.ai, Sauce Labs, BrowserStack), JIRA, XRay, and ADB tools to identify and raise quality issues with development teams in a timely manner.
  • Collaborate with product management, software development, and cross-functional teams using JIRA and Confluence to define test plans grounded in business requirements and application software designs.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of software test automation experience for Android mobile applications, with 3+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining Android UI test automation frameworks.
  • Proficiency in developing Android test tools and scripts using Kotlin and Java.
  • Experience defining test strategy at a platform or product-area level, leading release testing, and managing complex product issues.
  • Experience building and maintaining Mobile CI/CD pipelines (e.g., CircleCI, GitHub Actions, Bitrise).
  • Hands-on experience with core Android testing tools and frameworks (Espresso, UI Automator, JUnit, AndroidX Test).
  • Experience with collaboration and test management tools like JIRA, Confluence, and XRay.
  • Experience with scripting languages like Python, Bash/Shell, etc.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Android security and hardware-backed features (Android Keystore system, StrongBox, BiometricPrompt API, TEE).
  • Experience with cloud device testing platforms (e.g., Digital.ai, Bitbar, BrowserStack, Firebase Test Lab).
  • Experience testing Jetpack Compose UI elements.

Education

  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields preferred.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer, ASIC Simulation
job.description:
What if your Python automation caught a critical ASIC bug before the physical silicon was even manufactured? At NVIDIA, our simulation platforms make that happen every release cycle! We are the System Ethernet QA Team at NVIDIA's R&D center, responsible for the testing and qualification of virtual networking silicon (SimX) and software—from L2 forwarding and L3 routing to overlays, QoS, and security. With SimX, developers and QA engineers get hardware-free, early access to the ASIC for better debugging.

We are looking for a Senior QA Software Engineer who combines network protocol expertise with strong Python automation skills. Does debugging a BGP EVPN route leak excite you as much as refactoring a test framework? Then we should talk!

What you'll be doing:

We don't just complete checklists; we collaborate closely with R&D to lead the quality of new features from design to deployment. In this role, we:

  • Review architectural designs and requirements for new features introduced to the product

  • Drive the design, development, and execution of tests across functional, performance, and security scopes as part of SW GA and update releases

  • Develop Python automation suites built on clean OOP principles

  • Chase down defects and validate fixes until we fully resolve the root cause

  • Leverage the SimX platform to validate code and debug the ASIC long before hardware arrives.

What We Need to See:

  • Combined network engineering depth with thorough software habits

  • 5+ years of hands-on QA or networking experience, backed by CCNP-equivalent protocol knowledge: L2 (VLAN, STP), L3 (BGP, OSPF), EVPN, VXLAN, and advanced features like PFC, ECN, RoCE, and QoS

  • Production-quality Python engineering—specifically, strong OOP design and hands-on experience with Pytest

  • Deep Linux proficiency (at an LPIC-1 or LPIC-2 level) to navigate system internals, analyze logs, and debug effectively

  • Clear verbal and written communication, with professional proficiency in written and spoken English

  • B.Sc. or or B.A. or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a similar background.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • Experience with Docker and traffic generation tools (Ixia, TRex, Scapy)

  • Hands-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitLab CI)

  • Working knowledge of virtualization platforms (KVM, VMware).

NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

job.description:
About AudienceView

AudienceView is a leading event commerce platform serving over 2,100 organizations across 12 countries. The company helps live event organizations grow audiences, increase revenue, and streamline operations through an integrated ecosystem of ticketing, CRM, marketing, and commerce solutions.

With more than 20 years of industry experience, AudienceView supports performing arts organizations, sports teams, higher education institutions, festivals, and entertainment venues worldwide.

About the Role

AudienceView is expanding its engineering organization to support several strategic modernization initiatives and product refactoring projects. We are looking for experienced Quality Engineers who are passionate about automation, quality advocacy, and leveraging modern testing practices, including AI-assisted testing and development tools.

As a Senior Quality Engineer, you will play a key role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and quality of highly scalable web applications used by thousands of organizations worldwide.

What You'll Do

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable automation frameworks
  • Build and execute automated test suites for web applications and APIs
  • Perform manual and automation testing across functional, non-functional, exploratory, integration, and regression scenarios
  • Partner closely with Software Engineers, Product Managers, and stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle
  • Automate API testing using tools such as Postman
  • Test mobile applications as part of the overall quality strategy
  • Support release management and quality validation activities
  • Identify defects, investigate root causes, and collaborate with engineering teams to resolve issues
  • Promote quality best practices across the organization
  • Leverage AI-assisted tools to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, documentation, and quality processes

Must-Have Skills

  • 5+ years of Quality Engineering experience, combining manual and automation testing
  • Strong experience with Selenium WebDriver (or similar automation tools)
  • Strong experience with JavaScript and Java
  • Strong API testing experience
  • Mobile testing experience
  • SQL experience
  • Experience testing applications built with Node.js and React
  • Quality-first mindset
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills

AI-Assisted Development & Testing Experience

AudienceView is actively adopting AI-powered engineering workflows. You should have practical experience using tools such as Claude Code.

We are looking for professionals who have used AI tools to support automation development, test generation, debugging, documentation, quality analysis, or engineering productivity.

Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience with Playwright or Cypress in addition to Selenium
  • Python or C# experience
  • Performance testing with JMeter
  • Cloud experience (Azure preferred)
  • Ticketing, SaaS, or e-commerce platform experience
  • Experience supporting modernization or platform migration initiatives

Why Join AudienceView

AudienceView is a global leader in event commerce and ticketing technology, helping organizations create meaningful live-event experiences for millions of customers worldwide.

You'll join a team focused on innovation, modernization, AI adoption, and delivering high-quality software that powers some of the world's leading live-event organizations.

This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working remotely with a collaborative, international engineering team.

About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Testing Analyst to support a large-scale digital transformation initiative. This role will focus on User Acceptance Testing (UAT), quality assurance, defect management, business readiness, training development, deployment support, and post-implementation stabilization.

The successful candidate will work closely with Product Owners, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), business stakeholders, and project teams to validate system functionality, ensure requirements are met, and support successful user adoption.

The role will also leverage approved AI and Generative AI tools to improve testing efficiency, documentation, training development, knowledge transfer, and quality assurance while ensuring appropriate human review, privacy, security, and governance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and execute test scenarios, test scripts, and test cases based on business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.

  • Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT), functional testing, regression testing, enhancement testing, end-to-end testing, and retesting.

  • Identify, document, track, prioritize, and validate defects through resolution.

  • Maintain testing documentation, execution records, traceability, test results, and status reporting.

  • Support integration testing, data migration validation, and business process validation.

  • Participate in sprint and release testing, including test planning, defect triage, smoke testing, deployment validation, and post-deployment verification.

  • Monitor testing progress and communicate risks, issues, dependencies, blockers, and testing outcomes to project stakeholders.

  • Work with Product Owners, SMEs, and business stakeholders to validate business and technical requirements.

  • Develop and maintain user guides, quick reference guides, job aids, training presentations, process documentation, knowledge articles, and FAQs.

  • Prepare training scenarios, demonstrations, training datasets, and other user adoption materials.

  • Support or facilitate training sessions, user walkthroughs, demonstrations, and knowledge transfer activities.

  • Support business readiness, go-live, transition-to-operations, and post-implementation stabilization activities.

  • Identify opportunities to use AI and Generative AI tools to improve test case development, test coverage, defect analysis, reporting, documentation, training, and knowledge management.

  • Review and validate AI-generated content to ensure accuracy, completeness, relevance, accessibility, and alignment with approved requirements.

  • Ensure testing and AI-assisted activities comply with applicable privacy, security, accessibility, quality assurance, and governance standards.

Requirements

  • Demonstrated experience as a Testing Analyst, QA Analyst, UAT Analyst, Business Systems Analyst, or similar role.

  • Strong hands-on experience developing and executing test cases, test scripts, test scenarios, and UAT activities.

  • Experience with functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, enhancement, and release testing.

  • Strong experience with defect identification, documentation, tracking, triage, and resolution validation.

  • Experience working with user stories, business requirements, and acceptance criteria.

  • Experience working within Agile/Scrum or sprint-based delivery environments.

  • Experience with ServiceNow or similar work management/testing platforms is an asset.

  • Experience developing training materials, user documentation, job aids, FAQs, and knowledge articles.

  • Experience supporting business readiness, deployment, go-live, and post-implementation activities.

  • Familiarity with AI and Generative AI tools and their application to testing, documentation, analysis, and training development.

  • Understanding of responsible AI practices, including the importance of human validation of AI-generated outputs.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, documentation, and communication skills.

  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical teams, Product Owners, SMEs, and business stakeholders.

  • Strong attention to detail with the ability to manage multiple testing and readiness activities simultaneously.

job.title: INGENYX- Senior Quality Engineer - Sterility Assurance & Validation (Remote, MA,
job.description:
Expected Travel: Up to 50%

Requisition ID: 14320

Ingenyx proudly launched as a new, independent company following its divestiture from Teleflex on August 3, 2026.

Ingenyx is a leading global provider of product development and production services for medical device manufacturers. We set ourselves apart with deep expertise, decades of experience, a dedication to design for manufacturability, and extensive, in-house capabilities, which include engineering, regulatory services, material selection and formulation, prototyping, manufacturing, assembly and packaging. We deliver industry-changing innovations and next-generation solutions for extrusions; diagnostic and interventional catheters; balloons and balloon catheters; sheath/dilator sets; specialty sutures, braids and fibers; and bioabsorbable sutures, yarns and resins. Join a dynamic, growing team that offers healthcare providers an array of medical technology solutions that make a difference in patients’ lives.

For more information, please visit

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Engineer – Sterility Assurance & Validation to serve as the internal technical owner for sterilization and sterility assurance activities while also supporting broader Quality Engineering and process validation needs.
This is a hands-on technical role with responsibility for maintaining validated sterilization processes, providing oversight of contract sterilization providers, supporting microbiological control activities, and ensuring continued compliance with applicable regulatory and quality system requirements.
The ideal candidate brings strong medical device Quality Engineering experience with demonstrated expertise in EO and radiation sterilization, process validation, and sterility assurance.

Principal Responsibilities

Sterility Assurance & Sterilization

  • Serve as the internal technical owner for the Sterility Assurance program.
    • Provide technical oversight of ethylene oxide (EO) and radiation sterilization processes.
    • Support sterilization cycle transfer, validation, requalification, and maintenance of the validated state.
    • Review and approve sterilization qualification and requalification protocols and reports.
    • Review sterilization cycle deviations, excursions, nonconformances, and change assessments.
    • Support investigation, root cause analysis, CAPA, and risk assessment for sterilization-related issues.
    • Coordinate and review annual Sterility Assurance and bioburden technical assessments.
    • Provide oversight of radiation dose audits, including review of Quarterly Dose Audit results, as applicable.
    • Monitor bioburden data and trends and coordinate specialized microbiology support when required.
    • Provide technical oversight of contract sterilizers and support supplier qualification, audits, SCARs, and quality agreements.
    • Maintain sterilization procedures, technical documentation, validation records, and required periodic reviews.
    • Support regulatory inspections, certification audits, customer audits, and technical inquiries related to sterilization and sterility assurance.
    • Partner with external microbiology laboratories and specialized Sterilization/Microbiology SMEs as required.

Quality Engineering & Validation

  • Support manufacturing process validation activities, including IQ, OQ, and PQ.
    • Provide Quality Engineering support for manufacturing processes, process changes, equipment qualification, and technology transfers.
    • Review and approve validation protocols, reports, engineering studies, and associated quality records.
    • Support nonconformance investigations, deviations, CAPAs, and root cause analysis.
    • Participate in manufacturing and process risk management activities, including PFMEAs and change assessments.
    • Apply appropriate statistical techniques to validation, process monitoring, and problem-solving activities.
    • Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supplier Quality, Regulatory Affairs, and other Quality functions to maintain compliant and capable manufacturing processes.
    • Support continuous improvement and risk-reduction initiatives.

Education / Experience Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Life Sciences, Microbiology, or a related technical discipline.
    • 7+ years of Quality Engineering, Validation, Sterility Assurance, or related experience within the medical device industry.
    • Demonstrated experience with medical device sterilization processes, preferably including EO and radiation sterilization.
    • Strong experience with process validation and maintenance of validated processes.

• Working knowledge of:

o ISO 11135 – Ethylene oxide sterilization
o ISO 11137 – Radiation sterilization
o ISO 11737 – Bioburden and sterility testing
o ISO 13485
o FDA medical device Quality System requirements
• Experience investigating sterilization deviations, process excursions, nonconformances, and CAPAs.
• Experience working with contract sterilization providers and/or external testing laboratories.
• Ability to independently assess technical information, make risk-based recommendations, and clearly document conclusions.
• Strong cross-functional communication and technical writing skills.

Specialized Skills / Other Requirements

  • Experience with both EO and gamma radiation sterilization.
    • Experience with sterilization cycle transfer, duplication, or establishment of new sterilization cycles.
    • Experience with bioburden trending and microbiological control programs.
    • Experience with radiation dose audits and dose-maintenance programs.
    • Experience supporting regulatory or Notified Body audits involving sterilization.
    • Experience in contract manufacturing or multi-site medical device environment.
    • ASQ CQE or other relevant Quality/Validation certification.

What Success Looks Like

The successful candidate will establish strong internal ownership of Sterility Assurance while effectively leveraging external laboratories and specialized SMEs when deeper expertise is required. This role will ensure that sterilization processes remain validated and compliant while also providing hands-on Quality Engineering and Validation support to the broader manufacturing organization.
This position is well suited for an experienced Quality Engineer who wants to become a key technical leader in Sterility Assurance without moving away from hands-on engineering and problem solving.

OSC EdgeTech is a wholly owned subsidiary of Cook Inlet Region, Inc. (CIRI), an Alaska Native Corporation proudly owned by over 9,400 Shareholders. OSC EdgeTech was created to deliver agile, responsive IT solutions to meet the evolving needs of federal and defense customers. OSC EdgeTech streamlines the acquisition process while maintaining the trusted quality, security, and innovation that define OSC Edge.

Cook Inlet Region, Inc., also known as CIRI, is one of 12 land-based Alaska Native regional corporations created pursuant to the Alaska Native Claims Settlement Act (ANCSA). CIRI’s regional boundaries roughly follow the traditional Dena’ina territory of Southcentral Alaska. CIRI was incorporated on June 8, 1972, and is owned today by a diverse group of more than 9,500 Shareholders who live in Alaska and throughout the world.

OSC EdgeTech offers excellent benefits for eligible employees. Benefits include paid holidays, paid time off, 401K with employer match, dental, vision, health insurance plans, as well as life and disability benefits.

Position Overview

The Systems Integration Tester will be responsible for planning, implementing, testing, documenting, and maintaining solutions for the integration and testing of both developed and Commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) or Government off-the-shelf (GOTS) components. This role involves synthesizing customer requirements into effective test solutions while ensuring adherence to technical, schedule, and cost constraints. The engineer will coordinate testing activities, perform analysis of test results, and prepare evaluation reports to validate system performance, contributing to the success of the mission.

job.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) – Digital Banking
job.description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer / SDET (Canada-only)

Digital Banking & Credit Union Transformation

Company: Aequilibrium Software Inc.
Location: Canada (Remote)
Employment type: Full-time or contract, depending on client engagement
Seniority: Senior
Industry: Financial Services / Credit Unions

About Aequilibrium

Aequilibrium is a Canadian digital transformation and software engineering company specializing in digital banking, financial services, customer experience, and emerging technologies. We partner with Canadian and US credit unions to modernize digital banking platforms, integrate enterprise systems, and deliver reliable, intuitive member experiences. We are expanding our QA engineering capability to support multiple Canadian credit union clients undergoing digital banking modernization, platform migrations, and integration initiatives.

The Opportunity

We are looking for experienced Senior QA Automation Engineers / Software Development Engineers in Test (SDETs) who combine strong technical testing expertise with practical knowledge of banking and credit union operations. You will work with developers, business analysts, solution architects, product owners, and client teams to ensure complex digital banking applications are secure, reliable, accessible, and production-ready.

This is a hands-on engineering role. We are particularly interested in candidates who can design and maintain automated testing frameworks, validate end-to-end banking workflows, and test integrations between digital banking platforms and core banking systems.

Key Responsibilities

Test Automation & Quality Engineering

  • Design, develop, and maintain automated UI, API, and integration tests for web and mobile banking applications.

  • Build reusable test automation frameworks and integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Develop test strategies, test plans, scenarios, and traceability aligned with business requirements.

  • Execute functional, regression, integration, end-to-end, and exploratory testing.

  • Investigate defects, analyze logs, identify root causes, and collaborate with developers to resolve them.

  • Improve test coverage, automation reliability, and quality reporting.

Digital Banking & Credit Union Testing

  • Validate member-facing journeys, including login, MFA, account balances, transfers, bill payments, Interac e-Transfer, mobile cheque deposit and account servicing.

  • Test commercial banking capabilities such as delegated access, entitlements, approvals and business payments.

  • Validate integrations between digital banking platforms, core banking systems, payment services, lending applications and CRM systems.

  • Support data migration testing, reconciliation and regression testing during platform replacements.

  • Participate in system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT), release readiness and production validation.

  • Collaborate with client business teams to ensure test scenarios reflect real banking operations and member needs.

Engineering & Delivery

  • Work within Agile delivery teams and contribute to sprint planning, refinement and acceptance criteria.

  • Integrate quality engineering practices into development workflows.

  • Support performance, security, and accessibility testing in collaboration with specialists.

  • Provide clear quality metrics, defect reporting, and release-readiness assessments.

  • Help establish automated quality gates for AI-assisted software development.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of professional software testing or quality engineering experience.

  • 3+ years of hands-on test automation development.

  • Experience testing financial services, banking, credit union or other transaction-intensive applications.

  • Strong proficiency with at least one modern test automation framework such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or Appium.

  • Programming or scripting experience with TypeScript, JavaScript, Java, C#, or Python.

  • Strong API testing skills using tools such as Postman, REST Assured or equivalent.

  • Experience testing REST APIs, authentication, authorization and system integrations.

  • Experience with SQL, data validation, and troubleshooting integration issues.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and tools such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

  • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile delivery, defect management and risk-based testing.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate directly with client stakeholders.

Highly Desirable Experience

  • Direct experience with Canadian credit unions or digital banking transformation programs.

  • Testing digital banking platforms such as VeriPark, Backbase, Central 1 Forge/MemberDirect, Intellect Design, Temenos, Lumin or eBankIT.

  • Integration testing with core banking systems, especially Fiserv DNA or CGI RFS360.

  • Experience with Canadian payment capabilities, including Interac e-Transfer, bill payments, and payment processing.

  • Knowledge of mortgage lending, loan origination, commercial banking or CRM workflows.

  • Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365, Azure, and . NET-based enterprise environments.

  • Mobile application testing across iOS and Android.

  • Performance testing with JMeter, k6, or similar tools.

  • Accessibility testing aligned with WCAG standards.

  • Experience testing AI-generated code or implementing automated quality controls in AI-assisted development environments.

  • Experience supporting banking platform migration, cutover or production hypercare.

What Success Looks Like

Within the first 90 days, you will be expected to:

  • Understand the client's digital banking architecture, critical workflows and integration dependencies.

  • Establish or improve automated regression coverage for high-priority banking journeys.

  • Identify gaps in test coverage and recommend practical improvements.

  • Contribute to reliable release-readiness reporting and defect management.

  • Reduce manual regression effort while improving confidence in production releases.

Why Join Aequilibrium?

  • Work on meaningful digital banking modernization projects with Canadian credit unions.

  • Collaborate with experienced engineers, designers, architects, and banking specialists.

  • Contribute to complex integration, automation, and member-experience challenges.

  • Help shape modern quality engineering practices, including AI-assisted development and testing.

  • Join a remote-first Canadian team focused on purposeful impact and technical excellence.

To apply: Please submit your resume and highlight your test automation expertise, financial services experience, banking platforms, and core banking integrations in your cover letter.

About Danaher Diagnostics

At Danaher, we are dedicated to advancing science and technology to improve human health. Our Diagnostics businesses provide innovative diagnostic solutions that help healthcare professionals make faster, more accurate decisions and improve patient outcomes.

We are looking for a Regulatory Affairs Specialist – Africa (French Speaking) to support regulatory submissions, product registrations and market expansion activities across African markets.

Key Responsibilities

Regulatory Submissions & Product Registrations

  • Prepare and manage regulatory submissions for African countries, including initial registrations, renewals, variations and responses to additional information requests from regulatory authorities.
  • Support market expansion registrations for diagnostic assays, instruments and software, including medium- to high-complexity projects.
  • Coordinate with local regulatory representatives and health authorities to facilitate product registrations and approvals.
  • Ensure timely delivery of regulatory activities to support product launches and business priorities.
  • Maintain accurate regulatory documentation, product approvals, registration records and relevant certificates, including Certificates of Free Sale (CFS).

Regulatory Compliance & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Collaborate with global and regional Regulatory Affairs teams, Quality, Manufacturing, Sales and Marketing to support regulatory activities.
  • Conduct regulatory change assessments for product design, manufacturing, labeling, packaging and other relevant changes.
  • Support compliance with applicable regulatory requirements across African markets.

job.title: QA Engineer – Salesforce & Enterprise Applications
job.description:

With our global scale and deep expertise, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real impact on people’s health around the world. Together, we’re improving health and improving lives.


Labcorp is a global leader in diagnostic testing and drug development solutions, helping healthcare providers, researchers, and patients make informed decisions that advance care. Join us in our mission to improve health and improve lives.

Labcorp is seeking a QA Engineer – Salesforce & Enterprise Applications to support quality assurance across Salesforce and integrated enterprise applications to join our team!

Work Schedule: This is an initial one-year contract position, and the role is assigned to a second-shift schedule.with standard business hours of Monday through Friday, 12.30 PM IST – 9.30 PM IST in your local time zone. Business needs may occasionally require flexibility in work hours, including earlier, later, or additional hours, with reasonable notice provided when possible.

Job Responsibilities

  • Analyze user stories, business requirements, solution designs, and acceptance criteria from a QA perspective to ensure requirements are complete, consistent, and testable.

  • Identify requirement gaps, edge cases, dependencies, and quality risks early in the software development lifecycle and work with Business Analysts, Product Owners, and Developers to clarify expected behavior.

Technical Oversight

  • Develop and maintain test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test data, and test execution documentation.

  • Perform rigorous functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing for Salesforce applications and related enterprise systems.

  • Test Salesforce functionality including business processes, Flows, validation rules, objects, fields, permissions, profiles, record types, and other configuration and customization.

  • Design, develop, execute, and maintain automated test cases using Copado Robotic Testing, with a focus on reusable and maintainable regression automation.

  • Evaluate existing and new test cases to identify opportunities to improve automation coverage, regression coverage, and overall testing effectiveness.

  • Test integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise applications, including APIs, middleware, scheduled processes, and inbound/outbound interfaces.

  • Perform data migration and data validation testing, including field mapping, record counts, data completeness, accuracy, transformation, synchronization, and exception handling.

  • Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, severity, supporting evidence, and business impact; retest fixes and perform appropriate regression testing.

  • Participate in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, daily stand-ups, demonstrations, and retrospectives, and provide QA estimates, status updates, and quality risks.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to continuously improve QA processes, test automation, regression coverage, defect prevention, and overall software quality.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 3 years or more experience testing Salesforce platform applications on Sales Cloud or Service Cloud.

  • 2 years or more experience in Salesforce, Copado, or related QA/test automation certifications.

  • 2 years or more experience performing functional, integration, end-to-end, regression, and negative testing.

  • 2 years or more experience with test automation, preferably Copado Robotic Testing, or similar enterprise test automation tools.

  • 2 years or more experience with data migration, data conversion, or large-scale data validation testing.

  • 2 years or more experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • 1 year or more experience testing REST/SOAP APIs and integration platforms

  • 1 year or more experience with Jira, Salesforce DevOps processes, and version-control practices.

Certifications

  • Salesforce certifications. Professional certifications such as ISTQB, ASTQB, CSTE, CSQA, CQSE

Additional Job Standards

  • Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills with attention to detail.

  • Strong experience analyzing user stories, requirements, and acceptance criteria and translating them into comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, defect-management, and communication skills.

  • Strong command of the English language. Fluent in speaking and writing English.

  • Ability to independently analyze requirements and identify quality risks before testing begins.

  • Strong ownership of testing outcomes and commitment to delivering high-quality solutions.

  • Ability to effectively balance comprehensive testing with Agile delivery timelines.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills across business and technical teams.

  • Ability to continuously identify opportunities to improve testing efficiency, automation coverage, and quality processes.

About the role:

  • The QA Engineer will be responsible for analyzing requirements from a quality perspective, developing and executing comprehensive test scenarios, and building and maintaining automated tests using Copado Robotic Testing. The role requires strong Salesforce testing experience and the ability to test complex business processes involving integrations, data migration, and multiple enterprise systems.

job.title: Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst(QA)
job.description:
When our values align, there's no limit to what we can achieve.

At Parexel, we all share the same goal - to improve the world's health. From clinical trials to regulatory, consulting, and market access, every clinical development solution we provide is underpinned by something special - a deep conviction in what we do.

Each of us, no matter what we do at Parexel, contributes to the development of a therapy that ultimately will benefit a patient. We take our work personally, we do it with empathy and we're committed to making a difference.

About Parexel

Parexel is a leading global clinical development partner delivering insights-driven clinical and consulting solutions to the life sciences industry. With 22,000+ employees worldwide, we partner with biopharmaceutical companies and research sites to design and deliver patient-focused clinical trials that broaden access and make research a care option for anyone, anywhere.

We work with focus, agility, and shared purpose, moving with urgency to address patient needs and accelerate the delivery of new therapies. We embrace bold thinking, adapt quickly to change, and continually raise the bar for the speed and quality of clinical research. We are expanding our team and seeking talented individuals to help drive industry leading innovation, With Heart®.

About the Role

We are seeking a Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst to join our team. As a Senior Salesforce Functional Analyst, you will ensure that the Salesforce solutions our teams rely on are accurate, thoroughly tested, and ready for change. Your work supports the systems that help us manage client relationships, proposals, and contracts, which make it possible to deliver clinical research that advances new treatments for patients. This position plays a key role in translating business needs into clear requirements, validating every enhancement before it reaches production, and keeping releases reliable across the sprint cycle.


You will collaborate with business analysts, developers, administrators, and business stakeholders, work within Agile methodologies, and contribute from requirements through deployment. Responsibilities include business analysis, system and integration testing, Salesforce configuration, stakeholder support, and continuous improvement, with opportunities to deepen your expertise and influence how Salesforce supports our business.


You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through rigorous testing, well-documented requirements, and dependable Salesforce releases. With diverse teams and continuous learning opportunities, the Salesforce Business Analyst and Quality Assurance Analyst can explore career paths and expand skills across the Salesforce platform, Agile delivery, and clinical development business.

Key Responsibilities

  • Quality Assurance: Design, develop, and execute comprehensive system test cases for Salesforce enhancements, including managed packages and connected solutions. Perform regression testing, test integrations with other enterprise systems, maintain testing artifacts, and run end-to-end smoke testing during weekend sprint release deployments, which occur once every three weeks
  • Business Analysis: Work with stakeholders to understand business requirements and document them as user stories in collaboration with business analysts. Create Visio flows that document new and existing business processes and functionality
  • Salesforce Configuration: Administer a range of declarative solutions to support sprint work and resolve production issues when needed
  • Collaboration and Issue Resolution: Translate requirements into effective test scenarios, identify, document, and track defects throughout the testing lifecycle, and work with the development and administration team to resolve issues in a timely way. Take part in Agile ceremonies and contribute to sprint planning and retrospectives
  • Customer Support: Provide demos of new enhancements to business stakeholders and support them through user acceptance testing, including test data creation and training
  • Continuous Improvement: Analyze bugs, perform root cause analysis, and document results. Stay current on Salesforce releases and assess their impact on existing systems and tests. Proactively suggest improvements to testing processes and tools, and mentor junior team members in Salesforce testing practices and methodologies

You'll thrive in this role if you bring:

  • Strengths in Salesforce quality assurance, business analysis, and end-to-end testing of Salesforce solutions and their integrations
  • A proven track record of providing exceptional customer service to stakeholders at all levels, including C-suite leaders, and managing production issues with meticulous attention to detail
  • The ability to collaborate across teams and communicate clearly, both verbally and in writing
  • A proactive mindset, a bias for action, and a flexible approach to new learning and changing priorities
  • Comfort working in Agile environments with tools such as Jira, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced setting

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Salesforce Administrator Certification
  • 5+ years of hands-on Salesforce experience with a strong focus on business analysis, system and integration testing
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, data models, and business processes, and of Salesforce security
  • Knowledge of the full sales cycle, from lead generation and request for proposal through the contract lifecycle, including work orders and changes in scope
  • Ability to administer all aspects of Sales Cloud, including security and access, configuration (such as Flow, approval processes, validation rules, and Lightning record pages), reports and dashboards, and data management using Data Loader and Workbench
  • Proficiency in creating and executing test plans, test cases, and test scripts, and experience with automated testing tools for Salesforce (e.g., Selenium, Provar, Copado Robotic Testing)
  • Familiarity with API testing tools and techniques
  • Practical experience with Agile methodologies and related tools (e.g., Jira)
  • Microsoft Excel skills to clean and manipulate data, including formulas to compare datasets
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
  • Ability to work in shifts from 12 to 9 PM IST and provide support for weekend releases

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in healthcare, clinical development, or a related field
  • Business analyst experience

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.
