job.title: Senior QA Engineer (80-100%, f::m::d)
job.description:
Join OnlineDoctor: We're Expanding!

We are a fast-growing telemedicine company focused on improving access to dermatological care. Our platform uses technology to connect patients with dermatologists, enabling them to receive diagnoses and treatment plans remotely and asynchronously.

We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to take full ownership of verification and testing for our product. This is a hands-on role covering both manual and automated testing: you will investigate new features and edge cases yourself, while building automation that makes repeated checks reliable and efficient. Your focus will be on one product, our medical device—its web application across desktop and mobile browsers, and its backend services. You will decide what needs human judgment, what should be automated, and how to focus testing on the risks that matter most.

You will be part of the Product & Tech team, working with a medical device in a healthcare environment where reliability, privacy, and evidence that critical functionality performs as intended are essential.

Responsibilities:

Testing Strategy & Collaboration

  • Testing strategy: Define a risk-based testing approach, set coverage targets, identify gaps, and provide evidence-based recommendations on release readiness.

  • Manual testing: Plan and conduct exploratory testing and risk-based regression for new features, integrations, and critical user journeys.

  • Early involvement: Collaborate with the Product Owner and engineers to clarify requirements, edge cases, usability, accessibility, and testability early in development.

Test Automation & Infrastructure

  • Automated testing: Build and maintain reliable automated API, integration, and end-to-end tests, selecting the appropriate testing level and integrating checks into CI/CD.

  • Test infrastructure: Establish and maintain test environments, representative test data, and reporting to support effective day-to-day testing.

Verification & Quality Management

  • Medical-device verification: Verify functionality against agreed requirements and acceptance criteria, maintaining clear verification evidence.

  • Defect investigation: Investigate defects, communicate their impact, and work with engineers to address root causes and prevent recurring issues.

  • Traceability & test management: Maintain a practical test case management system that keeps test cases current and links requirements, tests, results, defects, and verification evidence.

Requierements:

  • Strong hands-on experience in manual testing and test automation, including ownership of testing for a product or major product area and maintaining reliable automated test suites.

  • Sound judgment in defining risk-based testing approaches and deciding what to test, at which level, and why.

  • Experience testing web applications and APIs, including authentication, permissions, integrations, and failure scenarios.

  • Ability to investigate problems across the application stack and collaborate effectively with developers on fixes.

  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD workflows and making test results actionable.

  • Experience selecting testing tools and establishing or maintaining test case management processes that keep requirements, coverage, and results traceable.

  • A detail-oriented, pragmatic, and independent approach, with strong communication skills and the ability to follow issues through to resolution.

Nice to have:

  • Familiarity with our stack (AWS, CircleCI, Python, pytest, react, jest, Playwright). This is helpful, but strong testing and automation skills matter more than experience with every tool we use.

  • Experience using AI in your testing or engineering work, for example to generate or prioritize test cases, analyze failures, or build test tooling, with a clear view of its limits and of the verification needed for medical-device software.

  • Experience testing products in healthcare or other environments with demanding privacy, security, or quality requirements.

  • Experience designing test data and environments for complex integrations or sensitive information.

  • Experience coaching engineers on testability and contributing to a broader quality culture.

What success looks like:

Within your first 6–12 months, you will have:

  • Established a risk-based testing approach, identified coverage gaps, and prioritized improvements based on critical user journeys, edge cases, and product risks.

  • Strengthened manual and automated testing through reliable test environments, representative test data, effective automation, exploratory testing, and clear medical-device verification records.

  • Improved visibility into test results, outstanding risks, and release readiness, helping the team detect defects earlier and reduce avoidable production failures.

You will own the testing approach and work with the wider team to make well-tested changes the norm. Quality and release decisions remain a shared responsibility.

What we offer:

Leadership and Strategy
  • Design and own the QA strategy across the NedGraphics and Optitex product portfolios, bringing a clear point of view on what good looks like based on prior experience building QA functions elsewhere

  • Build a quality-focused culture within the team and across the wider engineering organisation
  • Establish clear standards, processes, and quality gates for product releases, informed by best practices from previous roles

  • Expand automation coverage significantly across the product suite
  • Set the automation roadmap and direct the existing automation engineer
  • Identify and introduce AI-assisted testing tools to improve speed and coverage
  • Progressively reduce reliance on manual regression testing
Hands-on Testing
  • Contribute directly to test design, execution, and defect analysis on complex features
  • Stay close to the product portfolio to provide well-informed quality judgment

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

Essential
  • Proven experience leading or managing a QA team, ideally having built or significantly transformed a QA function from the ground up
  • Demonstrated experience building or executing QA strategy, not just following one: you know what good looks like and can point to a track record of setting the direction yourself
  • Hands-on background in software testing; this is a player-coach role
  • Solid experience testing native desktop applications
  • Working knowledge of at least one test automation framework for UI desktop applications (e.g. WinAppDriver, Appium, Squish by Qt Group, or equivalent)

Desirable
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing tools or a genuine interest in adopting them
  • Background in software product companies, ideally with desktop application portfolios
  • Exposure to agile or scrum delivery environments
  • Experience growing an automation capability from the ground up
  • Familiarity with Azure DevOps for work item tracking, test plans, and pipeline integration

  • A new, senior role with real scope to shape how quality is done at NedGraphics
  • Close collaboration with VP Engineering and a technically strong R&D team
  • A team of 5 QA engineers to lead and develop

job.title: Penetration Tester
job.description:
Penetration Tester

Location: Remote - North America

Company Mission – Our mission is to help secure as many companies as possible, by using the best way of doing so: penetration testing. Sprocket Security prioritizes offensive security for enterprises, empowering them to build robust defense strategies based on individual business risk.

How – At Sprocket Security, we've built an expert-driven Continuous Penetration Testing platform that blends cutting-edge automated and manual testing methods.

Your Mission – The easy work is disappearing, and we built it that way on purpose. Our platform now owns the recon, the scanning, the first pass anyone could run, so you start each day with leads already surfaced instead of a blank terminal. Your job is everything the tooling can't do: chasing a lead into a critical finding, going back into the same network a third time because you know there's more in it, and being the human a client trusts when the report lands.

Responsibilities:

  • Own continuous testing across your clients' full attack surfaces (network, web app, cloud, social engineering) by conducting manual penetration testing and directing automation and agents rather than running one-off scoped projects.
  • Take raw leads the platform surfaces and push them into deep, chained, business-level impact, including post-exploitation, lateral movement, and privilege escalation.
  • Validate whether activity was detected and acted on, not just whether you got in, and call out where a client's defenses held.
  • Write clear, business-relevant attack narratives that explain impact to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Run debriefs and client conversations that build trust and position Sprocket as a partner, not a vendor.
  • Feed repeatable techniques and automation candidates back to R&D so a one-off discovery becomes a capability the whole team runs continuously.
  • Mentor junior testers and interns, stay reachable, and think out loud with your team rather than working in silence.
  • Build scripts and tooling to improve your own efficiency and the team's.

Requirements:
Minimum

  • Web application testing beyond OWASP Top 10 basics: auth flaws, business logic, injection at depth.
  • Network and Active Directory testing: lateral movement, privilege escalation, not just scan-and-report.
  • Comfort directing, supervising, and validating AI and automation tooling across the full autonomy spectrum, and pushing well past what it surfaces on its own.
  • Post-exploitation and impact demonstration, with the ability to translate a technical finding into what it means for a specific client's business.
  • Scripting ability (Python, Bash, or equivalent) with a track record of building tools to improve efficiency.
  • Client-facing experience delivering findings and handling technical and non-technical conversations.
  • Genuine comfort with ambiguity and a role whose center of gravity keeps shifting toward harder, less routine work.
  • A collaborative approach: you ask early, share often, and invest in the people around you.

Preferred

  • OSCP or equivalent hands-on certification.
  • OSWE, CRTO, GPEN, GWAPT, or cloud security certifications (AWS Security Specialty, AZ-500).
  • Published research, disclosed CVEs, or an active bug bounty profile.

Certifications & Education: No specific degree or certification required. Equivalent hands-on experience is valued equally or more. If OSCP or equivalent isn't already held, we expect it within roughly 12 months, and we support that with a training budget.

This Role Might Not Be For You If:

  • You want a role built around one-time scoped engagements rather than continuous testing across a client's full surface.
  • You see AI and automation tooling as a threat to the craft rather than something that multiplies your reach.
  • You'd rather work heads-down than think out loud, ask for help, or hand off what you find to teammates and R&D.
  • You want the day-to-day to stay the same over time. This role's center of gravity keeps moving toward harder, stranger, more interesting ground, and that's the deal, not a catch.

Benefits:

  • Company matched 401k (immediate eligibility, no one should have to wait to start saving).

  • 100% company contribution for dental and vision.

  • Support for your career development with paid training, conferences, certifications, etc.

job.title: Ubuntu Linux Kernel Test Engineer
job.description:
Ubuntu is the most widely used Linux distribution in the world, delivering kernels across a vast matrix of versions, architectures, and configurations – with up to 15 years of security and maintenance commitments for Long Term Support (LTS) releases. Ensuring the quality and reliability of these kernels demands a dedicated, systematic approach to testing at scale.

The Canonical Kernel Team is looking for a Test Engineer to take ownership of our kernel testing strategy and infrastructure. You will design and maintain test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security. You will build and evolve automated test frameworks – including stress testing, fuzzing, code coverage analysis, and regression detection – that not only must remain effective across many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance, but must be able to scale with the high demand for Ubuntu kernels (currently more than 160 under active support).

The successful candidate will bring strong Python skills, familiarity with Linux kernel internals, and experience building test infrastructure that scales. You will work closely with kernel engineers to catch regressions early, validate fixes, and ensure every kernel we ship meets the highest standards of reliability.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the APAC region, except for Taipei, Taiwan, and Beijing, China, which are office-based locations.

What your day will look like

  • Design, develop, and maintain comprehensive test plans covering functional correctness, stability, performance, and security for Ubuntu Linux kernels
  • Build and improve automated test infrastructure for continuous kernel quality validation across multiple kernel versions and architectures
  • Maintain long-lived test suites that evolve alongside Ubuntu’s many concurrently supported kernel versions spanning years of maintenance
  • Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines for continuous kernel quality validation
  • Conduct performance benchmarking and regression detection across kernel releases
  • Measure and improve kernel code coverage, identifying gaps in test coverage and creating tests to address them
  • Execute and analyze stress tests covering CPU scheduling, memory management, I/O subsystems, networking, and filesystem workloads
  • Develop and maintain fuzzing harnesses to discover kernel vulnerabilities and reliability issues using tools such as syzkaller, Trinity, or custom fuzzers
  • Collaborate regularly and proactively with a globally distributed team
  • Contribute to upstream test suites and testing frameworks
  • Document test methodologies, results, and coverage gaps

What we are looking for in you

  • Significant programming experience in Python
  • Experience with test frameworks such as LTP, kselftest, xfstests, stress-ng, fio, or similar
  • Experience designing and executing system-level tests: functional, stress, performance, or regression testing
  • Familiarity with CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitHub CI, or similar)
  • Experience maintaining test suites over long periods, adapting to evolving software across multiple supported versions
  • Familiarity with Linux (Ubuntu or Debian preferred but not required), Linux kernel internals and subsystems
  • Experience with Linux systems administration and automation
  • Solid background with git
  • Well-organized, self-starting and able to deliver to fixed schedules
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent communication skills
  • Ability to travel twice a year, for company events up to two weeks each

Additional skills that you might also bring

  • Familiarity with kernel fuzzing tools and techniques (e.g. syzkaller, Trinity, AFL, or custom harnesses)
  • Experience with code coverage instrumentation (e.g. gcov, kcov, LLVM source-based coverage)
  • Knowledge of kernel tracing and observability tools (e.g. ftrace, perf, bpftrace, eBPF)
  • Familiarity with static analysis tools (e.g. sparse, smatch, Coccinelle) as part of a testing workflow
  • Experience with fault injection frameworks (e.g. failslab, fail_make_request) for reliability testing
  • Prior experience with test infrastructure at scale (provisioning, orchestration, result aggregation)
  • Experience with Ubuntu/Debian packaging or Snap
  • Knowledge of virtualization technologies (KVM, QEMU) and container runtimes
  • Cloud infrastructure experience (AWS, GCP, Azure, or OpenStack)
  • Prior involvement with open source testing communities or projects

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004.​ Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

job.title: LQA Game Tester (Arabic) - Freelance Remote
job.description:
About the company

Side (formerly PTW) is a global video game development and services provider, offering technical and creative solutions to many of the largest developers and studios around the world.

Founded in Japan in 1994, Side has grown to become a global force in the video games industry, with over 40 studios in 15 countries worldwide and offices across North America, Europe, South America, and Asia.

Our industry-leading services include codev, art production, localization, audio production, quality assurance, localization QA, player support, community management, and datasets. For more information, visit

About the role

As Localization QA Game Tester, you will work within our Localization Quality Assurance team and be the very first person to see the localized game in its entirety – translated text, images and the rest of the user interface collectively. You’ll get to experience the project in the way it will be consumed by the end users. You will work in a multilingual project team ensuring that the game is free from grammatical errors, cultural inconsistencies and ultimately ensuring that the game is accurately localized into the target language.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Collaborate with a global project team.
  • Identify and correct spelling, grammar, punctuation, and other language errors.
  • Ensure adherence to console manufacturer guidelines.
  • Log details of errors and issues, providing improvement suggestions.
  • Ensure accurate translation within context and maintain consistency in terminology and imagery.
  • Identify missing or incorrect content and ensure proper display/format of dates, calendars, and characters.
  • Write reports on errors and bugs found and perform ad hoc translation.
  • Oversee the quality of your work, collaborate with the team, and contribute to the overall success of projects.

Our Localization QA team conducts language checks on upcoming games across a variety of cutting-edge platforms, including PC, Xbox Series X/S, PS5, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation VR2, and various mobile and tablet devices. As an LQA Game Tester, you will be working on top gaming titles for some of the world’s leading publishers.

Requirements

  • No experience required. Just fluency in Arabic and conversational in English.
  • Strong cultural understanding of the language you are applying for.
  • Computer literacy – particularly with Excel.
  • Robust Internet research skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Previous experience with using different software, applications, and websites.
  • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely and collaborate within project teams.
  • Candidate must be located within Schengen Area.

What we offer:

  • You will be working for the pre-eminent global provider of specialist services to the games industry and provided with full training and the opportunity to work on some of the biggest game clients, titles, projects, and tech in the world.
  • Attractive remuneration, holidays, regular team competitions with great prizes; and inclusion into an extensive social calendar. Our environments thrive with collaborative teamwork with people from all around the world, different nationalities, and languages.
  • A supportive community inclusive of LGBTQ+, and any age, ethnicity, religion, or disability. We care about the well-being of our employees and have a dedicated employee well-being program. We empower our people and offer regular progression opportunities to ensure our employees flourish.
  • Learn as you work and be part of something real that changes the face of gaming - forever.
  • Working with a global multi-lingual workforce with superb training and promotion and progression opportunities.

Working Condition:

  • 100% remote within Europe. If you're based in Braga, Portugal, even better!
  • With the possibility of transitioning to a full-time role. However, if you prefer to remain a freelancer, that's perfectly fine!

We are currently building a talent pool for future opportunities. If your qualifications align with a role/project that becomes available, we will reach out to you directly to discuss next steps. While there may not be an immediate opening, we encourage you to submit your application, as we regularly review our pool of candidates when positions arise. job.title: Lead Penetration Test Engineer
job.description:
About the Role:

Grade Level (for internal use):

12

S&P Global Corporate

The Role: Lead Penetration Test Engineer

Location: US - Virtual, or Canada - Virtual

The Team:

The S&P Ratings Security team focuses on protecting our clients and users from modern security threats. Our mission is to safeguard systems and data by developing innovative solutions to the industry’s most complex security challenges. We are passionate problem solvers with deep security expertise.  

Responsibilities and Impact: 

We are seeking a Lead Penetration Test Engineer with extensive experience in penetration testing and offensive security. The ideal candidate will conduct penetration tests, re-testing, vulnerability scanning, and threat assessments across diverse environments. This role requires strong offensive security skills combined with cloud and application security expertise to identify vulnerabilities and develop effective mitigation strategies.

A successful candidate will excel in the following areas: 

Penetration Testing & Vulnerability Assessments

• Conduct comprehensive penetration testing of web applications, infrastructure, and cloud environments using both manual and automated techniques.
• Develop custom scripts, tools, and methodologies to enhance penetration testing capabilities and automate security testing within CI/CD pipelines.
• Apply cloud‑specific offensive techniques, including IAM abuse, container and serverless exploitation, and cloud misconfiguration testing.

Vulnerability Management & Remediation

• Collaborate with engineering and development teams to analyze vulnerabilities, develop remediation plans, and strengthen application security across development and production lifecycles.
• Perform detailed security assessments using DAST, SAST, and SCA tools to ensure continuous validation and improvement of security controls.

Attack Simulations & Research

• Lead and participate in attack simulations and tabletop exercises to validate security controls and improve organizational response capabilities.
• Research emerging threats, attack vectors, and adversarial techniques to inform offensive and defensive strategies.
• Partner with internal teams to design and execute threat assessments based on intelligence feeds and threat actor analysis.

Security Communication & Reporting

• Communicate and present penetration testing and security assessment findings to both technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
• Provide actionable remediation guidance and risk mitigation strategies to strengthen the organization’s overall security posture.

What We’re Looking For

Basic Required Qualifications

• Minimum 8 years of experience in information security with a strong focus on penetration testing, application security, and vulnerability management.
• Hands-on experience with penetration testing tools (e.g., Burp Suite, Nessus, Metasploit, Nmap) and methodologies (e.g., OWASP Top 10, MITRE ATT&CK, PTES).
• Expertise in identifying and exploiting common infrastructure and web application vulnerabilities (e.g., XSS, SQL Injection, IDOR).
• Familiarity with vulnerability classification and scoring frameworks (CVE, CVSS, CWE).
• Strong scripting or programming skills (e.g., Bash, Python, Go, PowerShell, JavaScript).
• Experience performing security assessments (DAST, SAST, SCA, credential scanning) and integrating security testing into CI/CD pipelines.
• Ability to translate complex technical findings into clear, actionable reports and confidently brief cross‑functional teams and executives.
• At least one recognized offensive security certification (OSCP, OSCE3, OSEP, GXPN, GPEN, or CREST CRT/CCT).

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with cloud security across AWS, Azure, or GCP.
• Knowledge of AI/ML security and adversarial testing methods, including evaluating LLMs and other models for manipulation, evasion, and data integrity risks.
• Demonstrated involvement in the infosec community (e.g., open-source projects, bug bounties, CVE research, conference talks, or security publications).
• Experience applying the MITRE ATT&CK Framework to offensive security operations and threat emulation.
• Familiarity with secure software development practices and the software development lifecycle.
• Experience with Java application technologies, deployment frameworks, and associated security best practices.
• Ability to work collaboratively across teams while independently owning deliverables and maintaining accountability to deadlines.

Right to work requirements for US based out candidates:

This role is open only for candidates with indefinite right to work within the US.

Compensation/Benefits Information (US Applicants Only):

S&P Global states that the anticipated base salary range for this position is $135,000 USD – $200,000 USD. Final base salary for this role will be based on the individual’s geographical location as well as experience and qualifications for the role.

In addition to base compensation, this role is eligible to receive additional S&P Global benefits. For more information on the benefits we provide to our employees, please click here.

This role is open for candidates with indefinite right to work within Canada.

Final compensation for this role will be based on the individual’s performance, geographic location, as well as experience level, skill set, training, licenses, and certifications. In accordance with Ontario's new regulations effective January 1, 2026, this job posting provides information on expected compensation. S&P Global will not be utilizing artificial intelligence in our hiring process. Additionally, we are committed to transparency and will inform all interviewed candidates of hiring decisions within 45 days of their interview. This posting is for an existing vacancy, and we encourage you to reach out for further information regarding our hiring practices or any questions you may have. Thank you for considering a career with us!

Advancing Essential Intelligence.

We're more than 35,000 strong worldwide—so we're able to understand nuances while having a broad perspective. Our team is driven by curiosity and a shared belief that Essential Intelligence can help build a more prosperous future for us all.From finding new ways to measure sustainability to analyzing energy transition across the supply chain to building workflow solutions that make it easy to tap into insight and apply it. We are changing the way people see things and empowering them to make an impact on the world we live in. We’re committed to a more equitable future and to helping our customers find new, sustainable ways of doing business. Join us and help create the critical insights that truly make a difference.

Throughout our history, the world's leading organizations have relied on us for the Essential Intelligence they need to make confident decisions about the road ahead. We start with a foundation of integrity in all we do, bring a spirit of discovery to our work, and collaborate in close partnership with each other and our customers to achieve shared goals.

job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
Quality Assurance Engineer – Manual & Automation Testing | SaaS | Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Client Business Hours — flexibility required for releases, sprint deadlines, and testing windows

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Quality Assurance Engineer (QA Tester) to ensure software applications are thoroughly tested, reliable, and production-ready before release.

This role combines manual testing, test automation, regression testing, API and performance testing, defect management, and release validation. You’ll work closely with engineering and product teams throughout the software development lifecycle to identify issues early and prevent critical defects from reaching users.

You’ll own quality across new features, integrations, bug fixes, and releases while helping improve testing processes and automation coverage over time.

If you naturally look for edge cases, care deeply about software quality, and enjoy preventing problems before they reach production, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Test Planning & Coverage

  • Develop comprehensive test plans, test cases, and acceptance criteria
  • Review requirements and user stories with product managers and developers
  • Define appropriate test coverage across:
    • New features
    • Integrations
    • Regression scenarios
    • User workflows
  • Translate product requirements into structured testing scenarios
  • Identify potential risks and edge cases early in the development lifecycle
  • Ensure critical workflows receive sufficient testing before release

Manual & Regression Testing

  • Execute:
    • Functional testing
    • Regression testing
    • UI/UX testing
    • Cross-browser testing
    • Cross-device testing
  • Validate new features and bug fixes before production release
  • Identify unexpected behaviors, functional issues, and usability problems
  • Log defects using:
    • Jira
    • Azure DevOps
    • Similar bug-tracking platforms
  • Write clear bug reports including:
    • Reproduction steps
    • Expected behavior
    • Actual results
    • Supporting evidence
  • Retest fixes and verify impacted functionality
  • Run regression testing before major releases

Automation Testing

  • Build and maintain automated test suites using:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Identify high-value and repeatable test cases for automation
  • Improve automation coverage over time
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using:
    • GitHub Actions
    • Jenkins
    • GitLab CI
  • Monitor automated test runs
  • Investigate and troubleshoot failed automated tests
  • Improve the reliability and maintainability of automated test suites

API, Performance & Security Testing

  • Conduct load and stress testing using tools such as:
    • Apache JMeter
    • Locust
  • Test APIs using:
    • Postman
    • RestAssured
  • Validate API responses, integrations, and expected behaviors
  • Identify performance bottlenecks and reliability issues
  • Support vulnerability testing and remediation efforts where required
  • Help ensure applications meet expected performance and security standards

Defect Management & Release Validation

  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution
  • Collaborate with developers to reproduce and isolate issues
  • Retest resolved defects before closure
  • Assess the impact of fixes on related functionality
  • Highlight unresolved issues and release risks before deployment
  • Support final release validation to ensure critical workflows are production-ready

Documentation & Quality Reporting

  • Maintain accurate:
    • Test plans
    • Test cases
    • Test results
    • Defect documentation
  • Track quality metrics including:
    • Defect density
    • Test coverage
    • Pass/fail rates
    • Regression results
  • Prepare clear quality reports for engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders
  • Maintain visibility into testing progress and outstanding issues
  • Clearly communicate release risks before deployment

Engineering & Product Collaboration

  • Work closely with developers to reproduce, isolate, and resolve defects
  • Participate in:
    • Sprint planning
    • Daily standups
    • Retrospectives
    • Release discussions
  • Review requirements for clarity and testability
  • Provide feedback on product usability and quality
  • Advocate for quality throughout the software development lifecycle

Requirements

  • 2+ years of QA or software testing experience
  • Hands-on experience with manual and regression testing
  • Experience with test management and bug-tracking tools such as:
    • Jira
    • TestRail
    • Zephyr
  • Familiarity with automation frameworks including:
    • Selenium
    • Cypress
    • Playwright
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
    • Agile methodologies
    • Functional testing
    • Regression testing
  • Ability to create structured test plans and test cases
  • Ability to write clear and reproducible defect reports
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent documentation and communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with engineering and product teams
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment
  • Availability during U.S. client business hours, with flexibility around releases, sprint deadlines, and testing windows

Nice to Have

  • Experience testing:
    • SaaS applications
    • Finance software
    • Healthcare software
    • Enterprise software
  • API testing experience with:
    • Postman
    • RestAssured
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Experience with:
    • GitHub Actions
    • Jenkins
    • GitLab CI
  • Exposure to:
    • Performance testing
    • Security testing
    • Compliance-heavy software environments
  • Experience with Apache JMeter or Locust

Tools & Technology

Jira | TestRail | Zephyr | Azure DevOps | Selenium | Cypress | Playwright | Postman | RestAssured | Apache JMeter | Locust | GitHub Actions | Jenkins | GitLab CI

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

  • Naturally catch edge cases others may overlook
  • Write clear, structured, and reproducible bug reports
  • Balance thorough testing with fast development cycles
  • Think proactively about risks rather than waiting for problems to appear
  • Understand when manual testing versus automation provides the most value
  • Communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Are comfortable challenging assumptions when requirements or expected behavior are unclear
  • Take ownership of product quality from development through release
  • Care about preventing defects rather than simply finding them after the fact

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may start your day by reviewing new requirements and user stories to identify test scenarios, dependencies, and potential edge cases.

Throughout the day, you could write and update test cases, manually test new features, run regression suites, execute automated tests, test APIs, and document bugs.

You’ll collaborate with developers to reproduce and resolve issues, retest fixes, review results from new builds, and maintain test documentation.

As a release approaches, you’ll help validate critical workflows and communicate outstanding defects or risks to engineering and product stakeholders.

In short: you serve as a critical quality gate before release, helping ensure users receive a stable, reliable, and thoroughly tested product.

Key Metrics for Success

  • High defect detection rate before production
  • Strong regression test coverage
  • Increasing automation coverage
  • Fast bug verification and resolution cycles
  • Low number of critical production defects
  • Reliable automated test execution
  • High percentage of releases deployed without severe issues
  • Accurate and complete test documentation
  • Timely identification of release risks
  • Strong stakeholder confidence in product quality

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Direct impact on product and release quality
  • Hands-on exposure to both manual and automated testing
  • Opportunity to work with Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, API testing, and CI/CD
  • Close collaboration with product and engineering teams
  • Opportunity to improve testing processes and automation coverage
  • Exposure across the complete software development lifecycle
  • Fully remote working environment
  • Career growth opportunities into:
    • Senior QA Engineer
    • QA Automation Engineer
    • QA Lead
    • Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET)
    • Quality Engineering Manager

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application
  2. Spark Hire One-Way Video Interview
  3. Video Interview with Pavago Recruiter
  4. Practical Assessment — Test Plan or Sample Bug/Test Case Exercise
  5. Client Interview with QA / Engineering Leadership
  6. Offer & Background Verification

Spark Hire Video Interview – Required

As part of the application process, all candidates are required to complete a one-way video interview through Spark Hire.

After completing the first step of your application, you’ll receive a Spark Hire invitation by email with instructions to record and submit your video responses.

Completion of the Spark Hire video is required to be considered for the next stage. Please check your inbox as well as your spam or junk folder for the invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re a Quality Assurance Engineer or QA Tester with experience in manual testing, automation, Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Jira, or API testing and care deeply about preventing defects before they reach production, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help ensure every release delivers the quality, reliability, performance, and user experience customers expect.

job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
The project moves away from traditional static navigation toward a dynamic, contentdriven "Feed". This is designed to mirror the engagement of social media platforms, providing guests with a curated stream of brand news, exclusive offers, and "Village" updates tailored to their specific interests.

Requirements

Strategy & Planning:

  • End-to-End Test Strategy: Develop the master test plan covering Unit, Functional, Regression, Performance, Security, and Cross-Device testing.

  • NFR & Compliance: Ensure the platform meets strict Non-Functional Requirements, specifically WCAG 2.2 AA Accessibility standards and secure authentication protocols.

  • Test Data & Migration: Define the strategy for validating data migration from legacy systems to the new scalable cloud architecture.

  • Automation Roadmap: Set up the automated testing pipeline integrated into the CI/CD workflow.

Execution & Reporting:

  • Cross-Platform Validation: Lead testing across iOS, Android, and Web to ensure a seamless "feed-first" guest experience.

  • Integration Testing: Verify complex API connections between the core platform and third-party services (Payment Gateways, PIM, DAM, and Analytics).

  • Performance & Load: Execute stress tests to ensure the platform handles high traffic volumes (e.g., during "Drops" or promotional events).

Technical Requirements (must-have):

  • QA Strategy & Leadership: Proven experience leading QA for large-scale B2C platforms (Mobile + Web).

  • Hands on experience in test automation with Playwright (TypeScript), Postman - API

  • Mobile Testing Expertise: Strong experience with geo-targeting, mobile app behavior, and cross-device fragmentation.

  • API & Integration Testing: Expert knowledge of REST API testing and validating third-party integrations (Postman/SoapUI).

  • Accessibility (WCAG): Practical experience testing for WCAG 2.2 AA compliance.

  • Performance Testing: Experience with load testing tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling) to simulate high-traffic scenarios.

  • Automation: Hands-on experience building automated test suites within a CI/CD pipeline (Azure DevOps Security)

  • Mindset: Familiarity with testing OAuth/OpenID

  • Connect and identifying common vulnerabilities.

  • Good communication skills (written and verbal)

  • Jira Proficiency

  • Full time availability, with overlap during 14:00-18:00 - to ensure seamless collaboration with USA based client

Additional Requirements (nice-to-have):

  • Experience with Digital Asset Management (DAM) or PIM systems.

  • Experience in the Luxury Retail or E-commerce sector.

  • Familiarity with Cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure) and auto-scaling validation.

  • Hands on experience with testing AI-based solutions (Python).

Highlights

This role requires writing the strategy and executing the test cases yourself until the team scales.

job.title: AI-Augmented QA Engineer
job.description:
AI-Augmented QA Engineer

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Augmented QA Engineer to own and expand automated testing for an early-stage, fast-moving security platform.

You’ll work closely with frontend and backend engineers to build reliable test coverage, strengthen the existing Playwright test suite, and ensure critical product workflows remain stable as the platform evolves.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you’ll have significant ownership. You’ll receive clear goals around test coverage and reliability rather than step-by-step instructions, making it ideal for someone who enjoys working independently and improving systems proactively.

What You’ll Own

Test Automation & Coverage

  • Write and maintain automated end-to-end tests using Playwright
  • Expand coverage across critical product workflows
  • Build regression tests that run automatically on every pull request
  • Test workflows including dashboards, detection workflows, device management, user permissions, and settings
  • Keep the test architecture clean, maintainable, and scalable as the product grows

Test Infrastructure & Reliability

  • Own the reliability of the automated test suite and CI pipeline
  • Diagnose and reduce flaky tests
  • Manage test data and seed data requirements
  • Monitor and improve staging environment stability
  • Maintain reliable test execution as the product and test suite expand

AI-Assisted Exploratory Testing

  • Use AI-assisted browser automation to explore edge cases and uncover bugs
  • Work with Claude and LLM-based tools as part of daily testing workflows
  • Experiment with AI-driven testing approaches beyond scripted test cases
  • Identify issues that traditional automated regression tests may not catch
  • Continuously explore ways to improve QA efficiency through AI tooling

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work directly with frontend and backend engineers throughout the development cycle
  • Collaborate on testing requirements and critical product flows
  • Communicate test failures, bugs, and reliability issues clearly
  • Contribute to a culture where engineers trust and act on automated test results
  • Take ownership of QA improvements without relying on layers of project management

Requirements

  • 3–5 years of QA, software testing, or test automation experience preferred
  • Candidates with less experience will also be considered if they demonstrate strong automation skills and relevant hands-on experience
  • Strong TypeScript skills and the ability to write clean, maintainable test code
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright, Cypress, or a similar E2E testing framework
  • Strong understanding of web application testing
  • Understanding of DOM interaction, network requests, and asynchronous behavior
  • Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot flaky automated tests
  • Experience creating or maintaining automated regression tests
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of testing goals
  • Strong problem-solving and debugging skills
  • Willingness to learn and use AI tools as part of the testing workflow
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to test reliability

Nice to Have

  • Experience building E2E testing infrastructure from scratch
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI pipelines
  • Experience with test data management, parallelization, and test reporting
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright specifically
  • Experience testing complex B2B web applications
  • Experience with multi-tenant applications and role-based access
  • Experience testing multi-step workflows
  • Familiarity with Claude or other AI/LLM-based development and testing tools
  • Experience working with React applications
  • Familiarity with Sentry, GCP Stackdriver, or similar observability tools

What Makes You a Strong Fit

You’ll thrive in this role if you:

  • Prefer building automated testing systems over relying primarily on manual QA
  • Enjoy improving test coverage and reliability proactively
  • Can work independently from high-level goals
  • Are comfortable diagnosing problems rather than waiting for detailed instructions
  • Have strong curiosity about AI-assisted testing and emerging tools
  • Enjoy working directly with engineers in a small, fast-moving team
  • Care about building test suites that engineers genuinely trust
  • Think beyond individual test cases and consider the reliability of the overall QA system

Tech Stack

  • TypeScript — Test code
  • Playwright — E2E testing framework
  • Claude & AI tooling — AI-assisted exploratory testing
  • React — Frontend application
  • Sentry — Error monitoring
  • GCP Stackdriver — Logging and observability

  2. Client Interview
  3. Final Selection & Onboarding

job.title: Software Engineer in Test (Remote, Greece or Cyprus)
job.description:
At LearnWorlds, we believe learning is the original human superpower, the force that turns knowledge into products, skills, and progress.

Our platform helps creators, educators, and organizations in more than 150 countries turn expertise into scalable learning experiences that sell, teach, and transform. As AI floods the world with information, learning becomes the only countermeasure, the skill that keeps humans creative, relevant, and in control.

The winners won't be those who automate fastest, but those who learn and adapt fastest. They'll need platforms that turn knowledge into teachable systems that scale, and that's exactly what LearnWorlds enables.

Build. Ship. Test. Improve. (Repeat.)

We're redefining how people create and share online learning and we're doing it with engineers who care deeply about product quality, clean architecture, and meaningful impact. We're a remote-first, fast-growing EdTech SaaS with a global footprint.

Our Engineering team builds the core experiences that thousands of educators and learners rely on daily. We move fast, we collaborate tightly, and we're constantly leveling up, both as individuals and as a team.

We're now looking for an experienced Software Engineer in Test to own automation outcomes for assigned product areas. You will build and maintain reliable Playwright and TypeScript automated tests using the Page Object Model (POM) pattern, and help teams decide what should be automated and what should stay manual or exploratory. You'll direct AI Agents daily to plan, generate, debug and maintain automation. It's how the work ships here, not a perk.

You'll join an established and fast-paced environment with a focus on ensuring quality deliveries and exceptional experience to all our users.

If you're a engineer who loves solving real quality challenges, writing maintainable test code, directing AI agents with judgment, and building automation that teams actually trust, this is where you'll do your best work.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own your product area. Join planning before the code exists, while scope, risk, data, and environments are still cheap to change
  • Pick the right layer. API where it's enough, E2E where only a browser will do, smoke for release signal, the cheapest test that still catches the bug
  • Build and evolve the framework. Page objects, flows, typed API clients, fixtures, code other engineers read and extend
  • Work across Product and Engineering. Push for testability while the design is still open, and keep automation useful instead of noisy
  • Design Phase. Formulate efficient and deterministic test scenarios and create comprehensive test strategy plans
  • Own CI e2e. Fast, deterministic, diagnosable. Fix flakiness at the root cause; a rerun is not a fix.
  • Report coverage and risk honestly. What automation covers, what it doesn't, and what still needs manual or exploratory testing.
  • Report defects developers can act on. Identify, categorize, and report bugs and errors to development teams with insightful information (screenshots, traces, error messages, stack traces, etc.), separating product defects from automation defects, environment issues, and data problems
  • Direct AI Agents, then own the output. Plan scope, generate tests, investigate failures and reject what's flaky, unasserted, or five times larger than the task.
  • Build the AI tooling layer. Reusable agent skills, subagent definitions, and the machine-readable convention rules everyone's tests get reviewed against locators, page-object structure, spec placement, test IDs, so generated tests are correct by default.
  • Shape the testing standards, don't just follow them.

Why You'll Love This Role

  • You'll work on real features used by thousands of educators and, most importantly, tens of millions of learners around the world
  • You'll build and evolve test automation that scales with our growing platform and ensures quality at every release
  • You'll be part of a tight-knit team where your ideas matter, and your work directly impacts product quality
  • You'll grow fast—technically and professionally in a team that's generous with knowledge and big on collaboration
  • You'll own meaningful product-area automation, not just isolated test cases, and help teams ship faster
  • You'll work in an engineering culture that treats Agentic AI as a real skill: prompt, steer, review, and ship faster without lowering the bar for test quality

Requirements

Must-Haves

  • At least 3 years of professional experience as a Quality Assurance / Software Testing engineer, with strong automation ownership
  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript and modern JavaScript/TypeScript development practices
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright test automation framework (or a comparable modern web automation framework) and Page Object Model (POM) design pattern
  • Experience with version control systems (Git) and CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar)
  • Excellent analytical thinking to produce and document test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and test strategy plans
  • Comfortable at more than one layer, API, UI, cross-browser, responsive, and able to say which one a given risk belongs to
  • Excellent debugging, problem-solving, and performance optimization skills
  • Close attention to detail and a product-oriented mindset, automation is a tool for product confidence, not the goal by itself
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain technical concepts, coverage, gaps, and remaining risk
  • Team player with the ability to get things done in a non-hierarchical flat organization
  • Excellent prioritization, estimation, and scheduling skills
  • Ability to learn the LearnWorlds platform quickly and connect automation decisions to real customer workflows
  • Proven Agentic AI skills: you regularly use and improve AI agents to complete multi-step test engineering work—planning, generating, debugging, and maintaining automation
  • Strong judgment over AI output: you review, steer, and reject generated tests that are flaky, insecure, poorly structured, or disconnected from real risk

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, or containerized test environments
  • Experience in EdTech, LMS systems, payments, ecommerce, analytics, mobile, or other complex SaaS products
  • Experience with test management tools (TestRail, Zephyr, or similar)
  • Familiarity with cloud technologies like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
  • Experience with backend/API automation beyond UI flows
  • GitHub repos, open-source contributions, or personal projects you're proud of

You'll Thrive Here If You…

  • Prefer ownership over hand-holding and clarity over bureaucracy
  • Think speed and quality can (and should) co-exist
  • Ask "why" before "how," and make decisions with context, not just checklists
  • Love clean code, good architecture, and continuous improvement
  • Embrace feedback, stay curious, and enjoy sharing knowledge
  • Treat AI agents as collaborators you direct with clear intent, not as a shortcut around engineering judgment
  • Believe AI won't replace QA engineers—but engineers who work well with agents will outperform those who don't

Benefits

    • Private life and health insurance plan
    • Fully remote work if you prefer to work from home, apart from when we have team meetings a few times per year
    • Your personal annual training budget
    • An annual home office allowance to set up your personal space
    • Company laptop
    • 23 days of paid time off
    • 3 early summer Fridays in July and August
    • Access to AI tools at work
    • A free LearnWorlds School to build and sell your own courses
    • Company retreats & other onsite team activities (see the video of our latest retreat).

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to own quality for our AI voice virtual agent. This role is for someone who is equally comfortable reasoning about a large language model's behavior and reading a SIP trace.

You should be interested in testing non-deterministic systems. A voice agent takes a live phone call, transcribes speech that may be accented or noisy, interprets intent, reasons over an LLM, generates a spoken reply, and decides whether to resolve the request or hand it to a human—all within a latency budget callers will notice. Nothing in that chain can be validated with a simple assertion of equality, so you will design the evaluation approach that makes it testable anyway.

You should also be interested in the underlying telephony. Testing this agent means placing real calls: provisioning SIP endpoints and softphones, driving calls programmatically, controlling media conditions, and distinguishing a model failure from a codec, jitter, or call-routing issue.

  • PLEASE SUBMIT CV IN ENGLISH.
  • ONLY ACCEPTING CANDIDATES FROM LATAM.
  • ADVANCED SPOKEN ENGLISH IS REQUIRED.

Responsibilities

  • Embed fully within a Scrum team, participating in all ceremonies and maintaining associated artifacts.

  • Own the end-to-end test strategy for the AI voice virtual agent across the LLM, speech, and telephony layers.

  • Design test scenarios for complex conversational behavior, including multi-turn dialogues, interruptions and barge-in, ambiguous or incomplete input, out-of-scope requests, human escalation/transfer, and failure recovery.

  • Build and maintain an evaluation framework for non-deterministic output, leveraging golden datasets, semantic/rubric-based assertions, and automated regression detection for prompt, model, or retrieval changes.

  • Adversarially test the agent against hallucinations, incorrect grounding, guardrail bypasses, prompt injections, and unauthorized disclosure of customer data.

  • Prepare and provision SIP devices, endpoints, and call scenarios to automate call origination end-to-end.

  • Diagnose failures across the entire stack, isolating issues down to the LLM, ASR (speech recognition), TTS (text-to-speech), media path, or call routing layer.

  • Extend automated coverage and integrate test suites into the CI/CD pipeline to serve as release gates.

  • Define and track core quality metrics, including task completion, containment, intent accuracy, transcription accuracy, response latency, and escalation correctness.

  • Maintain documented test coverage in the TMS with full traceability to business requirements.

  • Communicate and escalate quality risks to stakeholders backed by data and evidence.

Requirements:

    • 5+ years in QA, with recent hands-on ownership of a complex, integrated product.

    • Practical experience testing SIP/VoIP systems, including call flows, SIP signaling, media handling, softphones, or SIP trunking, with the ability to troubleshoot using SIP traces or packet captures.

    • Demonstrated creativity in test design (live scenario design will be a core part of the interview process and heavily weighted).

    • Proficiency in Python, sufficient to independently build and maintain automation frameworks.

    • Experience testing non-deterministic or probabilistic systems, with a clear approach to designing assertions for variable outputs.

    • Strong analytical skills, including the ability to define quality metrics, justify their calculation, and use data to back release decisions.

    • Hands-on experience with formal TMS tools and Jira.

    • Professional fluency in English (spoken and written), with reliable overlap with US Eastern business hours.

We use the following technologies:

  • Python with pytest for test automation.

  • Playwright for browser and WebRTC-based call driving.

  • JsSIP / WebRTC for programmatic call origination and media control.

  • SIP softphones and devices for manual and exploratory testing.

  • Allure TestOps as our TMS, linking automated runs to documented test cases.

  • Jira for project management and issue tracking.

  • Jenkins & GitHub Actions for CI/CD pipelines.

  • Grafana for quality and delivery metrics.

  • LLM APIs and evaluation tooling — currently in active development, and we are open to any effective approach.

Pluses:

  • Direct experience testing LLM-based or conversational AI products, including evaluation frameworks and LLM-as-a-judge approaches.

  • Familiarity with speech technologies, including ASR/transcription accuracy measurement (WER), TTS quality assessment, endpointing, and silence detection.

  • Experience with RAG or retrieval-grounded systems, specifically in evaluating grounding correctness and context retrieval.

  • WebRTC and media-layer testing experience, including codec behavior and performance degradation under jitter or packet loss.

  • Background in testing IVR, contact center, or conversational IVR platforms.

  • Multilingual testing capabilities, with emphasis on Spanish/English code-switching.

  • Literacy in prompt engineering, sufficient to analyze system prompts and identify potential failure modes

We are pleased to offer:

  • Remote work opportunity!

  • B2B Employment ($, gross).

  • Stable job with long-term growth perspective.

  • Competitive salary with annual performance review.

  • Really good hardware.

  • An exciting and challenging job with talented people around.

  • Continuous learning and career growth opportunities.

  • Compensation for professional training, seminars, and conferences.

  • Referral program: get rewarded for helping us grow the team with talented people.

  • Company-supported English classes to enhance your professional growth.

Creativity is a core requirement for this role, not a nice-to-have. The defects that matter here are found by someone who imagines the caller who interrupts mid-sentence, switches languages halfway through, gives a partial account number, answers a different question, or deliberately tries to jailbreak the agent. Scenario design is the primary skill we are hiring for.

Current State: We have automated call testing built on JsSIP/WebRTC with Python and Playwright, alongside a growing body of test scenarios. The evaluation layer—how we score responses consistently, catch regressions when a prompt or model changes, and report quality metrics leadership can act on—is where this role will have the most impact.

About us:

IDT Technologies is a part of IDT Corporation—an American telecommunications company founded in 1990 and headquartered in New Jersey. It is an industry leader in prepaid communication and payment services and one of the world's largest international voice carriers. We are listed on the NYSE, employ over 1,500 people across 20+ countries, and have revenues in excess of $1.5 billion.

Net2Phone () is a global provider of unified cloud communications solutions. It offers an integrated communications suite featuring powerful collaboration tools, including voice, messaging, chat, and unlimited domestic and international calling to 23+ countries.

job.title: Payment Integrations & Technical QA Manager
job.description:
We are an international broker. Our clients fund and withdraw through roughly 60 payment methods across Asia, Africa, LATAM and the Middle East.

Payments Product is a standalone function, and we are building the team around it. This is an early core hire.

We are looking for a Payment Integration Manager who will own payment integrations end to end: from the technical call with a provider through to stable production. You will also be the first line on every payment incident, and the person who decides whether a new integration is ready to go live.

This is a technical operations role rather than a coordination one.

Your responsibilities will be:

Running the full onboarding cycle for new payment providers: first technical call, credentials and sandbox access, configuration, test design, UAT, production launch and post-release stabilisation

Owning first-line response for payment incidents, including failed and stuck transactions, unconfirmed payments and method-level anomalies, and driving them to resolution rather than passing them on

Defining the acceptance standard for new integrations and holding the go or no-go decision before launch

Reading provider API documentation and turning it into implementation-ready specifications for engineering, including edge cases, failure paths and confirmation model behaviour

Running hands-on verification: manual checkout testing on mobile and desktop, callback verification through Postman, and SQL queries against transaction data

Maintaining the catalogue of payment methods and providers: what each supports, which integration types are available, what has been tested and where known failure modes sit

Building the first capability inventory of all live methods and providers

Later, producing a 90-day breakdown of deposit attempts by outcome: completed, declined by the provider, abandoned by the user, abandoned at redirect, and completed but never confirmed back to us

Requirements

What you'll need:

4+ years in payments, PSP integrations or fintech platforms, with hands-on ownership of integrations rather than tracking them, basic knowledge using AI tooling in daily work

Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks and asynchronous payment status, plus an understanding of confirmation models, callback mechanics, redirect flows and common failure modes

The ability to read a provider API specification and identify what is missing from it

Postman or equivalent for API testing, and structured checkout testing across mobile and desktop

Experience diagnosing a live payment incident from logs and API responses, separating provider-side causes from platform-side causes, and explaining the finding to both a provider contact and an engineer

The ability to turn ambiguous provider documentation and undocumented knowledge into specifications and catalogues that engineering can act on

Composure during incidents, and clear communication with the team and stakeholders

English and Russian at working level. Both are in daily use

Will be a significant plus:

Experience with APM and local rails in Asia, Africa or LATAM rather than cards alone

Experience with bank transfer rails, virtual accounts, QR-based methods, mobile money etc.

Background in brokerage, crypto payments, orchestration or another high-volume payments environment; on the provider side, at a PSP, gateway or payment company

Active use of AI tooling in daily work

Ability to work independently and make decisions without constant oversight

Proactive mindset: willingness to propose improvements, fixes, new approaches

What the first year looks like:

In the first months you take over incident first line, build the method and provider catalogue from documentation, existing knowledge and direct querying, and produce the deposit attempt analysis.

By mid-year you have defined the integration acceptance standard and applied it to a live provider onboarding from start to production.

In the second half the catalogue is current, the gate is running, and incidents reach you for decisions rather than for explanations. As the team grows, a Systems Analyst takes over formal verification while the acceptance gate stays with you.

Recruitment process:

HR interview, covering background, motivation and fit

Technical interview on payment integration knowledge, tooling and hands-on experience, including incident diagnosis

Product and problem-solving interview, covering integration decisions and prioritisation

Final interview with senior stakeholders

Benefits

We offer:

Fixed monthly compensation of [depending on experience]

Fully remote work within GMT to GMT+4, with no relocation required

End-to-end ownership of a provider from first call to production, and the go or no-go decision on every integration

Scope that grows with the business: cards, alternative payment methods, a card programme and new entities

Corporate AI tooling as part of the working process

Invest in your future with a company that will invest in YOU!

The Application Software Tester is responsible to ensure the quality and functionality of software applications before applications and updates are released for use by the business. The primary objective is to identify defects, bugs, and potential usability issues so that the team can address and resolve them before the software goes live and released to end-users. The Application Software Tester primary responsibilities are ensuring that testing activities allow applications to meet business requirements, systems goals, fulfill end-user requirements, and identify and resolve systems issues. This role will take an active role in cross-departmental projects as needed. The Application Software Tester will collaborate with analysts, designers, cross-functional business teams, and system owners in the testing of new software programs and applications. This will allow them to ensure that any new software integration into company systems meets functional requirements, system compliance, and interface specifications. The Application Software Testing will be responsible for creating, reviewing, and maintaining testing strategies to improve the Organizations testing processes using a combination of user advocacy, best practices, and post-deployment reviews.

Job Details:

  • Remote Opportunity!

  • Evaluate, document, develop, and deploy testing techniques for applications, products, and/or enhancements to existing applications throughout their development/product lifecycles.

  • Reviewing and understanding the software requirements and specifications provided by the development team or stakeholders, executing test scripts, cases, and scenarios that will determine optimal system performance according to specifications.

job.description:
Mashreq Bank

JOB DESCRIPTION

1

Job Title

AVP – Lead, QA & Proofing Unit

Department

Operations GRC

Direct Supervisor

Head – Internal Controls, Operations GRC

Job Number

2

Job Purpose

To lead the Quality Assurance and Proofing Unit under the Enterprise Reconciliation Framework (ERF), ensuring robust control oversight and assurance over reconciliation lifecycle activities across Operations and Business units. This role will provide independent validation, exception monitoring, and follow-up closure of outstanding reconciliation items. It will serve as the 1.5 Line of Defense, with an enterprise-wide mandate covering all reconciliation types (manual, semi-automated, automated) and platforms including TLM. The role ensures that reconciliation quality and closure processes are consistently applied and monitored, with clear escalation mechanisms.

3

Dimensions

Scope of work

  • Oversight of enterprise-wide reconciliation proofing, covering:

  • Nostro/Vostro

  • Inter-branch accounts

  • Sundry & suspense GLs

  • Internal accounts

  • VAT reconciliation

  • Independent review of reconciliation breaks across all platforms (automated/manual

  • Escalation and closure follow-up of breaks beyond T+3 days (auto) / agreed timelines (manual)

  • Thematic reviews, exception trend reporting, and root cause analysis

Service Level Management

  • Track adherence to reconciliation closure timelines (T+3, etc.)

  • Maintain performance dashboards with metrics across divisions and platforms

  • Set up QA KPIs aligned with ERF and Group Operations KRIs

  • Establish early warning triggers for high-risk or aging items

Quality Review

  • Monthly quality assurance sampling of reconciled items

  • Tracking accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of proofing controls

  • Raising exceptions to the CRU head and relevant BU operations for resolution

  • Conducting periodic health-checks aligned with audit and GRC guidelines

Key Interfaces

  • Internal: CRU head, Ops unit heads, Finance (CAD), Technology, Risk, Compliance

  • External: Audit (Internal & External), Regulators (for proofing expectations), IBG Ops Heads

  • Represent in Operations GRC Risk Councils, FROC and other governance forums

4

Key Result Areas

  • % of reconciliations reviewed as part of QA plan per quarter across all account categories
  • Reduction in aged unreconciled items (>180 and >360 days).
  • Reduction in outstanding >T+3 items across platforms
  • % adherence to reconciliation policy and internal controls.
  • No. of thematic issues identified and resolved via QA testing
  • Timely and accurate reconciliation attestation and proofing validations.
  • Platform enhancements delivered and automated rules adoption.
  • SLA adherence across business units and international/overseas branches.
  • Successful internal audit and risk reviews with minimal or no observations.
  • Quality of audit feedback for proofing-related controls
  • No overdue proofing validations.

5

Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships

  • Operates independently from the CRU but in close coordination
  • Enterprise-wide scope across Group Operations and Business Units
  • Covers both UAE and international operations including Egypt, Pakistan, India, and IBG branches
  • Maintains reporting line into GRC – not embedded within the CRU to preserve independent assurance role
  • Aligned with ERF governance manual, APPM, ORM Guidelines and reporting templates.
  • Works within a cross-functional, multi-country environment.
  • Expected to define and enforce centralized standards and controls while balancing local branch needs.
  • Works with constrained resources in a transformation phase and must effectively build team capacity.

Working Relationships

Directly interfaces with:

  • Head of CRU and his leadership team
  • Matrix relationships with - Audit, Risk, Compliance, CAD & Tax teams
  • Operations GRC leads in Egypt, India, Pakistan

6

Problem Solving

  • Recommend remediation plans for recurring proofing issues.

  • Diagnose systemic control weaknesses across reconciliation processes and recommend design enhancements.

  • Address recurring break trends and implement data-driven remediation plans across business and product lines.

  • Resolve conflicts or accountability gaps between Operations, Finance, and Technology teams on account ownership and reconciliation execution.

  • Mitigate regulatory and audit risks related to unreconciled balances by ensuring preventive and detective controls are in place.

  • Identify pattern-based failures or non-adherence to reconciliation SLAs

  • Drive cross-functional resolution forums for persistent items

  • Challenge ownership decisions or business rationales where reconciliation breaks are not justified

7

Decision Making Authority & Responsibility

  • Escalate aging/unjustified open items directly to Head of OpEx & GRC or Head of Central Accounts.

  • Recommend suspension of automated recon processes if persistent QA failures occur

  • Approve monthly QA plans and thematic review scope

  • Raise and track Corrective Action Plans (CAPs) jointly with Operations heads.

  • Approve or Reject proofing certifications.
