job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
About ThriveCart

ThriveCart is a powerful platform used by over 50,000 people worldwide to generate over $5B in sales. Included within the ThriveCart platform is a learning management system (LMS), affiliate management, cart and checkout functionality, making it a top solution for creators, coaches, consultants, and other businesses.

We integrate with everything you use and have a simple, clean UI with numerous features that allow customers to build income from existing traffic and we are the highest-converting cart for online businesses. Our business is growing, profitable, and backed by LTV SaaS Growth Funds, and we are looking to expand our footprint amongst online businesses.

Location

Remote (Latin America)

Job Overview:

You'll own quality end-to-end for ThriveCart's e-commerce platform — test strategy, automation, defect prevention, and production health monitoring. This isn't a click-through-test-cases role: you own quality for your domain.

AI is a core part of the workflow here, not a bonus skill — for generating test cases, creating test data, drafting test plans, and accelerating automation. What we're hiring for is judgment: knowing which tests actually matter, understanding risk, and thinking critically about AI-generated output.

This description spans L1–L4. Interview depth and expectations scale with level — see Qualifications & Expectations by Level below.

What You'll Own:

Test Strategy & Planning

  • Own the quality strategy for your features and domain: test plans, risk assessment, coverage decisions
  • Flag ambiguities and testability gaps during requirements review, before code is written — shift-left quality
  • Define acceptance criteria in partnership with Product
  • Balance manual exploration with automated regression coverage
  • Document test plans, coverage decisions, and known risk areas for async visibility across the team

Test Automation

  • Write and maintain automated tests (API, integration, end-to-end) using the team's frameworks
  • Keep automation suites fast, reliable, and maintainable — flaky tests are yours to fix, not ignore
  • Maintain CI/CD integration for test execution
  • L3+: Design and evolve the overall test automation architecture

Production Quality & Incident Response

  • Monitor features in production using observability tools — quality doesn't end at release
  • Respond to dev-escalations and incidents with urgency: assess blast radius, run targeted regression testing, help isolate root cause, communicate findings clearly
  • L3+: Own incident response from the quality side — lead triage, coordinate regression testing, write post-mortems with defect analysis, drive preventive fixes
  • L4+: Coordinate all QA activity during major incidents, communicate to stakeholders, ensure systemic fixes are validated before release

AI-Augmented QA (Expected, Not Optional)

  • Use AI tools daily: generating test cases and data, drafting test plans, analyzing bug patterns, accelerating automation writing
  • AI will generate more test cases than you need — prioritize ruthlessly based on risk
  • Review all AI-generated test output critically: AI has no product context, you do
  • L3+: Teach junior QAs effective AI workflows for testing; establish team AI quality standards
  • L4+: Set team standards for AI tool usage — evaluate tools, measure impact on coverage and velocity

Defect Advocacy & Communication

  • Write clear, reproducible bug reports that developers can act on immediately
  • Advocate for quality: flag risks before release, document known issues, be explicit about what is and isn't tested
  • L3+: Partner with Product and Engineering on quality metrics, track trends

Collaboration

  • Work closely with developers to improve testability at the code level
  • Help developers write better unit tests by identifying untested scenarios
  • L3+: Mentor L1/L2 QAs on testing mindset, automation skills, and risk thinking

What You Bring To This Role:

Technical Environment

  • Testing: API testing (Postman/REST clients), browser automation (Playwright), unit/integration test frameworks
  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions (tests run on every PR)
  • Observability: AWS CloudWatch, application logs, metrics dashboards
  • Platform stack: PHP/TypeScript, Ruby/TypeScript, MariaDB, Redis, AWS
  • Playwright is our standard framework for browser automation — what matters most is strong testing fundamentals

Must-haves:

  • Strong testing fundamentals — test strategy, test case design, risk-based prioritization
  • Hands-on automation experience with Playwright
  • Comfortable with API testing (Postman/REST clients) and reading application logs
  • Already using — or genuinely motivated to use — AI tools in a QA workflow
  • Clear written communication: bug reports and test plans others can act on without a meeting

Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience testing an e-commerce, payments, or subscription platform
  • Familiarity with PHP, TypeScript, or Ruby codebases
  • AWS/CloudWatch or similar observability tooling
  • GitHub Actions or another CI/CD pipeline

Qualifications & Expectations by Level

  • L1 (Junior QA) — 0–1 yrs: Executes test plans, writes simple automation with guidance, reports bugs clearly. Bootcamp, internship, or early professional QA experience is fine — we're hiring for rigor and curiosity over tenure. Uses AI to learn faster and generate test cases; validates all AI output.
  • L2 (QA Engineer 1) — 1–3 yrs: Has independently owned quality for a feature or product area — not just extended someone else's test plan or suite, but built one. Writes comprehensive test plans and automation, and responds to incidents with targeted testing.
  • L3 (Senior QA) — 3–6 yrs: Has led incident response from the QA side and mentored other QAs. Owns quality strategy for complex projects, improves automation architecture and infrastructure, and uses AI to multiply output rather than just speed up individual tasks.
  • L4 (Lead QA) — 6+ yrs: Has set QA standards or practices for a team, not just followed them. Serves as the quality authority for a domain, drives major incident response, and partners with leadership on quality metrics and AI tooling strategy.

Success Metrics

  • 30 days: First test plan written and approved, first automated tests in CI pipeline, understands the most critical user journeys
  • 60 days: Independently owning quality for a feature, automation suite stable, first incident response contribution
  • 90 days: Contributing to test strategy discussions, handling dev-escalations independently in your area

On-Call

Shared rotation with engineering (~1 week/month after ramp-up). QA on-call focuses on blast radius assessment and regression testing during incidents.

Career Path

Junior QA → QA Engineer 1 → Senior QA → Lead QA → Head of Quality

Learn More About ThriveCart:

job.title: Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
job.description:
Semi-Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
Full-time contractor · Fully remote · Latin America only

Cloudnonic is an international, fully remote cloud and software company. We build customized cloud-native systems for clients in Europe and North America, and we're looking for a Semi-Senior QA engineer to join the team.

Who we are

Cloudnonic Corp. is a digitally native software and cloud startup based in the Kitchener/Waterloo area, Ontario, Canada. We're fully remote, with developers in Canada and South America and clients across Europe, North America, and South America. We work across healthcare, finance, construction, and manufacturing, and we take the time to understand each client's industry so we can serve it well with technology.

We're big on AI and the cloud. Our services range from app and web development to AI and cloud integration, plus technology consulting: designing feasible, secure, cost-effective architectures for non-technical clients and advising them on their tech stack.

The role

You'll test across multiple client projects, each with its own platform, users, and quirks. You'll need to understand a new platform quickly and see it the way its end users do: what they expect, where they get confused, and what breaks when they do something nobody planned for.

We ship weekly, from development to staging to production. You'll be the quality gate in between. That includes regression testing: running the same core flows release after release, carefully, every time. If repetition bores you, this isn't the right fit. If you see it as the job that protects users, it is.

We deliver AI-first. AI generates our tickets and acceptance criteria, we pair with AI while developing, and every pull request goes through AI review before a senior engineer reviews it. That makes us fast, and it makes QA more important, not less. We expect you to use AI to generate test cases, draft scripts, and speed up automation, and to know where it falls short: an AI-written test can pass while missing the bug a real user would hit. You need to judge whether a test actually proves something. If you can only run the tests an AI wrote for you, this isn't the role for you.

You'll work closely with developers and project managers, and you'll keep moving our testing forward by adopting new automation tools as they appear. Expect to be challenged constantly, and to enjoy the work along the way.

What you'll do

  • Test new features and bug fixes across multiple client projects before they reach production
  • Run regression testing on core user flows for every release
  • Write clear test cases and test scripts based on acceptance criteria
  • Build and maintain automated tests using modern tools, including AI-powered testing tools
  • Report bugs with precise reproduction steps, expected vs. actual behavior, and evidence
  • Evaluate features from the end user's perspective and flag usability issues, not only functional ones
  • Work independently while keeping the team informed

We're looking for a self-starter who organizes their own day. We trust you to prioritize your week and keep everyone updated as you go.

Requirements

Language

  • Fluent Spanish
  • Advanced English (able to discuss issues with the team and clients)

Technical

  • 2+ years of full-time QA experience
  • Strong attention to detail
  • Ability to learn new platforms quickly
  • Experience writing test cases and test scripts
  • Basic technical background: browser developer tools, API testing (e.g., Postman), and basic scripting in JavaScript or TypeScript
  • Experience with test automation tools such as Playwright or Cypress
  • Experience using AI tools in daily work, including for QA (test generation, test case design, automation)
  • Experience with issue trackers (we use Linear)
  • Experience with Agile methodologies

Bonus

  • Experience testing healthcare or other regulated software
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Fluent English (B2+)
  • Strong written and oral communication

What we offer

  • Fully remote: work from home or anywhere you choose
  • Competitive pay: rates that compete with the best in the Latin American market, tailored to your seniority and skills, paid in the currency you prefer
  • Crypto payment available on request
  • Full-time contractor: you manage your own finances
  • Flexible hours: we work across time zones and trust you to get your work done on your schedule
  • Company culture: no rigid hierarchy; hard work and enjoying the journey are not in conflict
  • Gaming: online games with colleagues over Discord is a regular thing here
  • Broad technical exposure: many platforms and challenges in a short time; you won't get bored in the same project
  • International clients: US, Canada, Germany, and beyond, with the languages and cultures that come with them
  • Professional development: sponsored online courses and certifications on demand
  • Career development: build expertise across industries, not only in testing

Interested?

If this sounds like you and you meet the minimum requirements, apply.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Performance Test Engineer with at least 5 years of hands-on experience in designing performance testing frameworks and developing test scripts using Selenium and LoadRunner. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in performance and stress testing for complex web applications, particularly those involving dynamic elements, multi-window interactions, and enterprise workflows. Experience with IBM MREF (formerly known as IBM TRIRIGA, an Integrated Workplace Management System), Maximo Application Suite (MAS), or similar enterprise systems is advantageous but not mandatory. This role involves building robust, scalable performance testing solutions to ensure the efficiency, scalability, and reliability of our applications under various load conditions.

  • Design, develop, and maintain performance testing frameworks from scratch or enhance existing ones using JMeter, ensuring reusability, scalability, and maintainability for load, stress, endurance, and spike testing.

  • Implement best practices for test data management, correlation of dynamic values, parameterization, error handling, reporting, and logging to support efficient debugging and execution.

Required Qualifications and Skills

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in performance testing, with proven expertise in Selenium and LoadRunner.

· Strong programming skills in Java.

  • Solid understanding of performance metrics (e.g., latency, throughput, error rates), monitoring tools (e.g., PerfMon, Grafana), and profiling techniques for Java-based applications (e.g., JVM tuning, heap analysis).

﻿· Solid understanding to other performance tools such as LoadRunner, Gatling, or NeoLoad for comparative or hybrid testing.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps, and version control systems like Git.
  • Knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and defect tracking tools (e.g., JIRA).
  • Excellent problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently or in a team.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience performance testing enterprise applications like IBM MREF (formerly TRIRIGA), MAS, or similar IWMS/asset management systems.
  • Understanding of API performance testing (e.g., using JMeter's HTTP samplers or RestAssured) to complement UI-based load testing.
  • Certifications in performance testing (e.g., ISTQB Performance Testing Specialist) or JMeter-specific training.
  • Prior experience in domains like facilities management, real estate, or asset management software, with knowledge of monitoring tools like AppDynamics, Dynatrace, or New Relic for end-to-end analysis.

job.title: Senior SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)
job.description:
The Company

2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 50 Canada Recipient & Fast 500 North America Recipient 🏆
SpryPoint is modernizing how utilities serve their communities. As a high-growth software company, we're shaking up the status quo in the utility industry with the first and only truly cloud-native customer service and operations platform purpose-built for modern utilities.
Founded by industry veterans in 2011, we've grown from a profitable startup to a rapidly scaling company of 300+ employees serving 100+ utility clients across North America and the Caribbean. Our mission is simple: utility leaders should expect more from their technology providers.
Utilities face urgent demand to replace inefficient legacy systems while managing increasing operational complexity, and evolving customer expectations. With more than a decade of experience, and a track record of successful implementations spanning water, electric, and gas utilities, SpryPoint has built a reputation as a trusted and mission-critical partner to utilities across North America.
We deliver comprehensive solutions including SpryCIS, SpryEngage, SpryMobile, and SpryWallet that modernize the entire meter-to-cash process. What sets us apart? Our "updates, not upgrades" approach, user-centric design, and unwavering focus on customer success.
Backed by strategic investment from Norwest Venture Partners since 2023, and an exciting new investment partnership from Insight Partners announced in 2026, we're accelerating our growth while staying true to our core values: lead with kindness, vision with impact, radical honesty, bold disruption, keep it simple, and execute with excellence.
Join our award-winning team in transforming an essential industry that powers communities across the Americas.

We are looking for a Senior SDET to help build our test automation from the ground up. You will design the framework, write the automated tests that give us confidence to ship, and bring modern AI-assisted tooling into how we work. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who codes like a developer but is driven by quality.

You will be one of the first engineers on a new team, so the patterns you set will shape how the whole organization tests. You will work closely with the QA Engineering Manager and with developers across product squads.

In your first 90 days, the automation framework will be in place, with a proof-of-concept suite running in CI on our highest-risk flows. By six months, you'll have meaningful automated coverage of critical user journeys, a low flaky-test rate, and faster feedback on every change. Ongoing, you'll maintain a trusted, maintainable suite: applying AI tooling where it genuinely saves time, with other engineers picking up the patterns you set.

What You Will Do

  • Design and build the test automation framework and the standards other engineers will follow.
  • Write and maintain automated tests across the stack: API, integration, and end-to-end UI.
  • Prioritize automation by risk and value, favoring fast, reliable API-level tests over brittle UI tests where possible.
  • Integrate tests into CI/CD so they run automatically on every change and give fast feedback.
  • Drive down flakiness and keep the suite trustworthy, so failures mean something.
  • Evaluate and apply AI-assisted testing tools (test generation, self-healing tests, failure triage), and use AI and prompt engineering to accelerate test creation and edge-case discovery.
  • Review AI-generated tests and code with a critical eye (you are the human-in-the-loop, not a rubber stamp).
  • Mentor other engineers on automation practices and help raise testing quality across squads

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in software test automation or software engineering with a strong testing focus.
  • Strong coding skills in at least one of: Python, Java, JavaScript, TypeScript.
  • Deep experience with a modern automation framework (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium) including building or owning a framework, not just writing tests inside one.
  • Solid API testing experience (Postman, REST Assured, or similar) and comfort with SQL and database validation.
  • Hands-on experience integrating tests into CI/CD (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI).
  • Working knowledge of cloud (AWS) and containers (Docker).
  • A pragmatic, risk-based mindset and the judgement to know what's worth automating.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants or AI test-generation tools in real work (GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar), with a clear view of their strengths and limits.
  • Comfort writing effective prompts to generate test ideas, edge cases, and to analyze failures.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Claude and Claude Code.
  • Experience setting up test automation from scratch on a team that had little automation before.
  • Performance testing (k6 / JMeter) or security testing exposure.
  • Experience in a regulated or high-reliability domain (utilities, fintech, healthcare, or similar.

This is a great chance to meet with the Director of Software Engineering and dive deep into your career goals, work experience, and how we can support your growth. We encourage you to ask questions to learn more about the opportunity.

You'll walk the team through your technical assignment and showcase your skills. This is also a great opportunity to meet more of the team and see if there's a strong team fit!

🚀 Stage 5: References and Offer

We'll check your references to confirm all the great things we've learned about you. If all goes well, we’ll be thrilled to extend an offer and welcome you to the team!

💫 Expect More From Your Career at SpryPoint

💰 Competitive Total Rewards - Comprehensive compensation package that grows with you

job.title: Web/App Test Engineer
job.description:
Binance is a leading global blockchain ecosystem behind the world’s largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume and registered users. We are trusted by 300+ million people in 100+ countries for our industry-leading security, user fund transparency, trading engine speed, deep liquidity, and an unmatched portfolio of digital-asset products. Binance offerings range from trading and finance to education, research, payments, institutional services, Web3 features, and more. We leverage the power of digital assets and blockchain to build an inclusive financial ecosystem to advance the freedom of money and improve financial access for people around the world.

Role Overview

Responsible for end-to-end quality assurance across Web and App (mobile) surfaces — combining automated and exploratory testing to ensure product stability, compatibility, and interaction experience from the user's perspective. The core requirement is cross-platform testing capability (Web + App), with the ability to design and maintain an automated testing system and to think deeply about troubleshooting and user-experience-oriented quality.

In one sentence: This role is the quality gatekeeper for Web/App products — someone who can write automation scripts, test interaction experiences, investigate data issues, and use engineering methods to replace manual testing with systematic automated quality coverage. Not a manual tester — a QA engineer with real coding ability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and maintain comprehensive Web/App test cases and test plans covering functionality, compatibility, and interaction
  • Develop and maintain UI/API automated tests using Java, Python, or JavaScript to ensure high coverage and reliability
  • Combine automation and manual exploratory testing to validate user scenarios and discover potential experience issues
  • Perform root cause analysis on test failures and production issues, and drive fixes to closure
  • Identify blind spots in test coverage and continuously improve automation effectiveness
  • Participate in testing for new features — define expected behaviors, system impact, and risk points from a user-experience perspective
  • Conduct App compatibility testing across devices, OS versions, and screen sizes, as well as Web cross-browser and cross-resolution testing
  • Participate in performance testing (page load time, App cold start / warm start, etc.) and ensure stability under high-concurrency and weak-network scenarios

Requirements

  • Strong coding ability in at least one of Java, Python, or JavaScript (live coding assessment required)
  • Extensive Web/App automation testing experience with tools such as Selenium, Appium, Playwright, etc.
  • Solid understanding of Web/App testing methodologies and automation framework design
  • Proficiency in SQL for data validation and issue troubleshooting
  • Proven root cause analysis ability to solve complex quality problems
  • Familiarity with Web front-end technologies (HTML/CSS/JS) and mobile platform fundamentals (Android/iOS architecture and characteristics)
  • Experience building testing tools, platforms, or quality infrastructure

Ideal Candidate Profile

    Background:

  • 1–5 years of QA or test development experience, including at least 1 year of Web or App automation testing
  • Strong coding skills — able to write code from scratch, not just scripts
  • Proficient in SQL for independent data validation and troubleshooting
  • Hands-on mobile or Web testing experience
    • Core Competencies:
  • Automation capability: Can design and develop automation frameworks, not just use existing tools
  • Root cause analysis: Can trace test failures or production issues back to their root cause
  • SQL & data validation: Can write complex SQL to verify data consistency and troubleshoot data-related bugs
  • Cross-platform understanding: Understands Web/App architecture, including front-end/back-end interaction, network requests, cache mechanisms, and WebView
  • UX sensitivity: Can identify experience issues from the user's perspective, not just whether functionality works
  • Test tooling: Experience building test platforms, tools, or quality infrastructure
  • Collaboration drive: Can push developers to fix issues rather than passively waiting

    • Soft Skills:

  • Rigorous and detail-oriented
  • "Destructive thinking" mindset — adept at finding system weaknesses
  • Strong communication — bridges developers and product managers
  • Quality ownership mentality — treats quality as personal responsibility

Bonus Points

  • Payment, transaction, or financial system QA experience
  • AI tooling usage experience
  • Crypto / Web3 industry background
  • Hands-on App compatibility testing experience using cloud device platforms such as Testin or WeTest
  • Weak-network testing experience using tools such as Charles or Fiddler

Why Binance

• Shape the future with the world’s leading blockchain ecosystem
• Collaborate with world-class talent in a user-centric global organization with a flat structure
• Tackle unique, fast-paced projects with autonomy in an innovative environment
• Thrive in a results-driven workplace with opportunities for career growth and continuous learning
• Competitive salary and company benefits
• Work-from-home arrangement (the arrangement may vary depending on the work nature of the business team)

Who we are

At Fluxon, we believe that how you build matters as much as what you build. We help businesses navigate their most important technology decisions with confidence, and take responsibility for seeing them through. Founded by ex-Googlers and startup veterans, we’re proud to partner with teams behind some of the most ambitious products, including Google, OpenAI, Anthropic, Walmart and Stripe.

Our work spans strategy, design, and engineering — often in complex, AI-driven environments — where clarity, speed and quality are the standard. We use AI intentionally, applying it only where it adds real value and expands what’s possible. Care shapes everything we do.

Inside Fluxon, you’ll find a global, remote-first team of experienced builders, who are curious, kind and serious about their craft. We’re building a place where people can take ownership, solve problems that matter and do work they’re proud to stand behind. If you want to do your best work alongside people who care as much as you do, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

You are an architect for quality with the vision to define and build QA processes for any sort of app. You can work at any company in the world, but you choose us because you want to use your versatility and "nose for bugs" to solve new and interesting challenges. You are a champion of quality on multi-disciplined teams, blending a deep understanding of user experience with a technical approach to breaking systems.

You are a thought partner to developers and product managers — someone who doesn't just find bugs but identifies systematic gaps. You are brilliant yet humble; a doer with high integrity who takes ownership of quality and enjoys a full life outside of work.

If this sounds like you, we would love to chat!

Note: This position is fully remote and open to candidates based anywhere in Poland or Portugal.

Key responsibilities

  • Define and evolve the end-to-end QA strategy and processes for entire products, determining the most effective manual techniques to ensure "world-class" standards of quality
  • Plan and perform exploratory and manual testing for complex features, going beyond specifications to ensure the user experience is intuitive and seamless
  • Be the champion and source-of-truth for quality, helping both internal teams and clients identify systematic quality gaps while building processes to close them. Evangelize "quality at the source" across the development lifecycle
  • Own the documentation and reporting of quality metrics and bug tracking, ensuring the product team, engineers, and clients have clear visibility into project health
  • Partner with the PMs and TPMs to define acceptance criteria and manage release approvals
  • Lead cross-functional investigations into complex quality issues, driving them through to resolution with engineering and product teams

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in testing complex web, mobile, and API-based applications
  • 2+ years of experience acting as a sole QA leading a project, with the ability to build a testing strategy from a blank slate
  • A "nose for bugs" and the manual testing skills to break an app in ways a script might miss. You understand user experience as much as code
  • Strong understanding of client-server architecture, modern engineering stacks, and the ability to use DevTools and API clients (like Postman) to perform deep technical audits
  • Practical understanding of how manual testing fits into a modern CI/CD pipeline and the ability to collaborate on release cycles
  • Proficiency at maintaining test documentation and communicating test results to key stakeholders
  • A mindset for risk-based testing, with the ability to clearly articulate technical risks and quality tradeoffs to both engineers and non-technical stakeholders
  • A proactive personality who learns quickly while working independently and is always looking for ways to improve the "how" of building software
  • Upper-Intermediate level of written and spoken English

What we offer

  • Remote-first, flexible work with a budget to set up a work space that works for you
  • Localized healthcare coverage to support you and your family’s wellbeing
  • Flexible paid time off with a minimum of 3 weeks per year (plus holidays)
  • "No internal meetings" Fridays, so you can focus on deep, uninterrupted work
  • A professional growth budget for learning that matters to you – whether it’s developing your technical skills or learning a new language
  • A monthly wellness allowance to support your physical and mental health
  • Annual company offsites, where we gather in person to build meaningful connections
  • A competitive salary that reflects your expertise, impact and experience
  • Profit-sharing, so you can benefit directly from the value we build together
  • A paid sabbatical program, designed for rest, renewal and fresh perspective

job.title: Senior QA Engineer
job.description:
This is a remote position.

Embrace Healthcare Group powers some of the most innovative healthcare technology solutions in North America, with a focus on enhancing clinical efficiency and compliance across emergency care settings.

EPOWERdoc, a leading SaaS platform within the Embrace Healthcare Group portfolio, specializes in Emergency Department Information Systems (EDIS) tailored for hospitals of all sizes. Designed by clinicians for clinicians, EPOWERdoc streamlines emergency room documentation with intuitive workflows, customizable templates, peer-reviewed clinical content, and real-time coding assistance—helping providers reduce documentation time and focus more on patient care.

We’re looking for a Senior QA Engineer to build EPOWERdoc’s next-generation quality engineering practice, AI-native from day one. This is a hands-on builder role: you’ll choose and architect our test automation stack, write much of the code yourself, and use AI coding agents every day to design, generate, maintain, and triage tests.

You’ll also own how we test AI itself. You’ll design the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that show EPOWERdoc’s AI-powered capabilities are accurate, safe, and dependable enough for an emergency department. You’ll partner closely with developers, product managers, designers, and clinical content experts.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead QA strategy: Own the end-to-end quality strategy for EPOWERdoc, defining test plans, risk-based coverage goals, and quality gates for every release.
  • Architect the QA tech stack: Evaluate, select, and document the tooling for UI, API, performance, accessibility, and security testing, recording each decision and its trade-offs in architecture decision records.
  • Build automation and expand coverage: Design and maintain scalable test frameworks for web applications, APIs, and integrations. Set standards clear enough that engineers and AI agents can extend them reliably. Use these frameworks to replace manual regression with automated coverage of critical clinical workflows such as triage, documentation, orders, and discharge.
  • Performance and reliability: Build load, stress, and soak tests that model real emergency department peak volumes, establish performance baselines, and catch regressions before they reach production.
  • Own CI/CD quality: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines so every pull request and build is validated quickly. Use parallel execution and AI-assisted test impact analysis to keep feedback loops short as the suite grows.
  • Defect management: Work with engineering teams to identify, document, prioritise, and resolve defects early in the development lifecycle, and drive root-cause analysis.
  • Exploratory testing: Lead exploratory testing of new features and complex clinical user flows, combining human judgement with AI-driven exploration where automation alone adds less value.
  • Agile partnership: Bring a quality perspective to sprint planning, refinement, and retrospectives, including estimates, acceptance criteria, and release readiness.
  • Quality advocacy: Champion a quality-first culture from code reviews to release management. Report on quality metrics and trends such as escaped defects, flakiness, and test cycle time.
  • Security and compliance: Ensure testing practices, test data, and the use of AI tools meet HIPAA and healthcare data security standards, with no real PHI in test environments or AI prompts.
AI-NATIVE QUALITY ENGINEERING
AI is part of how this team works every day. In this role you will:
  • AI-assisted test design: Use LLMs to turn user stories, acceptance criteria, and clinical specifications into test scenarios, edge cases, and boundary conditions, then review and sharpen them with sound test-design judgement.
  • Agentic test authoring: Use AI coding agents and Playwright’s MCP server and test agents (planner, generator, and healer) to create and maintain automated tests. Hold generated code to the same review and quality bar as production code.
  • Self-healing and failure triage: Apply AI to locator healing, flaky-test detection, and automated failure analysis: clustering failures, summarising likely root causes, and routing defects to the right owner.
  • Synthetic test data: Make realistic, PHI-free synthetic patient records and clinical scenarios the default for functional, performance, and AI evaluation testing, using tools such as Synthea or LLM-driven generators.
  • Testing AI features: Design evaluation frameworks for AI-powered EPOWERdoc capabilities. These include golden datasets, scoring rubrics, LLM-as-judge grading calibrated against human review, and regression gates that run whenever a model, prompt, or knowledge source changes.
  • AI safety and guardrails: Test AI features for hallucination, clinical and coding accuracy, bias, PHI leakage, prompt injection, and graceful failure. Work with clinical experts to define what “good enough for the ED” means in measurable terms.
  • Measure and share impact: Track how AI changes test authoring time and maintenance effort, and share what works with other Embrace engineering teams.
THE STACK YOU’LL SHAPE
This is our starting point, not a mandate. You’ll own the final decisions and the reasoning behind them.
  • UI and end-to-end: Playwright with TypeScript, including visual regression and automated accessibility checks (axe-core).
  • API and integration: Playwright API testing, contract testing (for example Pact), and validation of HL7 and FHIR interfaces.
  • Performance: Locust or k6 for load, stress, and soak testing.
  • Security: OWASP ZAP and dependency scanning in CI, plus the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as the baseline for AI features.
  • AI tooling: AI coding agents (such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor), Playwright MCP and test agents, and LLM evaluation frameworks such as Promptfoo, DeepEval, or Ragas, with tracing through Langfuse or LangSmith.
  • CI/CD and reporting: Tests running on every pull request, with Allure or a similar dashboard for trends, flakiness, and release readiness.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

  • First 30 days: You understand EPOWERdoc’s clinical workflows, existing test assets, and release process. You’ve proposed the target QA stack and AI-native approach as written architecture decision records.
  • By 90 days: Playwright smoke and regression suites cover the most critical clinical workflows and run on every pull request. A performance baseline exists for peak load. AI-assisted test authoring is in daily use with measured results.
  • By 6 months: Manual regression effort is a small fraction of today’s. Flaky tests are tracked and trending down. An evaluation harness gates every release of AI-powered features.

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of professional QA or software testing experience, including at least 3 years building test automation, ideally in a SaaS or web application environment.
  • QA foundations: Solid understanding of QA methodologies, risk-based testing, test design techniques, and software development life cycles.
  • Programming: Strong coding skills in TypeScript or JavaScript and working proficiency in Python. You write test code with the same care as production code.
  • Test automation: Hands-on experience with modern automation tools, with Playwright strongly preferred (Cypress or Selenium also considered). This includes building scalable frameworks from the ground up, managing test data, keeping suites stable and fast, and a record of well-reasoned tooling decisions.
  • AI-native practice: Daily use of AI coding agents in test engineering, with examples you can walk us through, and the judgement to spot when AI output is wrong or shallow.
  • Testing AI systems: Understanding of how LLM features fail and how to test non-deterministic outputs with eval datasets, rubric or model-based grading, and pass thresholds.
  • Performance testing: Hands-on experience with Locust, k6, JMeter, or similar tools, including designing realistic workload models and interpreting the results.
  • API and CI/CD: Solid experience with API testing, CI/CD tools, and Git, and with running automated suites within build pipelines.
  • Communication and ownership: Ability to explain quality risks clearly to engineers, product managers, and leadership, with strong analytical skills and a proactive, self-starter attitude.
  • Ways of working: Experience working in a highly remote, fast-paced, and agile environment across time zones.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

Nice to have

  • Healthcare experience: Work in healthcare or health tech, especially EHR, EDIS, or other regulated clinical software (for example, ONC Health IT certification testing). This includes familiarity with HL7 v2, FHIR, and HIPAA requirements for test data and environments.
  • AI tooling experience: Hands-on experience with LLM evaluation and observability tools, or building MCP servers and custom AI agents for engineering teams.
  • Security and accessibility testing: Experience testing web and AI applications, including prompt-injection testing, red-teaming, and WCAG.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary aligned with UK working hours, ensuring fair and transparent compensation.
  • Global Team Collaboration—work alongside extremely talented professionals from around the world.
  • Professional Growth Support with access to training programs designed to enhance your skills and expand your knowledge.
  • Clear Career Progression and excellent opportunities for long-term advancement within the organization.
  • Comprehensive Health Benefits to support your wellbeing and peace of mind.
  • Flexible Remote Work Options that empower you to balance work and life effectively.

job.title: Testing Architecture Specialist
job.description:
This opportunity is in Tampa - Santo Domingo - Remote (EST +/- 6)

﻿﻿

Position Overview

Conceived on the back of the 2017 crypto wave, our client was borne of a realization. While Infura enabled the ICO boom, it also made it extremely vulnerable due to operating as a single point of failure. A secure, efficient, and censorship-resistant future for Web3 must be enabled by truly decentralized infrastructure, not by centralized platforms gating access to networks.

The pitfalls of Web2 become more obvious by the day - security breaches, gatekeepers, and ever-more aggressive censorship have turned the open-source dream of the free internet into increasingly dystopian surveillance and control system. Our client offers a radical escape: a means to bring the free internet back, only this time it's unstoppable.

Their engineering department currently includes a small stable team specialists in critical areas, our CTO, and our CEO. They achieved a great deal, but they also understand that what got you here, wont get you there. They will be scaling up the engineering team in 2022 and they want to bring smart people aboard that will help make fulfill the goals and deliver the best platform while ensuring quality.

Thats where you come in: you will be in charge of everyday research, design, and development of new testing frameworks for the Blockchain Protocol to ensure quality and provide QA Guidelines across the team and the project. You will have to drive your progress and propose new ideas and solutions that will make the Protocol be faster, leaner, robust, and secure.

You will need to architect, design, and implement the tooling that will ensure the quality in an efficient, automated, and replicable way. You will also be an active participant in the protocol research and development effort, making sure that any feature or attribute of the system quality can be properly measured, assessed, and improved on.

You should also be an active member of the community, you will have to be a leader and role model for community developers that will join the project. You will have the opportunity to do research and present papers that will drive and motivate others to participate in the development of the Blockchain Protocol.

Success will be measured primarily in qualitative terms, which may include but are not limited to: participating in ideation meetings, bringing new ideas to the table and running research to find the best solutions, and implementing those ideas with quality in mind.

Key Projects & Objectives

  • R&D
    • On a daily basis, you will be running research, designing systems, and participating in ideation meetings to bring new solutions to the table
    • Participate in other members Ideas, by discussing and proposing improvements
    • Help another team member to run research and comparison about different options
    • Write reports and papers about research results
    • Accept suggestions, ideas and help with your research tasks
    • Propose testing solutions and testing plans for every new aspect of the project
    • Ensure that other team members provide options to ensure project quality from the ground up
  • Implementation
    • Create testing infrastructure to support development
    • Describe testing strategies for every project goal
    • Implement QA systems for every step of the development and deployment process using automated tools and automated pipelines
    • Work side by side with the infrastructure specialist to implement automated testing tools down the pipeline
    • Work side by side with Protocol Specialist to ideate features with testing and QA mindset first, ensure that everything is testable and accountable
  • Review
    • Code review implementations, comment and suggest improvements
    • Help other team members to unblock their work
    • Participate in projects by providing your best knowledge
    • Review community contributions and help the community participation on the project
  • Role model
    • Participate in community channels, answer questions, and review projects
    • Follow the contribution guide patterns to be an example for the community
    • Identify improvements and bugs on community forums and GitHub comments

﻿How you will contribute

As a mission-driven organization, our client is a rewarding and engaging place to work for those who embrace our core ethos, which could be distilled as a commitment to results, truth, openness, kindness, stewardship, gratitude, and collaboration. Huge egos need not apply.

You'll come from a production environment in software engineering. You have a DevOps background and probably experience in automated tooling. What's most important is that you're a relentless optimizer and tinkerer, a great systems' thinker who can see how pieces of a process fit together, then deconstruct, rebuild and optimize them in order to produce improved outcomes (and test, test, test). You'll be a skilled practical problem solver who enjoys finding weak links and experimenting with ways to improve them.

You have some understanding of Computer Science, Networking, P2P, and preferably GoLang. You've been working on related areas like Infrastructure, Cloud, Backend, and CI/CD tooling. You love thinking about QA first, designing fault-tolerant systems and necessary automated testing tools that ensure project quality on every step. You think on QA first, analyzing every new proposal how it can be tested and how we can ensure quality.

As such, while it's important you have a grounding in a real-world software engineering environment, it's mindset and attitude they are looking for more so than any specific tech stack, job title, or level of experience. If you love engineering but wish you could spend less time on the minutiae and more time on building and optimizing a well-oiled software production machine, this might just be exactly the job for you.

While the fundamental engineering, product, and revenue infrastructure are in place and product-market fit has been proven, the vast majority of potential and impact lies in the future. For ambitious builders and innovators, there couldn't be a better time to join us. And you'll get to help solve one of the most urgent and pressing problems of our time a generational crisis - by helping us to build secure, censorship-resistant Web3 infrastructure and restore the free and open internet.

job.title: QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
QA Automation Engineer (Playwright, TypeScript, E2E Testing & CI/CD) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours
Preferred Locations: LATAM, Eastern Europe, Pakistan, South Africa

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients — a fast-growing, product-focused technology company — is hiring a senior-level QA Automation Engineer to strengthen its test automation infrastructure and improve software quality at scale.

This is not a manual QA role.

You’ll take hands-on ownership of:

  • Playwright automation
  • TypeScript-based testing
  • E2E test frameworks
  • Regression coverage
  • Test stability and flaky-test reduction
  • CI/CD integration
  • AI-assisted testing workflows

You’ll work directly with frontend and backend engineers to build reliable, scalable automation that increases release confidence and catches problems before they reach production.

If you think like an engineer, enjoy solving difficult automation problems, and care about building maintainable test infrastructure, this role is a strong fit.

What You’ll Own

Test Automation & Framework Development

  • Build and maintain end-to-end (E2E) automated tests using:
    • Playwright
    • TypeScript
  • Expand automation coverage across critical:
    • User journeys
    • Product workflows
    • Regression scenarios
  • Build reusable:
    • Test utilities
    • Fixtures
    • Testing patterns
    • Automation components
  • Improve framework:
    • Maintainability
    • Scalability
    • Reliability
    • Execution speed
  • Maintain clean and sustainable automation architecture

Test Stability & Flaky-Test Reduction

  • Identify, troubleshoot, and eliminate flaky tests
  • Diagnose failures involving:
    • DOM interactions
    • Network requests
    • Asynchronous behavior
    • Timing and synchronization
    • Test environments
  • Reduce false positives and inconsistent failures
  • Improve regression suite reliability
  • Develop reliable test-data strategies
  • Help maintain stable testing environments

CI/CD & Release Automation

  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Ensure automated test suites run reliably during deployment workflows
  • Review CI/CD test results and troubleshoot failures
  • Improve execution speed and feedback cycles
  • Support release validation and regression prevention
  • Increase engineering confidence in production deployments

Engineering Collaboration

  • Work directly with frontend and backend engineers during feature development
  • Collaborate on:
    • Testability
    • Regression prevention
    • Release readiness
    • Automation architecture
  • Participate in engineering and testing discussions
  • Identify quality risks before releases
  • Provide clear technical feedback when defects or automation issues are identified

AI-Assisted Testing & Quality Innovation

  • Use AI-assisted tools to improve:
    • Exploratory testing
    • Edge-case identification
    • Test development
    • Debugging
  • Identify opportunities to increase automation coverage and testing efficiency
  • Experiment with modern QA and automation workflows
  • Help evolve testing practices as AI-assisted engineering tools improve

Required Experience & Skills

Core Requirements

  • Strong proficiency in TypeScript
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright
    • Strong Cypress experience with willingness to transition to Playwright may also be considered
  • Proven experience building and maintaining E2E automation frameworks
  • Strong understanding of:
    • DOM interaction
    • Network requests
    • Asynchronous application behavior
    • Test synchronization
    • Flaky-test diagnosis
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting abilities
  • Experience improving automation reliability and regression coverage
  • Ability to work directly with software engineers in a modern product environment
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Comfortable working independently in a remote environment

Nice to Have

  • Experience building automation infrastructure from scratch
  • Experience with test-data management and environment strategies
  • B2B SaaS testing experience
  • Experience testing:
    • Multi-tenant applications
    • Role-based permissions
    • Complex user workflows
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tools and workflows
  • Experience in Agile or product-led engineering environments
  • Strong understanding of modern software development and release practices

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You think like an engineer first and tester second
  • You prefer automation over repetitive manual testing
  • You enjoy diagnosing why tests are unstable rather than simply rerunning them
  • You take ownership of framework quality and long-term maintainability
  • You understand how modern web applications behave across the DOM, network, and asynchronous workflows
  • You care about clean, reusable automation code
  • You work effectively with minimal management
  • You communicate clearly with frontend and backend engineers

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You might start by reviewing CI/CD test results and investigating a flaky Playwright test affecting the regression suite.

From there, you could build automated coverage for a newly released workflow, improve shared TypeScript fixtures, troubleshoot asynchronous behavior, or collaborate with an engineer on making a feature easier to test reliably.

You’ll also continuously improve test performance, framework stability, and automation coverage while experimenting with AI-assisted approaches to exploratory testing and edge-case detection.

In short: you build the automation infrastructure that keeps software releases fast, reliable, and production-ready.

Key Metrics for Success

  • Increased E2E automation coverage
  • Reduction in flaky and unreliable tests
  • Stable CI/CD test execution
  • Faster automated test execution
  • Improved regression detection
  • Increased release confidence
  • Reduction in production issues
  • Maintainable and reusable automation architecture
  • Strong collaboration with engineering teams

Why This Role Stands Out

  • Automation-first engineering role — not manual QA
  • Deep hands-on work with Playwright and TypeScript
  • Ownership over automation architecture and framework reliability
  • Direct collaboration with frontend and backend engineering teams
  • Opportunity to improve CI/CD and release quality
  • Exposure to AI-assisted testing workflows
  • High autonomy in a fast-moving product environment
  • Fully remote opportunity

Interview Process

  1. Initial Application Review
  2. Spark Hire Intro Video
  3. Initial Screening Call with Pavago
  4. Technical Assessment / Automation Review
  5. Client Technical Interview
  6. Final Interview – Culture & Ownership Fit
  7. Offer & Onboarding

Apply Now

If you’re a QA Automation Engineer with strong Playwright, TypeScript, E2E testing, and CI/CD experience who enjoys building reliable automation infrastructure rather than relying on manual testing, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build scalable, stable, and engineering-driven software quality systems.

job.title: Senior Software Engineer, Quality Engineering
job.description:
Who We Are:

Alpaca is a US-headquartered, global leader in agent-first brokerage infrastructure for stocks, ETFs, options, crypto, fixed income, 24/5 trading, and more.

Amongst our subsidiaries, Alpaca is a licensed financial services company, serving hundreds of financial institutions across 40 countries with our institutional-grade APIs. This includes broker-dealers, investment advisors, wealth managers, hedge funds, and crypto exchanges, totalling over 10 million brokerage accounts.

Our global team is a diverse group of experienced engineers, traders, and brokerage professionals who are working to achieve our mission of opening financial services to everyone on the planet. We're deeply committed to open-source contributions and fostering a vibrant community, continuously enhancing our award-winning, developer-friendly API and the robust infrastructure behind it.

Alpaca is proudly backed backed by $400 million in funding from top-tier global investors including Portage Ventures, Spark Capital, Tribe Capital, Social Leverage, Horizons Ventures, Opera Tech Ventures, SBI Group, Derayah Financial, Unbound, Peak XV, Elefund, and Y Combinator.

Our Team Members:

We're a dynamic team of 400+ globally distributed members who thrive working from our favorite places around the world, with teammates spanning the USA, Canada, Japan, Hungary, Nigeria, Brazil, the UK, and beyond!

We're searching for passionate individuals eager to contribute to Alpaca's rapid growth. If you align with our core values—Stay Curious, Have Empathy, and Be Accountable—and are ready to make a significant impact, we encourage you to apply.

Your Role

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Platform team, you will build and own the frameworks, tooling, and CI/CD infrastructure that let Alpaca’s engineers ship new features quickly and reliably. This is a software engineering role at its core: you will spend most of your time writing Go, designing automated test frameworks, and digging into application code and Kubernetes when needed. Just as importantly, you will help redefine how we use AI to raise the bar on quality - leveraging LLMs and AI-driven tooling to generate tests, catch regressions before they ship, and turn every incident into durable, automated coverage. We are looking for engineers who treat quality as an engineering discipline and see AI as a force multiplier for it - people who build the systems that make testing fast, reliable, and effortless for the teams that depend on them.

Things You Get To Do

  • Design and build automated test frameworks across our REST and gRPC API surface.
  • Leverage AI and LLM-based tooling to accelerate test generation, harden regression coverage, and turn production incidents into automated tests - embedding these practices into the frameworks the whole engineering org relies on.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines - we use a mix of GitHub Actions and Google Cloud Build.
  • Design and execute load, stress, and scalability tests to ensure our platform can handle growing demand.
  • Introduce chaos engineering practices - designing fault-injection and resilience experiments that surface failure modes before our customers do.
  • Standardize tooling and infrastructure to improve the day-to-day developer experience.
  • Partner with other teams to raise test coverage, reliability, and speed across services.
  • Dig into application code to root-cause failures and drive fixes to completion.
  • Mentor and guide product engineers, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

Who You Are (Must-Haves)

  • You have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer building and maintaining production systems.
  • You have written code in strongly typed languages and have at least 1 year of experience with Go.
  • You are fluent with AI-assisted engineering - you actively use LLM-based tools in your workflow and have a clear point of view on where they elevate quality (and where they don’t).
  • You have built and maintained CI pipelines before - ideally with GitHub Actions or Google Cloud Build.
  • You have designed and built automated test frameworks, and you understand the challenges microservices pose for reliable integration and end-to-end testing.
  • You are familiar with Kubernetes beyond the basics - you can write a Helm chart for a new service with relative ease, you understand best practices around security, and you have prior job experience or certifications to prove this.
  • You have worked at a startup before - you understand that things don’t always go according to plan, that there is significant technical debt, that some tasks just need to be done, and that sometimes there are no processes or documentation to guide your hand.
  • You are not afraid of taking a task from start to finish - gathering requirements, figuring out and implementing the best technical solution, then deploying and monitoring the results.

Who You Might Be (Bonus Points)

  • You have used AI/LLM tooling to build QA automation - test generation, flaky-test triage, or incident-to-regression pipelines - and can speak to what worked and what didn’t.
  • You have written code in Python or TypeScript, and can build efficient Dockerfiles and secure container images.
  • You have implemented load tests with k6 (REST) and ghz (gRPC) and have experience analyzing pprof/trace output.
  • You have done IaC deployments with Argo CD or Terraform, or have used Google Cloud Platform and Google Kubernetes Engine before. You are familiar with Tilt and have written a Kubernetes Operator before.
  • You have practiced chaos engineering - running fault-injection or resilience experiments with tools like Chaos Mesh, LitmusChaos, or Gremlin.
  • You are familiar with testing event-driven systems using Kafka (or even better, Redpanda).

How We Take Care of You:

  • Competitive Salary & Stock Options
  • Health Benefits
  • New Hire Home-Office Setup: One-time USD $500
  • Monthly Stipend: USD $150 per month via a Brex Card

Alpaca is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace dedicated to pursuing and hiring a diverse workforce.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer
job.description:
Senior QA Engineer

Full-Time | Remote (Europe / CET-Compatible Time Zones)

About Prism Studio

Prism Studio is a Malta-based, independent video game development company focused on building unforgettable, player-first experiences driven by clear artistic direction, state-of-the-art tools and a strong visual identity. Our work is guided by a culture of innovation, creativity and close collaboration, allowing us to pursue our vision of bringing back the fun in video games and creating experiences that feel engaging, rewarding and memorable for players. We operate as a fully remote studio with a globally distributed team of experienced developers, artists and designers. Prism is structured around trust, accountability and clear communication, enabling us to collaborate efficiently across time zones while maintaining a consistent standard of quality and execution.

The studio is currently developing its first PvPvE multiplayer showdown shooter, Heptic Arena, with the aim of standing out within the genre and leaving a lasting impression on players. Join us on our exciting journey as we continue to build cutting-edge games, push the boundaries of what’s possible in the gaming world, and provide unparalleled entertainment and compelling experiences for players around the globe!

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced Senior QA Engineer to play a hands-on role in maintaining and raising the quality of our games throughout development.

Working closely with engineering, design, art and production, you will help apply a structured and proactive approach to testing across game features. You will be responsible for creating detailed test plans, identifying and investigating complex issues, executing testing workflows, and ensuring problems are communicated clearly and resolved effectively.

This role goes beyond surface-level testing. We are looking for someone who understands game development from a technical perspective and can think critically about how systems interact, where they may fail, and how quality can be verified early in the development process. As we develop Heptic Arena, you will play an important role in ensuring that gameplay systems, multiplayer functionality, performance, and the overall player experience meet the standard we want to deliver.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and execute test coverage across features, systems, and game builds throughout development.
  • Create detailed test plans, test cases, and regression suites based on technical and gameplay requirements.
  • Test new features and systems across functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and compatibility scenarios.
  • Identify, reproduce, investigate, and document bugs with clear reproduction steps, supporting evidence, and relevant technical information.
  • Work directly with engineers, designers, and other disciplines to investigate issues, determine severity, and validate fixes.
  • Test gameplay systems within Unreal Engine 5, using your technical understanding of the engine to investigate issues beyond surface-level behaviour.
  • Support testing of multiplayer and networked gameplay, identifying issues relating to replication, connectivity, latency, synchronisation, and player interactions.
  • Coordinate and support internal playtests, turning observations and player feedback into clear, actionable findings.
  • Maintain bug-tracking workflows, QA documentation, and reporting within Jira.
  • Monitor defect trends and testing data to identify recurring issues and areas requiring additional test coverage.
  • Contribute to automated testing and internal QA tools where appropriate.
  • Work closely with production and QA leadership to prioritise defects against development milestones and release requirements.
  • Help the wider team identify technical and gameplay risks early rather than relying on testing at the very end of production.

About You

  • Strong professional experience in game development QA, ideally in a senior QA, QA Engineer, or similarly technical quality role.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer | Remote LATAM Only
job.description:
We are looking for a Senior QA Automation Engineer to strengthen our quality assurance process. Although the platform has existing automation in place, recurring bugs and unstable releases reveal structural gaps in quality coverage.

This role requires a highly skilled engineer capable of auditing the current automation, rebuilding unstable areas, improving test strategy, and ensuring reliable, defect-free releases.

You will collaborate closely with Development, DevOps, and Product teams to implement best practices, optimize testing workflows, and elevate overall product quality.

Key Responsibilities

1. Automation Quality & Test Architecture

  • Audit existing automation to identify false positives, flakiness, outdated libraries, missing regression coverage, and low-value tests.
  • Refactor or rebuild automation for stability, maintainability, and scalability.
  • Define the automation scope for the upcoming delivery cycle (new features, high-risk areas, historical bugs).
  • Implement best-practice patterns: Page Object Model, reusable fixtures, API abstraction, stable waits.

2. Functional & Regression Testing

  • Perform manual testing for new features with unclear or incomplete acceptance criteria.
  • Build/improve a complete regression suite integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Validate bug fixes and ensure test coverage prevents reoccurrence.
  • Report defect patterns and risk areas to leadership.

3. Testing Process & Standards

  • Create/update test strategy, test cases (manual + automated), test data plans, and acceptance criteria.
  • Document all test results clearly, ensuring traceability and reproducibility.
  • Enhance collaboration between QA, Dev, and Product to reduce defect leakage.

4. Environment & CI/CD

  • Work with DevOps to stabilize QA/UAT environments.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines with reliable pass/fail signals.
  • Reduce test flakiness and ensure poor-quality builds are blocked.

5. Release Quality Ownership

  • Validate release candidates end-to-end.
  • Execute smoke, sanity, exploratory, and performance testing when needed.
  • Provide clear go/no-go indicators based on quality KPIs.

Requirements

Technical Skills

  • Strong experience with automation frameworks: Cypress, Playwright, Selenium, WebdriverIO (depending on the stack).
  • API automation using Postman, REST Assured, or Playwright API.
  • Deep knowledge of waits, DOM handling, test data mocking/stubbing, and browser drivers.
  • Solid SQL knowledge for data validation.
  • Experience testing distributed systems, microservices, caching layers, and cloud environments.
  • Hands-on experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab, Jenkins, Azure DevOps).
  • Strong Git branching, PR review, and version-control best practices.

Quality Engineering Expertise

  • Ability to reverse-engineer unclear or undocumented features.
  • Strong root-cause analysis skills — understanding not only what fails, but why.
  • Ability to validate and correct inaccurate automation coverage claims.
  • Solid regression testing strategy.
  • Experience with performance/load testing tools (JMeter, k6) is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent communication with the ability to challenge assumptions diplomatically.
  • High sense of ownership — proactive, autonomous, and structured.
  • Transparent risk communication with PM/CTO and cross-functional teams.

Language Requirement

  • English: C1 required

job.title: Senior SDET, Agentic Quality
job.description:
About Onfleet

Onfleet’s mission is to power the future of commerce by enabling businesses of all sizes to move goods more efficiently and delightfully. Our product includes intuitive smartphone apps for drivers, a powerful modern web dashboard for logistics teams, and automatic notifications and real-time tracking for recipients. Onfleet powers millions of deliveries every week for thousands of businesses around the world across a range of industries, from grocery and prepared meals to pharmacy, flowers, and furniture.

About the role

Onfleet is hiring two senior SDETs to shape how our engineering teams build and trust automated quality. At Onfleet, the team that builds a feature owns its quality. Developers write and maintain their own tests. Your job is to make those teams better at it: you pair with them, teach, review, and find the cases they missed. You will not be the person who tests everyone else's work.

Together with our quality leads, you’ll own our test frameworks and the shared quality tooling every team depends on. You’ll also do feature development in production code and internal tooling. You’ll be part of our core quality engineering group, sometimes embedded on one team and sometimes working across several.

You’ll start by taking ownership of our existing automation and making it more reliable and complete, alongside greenfield work on new platform services. We measure this role by what the teams can do because you were there.

How We Work

We code using agents, and nearly 100% of our code is written this way. Generating code is the easy part. Knowing what good looks like, and holding the bar, is the job. The engineers who thrive here are scrutinizing and questioning: they reject AI slop and catch the wrong call before it ships.

Every engineer helps improve how we work instead of only following it. For this role that means building and improving the agentic tooling itself: test generation, review, verification, and the workflows around them.

We are candid and have a low ego. Challenge us on tooling direction, and expect to be challenged back.

What You’ll Do:

  • Strengthen the current suite. Improve reliability, extend coverage, and modernize patterns. A flaky test is a failing test.
  • Own the test frameworks. Unit, integration, and end-to-end, treated with the same care as production code.
  • Own the quality gates in CI/CD (continuous integration and continuous delivery). Pipelines, checks, and gates, so standards are enforced by the system and not by people.
  • Build agentic quality tooling. Extend the agents and workflows we use for test design, review, and verification.
  • Raise the bar through teams. Pair on test design, review code, help make hard-to-reach code testable, and write things down so the practice outlives any one person.
  • Ask the testability question early. In planning, ask how we'll test it and how we'll know it broke in production.
  • Know when a release is healthy. Metrics, dashboards and alerts that tell us something is wrong before a customer does, and that tell a team whether a release is safe to keep rolling out.
  • Ship features. Full-stack work in production code and internal tooling, alongside the teams you support.

What You'll Bring (required):

  • 8 or more years of professional software development experience, in any role.
  • 5 or more years where building and maintaining test automation was a core part of your job, as an SDET, test automation engineer, or software engineer who owned test infrastructure. Your title matters less than the work.
  • You build software, not just tests: test frameworks, internal tools, CI tooling, or product features. You want feature development in production code and internal tooling to be part of your job here.
  • Depth across unit, integration, and end-to-end testing, including hands-on work with a browser framework such as Playwright or Cypress.
  • Hands-on CI ownership: you have created, configured, or fixed a CI pipeline (GitHub Actions or equivalent), not just used one.
  • A track record of being the person who drove automated test coverage on a team, whatever your role was.
  • Working knowledge of DevOps practice: how code is built, deployed and monitored in production. You have added metrics, dashboards or alerts so a team knew when something broke.
  • Daily professional use of AI coding agents, and experience building or improving agentic tooling, not just using it.
  • A multiplier mindset: you get your satisfaction from the team shipping safer and faster, not from your own test count.
  • Excellent written and spoken English, roughly C1 level, and experience working day to day on an international team.

Nice To Have:

  • Mobile development (Android or iOS) and mobile test automation, using native frameworks such as Espresso or XCUITest, or cross-platform tools such as Appium or Maestro.
  • TypeScript, Node.js, and React.
  • Rust, or another statically typed language.
  • Clear evidence of driving CI/CD practice for a whole team or company.
  • Production canaries and progressive delivery: you have used production signals (error rates, latency, business metrics) to decide whether a release continues or rolls back, through canaries, feature flags or automated rollback.
  • Test data and environment management: getting a realistic system into a known state quickly and repeatably.
  • Test-driven development (TDD).
  • AWS and cloud-native services.

Location and Benefits:

  • Remote, open to candidates based in Canada or Latin America.
  • The team works on US Pacific Time. You'll need to reliably work a schedule that frequently matches US Pacific business hours (9am to 5pm PT).
  • Flexible PTO.
  • Laptop and work-from-home setup stipend.
  • Monthly technology stipends (internet and AI tooling).

Onfleet is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Onfleet's culture is one that strongly values diversity in its workplace and we are committed to working with potential team members who can bring diverse perspectives and experience to our company and culture.

We do not make hiring or employment decisions on the basis of race, color, religion, creed, gender, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, sex, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, citizenship, or any other basis protected by applicable local, state or federal law.

We highly encourage members of underrepresented groups to apply and we will consider qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Compensation

The base salary range for this role is $70,000 to $95,000 USD per year for candidates in both Canada and Latin America, depending on experience, skills, and background. Where an offer lands within that range reflects the depth and experience a candidate brings to the role.

How We Hire

You need an identity-verified LinkedIn profile to apply. That's the free "Verified" badge, the shield icon next to your name. We check for it, and applications without it don't move forward.

Before any offer, we verify your identity and work history. That includes a live video ID check and reference calls. We use AI, automated systems, and a person to review applications: every application that meets the requirements is also read by an engineering leader or a recruiter. If you misrepresent your identity or experience, the process ends.

Company Overview

We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

Software Engineering


Job Description

We are seeking a detail-oriented and data-savvy QA Engineer to join our dynamic software development team. This role has an emphasis on validating data integrity, pipeline reliability, and complex analytical insights.


Our team builds a high-throughput analytics platform that processes massive datasets to deliver dashboards and metrics from diverse data streams for the emergency call handling space. You will design, develop, and execute comprehensive test strategies that span across data ingestion, processing, storage, and front-end visualization layers.


Key Responsibilities


1. Data Validation & Pipeline Testing

  • Verify the accuracy, completeness, and consistency of data as it moves through data pipelines.

2. Analytics & Report Verification

  • Test the business logic and mathematical correctness of aggregations, KPIs, and predictive metrics.
  • Ensure that user-facing charts, graphs, and dashboards accurately reflect the underlying data.

  • Design, build, and maintain automated testing frameworks for both APIs and UI dashboards.
  • Implement automated data quality checks within the CI/CD pipeline.
