job.title: QA Analyst – Security Testing
job.description:
Location: USA (East Coast), LATAM - Fully Remote

Employment type: PART-TIME

About Bizmoni Corp.

Bizmoni is building an AI Business Network designed to help people and businesses connect, earn, learn, and grow in the AI era.

As a seed-stage, pre-revenue company, we are strengthening our platform, growing our global ecosystem, and laying the foundations for future funding and scale. This is an opportunity to join an entrepreneurial, international team and help shape both the product and the business.

About the Role

We're looking for a detail-driven QA Analyst to own manual testing across our web applications and APIs. You'll turn requirements into clear test cases, run structured test cycles, and give the team reliable reporting on release quality. You'll also bring a security mindset, checking for common vulnerabilities as part of everyday testing.

You'll work closely with Business Analysts, Product Owners and developers from refinement to release, and help shape how we document and evidence our testing.

What You'll Do:

  • Review user stories, specifications and acceptance criteria early, and raise gaps, ambiguities and risks before development starts.
  • Take part in backlog refinement and sprint ceremonies alongside BAs, Product Owners and developers.
  • Write clear test plans, test scenarios and detailed test cases with expected results and test data.
  • Maintain a requirements traceability matrix so every requirement has test coverage.

Test execution and defect management

  • Run manual functional, regression, integration, end-to-end and exploratory testing across web, mobile and API layers.
  • Test APIs manually using tools such as Postman or Swagger.
  • Log defects with clear steps to reproduce, expected and actual results, evidence and severity, and track them through to closure in [Jira / Azure DevOps].
  • Retest fixes and maintain regression test packs for each release.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by preparing scripts, guiding business users and capturing feedback.
  • Include basic security checks in your testing, such as access control, input validation, session handling and the OWASP Top 10, and escalate findings to the security team.

Reporting and documentation

  • Produce test progress, test summary and release readiness reports for engineering and business stakeholders.
  • Track and report on QA metrics such as test coverage, pass rates, defect trends and defect leakage.
  • Keep test documentation current in [TestRail / Xray / Zephyr / Confluence].
  • Contribute to QA processes and standards, and provide testing evidence for audits such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2.

What You'll Bring:

  • Manual testing experience. 3+ years in manual QA, testing web applications and APIs in an Agile environment.
  • Test case design. Strong at writing structured test cases using techniques such as boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning and state transition.
  • Requirements analysis. Proven ability to analyse user stories and acceptance criteria, identify gaps and turn them into testable scenarios.
  • Documentation. Experience creating and maintaining test plans, traceability matrices and test summary reports.
  • Tools. Hands-on with Jira or Azure DevOps and a test management tool (TestRail, Xray, Zephyr or similar), plus Postman for API testing.
  • Technical foundations. Good understanding of web technologies, HTTP and REST, and basic SQL for checking data.
  • Security awareness. Working knowledge of the OWASP Top 10 and how to check for common issues during manual testing.
  • Clear reporting. You write precise defect reports and explain quality risks clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

Nice to Have:

  • ISTQB Foundation certification (Advanced Test Analyst a plus).
  • Hands-on use of Burp Suite or OWASP ZAP for basic security testing.
  • Some exposure to test automation (Playwright, Selenium or Cypress), even if it isn't your main focus.
  • Experience supporting UAT with business users.
  • Background in a regulated sector such as fintech, banking or healthcare.
  • Experience with accessibility testing against WCAG 2.2.

Who Thrives at Bizmoni?

We look for people who demonstrate:

  • Ownership – Taking responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks
  • Results Orientation – Focusing on quality, execution, and impact
  • Continuous Improvement – Always looking for better ways to work and improve quality
  • Collaboration – Partnering effectively across teams and functions
  • Adaptability – Thriving in a dynamic and evolving environment
  • Mission Alignment – Believing in what we're building and its future potential

Compensation & Commitment

Bizmoni currently offers ONLY an equity-based compensation model, aligned with global startup practices that enable early contributors to participate in the company's potential long-term value creation.

The role requires a flexible commitment of approximately 8–16 hours per week, with clear deliverables and results-driven accountability. Contributors may maintain a primary paid role alongside their engagement with Bizmoni. As Bizmoni is currently seed-stage, compensation is provided in company equity. Full terms and conditions will be discussed during the selection process and confirmed in the consulting agreement.

Requirements for Remote Engagement:

  • Personal computer with camera and reliable internet connection
  • Willingness to participate in Bizmoni's equity-based compensation model

Why You'll Love Working at Bizmoni

  • Design the core AI agents of an emerging AI Business Network from day one
  • Set the technical architecture and standards that the platform will scale on
  • Work directly with founders and a talented, globally distributed team
  • Gain hands-on exposure to cutting-edge agentic AI, FinTech, and product initiatives
  • Contribute directly to Bizmoni's growth, scalability, and future funding readiness

Equal Opportunity Employer

Bizmoni is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive global environment where everyone is treated with dignity, fairness, and respect.

Engagement decisions are based on relevant skills, experience, potential, and business needs, without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable law. We believe diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences strengthen our culture, innovation, and global network.

Before Applying, Ask Yourself:

  • Are you open to ONLY equity-based compensation?
  • Are you open to dedicating a min. of 16 hrs weekly on our project?

If your answers are YES, then we are happy to meet you!

Recruitment Process:

  1. Interview with Leadership Team & TA Partner.
  1. Technical conversation / agent design discussion with [CTO / technical lead].
  1. Offer (based on final positive feedback).

Please send us your English CV stating the role you apply for. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted for an interview. Thank you.

  • Localization Testing: Verify translated UI elements across multiple languages for accuracy, context, and formatting compliance (e.g., date/time formats, currency symbols, address layouts, dynamic pluralization, and text truncation/wrap issues).
  • Pseudo-Localization: Conduct pseudo-localization builds during early development cycles to catch hard coded strings, layout clipping, and character rendering errors early in the SDLC.
  • Linguistic & UI Quality Verification: Review UI for visual integrity across different screen sizes when localized strings expand or shrink; coordinate linguistic reviews with native-speaking linguists or translation agencies.
  • TMS & Localization Tooling: Manage translation asset workflows using Translation Management Systems (TMS) such as Smartling, Phrase, Transifex, or Lokalise, integrating them with code repositories and build pipeline

Requirements

  • Internationalization and Localization Experience
  • Device Testing: Smart Home and Health including smartwatches, health trackers, smart displays, speakers, home security cameras, and camera doorbells.
  • Hands-on experience in localization and Internationalization testing with a primary focus on mobile and physical device testing.
  • Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and QA best practices.
  • Ability to think & execute testing from a user’s perspective
  • Technical i18n Knowledge: Strong understanding of character encoding (UTF-8, UTF-16), ICU standards, CLDR data, resource file formats (JSON, XML, .po, .strings, XLIFF), and Bidirectional (BiDi / RTL) layout handling.
  • L10n Testing Best Practices: Hands-on experience identifying truncation, text overlap, line wrapping, and font rendering issues across various localized builds.
  • Device Lab Familiarity: Hands-on experience testing on actual physical devices as well as cloud-based device testing platforms (e.g., BrowserStack, Sauce Labs, Kobiton).
  • OS & Tool Knowledge: Solid understanding of iOS (TestFlight, Xcode logs) and Android (ADB, Logcat, APK installation) ecosystems and debugging utilities.
  • API Tools: Basic familiarity with tools like Charles Proxy, Fiddler, Postman to inspect and debug device issues.
  • Core QA Skills: Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and QA best practices.
  • Basic understanding of test automation concepts or scripting to partner with automation engineers.
  • Experience testing IoT devices, wearables, or specialized embedded systems.
  • Familiarity with accessibility testing standards (WCAG, VoiceOver, TalkBack).
  • Tooling Proficiency: Experience with Translation Management Systems (e.g., Smartling, Phrase, Crowdin, Transifex) and defect management platforms (Jira).

Help Shape the Future of AI in Pharmaceutical

What if your expertise in pharmaceutical quality control, analytical testing, method development, and laboratory investigations could help artificial intelligence better understand pharmaceutical analytical sciences, laboratory operations, and regulatory expectations?

At Volga Partners, we're connecting experienced pharmaceutical professionals with opportunities to contribute to the development and evaluation of advanced AI models.

We're seeking experienced Quality Control (QC) and Analytical Development professionals who can apply their scientific expertise, laboratory knowledge, and industry experience to evaluate AI-generated pharmaceutical content.

This isn't a traditional laboratory position. You won't be performing analytical testing, developing methods, managing laboratory operations, or supporting product release activities. Instead, you'll evaluate complex scientific and analytical content, identify technical inaccuracies, assess scientific reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.al inaccuracies, assess regulatory reasoning, and provide structured feedback that improves AI model performance.

The Opportunity

As a Quality Control (QC) / Analytical Development Subject Matter Expert (SME), you'll serve as a subject matter evaluator, helping assess the quality, accuracy, completeness, and scientific validity of Pharmaceutical AI-generated content.

You'll analyze analytical, laboratory, quality, manufacturing, and compliance-related scenarios, identify errors or unsupported conclusions, and provide expert feedback grounded in analytical science, regulatory expectations, and pharmaceutical industry best practices.

  • Provide expert feedback: Clearly explain findings, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend technically accurate corrections.
  • Support AI quality improvement: Apply project-specific evaluation criteria, scoring guidelines, and quality standards.
  • Complete independent evaluations: Use designated online platforms to complete assignments accurately and within established project timelines.

Why Join Volga Partners?

Apply Your Industry Expertise in a New Way

Use the knowledge you've developed throughout your regulatory affairs career to contribute to advanced AI technologies.

Help Improve Scientific Accuracy

Your evaluations will help strengthen the quality and reliability of AI-generated pharmaceutical and regulatory information.

Work Remotely

Participate in project-based assignments from an eligible location, with flexibility based on project availability.

Explore the Future of Pharmaceutical Technology

Gain experience contributing to AI evaluation initiatives while leveraging your existing regulatory expertise.

No AI Background Required

We're looking for professionals who can identify regulatory risks, evaluate compliance considerations, and communicate expert assessments clearly.

job.title: Network Test Automation
job.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join a newly formed team working for a globally recognized networking leader on their flagship router product. The team’s mission is to build and enhance robust test automation and CI/CD pipelines, keeping the routing area healthy through continuous pre-commit testing: every pull request automatically triggers automated test suites on a large-scale CI/CD test orchestration platform, catching bugs before they reach the codebase.

Your work will focus heavily on designing, developing, and optimizing CI/CD test automation frameworks and test suites. You will automate provisioning, traffic generation, diagnostics, and regression testing using Python, pytest, PTF, sonic-mgmt, and Ansible. Additionally, you will own weekly regression runs and triage failures - from reading device and test logs, through distinguishing genuine product bugs from pipeline or environment issues, to raising well-documented defects.

The scale is significant: the platform executes hundreds of test suites and roughly a thousand test runs a day across pre-commit, nightly, and weekly pipelines. To keep triage fast at this scale, the workflow is supported by modern AI tooling - an AI-powered root cause analysis agent that turns hours of log digging into minutes, and collaboration bots that automatically pull the right people into dedicated spaces when a suite fails.

What else you should know:

  • The team is being formed right now - you will help shape how it works from day one

  • Support is also available from the DevOps and the Network team, as CodiLime engineers are responsible for developing and maintaining the CI/CD test orchestration platform

  • You will cooperate directly with the development and test engineers in a distributed, international environment (Europe, India, US)

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow, not an afterthought

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the team, will be responsible for:

  • Designing, building, and maintaining robust CI/CD test automation pipelines and test suites in Python for pre-commit PR testing and weekly regression runs

  • Automating environment provisioning, traffic generation, network diagnostics, and continuous regression testing across virtual and physical testbeds

  • Debugging failed runs - analyzing device, system, and test logs, distinguishing product bugs from test-suite or environment issues, and raising well-documented defects

  • Collaborating closely with development teams to understand the features they deliver and designing test coverage for those use cases

  • Extending test automation as new features are delivered in the Routing area

  • Leveraging AI tools (AI-assisted RCA, LLM coding assistants) to speed up scripting, log analysis, and root cause identification

  • Coordinating issue resolution with suite owners and dev/test engineers through dedicated collaboration channels

  • Managing physical and virtual testbed environments and provisioning resources for test execution

  • Identifying, analyzing, and resolving flaky tests to maintain high pipeline reliability

Do we have a match?

For success in this role, strong hands-on expertise in Python test automation, CI/CD pipelines, and network test tools is essential:

  • Strong Python programming skills and deep hands-on experience with pytest, PTF (Packet Test Framework), sonic-mgmt, and Ansible

  • Solid background in CI/CD engineering and automated test orchestration, focused on automating provisioning, traffic generation, diagnostics, and regression testing

  • Solid networking knowledge with a focus on routing (BGP, OSPF, routing tables, VRFs, Layer 3 concepts) and working with SONiC routers

  • Understanding of router concepts - overlay architecture, policies, IPsec tunnels (hands-on router experience is strongly preferred)

  • Proven debugging and troubleshooting skills: reading logs, CLI-level investigation, isolating root causes across product, test, and environment layers

  • Experience working closely with software development teams and translating delivered features into test scenarios

  • Hands-on use of AI tools in everyday engineering work

  • Experience with Docker

  • Good Linux command-line skills (shell scripting, command-line tools)

  • Good knowledge of English (B2+ level)

  • Proficiency with Git and CI/CD platforms

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the nice-to-haves:

  • Hands-on experience with Golang, C/C++, Groovy

  • Experience with SD-WAN

  • Hands-on experience with router solutions

  • Familiarity with Jenkins and GitHub-based CI/CD pipelines

  • Experience with physical or virtual network testbeds and virtual routers

  • Experience working with formal defect tracking systems

  • Experience with traffic generators

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

About ELB Learning

At ELB Learning, you'll become an integral part of a team that delivers innovative learning solutions for organizations around the world.

We're looking for a detail-oriented Quality Assurance Specialist who is passionate about ensuring every learning experience meets the highest standards of quality before reaching our clients.

About the Role

As a Quality Assurance Specialist, you'll play a critical role in reviewing learning deliverables throughout the production process. You'll evaluate content for grammar, formatting, functionality, accessibility, audio quality, and adherence to client standards while working closely with Instructional Designers, Developers, Creative teams, and Project Managers.

Your attention to detail and ability to provide clear, actionable feedback will help ensure every deliverable meets ELB Learning's quality standards before client delivery.

Language & Content Quality

Audio Quality

Functional & Technical QA

Process & Documentation

  • Document QA findings and communicate issues clearly to project teams.

Required Qualifications

  • Strong organizational skills with experience documenting issues and tracking resolutions.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing highly interactive eLearning, scenario-based learning, gamified content, simulations, or VR experiences.

  • Experience working with distributed production teams.

  • Previous production or instructional design experience.

Why Join ELB Learning?

Join a collaborative team committed to creating exceptional learning experiences for organizations worldwide. You'll work alongside talented instructional designers, developers, creatives, and strategists while helping ensure every learning solution meets the highest standards of quality before it reaches our clients.

job.title: Penetration Tester - UK
job.description:
Location: UK (Remote) Must be based in the UK.

Salary: Competitive Compensation

About Cognisys

Cognisys is a global cybersecurity company specialising in Penetration Testing, GRC Consulting and Managed Security services. We work with organisations across more than 30 countries, helping them identify risk, strengthen their security posture and navigate an increasingly complex cybersecurity landscape.

We're a small but mighty team with ambitious plans for growth. We combine deep technical expertise with a strong focus on customer service, practical advice and delivering meaningful outcomes for our clients.

Our people are at the heart of what we do. We value Together, Ownership, Momentum and Excellence,and we want people who are curious, collaborative and willing to take ownership of their work.

As we continue to grow, you'll have the opportunity to work alongside experienced cybersecurity professionals, contribute to challenging client engagements and help shape the way we deliver our services. We believe in giving our people the opportunity to develop, share ideas and make a genuine impact.

The Opportunity

Are you ready to make an impact in the fast-paced world of cybersecurity?

Cognisys is growing rapidly, and we're looking for a Pen Tester to join our team during an exciting period of innovation and expansion.

As a Pen Tester, you'll be responsible for delivering and supporting security assessments across a range of client environments, including networks, applications and cloud infrastructure.

You'll use a combination of automated tools and manual techniques to simulate real-world attack scenarios, identify meaningful vulnerabilities and help clients understand and address their security risks.

This is a client-facing role where technical expertise is only part of the job. You'll also need to communicate your findings clearly, produce high-quality reports and help both technical and non-technical stakeholders understand the risks and practical steps they can take to improve their security posture.

What You'll Be Doing

Penetration Testing & Security Assessments

  • Conduct penetration testing across networks, web applications, APIs, mobile applications and cloud environments.

  • Simulate real-world attack scenarios to assess client resilience against cyber threats.

  • Use a combination of automated vulnerability scanning tools and manual testing and exploitation techniques.

  • Identify, analyse and exploit security vulnerabilities across diverse client environments.

  • Assess the effectiveness of technical security controls and identify opportunities for improvement.

  • Apply appropriate offensive security methodologies, tools and techniques throughout engagements.

  • Stay up to date with emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques and industry developments.

Client Delivery & Communication

  • Work directly with clients throughout penetration testing engagements.

  • Present findings and recommendations clearly and professionally.

  • Help clients understand the potential business and technical impact of identified vulnerabilities.

  • Communicate complex technical concepts in a way that is accessible to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Support clients in understanding and prioritising remediation activities.

  • Build positive and professional relationships with client stakeholders.

Reporting & Quality

  • Produce high-quality technical reports following each engagement.

  • Clearly document vulnerabilities, exploitation techniques, evidence, risk and remediation recommendations.

  • Ensure technical findings are accurate, well-evidenced and easy for clients to understand.

  • Translate technical detail into clear, practical recommendations for both technical and executive audiences.

  • Maintain Cognisys' high standards for quality, consistency and client service.

Team Contribution & Development

  • Work collaboratively with the wider cybersecurity team.

  • Share knowledge, techniques and lessons learned with colleagues.

  • Contribute to the continued development of Cognisys' penetration testing methodologies and ways of working.

  • Take ownership of your continued technical and professional development.

  • Support a culture of learning, collaboration and continuous improvement.

About You

We're looking for someone with a strong technical foundation in offensive security who is equally comfortable working with clients and communicating technical findings.

You'll ideally have:

  • Hands-on experience conducting penetration testing and security assessments.

  • Experience using vulnerability scanning tools alongside manual testing and exploitation techniques.

  • A strong understanding of offensive security methodologies, tools and techniques.

  • A strong grasp of how to assess and break technical controls, with the ability to explain the findings clearly to clients.

  • Experience across one or more of the following areas:

    • Network penetration testing

    • Web application testing

    • API testing

    • Mobile application testing

    • Cloud security testing

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • The ability to communicate technical vulnerabilities and risks in a clear, non-technical format.

  • Strong client engagement skills and a professional approach to customer service.

  • The ability to manage your workload effectively and deliver work to agreed deadlines.

  • A proactive approach to learning and keeping up to date with developments in offensive security.

Certifications

The following certifications are highly regarded:

Industry-recognised certifications are preferred and may include:

  • OSCP

  • CPSA

  • CRT

  • CREST-related certifications

  • Other relevant penetration testing or offensive security certifications

Relevant practical experience will also be considered alongside formal certifications.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role means becoming a trusted technical consultant who can independently deliver high-quality penetration testing engagements while providing an excellent client experience.

For Example:

  • Deliver thorough, accurate and professional penetration testing engagements across a variety of client environments.

  • Confidently assess and exploit vulnerabilities using a combination of automated tools and manual testing techniques.

  • Demonstrate a strong understanding of how technical controls can be assessed, bypassed and exploited in realistic attack scenarios.

  • Produce clear, detailed and actionable technical reports that help clients understand their vulnerabilities and how to remediate them.

  • Communicate technical findings effectively to both technical teams and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Present findings and recommendations confidently to clients and support them in prioritising remediation.

  • Take ownership of your engagements, managing your testing, documentation and deliverables effectively.

  • Continue to develop your technical knowledge and stay current with evolving offensive security techniques, tools and threats.

  • Contribute positively to the wider penetration testing team by sharing knowledge, supporting colleagues and continuously looking for ways to improve our approach.

Why Join Us?

At Cognisys, you will be part of a collaborative and innovative team that values your input and shares support. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects that make a real impact for our clients. We'd love to hear from you if you want to challenge, lead and innovate! We're not just about the work; we're about the people. Join a team where innovation is celebrated, and your contributions are valued. We foster a collaborative environment where fresh ideas thrive, and professional growth is encouraged.

What we Offer:

  • Annual Leave: 25 days per year plus 8 English bank holidays.

  • Additional Leave: 1 day of paid leave for your Birthday.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Access to Westfield Health Care Cash Plan and an employee mental health and wellbeing platform.

  • Professional Development: £2,000 annual training budget to support your continued learning and career growth.

  • Referral Bonus: help to grow our team and earn up to £2,000 per successful referral.

Applications

We’re always happy to help with questions, but to keep our process fair for everyone, we’re unable to accept applications via email—please apply directly through the job advert page.

Please feel free to reach out to Andrea, our Talent Acquisition Lead, if you would like any further information, to discuss accessibility requirements, or if you require this information provided in an alternative format –

We welcome applications from candidates from a range of diverse backgrounds and can make various reasonable adjustments to consider individual needs.

job.title: Claims Quality Assurance Supervisor
job.description:
At WelbeHealth, we serve our communities’ most vulnerable seniors through shared intention, pioneering spirit, and the courage to love. These core values and our participant focus lead the way no matter what.

The Claims Quality Assurance Supervisor is responsible for developing and overseeing a group of para-professional level team members to ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements of processed claims on a pre and post pay basis. This position is a member of the WelbeHealth management team and facilitates collaborative relationships across WelbeHealth and with external stakeholders to promote WelbeHealth values, team culture and mission.

This role is different because the Claims Quality Assurance Supervisor WelbeHealth:

  • Leads claims quality assurance strategy and execution, ensuring accurate and timely claims payments while maintaining compliance with Medicare, Medicaid, contractual, and regulatory requirements across a growing healthcare organization.
  • Drives continuous improvement through data-driven auditing, trend analysis, and cross-functional collaboration, while developing team members, strengthening workflows, and implementing quality standards that support operational excellence and accurate claims processing.

We care about our team members. That’s why we offer:

  • Medical insurance coverage (Medical, Dental, Vision)
  • Work/life balance - We mean it! 17 days of personal time off (PTO), 12 holidays observed annually, and 6 sick days
  • 401K savings + match
  • Comprehensive compensation package including base pay and bonus
  • And additional benefits!

On the day-to-day, you will:

  • Oversee auditing activities that claims are paid in an accurate and timely manner and in accordance with internal and external regulations and guidelines
  • Identify issues and operational gaps, develop solutions, and make recommendations for improvement regarding processing and training
  • Track progress and communicating audits results/status on a regular basis to impact parties
  • Make recommendations related to identified trends or improvements, and work with management and team members in other departments to implement changes, as directed by identified trends
  • Create and update team procedures, workflows, and resource materials
  • Monitor the results of daily team member activities, report critical issues and/or concerns to management
  • Serve as the primary resource and point of escalation of issues related to quality assurance
  • Provide direct supervision, support, and guidance to team members
  • Evaluate team member performance, provide feedback, coaching and counseling when performance issues arise. Identify training gaps and opportunities for improved performance

Job requirements include:

  • Associates degree preferred or relevant professional experience in a health plan environment with an emphasis on billing, claims payment, coding and/or other closely related functions may be substituted
  • Minimum of five (5) years’ experience in health plans, i.e., managed care or PACE strongly preferred
  • Experience in claims processing environment, with an emphasis on claims auditing
  • Progressively responsible experience with demonstrated ability to mentor team members required
  • Working knowledge in Medicare and/or Medicaid billing and guidelines and ability to understand and analyze contractual and regulatory requirements and their effect on claims payment and resolutions
  • Ability to process accurate information in a timely manner; Excellent leadership, organizational and communication skills
  • Experience leading in a data-driven organization, leveraging reports and data to prioritize and manage people and projects; Comprehensive knowledge of claims processing and regulations, strong problem solving skills, and the ability to analyze problems and formulate solutions

If you’re a strategic, detail-oriented leader who is passionate about claims accuracy, regulatory compliance, and continuous improvement, we’d love to hear from you. Join us in strengthening claims quality, developing high-performing teams, and ensuring accurate, compliant claims processing that supports our mission to serve our participants.

Compensation consists of base salary plus bonus. WelbeHealth offers a competitive total rewards package that includes a 401(k) match, comprehensive healthcare coverage, and a broad range of additional benefits. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience and relevant qualifications.

job.description:
| About us:
Foodsmart is the leading Foodcare platform in the U.S., built to deliver nutrition-driven healthcare at scale. Powered by a national network of Registered Dietitians, Foodsmart combines personalized clinical nutrition care, behavior change tools, and food benefits to improve member health outcomes while lowering healthcare costs.

Our platform is designed to foster healthier food choices, drive lasting behavior change, and deliver sustainable health outcomes. Through our highly personalized, digital platform, we guide more than 3 million members—including those in employer-sponsored health plans, regional and national Medicaid managed care organizations, Medicare Advantage plans, and commercial insurers—on a tailored journey to eating well while saving time and money.

Foodsmart seamlessly integrates dietary assessments and nutrition counseling with online food ordering and cost-effective meal planning for the entire family, optimizing ingredients both at home and on the go. We partner with national and regional retailers across the U.S., many of whom accept SNAP/EBT, making healthier food more accessible. Additionally, we assist members with SNAP enrollment and management, providing tangible access to nutritious food. In 2024, Foodsmart secured a $200 million investment from TPG’s Rise Fund, which supports entrepreneurs dedicated to achieving the United Nations’ Sustainable Development Goals. This investment helps us expand our reach, particularly to low-income workers who are disproportionately affected by diet-related diseases.

At Foodsmart, our mission is to make nutritious food accessible and affordable for everyone, regardless of economic status. We are committed to a set of core values that shape our culture and work environment:

👥 Customer First - You start with the member and work backwards.
🚀 Make It Happen - You act with urgency, use data, and hold high standards.
🤝 One Team - You collaborate with respect and commit as a group.

Whether you're a dietitian, a commercial leader, or a technologist, working at Foodsmart means being part of a team that is passionate, supportive, and driven by a shared purpose. Join us in transforming the way people access and enjoy healthy food.

| About the role:
Foodsmart is seeking a proactive and detail-oriented QA Lead to take ownership of day-to-day QA execution and team coordination in our health tech platform. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with test automation, manual testing, and data validation, and will be responsible for ensuring end-to-end quality across our web, mobile, backend, and data-driven products. As QA Lead, you’ll guide junior testers, collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, and ensure that releases are timely, high-quality, and compliant with healthcare standards.

You will

  • Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of test cases, test plans, and test scripts for features and releases
  • Coordinate testing efforts across web UI, mobile apps, APIs, and backend services
  • Develop and maintain automated test suites using Cypress, Playwright, or similar tools
  • Validate data quality and transformations across data pipelines and Data Lakes
  • Support testing for AI/ML models and ensure output consistency and accuracy
  • Collaborate with developers, product managers, and DevOps to ensure CI/CD integration and fast feedback loops
  • Track and report on test coverage, defect metrics, and release readiness
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to QA engineers and manual testers
  • Drive regression, smoke, and performance testing across environments
  • Ensure adherence to QA best practices, including compliance with HIPAA and health tech regulatory standards

You are

  • Detail-oriented with a strong ability to break down complex systems into testable components.
  • Collaborative and communicative, partnering well with engineers, PMs, and QA peers.
  • Curious and continuously seeking better tools, methods, and insights to improve testing.
  • Resilient and able to adapt quickly in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
  • Motivated by Foodsmart’s mission and driven to build high-quality software that makes a meaningful impact.

You have

  • 8+ years of experience in software QA, including 3-5 years in a lead or senior QA role
  • Programming knowledge with Typescript/Javascript and/or Python
  • Strong hands-on experience in automated UI/API testing framework like Playwright, Cucumber, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, TestNG, JUnit, Protractor.
  • Experience testing mobile apps test automation.
  • Familiarity with data quality testing in cloud-based environments (e.g., AWS, Redshift, S3)
  • Comfortable writing and executing SQL queries for backend validation
  • Exposure to AI/ML product testing or model verification workflows
  • Strong understanding of Agile methodologies, CI/CD pipelines, and software development lifecycle
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills
  • Preferred Qualifications:
  • Back end development with node.js and TypeScript/Javascript.
  • Advanced SQL knowledge and proficiency in working with relational databases.
  • Familiarity with data pipeline and workflow management tools like Apache Airflow or Luigi.
  • Hands-on experience with data warehouse solutions such as Snowflake or Redshift.
  • Prior experience in health tech, digital health, or telehealth platforms
  • Knowledge of healthcare compliance standards like HIPAA
  • Experience with test management tools (e.g., TestRail, Zephyr) and bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira)
  • Familiarity with performance testing tools like JMeter, k6, or Postman for load testing

  1. Analizujemy Twoją aplikację

Administratorem danych osobowych jest Storware sp. z o.o. z siedzibą w Warszawie (ul. Bakalarska 15A U2, 02-212 Warszawa). 📃 O PROJEKCIE

Projekt zakłada ciągły rozwój produktu, a plan rozwoju sięga daleko w przyszłość. Praca opiera się na kreatywnym podejściu do tworzenia rozwiązań, m.in. poprzez brainstorming i pair programming. W codziennych zadaniach pojawiają się zagadnienia DevOps oraz technologie związane z chmurą, konteneryzacją i wirtualizacją.

Każda osoba w zespole ma realny wpływ na kształt powstających rozwiązań. Ceniona jest współpraca, inicjatywa oraz odpowiedzialność za wspólny rezultat.

👤 Kogo poszukujemy?

Poszukujemy osoby na stanowisko Mid Manual Tester, które będzie odpowiedzialna za testowanie nowych funkcjonalności (testy manualne, API i integracyjne), przygotowywanie scenariuszy testowych oraz raportowanie wyników testów. Osoba na tym stanowisku będzie ściśle współpracować z zespołem programistycznym, korzystać z systemów ticketowych (np. JIRA) oraz pracować w środowiskach Linux i Windows.

job.title: Senior RDMA Performance Engineer
job.description:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

The project involves SONiC validation on NVIDIA Spectrum-Based Platforms for AI Networking.

What else you should know:

  • We use Agile methodology.

  • The team operates within a startup environment.

  • The client is based in the US.

We work on multiple interesting projects at the time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to the interview for another project if we see that your competencies and profile are well suited for it.

Your role

As a part of the project team, you will be responsible for:

  • Configure, troubleshoot, and maintain NVIDIA/Mellanox Spectrum switches and ConnectX Network Interface Cards (NICs).

  • Implement and tune advanced congestion control mechanisms essential for AI workloads, including RoCEv2, Priority-based Flow Control (PFC), and Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN).

  • Optimize network environments to ensure maximum throughput, minimal latency, and minimal Job Completion Time (JCT) by performing setup tuning.

  • Conduct extensive performance benchmarking and validation testing on AI-ready data center fabrics utilizing RDMA and the NVIDIA Collective Communication Library (NCCL).

  • Leverage AI agents and specialized tools to automate routine network tasks, conduct rigorous testing, and analyze network telemetry.

  • Author and maintain clear, high-quality technical documentation detailing network designs, configurations, and benchmarking results.

Do we have a match?

As a RDMA Performance engineer you must meet the following criteria:

  • 7+ years of professional experiencein network engineering, with preferably 3+ years specifically focused on data center network design and architecture.

  • Hands-on experience configuring and troubleshooting core network protocols and technologies, including BGP, EVPN/VXLAN, LACP, and ECMP.

  • Deep understanding of AI-dedicated data center designs, including Rail-Optimized Design (ROD) and Rail-Unified Design (RUD) topologies, coupled with practical, hands-on experience configuring and deploying them.

  • Proven experience configuring, managing, and troubleshooting NVIDIA/Mellanox Spectrum switches and ConnectX Network Interface Cards (NICs).

  • Deep understanding of the protocols and congestion control mechanisms required for AI-dedicated data centers, specifically RoCEv2, Priority-based Flow Control (PFC), and Explicit Congestion Notification (ECN).

  • Demonstrated ability to tune and optimize network environments, with specific focus on switch buffer tuning and the implementation of Quality of Service (QoS) policies.

  • Experience conducting performance benchmarking and validation for AI-ready data center fabrics utilizing RDMA and the NVIDIA Collective Communication Library (NCCL).

  • Demonstrated ability to leverage AI agents/tools to automate tasks, testing, and analysis

  • Strong technical documentation skills and professional English communication

Beyond the criteria above, we would appreciate the nice-to-haves:

  • Professional-level certifications (CCNP/CCIE Enterprise/DC, JNCIP or equivalent)

  • Hands-on experience with network automation & validation frameworks (pyATS, NAPALM, Batfish, Nornir, NetBox)

  • Exposure to CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI, GitHub Actions, Jenkins) and IaC concepts

More reasons to join us

  • Flexible working hours and approach to work: fully remotely, in the office or hybrid

  • Professional growth supported by internal training sessions and a training budget

  • Solid onboarding with a hands-on approach to give you an easy start

  • A great atmosphere among professionals who are passionate about their work

  • The ability to change the project you work on

job.title: Penetration Tester - South Africa
job.description:
Location: South Africa (Remote)

Salary: R400 000 - R550 000 per annum (DOE)

About Cognisys

Are you ready to make an impact in the fast-paced world of cybersecurity? Cognisys is growing rapidly, and we’re looking for a Penetration Tester to join our team during this exciting period of innovation and expansion.

Cognisys is a leading cybersecurity company specialising in Penetration Testing, GRC Consulting and Managed Security Services. We pride ourselves on our customer service, forward-thinking approach and commitment to excellence. Our small but mighty team works with some of the best-known companies in the world and supports clients across more than 30 countries.

The Opportunity

As a Pen Tester, you will play a key role in delivering high-quality security assessments for our clients. You will test a range of environments, including networks, web applications, APIs, mobile applications and cloud infrastructure, using a combination of automated tools and manual testing techniques.

This is an opportunity to work on varied and challenging engagements, collaborate with experienced cybersecurity professionals and work directly with clients to help them understand and improve their security posture.

What You'll Be Doing

As a Penetration Tester, you will:

  • Conduct penetration testing across network, web application, API, mobile application and cloud environments.

  • Simulate real-world attack scenarios to assess clients' resilience against cyber threats.

  • Use a combination of automated tools, manual testing and exploitation techniques to identify and validate vulnerabilities.

  • Assess technical security controls and identify potential weaknesses and attack paths.

  • Analyse vulnerabilities and assess their potential business and security impact.

  • Produce high-quality technical reports outlining vulnerabilities, associated risks and practical remediation recommendations.

  • Clearly communicate complex technical findings in a way that can be understood by both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

  • Present findings and recommendations directly to clients, helping them understand, prioritise and remediate identified vulnerabilities.

  • Work collaboratively with colleagues to ensure the successful delivery of client engagements.

  • Keep up to date with emerging threats, vulnerabilities, tools and offensive security techniques.

  • Contribute to the continued development and improvement of Cognisys' penetration testing capabilities and methodologies.

What Success Looks Like

In your first few months, success in this role will look like:

  • Building a strong understanding of Cognisys' services, methodologies and approach to client delivery.

  • Successfully delivering penetration testing engagements to a high standard.

  • Producing clear, accurate and high-quality reports that provide clients with meaningful and actionable recommendations.

  • Building strong relationships with clients and communicating confidently throughout engagements.

  • Demonstrating sound technical judgement when identifying, validating and assessing vulnerabilities.

  • Effectively managing your time and workload across multiple engagements and competing priorities.

  • Continuously developing your technical knowledge and keeping up to date with developments in the offensive security landscape.

  • Contributing ideas and expertise to help improve our tools, methodologies and ways of working.

About You

We're looking for a passionate and technically capable penetration tester who enjoys understanding how systems work, identifying weaknesses and thinking creatively about how security controls could be bypassed.

You'll be someone who is naturally curious, enjoys solving complex problems and is motivated by staying ahead of emerging threats and attack techniques.

We’re also looking for someone who can combine strong technical capability with excellent client communication. You should be comfortable explaining complex vulnerabilities clearly, presenting your findings and helping clients understand the practical steps they can take to improve their security.

You'll thrive in this role if you enjoy variety, working across different technologies and environments, collaborating with others and continuously developing your technical skills.

Essential Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience conducting penetration testing across one or more areas, including networks, web applications, APIs, mobile applications or cloud environments.

  • Strong understanding of offensive security methodologies, tools and techniques.

  • Experience using vulnerability scanning tools alongside manual testing and exploitation techniques.

  • Strong grasp of how to assess and break technical controls and identify potential attack paths.

  • Experience identifying, analysing and validating security vulnerabilities.

  • Ability to assess the potential impact and risk associated with identified vulnerabilities.

  • Experience producing high-quality penetration testing reports with clear and practical remediation recommendations.

  • Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.

  • Excellent client engagement skills and confidence presenting technical findings and recommendations.

  • Ability to manage multiple engagements, priorities and deadlines effectively.

  • A proactive approach to problem-solving and continuous learning.

Desirable Skills & Experience

  • Industry-recognised certifications such as CPSA, CRT, OSCP or similar.

  • Experience testing a broad range of technologies and environments.

  • Experience working within a cybersecurity consultancy or professional services environment.

  • Experience presenting penetration testing findings directly to clients.

  • Knowledge of emerging cybersecurity threats, attack techniques and offensive security tools.

  • Experience with cloud security assessments across platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP.

  • Experience with API and mobile application security testing.

Certifications

Industry-recognised penetration testing or offensive security certifications are highly desirable, including:

  • OSCP – Offensive Security Certified Professional

  • CPSA – CREST Practitioner Security Analyst

  • CRT – CREST Registered Tester

  • CREST CPSA/CRT equivalent certifications

  • Other recognised offensive security or penetration testing certifications will also be considered.

We value practical technical capability and hands-on experience alongside certifications, so candidates with strong relevant experience who are working towards certification are also encouraged to apply.

Why Join Us?

At Cognisys, you will be part of a collaborative and innovative team that values your input and shares support. You'll have the opportunity to work on challenging projects that make a real impact for our clients. We'd love to hear from you if you want to challenge, lead and innovate! We're not just about the work; we're about the people. Join a team where innovation is celebrated, and your contributions are valued. We foster a collaborative environment where fresh ideas thrive, and professional growth is encouraged.

What we Offer:

  • Annual Leave: 25 days per year plus 12 South African public holidays.

  • Additional Leave: 1 day of paid leave for your Birthday.

  • Health & Wellbeing: Individual healthcare insurance plan and access to an employee mental health and wellbeing platform.

  • Professional Development: £2,000 annual training budget to support your continued learning and career growth.

  • Referral Bonus: help to grow our team and earn up to £2,000 per successful referral.

Applications

We’re always happy to help with questions, but to keep our process fair for everyone, we’re unable to accept applications via email—please apply directly through the job advert page.

Please feel free to reach out to Andrea, our Talent Acquisition Lead, if you would like any further information, to discuss accessibility requirements, or if you require this information provided in an alternative format –

We welcome applications from candidates from a range of diverse backgrounds and can make various reasonable adjustments to consider individual needs.

job.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

As part of Tenstorrent’s Automotive Robotics team, you will help design and deliver the core hardware modules inside our next generation chiplet based SoCs for automotive products. You will be the bridge between silicon design, DFT, OSAT partners, and customers to ensure our multi die SiP platforms meet aggressive performance, quality, and safety targets.

This role is remote, based in Munich, Germany.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

  • Experienced with industry standard ATPG and DFx insertion CAD tools.
  • Fluent in RTL coding for DFx logic including lock-up latches, clock gates, and scan anchors.
  • Able to translate system and safety requirements into concrete constraints on package architecture, DFT insertion, and support test engineering with planning, patterns, and debug.
  • Comfortable working in a cross functional role that extends beyond DFT, including low power designs with multiple clock domains.
  • Knowledge of fault models including Stuck-at, Transition, Gate-Exhaustive, Path Delay, IDDQ, and Cell Aware.
  • Exposure to post-silicon testing and tester pattern debug are major assets.
  • Experience with Fault Campaigns a plus.

What We Need

  • Define DFx strategy for multi chiplet packages from architecture through high volume production.
  • 10+ years of experience working across multiple teams and multiple companies to coordinate test, yield, and quality efforts.
  • Feed lessons learned back into next generation SiP architectures, DFT strategy, and test content.
  • MBIST, LBIST, IST planning, implementation, and verification.
  • JTAG, Scan Compression, and ASST implementation.
  • ATPG and test coverage analysis using industry standard tools.

What You Will Learn

  • How to bring a SiP to high volume, automotive grade production.
  • How chiplets, RISC V CPUs, AI accelerators, and die to die links come together in a unified automotive platform.
  • How to trade off package architecture, DFT, and test cost to hit aggressive performance, quality, and reliability targets.

Sobre a GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH

Valorizamos quem tem BRIO!

Somos uma empresa formada por NERDs apaixonados por resolver problemas complexos com tecnologia inteligente. Atuamos com uma mentalidade de jogo infinito: não focamos em ganhar uma partida isolada, mas em permanecer no jogo, buscando desafios cada vez maiores e manter um aprendizado contínuo para ser cada dia melhor.

Aqui, novas vagas importantes são prioritariamente preenchidas com pessoas da casa.

Nossos processos seletivos buscam futuros parceiros e sócios para a empresa. Para ir rápido, melhor ir sozinho. Se queremos construir algo grande, precisamos nos juntar a mais gente boa que pense como a gente. Dedicamos muito tempo nos processos seletivos para achar essas pessoas e entregamos desafios constantes para promover crescimento. Temos hoje comosócios da empresa, muitas pessoas que começaram em posições de base e mostraram que têm vontade de ser mais.

Fundadores [nossa base]

Uma empresa é a extensão dos valores e sonhos de seus sócios fundadores. A GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH foi fundada por quatro sócios, que têm como primeira formação a tecnologia, e são apaixonados por servir os outros usando seu conhecimento e por resolver problemas complexos.

Perfil que buscamos

Buscamos pessoas capazes de se adaptar a cenários dinâmicos e com sede de conhecimento. Valorizamos a inquietude: a busca constante por evoluir processos e construir resultados melhores a cada dia.

Se você é apaixonado por solucionar problemas com excelência, busca desafios que te tirem da zona de conforto e nunca está satisfeito com o mediano, seu lugar é aqui.

Venha construir o futuro da infraestrutura de crédito com a gente!



Sobre a vaga

Estamos em busca de um(a) Analista de QA Pleno para atuar junto ao nosso time de tecnologia e operação. Essa não é uma vaga padrão, o que precisamos é de uma mistura de uma pessoa que entenda muito do dia a dia do nosso time de operações e com habilidades em teste de software e garantia de qualidade. Como tudo na GIRO.TECH>GIRO.TECH, não tentamos seguir padrões e sim buscar soluções para os problemas.

Se você é nerd como a gente, gosta de mercado financeiro e tecnologia, essa vaga pode ser o que está buscando. Essa é a primeira vaga do nosso time de QA. Nossa intenção é passar muito conhecimento a essa pessoa para que se desenvolva e, em 12 meses, se torne líder da área. Será uma jornada de muito conhecimento sobre tecnologia e crédito estruturado. Sua grande missão será ajudar nosso time de operações no mapeamento de melhorias necessárias em nossos sistemas (todos desenvolvidos in-house), descrever o que precisa ser melhorado, escrever as histórias de testes e fazer a garantia de qualidade em homologação e produção.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Sua principal missão será ter domínio sobre as responsabilidades do nosso time de operação, conhecer os sistemas utilizados e mapear pontos de melhoria. Nossa missão é que o time de operação tenha cada vez menos trabalhos manuais e, para isso, precisamos melhorar constantemente nossos sistemas e processos. Suas principais responsabilidades serão:

  • Dominar as características de negócio da Bancarização e da Securitização. Saber as principais dores que os clientes e nosso time interno têm, como eles usam o produto e detalhes de negócio que podem afetar a operação.
  • Dominar a forma como a operação de bancarização funciona, conhecer os procedimentos diários de todas as operações da área e particularidades de cada uma. Entender todas as possibilidades de configuração dos nossos produtos, tais como: CDC, empréstimo pessoal, consignado, crédito automotivo, tipos de desembolso (automático, direcionado a loja, etc).
  • Conhecer todas as dependências do produto, tais como: ferramentas de assinatura, fornecedor de infra PIX para o desembolso, assinatura de endosso, biometria, etc.
  • Planejar e executar testes manuais e automatizados (API, integração e regressão), garantindo cobertura adequada para cada entrega.
  • Escrever e manter casos de teste claros e organizados, utilizando ferramentas de gestão de QA.
  • Testar nossas APIs e integrações com parceiros, validando fluxos de ponta a ponta, incluindo cenários de erro e edge cases.
  • Definir e acompanhar métricas de qualidade: taxa de bugs em produção, cobertura de testes, tempo de regressão, bugs por severidade.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias de sprint, colaborando na definição de critérios de aceite e validando entregas junto ao time de desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar os times em demandas e dúvidas sobre funcionalidades e processos, atuando como referência de como os fluxos funcionam nos sistemas e na operação.
  • Apoiar na priorização de atividades do produto junto com o time de negócio e técnico.
  • Ajudar na avaliação de issues reportadas por clientes, diagnosticando a causa raiz e propondo soluções (processos ou novas funcionalidades).
  • Criar automações de processos utilizando ferramentas de IA (como Claude e similares), buscando sempre — com segurança — automatizar tarefas do dia a dia não resolvidas em nossos sistemas.
  • Construir e manter documentação de qualidade: mapas de fluxo, cenários de teste, relatórios de bugs e playbooks de regressão.

O que buscamos (requisitos)

  • Bagagem profissional a altura do desafio, vontade de aprender e crescer. A graduação formal agrega mas não é um requisito.
  • Vivência anterior em times de tecnologia e QA relacionados a crédito e/ou mercado financeiro.
  • Gestão de ambientes de testes e homologação
  • Conhecimento de API testing
  • SQL básico
  • Noções de CI/CD
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de automação de testes

Perfil

  • Estar alinhado com nossos pilares de cultura, ser interessado, entregar mais que o esperado, comunicar-se com clareza e transparência..
  • Saber ouvir o cliente final (nosso cliente ou time de ops) e transformar problemas em possibilidades de melhoria.
  • Colaborar com o time e entender o que o negócio precisa.
  • Ser orientado a resultados.
  • Ser crítico. Questionar quando não estiver satisfeito com a solução independente de hierarquias, tempo de casa e posições.
  • Ser independente, buscando melhorias proativamente, sem esperar comando. Como será o ponto de partida desta área, exercitaremos muito a liberdade com responsabilidade, sabendo que buscar ajuda e colaborar é parte fundamental do processo.
  • Ser aberto a feedbacks e realizar as conversas difíceis sempre que necessário, com maturidade.

Informações adicionais

Cultura e liberdade

  • Remote First: trabalhe de onde quiser.
  • Sem Dress Code: vista-se como for mais confortável.

job.title: Test Engineer III
job.description:
Start Date: Immediate

JHNA, CTSi, and EXPANSIA have come together to form a Defense Technology platform named Aether Aerospace focused on delivering high-impact technologies, technology-enabled services and advanced manufacturing solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense and related national security customers. Backed by Falfurrias Management Partners, the platform brings together deep domain expertise across Army, Navy, and Air Force and Space Force programs, digital engineering, systems integration, and specialized manufacturing capabilities.

The combined organization operates as a multi-entity aerospace and defense technology and tech-enabled services and manufacturing enterprise positioned for scalable growth, operational excellence, and long-term value creation

OVERVIEW

Full-time/Permanent Employee

Location: Remote

Aether Aerospace is seeking a Test Engineer to support the development, integration, and maturation of complex digital engineering solutions from requirements and conceptual design through prototype development and transition. The Test Engineer will plan, execute, and document verification and validation activities across cloud platforms, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), application functionality and user experience, cybersecurity controls, system integrations, and end-to-end engineering workflows.

The initial prototype environment may be implemented in Azure Government, with the longer-term objective of supporting cloud-agnostic architectures capable of operating across additional commercial or government cloud environments. The Test Engineer will help ensure testing approaches, automation, and validation methods are adaptable, scalable, and not unnecessarily dependent on a single cloud provider.

This role will work closely with cloud, software, cybersecurity, systems engineering, Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), data, and program teams to ensure capabilities meet approved requirements and are ready for iterative reviews, stakeholder showcases, formal demonstrations, and future transition activities.

RESPONSIBILTIES

    • Develop and execute test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test scripts based on approved requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical design documentation.

    • Perform functional, integration, regression, system, user acceptance, performance, load, recovery, and end-to-end workflow testing across the prototype environment.

    • Validate cloud platform services, initially within Microsoft Azure, including networking, identity and access management, role-based access control (RBAC), logging, monitoring, configuration, and environment provisioning.

    • Develop testing approaches that support future cloud-agnostic and multi-cloud deployment models.

    • Support STIG evidence collection using tools using tools such as Selenium, Robot Framework, or similar tools.

    • Test Infrastructure as Code deployments using Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, OpenTofu, Gitlab CI/CD, AKS or similar technologies to confirm repeatability, configuration accuracy, portability, and deployment integrity.

    • Validate CI/CD-enabled deployments, configuration changes, and rollback activities in coordination with development and platform teams.

    • Test application functionality, user workflows, usability, accessibility, APIs, interfaces, and system integrations supporting secure digital engineering collaboration.

    • Conduct security-focused testing of authentication, authorization, least-privilege access, audit logging, configuration controls, vulnerability remediation, and other cybersecurity requirements.

    • Support verification of capabilities operating in a Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI)-capable environment and provide test evidence needed for program security and assessment activities.

    • Validate representative data-lifecycle processes, data movement, permissions, traceability, and integration across the Digital Engineering Ecosystem.

    • Perform functional and integration testing of AI/LLM-enabled services and workflows, including expected behavior, access controls, and interactions with other prototype capabilities.

    • Maintain requirements-to-test traceability and document objective evidence demonstrating that requirements have been verified and validated.

    • Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects through resolution; retest corrective actions and support root-cause analysis as needed.

    • Develop and implement automated test cases using the Pester testing framework to validate cloud automation, runbooks, and infrastructure operations.

    • Support automated testing where practical and integrate repeatable test execution into DevSecOps pipelines.

    • Assess capability readiness prior to bi-weekly showcases, formal demonstrations, and prototype acceptance activities.

    • Participate in Agile ceremonies, technical reviews, backlog refinement, demonstrations, and cross-functional engineering activities.

    • Ensure 100% of planned hours are worked and recorded

    • Identify and forward to your leadership any opportunities that could lead to growth within your work area

    • Participate in growth efforts as requested

    • Ensure all contractual deliverables are met/exceeded to the customer's satisfaction

    • Complete personal PDP and attend Company Meetings (with camera on)

    • Within your program, build productive and positive professional relationships with clients

    • Execute all contract requirements as assigned in accordance with the contract-specific LCAT and requirements

    • Perform other related duties as assigned

KEY QUALIFICATIONS

    Clearance:Active Secret clearance
    Education and Years of Experience:Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering, Systems Engineering, Cybersecurity, or a related technical discipline (or equivalent) with 5+ years of experience in software testing, systems testing, quality assurance, or test engineering, or a Master's with 3+ years of experience. Equivalent relevant experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.

    • Experience testing applications, services, or infrastructure in Microsoft Azure or another enterprise cloud environment.

    • Experience developing and executing formal test plans, test cases, test procedures, and test reports.

    • Experience validating Infrastructure as Code and automated infrastructure deployments.

    • Experience with functional, integration, regression, system, and end-to-end testing.

    • Experience testing web applications, APIs, system integrations, and user workflows.

    • Working knowledge of cloud security concepts, RBAC, authentication, authorization, logging, configuration management, and vulnerability remediation.

    • Understanding of cloud architecture concepts and the ability to apply testing approaches across different cloud environments.

    • Experience working in Agile and DevSecOps environments and using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

    • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, documentation, and communication skills.

PREFERRED ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

    • Experience supporting Department of War or Federal Government programs.

    • Familiarity with RMF, NIST security controls, STIGs, or related DoD cybersecurity requirements.

    • Experience with Microsoft Azure, with exposure to AWS, Google Cloud, Oracle Cloud, or other enterprise cloud platforms considered a plus.

    • Experience with cloud-agnostic technologies such as Terraform, containers, Kubernetes, or portable CI/CD pipelines.

    • Experience with automated testing tools or frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, Robot Framework, Cypress, Postman/Newman, pytest, Pester, Vitest, or similar tools.

    • Experience with Azure DevOps or comparable CI/CD platforms and cloud-native testing practices.

    • Experience with usability, accessibility, or UX testing.

    • Familiarity with Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE), digital engineering environments, digital twins, engineering data workflows, or governed AI/LLM services.

    • Experience supporting formal technical reviews, customer demonstrations, or prototype verification and acceptance activities.

Aether Aerospace is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.

job.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
job.description:
Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist

Company: Circle of Greatness
Location: Remote
Compensation: Up to $10 USD/hour, based on experience
Position: Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist

About the Role

Circle of Greatness is looking for a highly detail-oriented Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist to serve as the final checkpoint before client-facing work is released.

The ideal candidate has an exceptional eye for detail and enjoys finding errors, testing functionality, and making sure that every deliverable meets the expected quality standards before it goes live.

You will review different types of digital assets, including copy, graphics, funnels, landing pages, emails, SMS campaigns, paid ads, event materials, videos, reports, and proposals.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review client-facing deliverables before release to ensure accuracy, consistency, functionality, and quality.
  • Review copy for spelling, grammar, punctuation, consistency, brand voice, product information, pricing, and other important details.
  • Review graphics for text accuracy, branding, image quality, dimensions, cropping, mobile readability, and overall consistency.
  • Test funnels and landing pages, including links, buttons, forms, checkouts, upsells, thank-you pages, tags, automations, and tracking.
  • Review email and SMS campaigns for links, merge fields, sender information, formatting, and functionality.
  • Validate paid advertising assets, URLs, UTMs, creative versions, and campaign details.
  • Review event materials to confirm dates, times, time zones, speaker information, links, and other important details.
  • Review videos for captions, on-screen text, audio, CTAs, end cards, and formatting.
  • Validate reports and proposals to ensure names, dates, numbers, and formatting are correct.
  • Document and report identified errors clearly, including their location and severity.
  • Re-check corrected deliverables before providing final QA approval.
  • Build, maintain, and improve QA checklists for different types of deliverables.
  • Identify recurring quality issues and communicate patterns to the appropriate team members.
  • Perform periodic checks of live funnels, ads, links, and automations to identify issues after launch.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, proofreading, copy editing, digital production, or a related area.
  • Excellent written English with strong grammar, spelling, and proofreading skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail.
  • Experience with at least one funnel or website-building platform such as GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels, Kajabi, WordPress, or Webflow.
  • Comfortable testing email platforms, forms, checkouts, links, and automations.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage a high volume of deliverables across multiple projects or clients.
  • Ability to clearly document issues and communicate feedback to other team members.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Nice to Have

  • Previous agency experience.
  • Familiarity with design tools such as Canva, Figma, or Adobe.
  • Familiarity with advertising platforms such as Meta Ads Manager.
  • Understanding of UTMs, pixels, tracking, and basic analytics.
  • Familiarity with advertising compliance and platform policies.

What We're Looking For

  • Someone who genuinely enjoys finding mistakes and solving quality issues.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify things others may overlook.
  • High standards for accuracy and quality.
  • Clear and respectful communication when providing feedback.
  • Ability to maintain quality standards under deadlines.
  • Organized, proactive, responsible, and comfortable working remotely.

Compensation

Up to $10 USD per hour, depending on experience, skills, and evaluation during the recruitment process.
