job.title: Senior Quality Engineer - MONOPOLY GO!
job.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior Quality Engineer to join the MONOPOLY GO! team. The role can be based remotely in the UK, or in Barcelona or Seville on a hybrid basis, with three days a week in the office.

 

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day—whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities. We are a global team of game lovers developing, publishing, and innovating across the games industry, connecting millions of players around the world every day.

The MONOPOLY GO! Tech Vertical develops the platforms, services, and engineering capabilities that support a reliable, responsive mobile gaming experience.We are building a Quality Engineering organization that embeds quality throughout development through automation, continuous validation, and shared engineering ownership.

 

 

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Quality Engineer who enjoys writing code, solving complex problems, and building tools that help teams deliver with confidence. Reporting to the Quality Director of Tech, you will help establish our QE capabilities through hands-on development of automation frameworks, test infrastructure, and quality insights across mobile, Unity, APIs, integrations, performance, and CI/CD.

You will help build our Quality Engineering capabilities incrementally, prioritizing the areas of greatest risk and value with the team. We are building these capabilities while supporting an active live-service game. You will take ownership of immediate testing needs, including manual, exploratory, and release validation, while developing sustainable automation and tooling. A willingness to test directly is essential. You will use what you learn to guide automation priorities, while recognizing the continuing value of exploratory testing, and develop practical AI capabilities that improve engineering effectiveness.

 

What You Will Do

  • Build reusable engineering solutions. Write, review, debug, and maintain automation frameworks, tools, and test infrastructure that other engineers can adopt and extend.
  • Improve testability from the start. Participate in technical design and code reviews to identify risks early and improve test hooks, service interfaces, and diagnostic capabilities.
  • Balance building with hands-on testing. Perform manual, exploratory, and release testing where automation is not yet available or direct investigation provides greater value. Meet current delivery needs while building sustainable solutions.
  • Develop mobile and Unity automation. Automate Android, iOS, and Unity workflows, accounting for device differences, application lifecycle events, network conditions, and client performance.
  • Strengthen API and integration testing. Validate backend services, service contracts, client-server interactions, data integrity, and failure recovery through reliable automated tests.
  • Validate player-state consistency and recovery. Test interrupted sessions, reconnects, retries, and client-server synchronization to help protect player progress and data integrity.
  • Investigate failures across systems. Use logs, metrics, traces, crash reports, and telemetry to investigate client, backend, and integration failures, support root-cause analysis, and turn findings into regression coverage.
  • Validate mobile and backend performance. Profile frame rate, memory usage, application startup, crashes, and responsiveness. Develop backend load, stress, and endurance tests, establish meaningful baselines, and investigate bottlenecks and regressions with engineers.
  • Apply risk-based testing. Prioritize validation by player impact, technical complexity, change scope, and failure history. Combine service-level tests, targeted end-to-end automation, and exploratory testing.
  • Integrate validation into CI/CD. Deliver reliable automated feedback, useful diagnostics, and maintainable quality checks. Improve test stability and execution time, with clear ownership of failures.
  • Improve test data and environments. Build utilities, fixtures, and repeatable setup processes that make testing dependable and defects easier to reproduce.
  • Develop AI-assisted quality workflows. Build and evaluate solutions for test generation, failure triage, regression selection, and coverage analysis, with human review and measurable outcomes.
  • Strengthen telemetry validation and quality visibility. Partner with engineering and analytics to validate telemetry accuracy, completeness, duplicates, schema changes, and data freshness. Query large datasets to investigate issues and build quality dashboards that inform risk assessment and release decisions.
  • Help establish the QE organization. Contribute standards, documentation, reusable patterns, and mentoring. Partner with developers, Quality Analysts, and technical leaders to strengthen shared ownership of quality.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Demonstrated quality engineering, software development in test, or software engineering experience, including hands-on ownership of automation used by other engineers.
  • Strong programming skills in C# or Python, with the ability to work effectively in Unity and automation codebases. Experience in source control, code reviews, debugging, and maintainable software design.
  • Practical experience testing and automating Android and iOS applications, including device coverage, operating system differences, and unreliable network conditions.
  • Experience developing API and integration tests, diagnosing failures across services and data flows, and integrating reliable automated tests into CI/CD.
  • Working knowledge of performance, risk-based, and exploratory testing, with sound judgment about what to automate and when to investigate directly.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and practical experience with telemetry and big data, including querying large datasets, validating events and data pipelines, and using findings to guide testing and release decisions.
  • Experience with AI-assisted engineering tools and the ability to evaluate the accuracy and usefulness of their outputs.
  • Strong ownership and collaborative problem-solving, with the ability to turn ambiguous needs into practical solutions. A passion for quality, mobile games, AI, and technology.
  • Advanced professional proficiency in spoken and written English, sufficient to participate independently in technical discussions, explain engineering decisions, and write clear documentation with global teams.

 

Additional experience we value

  • Hands-on experience with Unity, C#, Unity Test Framework, or automated testing of Unity-based mobile games.
  • Experience with live-service games, player-state consistency, reconnect behavior, live configuration, or client-server synchronization.
  • Experience with mobile device farms, observability, quality dashboards, or establishing QE capabilities within a growing team.

 

What success looks like

Teams receive faster, more trustworthy feedback and clearer visibility into release risk. Immediate testing needs are met while dependable automation grows around critical player journeys and integrations. Performance regressions surface earlier, failures are easier to diagnose, and repetitive effort decreases. Your tools are maintained, documented, and adopted by other engineers, and AI capabilities demonstrate measurable value.

 

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/. 

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

job.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
job.description:
Viamericas is a #1 ranked and licensed money transmitter offering international money transfer, bill payment, check processing and a variety of other services at thousands of agent locations across the United States, and 287,885 locations in 95 countries. At Viamericas, our ultimate objective is to help immigrants succeed and improve their lives by providing the highest quality financial services. We are always seeking TOP TALENT – experienced individuals who embrace our core values of respect, innovation, integrity and impact.

Position Summary:

This position is a technical role within the software development organization focused on assuring the quality of our development products, features, bugs & enhancements. This role must have a solid understanding of the firm’s business, the product development lifecycle and experience implementing enterprise-class software. In this role, you should have an eye for detail and an ability to analyze the functionality of our products. If you are a passionate engineer with a never-ending desire for success, for finding issues before they arrive at the end customer and for being able to teach other team members, we’d like to meet you!
The individual must be driven to achieve results and be proactive. They will be expected to independently anticipate and handle most issues before they become problems and not let things get in the way of achieving the company’s goals. job.title: QA Tester
job.description:
About Peregrine

Peregrine Advisors is a rapidly growing AI and data innovation hub helping government solve hard problems and deliver better outcomes. We work across the full lifecycle—from strategy and governance through architecture, engineering, analytics, AI, visualization, and training—for clients including the SEC, PCAOB, DDOT, and DCAA.

Our clients describe our support as “absolutely excellent” and our people as “instrumental to organization’s success.” Winner of the United Nations COP27 Datathon, our work has earned all Exceptional CPARS ratings, SEC Chair’s Awards, the SEC Vision Award, and recognition from FDA leadership.

We are also built differently. Peregrine is the first and only social enterprise organized as a Benefit Corporation and SBA 8(a) company focused on AI and data for government. We believe business success should create client value, social value, and opportunity for our people.

As we enter our next stage of growth, we need dependable, motivated, and skilled people who have a combination of intellectual curiosity and intellectual courage. With new clients, larger programs, and expanding responsibilities, the people joining Peregrine now will have the opportunity to help shape the company we become.

People first. Ownership always.

We solve problems through people, process, and technology—in that order. Technology matters, but people make transformation happen. That principle defines our culture. Trust and motivation are the foundational pillars of delivery on which our skills stand. We hire people we can trust, who care deeply about what they do, take ownership, learn quickly, help one another, and refuse to walk past a problem because it belongs to someone else.

At Peregrine, you are not joining simply to fill a position. You are joining a team, taking ownership of a mission, and helping build a company. If that excites you, we should talk.

At Peregrine Advisors, you will make sure the application a federal agency relies on to process its filer applications works for the people who use it, testing it end to end, by hand and in code. But we hire people, not seats. As the work evolves, you will move to where the hardest problems are.

This is a remote position. The initial engagement requires United States citizenship and the ability to obtain a Public Trust determination.

Your first project

Your first project will likely have you testing the application that carries a federal agency's filer applications from submission to decision, built in Python on Amazon Web Services (AWS). Depending on the assignment, you may:

  • Test the application end to end, following each submission from intake through document processing, review, approval, and audit history, across the user interface, the application programming interfaces (APIs) behind it, and the database.
  • Test user functionality by hand before each release: write test cases from requirements and user stories, work through every screen, user permission, and exception path a reviewer will meet, and report defects a developer can act on at first read.
  • Automate the checks worth repeating: build and maintain end-to-end, API, and regression suites that run in the continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipeline on every build.
  • Validate the data and the controls around it: confirm with SQL that what a user sees matches the source document and the database, and test role-based access, permissions, and integrations such as identity verification and notifications.

You help prove that the system works for its users from submission to decision, in a regulated federal environment where accuracy and auditability are not optional.

This is where you start, not the shape of your career here.

Requirements

  • 4+ years of software quality assurance experience, including both manual and automated testing of web applications
  • Bachelor's degree
  • End-to-end testing of web applications across the user interface, APIs, and database
  • User functionality testing, with test cases, test scenarios, and expected results written from requirements and user stories
  • Functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT)
  • Test automation in at least one framework, such as Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or pytest
  • API testing of REST and JSON services with Postman or comparable tooling
  • SQL for validating data in relational databases such as PostgreSQL
  • Testing workflow-driven applications: assignment, review, status transitions, approvals, exceptions, and audit history
  • Defect tracking and test management in Jira or comparable tools
  • Proficiency in writing, PowerPoint, and Excel

Preferred

  • Python knowledge or experience, including writing automated tests in Python
  • Testing document-processing or optical character recognition (OCR) systems: extracted-field accuracy, missing fields, and poor-quality scans
  • Testing applications deployed on AWS, such as Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions, and S3
  • Running automated suites in CI/CD pipelines such as GitHub Actions
  • Section 508 accessibility testing
  • International Software Testing Qualifications Board (ISTQB) certification or comparable
  • Federal information technology experience
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted testing tooling

Who you are

You test what the user actually experiences, not only whether a screen loads. You follow a submission through every step to the decision at the end and ask whether the system read the document correctly, applied the right rule, and showed the reviewer the right information, and you know which checks belong in code and which need a person's judgment. You experiment, fail, learn, and repeat quickly. You would rather own an outcome than be handed a task.

What you bring

  • End-to-end testing craft: following a business process through every screen, service, and record it touches, and finding where it breaks.
  • User functionality testing that turns a requirement into the cases that would expose it if it were wrong, and explores past the script when something looks off.
  • Automation that earns its keep: end-to-end, API, and regression suites that run on every build and that the team trusts.
  • Data validation across the user interface, API responses, database records, and source documents.
  • Defect reports with steps to reproduce, expected and actual results, evidence, and severity, and clear communication with developers, product owners, and client stakeholders about what they mean for the release.

You adapt your development workflow as AI tools evolve, using them to help implement, test, and improve the components you own. You give the tools clear context, review and test their output, and remain accountable for the code you deliver.

When we talk

Be prepared to discuss a difficult problem you worked through, the decisions you made, what happened, and what you learned.

Benefits

This is a full-time W-2 position with a salary of $100,000 to $140,000 per year.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision insurance with the employee premium fully paid and half of dependent premiums; employer-paid life, accidental death, and short-term and long-term disability insurance; a 401(k) with an employer match of up to 4% of salary; unlimited paid time off; and sponsored professional certifications and continuing education.

What we offer

You will work alongside developers, engineers, data scientists, architects, and strategists, on work ranging from strategy to implementation. We support your development across assignments and clients through extensive onboarding, sponsored professional certifications such as the Data Management Capability Assessment Model (DCAM) and AWS technical certifications, and rotation across functions to expand your skills and perspective. The mission is real, the problems are hard, and you own what you ship.

What we commit to

As a Benefit Corporation, our commitment runs three ways: real, measurable value for our clients; government that works better for the public; and a team that makes everyone in it better.

We hire people who want to help build the firm, not just work at it. If that is you, apply.

Peregrine Advisors is an equal opportunity employer.

Peregrine exclusively works with OPEN Data Jobs to recruit our team. Register with OPEN Data Jobs to be considered for this and future openings.

job.title: Customer Success Quality Assurance Specialist
job.description:
Overview

At JDA TSG, we equip world-class brands with top-tier talent and operational expertise, because we know our people are our true differentiator. As a Customer Success Quality Assurance (QA) Specialist, you will act as the core architect of our communication auditing, compliance enforcement, and consistency analysis programs. We believe technology and customer success operations require relentless standards and objective analysis; your work will turn raw customer interaction data into actionable operational improvements. By auditing omni-channel customer touchpoints, maintaining quality rubrics, and performing deep root-cause analysis, your insights directly elevate performance quality across the entire organization.


What You Will Do

  • Interaction Auditing & Standards Architecture: You will create, maintain, update, and calibrate quality assurance scorecards and rubrics across email, chat, and phone channels. You will conduct regular, objective reviews of omni-channel customer interactions against established performance standards, brand voice guidelines, and compliance protocols. Success is measured by audit completion volume, rubric scoring consistency, and calibration accuracy across leadership syncs.
  • Compliance Enforcement & Root-Cause Analysis: You will act as the gatekeeper for messaging standards, privacy regulations, and compliance policies across all customer touchpoints. When metrics drop or communication issues persist, you will investigate systemic operational deficiencies and process breakdowns rather than focusing on surface-level agent faults. Success is measured by audit log accuracy, compliance adherence rates, and the elimination of recurring process defects.
  • Actionable Performance Insights & Leadership Alignment: You will translate raw audit logs into executive trend reports that highlight organizational training gaps, coaching needs, and software tooling friction points. You will facilitate calibration sessions with Customer Success Leadership to align on scoring standards, eliminate bias, and maintain objective evaluations. Success is measured by insight implementation rates, reduction in customer friction points, and leadership alignment scores.

Who You Are

  • 3+ years of experience in Customer Success, Account Management, or Call Center environments, with 2+ years dedicated to a Quality Assurance or Analyst position.
  • Experience building quality scorecards, rubrics, and tracking core communication metrics such as CSAT, Net Promoter Score (NPS), and Internal Quality Scores.
  • Demonstrated ability to conduct root-cause analysis, map out process defects, and analyze interaction data using spreadsheets, ticketing systems, or specialized QA platforms.
  • Exceptional written and verbal diplomacy skills with experience navigating customer communication platforms (e.g., Zendesk), allowing you to deliver unbiased, evidence-supported evaluations to management without generating interpersonal friction.
  • Practical familiarity with customer financial management software or prior experience building a QA program from scratch in a mid-market or high-growth environment.

What We Offer

  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage and benefits package
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Professional development opportunities
  • The specific pay rate offered for this role depends on candidate qualifications, relevant experience, technical expertise, and role requirements. Final individual offers are determined through candidate evaluations during the interview process.
  • Compensation: $62,000 to $72,000

Our customers and partners are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.
  • Lead the planning, coordination, and execution of User Acceptance Testing (UAT) across projects, releases, and business processes.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners, project managers, developers, and QA teams to define UAT scope, objectives, timelines, and entry/exit criteria.
  • Translate business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria into comprehensive UAT scenarios, test cases, and data requirements.

  • Track test results, requirements coverage, defect trends, risks, and outstanding issues; communicate status and recommendations to project and business leadership.
  • Evaluate UAT outcomes and provide a clear go/no-go recommendation for production release based on agreed acceptance criteria and residual risk.
  • Ensure business and compliance requirements are adequately tested and that required approvals, signoffs, and audit evidence are completed.
  • Drive continuous improvement of UAT processes, templates, tools, metrics, and testing practices.
  • Mentor UAT testers and promote consistent, risk-based, and customer-focused quality practices across delivery teams.
  • Support post-release validation, production readiness activities, and lessons-learned reviews as needed.


This role does not qualify for employer sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT extension program.

job.title: Software Verification & Test Engineer
job.description:
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Software Verification & Test Engineer

Remote | East Coast Hours | Up to 10% Travel | Full Time

Position Overview

Crown Innovations is seeking an experienced Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer to support the development, verification, and certification of advanced aviation navigation systems.

This position will support functional, system, performance, and hardware/software integration testing for safety critical avionics applications. The selected engineer will develop and execute test cases, test scripts, procedures, and verification activities designed to evaluate system performance against defined technical and certification requirements.

The role requires deep experience with DO-178C software verification and certification, avionics software and hardware testing, requirements-based verification, and safety critical aviation systems. The successful candidate must be capable of independently analyzing requirements, developing verification approaches, executing tests, evaluating results, documenting anomalies, and producing high-quality verification evidence.

This position also requires hands on experience with SCADE, strong Java development experience, and familiarity with avionics certification and aircraft safety analysis.

The ideal candidate is an experienced verification engineer who combines strong software development knowledge with rigorous testing discipline, exceptional attention to detail, and a thorough understanding of safety critical aviation software development and certification.

Key Responsibilities

Software Verification & Testing

  • Develop, review, and execute software and system test cases, test scripts, and test procedures.
  • Perform requirements-based verification of safety critical avionics software.
  • Conduct functional, system, integration, and performance testing.
  • Verify software behavior against system and software requirements.
  • Analyze test results and identify, document, and investigate anomalies.
  • Perform regression testing following software or requirements changes.
  • Support software verification activities throughout the avionics development lifecycle.
  • Ensure test artifacts are complete, traceable, repeatable, and suitable for certification evidence.

Avionics Hardware & Software Integration

  • Perform software testing on avionics hardware platforms and integrated hardware/software environments.
  • Support hardware/software integration testing associated with navigation avionics.
  • Evaluate system behavior under normal, abnormal, and boundary conditions.
  • Troubleshoot software, hardware, interface, and integration issues.
  • Support simulation, bench testing, and hardware in the loop testing environments when applicable.
  • Collaborate with software, systems, hardware, and test engineers to isolate and resolve technical issues.

DO-178C Certification & Compliance

  • Perform verification activities in accordance with DO-178C objectives.
  • Support preparation and maintenance of verification evidence required for avionics certification.
  • Ensure traceability between system requirements, software requirements, test procedures, test results, and identified anomalies.
  • Participate in requirements reviews, test reviews, peer reviews, and certification related activities.
  • Support development and review of verification documentation and certification artifacts.
  • Assist with identifying and resolving verification gaps or compliance issues.

Requirements Analysis & Traceability

  • Review system and software requirements for clarity, completeness, consistency, and testability.
  • Develop test cases and procedures directly from approved requirements.
  • Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements and verification artifacts.
  • Support requirements management and analysis using IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management tools.
  • Identify ambiguous, incomplete, or conflicting requirements and coordinate resolution with engineering stakeholders.

SCADE & Software Development Support

  • Utilize SCADE within model-based software development and verification environments.
  • Support verification of SCADE generated or model-based avionics software.
  • Apply Java development experience to support software development, testing, automation, troubleshooting, or verification activities.
  • Review software behavior and implementation as necessary to support test development and anomaly investigation.
  • Collaborate with development engineers throughout verification and certification activities.

Safety Critical Aviation Systems

  • Support verification and certification activities for navigation avionics and related aircraft systems.
  • Apply understanding of aircraft safety, system safety, and certification considerations when developing verification approaches.
  • Support analysis of system performance and navigation related functionality.
  • Participate in technical reviews involving software, hardware, systems engineering, and certification stakeholders.
  • Maintain rigorous quality standards consistent with safety critical aviation development.

Documentation & Technical Collaboration

  • Develop clear and complete test procedures, test reports, verification records, and technical documentation.
  • Document defects, anomalies, corrective actions, and test results.
  • Communicate technical findings clearly to engineering teams and program stakeholders.
  • Participate in peer reviews of requirements, test cases, procedures, results, and verification artifacts.
  • Support reporting program and technical status activities as required.

Minimum Required Qualifications

  • Minimum eight years of professional software development, software verification, software testing, or related engineering experience.
  • Minimum five years of Java development experience.
  • Direct professional experience using SCADE.
  • Direct experience supporting DO-178C software development, verification, testing, or certification activities.
  • Demonstrated experience developing and executing requirements-based software test cases and procedures.
  • Experience performing functional, system, integration, or performance testing of avionics systems.
  • Experience testing software in conjunction with avionics hardware.
  • Experience supporting avionics certification and testing activities.
  • Experience with navigation avionics, aircraft navigation systems, inertial navigation systems, or closely related aviation systems.
  • Experience with FAA certification activities, aircraft safety analysis, or other safety critical aviation development processes.
  • Ability to analyze software and system requirements and translate requirements into executable verification activities.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to software quality.
  • Strong written and verbal technical communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently within a remote engineering environment.
  • Must be a U.S. Citizen.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with IBM DOORS or comparable requirements management and traceability tools.
  • Experience performing detailed requirements analysis.
  • Experience with inertial navigation, GPS aided navigation, guidance, or control systems.
  • Experience with test automation.
  • Experience developing or maintaining automated test frameworks.
  • Experience with hardware in the loop, simulation, or laboratory test environments.
  • Experience with structural coverage analysis tools such as VectorCAST, LDRA, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with static analysis tools.
  • Experience with Python, C, C++, or other languages commonly used in embedded avionics verification.
  • Familiarity with DO-254, ARP4754A, ARP4761, or related aviation development and certification standards.
  • Experience supporting FAA or military airworthiness certification activities.

Work Environment & Schedule

This position is remote and requires availability during Eastern Time business hours.

Travel of up to 10% may be required to support program activities, technical reviews, integration, testing, or customer needs.

The position requires close collaboration with software, systems, hardware, certification, and program engineering teams.

Compensation

Aviation Software Verification & Test Engineer: $100,000 to $150,000 annually

Compensation is determined based on experience, technical expertise, certifications, education, internal equity, and business needs.

Crown complies with all applicable state and local pay transparency laws. The listed compensation range represents the good faith salary range for this position at the time of posting. Final compensation will be based on job-related factors.

Benefits

• Generous Paid Time Off (PTO)

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• Health Savings Account (HSA)

• Flexible Spending Account (FSA)

• 401(k) with Company Match

• Company Paid Life Insurance

• Tuition Reimbursement

• Employee Assistance Program

• Professional Development Opportunities

About Crown

Crown Innovations is a recognized leader in research, development, engineering, advanced integration, analytics, software, and strategic planning, with deep expertise supporting the modernization and continued evolution of the National Airspace System.

For more than 30 years, Crown has supported a diverse portfolio of government and commercial clients, including the Federal Aviation Administration, NASA, the U.S. Energy Information Administration, state and local governments, and commercial organizations.

As a prime contractor supporting high impact federal programs, Crown provides comprehensive capabilities across engineering, infrastructure modernization, lifecycle data management, modeling and simulation, software development, regulatory compliance, and emerging technologies.

Our employees play a direct role in advancing aviation safety, improving operational performance, modernizing critical infrastructure, and supporting nationally significant programs.

Crown has consistently been recognized as one of the best places to work in the Washington, DC metropolitan area and is committed to providing employees with opportunities to grow professionally while contributing to meaningful, mission driven work.

Compliance & Equal Opportunity

Persons unable to complete an online application should contact Crown HR for assistance at (703) 650 0663 ext. 3068.

job.title: Principal Software Development Engineer - QA + Networking
job.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Bangalore, India reporting to the Director Software Engineering in the Engineering department. You will join the team that built the world’s largest cloud security platform from the ground up, enabling organizations worldwide to harness speed and agility with a cloud-first strategy. With more than 100 patents and 15 million users across 185 countries, you will bring your vision to a team of experts dedicated to enhancing our multitenant architecture and global footprint.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams during the design phase and maintain cloud-based software solutions
  • Design and develop innovative test strategies to simulate complex customer usage scenarios and test at scale using Python
  • Develop and maintain robust, scalable test automation frameworks and integrate automated APIs into CI/CD systems (Jenkins/GitLab)
  • Take ownership of diagnosing and resolving customer issues, recreating production issues, and providing necessary workarounds for resolution
  • Provide critical insights to the development team to enhance product debugging and serviceability features

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You are a problem-solver who is energized by finding solutions to complex technical challenges and delivering high-impact outcomes.
  • You are customer-obsessed, anchoring your decisions in solving real-world customer issues and championing their needs from start to finish.
  • You are a high-trust collaborator who thrives in a team environment, giving and receiving candid feedback to build trust and achieve shared goals.
  • You are a learner with a growth mindset, constantly developing your technical skills and actively integrating feedback to improve.
  • You operate with urgency and maintain a strong bias for action, delivering high-impact, high-quality results in a dynamic environment.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • Extensive experience with TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS/TLS, and proficient with L4-L7 protocols, certificates, and debugging network flows using tools like tcpdump and Wireshark
  • CCNP or equivalent knowledge and experience in the networking domain
  • Experience building Python-based frameworks (preferably PyTest) for API, protocol, and system tests to drive reliability and coverage across microservices and experience with testing on cloud-based architectures and working with Cloud and Kubernetes ecosystems (AWS, Docker, VM, Proxmox)
  • Experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins/GitLab), implementing shift-left gating, test data provisioning, and parallel execution

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Experience leveraging generative AI developer tools and copilots to optimize code generation, test design, and automated debugging workflows
  • Practical experience with Security and Cloud-Security products/architectures
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience with Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) architectures

job.title: Middle QA Engineer
job.description:
At WhiteTech, we empower businesses in the financial ecosystem with cutting-edge white-label and SAAS solutions.

Our comprehensive suite of tools is tailored for EMI, PSP, e-commerce, and open banking platforms. With WhiteTech, clients gain access to a platform designed for flexibility, scalability, and seamless integration.

Our mission is to help businesses unlock their full potential in a rapidly evolving financial landscape.

Whether scaling your PSP, enhancing your EMI services, or diving into open banking, WhiteTech is your partner for innovation and growth.

We are a remote-first technology company and welcome applications from candidates across Europe, including the EEA, the UK, Switzerland, and other non-EEA European countries such as Ukraine, Moldova, Georgia, Armenia, Montenegro, Turkey, and the Western Balkans. We also consider applicants from different locations who can work within Central European Time (CET).

As we scale to new heights, we're searching for a Quality Assurance Specialist to ensure our products meet the highest standards of quality and efficiency.

Your role and impact:

As a Quality Assurance Specialist at WhiteTech you will play a crucial role in maintaining and enhancing the quality of our cutting-edge payment solutions. Your efforts in identifying, reporting, and tracking bugs, along with your active involvement in the entire software development lifecycle, will directly contribute to the reliability and performance of our products. You'll collaborate with a dynamic team to push the boundaries of what's possible in the fintech industry.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Take full ownership of quality assurance within cross-functional product teams.
  • Design and maintain comprehensive test strategies covering functional, UI, API, integration, and exploratory testing.
  • Drive pixel-perfect validation of complex web interfaces across multiple devices, screen sizes, and browsers.
  • Ensure full test coverage for API flows using tools like Postman, Swagger, and automation hooks if needed.
  • Collaborate closely with developers, designers, and product managers to define quality expectations and shift testing left.
  • Write structured, reusable test cases and detailed bug reports that help the team move fast without sacrificing quality.
  • Review and improve test documentation, coverage, and regression practices across releases.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of QA processes, tools, and team workflows.

Requirements & skills:

  • 3+ years of experience in manual and semi-automated testing of web-based applications.
  • 2+ years of hands-on experience with API testing, including auth flows, error handling, and payload validation
  • Proven experience testing payment systems, transactional flows, and basic third-party integrations.
  • Experience with responsive design testing, browser dev tools, network analysis, and cross-platform validation.
  • Knowledge of Postman, Chrome DevTools, Swagger, and test management systems (e.g. TestRail, Xray).
  • Understanding of frontend–backend architecture, including REST APIs, session handling, and data flows.
  • Working knowledge of SQL for data validation and backend consistency checks.
  • Solid understanding of SDLC, STLC, and Agile (Scrum/Kanban) development processes.
  • A strong "pixel-perfect" mindset and ability to quickly identify visual and behavioral UI issues.
  • Proactive, analytical, and able to work autonomously with a strong sense of ownership.

Our recruitment process typically follows these stages:

  1. Application screening
  2. Interview Stages (2-3 weeks):
    • Prescreening call with Recruiter (45 min)
    • Test task
    • Technical Interview (60 min)
    • Soft Skills Interview (35 min)
  3. Job Offer
  4. Referrals: Employment and Background Check

We offer:

  • Competitive compensation package (commensurate with your experience)
  • 19 business days of flexible Paid Time Off (PTO)
  • Fully remote work with flexible hours (within the CET time zone) from any location of your choice
  • Values-driven culture with a friendly and supportive work environment
  • Opportunity to regularly participate in conferences and community events as both a participant and contributor
  • Matrix organizational structure designed to streamline communication, remove barriers, and promote efficiency

Embrace the opportunity to develop your skills in a cutting-edge fintech environment.

Please apply now to be part of our dynamic team and make a tangible impact on the future of payments!

Let’s build something great together!

job.title: Data and BI Tester (Journeyman)
job.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a Data and BI Tester to document data models, metadata, ETL processes, data flows, BI solutions, testing activities, troubleshooting procedures, and user guidance supporting the USMEPCOM ENLIST program.

This Journeyman-level position will work with data engineers, database personnel, BI developers, testers, governance specialists, and Government stakeholders to maintain accurate documentation aligned with applicable architectural and metadata standards.

The role will capture technical designs, testing results, troubleshooting findings, and operating instructions so technical teams and users can understand, validate, maintain, and use data and BI capabilities effectively.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The Data and BI Tester will:

  • Create and maintain documentation for data models, warehouse components, metadata, and BI solutions.
  • Document ETL processes, transformation rules, source-to-target mappings, and data flows.
  • Maintain descriptions of data relationships, calculations, dependencies, and reporting logic.
  • Apply established architectural, metadata, terminology, and documentation standards.
  • Work with developers and engineers to verify that documentation reflects implemented functionality.
  • Document test procedures, scenarios, expected results, execution results, and supporting evidence supplied by testing teams.
  • Maintain traceability among documented requirements, data flows, BI components, test records, and identified issues.
  • Record troubleshooting steps, diagnostic findings, resolutions, and known limitations.
  • Develop user guides, job aids, report instructions, and guidance for interpreting analytical outputs.
  • Document report filters, calculations, navigation, refresh behavior, and relevant data limitations.
  • Coordinate reviews with technical specialists, data owners, testers, and Government representatives.
  • Track review comments, documentation gaps, approvals, and corrective actions.
  • Update documentation following schema changes, ETL revisions, BI releases, defect corrections, and operational findings.
  • Maintain document versions, revision histories, repository organization, and publication records.
  • Support release documentation, operational handoffs, knowledge transfer, and user acceptance activities.
  • Improve documentation clarity, consistency, accessibility, and usability based on stakeholder feedback.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

The following must-have qualifications are drawn from the supplied position requirements:

  • Active Secret clearance or higher.
  • Minimum of six years of relevant professional experience.
  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, data analytics, or a related field, or a permitted equivalent.
  • Ability to document data models, metadata, ETL processes, and data flows.
  • Ability to document BI solutions, testing activities, troubleshooting procedures, and user guidance.
  • Ability to maintain documentation in accordance with applicable architectural and metadata standards.
  • Applicable DoD 8570 certification for the assigned duties.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred but are not required:

  • ISTQB Foundation Level or test automation certification.
  • Experience documenting data warehouses, analytical platforms, dashboards, and operational reports.
  • Familiarity with SQL, ETL concepts, Power BI, data modeling, and metadata management.
  • Experience maintaining test evidence, defect documentation, troubleshooting records, and requirements traceability.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense programs.
  • Familiarity with data governance, lineage, authoritative sources, and common data definitions.
  • Experience with SharePoint, Confluence, Markdown, version-controlled documentation, or comparable tools.
  • Experience developing accessible technical documentation and task-based user guidance.
  • Strong technical writing, editing, organization, and cross-team communication skills.

Other responsibilities:

Provides insight and guidance to the project team management on testing approach, best practices, scheduling, effort estimations, regulatory expectations, etc. Ensures that validation efforts are completed in accordance to Clario SOPs.

What We Look For

Career Category

Quality

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline and portfolio of medicines to treat heart disease, obesity and obesity-related conditions, rare diseases, inflammatory conditions and cancer. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Quality Assurance Senior Manager

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. This QA Sr. Manager role will be responsible for the quality oversight of primary component suppliers. This person is an integral member of the Amgen cross-functional supplier team(s) that includes, but is not limited to, business operations, process development, supply chain and combination product quality.

Key Responsibilities:

job.title: QA/Test Automation Engineer (Senior)
job.description:
Overview

DecisionPoint seeks a QA/Test Automation Engineer to validate complex accession-processing workflows, business rules, integrations, and exception paths for the USMEPCOM ENLIST program. This senior role develops traceable functional test cases and test data, conducts exploratory and regression testing, supports automated test coverage, and documents objective evidence of software quality.

The QA/Test Automation Engineer works with Government stakeholders, mission liaisons, requirements analysts, developers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, DevSecOps engineers, and other testers. The position also supports Government user acceptance testing, defect triage, correction verification, sprint demonstrations, and release-readiness decisions.

This position is remote, with Chicago-area candidates preferred.

Note: By applying to this position, you acknowledge and consent to having your resume included in an active competitive government contract bid.

Duties & Responsibilities

The QA/Test Automation Engineer will:

  • Analyze requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, business rules, workflows, interface requirements, and technical designs to determine testing needs.
  • Develop and maintain risk-based test plans, test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, test data, and expected results.
  • Validate complex accession-processing workflows, decision logic, business rules, data relationships, integrations, and exception paths.
  • Ensure functional test cases are traceable to approved requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and identified risks.
  • Maintain traceability among requirements, test cases, test results, defects, corrections, and release decisions.
  • Conduct functional, integration, system, exploratory, regression, smoke, and end-to-end testing.
  • Develop, execute, maintain, and improve automated regression tests where appropriate.
  • Identify stable and high-value test scenarios suitable for automation.
  • Support the integration of automated tests into approved build, continuous-integration, or delivery pipelines.
  • Prepare and manage representative test data while protecting sensitive information.
  • Verify data processing, calculations, field validation, role-based behavior, interfaces, and error-handling logic.
  • Execute tests in development, integration, test, staging, or other Government-approved environments.
  • Document test execution results and retain complete, repeatable, and auditable test evidence.
  • Capture screenshots, logs, data comparisons, system responses, and other objective evidence needed to demonstrate test outcomes.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects through resolution.
  • Write clear defect reports containing reproducible steps, expected results, actual results, severity, evidence, and affected requirements.
  • Collaborate with developers and technical teams to reproduce issues, analyze root causes, and clarify expected behavior.
  • Verify corrected defects and perform targeted regression testing to identify unintended impacts.
  • Support defect-triage meetings and communicate quality risks, unresolved defects, and release impacts.
  • Prepare test status, defect metrics, coverage information, evidence summaries, and release-readiness recommendations.
  • Support Government user acceptance testing by preparing test cases and data, coordinating execution, documenting results, and tracking findings.
  • Assist Government users during acceptance testing and distinguish defects from training, configuration, data, or requirements issues.
  • Support sprint demonstrations, capability reviews, operational validation, and stakeholder-feedback activities.
  • Coordinate with cybersecurity personnel to verify approved security corrections and related regression impacts.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily coordination, reviews, demonstrations, and retrospectives.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of test strategy, automation coverage, defect prevention, evidence management, and quality practices.
  • Mentor other testers and share knowledge of complex workflows, business rules, test techniques, and automation practices.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

Candidates must possess all the following:

  • An active Secret clearance or higher.
  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, information technology, software engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent permitted by the applicable labor category.
  • At least eight years of relevant professional experience.
  • Experience performing functional software testing.
  • Experience validating complex workflows, business rules, decision logic, integrations, or exception paths.
  • Experience developing and maintaining test cases, test data, expected results, and traceability.
  • Experience documenting test execution results and retaining objective test evidence.
  • Experience identifying, documenting, tracking, and verifying software defects.
  • Experience conducting exploratory and regression testing.
  • Ability to support the development, execution, or maintenance of automated regression tests.
  • Ability to analyze requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria to determine test coverage.
  • Ability to support Government or customer user acceptance testing.
  • Ability to communicate test results, quality risks, unresolved defects, and release impacts clearly.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, technical documentation, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with analysts, developers, architects, cybersecurity personnel, DevSecOps engineers, testers, and Government stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications

The following qualifications are preferred:

  • A recognized software-testing certification, such as an ISTQB certification, Certified Software Tester (CSTE), Certified Software Quality Analyst (CSQA), or an equivalent credential.
  • Experience supporting federal or Department of Defense software-development or modernization programs.
  • Experience testing military accession processing, personnel processing, regulated workflows, or other rules-intensive mission systems.
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools or frameworks such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, Cucumber, Postman, REST Assured, JMeter, or comparable technologies.
  • Experience developing automated tests using Java, C#, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, or another supported programming language.
  • Experience testing web applications, APIs, databases, system interfaces, batch processes, or event-driven services.
  • Experience with requirements traceability matrices and test-management platforms.
  • Experience with Jira, Azure DevOps, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, Confluence, or comparable testing and collaboration tools.
  • Experience integrating automated tests with continuous-integration and continuous-delivery pipelines.
  • Experience with performance, security, accessibility, compatibility, or resilience testing.
  • Familiarity with Section 508 accessibility testing and assistive-technology validation.
  • Familiarity with Agile, DevSecOps, configuration-management, and secure software-development practices.
  • Experience mentoring testers or providing technical leadership for testing activities.

It is the policy of DecisionPoint Corporation to provide equal employment opportunity in accordance with all applicable Equal Employment Opportunity/Affirmative Action laws, directives and regulations to all employees and qualified applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, disability status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other protected status under Federal, State or Local laws.

job.title: Director of Quality Assurance
job.description:
Job Description:

Who We Are:

At Cart.com, we're defining the future of commerce.


Founded to solve the growing complexity of modern commerce, Cart.com helps businesses simplify how they sell, fulfill, and deliver products to their customers. We bring together technology, services, and logistics infrastructure into one connected platform, making it easier for organizations to grow, operate efficiently, and navigate an increasingly fragmented commerce landscape.

We work with brands, retailers, manufacturers, and public sector organizations to support every stage of the customer journey, from ecommerce and order management to fulfillment, distribution, and delivery. By combining software, expertise, and a nationwide logistics network into a unified solution, we help our customers move faster, operate smarter, and scale with confidence.

But what truly sets Cart.com apart is our people. We're builders, problem-solvers, and innovators who thrive on turning big challenges into meaningful outcomes for our customers. Every day, we're helping shape the future of commerce while creating opportunities to learn, grow, and make an impact.

If you're energized by solving complex problems, collaborating with talented teammates, and helping build what's next, we'd love to hear from you.

Cart.com Milestones

  • Founded in 2020 with a vision to build the first truly unified commerce platform.
  • Achieved unicorn status with a valuation exceeding $1 billion.
  • Raised more than $475 million to support continued growth and innovation
  • Expanded a nationwide commerce and logistics network that helps organizations scale, fulfill, and grow across channels.
  • Recognized by Inc.'s Power Partner Awards for helping businesses grow and scale.
  • Recognized as an award-winning employer for four consecutive years, reflecting our commitment to building an environment where talented people can grow, innovate, and make an impact.

Our values: Cart.com is building a company that is committed to living out these 6 core values:


  • Be brand obsessed: Our lives are shaped by the brands we interact with daily. We obsess over the brands we serve, and about the things they care about.
  • Think beyond the box: “We’ve always done it that way” is not a phrase uttered often at our office. We create creative solutions to complex problems.
  • Don’t give up: We learn from our challenges and see them for what they are; great building blocks to an amazing brand story.
  • Speak up: We communicate clearly and directly because we care deeply. Communication is the bedrock of our community.
  • Work together: We’ve built a team that prides itself on diversity of thought and background. Collaboration is better with contrast.
  • Remember to be human: We work hard, but we leave room for the people, places and things that we love

AI at Cart.com

AI is part of how we work. It’s not doing the hiring.


We’ll use AI in parts of our process, and we encourage candidates to use it for research, preparation, and other helpful support. However, our interviews exist to meet you, not your best AI-assisted draft. Real people make every hiring decision. If you have questions about how we use AI, just ask.

Military & Veteran Experience

Cart Government Solutions values the leadership, discipline, and operational experience veterans and transitioning service members bring to our team. Experience gained through military service in quality assurance, logistics, supply chain operations, inspections, compliance, validation, documentation, cold-chain management, healthcare operations, or government programs will be considered alongside equivalent civilian experience.

Remote:

Candidates who live in or around the Houston, TX area are ideal, but we are open to considering other US locations.

This position is open to applicants or individuals who are located in or willing to move to AL, AZ, CA, CO, CT, DE, FL, GA, IL, IN, IA, KY, LA, ME, MD, MA, MI, MS, NE, NV, NJ, NY, NC, OH, OR, PA, SC, TN, TX, UT, VA, WA, WV

The Role:  

Cart Government Solutions is establishing a dedicated quality function to support its growing government warehouse, distribution, and regulated logistics operations. As the Director of Quality Assurance, you will serve as the senior quality leader responsible for building, implementing, and continuously improving a government-specific Quality Management System (QMS).


This role will lead quality across a multi-site network, driving consistent standards, overseeing audits, investigations, CAPA, validation activities, and quality-system performance. You will partner closely with Operations, Compliance, Client Success, Engineering, IT, and program leadership to strengthen accountability, mitigate risk, and support operational excellence.


The ideal candidate is a hands-on quality leader with experience building or leading Quality Management Systems within regulated warehouse, distribution, pharmaceutical, healthcare, government, or government-contractor environments. You combine deep quality-system expertise with practical operational experience and have successfully led multi-site quality programs, developed teams, and driven continuous improvement in complex organizations.

You are equally comfortable leading investigations, audits, and validation activities as you are communicating quality risks, performance metrics, and strategic initiatives to executives, customers, auditors, and government stakeholders. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building programs, creating structure, influencing cross-functional teams, and scaling a high-performing quality function that supports critical government operations.


What You’ll Do:

Government Quality Management System Leadership

  • Build, implement, and continuously improve the government Quality Management System (QMS).
  • Establish quality policies, procedures, governance processes, and documentation standards across government operations.
  • Develop site and program quality plans aligned to customer requirements, contractual obligations, and operational risks.
  • Lead change-control and continuous-improvement initiatives that support business growth and compliance.
  • Develop quality metrics, reporting, and management-review processes; provide leadership visibility into quality performance, risks, and key decisions.

Multi-Site Quality Leadership

  • Lead and develop site quality teams across multiple locations.
  • Drive consistent quality execution while empowering local teams to maintain operational ownership.
  • Identify recurring issues, drive root-cause resolution, and ensure timely completion of corrective actions.
  • Influence cross-functional teams to adopt quality standards, processes, and controls.

Warehouse & Distribution Quality

  • Establish quality controls across receiving, storage, inventory management, fulfillment, shipping, and transportation activities.
  • Oversee inventory accuracy, product integrity, chain of custody, and customer-owned inventory controls.
  • Investigate operational quality issues, customer complaints, and inventory discrepancies.
  • Ensure corrective actions are effective and appropriate safeguards are implemented when issues arise.

Environmental Monitoring & Qualification

  • Oversee quality requirements for ambient, refrigerated, frozen, and ultra-cold storage environments.
  • Lead temperature mapping, environmental monitoring, equipment qualification, calibration, and requalification activities.
  • Ensure excursions, alarm events, and monitoring failures are investigated, documented, and resolved.
  • Partner with Facilities and Operations to maintain inventory protection and business continuity plans.

Incident Management, Investigations & CAPA

  • Lead investigations involving deviations, nonconformances, excursions, service failures, and other quality events.
  • Oversee root-cause analysis, corrective and preventive action (CAPA) programs, and effectiveness verification.
  • Monitor open actions, risks, and escalations while ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder communication.

Audits & Document Control

  • Lead internal audits and support customer, government, and external audits, inspections, and certifications.
  • Maintain audit documentation, corrective-action records, and controlled quality-system documentation.
  • Partner with Compliance and operational leaders to address findings and continuous-improvement opportunities.
  • Communicate audit outcomes, quality risks, and remediation plans to leadership and stakeholders.

Supplier Quality & Change Control

  • Oversee supplier qualification and approved supplier programs.
  • Assess the quality impact of new sites, equipment, technologies, and process changes.
  • Review WMS enhancements and operational changes for validation, compliance, and quality-system impacts.
  • Ensure required training is completed and documented before implementation of new processes or systems.

Government & Customer Engagement

  • Serve as the senior quality partner to Operations, Compliance, and program leadership.
  • Represent the quality organization during customer meetings, audits, inspections, and government reviews.
  • Communicate quality performance, risks, investigations, and corrective-action progress to customers and government stakeholders.
  • Translate customer and contractual requirements into sustainable operating procedures and quality controls.

How You'll Spend Your Time

Priorities may shift based on business needs, customer requirements, and the maturity of the government quality program.

  • 30% – Building and managing the government QMS, procedures, documentation, and change control.
  • 25% – Leading and developing site quality teams while driving operational execution.
  • 20% – Validation, environmental monitoring, temperature mapping, and qualification activities.
  • 15% – Audits, investigations, CAPA, and effectiveness verification.
  • 10% – Government and customer engagement, executive reporting, and strategic planning.

Travel: Up to 50%, depending on site support needs, audits, investigations, program implementations, and customer engagements.

Who You Are:

  • You understand the quality risks associated with warehousing, distribution, inventory control, cold-chain operations, regulated products, and customer-owned inventory.

The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the team:

At Dexcom, the Postmarket Investigations team serves as a critical link between real-world product performance and continuous product improvement. As part of the Customer Advocacy organization, we assess postmarket feedback and product data to ensure learnings are integrated into future product enhancements. This role has a direct impact on patient safety, product reliability, and regulatory compliance through partnership with teams across R&D, Quality, and Commercial Operations. Our team values technical excellence, accountability, and continuous learning, while fostering a collaborative and supportive environment. Team members have the unique opportunity to drive quality improvements, influence key business processes, and contribute to technologies that empower people to take control of their health.

Where you come in:

  • You will collaborate with cross-functional partners including Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, R&D, Clinical, and Process Engineering to support the investigation, documentation, and resolution of software- and device-related postmarket issues.

  • You will drive the development and continuous improvement of complaint investigation processes, ensuring alignment with software risk management activities such as hazard analysis, DFMEA, PFMEA, and product risk assessments.

  • You will apply structured problem-solving methodologies and data-driven approaches to conduct investigations, lead engineering studies, and identify root causes using statistical analysis and industry-standard tools.

  • You will analyze, synthesize, and communicate investigation outcomes to technical and non-technical stakeholders, providing clear recommendations and supporting informed decision-making across the organization.

  • You will contribute to postmarket quality processes, including CAPA, Health Hazard Evaluations (HHEs), and other quality system activities, ensuring thorough assessment of product performance and risk.

  • You have experience supporting software quality engineering activities throughout the product lifecycle, including requirements, architecture, design, development, verification, validation, release, and postmarket surveillance.

  • You have strong understanding of software risk management principles and methodologies, with the ability to apply risk-based decision-making in alignment with regulatory expectations and industry best practices.

  • You have excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to effectively convey complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders across the organization.

  • You have working knowledge of modern software technologies, including cloud-based platforms, distributed systems, cybersecurity fundamentals, software architectures, and data-driven applications.

  • You have proven ability to apply engineering fundamentals and structured problem-solving techniques to investigate complex issues, determine root causes, and drive effective corrective actions.

  • You have strong analytical mindset with experience interpreting data, identifying trends, and translating findings into actionable recommendations.

  • You have the ability to balance technical depth with business impact, driving decisions that support product quality, patient safety, compliance, and customer experience.

job.title: QA Engineer

About Arena:

Arena is a startup created in Silicon Valley with a mission to build communities for creators, publishers and brands with the power of AI. Companies using Arena include Disney, Reuters, Fox, Red Bull and NFL. We have +2,000 customers in 150 countries and with +50M users having conversations on Arena per month and engaging with our AI tools.

We are a Series A company backed by top-tier investors such as CRV, Redpoint and Craft Ventures. Arena offers a unique work environment and the chance to collaborate with diverse teammates across multiple countries, with a culture of ownership (autonomy, growth, and specially high performance).

Sometimes you're stuck in a job that doesn't make sense. Managing tasks and infinite backlogs, not talking to customers and miles away from making product decisions. If you love a good challenge, you're a curious product guy who experiments with AI and AI agents every day, and you want to be a part of one of the fastest-growing AI startups in Silicon Valley — then Arena is the company you're looking for.

About the Role:

We’re looking for a QA Engineer who’s passionate about technology, curious about how things work, and eager to ensure quality across our products. You’ll join a supportive, fast-paced environment and collaborate with experienced engineers to test web applications, APIs, and new features as they’re developed.

This is a great opportunity to grow in a company that values mentorship, ownership, and continuous learning.


What you will be doing:

  • Collaborate with product and engineering to understand requirements and define test strategies.
  • Write and maintain **manual and automated test cases** for web applications and APIs.
  • Run exploratory and regression tests for new features and releases.
  • Help monitor issues in production and identify patterns for improvement.
  • Contribute to maintaining and expanding our automated test suite using Cypress and Jest.

The challenges:

  • Real-time messaging to support 100,000 concurrent users per customer application;
  • High performance: our API responses are in the 10ms range;
  • High scalability: we use sharding, master-master, and master-slave to ensure scalability;
  • High availability: our code is running on homepages of the most visited websites and apps in the internet;
  • Distributed databases for our Data Platform storing every user engagement.

You Might Be a Fit If You Have:

  • Some experience (6–18 months) in QA or testing software
  • Familiarity with tools like Cypress, Jest, or Selenium.
  • Basic knowledge of JavaScript or TypeScript.
  • Understanding of REST APIs and how to test them.
  • Enthusiasm to learn, ask questions, and work in a collaborative environment.
  • Advanced English (spoken and written).

Nice-to-Have Experience:

  • Experience with HTML/CSS and browser dev tools.
  • Exposure to mobile testing (iOS or Android).
  • Understanding of how CI/CD and deployment pipelines work.
  • Curiosity about how distributed systems scale.

Example Projects You’ll Be Working on:

  • Build automated test suites and test cases for web apps, mobile apps, and APIs;
  • Build early warning systems that detect production environment errors;
  • Certify production releases;
  • Manual testing, where necessary – we prefer automated tests!
  • Continuously improve and maintain quality standards;
  • Analyze error patterns to identify repeating types of issues;
  • Monitor error and debug sources for production issues.

We also have some sweet perks like:

🔥 Be a part of the team in Silicon Valley and join a global team

💪 A team of exceptional engineers leading the cutting-edge AI Agents.

💶 Competitive salary package & benefits

⛱️ 4 weeks of paid time-off

📖 Learning and Development budget

🚀 Key moment to join Arena in terms of growth and opportunities

💻 Ability to put your stamp on real-world AI applications that serve millions of users.

📚 Fast-learning environment, entrepreneurial and strong team spirit

🌍 Multiple nationalities: cosmopolite & multi-cultural mindset

💆‍♀️ Our people matter, work-life balance is important at Arena
