We are looking for an experienced Test Lead to drive the Quality and Validation strategy for a high-impact solution, in a highly regulated industry, involving AI components and Salesforce integration. In this role, you will own both definition and delivery of the Testing & AI Validation Strategy. You will be responsible for defining how solution outputs are verified for correctness, reliability, and safe operation, bridging the gap between newly developed AI Agents components and the client’s Salesforce environment.

Requirements

What you’ll do

Strategy & Planning:

  • Own the QA Strategy: Design, plan and dDevelop the comprehensive Testing and AI Validation Strategy, covering FunctionalUnit, E2E, Integration, Regression, and User Acceptance Testing (UAT).

  • Address NFR and align against standards (e.g. GDPR, HIPAA, HITRUST, etc.)

  • AI Validation Logic: Define validation plans for AI components, specifically determining what constitutes "correct" output, setting success thresholds, and establishing evaluation methods (including handling hallucinations and grounding rules).

  • Environment & Data: Create detailed plans for Test Environments (Dev/Test/Prod) and define the Test Data Strategy to ensure sufficient coverage for standard scenarios, edge cases, and ingestion failures.

Execution & Reporting:

  • Hands-on Testing: Execute functional, regression, exploratory, performance, and load tests.

  • Integration Coordination: Coordinate "Joint End-to-End Validation" efforts, collaborating with the client team to manage testing of Salesforce integration

  • Pipeline Integration: Integrate testing activities into the CI/CD pipeline for continuous quality assurance

  • Process Management: Manage Jira test case structures aligned to user stories and acceptance criteria

  • Metrics: Provide regular reporting, tracking key QA metrics such as defect ratios

About the project, in short. Is it a new project or maintenance?

This is a new project for a client that we have already established collaboration with during other projects. We are finalizing the Discovery Phase for this project and moving into Delivery.

We are developing a data validation and automation engine that processes structured and unstructured inputs against a complex logic framework. The system utilizes AI models to interpret user-submitted data, identifying discrepancies and missing information before mapping the results to a structured output format. Key components include automated ingestion, rule-based validation logic, and integration with existing enterprise architecture in a highly regulated industry.

Technical Requirements (must-have):

  • Fluent English

  • QA Strategy: Experience defining end-to-end testing strategies for complex solutions

  • End-to-End Testing: Experience in designing and executing E2E tests for complex, integrated systems using any modern testing technology

  • AI/ML/LLM Testing Experience: Proven ability to validate AI models

  • Test Data Management: Experience strategizing and managing test data across multiple environments (Dev/Test/Prod)

  • Traceability mindset: linking requirements → test cases → evidence → defects → release decisions.

  • Experience testing NFRs: performance, reliability, auditability, security basics.

  • Strong understanding of privacy and sensitive data handling in testing (PII/PHI minimization, masking/anonymization)

  • Hands-on automation experience (at least one strong stack): e.g., Python/Java/JS + frameworks (pytest/JUnit/etc.)

  • QA Metrics: Ability to track and report on specific QA metrics, such as defect ratios

  • Good communication skills (written and verbal)

Additional Requirements (nice-to-have):

  • Familiar with AWS platform

  • ISTQB or similar certifications

  • Previous experience in fast-paced consulting or client-facing projects

Highlights

Lead QA and AI validation for a regulated AI + Salesforce project, owning strategy and hands-on testing across E2E, integration and NFR with CI/CD and close client collaboration.

job.title: Freelance Software Tester (Remote in Réunion, Monaco)
job.description:
Hi there! We are Testlio, a global software testing company with its own freelance network. Our freelancers test apps from companies across the globe. Testlio is a great place for people who value the freedom and flexibility of remote work.

At the moment, we are looking for freelance software testers based in Réunion or Monaco to participate in a software testing project for one of our clients, a globally know premier sporting league based out of the United States. We're currently in the process of testing out their app and subscription flow, and we'd love to welcome you as part of the testing team.

Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio

  • Schedule: You can create your schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you.
  • Location: Testlio is a 100% remote company. Seriously, you can work from the coffee shop, your home, or while waiting for class.
  • Growth: You’ll be testing global-scale mobile apps and have the chance to boost your skills and grow your career.
  • Payment: You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. This means you get paid even if you did not uncover any bugs.

Requirements

  • Age: You have to be at least 18 years old.
  • Location: Must be physically located in Réunion or Monaco. The use of a VPN is prohibited.
  • Language: Must at least be comfortable speaking English.
  • Availability: Approximately 1h total for the setup + 90 minutes for the testing task, spread over a couple of days.
  • Devices: Laptop/ PC
  • Experience: No experience needed, we can provide training and instructions.

What does testing look like?

  • Type of testing: Payments testing.
  • Type of work: You will be asked to test out our client's subscription flow to make sure that it works accurately in your country. 
  • Tasks: For this workspace, we will be validating our client's overall subscription flow. The workspace will be divided into 3 parts: 
    • You will be invited to participate in a paid project onboarding, where you can check the details and documentation prior to testing
    • You will receive a pre-payment from us that will be used in the next stage of the workspace, approximately $20 - $25 USD.
    • You will be asked to use the pre-payment amount to help us test our client's subscription purchase. 
  • Pay rate: $18 USD / h.
  • Payment: Payment will be made via PayPal or Payoneer.

How to start?

  1. Fill out the questionnaire. A member of our Recruitment Team will contact you with the next steps via email. 
  2. If you are not a match with our requirements visit our Community page instead to find out more about how you can participate in other projects. 

If you have any questions or need help, please contact Opportunities@testlio.com using the code FRENCHPAYMENTS in the Subject line/email body so we can quickly identify your request. 

Once you are ready, please fill out the initial application below. Those who meet the requirements will receive further information to participate in this paid testing opportunity.

job.title: Manager, Quality Assurance – Western U.S. (West of the Mississippi) & Florida
job.description:
We’re here for one reason and one reason only – to cure cancer. Every moment is dedicated to developing treatments and every action moves us one step closer to our goal. We’ve made incredible scientific breakthroughs and our pioneering personalized CAR T-cell therapies have changed the paradigm. But we're not finished yet.


Join Kite, as we make even bigger advances in cancer therapies, and help shape where our business and medical science goes next.


We believe every employee deserves a great leader. People Leaders are the cornerstone to the employee experience at Gilead and Kite. As a people leader now or in the future, you are the key driver in evolving our culture and creating an environment where every employee feels included, developed and empowered to fulfill their aspirations. Join Kite and help create more tomorrows.


Job Description

To be considered, candidates must currently reside in the Western U.S. (west of the Mississippi) or Florida at the time of application.


Job Description

At Gilead our pursuit of a healthier world for all people has yielded a cure for hepatitis C, revolutionary improvements in HIV treatment and prevention as well as advancements in therapies for viral and inflammatory diseases and certain cancers.

We set and achieve bold ambitions in our fight against the world’s most devastating diseases, united in our commitment to confronting the largest public health challenges of our day and improving the lives of patients for generations to come

Kite is seeking a highly motivated, self-driven individual to join the North America Regional Quality Operations team as Manager, Quality Operations in the exciting new area of CAR-T cancer immunotherapy. You will work cross functionally to assist with the qualification and monitoring program for apheresis collection and treatment centers that supports Kite’s rapid expansion of our commercially marketed cell therapy products.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Assess and approve any changes to Kite Konnect, courier tracking, order intake and order processing systems to assure validated state of the systems is maintained.
  • Assist in the management of an apheresis and treatment center (ATC) qualification process using risk-based tools for qualification, training, monitoring and disqualification.
  • Collaborate with our Commercial operations in the routine management of the ATC relationships and Supply Chain for courier qualification and monitoring processes.
  • Perform a variety of audits, qualify and monitor compliance to qualification requirements.
  • Maintain the monitoring schedule and approved ATC list.
  • Assist with resolution of ATC and courier issues and discrepancies, and the investigations to resolve the issues.
  • Support and/or own quality records (ATC, Deviations, CAPA, Change control, etc.)
  • Assist in development, implementation and management of ATC management system (GVault)
  • Support inspection readiness plans and interact with regulatory agencies during inspections on ATC-related matters, as needed.
  • Ability to travel up to 40%

Basic qualifications:

  • Bachelor's Degree and Six Years' Experience

OR

  • Masters' Degree and Four Years' Experience

OR

  • PhD / PharmD

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in biological sciences, nursing, medical technologist or related field
  • 8 years progressive experience in a medical or pharmaceutical environment, including nursing, apheresis/transplant/infusion centers, or blood banks, preferred; OR pharmaceutical, vaccines or biologics quality systems’ roles.
  • Minimum 3-5 years quality assurance experience preferred
  • Experience managing external suppliers, blood banks, and plasma centers.
  • Medical center or pharmaceutical auditing experience preferred.
  • Experience in areas such as Clinical Research, Medical Liaison, Apheresis, Cell Therapy Lab, and Medical Centers preferred.
  • Previous experience in deviation management, development of corrective preventive/actions and change control, preferred.
  • ASQ Certified Quality Auditor preferred
  • Strong working knowledge of and the ability to apply GMP and FACT/AABB standards
  • Previous experience presenting and responding to regulatory agency or certification audits, preferred
  • Proficient in MS Word, Excel, and Power Point
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills are essential in this collaborative work environment
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced small company environment with minimal direction and able to adjust workload based upon changing priorities
  • Must be able to work independently, can multi-task and prioritize job responsibilities
  • Self-motivated, detail-oriented, and willing to accept temporary responsibilities outside of initial job description
The salary range for this position is: $123,930.00 - $160,380.00. Kite considers a variety of factors when determining base compensation, including experience, qualifications, and geographic location. These considerations mean actual compensation will vary. This position may also be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus, discretionary stock-based long-term incentives (eligibility may vary based on role), paid time off, and a benefits package. Benefits include company-sponsored medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans*.

For additional benefits information, visit:

* Eligible employees may participate in benefit plans, subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans.

Kite is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the development of innovative cancer immunotherapies with a goal of providing rapid, long-term durable response and eliminating the burden of chronic care. The company is focused on chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) and T cell receptor (TCR) engineered cell therapies designed to empower the immune system's ability to recognize and kill tumors. Kite is based in Santa Monica, CA. For more information on Kite, please visit . Sign up to follow @KitePharma on Twitter at .

Volunteer Position
We are seeking full time and volunteer professional Software Test Engineers. We have product teams that work in various frameworks and platforms including.

Bloom - C#, Typescript + React, CSS, SQL, and Java
Paratext - C#,.React, Net development, XML/HTML/CSS


SIL International is a faith-based nonprofit organization committed to serving translation teams worldwide. If you believe, as we do, that all languages are of value, form an integral part of people’s identity, and have the potential to serve them in a rapidly changing world, then you can be part of a software team serving translation teams worldwide.

Summary:

A Software Test Engineer is responsible for designing and implementing software testing. Testing software products as early and often as possible is proven to improve the resolution of the quality picture and thus enable the software development team to objectively improve the quality of the software. The test cases for our software products are developed by the people with the most knowledge of the product. The output of the effort is a list of procedure-based test cases encompassing the desired test coverage. This position is intended to execute the test cases daily and at release milestones.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Manually execute scheduled tests as written, on time

  • Participate in reviews for new test cases developed

  • Report issues found into issue tracking systems

  • Report status at team standups

  • Manually perform Ad-Hoc testing

  • Work with Software Test Manager to collaborate, review, and deliver high quality software testing

  • Participate as an integral and enthusiastic part of the team, exhibiting ownership, follow-through, initiative, awareness, and effective communication with peers and management

  • Work with the team around a cohesive team roadmap

Minor Responsibilities:

  • Participate in regular project status, planning, partnership, and strategic meetings

  • Be available to travel to software development team meetings as needed

  • Be available to travel biannually to the Language Technology Conference

  • Participate in professional meetings

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:

  • A servant heart attitude

  • Demonstrated knowledge of QA process: different levels, types and methods of testing: unit, functional, negative, integration, performance, reliability, stress, user scenario, visual

  • Demonstrated knowledge of Black, Grey, and White box testing.

  • Strong written and verbal skills

  • Good interpersonal skills of communication

  • Good organizational skills

  • The ability to make decisions in a timely manner

  • The ability to generate multiple solutions to the problem

  • The ability to quickly pick up technical concepts

  • The ability to work both with a team and independently, and to multitask effectively

Education and Experience:

Software Test Engineers should have experience in software engineering and a good understanding of the software development lifecycle. Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent software testing work experience is preferred, but we care more for a heart and mind that are always learning.

Will complete the initial IT Software Department training program and relevant portions of IT Orientation.

job.description:
JOB PURPOSE – WHAT WILL YOU DO:

Our team is looking for a talented, innovative, and results-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer (QAE) to test the front-end/ back-end features and large-scale services.

Quality Assurance Engineers at Urban test cutting-edge applications and products at the user level and code level, both manually and with automated tools. Our QAEs are not pure black box testers, they are able to understand software internals, debug problems using log files, and write automated tests with scripting tools and/or user-level automated tools. QAEs at Urban are excellent individual contributors capable of taking up tasks from start to completion with minimal help. QAEs at Urban are responsible for understanding the domain as well as the product in detail, designing the test strategy/planning, developing the test cases, and driving the test case sign-off processes with the stakeholders, contributing to code-level unit tests, test execution, and reporting.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES – WHAT YOU WILL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR:

  • Develop automated test suites. Participate in design and code inspections.

  • Create and maintain a set of automated test scripts (using Java, JUnit, Selenium, etc.) to validate UI-based software, non-UI-based software, and build related processes.

  • Develop and maintain a dynamic test coverage matrix for all supported mobile devices, operating systems, software versions.

  • Perform manual testing, the scope of which will encompass all functionalities of services as a prequel to automation.

  • Perform API level and integration testing.

  • Analyze test logs; create test reports, co-ordinate with stakeholders.

  • Constructively identify problems and propose solutions, taking on projects that identify and mitigate risk while measuring software quality.

  • Enjoy working in a fast paced and challenging environment. Just like a visionary startup.

  • Ownership and responsibility of work.

  • Bring a professional attitude at work and belief in team effort.

  • Stay up to date with new testing tools and test strategies

SKILLS/COMPETENCIES REQUIRED – WHAT YOU WILL NEED:

  • Understanding of QA methodologies, life cycle and processes.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Demonstrated experience in writing clean scripts/code quickly. Preferably Java coding.  

  • Strong organizational skills, able to track multiple test executions simultaneously and synthesize the results.  

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to communicate cross-functionally and across management levels in formal and informal settings to report on test progress, metrics, issues, and risks.

  • Automation framework development experience.  

  • Experience in Agile/Scrum.

JOB PREREQUISITES (EDUCATION, PREVIOUS EXPERIENCE ETC)

  • Bachelor's in Computer Science / Engineering or related field.

  • 5+ years of experience software quality assurance.

  • Hands-on experience writing code (JAVA)

  • Experience testing/exercising REST APIs

  • Experience with testing frameworks such as JUnit and TestNG.

  • Working knowledge of testing fundamentals such as TDD & BDD.

Role Type: Contractor

In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters. job.title: Performance Tester Internship
job.description:
Overview: Scalability and Speed Optimization

The Performance Tester is dedicated to ensuring the speed, stability, and scalability of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will plan, design, and execute rigorous load, stress, and endurance tests on the core e-commerce storefront, the performance-critical internal SaaS tools (OMS, WMS, MES), and the emerging AI agent services to identify and eliminate performance bottlenecks.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will be the expert in pushing the platform to its limits, guaranteeing optimal user experience even under peak load.

  • Test Strategy & Design: Design comprehensive load, stress, and endurance testing strategies for critical systems, focusing on the high-volume e-commerce checkout funnels, payment gateway integrations, and API responsiveness across the modular monolith.

  • Execution & Analysis: Execute tests using industry-standard tools (e.g., JMeter, Gatling) and cloud-based load testing services. Analyze results to accurately identify performance bottlenecks in the Node.js/NestJS services, database queries (PostgreSQL/Redis), and infrastructure components.

  • Critical Flow Testing: Specifically test the performance and throughput of key supply chain APIs and user flows, including real-time inventory checks (WMS integration), order placement (OMS), and search functionality (Meilisearch).

  • Optimization Recommendations: Collaborate closely with the SRE and development teams to translate performance data into clear, actionable optimization strategies for code, database indices, caching (Redis), and infrastructure (auto-scaling).

  • CI/CD Integration: Work with the DevSecOps team to integrate performance testing as a mandatory quality gate within the CI/CD pipeline to prevent performance regressions in new deployments.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess deep experience in performance testing methodology, execution, and analysis:

  • Testing Tools: Expert proficiency in JMeter, Gatling, or similar high-scale load generation tools.

  • Monitoring & Analysis: Hands-on experience using the observability stack (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) to monitor system metrics, latency, and resource utilization during test execution.

  • Programming/Scripting: Proficiency in scripting languages (e.g., JavaScript/Python) for test scenario creation and data generation.

  • Backend Knowledge: Strong understanding of database performance tuning (PostgreSQL), caching, and API behavior (REST/JSON).

  • Cloud/Infra: Familiarity with cloud-based load testing services and containerized environments (Docker).

AI Agent Focus

You will validate the capacity and latency of our AI services.

  • Load Testing AI: Conduct stress and load tests on the AI agent systems, measuring latency and throughput under concurrent user requests, especially concerning the processing power required for LLM interactions (e.g., prompt processing, RAG retrieval).

  • Resource Impact: Analyze the impact of AI compute demands on shared infrastructure resources, providing data for cloud capacity planning.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Latency Reduction: Measurable improvements in API response times (e.g., 95th percentile latency) for critical services.

  • Throughput: Successful validation of system throughput capabilities against business-defined peak load targets.

  • Bottleneck Identification: Accuracy and impact of identified performance bottlenecks and recommended solutions.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Automation QA Lead or Technical Architect, working directly with the SRE and Backend Engineering teams to ensure performance is a core product feature.

job.title: QA Engineer – Creative Automation (100% Remote) (LATAM ONLY)
job.description:
About AllShore Talent

AllShore Talent partners with growing organizations to build high-performing technology and consulting teams. We connect skilled professionals with meaningful, long-term engagements across web technologies, digital experience platforms, and enterprise software delivery — offering competitive compensation, flexible engagement models, and a collaborative, remote-friendly culture.

About the Role

Adobe Workflows, API Integration and Digital Media

AllShore Tallent is seeking a mid-to-senior QA Engineer specializing in creative automation to validate end-to-end creative automation and digital media production workflows. The role spans Airtable intake and status control, AWS orchestration, Adobe Photoshop APIs, and review and approval. The current use case focuses on static banners and Photoshop outputs, with motion graphics and video workflows in the pipeline, including one moving into implementation.

The ideal candidate brings a methodical approach to tracing distributed workflows, finding edge cases, maintaining state integrity, and verifying data isolation, with a background in digital media workflow engineering, ad-tech production pipelines, creative automation, or cloud-native integration QA.

Key responsibilities

· Validate asynchronous, event-driven pipelines in which intake actions trigger background state machines and webhooks. Trace the complete flow from Airtable through AWS and Photoshop APIs to Frame.io.

· Verify idempotency, de-duplication, race-condition handling, and queue throttling, including duplicate Frame.io Approved webhooks.

· Test recovery from network interruptions, expired tokens, corrupt or oversized source media, missing manifest keys, and simulated API service limits. Verify circuit breaker thresholds, queue pausing, slot release, and manual or administrator recovery.

· Design deterministic cache lifecycle tests that distinguish reusable asset-level caches (Creative/DMC) from isolated template-level manifests. Confirm that template timestamp changes and asset re-uploads invalidate caches correctly and prevent stale file delivery.

· Reconcile assets, folders, and version stacks. Test URL-encoded filenames, duplicate same-name folder structures, version stack collisions, and protection of active in-progress uploads from deletion.

· Validate AI cropping and graphical transformations across human and non-human subjects in landscape and portrait source files. Assess bounding-box and focal-point detection, identify unnecessary Firefly Generative Expand versus appropriate native cropping, and verify masks preserve native boundaries.

· Inspect typography, font substitutions, leading, multi-line wrapping, bold ranges, safe-zone margins, CTA button bounds, disclaimer visibility, and ratings bug placement across aspect ratios.

· Document reproducible, step-level defects in Jira Cloud with complete asset and log context, and evaluate results against acceptance criteria associated with Epics, Stories, and Bugs.

Requirements

Required qualifications and technical skills

  • QA experience: Mid-to-senior QA engineering experience aligned with digital media workflow engineering, ad-tech production pipelines, creative automation, or cloud-native integration QA. Strong end-to-end troubleshooting, edge-case testing, state integrity, and data isolation skills.

  • Airtable: Practical understanding of field types, formulas, automations, and trigger actions. Ability to validate Action = Execute and Automation Status transitions from Pending to Queued to In Progress to Review, Approved, or Finalizing. Experience checking field hygiene, null and fallback values such as NA, Automation Version Stack ID tracking, and Invalidate Asset Cache and Creative Allocation overrides

  • : Strong practical knowledge of as an automated review and approval surface, including version stacking, Approved asset status hooks, share-link generation, and structural validation. Experience with API authentication nuances, including server-to-server (S2S) authentication and workarounds, custom headers, and rate-limiting behavior.

  • Adobe Photoshop and imaging APIs: Solid conceptual understanding of artboards, smart objects, layer hierarchies and masks, text layers, typography leading and sizing, and bounds calculation. Familiarity with Adobe Photoshop APIs and smart-object replacement mechanics. Ability to inspect and validate PSD/PSB, JPG, PNG, and GIF outputs, including raster and animated renditions as applicable.

  • AWS orchestration and observability: Comfort navigating SQS queues, DynamoDB locking and slot tracking, Step Functions / state machines, Lambda, and S3 asset storage and overwrite behavior. Ability to trace execution logs, correlation IDs, and failure payloads to distinguish upstream intake errors, service timeouts, and circuit breaker trip states.

  • Workflow reliability: Experience testing asynchronous and event-driven systems, webhook de-duplication, idempotency, concurrency, throttling, resilience, circuit breakers, layered caching and invalidation, and asset and folder synchronization edge cases.

  • Visual quality assurance: Understanding of bounding-box and focal-point detection, native cropping, Firefly Generative Expand, and mask boundaries. A keen eye for digital display production and design standards across multiple output formats and aspect ratios.

  • Jira Cloud: Deep comfort working with Epics, Stories, Bugs, acceptance criteria, and detailed, reproducible defect reports supported by assets and logs.

Preferred skills

  • Familiarity with Adobe Premiere Pro, After Effects, Motion Graphics templates (MoGRTs), Adobe Media Encoder with particular emphasis on presets, and video codecs, output formats, and resolutions to support upcoming motion graphics and video use cases.

You will integrate test execution into Azure DevOps pipelines, run automation against workloads deployed to Azure, and contribute to test strategy alongside developers, architects, and product owners. You will help advance how Aubrant approaches quality assurance, including the adoption of agentic automation patterns that accelerate test creation, maintenance, and triage. This role is hands-on; you will write production test code daily while contributing to the standards and tooling that shape our QA practice.

job.title: Automation QA Engineer Internship
job.description:
Overview: Quality and Test Automation

The Automation QA Engineer is vital for ensuring the reliability, performance, and correctness of our entire supply chain e-commerce platform. You will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining comprehensive automated test suites across the e-commerce user interface, complex internal business workflows (MES, WMS, OMS), and the logic governing our next-generation AI agents.

Internship Details

Duration: 3 months

Start Date: Immediate

Location: Remote

Stipend: None initially. Based on your first-quarter performance, you may be offered a paid full-time opportunity, or even be absorbed directly by the client as an FTE.

Key Responsibilities & Core Projects

You will embed quality assurance directly into the development and deployment lifecycle, serving as the gatekeeper for production releases.

  • Test Suite Development: Develop and maintain robust, end-to-end automated test suites covering critical e-commerce flows (catalog navigation, checkout, payments, invoicing) and complex internal tool workflows (OMS/WMS operations).

  • Quality Gates (CI/CD): Integrate automated test suites into the CI/CD pipeline (managed via Makefile) to enforce quality gates, ensuring no regressions are introduced and the platform adheres to performance standards before deployment.

  • Performance & Load Testing: Implement and execute performance testing and load testing protocols to validate the scalability and resilience of the NestJS modular monolith, especially for high-traffic scenarios and intensive SCM transactions.

  • API Integration Testing: Design and execute automated tests for API integrations between the core supply chain modules (e.g., testing the data contract integrity between WMS and OMS) and external payment services.

  • Test Data Management: Create and maintain reliable test data factories to simulate complex multi-tenant and domain-specific scenarios (e.g., various HS codes, tenant feature flags).

  • Regression Management: Continuously maintain and optimize the regression test suite to provide fast, reliable feedback to development teams operating within the Monorepo structure.

Required Technologies & Tools

Candidates must possess strong expertise in automated testing frameworks, CI/CD integration, and performance validation:

  • Automation Frameworks: Experience selecting, building, and maintaining E2E (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and API testing frameworks.

  • Programming: Strong proficiency in TypeScript and Node.js for writing high-quality, maintainable test code.

  • Performance/Load: Experience with tools for performance and load testing (e.g., JMeter, K6).

  • CI/CD: Practical experience integrating tests into automated pipelines and working within a Monorepo environment.

  • Data & Database: Ability to query PostgreSQL 15 directly to validate data integrity.

AI Agent Focus

You will be responsible for validating the behavior and accuracy of our AI systems.

  • Agent Behavior Testing: Develop tests to validate the deterministic and non-deterministic behaviors of AI agents, ensuring they accurately process inputs, access data securely, and perform their intended functions (e.g., workflow optimization, customer support responses).

  • Integration Validation: Verify the quality of data retrieval and the security of the API layers connecting AI agents (using LangChain/LlamaIndex) to the core WMS/OMS data.

Success Metrics & Career Path

Performance will be measured by:

  • Test Coverage: Measurable increase in automated functional and regression test coverage across critical application paths.

  • Defect Escape Rate: Reduction in the number of critical and high-severity defects escaping to production.

  • Pipeline Reliability: Maintenance of stable, non-flaky test runs within the CI/CD pipeline.

Mentorship Structure: Reports to the Technical Architect or Engineering Lead, working directly with development teams across the Catalog, OMS, and WMS modules.

job.title: Senior QA / SDET Engineer
job.description:
At TTEC Digital, we coach clients to ensure their employees feel valued, and fully supported, because an amazing customer experience is an employee first process. Our vision is the same, a place where employees know they can thrive.
TTEC Digital seeks a Sr. QA/SDET Engineer to join our team. This role is a full-time and fully remote opportunity!

The work:

We’re an innovation group inside TTEC (NASDAQ: TTEC), building the next generation of AI CX tools — automated QA, conversational analytics, knowledge assist, and agentic automation — for the world’s biggest brands and the millions of customers they serve. We move like an early-stage startup, backed by the scale, distribution, and enterprise client base of a company that’s been obsessed with customer experience since 1982.

This is the rare seat where getting in early actually matters at scale. TTEC is a public company at an AI inflection point. Ship the right products into thousands of live enterprise deployments and you don’t just move a metric — you move the trajectory of the company and the value of the stock. The leverage is real, and the work compounds.

Who we hire — the DNA

  • Self-starters and do-ers with grit — hackers in the best sense, with a startup mentality and a show-me bias: working software over slides, prototypes over proposals.

  • Want to learn, love new technology. This platform is built on the latest technology, and that technology changes and advances monthly. You adapt to change quickly — new tools, new models, new priorities — without drama.

  • Master debuggers and problem solvers. You love solving complex problems, you think outside the box, and you multitask across domains without losing the thread.

  • AI-native. You work with AI on all levels — you understand the technology around you (LLMs, SLMs, RAG, knowledge graphs, agents, training, eval) and you use AI tools daily to exponentially increase your velocity.

  • Distributed-systems literate. High-efficiency, event-driven, low-latency systems are our world; you understand what that demands.

  • Innovators who ship. You demonstrate ideas easily, fail fast, and move forward. You make committed timelines and hit them.

  • You consider yourself exceptional — and you like winning. So do we.

No one will have everything in this description. We're looking for well-rounded, smart people who move fast.

What You Will Do:

    The role:

  • Automation-first quality engineering for a platform combining voice, desktop, intelligence, and AI.
  • We emphasize AUTOMATION — we do not do manual QA here.
  • Weekly code deploys are the heartbeat: when a QA branch is ready, regressions run fast, results report fast, and the train doesn't wait.
  • Startup environment: 1-week sprints, fail fast, move forward.

    • What you'll own:

  • Automation coverage for your squads' services
  • Fast-turnaround regression suites gating weekly deploys ·
  • Rapid detection and reporting
  • Quality signal in minutes, not days
  • Load/stress coverage for your services' latency budgets
  • Your committed timelines.

    • Who you are:

  • Self-starter with grit and a show-me mentality.
  • You consider yourself exceptional, love new technology, adapt fast when the stack changes under you, and use AI tools daily to multiply velocity — including AI-assisted test generation.
  • A team player who likes winning, and a partner to dev, not a gate: when something breaks, you help the dev team isolate it fast.

What You Will Bring:

    • 5+ years SDET; writes real automation code (Go / Python), not manual scripts. Automation-first is a conviction, not a preference.

    • Master issue-isolator and root-cause debugger — you narrow a failure to the service, the commit, the event; dev teams love your bug reports because they're half the debugging done.

    • Fast regression discipline — parallelized suites, smart test selection, results in minutes; quality at weekly-deploy speed without becoming the bottleneck.

    • Comfortable in high-load testing environments — load, stress, and soak testing of high-throughput, low-latency systems; you know how to find the knee of the curve.

    • Experience testing event-driven systems, WebSocket flows, and browser extensions — ordering, race conditions, real-time state.

    • CI-native mindset — tests wired into trunk-based CI/CD; flake management as a first-class discipline (a flaky suite is a broken suite).

    • Contract/API testing between services; synthetic data and traffic generation (simulated calls, event streams, audio) for repeatable real-time testing.

    • Testing AI outputs — eval-style assertions for non-deterministic LLM/ML features — a strong plus.

About Us

TTEC Digital and our 1,800+ employees, pioneer engagement and growth solutions that fuel the exceptional customer experience (CX). Our sister company, TTEC Engage, is a 60,000+ employee service company, with customer service representatives located around the world. TTEC Holdings Inc. is the parent company for both Digital and Engage. When clients have a holistic need, they can draw from these independently managed centers of excellence, TTEC Digital and TTEC Engage.
We are also delighted to share that TTEC has been awarded the Great Place To Work 2024-2025 certification based on outstanding employee experience across 14 countries.
TTEC is a proud equal opportunity employer where all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability. TTEC has fully embraced and is committed to expanding our diverse and inclusive workforce. job.title: QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
At Upland Software, you’ll find smart, creative teams who love working together to deliver value for our customers, and a global culture of growth and possibility. Opportunity Summary:

InterFAX is a secure, scalable cloud fax platform used by enterprises and regulated industries worldwide. We provide reliable document delivery via APIs and web interfaces, integrating with complex customer environments across regions. As we grow our automation footprint, we’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer to elevate quality at speed across API, UI, and integration layers.

Primary Responsibilities:

  • Own end-to-end test automation across SOAP and REST APIs and web UI, with an emphasis on maintainability, speed, and reliability.
  • Design and implement robust test suites using Playwright (for both UI and API automation) and SoapUI (or ReadyAPI) for SOAP services—covering functional, regression, and smoke tests.
  • Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions/Azure DevOps/Jenkins) to enable gated builds, parallel execution, test artifacts, and quality gates.
  • Leverage AI tools (e.g., code assistants, intelligent test generation, flaky test diagnosis) to accelerate test design, triage failures, and improve test stability.
  • Triages and resolves automation failures quickly: debug network calls, flakiness, environment drifts, data setup issues, and concurrency/race conditions.
  • Establish quality signals and dashboards (e.g., pass/fail trends, flake rate, coverage by feature, API latency thresholds) and communicate risks clearly to engineering and product.
  • Champion best practices for test design patterns (page objects, fixtures, API clients), mocking/contract testing, test data management, and environment reliability.
  • Collaborate tightly with developers, QA, DevOps, and Support to ensure seamless releases and rapid feedback loops.
  • Contribute to standards and reusable frameworks for the CLA Business Unit to scale automation across products

Requirements:

  • Strong hands‑on experience testing SOAP and REST APIs (request/response validation, schema/assertions, auth flows, error handling, idempotency).
  • Experience with SoapUI including properties, data-driven tests, assertions, environment management, and CI execution.
  • Proficiency with Playwright for UI and API automation, including:
    • TypeScript or JavaScript test authoring
    • Fixtures, selectors, network mocking, traces/videos
    • Parallelization, tagging, retries, and flake control
  • Proven ability to leverage AI tools (e.g., copilots, test code generators, log analyzers) to enhance testing efficiency and stability.
  • Solid understanding of CI/CD and integrating automated tests (e.g., GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, GitLab, Jenkins): artifacts, reports, secrets, environment gates.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills for automation failures (timeouts, async waits, flaky selectors, network instability, test data conflicts) and improving test stability at scale.
  • Source control proficiency (Git) and collaborative workflows (PRs, code reviews, branching, tagging).
  • Clear communication with the ability to translate technical findings into actionable risks for stakeholders.

Desired Skills:

  • Experience with secure document delivery, telephony/faxing, or SIP/T.38/G.711 concepts.
  • Familiarity with contract testing (e.g., Pact), API schema validation (OpenAPI/WSDL), and mock servers.
  • Performance and reliability testing for APIs (e.g., k6, JMeter) and observability (e.g., Grafana, Datadog, Azure Monitor).
  • Test data management strategies and environment orchestration (containers, Docker Compose).
  • Experience with Azure or AWS services and secrets/key management.
  • Experience building shareable internal testing libraries or CLI tools.

Qualifications

  • 5–8+ years in software QA/automation with a focus on API and UI test frameworks.
  • Demonstrable ownership of CI-integrated automation at product scale.
  • Bachelor’s degree in CS/Engineering or equivalent practical experience.

  • Communication & Collaboration: Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with data engineering, reporting, and business teams.

job.title: Sr. Manager, QA Engineering & Automation
job.description:
Scopely is looking for a Senior QA Manager, Automation & Tooling to join our team supporting a soon-to-be-announced AAA mobile game title. This role can be remote in the US and Canada, or hybrid in Culver City.

You will lead the automation strategy for a live game, building the people, processes, frameworks, and tooling required to scale quality across frequent releases and a large, active player base. You will partner closely with Engineering, QA, Live Operations, and other disciplines to establish a development culture where automation is a shared responsibility and a core component of product quality.

At Scopely, we create and operate games played by millions of people around the world. This role is an opportunity to shape how quality engineering evolves from the ground up for a high-scale live mobile game.

What You Will Do

  • Define and execute the QA automation strategy for a live mobile game, including scalable frameworks, tooling, standards, and quality gates.
  • Build and lead an automation team from the ground up, including hiring, team structure, processes, mentorship, and career development.
  • Design, build, and implement automated testing across UI, API, integration, regression, end-to-end, mobile, and live-operations workflows.
  • Evaluate automation approaches, frameworks, platforms, and traditional or AI-assisted tools based on coverage, maintainability, speed, and value.
  • Establish automation standards, coding practices, test architecture, reporting, observability, and quality gates that can scale with the game and organization. 
  • Partner with Engineering and QA to prioritize automation, improve testability, integrate testing into CI/CD, and establish shared ownership of automated tests, ensuring automation is part of the definition of done for every feature.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership through framework design, prototypes, code reviews, automation implementation, and test-script development.
  • Mentor manual testers as they develop coding and automation skills, while defining metrics for coverage, stability, flakiness, execution time, and defect detection.
  • Communicate quality risks, automation progress, and investment needs while partnering with Product, Live Operations, Marketing, Customer Support, Localization, and external development teams.
  • Champion quality and release excellence across the organization while ensuring automation supports—not replaces—strong exploratory and risk-based testing.

What We’re Looking For

  • 8+ years of experience in QA, test automation, or quality engineering, including 4+ years leading or building automation teams.
  • Proven experience creating automation strategies, frameworks, tooling, and infrastructure for complex products, ideally from the ground up.
  • Experience evaluating automation approaches and tools, integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines, and scaling quality practices for frequent live releases.
  • Hands-on programming experience in one or more languages; C# preferred.
  • Strong understanding of testing methodologies, automation architecture, coding practices, testability, and software development lifecycles.
  • Experience mentoring manual testers in coding, automation, and automated test-script development.
  • Proven ability to align Engineering and QA around automation, shared quality ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Experience with mobile testing and familiarity with traditional and AI-assisted testing tools; game-testing experience preferred.
  • Experience with test management, defect tracking, source control, build systems, CI/CD, and release-management tools.
  • Strong communication, organization, analytical, stakeholder-management, and distributed-team leadership skills.

Bonus Points

  • Experience working on a live mobile, free-to-play, or core game.
  • Experience with mobile-device farms, emulators, simulators, or cloud-based device testing.
  • Experience testing Unity, Unreal, or other game-engine-based products.
  • Experience with API, backend-service, data, performance, load, or reliability automation.
  • Experience automating live events, remote configuration, experimentation, monetization, or service-driven game features.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered test generation, test maintenance, visual validation, defect triage, or code-assistance tools.
  • Experience establishing automation metrics, quality dashboards, and engineering quality gates.
  • Experience working across internal and external development partners.

 

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/. 

Notice to Candidates: Scopely will never request payment or financial information during the application or hiring process. Please apply only through our official website and verify that all Talent Partner communications come from an email address ending in @scopely.com.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

Employment at Scopely is based solely on a person's merit and qualifications. Scopely does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, creed, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity/expression, national origin, disability, age, genetic information, veteran status, marital status, pregnancy or related condition (including breastfeeding), or any other basis protected by law. We also consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.

job.title: AI Agent Tester - Real-World Tasks, Remote- Contract
job.description:
Role Title: AI Agent Tester — Real-World Tasks

Role Type: Contract

Location: U.S based

Required Skills:

  • ChatGPT

  • Muse

  • AI agents

  • Attention to Detail

  • Following Instructions

  • Screen Recording

Opportunity Snapshot:

  • Time per task: ~1.5 hours per run (evidence and scoring included)

  • Project kickoff: Already active.

  • Onboarding: Within 24–48 hours of being selected, you’ll receive the offer and complete onboarding. You’ll begin tasking as soon as tasks are assigned.

  • You’ll need: An active personal AI assistant account (Plus tier), active Muse and Dots access, a smartphone that can screen record, and a payment card you can use for test purchases that are reimbursed afterward

  • Your tasks: Run everyday errands with two AI agents, approve key steps, screen record, and score the results

About the role:

AI agents are starting to handle real-life errands: paying bills, booking trips, doing the groceries. We want to know how well they actually do it, from the point of view of a real user. That’s you. You’ll test two AI agents side by side, using your own accounts on your phone, and tell us what worked, what didn’t, and how it felt.

What you’ll do:

  • Run real-life scenarios: bills, returns, email follow-ups, bookings, shopping, groceries, travel, family logistics, outings, and forms

  • Approve or stop the agent at key steps

  • Screen record every attempt

  • Score each run on

  • completion, quality, control issues, satisfaction, and time

  • Share clear written feedback on the agent experience

Who we’re looking for:

  • US-based, with a Bachelor’s degree

  • Someone who already uses AI in daily life

  • 2-3 years of experience, preferably in engineering, business management, or office/operations

  • Detail-oriented, great at following instructions and documenting each step

  • Clear written communication

  • Generalists welcome, domain experts preferred

  • No coding or AI background needed

Why you’ll like it:

  • Get paid to use the AI tools you already use

  • Work entirely from your phone, on your schedule

  • Have a direct say in how next-generation AI agents get built and improved

About ELB Learning

At ELB Learning, you'll become an integral part of a team that delivers innovative learning solutions for organizations around the world.

Our Learning Experiences Team (LXT) creates custom learning experiences ranging from instructor-led training and eLearning to immersive simulations and virtual reality. We're looking for a detail-oriented Quality Assurance Specialist who is passionate about ensuring every learning experience meets the highest standards of quality before reaching our clients.

About the Role

As a Quality Assurance Specialist, you'll play a critical role in reviewing learning deliverables throughout the production process. You'll evaluate content for grammar, formatting, functionality, accessibility, audio quality, and adherence to client standards while working closely with Instructional Designers, Developers, Creative teams, and Project Managers.

Your attention to detail and ability to provide clear, actionable feedback will help ensure every deliverable meets ELB Learning's quality standards before client delivery.

Key Responsibilities

Language & Content Quality

  • Review outlines, design documents, storyboards, and completed courses for grammar, spelling, punctuation, formatting, and consistency.

  • Ensure deliverables align with client style guides, terminology, tone, and formatting requirements.

  • Verify that revisions from previous review cycles have been correctly implemented.

Audio Quality

  • Review narration and voiceover for pronunciation, pacing, timing, and quality.

  • Verify audio synchronization with on-screen content.

  • Identify audio issues requiring correction before client delivery.

Functional & Technical QA

  • Test navigation, buttons, links, interactions, branching logic, and assessments.

  • Ensure course functionality matches approved storyboards and design specifications.

Accessibility Compliance

  • Conduct accessibility reviews against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 standards.

  • Test keyboard navigation, screen reader compatibility, focus order, captions, transcripts, alt text, and color contrast.

  • Document findings and verify accessibility remediation.

Seat Time & Assessment Quality

  • Verify course seat time aligns with project requirements.

  • Ensure assessments and knowledge checks function correctly and align with learning objectives.

Process & Documentation

  • Document QA findings and communicate issues clearly to project teams.

  • Participate in Alpha and Beta review cycles.

  • Re-test resolved issues before final approval.

  • Escalate recurring quality concerns to appropriate leadership.

Required Qualifications

  • 2+ years of Quality Assurance experience within eLearning, instructional design, or digital content production.

  • Excellent written English with exceptional attention to grammar, spelling, and consistency.

  • Working knowledge of Articulate Storyline, Rise, or similar eLearning authoring tools.

  • Understanding of instructional design principles and terminology.

  • Experience reviewing content against WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA and Section 508 accessibility standards.

  • Experience testing screen readers, keyboard navigation, captions, transcripts, and color contrast.

  • Strong organizational skills with experience documenting issues and tracking resolutions.

  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience reviewing highly interactive eLearning, scenario-based learning, gamified content, simulations, or VR experiences.

  • Experience working with distributed production teams.

  • Previous production or instructional design experience.

Why Join ELB Learning?

Join a collaborative team committed to creating exceptional learning experiences for organizations worldwide. You'll work alongside talented instructional designers, developers, creatives, and strategists while helping ensure every learning solution meets the highest standards of quality before it reaches our clients.

job.title: Software Test Engineer
job.description:
Position Overview:

The Software Test Engineer (Mid-Level) is responsible for the overall quality of the Simr Platform, a web application that lets engineers run and manage their simulation workflows in the cloud. The platform has two main areas: the HPC side, where users run batch jobs and work in interactive sessions on HPC clusters, and the data side, where simulation results are ingested, processed, stored and made available for search, analysis and reporting through DataStudio, APIs and Jupyter notebooks.

While the role covers the platform as a whole, its main focus is the data side. The engineer is expected to understand the data workflows in depth, from simulation output files to queryable tables and reports, and to own their test planning, manual and automated testing, and data validation. Working closely with backend, data and frontend engineers, the engineer catches issues early and makes sure data features are released with confidence. The ideal candidate works independently on medium-complexity tasks, is comfortable with SQL and Python, and enjoys understanding how data moves through a modern, cloud-based system.

Responsibilities:

  • Plan, design and execute test cases for the Simr Platform, with a focus on data ingestion, processing, storage and reporting features.
  • Validate data end to end, from source files to what users see in the UI, APIs and reports, checking accuracy, completeness and consistency.
  • Test core HPC workflows of the platform, such as batch job submission and interactive sessions, as part of regression and release testing.
  • Use SQL and scripting to verify data and back-end behavior independently.
  • Test REST APIs and asynchronous/background processes, including error handling, retries and permissions.
  • Develop and maintain automated tests and integrate them into CI pipelines for regression and release testing.
  • Conduct performance tests for data-heavy scenarios and report the results.
  • Perform regression and release testing across different environments.
  • Investigate issues using logs, report bugs in JIRA with clear reproduction steps, and verify fixes.
  • Take part in requirement reviews and help define acceptance criteria.
  • Maintain test documentation (test plans, test cases, checklists, reports) and suggest process improvements.
  • Support junior QA engineers when needed.

Skills & Qualifications:

Must Have

  • Solid knowledge of software testing methodologies, test planning and test case design.
  • Good SQL skills for data validation.
  • Experience testing REST APIs (e.g., Postman or similar tools).
  • Programming experience in Python, Java or JavaScript for test automation (Python preferred).
  • Experience with test automation and running tests in CI pipelines.
  • Familiarity with Linux, version control (Git) and issue tracking tools (JIRA).

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with data pipelines, databases or big data tools (e.g., Airflow, Trino, Spark).
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP) and containers (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • UI test automation experience (Playwright, Selenium or similar).
  • Familiarity with Python data tools such as pandas or Jupyter.
  • Interest in engineering simulation software such as ABAQUS, ANSYS or
  • COMSOL, and familiarity with High Performance Computing (HPC).
  • ISTQB or other relevant certifications.

job.title: Quality Engineer, QA | Remote | 🇺🇸 US Startup Helping Frontline Workers 💙
job.description:
Company Overview
Our client is a fast-growing, venture-backed SaaS company helping frontline workers access life-changing benefits like childcare, elder care, and nutrition assistance. Their AI-powered platform connects employees to available government programs—cutting through complexity and delivering support where it matters most.

Used by major retailers, healthcare providers, and Fortune 500 companies, the product is trusted to handle sensitive workflows in regulated environments. The fully remote team is mission-driven, pragmatic, and growing quickly, with strong enterprise backing and a clear expansion path.

Your Role

This is not a “run the test plan someone else wrote” role. Until now, engineers have checked their own releases. The product has grown into a web app, connections to outside systems and AI chat features, so each release now needs someone who can say whether it’s ready, with evidence. New federal Medicaid rules start January 1, 2027, and the team is building tools that help states keep eligible people covered through them. You’ll start by building the automated tests and the ready-to-ship check for the releases closest to that date. It’s a hands-on, senior seat with no direct reports. You decide where the risk is, which team needs you most, and what “done” means.

You’ll:

  • Test strategy and automation

    • Decide where the product is most likely to break and what gets tested first

    • Build end-to-end journeys, a smoke suite on every build, and integration tests in code engineers review and keep

    • Pick the tools and run everything in GitHub Actions

  • Release verdicts

    • Give engineers a “ready / not ready” note before each release: what passed, what failed, what nobody checked

    • Write a plain-language summary for non-engineers of what’s verified, and push back on a risky date with evidence

  • Testing inside delivery teams

    • Sit with customer-facing teams and test features while they’re being built, moving between teams as workload shifts

    • Set a shared definition of “done” and coach engineers on testing their own work

  • Web app, services and outside systems

    • Run functional, regression and accessibility tests across browsers and devices, and check each customer’s configuration

    • Test APIs and asynchronous flows between services, and write contract tests for outside systems

    • Make sure the product behaves sensibly when a dependency is slow, down or returns wrong data

  • AI chat features

    • Build evaluation suites with golden datasets for chatbots and assistants, rerun them on every prompt or model change, and test guardrails

    • Use AI tools to write, maintain and triage tests

  • Test data and security

    • Seed realistic test data for a complex system, inside strict access and data-protection rules

    • Help find and fix security vulnerabilities in the app and its infrastructure

You Bring:

  • 5+ years in quality, test or software engineering, with automation you wrote yourself, running in CI and kept by other engineers

  • At least one test practice you built from a low baseline: you chose the tools, wrote the first suites, wired them into CI, and can explain what you left untested

  • Strong test code in Python or TypeScript across API, browser and pipeline, including headless browser runs and integration tests for failing dependencies

  • Experience testing business rules you had to learn first: you read the policy, found the gaps, and wrote tests from the answers

  • Experience as the only quality person across several teams, setting your own priorities with no backlog handed to you

  • Clear written updates for engineers and non-engineers alike, including the confidence to challenge a deadline with facts

What’s Offered

  • Fully remote across the U.S., with live collaboration during U.S. business hours

  • Full-time, permanent seat (about 40 hours a week)

  • Competitive USD compensation (bring your target to the first call)

  • Real authority: you define the testing strategy, the automation and what “good” looks like

  • An engineering buddy to help you get set up from day one

  • Direct impact: your work helps families get and keep the benefits they’re eligible for

job.title: Mid-level SDET (WFH)
job.description:
Work Arrangement:

  • Monday to Friday, 11:00 AM – 8:00 PM
  • Willingness to render overtime when necessary
  • Equipment will be provided by the company
  • Work-from-home setup effective immediately

Responsibilities:

  • Author and maintain automated UI and API tests (Playwright, TypeScript) covering the trading, custody, and customer-portal surfaces of the platform.
  • Work with agentic AI tools daily — planning tests, generating code, triaging failures, reviewing PRs — and critically verify everything an agent produces before it ships.
  • Triage nightly regression and smoke runs: separate genuine product bugs from environment noise and test-side defects, and file clear, well-evidenced bug reports that a developer outside your domain can act on.
  • Keep the suite honest: link failing tests to known bugs, release them when fixes land, and never let a silent skip or a warning-instead-of-failure hide a real defect.
  • Run and maintain suites in CI (GitHub Actions) and help keep the pipelines green, fast and trustworthy.
  • Keep test cases traceable in our test-case-management tooling.
  • Occasionally cross the test boundary and fix what you find: QA works in the same monorepo as the product, so small bug fixes and improvements to the application itself are yours to ship, through the same PR and review process the developers use.
  • Review teammates' test PRs — and respond to review findings on your own, including findings raised by AI reviewers — with evidence, not opinion.
  • Collaborate with developers, QA engineers, and product owners across a globally distributed team.

Requirements:

  • Hands-on experience in software testing, QA automation, or software development —typically 3 to 6 years relevant experience
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript, or clear evidence you can pick a language up quickly.
  • A solid grasp of how web applications and HTTP APIs work: requests and responses, status codes, JSON, authentication.
  • Genuine interest in AI-assisted engineering. You should be comfortable making AI tools do real work — and sceptical enough to check the output. If you already use AI assistants for real tasks, we'll want to hear how.
  • Excellent written English. In an agentic workflow, writing is the work: prompts, bug reports, test plans, and review comments all succeed or fail on clarity.
  • Attention to detail and honest reporting. A failing test you explain truthfully is worth more to us than a green one you can't.

Strong candidates usually bring several of the following — you don't need them all:

  • Hands-on experience with Playwright (or Cypress/Selenium).
  • Experience building or maintaining a shared test framework — fixtures, page objects, helpers, CI wiring — rather than only writing specs inside one.
  • Exposure to financial services, trading, or capital markets — order lifecycles, settlement, custody concepts.
  • WebSockets / real-time data, SQL/PostgreSQL, CI pipelines (GitHub Actions or similar).
  • Familiarity with digital assets or blockchain.

Nice to have:

  • Performance or load testing (k6, JMeter, or similar).

job.description:
Description

Keeper is hiring a talented Senior QA Analyst to join our Privileged Access Management (PAM) team, working closely with platform-level integrations that span Keeper Secrets Manager (KSM). This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of users and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help ensure the quality, reliability, and security of Keeper’s enterprise access management platform.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is transforming cybersecurity for organizations globally with zero-trust privileged access management built with end-to-end encryption. Keeper’s cybersecurity solutions are FedRAMP and StateRAMP Authorized, SOC 2 compliant, FIPS 140-2 validated, as well as ISO 27001, 27017 and 27018 certified. Keeper deploys in minutes, not months, and seamlessly integrates with any tech stack to prevent breaches, reduce help desk costs and ensure compliance. Trusted by millions of individuals and thousands of organizations, Keeper is the leader for password, passkey and secrets management, privileged access, secure remote access and encrypted messaging. Learn how our zero-trust and zero-knowledge solutions defend against cyber threats at .

About the Role

As a Senior QA Analyst focused on Privileged Access Management, you will validate complex workflows that span cloud infrastructure, identity providers, CI/CD systems, and enterprise operating environments. This role emphasizes integration testing, security-focused validation, and system-level quality across PAM and KSM capabilities, rather than isolated feature testing. You will design and execute comprehensive test strategies, analyze system behavior across environments, and collaborate closely with engineering, product, and security teams to ensure Keeper’s PAM platform meets high standards for reliability, interoperability, and security.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases for PAM and platform-level KSM integrations
  • Perform integration testing across cloud providers (AWS, Azure, GCP), IAM platforms (Okta, Ping Identity, Active Directory), and CI/CD systems (Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps)
  • Validate PAM functionality across Windows, Linux, databases, and hybrid infrastructure environments
  • Identify, document, and validate defects, collaborating with engineering and product teams to drive resolution
  • Execute security-focused validation workflows to ensure expected access controls, policy enforcement, and audit behaviors
  • Perform reliability, stress, and fault-tolerance testing for PAM services and workflows
  • Analyze logs, errors, and system behavior to diagnose failures and identify root causes
  • Contribute to automated test coverage in collaboration with engineering teams
  • Recommend improvements to enhance product usability, resilience, and security
  • Maintain clear documentation of testing procedures, results, and reproducible steps
  • Stay current with industry trends and best practices in privileged access and secrets management

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in QA or software testing, including at least 2 years focused on security, PAM, or infrastructure-oriented products
  • Strong understanding of PAM concepts, secrets management, and enterprise security practices
  • Experience testing integrations with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and CI/CD systems
  • Familiarity with IAM solutions such as Okta, Ping Identity, or Active Directory
  • Working knowledge of Windows and Linux operating systems
  • Ability to read and reason about code in languages such as Java, JavaScript, Python, Go, or .NET for validation purposes
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, QA, product, and security teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with secure software development and data protection practices
  • Experience with scripting languages or test automation frameworks
  • Experience working in Agile development environments

job.description:
Job Title: Quality Assurance Specialist

Location: South Africa

Job Type: Full-Time, Remote

Working Hours: US Hours (9am-5pm EST)

Salary: South African Rand (ZAR)

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct detailed quality assurance audits across clinical and operational processes
  • Review documentation, reports, and case materials to ensure accuracy, compliance, and adherence to healthcare standards
  • Utilize QA audit tools and platforms (including CentralReach) to evaluate performance and identify gaps
  • Interpret and apply healthcare regulations and standards across varying scenarios and cases
  • Provide clear, constructive feedback and recommendations for improvement
  • Analyze data using Excel and other tools to track trends, identify risks, and support decision-making
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to maintain and improve quality standards
  • Develop and refine QA processes, frameworks, and documentation
  • Translate complex findings into clear, concise, and actionable insights for stakeholders
  • Manage multiple audits and projects simultaneously using project management tools

Requirements

  • Previous experience in quality assurance, healthcare administration, compliance, auditing, or a similar role preferred.
  • Experience in ABA or healthcare is highly advantageous.
  • Excellent attention to detail and accuracy.
  • Strong organisational and time-management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Comfortable reviewing large amounts of information and identifying discrepancies.
  • Strong spreadsheet and computer skills.
  • Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling sensitive information.
  • Strong follow-through and accountability.
  • Ability to work independently and consistently meet deadlines.
  • Comfortable providing professional and constructive feedback to team members.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

Thinking of applying? Here's the inside scoop.

Let us walk you through the next steps.

Step 1 – Complete Your Application

Fill in our application form and upload your CV. This stores your profile in our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) and places you into our active job pipelines, making it easier for us to match you with current and future opportunities.

Step 2 – The First Look (One-Way Video Interview)

This is where your application comes to life. We review your CV and video interview to get a feel for your experience, communication style, and overall fit. If we like what we see, you're on to the next step!

Why do we ask for a video?

Because a résumé can tell us what you've done, but it can't show us you. Your video is your moment to shine, and it helps us see:

  • How you communicate and connect with people.
  • How you present yourself professionally.
  • Other opportunities you might be an even better fit for (bonus surprises!).

Think of it as your personal trailer. One great video means we can pitch you for multiple roles and get you in front of the right employers, faster.

Heads up: Some clients watch your video directly, so make it one you'd be proud to have represent you. This is your highlight reel—make it count!

Step 3 – Let's Actually Talk

A Recruitment Specialist calls to chat about your experience, your availability, what you want to earn, and the role itself. Consider it a friendly vibe check.

Step 4 – The Fine Print, Made Fun

We break down what it's like working as an independent contractor—hours, pay, contract terms, the whole deal. No surprises, no fine-print sneakiness. You'll get it all in writing.

Step 5 – Matchmaking Time

Our Talent Delivery Team plays cupid, matching you to clients where you're most likely to shine. We can't promise everyone gets picked, but we're rooting for you.

Step 6 – Showtime

Got shortlisted? We'll set up your interview, prep you like a pro, and have your back the whole way—with a Reworks teammate right there facilitating.

Step 7 – The Verdict

We chase feedback the second it lands and keep you in the loop.

Fraud Disclaimer: ReWorks Solutions will never request payment during recruitment or require in-person office visits. All official communication will come from a ReWorks Solutions email address. Please verify any suspicious messages with our team directly.
