job.title: Manager, FCC Monitoring & Testing, Americas
job.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

How you'll make impact

Airwallex is redesigning its Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) Program and second-line function, and this role will provide independent assurance that the program is designed and operating effectively. Reporting to the Director of FCC Monitoring, you’ll lead monitoring and testing across the Americas, helping Airwallex meet regulatory expectations as it grows into new products, regions, customer cohorts and licensing requirements.

  • Redesign and strengthen Airwallex’s FCC monitoring and testing approach across the Americas.

  • Build and deliver a regional assurance plan covering the US, Canada, Brazil and Mexico, aligned to local risk assessments, products, entities and regulatory expectations.

  • Map the control inventory to regional risk assessments, identify gaps in testing coverage by entity and product, and draft the annual testing plan around state examination cycles.

  • Use data analytics and AI thoughtfully to make monitoring and testing more proactive, efficient and auditable, while documenting methodologies, evidence and conclusions clearly.

  • Partner with local and regional MLROs, FCC Operations, Product, the VP of FCC, regulators, banking partners and senior leadership to assess control effectiveness and support expansion into new products, regions, customer cohorts and licensing requirements.

  • Establish strong working relationships across a new global function, operating independently across multiple time zones and contributing to a future-ready FCC Program.

This remote role is based in Dallas

What we're looking for

Essentials

  • Deep understanding of global AML and Sanctions frameworks, including regulatory expectations across the US regions.

  • Proven experience in program monitoring and testing, with evidence of enhancing the effectiveness of a financial crime compliance program.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to engage senior executives, regulators and global business leaders on complex financial crime risk matters.

  • Experience operating in a second-line financial crime compliance, risk or assurance function, with the independence and judgment to assess program effectiveness.

  • Strong understanding of sanctions oversight and its role within an FCC Program.

  • Ability to work autonomously, manage your own workload and deliver high-quality, well-documented work across multiple jurisdictions and time zones.

  • Experience using data analytics, automation or AI-enabled approaches to improve monitoring, testing or assurance methodologies.

Preferred

  • Experience working with or supporting Group MLRO, Regional MLRO or Country MLRO functions, including governance committees, regulatory engagements and risk oversight activities.

  • Risk and controls experience.

You'll thrive here if

  • You're comfortable owning the roadmap yourself.

  • You're comfortable making decisions with incomplete information and moving quickly anyway.

  • You hold yourself to a high standard even when no one is watching. Quality and accountability aren't external expectations; they're internal ones.

  • You enjoy working closely with people across multiple countries and time zones as part of one connected, global team, including flexing your hours occasionally to make that connection work.

  • You come to the table with a point of view, not just a problem.

Learn more about your team

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. job.title: Test Manager, Professional Services
job.description:
Our world is transforming, and PTC is leading the way. Our software brings the physical and digital worlds together, enabling companies to improve operations, create better products, and empower people in all aspects of their business.

Our people make all the difference in our success. Today, we are a global team of nearly 7,000 and our main objective is to create opportunities for our team members to explore, learn, and grow – all while seeing their ideas come to life and celebrating the differences that make us who we are and the work we do possible.

PTC is seeking an experienced Test Manager to join our Professional Services organization. In this role, you will lead quality assurance, test strategy, validation planning, and test execution for customers implementing PTC solutions.

You will work closely with customers, project managers, and delivery teams to ensure solutions are validated against business, regulatory, and technical requirements. You will help customers improve product quality, reduce delivery risk, accelerate time-to-value, and establish scalable testing and quality management practices.


Key Responsibilities

Test Strategy & Governance

  • Define and govern end-to-end test strategies for customer implementations.
  • Establish testing frameworks, methodologies, standards, tooling, and best practices.
  • Develop risk-based testing approaches aligned with customer objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Ensure traceability among requirements, risks, test cases, defects, and validation evidence.

Quality Planning & Delivery

job.title: Automated Test Engineer, Manager (Remote US)
job.description:
ICF is seeking an Automated Test Engineer, Manager to support a Federal Government agency client. You will help deliver reliable cloud applications, data services, and AI-enabled capabilities across an enterprise data lakehouse platform.

You will build and maintain automated tests, integrate them into continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, and provide evidence that releases meet acceptance criteria. Working with developers and business analysts, you will help continue building the maturity of the Playwright testing suite and expand testing across application workflows and supporting data services.


Job Location – Remote within the US; Must be able to support EST hours


What You Will Do

  • Manage and mentor the Automated Test Team, strengthen team coverage, and provide strategic direction and preparation that identify risks, gaps, and dependencies earlier. Ask proactive questions and develop deep, end-to-end expertise in the testing tools and platform.
  • Extend and maintain the existing Playwright/Cucumber framework using the Page Object Model, and recommend improvements as the platform evolves.
  • Design, develop, and maintain reusable automated functional, integration, and regression tests for application workflows and supporting services, including APIs where applicable.
  • Design strategy for switching roles in pipelined automated test jobs and provide guidance for application/ops teams toward support of those patterns.
  • Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines, publish actionable results, and troubleshoot unreliable tests to support repeatable execution and release quality gates.
  • Plan and collaborate on the implementation of AI-assisted testing and/or code review.
  • Translate user stories and acceptance criteria into traceable test scenarios, including negative cases, role-based access, and dependencies across workstreams; prioritize automation by risk and business impact.
  • Partner with data engineers to automate validation of ingestion, transformations, and migration results, checking data completeness, accuracy, and consistency across source and target systems.
  • Implement performance tests and collaborate with security specialists to integrate automated security checks, investigate findings, and verify fixes before release.
  • Maintain controlled test data and repeatable test setup; diagnose failures, document reproducible defects, and work with developers to resolve issues and verify corrections.
  • Support user acceptance testing and accessibility verification by preparing regression evidence and coordinating automated checks with required manual validation.
  • Report test coverage, execution results, defects, and release risks against agreed quality criteria; collaborate with developers on critical-service unit coverage and documented exceptions
  • Track defect rates and trends to ensure that changes to testing posture results in measurable improvements.
  • Plan and execute testing across development, test, staging, and production-like environments, validating environment readiness, configuration consistency, integrations, and successful promotion through release gates.
  • Guide strategy for ensuring adequate fixture data and resources in lower environments.
  • Participate in functional testing with business analysts, product owners, and users to validate end-to-end workflows, confirm expected outcomes, document defects, and verify resolutions.
  • Participate in Agile planning, reviews, and retrospectives; maintain version-controlled test documentation and improve the automation approach as the platform evolves.

What You Will Bring With You

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining automated test suites, preferably with Playwright and TypeScript, including reusable test components (Page Object Model), selector strategy for dynamic UIs, and failure diagnosis.
  • 5+ years of demonstrated experience writing, debugging, and reviewing test automation code in TypeScript or Javascript.
  • Experience writing Gherkin feature files and reusable step definitions with Cucumber or a comparable BDD framework. Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and managing test code through version control and peer review.
  • Experience deriving functional, integration, and regression tests from requirements and acceptance criteria, documenting defects, and verifying fixes within an Agile delivery team.
  • Experience validating data-driven application behavior and using test evidence to identify quality issues and assess release readiness.
  • U.S. Citizenship required due to federal contract requirements.
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a federal public trust or equivalent client-required background investigation.
  • Candidate must reside in the U.S., be authorized to work in the U.S., and all work must be performed in the U.S.
  • Candidate must have lived in the U.S. for three (3) full years out of the last five (5) years

What We Would Like You To Bring With You

  • 2+ years experience acting as a Test Team Lead
  • Experience establishing test architecture for a new or modernized application.
  • Experience testing Azure applications or data workflows involving Databricks, familiarity with Python or SQL for data validation.
  • Experience with Jira, Confluence, and Scaled Agile Framework
  • Familiarity with Section 508 and WCAG accessibility testing, including the complementary roles of automated checks and manual evaluation.
  • Experience validating AI-enabled search, document processing, or natural language workflows against defined evaluation criteria.
  • Experience supporting federal modernization programs and producing test evidence for governance, acceptance, or compliance reviews.

Professional Skills

  • Communicate defects, test results, and release risks clearly to technical teams and business stakeholders.
  • Organize testing across concurrent workstreams and proactively identify dependencies and blockers.
  • Apply sound judgment to prioritize automation and investigate underlying causes of test failures.
  • Collaborate across disciplines and take ownership of assigned testing activities through resolution.

Bot and Third-Party Applications

Overview

The Quality Assurance (QA) Manager will lead the development and implementation of a sustainable, scalable quality assurance process for the Enrollment Services department.

This process will establish consistent standards for prospective-student interactions and align enrollment practices with organizational expectations, partner agreements, program requirements, and applicable laws and regulations. The QA Manager will translate findings into measurable improvements across the student recruitment and enrollment lifecycle. In close partnership with Enrollment Leadership, Training and Development, and Enrollment Operations, the manager will identify skill and process gaps, strengthen coaching effectiveness, and promote an ethical, accessible, student-centered culture of continuous improvement.

Responsibilities

Quality Program Leadership

  • Lead the design, implementation, and maintenance of a scalable educational quality assurance framework aligned with organizational standards, university-partner requirements, program-specific expectations, and enrollment communication channels.
  • Establish, maintain, and continuously improve evaluation standards, sampling methodologies, and QA documentation, including scorecards.
  • Review enrollment interactions and records for quality, accuracy, student experience, policy adherence, and regulatory compliance.
  • Lead department-wide calibration and alignment efforts to ensure consistent scoring standards and uniform application of evaluation tools, scorecards, and supporting documentation.
  • Communicate findings objectively and foster a culture of learning, accountability, ethical conduct, and consistent student service.

Training Partnership and Skill Development

  • Identify performance, process, and compliance gaps through QA findings and partner with Enrollment Leadership and Training and Development to develop targeted, role-based solutions.
  • Provide trainers with evaluation insights, behavioral examples, and subject-matter support while maintaining confidentiality.

Analytics, Reporting, and Continuous Improvement

  • Analyze quality, compliance, conversion, student-experience, and operational data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities.
  • Monitor quality KPIs and thresholds and promptly escalate results outside established tolerances.
  • Lead cross-functional improvements and advise on quality impacts of changes to systems, workflows, communications, policies, and program launches.
  • Other duties, as assigned.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Education, Quality Management, Organizational Development, or a related field.
  • Three or more years of progressive experience in educational quality assurance, including experience operating within university-partner governance and compliance requirements.
  • Three or more years of experience leading people, programs, or cross-functional initiatives.
  • Demonstrated experience developing scorecards, conducting audits or evaluations, leading calibration and performing root-cause analysis.
  • Experience using dashboards and performance reporting tools to communicate quality trends and business insights.
  • Experience with Salesforce Education Cloud, Omnichannel, quality-monitoring, speech or text analytics, or third-party education technology platforms.
  • Ability to manage confidential information, competing priorities, and sensitive issues with sound judgment and integrity.
  • Flexibility to work evenings and weekends, as needed.
  • Ability to travel, on average 1-2 times per year.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of relevant privacy, consumer-communication, accessibility, records-retention, and higher-education compliance concepts, including FERPA and applicable calling and texting requirements.
  • Experience translating quality findings into training content, coaching priorities, or competency-development plans.

job.title: Ecosystem QA Lead
job.location: Belgrade, Serbia; Berlin, Germany; Limassol, Cyprus; Madrid, Spain; Munich, Germany; Paphos, Cyprus; Prague, Czech Republic; Warsaw, Poland; Yerevan, Armenia
job.description:
You’re the kind of person who looks at a complex, deeply interconnected system and immediately wants to know how it functions and what would make it break. Focused on finding more than just bugs, you want to untangle dependencies and raise the bar for quality across the board. You're comfortable stepping up to take ownership and lead the charge when things get complicated.

About JetBrains

We create intelligent software development tools for developers and teams. More than 15 million users, over 300,000 companies, and 88 of the Fortune Global Top 100 rely on our products to solve real, complex problems. Our mission is simple: make development teams more productive and AI adoptable at scale.

What you’ll do

DataGrip is our cross-platform IDE for databases, and its core functionality powers database tools across other JetBrains IDEs like IntelliJ IDEA, PyCharm, and PhpStorm. Because of the large size of this ecosystem, which spans many database systems, environments, and integrations, keeping our quality bar high is a complex, strategic challenge. You’ll take ownership of quality across these shared components and release processes. You’ll work closely with developers, DevOps, and product teams to map out expected behaviors, investigate hard-to-reproduce issues, and improve how we build and test. Your work will directly influence the reliability of tools used by millions of developers every day, making sure changes in one area don't unexpectedly break another.

Day to day, you will:

  • Lead QA activities, set priorities, and coordinate testing efforts across multiple teams and components.
  • Investigate unclear, poorly reproducible, and cross-component issues to find the root cause.
  • Analyze logs, test results, and user reports to spot broader quality patterns behind individual failures.
  • Define test strategies and apply risk-based testing to manage release cycles safely.
  • Work with developers and product teams to establish expected behavior when detailed specifications aren't available.
  • Improve our QA processes and guide the team in making confident release decisions.

What you’ll bring

  • A high degree of independence and technical curiosity.
  • Comfort taking ownership of complex problems and driving them to resolution.
  • The ability to see the big picture and understand how changes in one area affect the rest of the system.
  • A proactive approach to improving processes rather than just following them.
  • Strong analytical thinking, with the ability to turn scattered logs and user reports into clear insights.
  • The communication skills to bring different teams together and coordinate testing efforts smoothly.

What you’ll need

  • The proven ability to test complex, multi-component systems and navigate integration and end-to-end testing.
  • Practical knowledge of relational databases and SQL.
  • Experience leading QA activities and shaping test strategies for multiple products and release cycles.
  • Familiarity with reading and debugging code (Java or Kotlin preferred) to troubleshoot deeply embedded issues.
  • Hands-on experience writing or maintaining automated tests.
  • The ability to navigate and troubleshoot CI/CD systems, test environments, and infrastructure (such as Docker, Kubernetes, or TeamCity).
  • Experience investigating distributed systems, APIs, and service-to-service integrations using monitoring and logging tools.

What success looks like

Within your first few months, you’ll have a firm grasp of the DataGrip ecosystem and how its components interact across our IDEs. You’ll be independently identifying quality risks, setting clear testing priorities, and helping teams ship reliable releases without bottlenecks. Long-term, you’ll have established smoother QA workflows, making it easier for everyone to understand dependencies and catch cross-product issues before they reach our users.

Why join JetBrains?

  • Strong base salary. We offer competitive pay that reflects your skills and experience.
  • Flexible work schedule. Enjoy the freedom to work from home or from the office.
  • Extra time off. More days to relax, recharge, and do the things you love.
  • Learning and development opportunities. Access to conferences, courses, and language classes.
  • Relocation support. Assistance to help make your move as smooth and stress-free as possible.
  • Free meals and snacks. Lunch and refreshments provided to keep you fueled.
  • Health and wellness. On-site gyms or sports club stipends.
  • Internal events. Company-wide celebrations and team gatherings.

*Some benefits may vary depending on location.

#LI-DNI 

We are an equal opportunity employer

We know great ideas can come from anyone, anywhere. That’s why we do our best to create an open and inclusive workplace – one that welcomes everyone regardless of their background, identity, religion, age, accessibility needs, or orientation.

We process the data provided in your job application in accordance with the Recruitment Privacy Policy.

job.title: Director, Enterprise Quality Engineering and Agentic Evaluation
job.description:
Company Description

Zayo provides mission-critical bandwidth to the world’s most impactful companies, fueling the innovations that are transforming our society. Zayo’s 141,000-mile network in North America and Europe includes extensive metro connectivity to thousands of buildings and data centers. Zayo’s communications infrastructure solutions include dark fiber, private data networks, wavelengths, Ethernet, and dedicated Internet access. Zayo serves wireless and wireline carriers, media, tech, content, finance, healthcare and other large enterprises.

We are seeking an experienced Director, Enterprise Quality Engineering and Agentic Evaluation to build and lead a modern enterprise quality capability across Zayo’s technology organization. This role will be accountable for improving the reliability, predictability, and speed of technology delivery while providing independent assurance for critical business platforms, transformational programs, and AI-enabled solutions.

The successful candidate will combine deep quality engineering expertise with strong enterprise leadership, bringing a risk-based, automation-first approach to how quality is embedded across the software delivery lifecycle. The role will also shape how Zayo evaluates and governs emerging agentic AI capabilities, ensuring they are reliable, controlled, and ready for enterprise-scale adoption.


This is a highly collaborative and transformational leadership role, partnering across Engineering, Product, Architecture, Data and AI, Operations, and business teams to strengthen quality outcomes, reduce production risk, and establish a culture of measurable engineering excellence.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead Zayo’s enterprise quality engineering strategy, operating model, roadmap, service catalog, standards, and governance.
  • Own the enterprise quality engineering platform, including Tosca, qTest, automation assets, integrations, test execution infrastructure, quality reporting, and AI-evaluation capabilities.
  • Establish risk-based quality models, release-readiness criteria, quality gates, certification standards, and evidence requirements for critical platforms, business processes, integrations, data products, and AI agents.
  • Lead a centralized quality engineering service that plans, automates, executes, and governs testing across enterprise products, platforms, programs, and high-risk releases.
  • Develop reusable automation frameworks, model-based testing patterns, API and integration testing capabilities, regression suites, and continuous testing practices aligned to business risk and production impact.
  • Establish enterprise capabilities for AI-agent evaluation, including scenario design, evaluation datasets, regression testing, tool-use validation, policy and permission checks, human escalation criteria, and production quality monitoring.
  • Own the enterprise approach to test data, test environments, service virtualization, production validation, and quality analytics to reduce release risk and delivery delays.
  • Provide independent quality intelligence and release-risk assessments to engineering, product, program, and executive stakeholders.
  • Manage vendor-outsourced quality engineering resources, Tricentis partners, systems integrators, and specialist testing providers to deliver sustained enterprise quality outcomes.
  • Build a quality engineering culture focused on automation, objective assurance, reuse, engineering discipline, measurable outcomes, and continuous improvement.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Mathematics, or a related discipline; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Minimum of twelve (12) years of experience in quality engineering, software testing, test automation, platform engineering, enterprise technology delivery, or related technology disciplines, including 5+ years leading quality engineering, test automation, enterprise testing, or platform-oriented teams.
  • Demonstrated experience building or leading modern quality engineering capabilities beyond manual test execution, including automation strategy, risk-based testing, continuous testing, quality gates, and release assurance.
  • Strong experience with enterprise test automation and test management platforms, preferably Tricentis Tosca and qTest.
  • Experience leading testing or quality engineering across multiple products, platforms, business processes, programs, or business units.
  • Strong understanding of API, integration, data, workflow, cloud, event-driven, distributed-system, performance, resilience, and production validation testing.
  • Practical knowledge of generative AI, large language models, retrieval, AI agents, tool calling, evaluation methods, and responsible AI testing practices.
  • Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, vendor management, financial management, organizational leadership, and decision-making skills.

Estimated base salary range: $126,600 - $194,700 USD/annually.

Work Authorization Requirement: This position is not eligible for employment-based visa sponsorship. Zayo will not provide, transfer, or assume sponsorship for any employment visa or work authorization for this position now or in the future.


The base pay range shown is a guideline and reasonable estimate for this role. It takes into account the wide variety of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions. Actual compensation offered may vary from the posted range based upon geographic location, work experience, skill level, certifications, and other business and organizational needs. Non- sales roles may be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive plan. Sales roles may be eligible to participate in a sales incentive plan.


Additionally, this position may be eligible for certain benefits, such as health insurance, life insurance, disability retirement plans, paid time off.


The posting will be active for a minimum of 3 days. The active posting will continue to extend by 3 days until the position is filled.


Benefits, Rewards & Wellness

  • Excellent Health, Dental & Vision Insurance
  • Retirement 401(k) Savings Plan
  • Generous paid time off policy including paid parental leave

Zayo is an equal opportunity employer to all protected groups, including protected veterans and individuals with disabilities. If you are an individual with a disability and would like to request a reasonable accommodation as part of the employment selection process, please contact us.


This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.


As part of the application, hiring, onboarding, and/or employment process, Zayo or its affiliates, partners, and vendors may collect, store, and use biometric identifiers and biometric information (collectively, “Biometric Data”), such as fingerprints, facial geometry scans or other unique biological characteristics. Zayo uses CLEAR1, a third-party identity verification service, to verify applicant identity during the hiring process. CLEAR1 may collect Biometric Data, including facial geometry scans and/or other biometric identifiers, to authenticate your identity. Biometric Data will be retained pursuant to CLEAR1’s policies, which can be found here: Zayo will not sell, lease, trade, or otherwise profit from any applicant's or employee's Biometric Data. By proceeding with your application, you acknowledge this disclosure. Prior to any collection of Biometric Data — including through CLEAR — you may be presented with a separate consent form and asked to provide your written authorization in accordance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including the Illinois Biometric Information Privacy Act (BIPA), the Texas Capture or Use of Biometric Identifier Act (CUBI), and other applicable biometric privacy statutes.

job.title: Freelance Software Tester for Payments testing (Remote in Germany & the Netherlands)
job.description:
Hi there! We are Testlio, a global software testing company with its own freelance network. Our freelancers test apps from companies across the globe. Testlio is a great place for people who value the freedom and flexibility of remote work.

At the moment, we are looking for freelance software testers based in Germany & the Netherlands to participate in a moderated Usability study for one of our clients, a global financial technology company. More specifically, you will be a great fit for this study if you regularly send money to India and have experience using money transfer apps to send funds to India/ Indian Bank accounts. We're very interested in hearing your feedback, as this will help our client improve their own app, further impacting thousands of global customers. 

Benefits of being a freelancer at Testlio

  • Schedule: You can create your schedule and work on other testing runs that interest you.
  • Location: Testlio is a 100% remote company. Seriously, you can work from the coffee shop, your home, or while waiting for class.
  • Growth: You’ll be testing global-scale mobile apps and have the chance to boost your skills and grow your career.
  • Payment: You are paid by the hour, not by the bug. This means you get paid even if you did not uncover any bugs.

Requirements

  • Age: You have to be at least 18 years old.
  • Location: Must be physically located in Germany or the Netherlands. The use of a VPN is prohibited.
  • Language: Must at least be comfortable speaking English. Some knowledge of German and Dutch is also ideal. 
  • Availability: 1.5 hours needed for the study.
  • Devices: Laptop/ PC + iPhone/ Android Phone.
  • Experience: Digitally sending money to people in India/Indian bank accounts.
  • App Usage: Have never used the Wise app before. 

What does testing look like?

  • Type of testing: Moderated Usability study.
  • Type of work: One time study. This is not a recurring project. 
  • Type of test: You will meet 1:1 with a Testlio UX Researcher at a specified time for a live remote video call with your camera on and share your device's screen to complete your testing.
    Task Description: During the live testing session, you will be asked about how you currently send money from your country to India, including the services and methods you typically use. Then, you will make a real money transfer of about $20 using the application we are testing and share your thoughts and feedback as you go. We are interested in understanding what feels clear or unclear, what you expect throughout the experience, and your overall impressions.
    • About the Money Transfer: The $20 you will send will during the test will be to one of our trusted Test Leads. They will send the money back to you within ~1 business day to your paypal account.
      Recording: Please note we will be recording this live testing session for research and analysis purposes. We will redact any sensitive PII information.
  • Pay rate: $100 USD.
  • Payment: Payment will be made via PayPal or Payoneer.

How to start?

  1. Fill out the questionnaire. A member of our Recruitment Team will contact you with the next steps via email. 
  2. If you are not a match with our requirements visit our Community page instead to find out more about how you can participate in other projects. 

If you have any questions or need help, please contact Opportunities@testlio.com using the code INDIAPAYMENTS in the Subject line/email body so we can quickly identify your request. 

Once you are ready, please fill out the initial application below. Those who meet the requirements will receive further information to participate in this paid testing opportunity.

job.title: RCM Quality Assurance & Compliance Specialist
job.description:
About AdvantixxRCM

AdvantixxRCM is a healthcare revenue-cycle management company supporting medical practices and healthcare organizations with accurate, compliant, and service-focused billing operations. Our culture values ethical billing, patient-conscious service, accuracy, ownership, respectful collaboration, continuous improvement, privacy, security, and speaking up.

Team members protect confidential patient and client information, use only authorized systems, and follow company, client, payer, HIPAA, and applicable legal requirements. AdvantixxRCM is an equal opportunity employer.

RCM Quality Assurance & Compliance Specialist

This role audits revenue-cycle work, identifies operational and compliance risk, and helps teams prevent errors before they affect patients, clients, payers, or collections.

Responsibilities

  • Audit claims, account notes, coding-related workflows, eligibility, authorization, payment posting, A/R, denials, and client reports against approved standards.
  • Track error rates, root causes, corrective actions, and repeat findings; maintain defensible audit documentation.
  • Review adherence to payer, client, HIPAA, privacy, security, minimum-necessary, ethical-billing, and company requirements.
  • Escalate suspected overbilling, underbilling, false documentation, improper access, conflicts, retaliation, privacy incidents, or other misconduct immediately.
  • Support training, SOP improvements, calibration, quality dashboards, and corrective-action follow-up.
  • Preserve evidence and cooperate with lawful internal, client, payer, and regulatory reviews.

Qualifications

  • Two or more years of healthcare RCM, billing, coding, denial, audit, compliance, or quality experience preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of claims, EOB/ERA review, payer requirements, documentation standards, and common revenue-cycle risks.
  • Excellent analytical judgment, attention to detail, written communication, and discretion.
  • CPC, CPB, CRCR, CHC, auditing, or related credential preferred but not required unless stated in an offer.

Independence and Non-Retaliation

The specialist must report findings objectively and must not alter, suppress, backdate, or conceal records. Good-faith reporting and participation in reviews are protected from retaliation. The role has no authority to provide legal advice or bind AdvantixxRCM or a client.

Performance

Success includes audit accuracy, timely escalation, corrective-action closure, repeat-error reduction, documentation quality, training effectiveness, and protection of patient, client, payer, and company information.

Employment Notice

This is a full-time U.S. employee opportunity with remote eligibility. Final classification, schedule, location, compensation, and benefits will be stated in the written offer. Employment is contingent on applicable identity, work-authorization, background, credential, and reference verification and required agreements. AdvantixxRCM is an equal opportunity employer.

job.title: Lead Software Test Engineer, Safety Critical Embedded Systems
job.description:
About Forterra

At Forterra, we are unleashing autonomy at scale to transform the battlefield. Our mission is to build the foundational platforms that enable an intelligent ecosystem to coordinate, adapt, and execute with speed and precision even in the uncertainty and disruption of modern conflict. In an era marked by rapid technological change and evolving threats, we design for flexibility, survivability, and operational dominance.

Forterra delivers weapons, sensors, and battlefield effects through integrated autonomous networks reaching operational areas faster, safer, and without placing human lives at risk. Our systems operate with distributed control, dynamic routing, and real-time responsiveness, enabling sustained advantage across complex mission environments.

About the role

Forterra is looking for a Lead Software Test Engineer to establish and run verification and validation for the safety critical embedded software used on our autonomous ground vehicles. This is initially an individual contributor role. You will set the software test approach, build the automation and test environments, execute the work, and maintain the evidence needed for customer and safety reviews. You will work closely with software, systems, and safety engineers to find problems early and make sure the software behaves correctly when things go wrong. As the capability grows, the role may develop into a technical lead for a small test team

Someone who can build a practical software test capability from the ground up and is comfortable working directly in the code, test environments, and evidence. This person should be able to work across software, systems, and safety engineering while staying focused on finding meaningful failures and making the product more dependable

What you'll do

  • Set the verification and validation approach for safety critical embedded software from kickoff through qualification, including the test plan, test procedures, results, and reports.
  • Turn system, software, and safety related requirements into practical tests with objective pass or fail criteria.
  • Maintain traceability between requirements, tests, results, and anomalies.
  • Build and maintain automated test frameworks for embedded software, including software in the loop and hardware in the loop environments.
  • Exercise failure behavior through fault injection, timing and jitter tests, communications failures, memory faults, power and clock faults, negative tests, boundary tests, and stress tests.
  • Use static analysis, dynamic analysis, and coverage results to find gaps and help the team close them.
  • Prepare and maintain test evidence, including plans, procedures, results, V&V matrices, compliance matrices, anomaly records, tool qualification records, and contributions to the safety case.
  • Work with software, systems, and safety engineers to review designs for testability, improve requirements, and support technical reviews and assessments.
  • Provide technical guidance through test plan reviews, design reviews, pairing, and mentoring.
  • Help establish the practices and infrastructure needed to grow a small software test capability.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field. Equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Five or more years of experience testing embedded systems or safety critical software.
  • Strong working knowledge of C or C++ and Python for test automation.
  • Experience working with requirements management and requirements traceability using tools such as Jama or DOORS.
  • Familiarity with MISRA C or MISRA C++, static analysis, and structural coverage methods such as branch coverage and MC/DC.
  • Experience testing software on an RTOS such as QNX, including work with embedded targets, debuggers, and instrumentation.
  • Strong troubleshooting skills and the ability to separate hardware, software, and firmware problems in a complex system.
  • A practical, organized approach to managing several priorities and producing clear technical documentation.
  • Ability to work remotely with up to 25% travel

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience applying safety critical development and assurance standards such as ISO 26262, IEC 61508,
  • DO-178C, MIL-STD-882E, JSSSEH, or JS-SSA-IG.
  • Experience with QNX, Linux, NXP S32G, or similar embedded platforms.
  • Experience with CAN, CAN-FD, Ethernet, UDS, J1939, or other vehicle networks and diagnostic protocols.
  • Understanding of robotics domains such as motion control, planning, perception, fault management, and vehicle interfaces.
  • Experience integrating electromechanical systems in automotive, aerospace, medical, industrial, defense, or similar environments.
  • Experience providing technical leadership through design reviews, mentoring, or improvements to shared test and development practices.

US Salary Range

$125,000.00.—$150,000.00 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate and is based on a wide variety of compensation factors. The salary offered to candidates will vary based on a variety of factors including (but not limited to) relevant work experience, education, specialized training, critical expertise, training, and more. Equity in Forterra is included in most of our full-time, high-demand roles and is therefore considered part of Forterra’s overall compensation package. In addition to base salary and equity, Forterra offers competitive benefits for full-time employees including:

  • Premium Healthcare Benefits: Three plan options, including an HSA-eligible plan, with Forterra covering 80% of the plan premium for you and your dependents.
  • Basic Life/AD&D, short and long-term disability insurance plans 100% covered by Forterra, plus the option to purchase additional life insurance for you and your dependents.
  • Extremely generous company holiday calendar including a winter break in December.
  • Competitive paid time off (PTO) offering 20 days accrued per year.
  • A minimum of 7 weeks fully paid parental leave for birth/adoption.
  • A $9k annual tuition reimbursement or professional development stipend.
  • Fully stocked beverage refrigerators with all the Celsius your little heart desires.
  • 401(k) retirement savings plan, including traditional, Roth 401(k), and after-tax deferral with company match up to 4%.

Your recruiter will be able to share more information about our salary and benefits offering during the hiring process.

CLEARANCE ELIGIBILITY - This position may require eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. security clearance. For more information about U.S. Security Clearances: click here. 

Forterra is an equal-opportunity employer, providing and promoting equal employment opportunity in all personnel practices. Forterrans are unique, talented individuals who are united through a shared passion to deliver autonomous systems that enable national resilience and a robust supply chain.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any factor, including veteran and disability status, and criminal history, in accordance with applicable local, state, and federal laws.

Forterra is also committed to working with and providing reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities. Please let your recruiter know if you need an accommodation at any point during the interview process.

To see Forterra’s candidate data privacy policy, please visit Forterra Legal | Job Applicant Privacy Notice.

Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET) to join our Keeper Secrets Manager (KSM) team. Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations, globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and is sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help ensure the quality, reliability, and security of Keeper’s secrets management platform.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at .

About the Job

As a SDET on the KSM team, you will design, build, and scale automated test systems that validate the APIs, SDKs, and integrations powering Keeper Secrets Manager. You will focus on automation framework design, CI/CD integration, and system-level validation for secure, cloud-native services, rather than manual test execution. You will work closely with software engineers and DevOps teams, influence automation strategy, and help raise the bar for quality engineering across the KSM platform.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain automation frameworks using tools such as Playwright and Pytest

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience in test automation or software development in test
  • Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as Python or JavaScript/TypeScript
  • Proven experience owning the design and evolution of automation frameworks or test systems
  • Hands-on experience with automation frameworks such as Playwright or Pytest
  • Experience testing APIs, SDKs, and backend services in cloud environments (AWS preferred)
  • Strong experience integrating automation into CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Understanding of secure authentication concepts (SSO, OAuth, SAML)
  • Strong debugging, analytical, and cross-team collaboration skills
  • Due to this role’s involvement in FedRAMP-compliant environments, candidates must be a U.S. Person.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing secrets management, security, or DevOps platforms
  • Familiarity with RESTful or GraphQL APIs
  • Exposure to performance or load testing
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

About the Role

High 5 Games is seeking a dedicated QA Engineer to help us build the next generation of land-based, online, mobile, and social games. We are looking for an outstanding software tester who thrives on hunting down bugs, has a keen eye for a flawless user experience, and possesses a genuine passion for the gaming industry.

As our QA Engineer, you will act as the final gatekeeper for our releases, going beyond surface-level checks to deeply analyze game logic, mechanics, and client/server backend systems. Collaborating directly with developers and designers in an Agile environment, you will be trusted with sensitive, pre-release game data—making absolute integrity, discretion, and reliability essential to your success.

Responsibilities

  • Game Analysis & Test Execution: Deeply analyze slot game mechanics and features to identify potential flaws. Write and execute thorough test plans and creative test cases, ensuring coverage of complex scenarios and edge cases that standard testing might miss.
  • Root Cause Analysis & Debugging: Analyze historical data, crash logs, and backtraces using basic debugging techniques to help engineers categorize and identify the root causes of issues.
  • Cross-Platform UI/UX QA: Ensure the user interface is top-notch by performing rigorous mobile (iOS/Android) and cross-browser testing for a seamless player experience.
  • Backend Verification: Conduct robust API and Database (DB) testing to ensure secure, accurate data flow, wallet transactions, and seamless server integrations.
  • Agile Collaboration: Participate actively in our Agile development cycle and stand-ups, working proactively with cross-functional teams to resolve issues early in the process.
  • Bug Tracking & Adaptability: Identify, isolate, and document complex bugs clearly in a fast-paced environment that often requires frequent shifts in focus. Manage your workflow to meet strict production deadlines without compromising quality.

Requirements

  • Education & Experience: Bachelor’s Degree (or equivalent experience) with a minimum of 5 years of hands-on QA testing experience in the software or gaming industry.
  • Slot Game Expertise: Proven experience testing slot games (understanding RNG, paylines, bonus features) and a passion for casino and social/mobile gaming.
  • Core Technical QA: Demonstrable experience in API testing (e.g., Postman, REST Assured), Database testing (e.g., SQL queries), and working with command-line tools for debugging.
  • Platform Knowledge: Strong background testing native and web-based mobile applications, with a solid working knowledge of iOS, Android, Windows, and Linux operating systems.
  • Certifications: Must hold a recognized Software Testing Certificate (such as ISTQB or equivalent) to demonstrate a solid foundational understanding of formal software testing methodologies.
  • Tools: Familiarity with bug tracking software, specifically JIRA.
  • Automation Knowledge (Advantageous): While primarily a manual testing role, experience with QA Automation (e.g., Selenium, Appium, Cypress) is a significant advantage.
  • Analytical Problem-Solver: Possesses best-in-class analytical skills to dissect complex issues and anticipate creative ways a user might break the game.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to clearly articulate technical concepts to both engineering and non-technical audiences.
  • Driven Team Player: Goal-oriented, proactive, open-minded, and receptive to feedback. You look for solutions rather than just pointing out problems.
  • Trustworthy: High professional integrity and discretion when handling proprietary game mechanics, internal game logic, and unreleased IP.

job.title: Quality Assurance Specialist
job.description:
Position Summary

The Quality Assurance Specialist helps protect the integrity, quality, and reliability of the Maxsold marketplace.

This role reviews and executes refund requests, investigates suspicious bidding/selling activity, evaluates higher-risk transactions, identifies catalog quality concerns, and works across departments to address issues that may create customer, financial, operational, or reputational risk.

The Quality Assurance Specialist is expected to assess the available evidence, apply marketplace policies consistently, and make clear, well-supported decisions. This requires strong judgment, attention to detail, curiosity, and the ability to remain objective.

Success in this role is not simply identifying that something may be wrong. It requires determining what can be established, identifying what information is still needed, recommending or executing the appropriate action, and documenting the reasoning clearly.

What You Will Own

Refund Review and Resolution

  • Review refund requests submitted by buyers.
  • Assess buyer claims against listing information, photographs, communications, pickup reports from sellers, marketplace policies, and other available evidence.
  • Identify gaps, inconsistencies, or unsupported claims within the information provided and work to clarify them.
  • Request or coordinate the collection of additional evidence when required.
  • Determine whether refund requests should be approved, denied, or escalated for further review.
  • Execute approved refunds and ensure the appropriate internal or seller-funded treatment is applied.
  • Communicate refund decisions and supporting rationale clearly to the appropriate internal teams.
  • Identify repeated refund patterns involving buyers, sellers, listings, auction practices, or specific items.
  • Maintain accurate and complete records of decisions, evidence, and outcomes.

High-Risk Transaction Review

  • Review flagged first purchases and other transactions identified as presenting elevated risk.
  • Assess available account, payment, bidding, purchase, and behavioural information.
  • Determine whether activity can proceed, requires additional verification, or should be restricted or escalated.
  • Identify patterns that may indicate account misuse, payment risk, fraud, or coordinated activity.
  • Balance risk prevention with the need to avoid unnecessarily disrupting legitimate customers.
  • Document findings and decisions in a clear and reviewable manner.

Suspicious Bidding and Marketplace Conduct

  • Investigate reports or system flags involving suspicious bidding activity.
  • Review account connections, bidding patterns, payment information, refund behaviour, auction participation, and other relevant facts.
  • Distinguish between confirmed facts, risk indicators, and unproven assumptions.
  • Determine whether activity requires monitoring, education, restrictions, suspension, or leadership review.
  • Coordinate with Support, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, or Operations leadership where seller or buyer action may be required.
  • Maintain confidentiality and avoid disclosing sensitive investigation methods or account information unnecessarily.

Catalog and Auction Quality

  • Review auction catalogs before launch for prohibited items and marketplace risk.
  • Work with Seller Support, partners, and other internal teams to correct issues before launch.
  • Apply quality standards consistently while recognizing differences in auction type, category, and risk.
  • Identify repeated quality concerns and recommend education, process changes, or additional review.
  • Help improve catalog standards, review criteria, and preventive quality controls.

Fraud and Chargeback Risk Support

  • Identify transactions, accounts, or operational practices that may create fraud or chargeback exposure.
  • Gather and organize evidence required for internal review or chargeback response.
  • Work with Finance and Support to ensure relevant account, payment, communication, and pickup information is available.
  • Identify recurring causes of chargebacks and recommend preventive actions.
  • Escalate material financial or marketplace risk promptly.

Cross-Departmental Collaboration

  • Work closely with Buyer Support, Seller Support, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, Product, and Operations leadership.
  • Provide clear, evidence-based guidance when other teams flag refund, fraud, bidding, catalog, or marketplace concerns.
  • Ask focused questions that help teams gather the information required for a decision.
  • Explain decisions and policy applications clearly.
  • Escalate complex or high-impact matters with complete context, supporting evidence, and a recommended next step.

Policy and Process Improvement

  • Surface emerging risk patterns and marketplace behaviours.
  • Recommend improvements to refund processes, catalog review, fraud controls, escalation standards, and internal documentation.
  • Participate in audits and targeted reviews of buyers, sellers, partners, auctions, or internal processes.

What You Bring

  • 3+ years experience in quality assurance, fraud prevention, dispute resolution, refunds, risk operations, marketplace operations, investigations, or a related field.
  • Strong critical-thinking and analytical skills.
  • Sound judgment when working with incomplete, conflicting, or emotionally presented information.
  • The ability to assess evidence objectively and separate facts from assumptions.
  • Strong written communication and documentation skills.
  • The confidence to make and explain decisions based on policy and available evidence.
  • A high level of attention to detail.
  • Curiosity and persistence when investigating unfamiliar or complex issues.
  • The ability to recognize patterns across accounts, transactions, auctions, and customer behaviour.
  • Strong organization and case-management habits.
  • The ability to manage competing priorities and time-sensitive reviews.
  • Comfort collaborating with multiple departments and challenging conclusions respectfully.
  • Discretion when handling confidential, sensitive, or potentially fraudulent activity.
  • The ability to remain calm and objective when decisions may be disputed.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A degree in a technical, analytical, or STEM-related field is strongly preferred, including Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, Information Systems, Business Analytics, Economics, Operations, or another related discipline.
  • Candidates without a traditional STEM degree may be considered if they can demonstrate strong analytical ability, technical aptitude, structured problem-solving, and experience learning complex systems.
  • 4+ years of experience in customer support, quality assurance, fraud or risk operations, dispute resolution, investigations, marketplace operations, or another role where you were responsible for reviewing information and making customer-impacting decision
  • Experience reviewing refund, fraud, payment, chargeback, or account-risk cases.
  • Familiarity with ticketing, CRM, payment-processing, or case-management systems.
  • Experience interpreting and applying customer-facing policies.
  • Experience reviewing product listings, catalogs, claims, or marketplace content.
  • Experience conducting audits or pattern-based investigations.
  • Familiarity with payment disputes, account verification, or transaction-risk indicators.
  • A track record of identifying process gaps and recommending practical improvements.

What Success Looks Like

A successful Quality Assurance Specialist:

  • Makes timely, consistent, and evidence-based decisions.
  • Applies policy accurately while recognizing when a matter requires additional judgment.
  • Approves valid refund requests and confidently denies unsupported requests.
  • Produces clear documentation that explains what happened, what evidence was reviewed, and why a decision was made.
  • Recognizes suspicious patterns and escalates them at the appropriate level.
  • Balances thoroughness with the need to make timely decisions.
  • Focuses effort on material customer, financial, operational, and reputational risk.
  • Contributes to stronger policies, processes, and preventive controls.
  • Earns trust through consistency, objectivity, discretion, and sound judgment.

Why This Role Matters

Quality Assurance protects the marketplace from preventable loss and harmful activity while ensuring suspicious behaviour, policy enforcement, and quality concerns are reviewed appropriately.

The work performed by this team affects buyer confidence, end-user accountability, auction quality, refund exposure, fraud prevention, chargeback risk, and Maxsold’s broader reputation.

This role is well suited to someone who enjoys investigating complex situations, weighing evidence, making defensible decisions, and improving the systems that protect a marketplace.

Job Title: Member of Technical Staff, Quality Engineering

The Role

You'll design and build an intelligent, highly automated quality engineering system where AI agents help generate tests, execute regression suites, investigate failures, and continuously improve test coverage.

You'll own the technical foundations that allow our engineering team to ship quickly and confidently without scaling QA headcount alongside product complexity.

We're looking for a Staff-level engineer with deep test automation expertise, strong software engineering fundamentals, and a track record of building systems that make quality an integrated, automated part of software development.

  3. Make quality continuous: Integrate automated quality checks deeply into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and release processes.
  4. Automate regression and triage: Develop systems that detect regressions, identify likely root causes, classify failures, and reduce the manual effort required to investigate issues.
  5. Improve testing intelligence: Leverage AI agents to identify coverage gaps, generate meaningful test scenarios, and prioritize testing based on product changes and risk.
  6. Design QA for scale: Build workflows that support growing product complexity and engineering velocity without requiring proportional increases in QA staffing.
  7. Establish quality observability: Create clear visibility into test reliability, regression trends, release readiness, and overall product quality.

What We're Looking For

  1. Staff-level engineering expertise with deep experience in Quality Engineering, Software Development in Test (SDET), or Test Automation Architecture.

  5. Strong understanding of CI/CD, integration testing, contract testing, regression strategies, and test infrastructure.

  7. AI-native engineering habits: You already use AI coding agents extensively and have practical experience applying AI to test generation, automation, debugging, or quality workflows.
  8. Strong systems thinking, including the ability to identify bottlenecks and design automation that removes repetitive QA work.
  9. Experience establishing engineering quality standards and mentoring developers or QA engineers.

  5. You think about quality as an engineering platform rather than a separate phase of software delivery.

job.title: Senior Manager, Test & Quality Assurance
job.description:
About Ellucian

Ellucian powers innovation for higher education, partnering with approximately 3,000 customers across 50 countries, serving more than 21 million students. Ellucian's AI-powered platform, trained on the richest dataset available in higher education, drives efficiency, personalized experiences, and strengthened engagement for all students, faculty and staff. Fueled by decades of experience with a singular focus on the unique needs of learning institutions, the Ellucian platform features best-in-class SaaS capabilities and delivers insights needed now and into the future. These solutions and services span the entire student lifecycle, including data-rich tools for student recruitment, enrollment, and retention to workforce analytics, fundraising, and alumni engagement. Ellucian's innovative solutions, vast ecosystem of partners and user community of more than 45,000 provides best practices leading to greater institutional success and achieving better student outcomes.


About the Opportunity

***candidate should be located in EST time zone***

Ellucian is seeking a strategic and technically accomplished Senior Manager, Test & Quality Assurance to lead our global Quality Engineering organization within Professional Services. This highly visible leadership role is responsible for defining and executing our enterprise test and quality assurance strategy, ensuring consistent, scalable, and high-quality customer implementations across our global delivery organization.

Reporting into Professional Services, you will lead a distributed team of Quality Engineers across the United States and Latin America, while partnering closely with our India Center of Excellence (CoE) through a dotted-line leadership model to deliver a unified global quality strategy. In addition to leading a lean core team, you will oversee a scalable contractor workforce that supports implementations worldwide, ensuring consistent execution, governance, and quality standards regardless of delivery location.

This is more than a people leadership role. You will establish the vision, operating model, and quality engineering practices that enable Professional Services to deliver reliable, repeatable, and efficient customer implementations. Working closely with Services Delivery, Product Engineering, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, and our India CoE, you'll champion an automation-first mindset, modern testing practices, and continuous improvement initiatives that enhance customer outcomes while improving delivery efficiency across the organization.

If you're passionate about building global teams, driving organizational transformation, and modernizing quality engineering at scale, this is an opportunity to shape how Ellucian delivers technology to higher education institutions around the world.

Where You Will Make an Impact

Global Quality Strategy & Leadership

  • Define and execute the global Test & Quality Assurance strategy for Professional Services, aligning quality initiatives with organizational priorities and customer delivery goals.
  • Lead and develop a distributed team of Quality Engineers across the United States and Latin America, while providing functional leadership and strategic direction to quality resources within our India Center of Excellence.
  • Build a cohesive global quality organization that operates consistently across multiple regions, balancing centralized governance with regional execution.
  • Manage and coordinate a flexible workforce that includes full-time employees and a global network of implementation partners and contractors supporting customer deployments.
  • Establish governance, standards, KPIs, and quality metrics that drive consistency, accountability, and continuous improvement across all delivery teams.
  • Foster a high-performing culture focused on collaboration, innovation, operational excellence, and customer success.

Quality Engineering & Automation

  • Drive the evolution of our Quality Engineering practice by championing automation-first testing strategies across the implementation lifecycle.
  • Define and implement enterprise testing frameworks utilizing technologies such as:
    • UI Automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium)
    • API Testing (Postman, REST Assured, SoapUI)
    • Performance Testing (JMeter, K6, Gatling)
    • Security Testing (OWASP ZAP or equivalent)
  • Develop reusable testing frameworks, accelerators, and best practices that improve delivery quality and implementation efficiency across global teams.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps teams to integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and modern delivery practices.
  • Establish scalable approaches for test data management, environment strategy, and quality governance across multiple implementation programs.

Delivery Excellence

  • Embed quality throughout the customer implementation lifecycle, ensuring testing is an integral part of delivery rather than a final validation step.
  • Partner with Professional Services leaders to standardize implementation quality across regions while maintaining flexibility to support customer-specific requirements.
  • Define operational dashboards and executive reporting that measure quality, automation maturity, implementation readiness, and customer delivery health.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives using customer feedback, delivery metrics, root cause analysis, and lessons learned.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Collaborate closely with Professional Services Delivery, Product Engineering, Cloud Operations, Customer Success, Product Management, and the India CoE to align quality objectives across the organization.
  • Influence cross-functional leaders to adopt modern quality engineering practices and automation strategies.
  • Serve as the executive point of contact for testing and quality assurance, providing strategic guidance on delivery risk, quality improvements, and operational readiness.
  • Build strong partnerships across global regions to ensure consistent execution, knowledge sharing, and continuous innovation.

What You Will Bring

Leadership Experience

  • 10+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, or Software Testing.
  • 5+ years leading geographically distributed engineering or quality teams.
  • Experience managing teams across multiple regions, including North America, Latin America, and/or India.
  • Demonstrated success leading both direct employees and contractor organizations in a global delivery environment.
  • Experience building scalable operating models and driving organizational transformation across international teams.

Technical Expertise

  • Deep expertise in modern Quality Engineering practices, automated testing frameworks, and enterprise testing strategies.
  • Hands-on experience with:
    • UI automation (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar)
    • API testing (Postman, REST Assured)
    • Performance testing (JMeter, K6, Gatling)
    • Test management and reporting platforms
  • Strong programming or scripting skills (JavaScript, TypeScript, Python, or Java).
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes), and modern DevOps practices.

Professional Services Experience

  • Experience leading Quality Assurance or Quality Engineering within a Professional Services, Consulting, or SaaS implementation organization.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise software implementation methodologies and customer delivery lifecycles.
  • Experience developing repeatable testing and quality processes that scale across multiple customers, delivery teams, and geographies.
  • Higher education technology experience is preferred but not required.

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic mindset with the ability to define vision, influence stakeholders, and execute through global teams.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and executive stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence within matrixed organizations, including dotted-line leadership relationships.
  • Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Passion for coaching and developing talent while fostering a culture of continuous learning, innovation, and operational excellence.

What makes #Ellucianlife

  • Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision
  • Flexible time off
  • Thrive Flex Lifestyle Account (LSA) that allows you to contribute towards your health, financial or learning interests
  • 401k w/ match & BrightPlan - to help you save for the future
  • Parental Leave
  • 5 charitable days to support the community that supports us
  • Telemedicine
  • Wellness
    • Headspace Care (mental health)
    • Wellbeats (virtual fitness classes)
  • RethinkCare & Wellthy– caregiver support
  • Diversity and inclusion programs which provide access to internal employee resource groups
  • Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
  • We Foster a learning culture with:
    • Education Assistance Program
    • Professional development opportunities
    • LinkedIn Learning

You will play a key role in defining and implementing testing approaches for AI-powered products, validating model accuracy, output consistency, performance, edge cases, and overall product quality. Additionally, you will leverage Generative AI and modern AI tools to enhance test automation, streamline test case development, and improve testing efficiency and coverage.
