job.title: Associate Director, Global GCP QA
job.description:
About Us:

Structure Therapeutics develops life‐changing medicines for patients using advanced structure‐based and computational drug discovery technology. The company’s platform combines the latest advancements in visualization of molecular interactions, computational chemistry, and data integration to design orally available, superior small molecule medicines that overcome current limitations of biologic and peptide drugs. We are advancing a clinical‐stage pipeline of differentiated treatments focused on chronic diseases with high unmet need, including cardiovascular, metabolic, and pulmonary conditions.

Structure Therapeutics is led by an experienced group of international drug innovators and financed by top-tier global life sciences investors. The company completed an initial public offering (IPO) in February 2023. With offices in California and Shanghai, Structure Therapeutics has the benefit of being at the center of life science innovation in both the US and China and capitalizing on the strengths of each geographic location.

Position Summary:

The Associate Director, Global GCP QA is responsible for compliance oversight, and supporting strategic execution across clinical studies and vendor programs, in compliance with applicable national and international standards, regulations, and guidelines. The position will provide support and promote collaboration internally to ensure all systems; processes, and their outcomes remain compliant. The role will provide expert GCP guidance across global regulatory requirements (FDA, EMA, MHRA, NMPA, PMDA, etc.) and ensure compliance with ICH GCP, FDA, EMA, and other relevant global regulations. The role will collaborate cross-functionally to drive continuous improvement and ensure patient safety and data integrity. This position will report to the Executive Director, Global GCP, QA.

Job Responsibilities

Study Quality Oversight

  • Independently provide QA oversight for assigned clinical programs.
  • Ensure ongoing clinical phase and China clinical programs are in compliance with applicable health authority regulations and guidelines.
  • Perform review of key Clinical and regulatory submission (e.g. IND/NDA) documents.
  • Work with cross-functional teams to identify and document risks associated with vendors, supporting study compliance, data integrity, and participant safety.
  • Perform reviews of clinical trial documentation for data integrity and compliance with Good Clinical Practice guidance and regulations.
  • Manage assigned quality events and CAPAs, escalating significant risks appropriately.
  • Prepare quality metrics and trend analyses for management review.
  • Support the creation, maintenance, and improvement of quality SOPs, manuals, templates, process maps, and approval flows to establish a robust GCP QMS.
  • Partner with clinical functions to provide quality guidance and drive the implementation of fit-for-purpose procedures that ensure data and documentation are generated and managed in compliance with GCP.
  • Support the implementation of continuous improvement initiatives across Global QA processes to enhance operational efficiency and maintain high compliance standards.
  • Support quality improvement projects, supporting clinical operations in improving trial processes and outcomes.
  • Promote a culture of quality through effective communication, training, and proactive engagement with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Assist in periodic reporting of key quality metrics to leadership to support continuous improvement in GCP compliance across Structure.

Compliance and Audit Management

  • Lead audits for the assigned studies, including internal processes, investigator sites, vendors/CROs, TMFs, and CSRs (both routine and for-cause).
  • Review and interpret audit findings and ensure effective root cause analysis and CAPAs.
  • Support GCP-related vendor qualification and oversight, ensuring adherence to global quality standards, contracts and quality agreements.
  • Evaluate and mitigate compliance risks in GCP domain with a focus on risk-based thinking and operational efficiency.

Inspection Readiness & Compliance Monitoring

  • Support inspection readiness and lead assigned inspection workstreams.
  • Support global regulatory authority inspections
  • Maintain a contemporary knowledge of current agency and industry trends, standards, and methodologies related to GCPs.

Qualifications:

  • BS/MS or equivalent in a scientific discipline required; advanced degree is preferred.
  • Auditor certifications and/or SQA RQAP credentials are preferred.
  • 8+ years of pharmaceutical/biotechnology experience, including at least 4 years in GCP QA lead auditor role.
  • Prior experience in Big Pharma is preferred.
  • Prior experience in supporting regulatory inspections (FDA, EMA, MHRA, NMPA, PMDA).
  • Expertise in ICH E6, E8, E2A-F, 21 CFR Part 11, EU Annex 11, and other global standards.
  • Prior success in executing QMS systems, including vendor management and system implementation.
  • Working knowledge of EDMS and other document and data management platforms.

Key Competencies

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Exceptional project management, and communication skills.
  • Bias for action with the ability to drive outcomes across matrixed teams and third parties.
  • Strong strategic thinking and adaptability in a fast-paced, global environment.

Travel Required: Up to approximately 50% depending on location. Role can be REMOTE or ONSITE (if onsite, hybrid model).

Structure Therapeutics Inc. is an Equal-Opportunity Employer.

Structure Therapeutics is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices, and we strive to provide employees with total compensation packages that are market competitive. For this role, the anticipated base pay range is $165,000-$210,000. The exact base pay offered for this role will depend on various factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s geography, qualifications, skills, and experience.

At Structure, base pay is only one part of your total compensation package. The successful candidate will be eligible for an annual performance incentive bonus, new hire equity, and ongoing performance-based equity. Structure Therapeutics also offers various benefits offerings, including, but not limited to, medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401k match, unlimited PTO, and a number of paid holidays including winter shutdown.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Specialist
job.description:
At Flexspring, you will have the autonomy and flexibility to tackle your role in a way that is right for you. We foster a learning culture that will allow you to develop new skills and progress in your career.

About Flexspring

Flexspring is the leading expert in data integration for HR applications. We work with various clients to build customized integrations that will solve their specific HR business needs.

The Opportunity

Business is booming at Flexspring. We’re seeking a collaborative, proactive, and problem-solving QA Specialist to join our R&D all-star team working on our Flexspring suite of web apps and services. If you love to solve problems, learn to use cutting-edge technology, collaborate with a young, motivated and diverse team, and design and develop solutions in a fast-paced environment with satisfying outcomes, then we would like to meet you.

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Oversee the development of test automation scripts within QA team, and perform code review.
  • Mentor Test automation engineers on good test automation and practices.
  • Write, maintain, and execute functional, browser, performance, load, and stress tests.
  • Create detailed, comprehensive and well-structured test plans and test cases;
  • Design, implement, run and analyze results of test suites for the full gamut of test types: functional, integration,
  • security, system, stress, load and robustness tests;
  • Estimate, prioritize, plan and coordinate testing activities;
  • Design, develop and execute automation scripts and programs using open-source tools;
  • Identify, record, document thoroughly and track bugs;
  • Perform thorough fix validation and verification when bugs are resolved;
  • Liaise with internal teams (e.g. developers and product managers) to identify system requirements;
  • Monitor debugging process results;
  • Investigate the causes of non-conforming software and help colleagues implement fixes and solutions;
  • Track quality assurance metrics, like defect densities and open defect counts;

What We Offer

  • Expect excellence: Collaborate, learn and grow with a high-performance team.

Required Skills And Attributes

  • 3-5 years of experience working in Quality Assurance and Test Automation;
  • Knowledge and practical experience with Java, SQL, Rest Assured, JMeter, Selenium;
  • In-depth knowledge and practical technical application of TDD, BDD and CI/CD.

  • Experience with performance and/or security testing;

Job Summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled QA Engineer to support a large-scale digital transformation, integration modernization, and loyalty platform evolution program within the QSR and e-commerce ecosystem. This role focuses on ensuring high-quality delivery of cloud-native microservices, API orchestration platforms, identity systems, and loyalty-driven customer journeys.

The QA Engineer will work closely with product owners, business analysts, developers, DevOps, and architects to design, execute, and automate comprehensive testing strategies across backend services, APIs, integration hubs, and mobile/web platforms.

Strong experience in e-commerce, loyalty platforms (Paytronix preferred), API testing, event-driven systems, and cloud-native architectures is highly desirable.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and execute manual and automated test cases for backend services, APIs, integration workflows, and event-driven systems.

  • Develop and maintain API automation frameworks for validating orchestration flows, authentication, caching, and proxy services.
  • Validate event-driven and asynchronous workflows, including pub-sub messaging, retry mechanisms, and graceful degradation scenarios.

  • Actively participate in sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, test planning, and release validation activities.
  • Create and maintain test documentation, test reports, dashboards, and quality metrics.
  • Continuously improve QA processes, automation coverage, and testing efficiency.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • 6-8 years of experience in software quality engineering, with strong focus on backend, API, and integration testing.
  • Hands-on experience with API testing tools such as Postman, REST Assured, Karate, or similar frameworks.
  • Strong experience in test automation using Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, or equivalent tools.
  • Experience testing event-driven architectures, asynchronous workflows, and distributed systems.
  • Solid understanding of microservices, API gateways, caching layers, authentication systems, and cloud-native architectures.
  • Experience working with e-commerce platforms, loyalty systems (Paytronix preferred), or customer engagement ecosystems.
  • Strong experience in CI/CD integration and continuous testing pipelines.
  • Good working knowledge of AWS or other cloud platforms.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery environments.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience in performance and load testing using JMeter, Gatling, or similar tools.
  • Exposure to observability-driven testing using OpenTelemetry, logging, and tracing tools.
  • Experience testing mobile applications (iOS/Android) and cross-platform workflows.
  • Experience in QSR, retail, or high-scale consumer digital platforms.
  • Knowledge of feature flags, progressive delivery, and canary releases.

job.title: QA and Testing Analyst
job.description:
About MCU:

At Municipal Credit Union, we believe that an incredible culture helps create a happy and motivated team that works hard to achieve the best results for themselves and their members. For more than 100 years, MCU has provided affordable financial products and convenient services to a membership base that is now comprised of over 600,000 individuals. With each new generation we have the pleasure of interacting with, we maintain the credit union promise of people helping people.

Our Mission:

To help hard-working New Yorkers build better tomorrows

Our Vision:

Be New York's most loved financial institution by helping our members build their best financial futures

Overview:The QA and Testing Analyst independently analyze business and technical requirements, identifies program/project needs, develops the testing strategy, plans, approach, scenarios and performs the functional testing and user acceptance testing for the core credit union technologies. The Analyst partners with Software Development, Application Support, IT Operations, Business Analysis, Information Security, Infrastructure, project teams, business stakeholders, vendors, and end users while maintaining appropriate independence and quality controls.

Responsibilities:

Specific duties include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Oversee and coordinate the end-to-end technical analysis and testing lifecycle for multiple, complex technology initiatives.
  • Creates test plans for testing of major platform and application deployments, upgrades, and maintenance. Follows best practice testing processes and performs them in a timely and efficient manner.
  • Review business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, technical designs, change requests, and vendor documentation for completeness, clarity, traceability, accuracy, and testability.
  • Participate early in project planning, backlog refinement, design reviews, sprint planning, release planning, and change readiness activities to identify quality risks and testing dependencies.
  • Develop risk-based test strategies and test plans that define scope, objectives, environments, data needs, roles, entry and exit criteria, schedules, dependencies, assumptions, risks, and required evidence.
  • Create and maintain detailed test scenarios, test cases, test scripts, test data, traceability matrices, regression suites, checklists, and reusable testing assets.
  • Execute functional, integration, interface, system, end-to-end, regression, smoke, sanity, exploratory, negative, usability, accessibility, data conversion, security, performance, resilience, and production-readiness testing as appropriate.
  • Test web, desktop, mobile, API, batch, database, reporting, file transfer, workflow, vendor-hosted, and internally developed solutions across supported environments.
  • Validate REST and SOAP services, request and response payloads, authentication, error handling, contract behavior, downstream processing, and third-party integrations using approved tools.
  • Validate SQL queries, stored procedures, database objects, reports, data mappings, calculations, transformations, interfaces, reconciliation results, and data integrity across source and target systems.
  • Increase team capacity through the use of automated solutions to enable speed and agility in meeting business needs.
  • Create, execute, maintain, and improve automated tests for repeatable functional, API, integration, and regression coverage using approved frameworks and coding standards.
  • Integrate automated tests into Azure DevOps or other approved CI/CD pipelines and analyze results to provide timely feedback on build quality and release risk.
  • Identify, reproduce, document, prioritize, and track defects with clear steps, expected and actual results, screenshots or logs, severity, business impact, environment details, and supporting evidence.
  • Lead or support defect triage; work with developers, vendors, business analysts, and stakeholders to clarify issues, determine disposition, and drive timely resolution.
  • Maintain bidirectional traceability between requirements, test cases, defects, test results, approvals, and release decisions in approved systems of record.
  • Validate deployment packages, configuration changes, implementation steps, release notes, support documentation, monitoring, rollback procedures, and production-readiness checklists.
  • Support User Acceptance Testing by coordinating test readiness, data, access, schedules, instructions, evidence collection, defect routing, and status reporting while preserving business ownership of acceptance.
  • Perform post-implementation validation and production smoke testing, monitor early-life issues, and contribute to incident reviews and root cause analysis when defects escape to production.
  • Produce concise testing status reports and quality metrics, including execution progress, pass and fail rates, defect aging and trends, escaped defects, rework, automation coverage, requirement coverage, and release readiness.
  • Promote shift-left testing by helping teams define testable acceptance criteria, improve unit and integration coverage, and identify defects earlier in the software development lifecycle.
  • Continuously improve QA standards, templates, tools, automation, test data management, environment controls, documentation, and lessons-learned practices.
  • Apply appropriate QA practices across Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Waterfall, vendor implementation, and hybrid delivery methods.
  • Follow change management, secure development, records retention, privacy, information security, incident management, and technology governance requirements.
  • Maintain current knowledge of testing techniques, application security, financial services technology, automation tools, AI-assisted software delivery, and emerging quality risks.
  • Adhere to all regulatory compliance training, including BSA/AML/OFAC, and support overall BSA/AML/OFAC compliance responsibilities applicable to the position.
  • Demonstrate clear written and verbal communication, sound judgment, attention to detail, objectivity, ownership, collaboration, and constructive technical feedback.
  • Maintain the highest ethical standards and protect confidential member, employee, and organizational information.
  • Perform other related duties and special projects as assigned.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Cybersecurity, Business Technology, or a related field is preferred; an equivalent combination of education, training, certifications, and relevant experience may be considered.
  • Three or more years of hands-on software quality assurance, testing, business systems analysis, application support, or software development experience is preferred.
  • Experience testing enterprise applications, integrations, APIs, databases, reports, batch processes, and vendor platforms in a regulated or control-focused environment is preferred.
  • Financial services or credit union experience is preferred.

Technical Knowledge and Skills:

  • Strong knowledge of the SDLC, software testing lifecycle, quality assurance, quality control, risk-based testing, defect management, release validation, and test documentation.
  • Hands-on experience with manual testing and familiarity with automation approaches for UI, API, integration, and regression testing.
  • Experience with tools such as Azure DevOps, Postman, Selenium, Playwright, or comparable test management, defect tracking, API, and automation tools.
  • Working knowledge of C#, VB.NET, .NET applications, ASP.NET, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, web services, microservices, and object-oriented concepts sufficient to test and troubleshoot solutions effectively.
  • Strong SQL and Microsoft SQL Server skills, including validation of queries, stored procedures, database objects, data integrity, extracts, reports, and SSIS packages.
  • Knowledge of source control, pull requests, branching practices, code reviews, build pipelines, CI/CD, deployment practices, configuration management, and rollback validation.
  • Knowledge of secure coding and application security concepts, including identity, authentication, authorization, encryption, secrets, input validation, dependency risk, common web risks, privacy, and auditability.
  • Ability to review logs, traces, monitoring alerts, job results, data outputs, and technical documentation to isolate and communicate the likely source and impact of issues.
  • Knowledge of performance and load testing concepts, accessibility testing, mobile and browser compatibility, test environment management, and test data controls.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and testing tools, including the need to validate generated code, test cases, data handling, security, accuracy, and human review, is desirable.
  • ISTQB, quality assurance, Agile, Azure, security, or relevant technical certification is desirable.

Core Competencies:

  • Analytical Thinking: Breaks complex processes and systems into testable components and uses evidence to identify risk and root cause.
  • Quality and Detail Orientation: Produces accurate, repeatable work and identifies inconsistencies that could affect members, employees, financial processing, compliance, or operations.
  • Independence and Objectivity: Provides fact-based quality assessments and raises concerns respectfully, even when schedule or delivery pressure exists.
  • Communication: Explains defects, risks, status, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaboration: Builds productive relationships across technology, operations, business teams, vendors, and end users without compromising quality standards.
  • Planning and Organization: Manages concurrent testing assignments, dependencies, evidence, and deadlines while adapting to changing priorities.
  • Problem Solving: Reproduces issues, analyzes data and system behavior, and works methodically toward practical resolution.
  • Ownership and Accountability: Follows issues through closure, maintains reliable records, escalates concerns promptly, and delivers on commitments.
  • Continuous Improvement: Uses metrics, retrospectives, incidents, and release outcomes to strengthen testing processes and prevent recurrence.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

• Work is primarily performed in a professional office or remote technology environment using a computer, telephone, collaboration tools, and testing systems for extended periods.

• Must be able to participate in scheduled releases, production validations, incident response, or testing activities outside normal business hours when required.

• Must be able to communicate effectively, review detailed information on-screen, and perform repetitive keyboard and mouse activity with or without reasonable accommodation.

• Occasional travel to MCU locations, vendor sites, or project meetings may be required.

Why you'll be a good fit:

Our Core Values are an integral part of who we are and who we hire. By living our Core Values, every day, we continue to attract the best and brightest talent, achieve unsurpassed results and continuously challenge ourselves to be better than yesterday. These values are at the heart of our organization and within every teammate. To be a great fit, you’ll bring the following

Results - We are passionate about winning.

Agility - We proactively anticipate, respond and pivot to ensure MCU wins.

Integrity- We operate with the highest ethical standards and highest degree of honesty.

Belonging- We cultivate a culture of inclusion and teamwork.

Ownership- We take personal responsibility and hold ourselves accountable for the results.

Why You’ll Love Working Here:

The pay range for this position is between $71,600-116,550 annually. Actual base pay offered may vary depending on a number of factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and location. Employees in this position may also be eligible for a discretionary bonus, 401(k) with an 6% employer match per pay period. Benefits for this position include Medical, vision, dental, life, and disability insurance, flexible paid time off and 11 paid holidays annually.

Municipal Credit Union (MCU) is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Municipal Credit Union provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws.

We are committed to hiring, training, cultivating, promoting, and celebrating an environment where we have a welcoming and fulfilling place for all people to call home. Diversity of race, thought, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, religion, and disability will empower us to thrive as individuals, as teams, and as an organization.

job.title: Environmental Health System QA Analyst | Public Health
job.description:
About Us

Flourish and Thrive Labs is a woman-owned and led consulting firm specializing in public health solutions. Our team, composed of former public health officials, works with state and local health departments across the country, building resilient public health operating systems. We pride ourselves on being different, holding ourselves to high ethical standards, and taking care of each other.

We view our company as an urban neighborhood—a diverse group of individuals coming together to live and work, embracing the beauty in that diversity. We are a wacky bunch who are intent on spreading joy! (We just mailed out stickers to over 200 local health health professionals because we felt they could use more joy!)

As Salesforce, Microsoft, Snowflake, and AWS partners, we specialize in technology implementation with a strong people focus. We combine this with strategic planning, data analysis, coaching, and facilitation to effectively support local public health department staff.

Our core values are:

  • People First
  • Focus on Capacity Building
  • Belief in Continuous Experimentation
  • By Public Heath; For Public Health
  • We Do What Is Right. Always.

We're seeking passionate, joyful individuals who align with our ethos of being different and making a difference.

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL/ TRIBAL/ STATE/ FEDERAL).

About Consulting at F&T Labs

If you're new to consulting, we want to help you understand what makes F&T Labs different and why our approach might be perfect for you. We know transitioning from government and non-profit to consulting can be a big step, but we've designed our work environment to blend the best of both worlds.

First, let's talk about how we work. Unlike traditional consulting firms, we hire you for a role, not a specific project. This means you can contribute to various initiatives that match your expertise and interests. Think of it as bringing your public health superpowers to different challenges where they're needed most.

We believe in measuring what matters. While many consulting firms focus on billable hours, we care about the quality and impact of your work. Time sheets don't measure your success with us – it's measured by the meaningful solutions you help create for our clients and their communities.

Yes, we have utilization targets (consulting speak for how much of your time is spent on client work), but we view these as guideposts rather than strict rules. They help us ensure we're making a sustainable impact while maintaining a healthy business. These targets are meant to motivate, not to create stress.

One of the most dynamic aspects of consulting is its natural rhythm. Some weeks might be bustling with activity, while others might be quieter. We embrace these ebbs and flows because they create space for both intense, focused work and time for learning, reflection, and personal growth. This is part of our philosophy that work and life shouldn't be at odds – they should be integrated in a sustainable and energizing way.

At our core, we're built on a simple belief: when our team members flourish, our clients flourish, and ultimately, communities thrive. That's why we've created an environment that supports your growth, values your expertise, and understands that the best solutions come from people who feel empowered and energized by their work.

If you're passionate about public health and excited about the possibility of expanding your impact through consulting, we'd love to talk with you. Your experience in public health is valuable, and we're here to help you apply it in new and meaningful ways.

Notice

No 3rd Party Recruiters. No Phone Calls. We are unable to do informational interviews at this moment. Candidates who call or schedule a "coffee chat" will be considered disqualified.

Environmental Health QA Analyst

WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TEAM MEMBER WITH GOVERNMENTAL PUBLIC HEALTH EXPERIENCE (LOCAL / TRIBAL / STATE / FEDERAL). IF YOU HAVE THAT EXPERIENCE, PLEASE ENSURE IT IS CLEAR ON YOUR RESUME.

What do we mean by governmental public health? We're looking for people who have worked directly for a public health agency: a local health department, tribal health organization, state health department, or federal public health agency like CDC. We require this because there's no substitute for the lived experience of navigating government systems, understanding the constraints public health staff face, and developing genuine empathy for the people doing this work. That empathy shapes how we build solutions.

Compensation Note: If a salary range is listed for this position, please note that we will be offering at the starting point of the band. We cover 100% of your health insurance!

Role Overview

We're seeking an Environmental Health QA Analyst who finds satisfaction in making sure things work exactly as they should. You're the person who notices when something is slightly off, who thinks through edge cases others miss, and who won't sign off until you're confident the solution will hold up in the real world.

This role focuses on environmental health workflows. You'll be testing systems that support restaurant inspections, permit applications, complaint tracking, and other environmental health functions. Your understanding of how these programs actually operate will help you spot issues that someone without that background would miss. You'll know that an inspector in the field needs the mobile app to work offline, or that a permit workflow has to account for multiple review stages.

This is a role for someone who takes pride in catching problems before users do. You'll dig into applications, document what you find, and work with developers to get it fixed. You're not just checking boxes on a test script. You're thinking critically about whether the solution will actually work for the health department staff who depend on it.

You'll be part of a collaborative team working on our PH360 platform and client implementations. Your public health experience will make you an advocate for the end user, ensuring that what we deliver is reliable, intuitive, and built for how public health actually works.

How You'll Work

You'll be part of an Agile Release Train (ART) that follows SAFe principles. This means:

  • Program Increment (PI) Planning: You'll participate in quarterly planning sessions, helping identify testing needs and contributing your environmental health perspective
  • Sprint Collaboration: You'll work in two-week sprints with daily standups, regular backlog refinement, and sprint retrospectives
  • Continuous Testing: You'll test features as they're developed, providing rapid feedback to the development team
  • Cross-functional Partnership: You'll work closely with developers, solutions analysts, and architects to ensure quality throughout the development process

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute test plans and test cases for environmental health applications
  • Identify, document, and track defects with clear steps to reproduce
  • Verify that solutions work correctly across different scenarios and edge cases
  • Test environmental health workflows including inspections, permits, complaints, and reporting
  • Collaborate with developers to troubleshoot issues and verify fixes
  • Bring your public health perspective to testing, anticipating how real users will interact with the system
  • Participate in requirements reviews to identify potential issues early

Continuous protection. AI-powered Nonstop SecOps. That’s Ontinue.

job.title: Senior Infrastructure Test Engineer, DevOps
job.description:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Software Development Test Engineer (SDET), DevOps to design and automate testing for the infrastructure, deployment pipelines and cloud environments that support Keeper’s products. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help ensure the reliability, security and compliance of the infrastructure and automation that power Keeper’s cloud services.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Role

As a Senior SDET focused on DevOps and infrastructure, you will build automated test frameworks and validation workflows for AWS environments, infrastructure-as-code, CI/CD pipelines and containerized deployments. This is not a traditional manual QA role. You will apply software engineering and automation practices to verify that infrastructure changes are functional, secure, repeatable and compliant before they reach production. You will work closely with DevOps, Platform Engineering, Security and Compliance teams to test infrastructure changes, identify configuration and deployment defects, improve release confidence and strengthen automated validation across Keeper’s cloud environments.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and maintain automated test frameworks for AWS infrastructure, infrastructure-as-code and deployment workflows
  • Validate infrastructure changes across VPCs, subnets, routing, NAT gateways, IAM, security groups, load balancers and related AWS services
  • Develop automated tests for Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible or similar infrastructure-as-code implementations
  • Build validation into CI/CD pipelines to identify infrastructure, configuration and deployment issues before production release
  • Test containerized and Kubernetes-based environments for functionality, resilience, configuration and security
  • Validate infrastructure hardening and security controls against applicable STIG, CIS and compliance requirements
  • Develop automated integration, regression, smoke, performance and failure-recovery tests for platform and infrastructure changes
  • Verify that Keeper applications and services continue to operate correctly as underlying infrastructure and deployment configurations change
  • Analyze logs, metrics and telemetry to troubleshoot failures and produce clear, reproducible defect reports
  • Partner with DevOps and Platform engineers to identify test gaps, improve infrastructure testability and automate repetitive validation workflows
  • Support audit readiness and compliance validation by producing repeatable test results and technical evidence
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to improve test development, debugging, root-cause analysis, documentation and workflow efficiency

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience as an SDET, Software Engineer in Test, Infrastructure Test Engineer or similarly automation-focused engineering role
  • Strong hands-on experience with AWS infrastructure and networking, including VPCs, subnets, routing, NAT gateways, security groups and IAM
  • Strong experience testing or validating infrastructure-as-code using Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible or similar technologies
  • Proficiency in Python, Bash, Go or another language used for test automation and infrastructure validation
  • Experience building automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar platforms
  • Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure testing, configuration validation, integration testing and failure-recovery scenarios
  • Experience troubleshooting cloud and infrastructure issues using logs, metrics and observability platforms such as Datadog
  • Familiarity with security hardening and compliance requirements such as CIS benchmarks, DISA STIGs, FedRAMP, SOC 2 or ISO 27001
  • Strong understanding of Git-based development workflows and automated software delivery practices
  • Ability to work closely with DevOps, Platform Engineering, Security and Compliance teams to diagnose complex technical issues
  • Ability and willingness to use AI-assisted tools effectively to improve test automation, debugging, technical analysis and documentation
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience validating infrastructure in FedRAMP High, DoD, IL5 or similarly regulated cloud environments
  • Experience with automated infrastructure testing frameworks such as Terratest, pytest or similar tools
  • Experience testing Kubernetes infrastructure, container security or deployment resilience
  • Familiarity with vulnerability scanning, compliance drift detection or SIEM integrations
  • Experience with AWS GovCloud and/or Azure Government
  • Familiarity with secrets management, IAM, PAM or zero-trust security architectures

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships)
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)
  • Above market annual bonuses

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

Keeper Candidate Privacy Notice

This notice explains how Keeper Security processes your personal data during recruitment. Depending on the role and location, the Controller of personal data (the organization responsible for determining why and how personal data is processed) will be Keeper Security Inc. (US), Keeper Security EMEA Ltd. (Ireland), or Keeper Security APAC K.K (Japan).

1. Data We Collect

Information You provide:

  • Contact details, CV/resume, cover letter
  • Employment history, qualifications, work eligibility
  • Application responses and uploaded documents

Information We generate:

  • Interview notes, assessments, communications
  • Scheduling information

Information From Others:

  • Recruiter/referral information who submit your profile
  • References (with your consent, before final offer)
  • Public professional profiles
  • Background verification (post offer)

Voluntary Diversity and Equal Opportunity Information

  • We may ask you to voluntarily provide diversity information including race/ethnicity, gender, disability status and veteran status (US). Providing this information is optional and Keeper collects this data in order to comply with EEOC and similar requirements

2. How We Use Your Data

  • Assess your application and suitability
  • Manage interviews and recruitment workflow
  • Consider you for other/future roles (we may seek your consent to keep your information on our systems beyond the retention period specified)
  • Comply with employment law obligations

3. Legal Basis

  • Legitimate Interests (recruitment management, security and integrity of the hiring process)
  • Contracting steps (for progressed candidates)
  • Legal and regulatory compliance obligations; explicit consent where required

4. Who We Share Information With

Internal:

  • HR, hiring managers, interviewers*, IT support for system administration

*Note - diversity and equal opportunity data is not shared with hiring managers.

Third Parties:

Service providers who assist with:

  • Applicant tracking, recruitment systems and assessment providers
  • Background verification vendors (post offer)
  • Recruitment agencies (where applicable)
  • Tools to support communication, collaboration and to securely store your data

Keeper ensures that all our third parties are contractually bound to protect your personal data with adequate safeguards in place.

5. International Transfers

Your data may be accessed by Keeper entities globally as needed for the purposes of hiring and decision making. We protect any such data transfer between Keeper entities using appropriate safeguards under applicable data protection laws.

6. Security

We implement appropriate technical and organizational measures to protect your data, consistent with our industry leading security standards.

7. Retention

We keep your data for 24 months from your last application activity, then delete or anonymize it.

Exceptions:

  • You opt into our talent database for further retention by providing consent (extended retention)

8. Your Rights

You have the following rights and can contact us at the email below to exercise them:

  • Access, correct, or delete your data, subject to applicable law and retention requirements
  • Object to or restrict processing
  • Withdraw consent (where applicable)
  • Request data portability

If you become an employee, your rights regarding your employee record are governed by our internal Employee Privacy Notice and certain data will be retained as required under relevant laws such as employment or tax law.

When you request access to your personal data, some information may be redacted if it includes the personal data of other individuals or information that we must protect in order to preserve their privacy rights.

9. Automated Decisions

Keeper does not make hiring decisions using solely automated processing.

job.title: Staff Software Engineer, QE
job.description:
About AlphaSense:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Role:

As a Staff Quality Engineer on the Content Portfolio team, you will own and drive test strategy, build automation frameworks, and embed a culture of quality ownership across the engineering organization. Your deep expertise in automation, cloud services, Kubernetes, and modern programming languages will directly shape how we test, release, and deliver reliable software at scale. You will partner closely with developers, product managers, and platform teams to define test requirements, architect quality infrastructure, and ensure AlphaSense ships with confidence at velocity.

You will:

  • Lead the development of test automation frameworks across UI, API, and GraphQL layers, focusing on reliability, maintainability, and speed

  • Design and integrate AI evaluation frameworks to assess accuracy, consistency, and reliability of LLM-powered features

  • Leverage AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor and Claude to accelerate test creation, debugging, and code generation

  • Lead technical implementation of performance testing and monitoring solutions

  • Develop custom reporting and analytics tools to provide insights into test coverage, flaky test rates, and quality metrics

  • Drive adoption of newer testing technologies and approaches

  • Optimize test execution pipelines for faster feedback in CI/CD environments

  • Partner with development teams to implement shift-left testing practices and embed quality ownership within teams

  • Lead root cause analysis for critical issues and drive systematic improvements to prevent recurrence

  • Participate in code reviews to ensure testability and quality considerations are addressed early

  • Provide technical mentorship to QE engineers on automation best practices, framework usage, and AI tooling

Desired Skills:

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in software quality engineering roles with at least 2 years operating at a Staff/Lead level.

  • Deep proficiency in testing TypeScript/JavaScript and modern frontend ecosystems (React, Webpack, or similar).

  • Expert-level experience with Playwright or comparable browser automation frameworks (Cypress, Selenium WebDriver) for end-to-end testing.

  • Strong experience with unit and component testing frameworks such as Vitest, Jest, or React Testing Library.

  • Proven track record of designing and building test automation frameworks from scratch or significantly evolving existing ones at scale.

  • Solid understanding of CI/CD systems (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Buildkite, Gitlab or similar) and how to integrate and optimize test suites within them.

  • Experience with GraphQL APIs - Writing integration tests, mocking schemas, and validating query/mutation contracts.

  • Familiarity with performance and load testing tools (k6, Lighthouse, Artillery).

  • Experience with visual regression testing (Percy, Chromatic, Playwright visual comparisons).

  • Hands-on experience with Allure or similar test reporting/analytics platforms.

  • Understanding of AI/ML-powered products and the unique testing challenges they present (non-deterministic outputs, data quality, model evaluation).

  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, or market intelligence domains.

  • Track record of contributing to developer experience improvements like test tooling plugins, custom ESLint rules for test quality, documentation-as-code practices.

  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP).

  • Familiarity with AI/LLM evaluation frameworks

  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or Claude for accelerating test authoring, code review, and debugging.

  • Experience building or configuring MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

job.title: QA Automation Engineer co-op
job.description:
About Flexspring

Everything connects. That's not just our tagline - it's the whole job.

Flexspring is an iPaaS (Integration Platform as a Service) built for one of the thornier problems in enterprise software: getting HR systems to actually talk to each other. We link payroll, recruiting, benefits, and HRIS platforms API-to-API so data moves between them cleanly and in near real-time, with no manual re-entry anywhere. The results back it up - 3,000+ integrations delivered, 800+ clients including Fortune 500 companies, ADP Marketplace Platinum Partner, and named HR Data Integration Experts of the Year 2025. And we do it all as a remote-first team spread across Canada and beyond.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a QA Developer Co-op to join our R&D team - and we'll be upfront about what that means.

This is real experience, in the fullest sense. No throwaway side project, no busywork to fill the term - from your first weeks you'll be testing our actual product, as a real part of the team, protecting data that real customers depend on. Many of our co-ops go on to join us full-time after graduation.

You'll work mainly in Java, writing automated tests around the ways real integrations break - API timeouts, mismatched data, systems drifting out of sync. Good QA here is half code, half detective work - every test exists because a real company is counting on its HR data to arrive intact. If you like asking "what could go wrong here?", and you get a little satisfaction from catching the bug everyone else missed, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Be Working On

  • Writing and maintaining automated test suites in Java - and understanding the customer problem behind what you're testing
  • Designing tests around the ways real integrations break - API timeouts, corrupted or mismatched data, systems falling out of sync
  • Tracking failures back to their root cause, not just the symptom
  • Using modern tooling, AI included, to work efficiently - and reviewing what it produces with a careful eye before you trust it
  • Working closely with developers through code reviews and team discussions to keep quality high

What We're Looking For

  • Strong analytical thinking. This is the heart of good QA - you can look at a feature and reason about where it might break and why that would matter, connecting each test back to the real customer on the other end.
  • A thoughtful approach to new tools. You enjoy picking up unfamiliar technology, including AI tools, and using it to work faster and smarter. You also know that generating output is only the start - the real value is in reviewing it, catching what's off, and being able to stand behind the result.
  • You've already completed a co-op term or have some professional work experience - this won't be your first time in a real work environment
  • You're currently studying Software Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field
  • A solid foundation in Java
  • You've written automated tests before, even for a class project (JUnit or something similar)
  • You've worked with or learned about APIs
  • You're curious, motivated, and get real satisfaction from finding what others miss

Nice to Haves

  • Experience with testing frameworks or tools (JUnit, Selenium, Postman, REST-assured, or similar)
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and how data moves between systems
  • Interest in integration platforms (iPaaS) and how systems connect
  • Curiosity about how large systems talk to each other - and what happens when they don't

What You'll Walk Away With

  • Real, hands-on experience protecting the quality of a production platform real customers rely on
  • Mentorship from senior developers who'll invest in how you think, not just the tests you write
  • A working understanding of how HR data moves between enterprise systems - and where it tends to break
  • Real practice using AI and modern tooling the way strong engineers do - fast, but with judgment
  • Competitive co-op pay
  • Flexible hours in a remote-first environment
  • A strong chance to grow into a full-time role after graduation

job.title: Quality Assurance Lead
job.description:
The QA Lead is accountable for the quality assurance practice across product delivery, ensuring that software is testable, test execution is timely and transparent, critical defects are surfaced early, and releases meet agreed quality standards. This role leads day-to-day QA planning and execution, strengthens automation and regression coverage, coaches QA team members, and works closely with Product Owners and Engineering to embed quality throughout the software development lifecycle rather than treating testing as a final-stage activity.

The QA Lead is expected to create clear visibility into test readiness, progress, risk, and blockers. The role owns the operating discipline of QA: defining test approaches, ensuring execution begins when planned, maintaining useful quality metrics, driving defect triage, and escalating issues early when delivery or release quality is at risk.

Key Responsibilities

Quality Leadership & Accountability
  • Own the day-to-day QA practice and establish consistent expectations for test planning, execution, documentation, and release readiness.
  • Ensure QA work begins when planned and that delays, blockers, environment issues, data needs, or scope gaps are identified and communicated immediately.
  • Create transparency into what has been tested, what remains untested, current defects, quality risks, and confidence in release readiness.
  • Hold QA team members accountable for execution commitments, timely updates, accurate status reporting, and follow-through.
  • Coach QA team members on testing discipline, risk-based thinking, root-cause analysis, and stronger ownership of outcomes.
Test Strategy, Planning & Execution
  • Develop and maintain test strategies for new features, enhancements, integrations, defects, and platform changes.
  • Partner with Product Owners early in discovery and refinement to identify test scenarios, edge cases, data needs, dependencies, and acceptance criteria before development is complete.
  • Ensure test cases provide adequate functional, integration, regression, negative, end-to-end, and workflow coverage based on business and technical risk.
  • Coordinate test data, environments, integrations, and dependencies required for successful QA execution.
  • Confirm that critical workflows can be tested end-to-end before work is considered ready for business UAT.
  • Use risk-based testing to prioritize the highest-value scenarios when time or environment constraints require tradeoffs.
Defect Management & Release Readiness
  • Lead defect triage in partnership with Product and Engineering, ensuring severity, priority, business impact, and ownership are clear.
  • Track critical defects through resolution and retest and ensure unresolved quality risks are explicitly documented before release decisions.
  • Define and enforce practical QA exit criteria, including expectations for critical defect closure, regression completion, and stability.
  • Provide an objective quality recommendation for releases based on test evidence and known risk.
  • Identify recurring defect patterns and partner with Engineering and Product on preventive actions rather than relying only on downstream testing.
Automation & Continuous Improvement
  • Develop and maintain a pragmatic test automation strategy focused on high-value regression, repeatable workflows, integrations, and business-critical scenarios.
  • Partner with QA Automation Engineers and Engineering to increase reliable automated coverage without creating brittle or low-value automation.
  • Use modern AI-assisted tools, where appropriate, to accelerate test-case creation, test-data design, automation development, and quality analysis while preserving human review and accountability.
  • Evaluate test tooling, frameworks, and processes and recommend improvements that increase efficiency, coverage, and maintainability.
  • Reduce manual regression effort over time by identifying the strongest candidates for automation and incorporating automated tests into delivery pipelines where feasible.
Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Work closely with Product Owners to ensure requirements and acceptance criteria are clear, testable, and aligned to expected business outcomes.
  • Partner with Engineering on defect prevention, unit/integration test expectations, environment stability, observability, and root-cause analysis.
  • Collaborate with Architecture and platform teams when quality issues involve integration, infrastructure, data movement, or systemic technical risk.
  • Support business UAT by ensuring the product is genuinely ready for validation and by helping distinguish blocking defects from non-blocking follow-up work.
  • Communicate quality risk in clear business terms so leadership can make informed release and prioritization decisions.
Metrics & Reporting
  • Maintain a small, actionable set of QA metrics that reflect product quality and execution health rather than activity alone.
  • Track measures such as test execution progress, escaped defects, defect severity, defect reopen rate, regression coverage, automation coverage, UAT rework, and recurring defect trends.
  • Use metrics to identify systemic improvement opportunities and to show whether changes to process, automation, or requirements quality are producing measurable results.
  • Provide concise status reporting that clearly states current quality, material risks, blockers, required decisions, and next actions.
Required Qualifications
  • Significant hands-on experience in software quality assurance, including functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing.
  • Experience leading QA execution, mentoring testers, or functioning as a senior/lead resource responsible for quality outcomes.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery and the role of QA throughout discovery, development, testing, UAT, and release.
  • Demonstrated ability to create test strategies and translate complex business workflows into thorough, risk-based test coverage.
  • Experience managing defects and facilitating effective triage with Product and Engineering.
  • Working knowledge of test automation concepts, frameworks, and CI/CD practices.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to surface concerns early and communicate quality risk clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong ownership mindset, organization, follow-through, and comfort operating in a fast-moving environment with multiple concurrent priorities.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience testing complex enterprise applications, healthcare technology, claims, payments, utilization management, provider data, EDI, APIs, or other heavy integration workflows.
  • Experience with automated API, UI, regression, and integration testing.
  • Experience using AI-assisted development or testing tools such as Microsoft Copilot, GitHub Copilot, or comparable tools.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, test-management tools, CI/CD pipelines, observability platforms, and cloud-based application environments.
  • Experience helping a QA organization mature from primarily manual testing toward a balanced automation and risk-based quality model.
Success Measures

Success in this role will be demonstrated through measurable improvement in the reliability, transparency, and efficiency of the QA function, including:
  • QA execution starts on time, with blockers surfaced immediately rather than discovered later.
  • Leaders and delivery teams have clear visibility into test progress and release risk.
  • Critical defects are identified earlier in the lifecycle, and fewer defects escape into UAT or production.
  • UAT rework and repeated defect patterns decline over time.
  • Regression coverage becomes increasingly reliable, repeatable, and automated.
  • QA team members demonstrate stronger ownership, consistency, technical capability, and accountability.
  • Release decisions are supported by objective test evidence and clearly documented risk.
Leadership Expectations

The QA Lead is expected to model transparency, ownership, and proactive communication. Problems do not need to be perfectly solved before they are raised. When quality, timing, environment stability, or test readiness is at risk, the expectation is to surface the issue early, explain the impact, and drive the appropriate next action with the delivery team.

  • Design regression coverage for configuration changes: when an admin edits a checklist, pipeline or rate card, we know what still works.

  • Experience testing complex, workflow-heavy systems — CRMs, case management, fintech or similar — where state and permissions matter more than pixels.
  • A tester’s mindset: you enjoy breaking things, you think in edge cases, and you can reason about a 9-market × multi-course-level combination space without trying to test all of it.

Nice to have

API testing (Postman, REST clients); performance or load testing basics; experience with data-sensitive platforms and UK and Europe GDPR awareness; edtech or marketplace background.

job.title: QA Engineer — CTRM Platform
job.description:
About the role

A hands-on QA engineer owning the quality of our CTRM platform end to end: deciding what has to be tested, building the automation, finding the defects that matter and making sure they stay fixed. You work directly with backend engineers, the product manager, the data team, and the traders and finance users who will run their business on the system — no account manager in between.

Agents write most of the code here. That makes testing more important, not less: the team ships quickly, and a large part of quality now depends on independent verification that the system does what the business needs, not what the code happens to do.

What the work looks like

The system we are building exists so that anyone involved in a deal can reconstruct the P&L between any two points of the chain, at any moment, on an agreed and versioned allocation basis. A defect here is rarely a broken button. It is a pricing formula averaged over the wrong period, a provisional cost that is never replaced by the actual, a figure that changes when someone reruns last month, or an FX rate applied on the wrong date. Numbers from this system feed invoices, hedges and shareholder reporting.

Scope

  • Test strategy and test plans for the platform: deal capture, pricing and pricing periods, provisional and final invoicing, costs, demurrage and claims, P&L and margin, reporting
  • Automated tests at API, data and UI level, integrated into CI so every change runs against them
  • Realistic test data and scenarios — term contracts, multi-lot cargoes, price-formula deals, FX, late invoices, cost reallocation — and expected results someone in the business has signed off
  • Regression testing of calculations: the same deal must produce the same P&L, and a past date must reproduce the P&L as it stood then
  • Data and integration testing — market data feeds, imports from accounting and operations systems, reconciliation between the platform and the source it came from
  • Reviewing agent-written code and agent-written tests critically: a test that always passes is worse than no test
  • Working with users on acceptance testing and turning their “this number looks wrong” into a reproducible defect
  • Release quality: what is safe to ship, what is not, and why

Requirements

  • 4+ years in QA or software testing, with ownership of test strategy and automation on a business-critical product
  • Strong test automation in Python (pytest or similar) or another mainstream language; API testing; UI automation with Playwright, Cypress or similar
  • Good SQL and the ability to test data directly: write queries to check a calculation, find a population mismatch, prove a number wrong
  • Experience testing calculation-heavy or financial systems — trading, banking, payments, billing, ERP or accounting. You think in edge cases: rounding, dates and time zones, currencies, partial quantities, reversals and corrections
  • Understanding of CI/CD and of where tests belong in it
  • Working with coding agents, seriously. You use agents to write tests and tooling, and you know how they fail: tests that assert what the code does rather than what it should do, mocks that hide the real behaviour, coverage that looks high and checks nothing. We hire for verification habits, not speed
  • Precise written communication: defect reports a developer can reproduce on the first attempt, and test results a manager can act on
  • English sufficient to present findings and defend a release decision
  • Professional proficiency in Russian

Nice to have

  • Experience with CTRM/ETRM systems or energy or commodity trading — deal lifecycle, pricing formulas, invoicing, P&L
  • Performance and load testing
  • Property-based or data-driven testing for financial calculations
  • Experience setting up a QA function or test framework from scratch in a growing team

What we offer

  • Ownership of quality on the platform, and room to shape how testing is done
  • Direct access to founders, engineers and business users; short feedback loops
  • Generous AI tooling budget — frontier models are a working expense, not a perk
  • Competitive compensation, discussed individually

How to apply

Share your CV and an answer to any of the questions below, at your choice. Applications without answers are not reviewed.

  1. A cargo is priced on an average of five quotation days after the bill of lading, in USD, with costs invoiced in EUR. The P&L for this deal shown last month differs from what the system shows today for the same date, and nobody changed the deal. How would you test for this, what would you look at first, and what tests would you add so it cannot happen silently again?
  2. Give a real case where a defect reached production in a system where numbers mattered — money, quantities, prices. What was wrong, why did the tests miss it, how was it found, and what did you change?
  3. Show a real prompt or task brief you gave an agent to write tests, and what it produced. Then one case where agent-written tests looked good and did not actually protect anything: what was wrong, how you noticed, what you did instead.
  4. Which systems have you personally tested — trading, banking, payments, billing, ERP or accounting? Pick one and tell us about a defect class specific to that kind of system that someone without that experience would miss.

  • Collaboration: Work closely with the QA team on escalated issues and with leadership to drive systemic improvements

What Makes This Role Unique

Unlike traditional QA roles focused on individual file audits, this is focused on strategic and

investigative claims handling. You'll have the autonomy to identify what to investigate, design

your approach, and drive change at the account and organizational level. Your work directly

protects revenue and strengthens client relationships.

Required Qualifications

  • Claims Experience: 3-5+ years of claims adjusting experience across multiple lines of business
  • Technical Expertise: Strong understanding of exposures, coverage, and regulatory requirements
  • QA/Audit Background: Previous quality assurance, audit, or quality review experience
  • Analytical Skills: Demonstrated ability to identify patterns, trends, and root causes in complex data
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, comfortable presenting findings to leadership

Key Competencies

  • Investigative Mindset: Natural curiosity about why issues occur, not just what occurred
  • Strategic Thinking: Ability to develop hypotheses and design audits to test them
  • Independence: Self-directed and comfortable working with ambiguity
  • Influence: Can challenge leaders constructively with data-backed recommendations
  • Detail-Oriented: Thorough in analysis while maintaining big-picture perspective
  • Relationship Management: Builds trust with stakeholders at all levels
  • Proactive: Takes initiative to surface issues before they escalate

What Success Looks Like

  • Identifying systemic issues before clients raise concerns
  • Building trusted relationships with account managers and directors
  • Driving measurable improvements in quality outcomes through root cause work
  • Contributing strategic insights that inform operational decisions

At Reserv, we value diversity in backgrounds, perspectives, and life experiences and believe that diversity in viewpoints and critical thinking drives innovation, first-principles thinking, and success. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and encourage those from all walks of life to apply. If you believe you are a good fit for this role, we would love to hear from you!
