job.title: Quality Assurance Analyst
job.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Does the idea of applying your talents at a company that assists people in understanding how to obtain additional health care benefits and compensates well for doing so, inspire you? We call it “Doing good while doing well” and invite you to apply to join us and begin moving forward along a beneficial career path – one built on providing solutions by helping others navigate through the complex world of health care benefits.

Here at BeneLynk, our mission is to improve lives and positively impact social determinants of health barriers by providing our healthcare partners with the information they need, and people with the advocacy they deserve. We are laser-focused on our longstanding area of expertise in the healthcare world. We fully understand barriers and surface solutions, then provide the advocacy that changes lives and improves outcomes. Everything we do, from the systems we build, to our government relations, to our outreach operations, is in service of this one central vision.

WHO WE ARE

We are big-hearted people, passionate about serving our health plan clients, their members, and each other. We are a team in every sense of the word, striving toward a common mission – that is the goal of everyone at BeneLynk. Every day, we are relentless in helping people who need essential resources to make their lives easier and healthier. The members we serve call us "miracles," "kind," "professional," "human," and "compassionate," and all with "service that gets the job done." We pride ourselves on creating a healthy environment for our employees to thrive in their ability to assist others.

QUALITY ASSURANCE ANALYST

POSITION SUMMARY

Benelynk is building the technology platform that powers Veteran Directed Care (VDC), a VA program that gives veterans the flexibility to direct their own long-term in-home care, including hiring and managing their own caregivers. We are seeking to hire a Quality Assurance (QA) Analyst to support a new product being added to our portfolio.

The Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible for monitoring, inspecting, testing, and proposing measures to correct or improve the organization’s products so that they meet established quality, functional, and compliance standards. In practical terms, this role designs and executes the test strategies, test plans, test suites, test cases, and test scripts that validate product functionality End-to-End — identifying, logging, and reproducing defects before they reach the user, and confirming that what was built matches what was asked for.

This position supports the technology platform BeneLynk is building to power Veteran Directed Care (VDC), a VA program that gives veterans the flexibility to direct their own long-term in-home care, including hiring and managing their own caregivers.

BeneLynk’s Engagement Advocates use an internal, proprietary platform (i.e., Veteran Choose) to guide veterans through the full lifecycle — onboarding, caregiver engagement, time submission and approval, payroll, and reporting. The platform also includes a self-service module that allows the Veteran, Case Manager, and Direct Care Worker to access the system directly to perform the functions they require and to retrieve their unique actions and reports.

Because this platform serves several very different audiences within a single connected system — veterans (many of whom are elderly or non-technical), family caregivers, professional Direct Care Workers, Enrollment Advocates, and partner agencies (ADNAs) — the QA Analyst must validate distinct role-based experiences, permissions, and workflows rather than a single user path. The role also carries a high-consequence testing burden: errors in eligibility, service authorizations, budgets, timesheets, or payroll affect a veteran’s care and a caregiver’s paycheck. Accuracy is not a preference here; it is the product.

The QA Analyst will work in conjunction with the Chief Product Officer, the Product Owner, the UI/UX Product Designer, Operations, and the Engineering (ENG) team to design, develop, test, validate, deploy, monitor, and manage the solutions being released. In addition, this individual will assist in capturing business needs and business requirements from stakeholders and in defining corresponding project and product directives relative to Product Development (PD) initiatives.

At BeneLynk we know that innovation does not come without rolling up our sleeves and getting the work done. The QA Analyst will be an integral piece in defining and executing testing strategies that ensure BeneLynk continues to deliver high-quality products and services to its customers.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Represent BeneLynk’s Customers:This function is listed first, because we always want to be thinking of how best to serve our internal and external customers. The first responsibility of the QA Analyst is to understand the business needs and goals of BeneLynk’s clients — and the lived experience of veterans, caregivers, and Direct Care Workers — along with the functionality of the products and services designed to address them.
  • Ensure Product Quality:The QA Analyst is responsible for designing and executing End-to-End validation and User Acceptance Testing (UAT) of product functionality across both the Advocate-facing platform and the self-service module. This individual is vital to the assurance and attestation that BeneLynk products are absent of issues and recurrently adhere to the Voice of the Customer (VOC).
  • Validate Program and Payroll Integrity:The QA Analyst will validate the complex program logic that sits underneath the interface — eligibility, service authorizations, budget calculations, timesheet capture and approval, payroll processing, and reporting — including boundary conditions, rounding, retroactive corrections, and error-state handling.
  • Team Collaboration:This role is responsible for fostering an effective and collaborative team structure, working with colleagues across technical, business, and operational departments. This cohort will be part of a team structured to understand, design, and execute QA and UAT plans based on the business goals, needs, and requirements captured from these teammates.

This role may have multiple responsibilities, reflecting the small, but growing, size of BeneLynk as a company. All of us, including our senior management team, are on the front line performing what needs to be accomplished to establish BeneLynk as the nation’s premier provider of benefit and SDoH advocacy services.

ADDITIONAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:

Test Design and Execution

  • Develop test strategies, test plans, test suites, test cases, and test scripts — providing a high level of testing and analysis coverage across existing functionality and new features.
  • Execute role-based testing across all platform personas — Enrollment Advocate, Veteran, Case Manager, Direct Care Worker, and partner agency (ADNA) — validating that permissions, visibility, and available actions are correct for each role.
  • Validate the VDC service lifecycle End-to-End: onboarding, caregiver engagement, time submission and approval, payroll, and reporting.
  • Identify appropriate parameters, functions, and data to test and validate product attributes; parameters may include general function, validity of results, accuracy, reliability, and compliance with industry standards.
  • Test the self-service module against real-world usage conditions — including mobile devices, low-bandwidth connections, and assistive technology — recognizing that many end users are elderly, non-technical, or non-native English speakers.
  • Support accessibility validation against WCAG 2.1 AA as a baseline requirement, escalating findings to design and engineering.

Requirements, Documentation, and Reporting

  • Review design specifications, wireframes, prototypes, and project/product parameters to understand the scope, requirements, and function of the software product.
  • Conduct testing and analysis to ensure that products perform according to user requirements and within established guidelines as conveyed within the Business Requirements Document (BRD) and Project Charter (PC).
  • Assist in Requirements Gathering (RG) with stakeholders and end users, and help translate captured business needs into testable acceptance criteria.
  • Provide the testing scope/overview documentation, test plan, test results, and associated tickets for resolution and prioritization.
  • Maintain clear documentation of test coverage, results, and decisions to support audit readiness and compliance traceability (e.g., HIPAA, VA program requirements).

Defect Management and Continual Improvement

  • Identify, log, and recreate error codes, bugs, and defects; report findings to the Product Management Office (PMO) and/or Engineering (ENG) when applicable or required.
  • Respond quickly to QA/UAT and/or Production (PRD) issues, research and identify ways to reproduce defects, update tickets, and monitor the status of project/product initiatives accordingly.
  • Devise best practices, processes, and procedures to stringently inspect and report detailed quality issues for prompt correction.
  • Facilitate proactive solutions by collecting, analyzing, and communicating quality data.

Collaboration and Delivery

  • Collaborate with stakeholders including Product Management, Design, Engineering, Operations, and Leadership to understand the journey of our Advocates and the veterans and caregivers they assist.
  • Work on multiple initiatives to prioritize features, devise program testing and analysis requirements, create corresponding documentation and process flows, and define on-time delivery of End-to-End testing.
  • Perform other duties as assigned by the Chief Product Officer and/or BeneLynk leadership personnel regarding QA/UAT and/or business-related objectives.

REQUIRED SKILLS/ABILITIES/EXPERIENCE:

  • 2–4+ years in Quality Assurance (QA) and/or User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including experience leading product testing and analysis efforts across multiple QA and/or UAT initiatives.
  • Experience in Agile business/software development lifecycle processes and methodologies; experience with or knowledge of SCRUM fundamentals, frameworks, and methodologies.
  • Experience performing End-to-End testing across multiple applications and developing test plans, test scripts, and a coverage matrix for comprehensive testing of the systems under test.
  • Ability to create test plans, test suites, and test cases from project/product specifications and/or verbal communication channels.
  • Experience creating written QA/UAT test reports showcasing test progress, status, test plan completion, defects identified, and associated risks.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason through complex conditional business rules and identify the edge cases others miss.
  • Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
  • Calm under pressure, with a proactive and self-starting attitude and excellent interpersonal skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to serve as a liaison among developers, designers, product managers, and operations.
  • Experience presenting information to teams, stakeholders, and/or executives.
  • Proficiency in the MSFT Office Suite (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and/or related software.
  • Adept at understanding the premise, intent, and utilization of QA/UAT operations and how they coalesce with product design, development, and delivery processes.
  • Recurrently portrays a collegial comportment and candor to all BeneLynk cohorts.

REQUIRED EDUCATION/TRAINING

  • Associate degree in a related field required. Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred.

SUPERVISORY DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES

  • This position has no direct reports.
  • Assists Product Management leadership in orchestrating and supervising QA/UAT operations when applicable or required.
  • Assists Product Management leadership in performing training and development initiatives related to QA/UAT operations when applicable or required.

PREFERRED SKILLS/ABILITIES/EXPERIENCE AND EDUCATION/TRAINING

  • Use of MSFT Azure DevOps (Test Plans, Test Suites, Test Cases) or a comparable test management suite.
  • Experience testing payroll, timekeeping, EVV, billing, or other financial transaction systems where calculation accuracy is material.
  • Familiarity with Veteran Directed Care (VDC), VD-HCBS, Financial Management Services (FMS), Home and Community-Based Services (HCBS), or VA program operations.
  • Experience in relevant fields including health plan systems, Medicare and Medicaid benefits, and/or SDoH database companies.
  • Testing and deploying solutions in a call center environment.
  • Exposure to accessibility testing standards and assistive technology.
  • Familiarity with test automation concepts and tooling.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field from a regionally accredited university.

PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at a time.
  • Must have a stable internet connection.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

This role is a remote position.

POSITION TYPE/ EXPECTED HOURS OF WORK

Full-time/Exempt – This is a salaried position

SALARY

Based on Experience; Up to $80k annually

EMPLOYEE BENEFITS

We offer competitive salaries and benefits here at BeneLynk, as we truly value our employees and the amazing work that they do each day. Please see below for a list of some of our awesome employee benefits:

  • Medical, Dental, Vision and Employee Assistant Program Benefits
  • 401K Match
  • 15 Paid Days Annually
  • Excellent Growth & Advancement Opportunities

EMPLOYEE PERKS

Work hard, play hard!Having an engaged workforce and positive work environment is one of our top priorities here at BeneLynk. We do so through numerous initiatives that can be found below. We like to call our virtual work community, “The Bene-Verse”. We also have an internal Culture Ambassador committee dedicated to ensuring all employees have a pleasant and exciting work experience.

  • Monthly Company Town Hall Events:We love the opportunity to come together as a company. Join us monthly as we discuss exciting company updates, internal promotions, internal awards, upcoming events, and more!
  • Monthly Internal Mental Health Newsletters:Our Culture Ambassadors spearhead an internal newsletter centered on mental health topics. Our employees’ overall wellbeing is our top priority, so we like to provide support whenever it is needed through this uplifting internal newsletter.
  • Monthly Streaming Services Perk:Yes- we pay YOU to enjoy the television shows that you enjoy! We pay up to a $12 per month for any streaming service subscriptions that you currently have.
  • Tickets at Work Perk:Enjoy discounted movie tickets, hotel stays, and more through our company’s ‘Tickets at Work’ perk!
  • Monthly Lunch & Learn Events:Meet key members of our Senior Management team through engaging Lunch & Learn sessions on a monthly basis. Lunch is on us for those employees that sign up!
  • Monthly Bene-Verse Events:We put on awesome monthly events for our employees including virtual trivia, team building exercises, guided painting sessions, and more!

EEO STATEMENT

At BeneLynk, we don’t just accept differences; we celebrate, support, and thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our products, and the communities that we serve. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling this company’s unwavering commitment to equal employment opportunity. BeneLynk is an equal opportunity employer, and as such, employment here is solely based on a person's merit and qualifications directly related to their professional expertise.

If you require reasonable accommodation in completing an application, interviewing, completing any preemployment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to our HR team.

E-VERIFY

BeneLynk participates in E-Verify. We will provide the U.S. Social Security Administration (SSA) and, if necessary, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) with information from each new employer’s Form I-9 to confirm work authorization.

job.title: QA Tester, Data Integration - Canada Remote 12 Month Contract
job.description:
OVERVIEW

Reporting to Manager, IT Quality Assurance and working closely with the QA Lead, the 12-month Contract position of QA Tester performs hands-on testing for a new enterprise data platform that integrates and consolidates data from multiple source systems, including SAP and CRM, into a single, centralized source on AWS. This role focuses on integration testing across source systems and detailed data validation to confirm the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of integrated data across QA and Production environments. The QA Tester analyzes technical specifications and data-mapping documentation, identifies and resolves defects in partnership with development teams, and produces detailed reports and documentation of all testing efforts. A naturally curious and investigative mindset is essential to interrogate data, question anomalies, and drive issues to root cause. Their work is vital in delivering a reliable, high-quality data platform that aligns with organizational standards and business expectations.

Residency in Canada is required throughout this fixed term contract.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Test Execution: Develop and execute test cases, scripts, and scenarios for the data integration platform across QA and Production environments.
  • Integration Testing: Perform integration testing across source systems such as SAP and CRM, verifying that data flows correctly between systems and into the consolidated platform.
  • Data Validation: Conduct detailed data validation, reconciliation, and data-quality checks to confirm the completeness, accuracy, and integrity of integrated data. Work closely with development teams to reproduce, isolate, and resolve data discrepancies.
  • Documentation Analysis: Review technical specifications and data-mapping documents to understand intended data flows and identify potential areas of concern.
  • Reporting & Documentation: Produce detailed reports and documentation for all testing efforts, including results, data logs, and defect tracking, to maintain accurate records and facilitate communication.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Communicate test progress, results, and issues to the QA Lead and project stakeholders, ensuring transparency and alignment with project goals.
  • Defect Analysis & Resolution: Analyze test results to identify, document, and resolve defects; partner with development teams to reproduce, isolate, and verify fixes.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education

  • A bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field is required.

Experience

  • 2-5 years of experience in software quality assurance, with a proven track record of executing various types of testing, identifying defects, and ensuring quality.
  • Experience with integration testing and/or testing data across enterprise systems such as SAP and CRM is required.
  • Hands-on experience with data validation and reconciliation; exposure to cloud data platforms (AWS) is an asset.
  • Familiar with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.
  • Familiar with JIRA, Confluence, test management and data validation tools.

Knowledge/Competencies/Skills

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to document issues, track corrective actions, and provide data-driven insights for improvement.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the capacity to work effectively with cross-functional teams and influence quality-related decisions.
  • Excellent communication (listening, speaking and written) and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to communicate ideas in both technical and user-friendly language.
  • Keen attention to detail, tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn new products.
  • Highly self-motivated and directed, and adept in a team-oriented, collaborative environment.
  • Strong intellectual curiosity and an investigative mindset—naturally digs into data, questions anomalies, and pursues root cause.
  • Can effectively prioritize and execute tasks in a high-pressure environment.

WORKING CONDITIONS

Working Hours

  • Covering the core hours of operation, 9:00 AM to 3:00 PM local time, this is a Full-Time position, scheduled forty (40) hours per week, working not less than 37.5 hours per week.
  • Extra or flexible hours, including occasional after-hours and weekend support, may be required.

Remote and/or Field Work

  • Remote

Travel

  • Not applicable

PAY TRANSPARENCY

ExpectedCompensation:

  • An annual base salary in the range of $70,000 to $85,000.
  • The salary range listed complies with the OntarioEmployment Standards Actand reflects a potential base salary range for this role. The actual salary offered will be determined within the range, and will depend on factors, such as the candidate’s unique qualifications, relevant experience, work location and expected contributions.

Job Vacancy Reason

Artificial Intelligence

  • AI is not used during our hiring processes.

Applicant and Interviewee Communication

  • We thank all applicants for their interest. However, only those under consideration will be contacted.
  • Applicants who have been interviewed will be informed whether a hiring decision has been made within 45 days of their final interview.

Record Retention

  • Job posting records and associated application forms will be retained for at least three years.

ABOUT CIRCULAR MATERIALS

Circular Materials is a national not-for-profit producer responsibility organization (PRO) that supports producers in meeting their extended producer responsibility (EPR) obligations across Canada. Created by producers for producers, we design, and deliver effective recycling programs that drive advance innovation, improve environmental outcomes and create value across the recycling supply chain.

Through full-service program delivery, including collection, management, promotion, education, and reporting, we are advancing systems where more materials are recycled and returned to producers for use in new packaging and products.

Circular Materials is an equal opportunity employer, committed to building a workforce that reflects diversity of thought, skills, experiences, and backgrounds as we work together to accelerate a circular economy for people and the planet.

We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, including Indigenous Peoples (First Nations, Inuit, and Métis), persons with disabilities, racialized individuals, and members of the 2SLGBTQIA+ community. job.title: Quality Assurance Manager
job.description:
Quality Assurance Manager

Company: Corporate Stays

Department: Operations

Job Type: Full-Time Freelancer

Work Arrangement: Remote
Working Hours: Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM Montreal time
Reports To: COO

About Corporate Stays

Corporate Stays provides furnished accommodations for business travelers, professionals, and extended stays. We focus on delivering comfortable, well-maintained properties and a consistent guest experience across our Canadian markets.

Our operations rely on collaboration between local housekeeping teams, maintenance providers, and operational partners to ensure our apartments meet company standards and provide a high-quality stay for every guest.

Position Overview

The Quality Assurance Manager will be responsible for monitoring, evaluating, and continuously improving the quality of Corporate Stays apartments across Canada.

This role will oversee property inspections, housekeeping quality, maintenance standards, and overall property presentation. Using inspection reports, photographs, guest feedback, and performance data, the Quality Assurance Manager will identify recurring issues, coordinate corrective actions, and ensure service providers consistently meet Corporate Stays' quality standards.

The ideal candidate has experience managing quality across multiple properties, strong analytical skills, and the ability to work effectively with remote teams and local service providers to drive measurable improvements.

Goal of the Position

To ensure that Corporate Stays apartments across Canada consistently meet established quality standards, reduce guest complaints related to cleanliness and property condition, and maintain a structured quality assurance process that supports continuous operational improvement.

Main Responsibilities

  • Monitor the quality of all Corporate Stays apartments across Canada.
  • Review Breezeway inspections, checklists, and photographs to assess property condition, cleanliness, maintenance, and presentation.
  • Identify recurring housekeeping, maintenance, and property presentation issues.
  • Implement and maintain a consistent quality scoring system for each apartment.
  • Establish and monitor quality scores for housekeeping vendors and other service providers.
  • Coordinate remote video inspections and independent local audits to verify property conditions.
  • Analyze guest complaints and reviews to identify quality issues and recurring trends.
  • Establish and continuously improve housekeeping and property presentation standards.
  • Ensure corrective actions are assigned, completed on time, documented, and verified.
  • Develop preventive quality improvement plans based on inspection results, guest feedback, and performance trends.
  • Maintain and improve operational SOPs to support consistent quality standards.
  • Train and coach local service providers on Corporate Stays' quality standards, inspection requirements, and procedures.
  • Coordinate targeted on-site inspections when necessary to investigate recurring issues or verify improvements.
  • Work closely with local operations teams, housekeeping vendors, maintenance providers, and other stakeholders to resolve quality concerns.
  • Track quality performance and identify opportunities to improve processes, vendor accountability, and the overall guest experience.
  • Prepare a weekly quality performance report for Laurence, highlighting results, recurring issues, corrective actions, vendor performance, and areas requiring attention.

Performance Goals (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on the following indicators:

  • Average Property Quality Score: Overall quality scores across the Canadian apartment portfolio.
  • Inspection Pass Rate: Percentage of apartments passing inspections according to established standards.
  • Guest Complaints: Number of complaints related to cleanliness and property condition per 100 stays.
  • Recurring Quality Issues: Number and frequency of repeated housekeeping, maintenance, and property presentation issues.
  • Corrective Action Completion: Percentage of corrective actions completed and verified within the required timeframe.
  • Vendor Quality Performance: Quality scores and consistency of housekeeping vendors and other service providers.

Qualifications

  • At least three years of relevant experience in hospitality operations, serviced apartments, furnished rentals, or short-term rental property management.
  • Experience supervising housekeeping quality and property conditions across multiple properties.
  • Strong familiarity with property inspection tools, quality control processes, and property management software.
  • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Experience coordinating remote teams and working with local contractors or service providers.
  • Ability to establish procedures, monitor performance, and hold service providers accountable for quality standards.
  • Ability to analyze inspection results, guest feedback, and operational data to identify trends and implement corrective measures.
  • Strong attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying and preventing quality issues.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with Breezeway, Hostaway, Guesty, or similar property management and operational platforms.
  • Experience developing property inspection checklists, quality scoring systems, and vendor performance reports.
  • Experience coordinating quality assurance processes across multiple properties or cities.
  • Familiarity with housekeeping operations, maintenance workflows, and furnished apartment presentation standards.

Success Profile

The successful candidate is detail-oriented, analytical, proactive, and comfortable managing quality across a portfolio of properties. They can identify patterns behind recurring issues, communicate expectations clearly, coordinate corrective actions, and ensure service providers follow through.

Success in this role means improving property quality scores, reducing cleanliness and property-condition complaints, strengthening vendor performance, and establishing a reliable quality assurance process across Corporate Stays' Canadian operations.

job.title: Principal Quality Engineer and Technical Integrations Lead
job.description:
This is a remote position.

Title: Principal Quality Engineer and Technical Integrations Lead
Location: USA, Remote
Budget: ​$140-$150 K USD
Job Description
Overview

Reporting to the VP, Head of QA and Technical Enablement, the Principal Quality Engineer and Technical Integrations Lead will play a critical role in ensuring the quality and reliability of Nuuvia’s Lifecycle Banking platform. This hands-on position is responsible for building scalable test automation, validating complex financial technology integrations, and embedding quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

The successful candidate brings strong FinTech experience, knowledge of bank and credit union core systems, and a practical understanding of APIs, digital banking platforms, and payment technologies. This person is a resourceful problem solver who thrives in a fast-moving startup environment, works independently, and uses automation and AI-enabled tools to improve speed, coverage, and effectiveness. They will work not only with engineering teams but also with Implementation and Sales to provide technical integration support to new and existing customer pipelines.

This is a remote, US-based position.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Quality Engineering

  • Develop and execute comprehensive test strategies for web applications, APIs, integrations, and data workflows

  • Create, maintain, and expand automated test suites covering functional, regression, integration, database, and end-to-end testing

  • Validate software across multiple client configurations, environments, and integration partners

  • Investigate defects, document findings clearly, and collaborate with Engineering and Product to drive timely resolution

  • Design and maintain scalable automation frameworks that improve test coverage and accelerate release cycles

  • Support release-readiness activities, including regression testing, production validation, and Go or No-Go recommendations

  • Use AI-assisted development and testing tools to improve test creation, defect analysis, documentation, and troubleshooting

  • Maintain existing systems while supporting growth and technical advancements

  1. FinTech & Core System Validation

  • Test integrations with bank and credit union core processing systems, digital banking platforms, card providers, and third-party services

  • Confirm that integrations meet functional, security, compliance, and client-specific requirements

  • Support implementation teams in diagnosing configuration, data, and integration issues

  • Help with Technical Integrations by reviewing specs, tracking capabilities, and working externally to improve communication and reduce churn

  1. Startup Collaboration

  • Operate effectively in an environment where priorities evolve and team members take broad ownership

  • Work independently, identify gaps, and drive issues through resolution without requiring extensive direction

  • Collaborate closely with Engineering, Product, Implementation, Client Success, and Compliance

  • Balance release speed with product quality, security, and customer impact

  • Contribute to a culture of accountability, curiosity, continuous improvement, and shared ownership of quality

Minimum Required Skills and Qualifications

  • 12 or more years of technical integrations and quality engineering experience

  • Experience testing SaaS and FinTech products in complex, integration-heavy environments

  • Direct experience working with banks, credit unions, and financial-services technology providers

  • Working knowledge of bank or credit union core processing systems and digital banking ecosystems

  • Strong SQL knowledge and experience with database validation testing

  • Experience using AI-assisted engineering or testing tools to improve productivity and quality

  • Previous startup and growth-stage company experience

About InvestEngine

We’re a London-based fintech on a mission to make ETF investing simple and accessible. Over 150,000 clients have trusted us with over £3.5 billion in assets — and we’re just getting started. We’ve been featured by Forbes, MoneyWeek, and Finder, and we’re growing fast with big ambitions.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Middle QA Engineer to join our high-velocityGrowthteam — own quality across the whole customer journey, from landing page and registration through onboarding to analytics, at a high task flow.You’ll work with strict protocols, regulations, and third-party providers to make sure everything runs smoothly.

You’ll collaborate with engineers, product managers, marketers, and external partners, often in English. In this role, you’ll take real ownership of building high-quality, resilient features — perfect for someone proactive, detail-oriented, and eager to grow in a dynamic, cross-functional environment.

What You’ll Do

  • Manually test frontend and backend features

  • Collaborate with developers and marketers to clarify requirements

  • Proactively identify gaps, propose improvements, and help evolve QA processes

  • Perform basic API testing using Postman

  • Write and run simple SQL queries to validate data

  • Use proxy tools for deeper request/response validation

  • Support regression testing in mobile apps when needed

What We’re Looking For

  • 3+ years of manual QA experience, focused on web applications

  • Solid knowledge of test design techniques

  • Hands-on experience testing APIs and working with Postman

  • Technical literacy: HTML/CSS, client-server architecture, and basic debugging

  • Ability to write SQL queries to validate backend logic

  • Confident using proxy tools like Charles or Fiddler

  • Strong critical thinking and analytical skills — not just following test scripts

  • Self-driven, organized, and comfortable working without micromanagement

  • Clear communicator who collaborates well with tech and non-tech teams

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with automation tools or AI-assisted testing (not required, but a plus)

  • Previous experience in product-first companies or marketing-driven environments

How We Work

We’re a lean, fast-moving team that values clarity, ownership, and continuous improvement. You’ll be more than just a ticket-tester — you’ll help shape how we build, ship, and maintain quality across the product.

We expect initiative, not just execution. At the same time, you’ll have support from experienced QA leads and an open, collaborative culture that encourages experimentation and learning.

What We Offer

  • Impact from day one
    You’ll help ship critical features used by tens of thousands of customers.

  • Room to grow
    You’ll have the chance to expand your scope — from owning areas of testing to helping shape team-wide QA practices.

  • Modern tools
    You’ll work with Postman, SQL, and more. And if something’s missing — help us find and adopt it.

  • Transparent and open culture
    We believe in async-first communication, clear ownership, and team visibility.

  • Supportive team
    You’ll collaborate with thoughtful, motivated people across engineering, product, and marketing.

  • Remote and flexible
    We care about outcomes, not location. Work from where you’re most productive.

Our Hiring Process

  1. Intro call with our Talent team

  2. Technical interview with the QA Team

  3. Gamified cognitive assessment to understand how you think and problem-solve

  4. Final conversation with our QA Lead

job.title: QA Practice Lead
job.description:
Join the team building an AI-first company 🚀

Hostinger serves more than 5.5 million clients across 150 countries, but we're still excited about what we're creating next.

AI is changing how we build products, support customers, work together, and solve problems. It helps us move faster, spend less time on repetitive work, and focus on bigger ideas.

If you want your work to influence both what we build and how we build it, we'd like to meet you.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles.

Your role at Hostinger

As a QA Practice Lead, you'll play a key role in shaping the future of quality assurance at Hostinger. You'll lead the evolution of our QA practices by introducing AI-powered testing approaches, improving automation capabilities, and helping QA engineers transition from traditional test execution to orchestrating and validating AI agents.

Working closely with Engineering, Product, AI, and DevOps teams, you'll define the tools, standards, and skills needed to ensure quality across Hostinger's products as we continue to innovate and deliver faster.

This is an opportunity to build a new approach to QA, experiment with emerging technologies, and drive meaningful change across our engineering organization.

Curious to learn more? Connect with your future lead: Asta Dagienė, Head of Delivery

Your day-to-day:

  • Shape and drive Hostinger's QA strategy, introducing AI-powered testing tools, methodologies, and best practices across engineering teams.

  • Experiment with and implement AI agents for test generation, execution, maintenance, and failure analysis.

  • Help QA engineers transition toward AI-assisted workflows by developing their skills in agent orchestration and validation.

  • Establish quality standards and metrics to ensure reliable, efficient, and consistent testing across Hostinger's products.

  • Collaborate with Engineering, Product, AI, and DevOps teams to integrate modern testing solutions into CI/CD pipelines.

  • Drive continuous improvement, encourage innovation, and turn new ideas into scalable QA practices.

What will help you succeed:

  • 5+ years in quality engineering spanning strategy and automation, with a track record of driving change across teams and a clear point of view on how agentic workflows will transform QA.

  • Hands-on experience with test automation frameworks (Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or similar) and programming languages such as JavaScript/TypeScript and Python.

  • Solid understanding of testing strategies, including unit, integration, API, and end-to-end testing, as well as test reliability and automation best practices.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools and agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, MCP, or similar) to improve QA workflows, with the ability to demonstrate practical applications, validate AI-generated results, and measure their impact.

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, Git, scripting, and quality metrics.

  • Strong communication, coaching, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence teams and drive change.

  • Proactive, curious, and adaptable mindset, with a passion for experimenting with emerging technologies.

Benefits you'll love

🚀 360° Growth: You'll never stop learning here. Get access to Reforge and CoachHub, go to global conferences, and borrow from our physical and digital libraries. Depending on your location, you can mentor or be mentored through TesoXchange. People give each other open feedback, share what they know, and take on new projects as their skills grow.

🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work where you do your best work: our offices in Vilnius, Kaunas, Jakarta, or Luxembourg, your home, or anywhere in the world. You plan your own day and own your results, and good ideas go live fast.

💪 Wellness simplified: Your wellbeing comes first. You get time off to recharge, a Headspace subscription, and events focused on wellbeing. Depending on your location, you also get health insurance from day one, a gym membership, regular health checks, and clubs for sports, arts, and hobbies.

🎉 Work hard – play hard: We celebrate wins together at Summerfest & Winterfest, Town Halls, team-buildings, and workations. Meet the Client sessions connect you directly with the people you build for. Milestones outside work matter too, so we celebrate weddings, new parenthood, and graduations with you.

Compensation starts at €6,600 gross/month, depending on your experience and skills.

We're always looking for experienced talent to raise the bar. If you're excited about the role but the listed compensation range doesn't align with your expectations, we still encourage you to apply - we're open to adjusting it based on the impact and value you bring.

Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey 🚀

Three. Two. Onboard

job.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
WHAT WE NEED
Within Hazelcast our Quality Engineering team is dedicated to maintaining the highest standards of software quality for our customers. As part of our team you will be among fellow skilled quality engineers whose focus is to ensure our Java-based real-time distributed storage and stream processing platform meets rigorous quality benchmarks.
We are looking for Software Engineers in Test with strong experience testing Java software platforms to work side by side with our expert Java developers.
In this role, you’ll tackle complex challenges, contribute to our product quality vision and play a key part in delivering reliable, high-performance software that delights our customers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Work closely with software developers to understand the system architecture, design, and implementation to create effective test strategies.
  • Pay attention to code quality and software craftsmanship
  • Participate in code reviews, ensuring that code is designed with test automation in mind.
  • Participating proactively in daily standup meetings, story grooming sessions, team retrospectives, regularly reporting progress as well as suggesting and implementing improvements.
  • Develop detailed test plans, test scripts and test completion reports based on functional and technical specifications.
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance automated testing frameworks for functional and non-functional testing.
  • Design and execute performance, load, and stress tests to ensure the application can scale and perform under heavy traffic or resource constraints.
  • Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to ensure frequent, automated validation of code changes.
  • Monitor the health of test suites and ensure that automated tests run successfully whilst ensuring test environment and test cases are optimized to improve system performance.
  • Investigate test failures and work closely with developers to diagnose and resolve defects and issues.

WHAT YOU HAVE

  • Min. 5 years experience in a Quality Engineering role
  • Min. 5 years experience with Java (building test frameworks and testing Java applications)
  • Experience in Distributed Caching, Compute and Streaming
  • Experience with automation frameworks and tools (JUnit)
  • Experience in non-functional / quality attribute verification.
  • Performance benchmarking (latency and throughput)
  • Resilience testing (chaos and fuzzing)
  • Scalability testing
Knowledge of following are desirable:
  • Demonstrated experience using AI/LLM tools, developing prompts, code, tools and automation that enhance product quality with less friction
  • Experience with CI/CD (Jenkins, Github Actions)
  • Experience with Linux and Bash
  • Experience with Docker, Maven, JFrog
  • Experience with Cloud Platforms such as AWS
  • Experience with Infrastructure Deployment (Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible)
  • Experience with Vulnerability & Compliance Tools (SonarQube, OWASP, Trivy, Blackduck)
  • Experience of Big Data Storage Testing including designing and manipulating test data
  • Experience with development frameworks (Spring, Springboot, VertX, Quartkus)
  • Experience across Enterprise and Opensource solutions
  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field of study (Computer Science, or related discipline) or equivalent experience.
  • Understanding of the QA process (Test Plans, Test Scripts & Test Completion Reports)
PERSONAL QUALITIES
  • A passion for quality as well as for both detecting and preventing defects.
  • Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
  • Efficient at debugging code and resolving issues quickly.
  • Ability to work effectively in a remote team environment, a team player who fosters collaboration.
  • Able to make critical decisions, able to balance quality and time ensuring products and features are released in a timely manner without compromising on critical testing.
  • Inquisitive, using critical thinking to ask lots of questions, overcome biases, break assumptions and consider different perspectives.
  • Able to plan and organise your own work.
  • Deep understanding of testing methodologies such as unit testing, integration testing, regression testing, and non-functional testing (Performance, load, stress, soak).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills to clearly convey complex information and collaborate with cross-functional teams

BENEFITS

  • 25 days annual leave + Bank holidays
  • Group Company Pension Plan
  • Private Medical Insurance
  • Private Dental Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • EAP (Employee Assistance Program)

job.title: Platform Quality Engineer
job.description:
About StarCompliance

StarCompliance is on a mission to make compliance simple and easy. Trusted globally by enterprise financial institutions, the user-friendly STAR platform empowers organizations to achieve regulatory compliance while safeguarding their integrity and business reputations. Through a customizable, 360-degree view of employee activity, the STAR software enables firms to automate the detection and resolution of potential areas of conflict while streamlining daily workflows and increasing efficiency.

Role

The Platform Quality Engineer is a hands-on engineering role within StarCompliance’s centralised Platform Quality Engineering function, responsible for ensuring platform-level quality assurance across the enterprise SaaS platform.
Reporting to the Lead Quality Architect, the Platform Quality Engineer contributes directly to the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated quality controls that validate cross-service integration, core enterprise user journeys, and non-functional platform characteristics. The role is focused primarily on integration and API-level testing across a distributed, cloud-native system, including asynchronous and event-driven workflows.
StarCompliance’s enterprise platform is built on distributed services and cloud infrastructure, including messaging and integration components such as Azure Service Bus. The Platform Quality Engineer is expected to understand how these systems behave under load, failure, and recovery conditions, and how to test them to ensure reliability, resilience, and performance at scale.
The role places strong emphasis on validating failure modes, resilience, and recovery behaviour across distributed services, diagnosing complex system failures using logs, telemetry, and test data, and contributing to enterprise performance testing.
The Platform Quality Engineer works closely with Product Owners and engineering teams to understand upcoming platform changes and integrations, ensuring the enterprise platform is validated under realistic functional and load scenarios ahead of release

Responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain automated tests primarily at the integration and API layers to validate behaviour across distributed services.
  • Develop tests that validate asynchronous and event-driven workflows, including messaging, retries, ordering, and failure scenarios (e.g. Azure Service Bus–based integrations).
  • Contribute production-quality code to shared automation frameworks and quality tooling used across the enterprise platform.
  • Design and execute performance and scalability tests for the enterprise SaaS platform
  • Build and maintain performance test data, scenarios, and workloads that reflect real-world usage patterns, including message throughput and concurrency.
  • Integrate automated functional and performance tests into CI/CD pipelines, contributing to reliable, high-signal quality gates.
  • Support validation activities within the Staging environment as the primary platform integration and quality assurance layer
  • Analyse functional, integration, and performance test results to identify systemic platform risks and improvement opportunities.
  • Partner with Product Owners to understand upcoming platform changes and integrations, preparing targeted integration and performance tests in advance.
  • Collaborate with architecture, platform, and engineering teams to improve system testability, reliability, and observability.
  • Apply AI-assisted engineering tools to accelerate test creation, improve coverage, analyse failures, and reduce test flakiness.
  • Adhere to and contribute to quality standards, patterns, and engineering practices defined by the centralised Platform Quality Engineering function

Skills and Experience

  • Demonstrable experience in platform- or enterprise-scale SaaS application quality assurance, with a focus on validating integration, non-functional characteristics, and release readiness across distributed systems.
  • Strong coding skills in one or more of C#, TypeScript, or Python, with the ability to write clean, maintainable, production-quality code.
  • Demonstrated experience designing and maintaining automated tests at the integration and API layers for distributed, cloud-native systems.
  • Solid understanding of cloud-native architectures and how to test them, including messaging, asynchronous processing, retries, ordering, and failure handling
  • Hands-on experience testing event-driven systems using cloud messaging or integration technologies (e.g. Azure Service Bus, Kafka, SNS/SQS, or similar).
  • Strong hands-on experience with performance testing tools and approaches (e.g. k6, JMeter, Gatling, or similar).
  • Experience designing realistic performance test scenarios and generating representative test data, including load, concurrency, and message-driven workloads.
  • Practical experience integrating functional and performance testing into CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps preferred).
  • Experience diagnosing complex system failures using logs, telemetry, and test data.
  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve productivity, test quality, or failure analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to reason about system behaviour and failure modes in distributed environment

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Relevant certifications in cloud platforms (Azure preferred), performance testing, or quality engineering are beneficial but not required.

AI

  • At StarCompliance, we’re dedicated to leading the way in innovation by seamlessly integrating AI into our offerings. We encourage our team to fully embrace these advanced tools, empowering us to work more efficiently, create with greater precision, and deliver exceptional value to our clients.

    • Integrity and Ethics

  • All StarCompliance employees are expected to commit to a high standard of personal integrity and carry out their responsibilities in an ethical manner

job.title: Senior Software Engineer in Test
job.description:
Overview

Join an amazing team that is consistently recognized for our achievements and culture, including our most recent Forbes award of being one of America's Best Midsize Employers for 2026!

Position Summary:

As a Senior Software Engineer in Test, you will be designing, developing, and maintaining complex software testing framework and tools. This position involves leading project, mentoring junior team members, and ensuring the delivery of high-quality software solutions.

Geo-Salary Information

An in-person interview may be required during the hiring process

State specific pay scales for this role are as follows:

$94,458 to $179,048 (CA, NJ, NY, WA, HI, AK, MD, CT, RI, MA)

$85,871 to $162,771 (NV, OR, AZ, CO, WY, TX, ND, MN, MO, IL, WI, FL, GA, MI, OH, VA, PA, DE, VT, NH, ME)

$77,283 to $146,494 (UT, ID, MT, NM, SD, NE, KS, OK, IA, AR, LA, MS, AL, TN, KY, IN, SC, NC, WV)

The expected base salary for this position will vary depending on a number of factors, including relevant experience, skills and location.

In CA: Typical hiring range is $123,078 to $170,941

Responsibilities

Essential Job Functions:

  • Design, Develop and Maintain Test Automation Frameworks, Tools and Libraries: Develop a strong understanding of relevant product areas, independently implementing and maintaining complex automated tests and medium complex framework features.
  • Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills: Skilled in debugging and resolving simple blocking issues, especially with automation scripts, new frameworks and new tools. Applies analytical and creative approaches to tackle simple quality challenges with solutions.
  • Implement/Enhance Continuous Integration Continuous Deployment (CI / CD): Understanding of automation framework with CI/CD pipelines to facilitate automated testing during the build and deployment processes.
  • Performance Testing Support: Design and implement complex performance test script based on existing automation framework and tools to execute performance tests. Provide analytical and provide feedback for the releases in the test result report.
  • Define and Enforce Automation Standards and Best Practices: Enforcing coding standards, best practices, and guidelines for writing and maintaining automated scripts and framework. Review code written by team members to ensure adherence to standards and provide constructive feedback.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration and Communication: Work closely with cross functional teams and stakeholders to gather requirements and provide simple solutions in framework to meet medium-complex testing needs in small-medium sized team.
  • Create, Monitor and Analyze Test Results: Create, review and analyze test execution results, providing complex insights and simple recommendations based on findings.
  • Training and Mentorship: Train and mentor TE and SETs on using the automation framework to start writing medium automation tests. Training others to diagnose, resolve mid-complex issues and prepare proper documentation to ensure smooth operation.

Qualifications

Education:

Minimum:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or other related fields Or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Experience:

Minimum:

  • 5+ yrs industry experience, independently implementing medium sized automation framework/tools

Preferred:

  • 3 or more years of development experience with Java and/or Python
  • 3 or more years of experience creating automation frameworks
  • 3 or more years of experience developing testing tools

Knowledge and Skills:

Minimum:

  • Familiar with the following:
    • Training, Leading, and Mentorship - Capability to train, lead and mentor junior team members in automation best practices and framework usage.
  • Knowledgeable of the following:
    • Framework Design and Development - Develop a strong understanding of relevant product areas, proficiency in designing and implementing high quality framework, that are modular, configurable, maximize reuse, are fast, effective, user friendly, secure, compliant, stable and maintainable.
    • Develop Testing Tools, Utilities - Develop a strong understanding of relevant product areas, integrate innovative tools, libraries, and technologies into the automation framework to enhance testing capabilities.
    • Create and Maintain Libraries - Proficiency in creating and maintain automated reusable libraries/components to enhance automated capabilities
    • Technologies - Experienced in containerization technologies. Experienced in cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure. Experienced in Leveraging DevSecOps to Improve Engineering Efficiency
    • Release Process and Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) - Agile software development release process, CI/CD practices and tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub) to integrate automated tests into the build process.
    • Performance Testing - Familiarity with performance testing concepts and tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner) to assess system behavior under load.
    • Documentation Skills - Proficiency in documenting framework architecture, components, usage instructions, presentation, and bug report, etc...
    • Requirements Analysis - Analyze [simple/complex] system requirements and design to determine the best approach for testing of the change/implementation.
    • Critical Thinking and Problem-Solving Skills – Debugging and resolving blocking issues, especially in automation scripts, frameworks and tools. Applies analytical and creative approaches to tackle complex quality challenges with innovative solutions.
    • Collaboration and Communication - verbal and written communication skills on executing task-specific collaboration, conveying precise technical details, responding to immediate issues, and ensure clarity in resolving project-level technical challenges
    • Multi-Tasking Skill with Positive Attitude - Multi-Tasking skill with willingness and positive attitude to do whatever it takes to complete tasks on time or as quickly as possible.
    • Product Knowledge - Acquire and apply domain-specific knowledge to ensure that testing efforts align with business objectives and real-world use cases.
    • Test Automation Tools - Experience coding with popular test automation tools and frameworks (e.g., Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, Appium, IDE, Metrics etc.). Knowledge of containerization technologies like Docker and Kubernetes.
    • Debugging and Troubleshooting - Strong skills in diagnosing issues within the automation execution and scripts to ensure smooth operation.
    • Best Coding Practices - Ability to conduct code reviews and provide constructive feedback to ensure quality and adherence to standards and best practice.
  • Experienced with the following:
    • Coding Skills - Strong knowledge of programming languages commonly used in automation, such as Java, Python, or JavaScript.
    • Time Management - Excellent organizational skills to manage multiple testing projects, prioritize tasks to meet deadlines.
    • Adaptability and Flexibility - adapt to changing requirements, code designs and implementation changes, new technologies, methods to solve problems, shift priorities, workstyle and responsibilities.
    • API Testing - Knowledge of API testing methodologies and tools (e.g., Postman, SoapUI, Curl, Insomnia) for validating RESTful and SOAP APIs.
    • Continuous Learning - Commitment to staying updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in test automation and quality assurance.
    • Attention to Detail - Meticulous attention to detail to ensure high-quality automated tests and reliable framework performance.

About the Company

Why choose a career at Mercury?

At Mercury, we have been guided by our purpose to help people reduce risk and overcome unexpected events for more than 60 years. We are one team with a common goal to help others. Everyone needs insurance and we can’t imagine a world without it.

Our team will encourage you to grow, make time to have fun, and work together to make great things happen. We embrace the strengths and values of each team member. We believe in having diverse perspectives where everyone is included, to serve customers from all walks of life.

We care about our people, and we mean it. We reward our talented professionals with a competitive salary, bonus potential, and a variety of benefits to help our team members reach their health, retirement, and professional goals.

Learn more about us here:

Perks and Benefits

Mercury Insurance is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

job.title: CDD/Freelance QA Engineer
job.description:
About

Swan is the leading European fintech specialized in embedded banking. A laureate of the French government’s selective year list of tech champions, “French Tech Next 120,” we are quickly expanding across Europe.

Over 100 European companies have already seamlessly integrated banking services such as accounts, cards, and payments into their products through our Banking-as-a-Service platform. This approach, known as “embedded finance”, empowers businesses to elevate their offerings and create new revenue streams — often times tripling their revenue!

Our founders’ vision from the beginning was Simplicity: that anyone with a fintech idea at 2 am can visit our website, start building, and buy themselves a coffee with a self-issued card the very next day. That vision has taken us far.

Following a 38M€ Series B round last September, we have been doubling our headcount and already have over 230 Swanees across offices in Paris, Bordeaux, Berlin, Barcelona, Amsterdam, and Milan! If you’re excited about joining a European fintech adventure, Swan is the way!

To learn more about us:About Swan;Our story.

Job description

In this role, you will be the QA reference for two product squads at Swan: KYC/Onboarding (how individuals and companies open an account and get verified) and Capital Deposit (how entrepreneurs deposit share capital to incorporate their company). You will join the QA team, which works with every product squad so that Swan ships reliable banking features to its partners. The QA team is small, experienced and close-knit: we share practices and back each other up.

✨ Your mission

Your main mission is to ensure the quality of everything the KYC/Onboarding and Capital Deposit squads release for the duration of the contract, while reducing the automated-test debt on these flows and making good use of AI to test faster and better.

✨ Main Tasks

  • Get up to speed quickly on the onboarding and capital deposit flows, their business rules and their regulatory constraints, and take over QA activities in both squads.

  • Analyze specifications and user stories with Product Managers and engineers, raising ambiguities, missing rules and risks early (shift left).

  • Design risk-based test strategies and functional test cases (ISTQB techniques: equivalence partitioning, boundary values, decision tables, state transitions…) for new features.

  • Execute functional, exploratory and regression testing (UI and API), and validate releases.

  • Automate E2E scenarios with Cucumber (Gherkin) and Playwright (TypeScript) to cover new features and close the existing automation gap, and maintain the existing test suites.

  • Maintain the test repository (Qase) and the requirements repository so that requirements, test cases and coverage stay accurate and traceable.

  • Report bugs clearly, qualify bugs reported by others, follow them up to resolution, and take part in root-cause analyses and post-mortems.

  • Prioritize your work across two squads, and keep both teams informed of test status, risks and blockers.

  • Use AI tools (Claude) to speed up test analysis, test design and test automation, critically review what the AI produces, and share good practices with the QA team.

✨ Curious about your future team?

In this part please provide a short 3 to 4 line paragraph that gives us the scoop on the team such as the composition, internal structure, operational approach, key stakeholders, and any other detail of the team.

You will join a QA team of 4 QA engineers and a QA Platform Engineer led by the QA Manager, inside an Engineering organization of [X]+ people. Each QA engineer is embedded in one or more product squads (4 to 8 engineers with a dedicated Product Manager) that plan their roadmap quarterly and deploy as they go. Day to day, you will work closely with the engineers, Engineering Managers and Product Managers of the KYC/Onboarding and Capital Deposit squads, and with other QA team members.
Within the QA team, we share a common automation framework, common tools (Qase, Linear, Notion, GitHub, home-made requirement repository tool) and an AI-assisted QA pipeline that we keep improving together.

Our technical environment:

  • E2E test automation: Cucumber (Gherkin) + Playwright (TypeScript)

  • Test management: Qase; requirements repository linked to test cases

  • Project management & documentation: Linear, Notion; code & CI: GitHub

  • AI: Claude / Claude Code, used across the QA team to support test analysis, test design and automation

  • Swan's public API is GraphQL

Preferred experience

✨ You’re a great match if:

  • You are a confirmed QA Engineer / software tester (around 4+ years of experience), ideally in an agile product team

  • You can work with several teams at once: you prioritize, you say what will and won't be done, and you keep everyone informed.

  • You are comfortable testing APIs (GraphQL or REST) as well as web interfaces.

  • You have hands-on experience with test automation, ideally Playwright and/or Cucumber/Gherkin, and you are comfortable reading and writing TypeScript (or a similar language).

  • You build good relationships easily, you communicate clearly in writing and out loud, and you can explain a risk or a bug to an engineer, a PM or a business stakeholder alike.

  • You already use AI tools (Claude, Copilot, ChatGPT…) in your testing work, or you are keen to, and you keep a critical eye on what they produce.

  • Experience in banking, fintech or another regulated industry is a strong plus.

  • You know the ISTQB concepts and vocabulary (test levels, test techniques, risk-based testing, defect lifecycle) and apply them pragmatically. An ISTQB certification is a plus.

  • Languages: you are fluent in English and French.

  • Our ideal teammate: Sociable. Skilled. Empathetic. Frank. We love to challenge each other, and we leave our egos at the door 🙂

It’s okay if you don’t tick all the boxes — don’t let imposter syndrome prevent you from applying! 🙌

Swan is committed to providing a caring work environment for all employees, regardless of age, sex, disability, sexual orientation, race, religion, or belief.

When it comes to recruitment, we’re interested in your work experience, skills, and overall personality. Because diversity makes the workplace stronger and is necessary for Swan’s success, we are intensifying efforts to incorporate concrete actions to help us improve in this area.

About Swan

✨ Our values:

Swan’s core values guide our actions daily. Individually, they may seem obvious, but together, they form a unique culture.

Simplicity: Leonardo Da Vinci said: “simplicity is the ultimate sophistication.” If something's convoluted or confusing, we work extra hard to break it down. - Making complex things simple is what we do.

Long Term: We always play the long game, whether it's to support our partners in their growth journey, or make tangible commitments to climate action.

Excellence: We are a team of experts who consistently go all out to create pixel-perfect banking services and exceed our partners' expectations— whatever it takes.

Be Human: We believe in the power of kindness and the importance of acting with integrity. But embracing our humanity extends beyond interpersonal interactions, it means caring about greater issues that affect our planet.

You can find out more about our culture.

Recruitment process

  • A 30-min video call with our Talent Acquisition Manager, to get to know you, understand your career expectations and answer your questions

  • Hiring Manager interview

  • Case study

  • Peer Interview automation, test execution, collaboration

  • Last interview with our CTO

job.description:
Senior QA Automation Engineer

Local Now | Remote (United States)

About Local Now

Local Now is a free, ad-supported streaming service delivering local news, weather, sports, and lifestyle programming to viewers across virtually every connected device. As part of Allen Media Group, we operate at meaningful scale across mobile, smart TVs, streaming sticks, set-top boxes, and the web. We are now investing in a ground-up rebuild of our streaming platform with a privacy-first architecture, modern shared-code strategy, and the engineering rigor needed to grow sustainably.

We build for audiences who expect frictionless playback on any device, and for advertisers who depend on us to deliver reliable, high-quality monetization. The work is tangible: every improvement we make is felt by millions of viewers.

The Role

We are hiring aSenior QA Automation Engineerto lead the design, implementation, and scaling of our automated testing strategy as our LN 2.0 streaming platform launches and stays exceptional across every device family we ship on. You will work closely with our QA Manager and the engineering team to architect test frameworks, design test coverage, and drive end-to-end automation for a product where playback quality and ad reliability directly affect business outcomes.

This is a senior individual-contributor role with high technical ownership. You will be the foundational automation lead in the new QA practice we are building, establishing the tools, standards, and pipelines that will scale with our platform.

What You Will Do

  • Architect, build, and scale maintainable test automation frameworks across mobile, connected TV (CTV) platforms, and web.

  • Drive the test automation roadmap, establishing automation best practices, framework architecture, page-object models, and test data strategies.

  • Integrate automated test suites directly into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Bitrise, Jenkins) for continuous regression, deployment health checks, and release gating.

  • Test video playback (live and VOD), ad insertion (client-side and server-side), and quality-of-experience (QoE) scenarios.

  • Test and debug API/microservice integrations for data integrity, performance, and contract validation.

  • Validate privacy and consent flows: CMP behavior, preference persistence, DSAR-affected paths, and PII boundaries.

  • Report bugs with the rigor that engineers actually want to read — clean repro steps, environments, logs, and severity assessment.

  • Partner with engineering leads on triage, regression coverage, architecture reviews, and quality metrics.

  • Contribute to a device lab strategy and solve the practical realities of automating and testing across many CTV platforms.

What We Are Looking For

  • 5+ years of QA experience on consumer software, with at least 3 years leading automation efforts on multi-platform mobile and/or CTV products.

  • Proven track record of architecting automated test frameworks from scratch for web, mobile, or CTV using modern tools (e.g., Playwright, Appium, Detox, XCUITest, Espresso, or Robot Framework).

  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining automated CI/CD test pipelines.

  • Streaming video QA experience — playback, manifests, ad pods, DRM, QoE.

  • Hands-on testing and automation familiarity on Roku, Fire TV, Apple TV, Android TV, Tizen, or Vizio platforms.

  • Strong analytical and bug-investigation skills; able to isolate environmental, timing, and platform-specific issues.

  • Clear written communication; excellent at writing reproducible bug reports and concise automation docs and test plans.

  • Self-directed technical leader who thrives in a remote, distributed engineering culture.

Nice to Have

  • Experience with consent / privacy testing or compliance-driven regression suites.

  • Hands-on experience using AI tools like Cursor and Claude to accelerate test authoring, triage, and analysis.

  • Experience setting up physical or cloud-based device farms (e.g., AWS Device Farm, Sauce Labs, HeadSpin) for automated CTV/mobile testing.

Overview:

FinteqHub is expanding the team and is looking for an experienced QA Tech Lead to help strengthen test coverage and develop its testing approach.

About Product:

Finteqhub

А PCI DSS certified payment gateway for online businesses, providing integration with payment systems via a single software platform.
Learn more

Purpose of the role:

FinteqHub is looking for a QA Tech Lead to shape how our engineering teams approach testing and to help them make good testing decisions on their own. You'll be based in the Payment Integrations team. There you'll drive the migration of our API tests from Java to Go and Gonkey, and from there you'll develop QA practice across all teams.

Our stack: Go, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Kubernetes. Tests are written in Go, Gonkey (YAML), TypeScript and Playwright, with reporting in ReportPortal and mobile testing on BrowserStack.

Key responsibilities:

  • Audit the legacy Java API test suite and decide what to keep, what to retire, and what should move to a lower test level.

  • Oversee the AI-assisted migration of tests to Go and Gonkey, and make sure no critical checks are lost.

  • Close coverage gaps in line with the test pyramid, starting with scenarios where money is at risk.

  • Help every team define and document its own test strategy and pyramid, and review them.

  • Advise team leads and automation engineers on testing decisions, with a clear view of the risk and cost of each option.

  • Own regression: plan the runs, distribute the checks and report status. Keep daily and nightly runs healthy: tackle flaky tests, and make sure every failure has an owner and a deadline.

  • Lead the investigation of cross-team defects: bring the right people together, find where the problem is and get it reproduced.

  • Set shared QA standards and tooling: ReportPortal, TMS, and formats for test cases and bug reports.

  • Bring AI into everyday testing: agents write tests, engineers review them.

  • Run a biweekly QA sync, mentor engineers, and help manual QAs move into automation.

  • Expand UI test automation as the next stage.

Required Experience:

  • Senior or Lead-level experience in test automation, with a strong focus on API testing.

  • You have built a test strategy and test pyramid from scratch, in more than one product.

  • A track record of changing testing practices across several teams.

  • Strong test design skills: you build coverage from requirements and specs, not just automate existing cases.

  • You see the system as a whole and understand the product, not just the framework.

  • You know where a unit test is enough and where e2e is needed.

  • Ability to align teams and drive decisions without formal authority.

  • Mentoring experience.

  • Experience writing tests in several languages and frameworks, and you pick up new tools quickly.

  • You read Java well enough to audit and migrate an existing test suite.

  • Solid understanding of REST/HTTP, JSON and API contract testing.

  • Hands-on experience with k8s, Docker, PostgreSQL and any message broker.

  • Experience with CI pipelines, investigating failures across services through logs, metrics and the DB, and stabilising flaky tests.

  • You use AI in your daily QA work: generating tests from specs, porting tests between languages, analysing failures, reviewing code.

  • You also know where AI gets things wrong.

  • At least Intermediate level of English.

  • Native-level Russian.

Nice to have:

  • Go (a strong plus).

  • Experience with TypeScript and Playwright.

  • Experience migrating a test suite from one stack to another.

  • Experience building AI-based tooling or agents for QA tasks.

  • Mobile testing experience, including BrowserStack.

  • Experience in fintech or payment systems (payment flows, callbacks, idempotency, reconciliation).

  • Experience with API testing tools.
