job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our Quality Engineering team and help ensure the reliability, security, and overall quality of our cybersecurity products. You will play a key role in defining, leading, and scaling quality assurance across our platform, with a strong emphasis on test automation.

This is a hands-on senior individual contributor role. You will lead our web application test automation efforts, designing and evolving automated testing solutions with Playwright and JavaScript, and integrating automated testing throughout the software development lifecycle. You will also mentor junior QA and automation engineers and influence engineering practices across teams.

Requirements

QA Strategy & Leadership

  • Lead the design and execution of QA strategies, frameworks, and automated test plans across multiple products
  • Identify high-value opportunities for automation and help define the team's automation strategy and roadmap
  • Participate in requirements and design reviews to identify quality risks and testability concerns early in the development lifecycle
  • Define meaningful quality metrics and provide visibility into automation coverage, reliability, and product quality
  • Continuously evaluate testing tools, techniques, and approaches, and drive improvement of QA processes aligned with engineering goals

Test Automation & Infrastructure

  • Lead the design, development, and ongoing improvement of our automated testing framework using Playwright and JavaScript
  • Develop reliable, maintainable, and reusable automated tests for browser-based cybersecurity applications, with coverage across backend, frontend, and infrastructure components
  • Establish and promote automation architecture, coding standards, design patterns, and testing best practices
  • Own and enhance CI/CD-integrated testing infrastructure, including quality gates and feedback mechanisms, for consistent validation across environments
  • Review existing automation and improve its reliability, maintainability, execution speed, and coverage
  • Diagnose and resolve flaky tests, automation failures, and complex application or environment issues
  • Analyze test results to distinguish product defects from automation, environment, and test-data issues
  • Contribute to our growing suite of automated security checks (e.g., SAST/DAST and dependency scanning) in CI/CD pipelines

Team Enablement & Collaboration

  • Mentor junior QA and automation engineers, conduct code reviews, and provide technical guidance
  • Partner with software engineers, product managers, security teams, and QA engineers to develop effective test strategies for new features and releases
  • Advocate for quality engineering practices and help shift testing earlier in the development lifecycle
  • Promote a culture of quality and accountability

What You Bring

Required:

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance, Quality Engineering, Software Development Engineering in Test (SDET), or a similar role
  • Strong experience designing and developing automated tests for modern web applications
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright, preferably using JavaScript or TypeScript, with emphasis on designing scalable automation frameworks rather than solely creating individual test cases (experience with Cypress, Selenium, Jest, or similar is a plus)
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies, including functional, integration, regression, end-to-end, and negative testing
  • Strong experience integrating automated tests with CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI) and source-control workflows
  • Experience testing complex applications involving role-based access controls, permissions, multi-tenant environments, or security policies
  • Experience mentoring junior engineers and providing constructive technical feedback through code reviews
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally

Preferred:

  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, or similar technologies
  • Experience in security-critical, high-availability, or infrastructure-heavy systems
  • Familiarity with API security, authentication flows, and data protection practices
  • Experience leading QA initiatives in Agile environments
  • Familiarity with security testing tools (e.g., OWASP ZAP, Burp Suite, SAST/DAST)

What Success Looks Like:

Success means moving beyond simply increasing the number of automated tests. You will build an automation ecosystem that engineers trust: tests that are reliable, maintainable, appropriately scoped, and give rapid feedback when something goes wrong. You will become a technical leader within the QA organization, helping decide what to automate, how to automate it, and how automation fits into the broader development process, while growing the engineers around you.

You as a Person

  • Knowledge: Deep expertise in QA automation and CI/CD workflows
  • Skill: Builds scalable testing systems and mentors others in quality practices
  • Ability: Influences teams and drives improvements in product quality

You in the Role

  • Autonomy: Owns and evolves QA and test automation across multiple products
  • Complexity: Solves complex quality challenges across the full stack
  • Impact: Ensures consistent, high-quality product releases

Extra Credit

  • QA certifications such as ISTQB, or security certifications such as OSCP, CEH, or CSSLP
  • Experience with SaaS platforms or networking-intensive solutions
  • Hands-on experience with cloud security and compliance (FedRAMP, SOC 2, ISO 27001)

Benefits

Why Dispel/Benefits

At Dispel you’ll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

  • Base salary: $90,000 – $120,000
  • 401(k) with company match
  • Generous paid time off and holidays
  • Performance bonus and equity eligible
  • Remote work
  • Medical, vision, dental insurance

job.title: AI-Native Software Engineer, QA Automation
job.description:
AI-Native Software Engineer, QA Automation — Mid to Senior | Zenara Health

Location: Remote - India

Type: Full-time

Working Hours: All meetings and live collaboration happen between approximately 6:00 PM and 12:00 AM IST, overlapping US Pacific Time. Attendance in that window is required. Your remaining work is yours to schedule.

Commitment: Approximately 50 hours per week

Industry: Healthcare technology experience is preferred but not mandatory

About the Company

Zenara Health is a technology-oriented mental healthcare organization building clinical software for behavioral-health clinics. Our products include Assess and Zenflow, which support assessments, care management, clinical workflows, and operational delivery .

We are a startup, not a department. We are building an AI-native engineering team where quality must scale at the same speed as development.

About the Role

We are looking for an AI-Native Software Engineer focused on QA Automation.

This is not a manual testing role.

This is not a role for someone who simply clicks through test cases.

This is a software engineering role for someone who builds systems that prove whether the product works.

Our developers build with AI agents. That means code can arrive faster than traditional QA can review it by hand. We need a QA automation engineer who can build the testing harness, automated checks, synthetic data, test environments, and agent-driven QA workflows that keep up with agent-speed development .

Here is the test: can you build a test system, seed a real bug, prove the test catches it, and explain what is still unverified?

We are not looking for someone who signs off work because it “looks fine.” We are looking for someone who demands evidence.

Our AI-Native QA Vision

QA at Zenara is not a downstream gate. It is an engineering platform.

We are building toward a system where product requirements can become test plans, test data, automated browser and API checks, evidence reports, failure routing, and release confidence — with agents helping create and run the work, and engineers governing the quality.

You will help design and operate this QA system, including:

  • Browser and API test runners
  • Synthetic test data
  • Isolated test environments
  • Requirement-to-test workflows
  • Automated checks on every change
  • Agent-driven QA workflows
  • Evidence generation for releases
  • Flaky-test reduction
  • Failure routing and debugging
  • Quality metrics and release confidence

The goal is not to automate bad testing. The goal is to build a system that catches real defects before customers do.

What You’ll Do

  • Build and maintain the QA automation harness across browser, API, data, and workflow layers.
  • Create automated checks that run on every meaningful change.
  • Build synthetic test data and isolated test environments.
  • Own the UAT/QA automation pipeline from requirement to test plan to run to evidence.
  • Use AI agents to help generate, execute, improve, and debug tests.
  • Build independent agent-driven QA workflows that test the work of code-writing agents.
  • Prove tests work by reintroducing known bugs and showing they fail correctly.
  • Reduce flaky tests and distinguish real product failures from environment noise.
  • Produce reliable QA evidence for releases.
  • Work with engineering and product to define quality gates for critical user journeys.

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong software engineering ability: you can design, write, debug, and maintain code.
  • Experience with test automation using Playwright, Cypress, API testing frameworks, or similar tools.
  • CI/CD experience and comfort wiring tests into build and release workflows.
  • Practical experience using AI agents to create or improve tests.
  • Strong judgment about whether a test actually proves anything.
  • Ability to seed a bug, run a test, and demonstrate that the test catches the failure.
  • Comfort debugging flaky tests, environment issues, and test data problems.
  • Skeptical, evidence-driven thinking.
  • Clear communication around risk, coverage, and release confidence.

Our Current Stack

  • TypeScript
  • Node.js, Hono
  • React
  • Prisma, PostgreSQL
  • Redis, BullMQ
  • Playwright
  • Azure AKS, Blob Storage, Azure Monitor / OpenTelemetry
  • Terraform, Helm, CI pipelines
  • Medplum / FHIR
  • Flowable
  • Claude Code, Codex
  • Dify-based AI workflows

What “AI-Native QA” Means for This Role

For this role, being AI-native means you can:

  • Use agents to generate test ideas, test code, and edge cases.
  • Review agent-created tests critically.
  • Build workflows where agents test independently from the agents that wrote the code.
  • Use AI to analyze failures and propose debugging paths.
  • Create repeatable quality gates that scale with development speed.
  • Measure whether AI-generated tests are actually useful.
  • Avoid false confidence from tests that pass without proving behavior.

The point is not to have more tests. The point is to have trustworthy evidence.

Nice to Have

  • Healthcare or regulated-software experience.
  • Experience testing AI-powered features, including output quality.
  • Experience building test environments and synthetic data.
  • Performance or load testing experience.

What Success Looks Like

In your first 30 days, you will map the current QA setup, agree the highest-risk user journeys, and deliver one automated end-to-end QA lane that runs on every change and catches a known bug .

Within your first 90 days, key journeys for Assess and Zenflow will be covered automatically, every release will have QA evidence, and flaky-test rate and run time will be measured and improving .

Over time, success means building a mature agentic QA platform where escaped defects are low and QA throughput keeps pace with agent-speed development .

Outside required collaboration, we care about output, reliability, and quality.

Compensation and Benefits

  • Competitive compensation, based on demonstrated ability and experience
  • Fully remote work
  • Equipment allowance
  • Direct access to the founder and Head of Engineering
  • The opportunity to build the QA function as an engineering platform from the ground up

Who Will Thrive in This Role

This role is well suited to someone who:

  • Thinks like an engineer, not a manual checklist executor.
  • Enjoys building tools, systems, and automation.
  • Is naturally skeptical and evidence-driven.
  • Cares about proving behavior, not just producing green checkmarks.
  • Wants to make QA scale with AI-native development.
  • Likes working in fast-moving, ambiguous startup environments.

You may struggle if you only have manual testing experience, cannot code, sign off work without evidence, or write tests that pass regardless of whether the product is correct .

If you want to build the quality system for an AI-native software team, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: QA Lead
job.description:
In short

We're looking for an experienced QA Lead to take ownership of quality assurance across our mobile and IoT projects. You'll design test strategies, raise the bar on QA practices, build up the chapter, and mentor a team of testers who already know what they're doing. This is a permanent role: B2B contract, monthly salary, full benefits, and you'd be reporting to the CTO on QA direction across the company.

Why intent?

We've been designing and co-creating connected devices since 2008. Wearables, smart audio, health-tech hardware for clients like Oura and BOSE, backed by investors like a16z and Founders Fund. We're 60+ people, fully remote, and AI-native since before LinkedIn influencers discovered the term. QA here isn't "click through the screens": it's mobile apps talking to firmware over BLE, sensor pipelines, edge cases that only appear at -10°C with a flat battery. The bugs are real, the stakes are real, and good QA leadership changes whether a product ships well or limps out the door.

Who this role is NOT for

If your version of QA leadership is reviewing test cases and writing weekly reports, this isn't going to work. We're not hiring someone to manage a team that already runs itself. We're hiring someone who shapes how testing is done across mobile and IoT projects, decides what tooling we invest in, and pushes the whole chapter forward. If you need full specs to make a call, if "that's not in scope" is a sentence you use often, or if you'd rather not be the one explaining quality trade-offs to a US client at 18:30, we're probably not your people. We're AI-native and we expect you to treat AI as a daily multiplier, not a gimmick.

What you'll do

  • Plan, design, and execute comprehensive testing strategies for IoT and mobile products

  • Lead and mentor the QA team: guide test design, review approaches, run knowledge-sharing

  • Introduce modern QA tools and practices, including test automation and CI/CD integration

  • Define and track quality metrics, and continuously improve testing efficiency

  • Work directly with the CTO on QA direction across the company

  • Collaborate with developers, PMs, and clients to define acceptance criteria and coverage

  • Oversee the full range of testing: compatibility, functional, integration, E2E, automated, performance, security, regression

  • Run quality work end to end: from raw BLE signal capture all the way to cloud data validation

  • Use AI tools as part of your daily workflow, not as a party trick

How we work

Fully remote. We have a pet-friendly office in Warsaw and a coworking space in Gdansk if walls and coffee machines motivate you, but nobody will ask why you're not there. Working hours are flexible: most of the team operates between 10:00 and 18:00 CET, and that's when most meetings happen. Evening calls with US-based clients (up to ~20:00) are part of the rhythm, sometimes a couple of times a week, always planned ahead. You'll lead the QA chapter for the whole company, and at the same time be embedded in a project squad led by a PM for day-to-day delivery.

What you'll get

  • 20,500-28,000 PLN/month net B2B, depending on your experience

  • 26 days of paid leave

  • 10 days of paid sick leave

  • Saltus medical care

  • Self-development budget (2,000 PLN/year)

  • Truly flexible hours: you organize your day

  • Fully remote, with pet-friendly Warsaw office + Gdansk cowork if you want them

  • All necessary equipment provided

  • Internal knowledge-sharing: tech talks, team sessions, library and conference budgets

Your first months

We aim to give you space to ramp up before owning the chapter direction, but this is a real company with real deadlines: if a project needs you sooner, we'll make sure you have the support to hit the ground running. You'll get paired with a buddy, meet the team, and start with real tasks while being guided by leadership. Monthly HR check-ins, real feedback after month two, and a proper review after month three. No one waits three months to tell you something isn't working: if it's great, you'll know; if something needs adjusting, you'll hear about it while there's still time to adjust.

Recruitment process

The entire process is in English. All interviews are recorded for internal evaluation purposes.

  1. Application with a few screening questions

  2. HR call, ~45 min, casual

  3. Short take-home task (~60 min)

  4. Technical meeting, ~90 min, with the CTO

  5. Final feedback within a few days

Once we're in touch, you'll hear from us fast. We don't ghost and we don't drag.

One more thing

intent is an equal opportunity employer. We care about what you can do, not where you come from. Send us your CV and a few words about why this caught your eye. Bonus points if you share an improvement you introduced in a previous QA team that actually moved the needle, the specifics matter more than the title.

Requirements

What we're looking for

  • 6+ years in software testing, ideally mobile and IoT

  • 2+ years leading a QA team, with real ownership of how testing gets done

  • Hands-on with test case management (Qase, TestRail) and the Atlassian stack (Jira, Confluence)

  • Solid manual AND automated testing experience: Cypress, Appium, Postman, Robot Framework

  • Strong understanding of BLE, API testing, and cloud platforms (AWS, Firebase)

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with serious attention to detail

  • English at B2+, written and spoken, because our clients are mostly US-based

  • Leadership mindset: you grow people, you don't just review their work

  • Initiative, ownership, and the kind of communication where people don't have to guess what you meant

Nice to have

  • Hardware-in-the-loop test setups

  • Experience scaling QA practices in a software house or product company

  • Working knowledge of MQTT, NFC, Wi-Fi, Thread, or similar IoT protocols

  • ISTQB Advanced or higher

  • Genuine curiosity about the devices you test, not just the screens on top of them

job.title: Senior QA Engineer
job.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

QUALITY ASSURANCE

What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is in the business of creating fun games we want to play and building the art and tools we need to bring those games to life. We provide our engine technology to developers around the world and consistently strive to stay on the cutting edge of our industry. We iterate to improve everything, every day: our games, our technology, our processes, even our workspaces and people. This unrelenting focus on innovation and quality defines us.

Our QA Engineers work with product owners, developers, and QA management to define acceptance criteria, identify risks, and plan testing coverage for upcoming features and releases. QA Engineers develop and implement automation utilizing technical tooling, including Al, to expand QA coverage across multiple features. You will facilitate functional, qualitative, and performance testing efforts while using a mix of technical testing skills across your product space to analyze and report on quality. At the senior level the expectation is to be able to work in a highly autonomous environment within the gameplay pillar while regularly keeping stakeholders informed of potential quality risks.

In this role, you will

  • Work with QA analysts, QA management, product owners, and other developers to define acceptance criteria, identify risks, plan test coverage, and, crucially, build tooling and automation to improve efficiency across the team
  • Examine technical gaps and automation initiatives to ensure quality for both Unreal Engine and Unreal Editor for Fortnite (UEFN) developer tools and build
  • Build and drive test strategies and test plans to cover multiple features in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
  • Use a mix of technical and manual QA skills to execute a variety of testing techniques across the product to analyze quality while discovering or troubleshooting reported defects and internal issues
  • Leverage Al-assisted tools to speed up test plan, automation, and strategy where possible
  • Report and track data quality and use that data to drive conversations around product quality and development health, supporting the dev team before, during, and after deployments
  • Test communications between the client and backend services

What we're looking for

  • Strong experience and demonstrated skills in writing test automation or QA tools, as well as reading code or scripts in multiple languages (C++/C#/Python)
  • Experience developing test plans and risk mitigation strategies
  • Experience using Al tools and judgement about when their output can be trusted
  • QA cross team project or feature leadership, including mentoring more junior employees, providing cross team QA plans, and owning test quality improvements - gap analysis or optimization efforts
  • QA Engineer skills & strengths at a senior level, which includes, strong communication skills and ability to confidently collaborate with stakeholders and with partner teams, the ability to provide mentorship and lead projects, and deliver high quality work products; looks for and suggests ways to improve / optimize/close testing gaps

This role is open to multiple locations across the US (including WA).

Pay Transparency Information

The expected annual base pay range(s) for this position are detailed below. Each base pay range is relevant only for individuals who are residents of or will be expected to work within the specified locale. Compensation varies based on a variety of factors, which include (but aren’t limited to) things such as skills and competencies, qualifications, knowledge, and experience. In addition to base pay, most employees are eligible to participate in Epic’s generous benefit plans and discretionary incentive programs (subject to the terms of those plans or programs).

$89,107—$130,690 USD

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

Epic Games deeply values diverse teams and an inclusive work culture, and we are proud to be an Equal Opportunity employer. Learn more about our Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Policy here.

job.title: Consumer Compliance Lead - Product Advisory & Testing
job.description:
About Nu

Nu serves more than 140 million customers, guided by a mission to fight complexity and empower people. The company has been leading an industry transformation through innovative products and human-centered services.

 

Proprietary technology and data at scale power Nu’s digital platform, built to promote financial access, advancement, and transparency. Its business model thrives on customer love and lower costs, feeding a flywheel of growth and profitability.

Visit our Institutional Page

About the team

At Nu, Compliance is a strategic partner—not a tollgate. We view effective Risk Management & Compliance as the engine that maintains agility and empowers rapid, responsible growth across multiple global markets. Our team partners directly with internal clients using a targeted friction approach: we focus on the most relevant regulatory risks and embed compliance directly into product design rather than distributing rules after the fact.

The Global Compliance function serves as the Second Line of Defense, responsible for the full regulatory lifecycle: tracking new regulations, advising product and technology teams, testing controls, coordinating regulatory inspections, and monitoring remediation of regulatory issues.

This role is positioned at a pivotal moment. Nu has received conditional approval for a US National Bank Charter. Reporting to the Head of US Compliance, this individual contributor will independently assess complex regulatory questions, influence product and operational decisions, and lead compliance reviews from planning through reporting and remediation validation. The role also contributes to policy development, compliance risk reporting, and advice on regulatory issues.

Success requires strong regulatory judgment, practical experience evaluating controls, and the ability to turn complex requirements and findings into clear, actionable recommendations. You should be comfortable establishing processes, managing competing priorities, and driving work to completion in an evolving business.The role requires someone who can build from scratch, own outcomes, and operate with an entrepreneurial mindset in a highly regulated environment.

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced consumer compliance professional to lead product compliance advisory engagements and internal compliance testing and monitoring across Nu’s US consumer banking products, including deposits, credit cards, and personal loans.

Reporting to the US Head of Compliance, this manager-level individual contributor will independently assess complex regulatory questions, influence product and operational decisions, and lead compliance reviews from planning through reporting and remediation validation. The role also contributes to policy development, compliance risk reporting, and advice on regulatory issues.

Success requires strong regulatory judgment, practical experience evaluating controls, and the ability to turn complex requirements and findings into clear, actionable recommendations. You should be comfortable establishing processes, managing competing priorities, and driving work to completion in an evolving business.

What you will do

Product Compliance Advisory

  • Serve as a primary compliance advisor to Product, Engineering, Operations, Marketing, and other business teams throughout the product lifecycle, from initial design and launch through servicing.

  • Independently interpret applicable federal and state consumer financial protection requirements and translate them into practical product requirements, controls, and business guidance.

  • Review proposed products, features, customer journeys, disclosures, marketing materials, and operational processes to identify compliance risks and recommend workable solutions.

  • Assess the compliance implications of product and process changes, documenting advice, material risks, and matters requiring escalation.

  • Provide effective challenge to business decisions and control designs, working with stakeholders to resolve concerns and escalating material or unresolved risks.

  • Evaluate relevant regulatory developments and enforcement trends and advise business partners on necessary changes.

Compliance Testing & Monitoring

  • Develop and execute risk-based compliance testing and monitoring coverage, prioritizing products, processes, and controls based on regulatory obligations, customer impact, and emerging risks.

  • Lead reviews from scoping through completion, including defining objectives, developing test procedures, selecting samples, evaluating evidence, and documenting conclusions.

  • Assess whether controls are appropriately designed and operating effectively, including whether customer outcomes and business practices meet applicable requirements.

  • Produce clear, well-supported findings and reports that explain the regulatory concern, supporting evidence, customer impact, and recommended corrective action.

  • Establish and maintain monitoring indicators that help identify compliance weaknesses, recurring exceptions, and changes in risk.

  • Evaluate remediation plans, track corrective actions, and validate that completed remediation addresses identified issues.

Policy, Risk Reporting & Issue Advisory

  • Draft and update consumer compliance policies and standards, and advise business owners on related procedures.

  • Contribute to compliance risk assessments and management reporting, communicating significant findings, trends, and unresolved exposures.

  • Advise on issue assessment, root cause analysis, customer impact, and corrective action, with business owners accountable for implementing remediation.

What we are looking for

Required

  • Substantial experience in US consumer compliance at a bank, financial institution, or fintech, with demonstrated responsibility for both product advisory and compliance testing or monitoring.

  • Strong working knowledge of consumer financial protection requirements relevant to deposits and unsecured lending, including TILA/Regulation Z, ECOA/Regulation B, EFTA/Regulation E, TISA/Regulation DD, FCRA/Regulation V, and UDAAP.

  • Demonstrated ability to research and interpret regulatory requirements, exercise sound judgment in ambiguous situations, and develop defensible recommendations.

  • Hands-on experience designing and executing compliance reviews, evaluating controls, documenting findings, and validating remediation.

  • Ability to analyze operational and customer data to identify exceptions, assess customer impact, and support conclusions.

  • Strong writing and communication skills, including the ability to explain complex requirements and influence decisions across technical, business, and leadership audiences.

  • Proven ability to independently own significant workstreams, establish priorities, and escalate issues appropriately.

Preferred experience

  • Compliance advisory or testing across digital deposit, credit card, or personal loan products.

  • Experience with building compliance capabilities for a new or growing bank or fintech.

  • Experience using data analytics or automation to improve compliance monitoring and testing.

  • CRCM preferred, but not required.

 

Work Setup

Location

Miami, Florida

Work model

Hybrid 2-3 times/week: Our hybrid work model brings us to the office at least twice a week, on strategic days designed to maximize team connection and collaboration. For more details, visit https://building.nubank.com/nu-hybrid-work-model/

Office requirement

2 days per week at the office.

 

Our Benefits

  • Opportunity of earning equity at Nu

  • Medical Insurance

  • Dental and Vision Insurance

  • Life Insurance and AD&D

  • Extended maternity and paternity leaves

  • Nucleo - Our learning platform of courses

  • NuLanguage - Our language learning program

  • NuCare - Our mental health and wellness assistance program

  • 401K

  • Saving Plans - Health Saving Account and Flexible Spending Account

  • Work-from-home Allowance

  • Relocation Assistance Package, if applicable.

Our recruitment process may involve the use of artificial intelligence–enabled tools, such as automated interview transcription and analysis, to support the evaluation process. Artificial intelligence is not used to make final hiring decisions; all decisions are made by human reviewers.

To maintain a consistent and fair process for every candidate, Nu does not provide individualized technical feedback. See how our policy works here

job.description:
Join the ASI Partners family as a legacy person you can come back to or refer others to as a government career source and interview for a direct-hire REMOTE opportunity with a major subcontractor on a long-term contract (potential to 2029) serving a massive IT modernization effort at the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

We are looking for a fully-certified Salesforce Quality Assurance guru with at least 7 years ideally doing QA with the government Cloud working on Salesforce/Mulesoft, Agile CI/CD, Security model, Apex, LWC, etc.

Having a Public Trust clearance, a SECRET level government clearance, or having a higher-level clearance would expedite your start date on the contract, but we will also consider strong candidates interested in government service that can stay in place for 4-8 weeks while the clearance process finalizes. WE CAN ONLY ACCEPT U.S. CITIZENS and will verify personal information after the initial interview was successful to move forward.

So, what is the major modernization effort?

Older modernization roadmaps lacked long-term retirement strategies for core mainframes so IRS leadership rolled out a new technical framework stretching through 2029 with heavy emphasis on building a Unified API Layer to unlock legacy data. The IRS plans to wrap up its move toward a single, unified Enterprise Case Management (ECM) system. This platform will consolidate siloed databases and allow employees to support taxpayers from a single interface.

Fiscal Year 2028 Target: This is the projected completion window for updating the critical Individual Master File (IMF). The IMF has processed individual taxpayer data since 1970 using outdated COBOL and Assembly Language Code. The IRS aims to fully convert this core code into modern, developer-friendly Java.

By establishing a solid data structure and robust DevOps pipeline (using tools like SFDX and Git), the subcontractor we are hiring for helps create the stable infrastructure required for the IRS Office of Chief Counsel, the Taxpayer Advocate Service, and the Office of Appeals to safely adopt these modern AI systems.

Tech contests and other perks in addition to great HR benefits

Among great benefits like three weeks PTO, parental leave, and top of the line options for medical/dental/vision benefits and 401K, our subcontractor holds AI application contests that can land you an additional $10K for a good concept, and sets KPI metrics which awards up to $20K additional for meeting those metrics. They will certify you for free including also Agentforce certification. There are other great perks such as optional trips for people interested in cross-project management and discount programs. The company is stable, growing, and has been around for 20 years.

They are looking for a number of people, including the below position, so if you do not meet the criteria for this one, ASI Partners will interview you and we can offer other options if you meet the qualifications for those. Please read the below for the job requirements and qualifications needed for this exciting multi-year project for the IRS and apply immediately if you are interested. We will be choosing our team in the next 20 days already so go ahead and apply now with a solid resume if interested.

Salesforce Quality Assurance II
A Salesforce Quality Assurance II leads end-to-end test lifecycle management for functional Salesforce areas, including advanced Agentforce/Einstein AI behavioral validation and automated regression engineering.

Key Duties & Responsibilities
•Test Strategy & Planning: Design and execute detailed test plans, including functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing.
•Automation & CI/CD: Own and maintain automated test suites (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright) and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines.
•Requirements Analysis: Translate business, user, and technical requirements into comprehensive test cases, covering both positive and negative scenarios.
•Defect Management: Identify, document, and track defects in tools like Jira or ALM; participate in root cause analysis and triage sessions.
•Collaboration: Work closely with developers, business analysts, and operations to validate fixes, ensure traceability between test cases and requirements, and provide quality updates to stakeholders.
•Performance & Security Testing: Validate system performance, security controls, accessibility, and governance compliance.
•Process Improvement: Contribute to refining testing procedures, automation frameworks, and QA standards.
•Agile Participation: Engage in Agile/Scrum ceremonies such as backlog refinement and sprint planning.

Qualifications
•Education: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent experience.
•5-8 years of QA experience with 3+ years on Salesforce Government Cloud; Salesforce Certified Administrator+ AI Specialist required; active Public Trust or Secret clearance required
•Expert in integration testing (Postman, SoapUI), MuleSoft middleware validation, and leading defect triage/sprint planning within Agile delivery framework.
•Salesforce Skills: Salesforce Administrator, Platform App Builder, and familiarity with declarative features.
•Technical Skills: Strong problem-solving, root cause analysis, and consultative approach; experience with test automation tools and CI/CD pipelines .
•Certifications: ISTQB Foundation/Advanced, Agile Tester, AWS Cloud Practitioner, or Salesforce certifications are valuable .

Salary: $100,000 – $130,000 / year

We’re looking for an outstanding Quality Assurance Engineer to join our team. This role is available across our primary LATAM hub in Peru.

Who you are

You are a pragmatic, detail-oriented quality engineer who enjoys ensuring that complex software systems work reliably for the people who use them. You bring strong experience with both manual and automated testing, communicate clearly with clients and technical peers, and adapt easily across industries, applications, and technical stacks. You understand that quality is a shared responsibility and enjoy collaborating closely with engineers, product teams, and clients throughout the software development lifecycle. You are curious about new tools—including AI tools that improve your productivity and the effectiveness of your testing.

What you will be doing

  • Work directly with clients to understand business requirements, identify quality risks, and develop effective testing strategies.

  • Identify, document, prioritize, and communicate software defects clearly, partnering with engineers to investigate root causes and validate fixes.

  • Build scalable automation approaches that improve test coverage, shorten feedback cycles, and reduce repetitive manual testing.

  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines using industry-standard tooling such as GitHub Actions, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, or similar platforms.

  • Validate APIs, data integrations, and backend systems using appropriate testing strategies and tools.

  • Collaborate with software engineers, product managers, designers, and client stakeholders to establish acceptance criteria and advocate for quality throughout the development process.

  • Gain experience across multiple clients and industries, adapting testing strategies to different technical and business environments.

  • Build trust with clients and internal teams through strong communication, problem-solving, attention to detail, and execution.

Why you should apply

  • You want to work with passionate, talented people who are always looking for ways to make things better.

  • You value a work environment where kindness, mutual trust, and egoless collaboration are paramount.

What you bring to the table

We expect candidates to demonstrate a solid foundation in software quality assurance, hands-on experience with both manual and automated testing, and a keen interest in consulting.

  • Quality Engineering: Strong experience designing and executing manual testing strategies, including functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and end-to-end testing.

  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills and the ability to clearly communicate quality risks, defects, and recommendations to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

How to Apply

Send your updated resume and three professional references (name, title, organization, phone number and email address) to with "SNAP EBT Test Lead" in the subject line. Please include your current location and your availability to start on or about January 1, 2027.

Welcome to MICE DESK

﻿

MICE DESK is the leading European company automating the sales process in the hospitality industry — and we are now expanding to the US.

Our platform, Rocket, turns event, meeting, and group inquiries into autonomous end-to- end workflows: from RFP to signed contract, across email, CRM, and PMS systems. We integrate with the systems hotels actually run on — Oracle OPERA Cloud, SIHOT, Guestline, Salesforce, Marriott's enterprise stack — which means our engineers work inside real hotel operations, not against sandbox APIs.

We are a Series A-stage company with a deliberately small team and real enterprise traction: major hotel groups across Europe run their group sales on Rocket. The people joining now shape the product, the deployment playbook, and the culture.

﻿

﻿The Role

QA Automation Engineers are how Rocket stays reliable at scale. You build the automation frameworks, testing infrastructure, and quality processes that allow Engineering to ship quickly without compromising stability.

This is an automation-first role focused on building quality into every stage of the development lifecycle. You work closely with Engineering, Product, and DevOps to ensure every feature, integration, and release is validated through automated testing before it reaches production.

If you enjoy designing automation systems, solving complex engineering problems, and creating the foundations that enable fast, confident software delivery, this is the role.

What You Will Own
﻿

1. Test automation, end-to-end.

Own the strategy and implementation of automated testing across the platform. Design scalable automation frameworks for UI, API, integration, and end-to-end testing, continuously increasing automated test coverage while ensuring tests remain reliable, maintainable, and efficient.

2. CI/CD quality engineering.

Build quality directly into the deployment pipeline by integrating automated testing throughout the CI/CD process. Establish quality gates, monitor test execution, improve developer feedback loops, and reduce release risk through continuous validation.

3. Platform quality and reliability.

Ensure the reliability of Rocket's distributed systems by validating APIs, integrations, backend services, and AI-powered workflows. Develop regression, smoke, and integration testing strategies while identifying quality risks early in the development lifecycle.

4. Engineering collaboration.

Partner closely with Engineering and Product throughout feature development. Promote testability, establish automation best practices, participate in technical design discussions, and help build a culture where quality is a shared engineering responsibility.

5. Continuous improvement.

Continuously evolve our quality engineering practices by introducing modern automation tools, improving testing processes, strengthening regression coverage, and driving automation-first thinking across the engineering organization.

Who You Are
﻿

Must-have

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Engineering or QA Automation
  • Strong experience designing and building automation frameworks from scratch
  • Hands-on experience with API, integration, UI, and end-to-end test automation
  • Strong programming or scripting skills (JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, Java, or similar)
  • Experience with modern automation tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, or equivalent
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong understanding of software testing methodologies and quality engineering principles
  • Experience testing distributed systems, REST APIs, and asynchronous workflows
  • Strong analytical and debugging skills
  • Excellent English communication skills (B2–C1)
    ﻿

Nice-to-have

  • Experience testing AI-powered or LLM-based applications
  • Experience with performance or load testing tools
  • Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud environments
  • Familiarity with contract testing and API mocking
  • Experience working in high-growth product startups
  • Knowledge of hospitality technology or enterprise SaaS platforms

Hiring Process

  1. Intro interview — background, engineering experience, automation expertise, and motivation for joining MICE DESK
  2. Technical interview — automation frameworks, testing strategies, CI/CD integration, quality engineering practices, and real-world automation challenges
  3. Founder interview — engineering culture, ownership, product quality, and your role in building a reliable AI-native platform

Why MICE DESK

  • Own quality engineering for one of Europe's leading AI platforms for hospitality sales automation—now expanding into the US
  • Build the automation frameworks and quality systems that enable rapid, reliable software delivery
  • Work closely with Engineering, Product, and DevOps on modern technologies and AI-powered workflows
  • Help establish engineering quality standards at a fast-growing Series A company

job.title: Senior SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test) - Asian Timezones
job.description:
Company Overview

hermeneutic research is a best-in-class proprietary trading firm. It deploys research-driven discretionary and systematic strategies as well as makes strategic long-term investments. The partners' decade-long history of success in trading and business building and a firm-wide cultural emphasis on alpha generation, open debate, relentless iteration, and teamwork are key to the firm's continued expansion in a challenging market environment that has hamstrung competitors. A hard-wired emphasis on risk management and opportunistic market participation ensure that hermeneutic research will continue its growth trajectory in the coming decades.

Job Overview

As a Senior SDET, you will play a critical, hands-on role in ensuring the quality, reliability, resilience and performance of our trading and research systems. This is a software-engineering role: you will design and build test automation from the ground up, not just execute test plans. You will work closely with engineers, researchers, trading and operations teams to design, automate and own testing strategies across services and workflows.

This is an individual-contributor role focused on deep technical execution, framework ownership and quality advocacy. You will shape best practices, identify gaps in existing testing approaches, and drive improvements across the SDLC, particularly in high-ambiguity areas where testing is limited or does not yet exist.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build and own automated test frameworks and suites for backend services, APIs and UIs from the ground up
  • Ensure adequate coverage across functional, integration and performance testing
  • Collaborate closely with engineering, research, trading and operations teams to define test requirements and quality expectations
  • Identify gaps in existing test strategies and work with engineering to improve coverage and reliability
  • Advocate and implement shift-left testing so issues are caught early in the SDLC
  • Participate in architecture and design discussions to drive testability and automation
  • Validate correctness and performance in low-latency, high-throughput conditions

Requirements

Must Haves

  • 5+ years in QA/test automation engineering, including demonstrable hands-on ownership of an automation framework built from scratch (architecture and design decisions you can speak to in depth)
  • Strong programming ability in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go or C++, used to build frameworks and tooling, not just author test scripts
  • Solid grasp of QA methodologies, test design and automation architecture
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD build and deployment workflows
  • Experience in a trading firm / financial-technology environment, with exposure to systematic trading systems or similarly complex, low-latency, data-driven platforms
  • Ability to work cross-functionally and communicate effectively with engineering and research teams

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with modern automation frameworks, particularly Playwright and Pytest, for API and/or UI testing
  • Experience validating low-latency / high-throughput systems, familiarity with performance tools such as k6 or Locust
  • Experience in crypto / Web3 or systematic-trading domains specifically
  • Applied use of AI in the QA workflow, e.g. LLM-assisted test generation, agentic failure triage, or LLM-output evaluation (LLM-as-judge, non-deterministic system testing), as an engineering practice, not just tool usage
  • Working knowledge of SQL/NoSQL
  • Exposure to data warehouse / data lake / streaming-pipeline testing
  • Familiarity with monitoring/logging tools such as Datadog or Grafana

Interview Process

  1. CV Screening – We will review your application based on the qualifications and experience outlined above.
  2. First Interview – An initial interview with the hiring manager to evaluate overall fit, experience, and mutual expectations.
  3. Test Assignment Review – A problem-solving session with the team, or a take-home assignment with a follow-up discussion of the candidate’s approach and solutions.
  4. Second Interview – Interview with the CTO to delve into your resume and skills and discuss your career goals.
  5. Co-Founder Interview – A concluding discussion to evaluate cultural fit, strategic alignment, and how you resonate with the firm’s values.

Company Values

Throughout the process, you'll be assessed for cultural fit through our company values:

  • Drive – We believe the best team members are deeply passionate about what they do. That passion fuels their growth, drives them to seek out the best teams, and leads them to hold high expectations of themselves in pursuit of excellence.
  • Ownership – We aim to extend ownership as broadly as possible across the firm. In return, we value people who take initiative, step up when needed, and treat the company’s goals as their own.
  • Judgment – We value those who see the big picture and focus on what truly drives impact and results. They use time wisely, adapt across domains, and always prioritize outcomes over comfort zones.
  • Openness – We foster a culture of open communication, mutual challenge, and shared growth. We believe constructive debate and proactive knowledge sharing lead us closer to the truth—and better decisions.
  • Competence – We work with people who bring exceptional intellectual strength. What sets them apart isn’t just what they know—it’s how they use what they know to navigate change, adapt quickly, and contribute meaningfully in fast-changing environments.
  • Resilience – We perform under pressure. Markets move fast, and so do we—but we stay grounded, focused, and calm. We embrace uncertainty, learn from setbacks, and adapt quickly without losing sight of long-term goals.

job.title: Software Developer in Test (SDET)
job.description:
Hey there! We're AKKO!

Our mission is to protect the devices the world relies on by relentlessly innovating to deliver an unparalleled digital insurance experience. AKKO enables partners and their end-users with modern and seamless protection solutions. We've become the #1 ranked provider in our space with industry- leading reviews and NPS scores.

With rapid growth and a fully remote team fueled by passion, innovation, and collaboration, we’re just getting started. Our investors—led by Mundi, Fika, and Pear—bring the same conviction that helped power companies like Doordash, Gusto, wefox, and Pipe.

We are seeking a Software Developer in Test (SDET) to focus on our automation and manual testing of the suite of software products that we offer to customers. The candidate will be required to carry out tests to ensure the software we’re building addresses the business requirements and provides user friendly experience to our customers. The primary role is heavy on writing automated tests, maintaining them and triaging failures. This role will also include manual testing work for newer initiatives.

THE DAY-TO-DAY

  • Define risk-based test plans and acceptance criteria in partnership with Product/Engineering; translate user stories into clear test cases.
  • Build and maintain automated tests (Cypress/TypeScript preferred) across E2E, integration, and API layers; create reusable utilities/page objects and stabilize flaky tests.
  • Implement and own CI/CD test gates (smoke/regression) with parallelization and clear pass/fail signals; track coverage and test health metrics.
  • Perform targeted manual/exploratory testing for new features, edge cases, and UX flows; drive regression for critical paths.
  • Create and manage test data, mocks/fixtures, and environment configurations to keep tests deterministic and fast.
  • Coordinate with engineers to reproduce, triage, and debug issues using logs/metrics/trace tools; verify fixes and prevent regressions.
  • Own post-deploy smoke testing and release sign-off for web apps and mobile apps; document results and risks.
  • Continuously improve the QA/SDET toolchain and practices (coding standards, coverage goals, flake budgets, reporting dashboards).

WHAT MAKES YOU QUALIFIED

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Software or related field (advanced degrees a plus).
  • 3+ years in software testing with strong grounding in functional/regression and modern test design techniques (BC, EP, pairwise, etc.).
  • Hands-on experience testing web applications and mobile apps end-to-end, including UX/UAT and bug verification across browsers/devices.
  • 2+ years focused on test automation, including designing scalable frameworks and CI integration.
  • Proficiency with Cypress (preferred) and JavaScript/TypeScript; experience with API testing (Postman/Newman, supertest, REST/GraphQL) and at least one additional tool (Playwright/WebdriverIO/Jest/Mocha).
  • Comfortable with CI/CD (GitHub Actions/CircleCI/GitLab), Git, and basic Docker; familiarity with env management and secrets.
  • Strong analytical skills; fluency with SDLC/Agile and tooling (Atlassian suite or similar).
  • Ability to produce clear documentation (test plans, traceability, results) and communicate risks to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated tests (unit/integration/E2E) with a focus on reliability and maintainability.
  • Experience with Cypress specifically (selectors, fixtures, commands, intercepts, parallelization).

The position disclosed is a contract position looking to be filled immediately. The contractor will be expected to work during EST (New York- USA) hours 9 AM - 5 PM.

This position is open to international applicants.

WHAT ELSE ARE WE LOOKING FOR?

Our team is fostered around our core values:

  • Embrace Relentless Ownership
  • Move Fast, Build Smart
  • Win Together
  • Focus On Outcomes, Not Activity
  • Earn Trust Every Day

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Technical Product Manager, Enterprise Platform to own the roadmap and delivery of platform capabilities for enterprise and public sector customers with complex security, compliance and deployment requirements. This is a 100% remote position from select locations, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the Chicago, IL or El Dorado Hills, CA metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help deliver secure, reliable and supportable platform capabilities for some of the world’s most demanding IT environments.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at .

About the Job

As a Senior Technical Product Manager, Enterprise Platform, you will own product scope, priorities and release planning for a strategic platform initiative serving enterprise, public sector and other highly regulated customers.

You will work across Engineering, QA, Product and customer-facing teams to turn customer, field and executive requirements into clear product scope, acceptance criteria and release plans. The initiative spans multiple Keeper product areas and shared services, including backend systems, Vault, Admin Console, privileged access management, secrets management, identity and deployment infrastructure.

This role requires strong technical fluency and experience delivering software into customer-managed, private cloud, on-premises or otherwise highly controlled environments. You should be comfortable discussing containers, CI/CD, Linux, networking, TLS, software packaging, cloud dependencies and deployment architecture well enough to evaluate trade-offs, identify risks and help drive technically complex work to completion.

You will own what is delivered, why it matters, how work is prioritized and when the platform is ready to release, while partnering closely with technical and QA leads on architecture, implementation and validation.

Responsibilities

  • Own the product roadmap, priorities and release scope for secure customer-managed and restricted deployment environments
  • Translate customer, field, CTO and business requirements into clear product requirements, feature definitions and measurable acceptance criteria
  • Drive cross-functional delivery across multiple engineering teams working within shared codebases and platform services
  • Define release plans, milestones, dependencies and readiness criteria across backend, client, PAM, identity, infrastructure and platform workstreams
  • Own product requirements for installation, upgrades, versioning, rollback, supportability and lifecycle management
  • Drive platform workstreams including database upgrades, logging and metrics, licensing, offline operation, customer-controlled encryption keys and deployment reliability
  • Partner with technical leads to evaluate feasibility, resolve trade-offs and ensure requirements align with platform architecture and engineering standards
  • Partner with QA to define acceptance criteria, validation requirements and release readiness
  • Ensure customer-managed deployment requirements are incorporated into shared platform services while avoiding unnecessary product forks
  • Maintain alignment between customer-managed deployment requirements and Keeper’s broader cloud platform roadmap
  • Define requirements for containerized delivery across Docker, Kubernetes, Helm and Linux-based environments
  • Define product requirements for secure software supply chain practices including image signing, SBOMs, release artifacts and auditable build processes
  • Work with Engineering to identify cloud-specific dependencies and define requirements for customer-managed or disconnected alternatives
  • Support Sales Engineering and customer-facing teams on technical evaluations, demonstrations, trials and early customer feedback
  • Define requirements for installation, upgrade, administration and operational documentation
  • Maintain clear visibility into delivery status, risks, dependencies and decisions for Product and Engineering leadership
  • Protect product scope and uphold core platform principles including security, maintainability, zero-knowledge architecture and shared-code consistency
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT or similar platforms to improve product research, requirements development, technical analysis, documentation and workflow efficiency

Requirements

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, technical product management, platform product management or a related technical product role
  • Significant experience owning technically complex software products or platform capabilities delivered across multiple engineering teams
  • Direct experience shipping software that customers operate in their own environments, such as self-hosted, on-premises, appliance, private cloud or disconnected deployments
  • Strong understanding of software installation, upgrades, versioning, backward compatibility, release planning and support lifecycle requirements
  • Strong technical understanding of containers and deployment technologies including Docker, Kubernetes and Helm
  • Familiarity with Linux systems, networking, DNS, TLS and common enterprise infrastructure concepts
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines, build systems, container registries and modern software delivery practices
  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure and services, particularly AWS, and the role of services such as object storage, queues, messaging and email within distributed applications

job.title: Senior SDET
job.description:
Synack’s Penetration Testing as a Service platform manages customers’ attack surfaces by discovering new assets, pentesting for critical vulnerabilities and gaining visibility into the root causes of security risks. We are committed to making the world more secure by harnessing a talented, vetted community of security researchers to deliver continuous penetration testing and vulnerability management, with actionable results. Synack's PTaaS platform has uncovered more than 71,000 exploitable vulnerabilities to date, protecting a growing list of Global 2000 customers and U.S. agencies in a FedRAMP Moderate Authorized environment. For more information, please visit .

Are you process-driven and notice the slightest deviation from the norm? If you get a thrill from helping to correct others’ mistakes and are not afraid to speak up, then this is the role for you. As a Senior QA Engineer you will work on game-changing problems in cybersecurity. You will validate software using cutting-edge technologies and take testing to the next level as part of a collaborative environment. Sounds interesting? Keep reading!

Here’s what you'll do

  • Debugs software products through the use of systematic tests to develop, apply and maintain quality standards for firm products.

Here's what you'll need

job.title: Senior Software Quality Engineer
job.description:
As a Senior Software Quality Engineerat vCluster Labs, you aren't just writing test cases; you are the architect of how we know our product works. You'll own test strategy end-to-end across a fast-moving codebase, build the automation frameworks that give engineering the confidence to ship daily, and be the voice for testability and reliability in every design conversation you're part of.

As a Senior Software Quality Engineer, your role will include:

  • Test framework ownership: Lead the design, development, and maintenance of automated test frameworks spanning backend services and UI, built to scale with a fast-growing product.

  • Test strategy: Own and drive test strategy across services and features, ensuring coverage is thorough and tied directly to product goals, not just ticket checkboxes.

  • Cross-functional influence: Work closely with engineering and product to shape features early, advocate for testability, and align the team on what "quality" means for this product.

  • Architectural input: Sit in on architecture and design discussions, bringing a testability and reliability lens before code gets written, not after.

  • CI/CD integration: Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, etc.) so engineers get fast, high-confidence feedback on every change.

  • Exploratory testing: Run exploratory testing to catch usability issues, edge cases, and regressions that automation won't find on its own.

  • Parallel execution: Move across multiple projects at once in a startup environment where priorities shift, without losing rigor.

This role could be a fit for you if you bring:

  • Experience depth: 7+ years in QA or software testing, including 2+ years operating at a senior or staff level.

  • Programming ability: Strong hands-on skills in at least one of Go, Python, or JavaScript, used for building automation and tooling, not just scripting one-off checks.

  • AI-assisted QA workflow: Daily use of AI tools for reviewing PRs and design docs, writing test plans, and automating test cases, paired with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to verify it yourself.

  • Ownership mindset: You spot what needs to happen and drive it forward without waiting to be told.

  • Startup fluency: Proven ability to stay calm under ambiguity and juggle competing priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Communication: Strong written and verbal skills, with the ability to advocate for quality across engineering and product.

  • CI/CD depth: Deep understanding of CI/CD systems and hands-on experience integrating automated test suites into pipelines (GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar).

  • Kubernetes fluency: Working knowledge of Kubernetes environments and distributed systems, or a strong aptitude and willingness to learn quickly.

  • Debugging skill: Excellent analytical and debugging ability, particularly for backend and infrastructure-related issues.

Bonus points for:

  • Experience testing in tenant cluster or Tenant Isolation environments.

  • Prior experience owning QA at a startup through a period of rapid product growth.

About vCluster Labs

We're the #1 platform for AI infrastructure, trusted by the world's fastest-growing AI cloud builders. We're a venture-backed startup that's raised over $28M from top-tier investors including Khosla Ventures (first investor in OpenAI, GitLab, Stripe, and DoorDash), and we're in a hyper-growth phase looking for motivated people to join our team. Our headquarters are in San Francisco (Salesforce Tower), but our team is distributed around the globe with a remote-first culture.

We give AI Cloud providers and AI factories a hyperscaler-like experience on their own GPU infrastructure. Our platform runs the full stack an operator needs, from bare metal provisioning and node lifecycle management up through managed Kubernetes, Slurm, Ray, and inference clusters, so they can turn raw GPUs into cluster products they can sell in days instead of spending 12+ months building it themselves. Today we power over 100,000 GPUs and 1 million CPUs across 50+ AI clouds and Fortune 500 companies, backed by a team of 40+ infrastructure engineers who build alongside our customers rather than just shipping them software.

We're the company behind vCluster, the open source technology for tenant isolation on Kubernetes, with 11,000+ GitHub stars and 40M+ tenant clusters created since 2021. Open source is part of our DNA. At KubeCon North America 2025, we launched our Infrastructure Tenancy Platform for AI, a Kubernetes-native framework built for running AI, ML, and GPU-intensive workloads anywhere, with an NVIDIA-validated reference architecture for DGX systems.

Benefits

We offer the following benefits:

  • Competitive Salary: We offer a competitive compensation package, including equity.

  • Premium Insurance: Health, dental, vision, and life Insurance, including plans for you and eligible dependents (benefits vary depending on country).

  • Flexible Working Schedule: You have a doctor’s appointment or need to head to the supermarket to get groceries at 2pm? We won’t have an issue with that. To us, results matter more than clocking in and out at the same time every day.

  • Workplace Flexibility: We’re very flexible about where you work. We know things can change in life and we’re happy to adjust the work environment for you along the way.

Culture & Values

At vCluster Labs, we value and stand for:

  1. Make it Happen: We have a relentless bias for action and the grit to push through obstacles. We do whatever it takes to figure it out, put in the work, and ruthlessly prioritize the actions that drive measurable impact for the business.

  2. Own the Outcome: We understand that our responsibility doesn't end when a task is checked off; it ends when the value is delivered. We connect our daily individual actions to the broader success of the company and our customers.

  3. Create Wow: We measure success by the experience we generate, both inside and outside the company. For our customers, this means impressive speed and intuitive experiences. For our team, this means going the extra mile to support one another and to continuously drive each other to new heights.

  4. Open Source, Open Mind: We are actively contributing to and maintaining open-source projects. Internally, we foster meritocracy — the strongest ideas win, no matter who or where they come from.

  5. Build Tomorrow’s Standards, Intentionally: We don't just ship software; we define the state-of-the-art of tomorrow. We are fearless in tearing down old approaches to build something better, but we are disciplined in how we do it because we know our users rely on our technology to run mission-critical infrastructure platforms.

Compensation Range: €65K - €110K

job.title: QA Engineer, Agentic Development
job.description:
Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!

What do we do?💥

We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences.

Check out our ‘About Us’page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional.

Overview

Clariti is building a new product with a team that uses agentic development to move quickly. As a QA Engineer, you will help define how quality works across that process. You will shape the testing strategy, own the automation that backs it, and decide where testing effort will do the most good. You will work closely with developers, product, and AI-assisted tooling to keep quality high without slowing delivery.

Responsibilities

  • Shape quality from the start of each feature: work with product and engineering on acceptance criteria, testability, and definition of done before code is written.
  • Design and own the automated QA workflow for agentic delivery, from triage through test generation and execution reporting, and keep it reliable as volume grows.
  • Review AI-generated tests and code for correctness, gaps, and false confidence.
  • Probe beyond the written criteria, including edge cases, failure paths, data integrity, security, performance, and cross-system behavior, and feed what you find back into stories and the pipeline.
  • Keep coverage deliberate and efficient: map risk to tests, and prune generated or duplicate tests that add maintenance cost without adding confidence.
  • Design and maintain end-to-end and API automation with Playwright and TypeScript.
  • Build and maintain CI/CD quality gates so every change is verified before merge without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Track quality and efficiency metrics, such as escape rate, flake rate, acceptance-criteria coverage, suite runtime, and maintenance effort.
  • Triage failures across automated and human-written tests, find root causes, and fix the system so the same failure class doesn't recur.
  • Make technical quality decisions on architecture, test data, and environments.
  • Upskill the team on testing for agentic development, including how to specify work so that generated tests are useful.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in QA, SDET, or software engineering with a quality focus.
  • 3-5 years of hands-on Playwright automation with TypeScript or JavaScript.
  • Experience establishing or significantly shaping QA practices on a product, whether at a startup, scale-up, or new product team, and whether or not you were there from day one.
  • Experience using AI coding assistants and agentic tools in a real delivery workflow, with a clear view of where they are reliable and where human judgment is needed.
  • A quality-ownership mindset: you see quality across the whole system, raise concerns about unclear requirements early, and identify what needs testing without being told.
  • Exploratory and risk-based testing instincts: you find behavior nobody specified and judge which risks are worth the effort.
  • Ability to read and critically evaluate code, including code you did not write.
  • Experience building or maintaining CI/CD test pipelines.
  • Solid grounding in Agile and test strategy, including risk-based planning, the test pyramid, and regression scope.

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with one or more structured agentic development methodologies, and curiosity about how different teams practice them.
  • Experience designing evals or quality metrics for LLM- or agent-based systems.
  • Experience reducing test suite bloat or flakiness in a large automation codebase.
  • Experience with API testing tools (Postman, RestAssured) and contract testing.
  • Experience with Jira automation or test case management systems.

We invest in and empower our team members with competitive compensation packages, well deserved time off and benefits to keep you and your family healthy! *

💰 The base salary range for this role is expected to be between $75,000-$90,000 based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications while considering internal pay equity and our broader pay philosophy. 💰

If you have questions about compensation as we move through the process, we’re happy to discuss further.

*Benefits depend on employment type (full-time, part-time, contract, etc).

Things to Note 📝

Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation.

Travel- Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description.

We're committed to building an inclusive culture where our team members take ownership over projects, tasks, and outcomes; bring a growth mindset to drive continuous learning and self-development; have the ability to communicate courageously in a direct but respectful way; and are customer-focused by keeping the customer at the heart of decision-making. It’s the diversity of our team that helps us make better decisions, by leveraging the diversity in thought & experience across to create impactful solutions as we explore new paths & challenges as we grow. We’re working to create a workplace and team that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Questions? We are here to help

If you require accommodations in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in our hiring process for any reason, please direct your questions to and we’ll be happy to support you.
