job.title: Staff QE
job.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

About the team

Every insight on AlphaSense is tied to a company. Reference Entity Data Services (REDS) owns the data that makes that possible: one trusted record for every company, connected across all the sources we bring in.

REDS turns records from many providers into one authoritative view, keeps it current, and supplies it to every part of the platform that depends on it, from search to company profiles. When that foundation is right, customers find the right company and trust what they see.

About the Role

As the Staff Quality Engineer dedicated to REDS, you will define how we prove our data is correct before it reaches customers. You will set the strategy, build the practice from the ground up, and work closely with engineering and product leadership to make quality a measurable part of how the team ships.

What You'll Do

  • Own the quality strategy for AlphaSense's company reference data, built on quality by design and automation by default.
  • Close test coverage gaps on our critical workflows: ingesting provider data, matching records, keeping identifiers stable over time, and delivering entity data and change events to the product teams that rely on them.
  • Define what "correct" means for company data, and build the golden datasets, labeled samples, and automated checks that prove it, including measuring match precision and recall and the tradeoff between false merges and false splits.
  • Set the quality measures and release standards the team uses to ship with confidence.
  • Build and grow scalable automation across our data, API, and event-driven interfaces, and decide what belongs at the unit, component, API, and E2E layers.
  • Anticipate data lifecycle risks such as provider data drift, schema changes, and late or conflicting records, and build regression coverage for them.
  • Partner with developers on test planning for new features, so automation is ready as the code is.
  • Use production signals to focus effort where it reduces the most risk to customers.
  • Bring AI into how the team designs, maintains, and triages tests.
  • Coach engineers and influence across teams to raise the quality bar.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of hands-on experience in quality engineering, including setting strategy for complex backend or data platforms.
  • Hands-on experience designing and automating tests for backend and data systems, including API and contract testing, data pipeline validation, and event-driven or streaming interfaces (e.g., Kafka).
  • Strong skills in at least one programming language (such as Python, Kotlin/Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Ruby), and comfort working in unfamiliar codebases.
  • Deep expertise in test design across unit, API, and end-to-end layers, and judgment about where each belongs.
  • Experience validating data correctness at scale, ideally in matching, identity, or pipeline-driven systems.
  • A strong grasp of continuous delivery, CI/CD, and release quality gates.
  • A track record of using AI to speed up engineering and testing.
  • Proven ability to set direction on your own and influence without authority.
  • Clear, confident communication with technical and business stakeholders.

Bonus Points

  • Experience with data pipelines or data-operations tooling.
  • Hands-on E2E automation experience with Playwright
  • Experience with financial, company, or reference data.
  • Experience evaluating AI or LLM output.
  • BS/MS in a relevant technical field.

What we offer

  • Playing a part in the story of a fast-growing company
  • Competitive compensation package
  • Lunch and recreational benefits
  • Occupational health care

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered equity, and a generous benefits program.

Compensation Range
$148,350—$203,550 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

  • Execute end-to-end functional and migration testing for Temenos T24 LD to AA Loans Migration projects.

  • Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and stakeholder communication skills.
  • Experience working in Agile, hybrid, or large-scale banking transformation programs.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer
job.description:
About JuiceX

JuiceX is a rapidly growing prediction markets exchange. Our company is building the infrastructure to offer a fully compliant, transparent, and innovative marketplace for event driven contracts under U.S. regulatory frameworks.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Senior QA Engineer to own quality across the full delivery lifecycle, from business requirement through production sign off. At a regulated exchange where trading, clearing, and the payments that fund them all have to be correct, quality protects our customers' money and our regulatory standing. You will work across distributed backend services in Rust, web and mobile front ends in React and TypeScript, a cloud native platform on Kubernetes, and integrations with payment, identity, and market infrastructure partners.

Professional Experience

  • Owning quality across the full delivery lifecycle, from requirements through production sign off
  • Risk based test strategy and test design across unit, integration, end to end, performance, and exploratory testing
  • Hands on test automation and the frameworks behind it, integrated into CI/CD
  • Testing distributed backend services and modern web and mobile front ends
  • Reading and writing code and validating data directly, not testing only through the UI
  • Using AI coding and testing tools to accelerate work without lowering the quality bar

Qualifications

  • 5+ years in QA or quality engineering, including owning release sign off for production systems
  • Strong test design and risk analysis skills
  • Hands on test automation, ideally Playwright with TypeScript, plus API testing
  • Comfortable reading and writing code in at least one backend language (Rust is a plus)
  • Working SQL for data validation
  • Real, regular use of AI coding and testing tools, with examples you can share
  • CI/CD experience
  • Clear written communication
  • Preferred: financial services experience, including trading, payments, or fintech
  • Preferred: experience in regulated environments
  • Preferred: performance and load testing
  • Preferred: experience building AI agents, tooling, or LLM evaluations
  • Preferred: mobile testing

Position Responsibilities

  • Turn business requirements into clear, testable acceptance criteria before development starts
  • Define a risk based test strategy for each initiative, balancing unit, integration, end to end, performance, and exploratory testing
  • Design, build, and maintain automated test suites and frameworks, and integrate them into CI/CD
  • Review changes for test quality and coverage, and drive flaky or failing tests to root cause
  • Own the go or no go decision for production releases, with clear, auditable evidence of what was tested
  • Track escaped defects, feed the lessons back into requirements and tests, and raise the quality bar across the team
  • Use AI to turn requirements into test scenarios, edge cases, and automation
  • Run agent driven exploratory and UI testing
  • Build AI assisted tooling for test maintenance and failure triage, and reusable QA workflows the team can apply
  • Test and evaluate AI powered product features, verifying AI output against real system behavior before sign off

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (Platform)
job.description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:

Our QA-Core team exists so every engineering team at Upgrade can test their software quickly and trust the result. We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer on the team to architect and build test automation infrastructure, tooling, and agentic solutions to increase engineering productivity. This is not a traditional product QA role - it’s a build role. You will work closely with our product teams to understand their automation requirements, design services from scratch, ship them to production clusters and own them.

This is a fully remote position open to candidates who are based in the US.

Our Core Technologies Include:

Java, Python, Kubernetes, Selenium WebDriver, Playwright, TestNG, Maven, Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, SQL, Grafana, SumoLogic, Docker, Gatling, Claude Code, MCP server

What You’ll Do:

  • Design and own automation framework for functional and performance testing.

  • Build agents to automate existing QA/testing workflows and remove engineering friction.

  • Build the applications and services that automation depends on, deploy them, and operate them in production environments.

  • Take prototypes all the way. Build demos in a timely manner, gather feedback from the teams who'd use it, and iterate through successive versions until it's hardened, monitored, and running with matured quality.

  • Identify gap areas in existing frameworks and tools, and iterate toward solutions that close them.

What We Look For:

  • 5-7+ years building production software, with demonstrated depth across test infrastructure, test frameworks, and developer tooling, and working knowledge of platform engineering.

  • Proven track record building agentic solutions and test automation frameworks from the ground up — designed, shipped, iterated on, and adopted as part of how other engineers work.

  • Fluency with agentic coding tools as part of your daily workflow: ability to orchestrate multiple agents to execute, review agent-generated PRs.

  • Hands-on experience with micro-services, Kubernetes and managing deployment lifecycle

  • Ability to take an ambiguous problem statement to a scoped, defensible solution independently.

What We Offer You:

  • Competitive salary and stock option plan

  • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance

  • Flexible PTO

  • Opportunities for professional growth and development

  • Paid parental leave

  • Health & wellness initiatives

Environmental & Working Conditions

  • Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.
  • Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.
  • The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.
  • Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.
  • Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.
  • Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement. English is required for all positions, as it involves interacting with staff at Upgrade's offices worldwide.

job.title: Director, SDET
job.description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    The Director of SDET is a pivotal role blending strong technical depth with strategic and people leadership.

    You will own the quality engineering vision for the organization, mentor the next generation of SDET managers and leads, and champion the adoption of AI-driven tools and practices to modernize how the organization builds, tests, and ships software.

Responsibilities:

    -> Quality Strategy & Architecture:
  • Own the end-to-end quality engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap across multiple product lines or business units
  • Establish quality gates, release readiness criteria, and CI/CD processes
  • Drive a "shift-left, shift-right" quality culture — embedding testability into design reviews and using production observability to close the loop
  • Conduct architectural reviews across new and existing products to proactively surface scalability, reliability, and performance risks
  • Evaluate and select tooling, frameworks, and platforms (open-source and commercial) that scale automation across teams
    • -> AI Adoption:
  • Lead the org's AI adoption strategy for quality engineering — building or integrating AI/ML-based testing tools to improve coverage, productivity, and defect prediction
  • Continuously evaluate and leverage AI for all aspects of Quality Engineering ensuring quality strategy keeps pace with how product is built
    • -> Stakeholder & People Leadership:
  • Partner with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Security leadership to align quality goals with business and release objectives
  • Provide regular quality updates, metrics, and strategic recommendations to executive leadership
  • Define, set up, and monitor key quality and productivity metrics (KPIs/OKRs)
  • Lead succession planning and mentor SDET Managers and Leads to build the next layer of quality leadership

Requirements:

  • 15+ years in software testing/quality engineering, including 5+ years in a Director or senior engineering leadership role
  • Deep expertise in test automation frameworks (Selenium, Playwright, RestAssured, etc.) and languages (Java, Python, JavaScript/TypeScript)
  • Strong understanding of CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Harness CI/CD), containerization (Docker/Kubernetes), and cloud platforms (AWS/Azure/GCP)
  • Hands-on experience building AI/ML-based testing tools that measurably improve coverage and productivity
  • Solid grounding in performance testing, security testing, and other non-functional quality attributes
  • Experience architecting test strategies for microservices, distributed systems, and mobile platforms

Preferred Exposure:

  • Experience presenting AI or quality-transformation initiatives at conferences
  • Prior experience testing high-transaction SaaS platforms (CRM, Payments, Automation, Email, Fintech, or similar)
  • Experience building and testing AI products using Agentic AI, including evaluation frameworks
  • Contributions to open-source testing frameworks or published thought leadership on QE/AI trends

Key Competencies:

  • Quality vision and strategic execution
  • Non-functional testing (performance, security, reliability) and continuous delivery
  • Operational discipline within a fast-paced, rapid release environment
  • Stakeholder management across Engineering, Product, DevOps, and business functions
  • Team building and mentorship
  • Data-driven reporting of quality and productivity metrics to executive stakeholders

job.title: Salesforce QA Automation Developer
job.description:
Join nesto — proudly named Canadian Rocketship 2025*. A Deloitte Fast 50 company evolving alongside Canada’s top tech innovators and disrupting a 2.1 Trillion-dollar mortgage industry at light speed by building the mortgage ecosystem of the future.

BUILD lending technology with the best developers, AI engineers, and mortgage experts in the country. Work on a modern tech stack and a development framework designed to unlock your full potential and accelerate your career.

Why join us

  • Hypergrowth: Deloitte Fast 50 — 3 years in a row
  • Tech community credibility: TechTO Canadian Rocketship 2025*
  • Industry leadership: CLA Lending Company of the Year — 4 consecutive years
  • Talent magnet: CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025
  • Trusted technology: powering major financial institutions across Canada
  • An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients.

Who are you

Builders. Problem-solvers. Curious minds. People who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we’re stronger together.

If you trust your skills and want to build real technology that reshapes an entire industry, join us now.

About nesto and Nesto Cloud

Nesto is Canada’s leading provider of mortgage technology and financing solutions, managing $73B+ CAD in residential and commercial mortgages, with 1,000+ team members across 12 offices nationwide. You will be working on Nesto Cloud, Canada’s most advanced cloud platform, delivering end-to-end technology solutions for lenders in the digital age.

About the Team

Our Salesforce team expertise spans the entire platform lifecycle from business process discovery and architectural design, all the way to custom development and automated workflow deployment, ensuring a seamless, data-driven experience for our advisors and clients.

What you’ll be doing

  • Review manual test cases for Salesforce customizations (including Lightning Web Components, Apex triggers, Flows, and declarative changes) and provide feedback on suitability for automation to the project team.
  • Support, maintain, and enhance all test case automation-related activities during iterative development, system testing, and regression testing across multiple Salesforce releases.
  • Review user stories and functional requirements to ensure thorough test coverage across standard and custom Salesforce objects.
  • Assist with manual testing; execute manual test cases and scripts for features under development using test management/tracking tools.
  • Create and maintain test plans, cases, and scenarios/scripts in compliance with defined QA standards and methodologies, including robust test data management strategies.
  • Establish, configure, and maintain Salesforce testing environments (Sandboxes and Scratch Orgs) for executing test cases and scenarios.
  • Participate in the development, deployment, and administration of QA processes, tools, and supporting CI/CD technologies within the Salesforce ecosystem.
  • Design, create, and execute automation scripts using Playwright or other tools, specifically tailored to navigate Salesforce Lightning interfaces, dynamic IDs, and Shadow DOM components.

Who we are looking for

  • 3+ years of experience with software testing, including significant experience testing Salesforce applications (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Community Cloud).
  • 2+ years experience with automated functional testing tools, preferably Playwright (experience overcoming common Salesforce automation hurdles is highly valued).
  • Excellent troubleshooting, problem-solving, and analytical skills, with a deep understanding of Salesforce security models (Profiles, Permission Sets, Sharing Rules).
  • Experience working with Postman for API testing, specifically interacting with Salesforce REST and Bulk API
  • Experience working with X-ray (or similar test management tools natively integrated with Jira).
  • Experience working with Agile Methodologies, highly frequent release cycles, and Salesforce deployment processes (e.g., Salesforce DX, Copado, Flosum, or standard CI/CD pipelines).
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript, HTML, CSS, and Git, alongside familiarity with Salesforce-specific languages like SOQL and a basic understanding of Apex.
  • Salesforce Certifications (e.g., Salesforce Certified Administrator, Platform App Builder) are a strong asset.
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science (an asset).
  • You enjoy working in a team and collaborating with people with different backgrounds.
  • You are self-driven and thrive in fast-paced teams.

The Reward

The A-Team: Work alongside high-performing talent in the industry.

Accelerated Growth: The slope of your learning curve here will be vertical. You will touch more production systems in one year than you would in five years at a bank.

Top-Tier Coverage: Premium benefits plan fully paid by nesto, including comprehensive insurance and unlimited access to telemedicine and mental health services for you and your family.

Rest & Recharge: 4 weeks of vacation to ensure you stay at peak performance.

Best-in-Class Tools: Access to the resources and tech you need to execute without friction.

Working framework: the environment that makes you productive and enables teamwork.

Diversity & Inclusion

At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. We are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

job.title: Senior Test Lead (Tricentis Tosca), Defense Counterintelligence and Security Age
job.description:
This is a remote position.

Senior Test Lead (Tricentis Tosca), Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA), Remote

Summary:

  • Job Title: Senior Test Lead
  • Level: Senior; 8+ years of software testing, automation, or quality engineering experience; 5+ years hands-on Tricentis Tosca experience.
  • Openings: To be confirmed.
  • Security Clearance: Active Secret clearance required; U.S. citizenship required.
  • Work Type: Remote, with periodic meetings in Quantico, VA or Annapolis, MD as required.
  • Job Type: Full-time.
  • Program Name: DCSA programs; testing and quality engineering across mission-critical systems.
  • Agency name: Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA).
  • Start Date: To be confirmed.

BizFirst is assisting our client with recruiting a Senior Test Lead to support Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency (DCSA) programs through hands-on automated testing, test strategy, team coaching, and stakeholder alignment.

Our client is a technology integrator that supports government customers with IT modernization, performance engineering, and cybersecurity. Its engineering teams collaborate on complex technical programs in a culture of innovation, continuous improvement, and professional development.

What will you do

The Senior Test Lead is a player/coach who spends 50–70% of their time hands-on with the team building, executing, and debugging automated tests, and the remaining time setting strategy, coaching, and driving stakeholder alignment. The role leads delivery across the Tricentis Quality Engineering platform: Tosca, qTest (Manager/Insights/Launch), Elastic Execution Grid (EEG/DEX), NeoLoad, and LiveCompare, fully integrated into CI/CD for Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency programs.

The role requires a senior testing professional capable of operating independently with government stakeholders, managing complex testing cycles, and ensuring delivery quality across mission-critical systems.

This is a key-person position on the contract and requires a highly experienced testing professional capable of operating independently with senior customer and program stakeholders.

The position may be performed remotely but requires the ability to participate in periodic customer and program meetings in the Quantico, VA or Annapolis, MD area, as required.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

Hands-On Test Design & Automation

  • Build and maintain release-ready automated suites; ensure CI/CD quality gates backed by qTest traceability.
  • Author Tosca automation across UI, API, Mobile (Engine 3.0), Vision AI, and packaged apps; implement TestCase Design and TDM.
  • Configure and optimize EEG/DEX for stable, parallel execution; resolve flaky tests and environment issues.
  • Work directly with engineers to reproduce failures, collect evidence, isolate defects, and recommend release readiness.
  • Identify automation opportunities based on risk, complexity, and mission needs.
  • Serve as escalation point for complex testing and automation problems.

Test Architecture & Quality Management

  • Architect Tosca modules, reusable assets, naming standards, and automation frameworks.
  • Govern qTest structures (plans, cycles, traceability, execution, and reporting) and ensure data accurately reflects priorities and readiness.
  • Maintain requirement-to-test traceability; ensure test assets match current program releases.
  • Use qTest Insights analytics to communicate quality, coverage, and execution trends.

CI/CD Integration & Quality Gates

  • Build executable quality gates in Jenkins, GitLab, or Azure DevOps; trigger Tosca suites through qTest Launch.
  • Define gating criteria supporting continuous integration and deployment.
  • Integrate NeoLoad performance checks and LiveCompare change-impact analysis where appropriate.
  • Review and approve automation designs for scalability, maintainability, and alignment with mission workflows.
  • Oversee smoke, integration, regression, and end-to-end automated execution.

Planning & Schedule Alignment

  • Lead and participate in test cycles (smoke, integration, regression, end-to-end, API, mobile, performance).
  • Define entry/exit criteria, environments, data, and readiness checks.
  • Provide testing inputs to the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS), including durations, dependencies, resource needs, and critical-path impacts.
  • Coordinate testing across development, cybersecurity, infrastructure, and government teams.
  • Identify schedule risks related to defects, environments, automation readiness, or scope changes.

Defect Triage & Release Readiness

  • Run daily defect triage; reproduce issues, attach evidence (logs, artifacts, screenshots), and drive prioritization and escalation.
  • Manage defect lifecycle, root-cause analysis, and aging trends.
  • Set quality thresholds for release gates; advise on release readiness and risk acceptance.

Coaching & Team Development

  • Coach testers on model-based design, test data strategies, and CI/CD integration.
  • Review automation for maintainability and risk-based coverage; improve practices through patterns and code reviews.
  • Mentor testers on Tricentis tools and quality engineering.

Customer Engagement & Reporting

  • Serve as senior point of contact for Tricentis testing with DCSA and contractor partners.
  • Participate in readiness sessions, technical reviews, and program leadership briefings.
  • Communicate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Build effective relationships across development, testing, cybersecurity, infrastructure, DevSecOps, and program management.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related technical discipline; equivalent experience may be considered.
  • Active Secret clearance (required).
  • U.S. citizenship required due to federal access requirements.
  • 8+ years of software testing, automation, or quality engineering experience.
  • 5+ years hands-on Tricentis Tosca experience.
  • Experience supporting federal systems, ideally DCSA, NBIS, or NI2 mission environments.
  • Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD or DevSecOps workflows.
  • Strong foundation in SDLC, Agile, DevOps, and DevSecOps.
  • Demonstrated experience leading technical testing teams.
  • Excellent communication and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Tricentis Tosca and/or qTest certifications.
  • Hands-on experience with Tosca API Testing, DEX, TestCase Design.
  • Experience with Jenkins, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, Git/GitLab.
  • SQL/database testing and REST/SOAP API testing experience.
  • Experience supporting large DoD or federal-sector programs.
  • PMP, ISTQB, or relevant testing/project management certifications.
  • Experience with AI-assisted testing or emerging Tricentis capabilities.

job.title: Quality Engineer
job.description:
ABOUT BETTER IMPACT

Our mission is simple: better volunteerism, stronger communities. Better Impact provides software that helps nonprofits, government agencies, healthcare organizations, and companies recruit, schedule, communicate with, and track volunteers and their impact.We advance volunteerism by equipping the professionals who make it happen with the technology, benchmarks, and community they need to run effective volunteer programs.

Today, our products support more than 85,000 organizations, millions of volunteers, and over 600 million volunteer hours across the nonprofit, public, healthcare, and corporate sectors. Our vision is a world where volunteerism is recognized, resourced, and respected in every community.

We are a growing, private-equity-backed business focused on meaningful work

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Design a quality strategy that works across .NET, PHP, and Node and TypeScript. You're not bringing a single-stack playbook. You're defining an approach to quality that holds up across a portfolio of different systems.

Build the automation layer. API and end-to-end test coverage, integrated into each platform's delivery pipeline, with agentic and AI-driven tooling brought in deliberately so coverage scales without adding headcount for every new surface.

Define and own the quality gates across all products. No ticket exits development without a clear testing designation. Nothing ships to production without documented evidence that tests passed on an environment that genuinely mirrors production, same stack and same configuration. You own the standard, and you own sign-off on environment parity.

Own regression protection through various legacy technology modernization eforts. Build the safety net that lets engineering re-platform aggressively without silently breaking customer-facing behavior. This is the difference between a modernization that ships and one that stalls under fear of breaking things.

Embed quality into each development teams delivery cycle rather than bolting it on at the end. You'll partner with engineering leadership across platforms and with product owners, and make quality a discipline teams rely on rather than a checkpoint they route around.

Requirements

WHO YOU ARE

You have deep experience in software quality, with real depth in test automation. You are not a manual-QA manager looking to direct a team of testers. You've built systems, architected automated suites, and made hard calls about what to test and how.

You have built or substantially rebuilt a quality function before, ideally across more than one stack or product. You know what it takes to create standards where none exist and to get engineering to adopt them without resentment.

You are fluent in modern automation and comfortable that the stacks differ. You can reason about quality in a .NET system, a PHP system, and a Node and TypeScript system, and design an approach that generalizes rather than one that only fits what you already know.

You treat AI and agentic tooling as the force multiplier that makes cross-stack quality possible for a small team.

You have protected a product through a major migration, re-platform, or rewrite, where regression was the central risk and the cost of getting it wrong was customer trust.

You understand that a multi-region SaaS product carries uptime and SLA obligations, and you build quality processes with that reality in mind.

Government, healthcare, or compliance experience is a plus but not required.

Benefits

  • Medical, dental & vision insurance (after 90 days)
  • ﻿﻿401(k) (after 90 days)
  • ﻿﻿Unlimited vacation + 9 paid holidays
  • ﻿﻿Paid parental leave
  • ﻿﻿Competitive comp package

Your role and responsibilities

job.title: Associate QA Engineer
job.description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.

The Role

Nitro is an AI-native data platform that democratizes life sciences data for non-technical commercial teams, turning fragmented HCP/HCO, prescription, and industry data into decisions the field can act on. We're looking for a QA Engineer to drive quality for the platform and help modernize how we test it. Here, testing isn't a gate bolted onto the end of shipping, it's part of the same function as building and deploying. You'll own your share of that full chain. This is a junior role for someone who wants to build a real career in QA and automation. You'll start hands-on with day-to-day testing and grow into broader ownership of our test automation as you develop. We're investing in making our testing environment more AI-forward, and you'll have real room to shape and extend that work, not just maintain what exists. The function itself is evolving, too: our Operations org is moving from traditional QA toward evaluating AI-native systems, and this role is your entry point into where that's headed.

What You'll Do

  • Own day-to-day QA across releases: new data connectors, schema changes, customer rollouts, platform upgrades, ensuring changes are solid before they reach customers
  • Help cut down false-failure noise in the test suite and improve how efficiently it runs, so the team can trust what it's telling them
  • Get close enough to the business logic behind our data pipelines to know not just whether a test passes, but whether it's testing the right thing
  • Build new automations as new features roll out

Requirements

  • Genuine interest in building a career in QA and automation. Entry-level to ~1-2 years of QA or testing experience
  • Comfortable moving between technical detail and business context. You care about why a test matters, not just whether it passes
  • Familiarity with coding with Claude or similar
  • Strong foundations in Java and SQL
  • Proficiency with version control systems (Git)

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with API/UI test automation frameworks and tools like Cucumber, Selenium
  • Experience with AWS (EC2, S3, IAM)
  • Knowledge of CI/CD tools like Jenkins

Interviewing with Veeva

    We value your time and believe in a transparent hiring process. Here is the process you can expect.

  • Follow the application process and submit your resume.
  • Within 3 days, you will receive a link to a personality assessment administered by a third party.
  • Once you complete the assessment, our team will review your full application package and follow up via email with our decision.
  • If moving to the interview stage, the process is as follows:
    1. A conversation with the hiring manager
    2. A technical/coding skills exercise
    3. A final panel interview with team members and senior leaders
  • Once all interviews are complete, the manager will be in touch with a final decision.

Perks & Benefits

  • Medical, dental, vision, and basic life insurance
  • Flexible PTO and company paid holidays
  • Retirement programs
  • 1% charitable giving program

  • LYNX MOSA.ic.AI: LYNX MOSA.ic.AI is a unified CPU and GPU software platform that enables deterministic, certifiable deployment of AI and advanced workloads in mission-critical edge systems. As a DO-178/DO-254 Software Quality Assurance (SQA) Engineer at Lynx, you will be responsible for ensuring that our software development processes and deliverables meet DO-178 and DO-254certification standards.   • Learn and support traceability activities (SLR/HLR/LLR/test/evidence)

  • Basic understanding of software and hardware development lifecycle and documentation practices

job.description:
Position: Offensive Security Consultant / Penetration Tester
Location: United States - Remote

﻿TalentFish is casting a line for experienced Penetration Testers. Our client is an established consulting firm focused on Cyber, Risk and Penetration testing. This role is open due to company growth and requires consultative Penetration testers. This is a not tool-heavy checkbox testing organization. We are fishing for Penetration testers who think like adversaries, pursue meaningful attack paths, and turn technical evidence into decisions clients can act on. We are looking for a consultant first mentality - testers who are focused on actual remediation and client solutions.
You are an experienced penetration tester who prefers deep manual work over scanner-driven checklists. You enjoy chaining findings, building proof-of-concept tooling, thinking like an adversary, and explaining technical risk clearly. You understand that the test isn't finished when the exploit lands, it's finished when the client understands their risk and knows how to fix it.
The person we're looking for: You combine technical depth with humility, curiosity, clear communication, strong judgment, and a bias toward practical solutions.

﻿What You'll Do

  • Lead manual penetration tests across network, web/API, cloud, wireless, thick client, and enterprise environments
  • Execute objective-based red team and adversary simulation engagements when in scope
  • Develop custom proof-of-concept exploits, scripts, and tradecraft when existing tools are not enough
  • Produce clear reports with attack narratives, evidence, business impact, and prioritized remediation guidance
  • Contribute to methodology, tooling, lab work, research, and deliverables.
  • Participate in project kickoff and report delivery meetings
  • Mentor by example through sound judgment, clean execution, and professional communication
  • Support clients through remediation: answer follow-up questions, validate fixes, and help their teams understand not just what was found, but why it matters

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience in penetration testing, offensive security consulting, or red team operations
  • Depth in at least one major domain, such as network, Active Directory, web/API, cloud, or red teaming
  • A skills-based certification or equivalent practical proof of ability
  • Proficient with common industry tools and C2 frameworks
  • Scripting or coding ability useful for automation, tooling, or exploitation
  • Working knowledge of PTES, OWASP, MITRE Telecommunication&CK, and related offensive security references
  • Strong client-facing communication and ability to deliver with minimal supervision. You can walk a systems administrator through a finding, brief an executive on business risk, and listen well enough to understand a client's environment and constraints before prescribing fixes

Bonus Points

  • Previous experience conducting penetration testing in a consulting capacity
  • Experience testing cloud, identity, EDR-protected endpoints, or mature enterprise networks
  • Ability to translate offensive security findings into compliance-relevant risk and remediation guidance
  • Experience with malware development, C2 framework enhancements, and EDR evasion
  • Desire to contribute to blog and/or speak at industry conferences on occasion

What you can expect: remote-first work, challenging client environments, uncapped quarterly performance bonus potential, paid training and certifications, conference opportunities, experienced teammates, and room to improve methodology.
Our client works as a high-trust, low-ego team that shares techniques, debriefs hard findings, challenges assumptions, and helps each other improve.
You will have room to go deep technically, improve methodology, contribute to research and tooling, and deliver work clients can rely on.

Compenstation 130K to 150K + + base plus bonus.

job.title: Penetration Tester

About Workstreet

At Workstreet, we’re on an exciting journey to help businesses scale securely by designing and implementing cutting-edge security and compliance programs. As a fast-growing startup, we specialize in a wide range of GRC (governance, risk, and compliance) services that support frameworks across SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, CMMC, NIST 800-171, NIST 800-53, and FedRAMP. We empower companies to meet regulatory requirements and enhance their cybersecurity posture from day one.

Get to know the Security Services Team

We are the team that turns complex security requirements and compliance frameworks into infrastructure and services that actually work. Moving fast and taking true end-to-end ownership, our team spans three core functions: Cloud Security Engineering, where we design hardened AWS, Azure, and GCP environments, write Terraform baselines, and fix failing controls to meet frameworks like SOC 2, ISO 27001, CMMC, and FedRAMP; Penetration Testing, where we run disciplined offensive assessments across networks, apps, cloud, and AI/LLM systems to catch vulnerabilities before adversaries do; and Vulnerability Management, where we continuously prioritize, patch, and validate risk reduction across the client footprint. We do not hide behind process or just point out gaps. We step in, build solutions, and deliver real security posture improvements with minimal disruption.

What makes this team special isn't just our technical depth; it is how we back each other up. Our strongest engineers and assessors are the ones building reusable modules, writing custom tools, jumping into channels to unblock teammates, and mentoring without being asked. From early-stage startups to regulated enterprises, you will work directly with clients, take on real ownership early, and be surrounded by people who want to see you get good. What help you succeed

  • Integration of GRC compliance frameworks - Practical alignment of technical vulnerability data to satisfy the automated audit and evidence requirements of SOC 2, GDPR, or HIPAA.

What we offer

job.title: QA Engineer - Load and Performance Testing
job.description:
This is a remote position.
Join one of the Philippines' fastest-growing tech companies! Open to Philippine-based candidates only.
About Us
Full Scale is a fully remote-first company that helps businesses build dedicated teams of skilled software engineers. We make it easier for growing companies to find, onboard, and retain high-performing software talent.
The Role
As a QA Engineer, you will help ensure our client's applications remain fast, stable, and reliable under real-world demand. This is a hands-on, hybrid QA role where you will create and execute load and performance tests across web, mobile, and API applications, analyze results, and work with development and infrastructure teams to identify performance bottlenecks.
Load testing is an important part of this role, but it will not be your only responsibility. Testing activities run in cycles, with some weeks requiring load testing once or twice and major events potentially requiring continuous testing for around three weeks. When load testing is paused, including during periods when NeoLoad credits are unavailable, you will support the team with manual testing and some automation testing.
We're looking for someone with practical load-testing knowledge who is flexible, analytical, and comfortable handling other QA responsibilities between performance testing cycles.
Key Responsibilities
  • Performance Test Scripting: Create, maintain, and execute performance test scripts for web, mobile, and API applications using NeoLoad, JMeter, or similar tools.
  • Test Execution: Plan and run load, stress, and performance tests, monitoring application behavior during execution.
  • Results Analysis: Analyze response times, throughput, and error rates to identify performance bottlenecks and potential causes.
  • Monitoring and Observability: Use monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Azure Monitor, Grafana, or Splunk to help investigate application and infrastructure performance.
  • Reporting and Communication: Prepare clear test reports, document findings, and communicate results to the team.
  • Cross-Team Troubleshooting: Work with development and infrastructure teams to investigate performance issues and support troubleshooting.
  • Manual Testing: Execute manual test cases across web and mobile applications when load testing is not active.
  • Automation Testing: Assist with automation testing as needed between performance testing cycles.
  • Flexible QA Support: Adapt to changing testing priorities and support other QA activities during periods when load testing is paused.

Requirements

  • Ideally, 1–3 years of hands-on experience in load and performance testing. Candidates with 5–6+ years of experience are also welcome.
  • Hands-on experience with NeoLoad is strongly preferred.
  • Solid understanding of load, stress, and performance testing concepts.
  • Experience testing web, mobile, and API applications.
  • Knowledge of REST APIs, HTTP/HTTPS, JSON, and SQL.
  • Ability to execute performance tests, analyze results, and identify performance bottlenecks.
  • Experience with monitoring tools such as Dynatrace, AppDynamics, Azure Monitor, Grafana, or Splunk.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
  • Willingness to perform manual and some automation testing when load testing is not active.
  • Comfortable working in a hybrid QA role where load testing is not a full-time, daily responsibility.
  • Scripting experience in JavaScript, Python, or Groovy is a plus.

Benefits

  • 100% remote work setup
  • Work from anywhere in the Philippines
  • Hands-on exposure to enterprise-scale applications and performance testing tools
  • Opportunity to work with NeoLoad, JMeter, and other performance monitoring tools
  • Collaboration with development and infrastructure teams
  • Opportunity to broaden QA skills through performance, manual, and automation testing

job.title: Senior Tester II
job.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

QUALITY ASSURANCE

What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

What You'll Do

Epic Games is looking for a full-time Senior Tester II for our testing group in Brazil. The person in this role will own the testing approach for a specialized domain within a major Epic product, and will be expected to make that domain measurably faster and more reliable to test over time through better methods, tooling, and use of data. You will work embedded with the development team, developing and executing tests with or without QA Analyst guidance, and proactively identifying problems beyond the day-to-day in order to solve them at the root rather than one case at a time. The Senior Tester II is also a technical reference point for the wider test team, mentoring testers and raising the quality bar through example. If you are interested in a fast-paced environment, capable of navigating interpersonal quandaries, and desire to work on a world-class QA team, then we would love to talk to you.

In this role, you will

  • Own the test approach for your area, developing and executing tests independently, with or without QA Analyst guidance
  • Design and introduce sustainable testing methods, including tooling, automation aids, or data analysis, that measurably increase the throughput or efficiency of testing efforts
  • Proactively identify systemic problems that go beyond day-to-day concerns and develop semi-permanent solutions instead of one-off fixes
  • Perform test gap and risk analysis for your domain, using defect data and coverage insights to redirect testing effort to where it matters most
  • Provide the development team with reports on blocking issues, test results, and overall quality status, framing risk in terms the team can act on
  • Escalate quality concerns that cannot be resolved within existing constraints, bringing a recommended path forward
  • Self-prioritize your work on a week-to-week basis and help shape the team's priorities aligned with product goals
  • Mentor testers on your team and act as a domain reference for adjacent teams, sharing context, methods, and standards

What we're looking for

  • A minimum of 4 years of experience in QA/Testing at games or software, including experience working embedded within a development team throughout the software development life cycle
  • Demonstrated depth in the product areas you have tested, with the judgment to know where risk concentrates and how to go after it
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese
  • A track record of improving how testing gets done, through tooling, process change, or data, with evidence of the resulting impact
  • Ability to analyze defect trends and coverage gaps, and to act on that analysis to prevent future issues
  • Experience with gaming consoles and/or mobile devices
  • Experience with game engines such as Unreal and Unity
  • Proficient with test management tools (e.g., TestRail, Xray, QMetry) and issue tracking systems like Jira
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to drive alignment on quality with developers, designers, and production
  • Experience mentoring less experienced testers

EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

job.title: Head of Quality Engineering
job.description:
Description

We’re looking for a Head of Quality Engineering to raise the bar for quality across our web, mobile, and desktop products.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who can shape a scalable quality engineering strategy, drive meaningful test automation, and turn quality into a measurable engineering discipline. You’ll work across teams, influence engineering decisions, and build processes and systems that help quality scale beyond the QA team. We’re looking for someone with strong technical expertise who can set the direction, guide implementation, and make informed trade-offs rather than being responsible for day-to-day hands-on execution.

We are actively integrating AI and automation into all areas of the business and are looking for candidates with a mindset focused on improving efficiency, automating repetitive processes, and delivering a better user experience.

Key responsibilities

  • Own the company's test coverage trajectory (unit and end-to-end) and make it grow predictably as a managed metric, not as a side effect of individual enthusiasm
  • Build the quality infrastructure and standards that let developers and AI agents write and run tests as a natural part of delivery. The role builds the instruments; engineering teams produce the tests
  • Turn tests into real protection for the products: quality gates as the default state of every codebase, so broken changes stop reaching users
  • Move releases, mobile first, from manual verification to automated confidence, so release cadence can grow without trading away quality
  • Define how the company trusts AI-written code: the verification layer and acceptance standards for agent-driven development
  • Grow the QA discipline and the QA engineers across all teams, in partnership with their team leads: shared standards, shared tooling, and a common bar for what quality engineering means at Muse
  • Build and maintain the company-level quality roadmap together with the product team leads, and report progress and risks to engineering leadership

Requirements

Proven impact: You have a track record of taking teams or organizations from having tests that provide limited protection to implementing automated testing that reliably gates releases. You can demonstrate the impact with measurable results, such as improved coverage, fewer escaped defects, faster release cycles, reduced flaky-test rates, or similar metrics.

Cross-platform automation: You have production experience across web, mobile, and desktop, with hands-on expertise in at least two and architecture or review-level experience in the third.

  • Web: Playwright or equivalent at scale, with experience designing maintainable test architecture, parallelizing test execution, and systematically addressing flaky tests.
  • Mobile: Maestro, Detox, Appium, or equivalent, with experience supporting release trains, staged rollouts, and reliable device/emulator CI.
  • Desktop: Native applications across Windows, macOS, or Linux. Experience with visual regression testing is a plus; C++/Qt experience is an advantage.

Quality & CI/CD: You treat quality as an engineering metric. You have established quality baselines, tracked meaningful trends, and validated that automated tests effectively detect defects through mutation testing or equivalent practices. You have operated large automated test suites as real CI/CD gates, balancing required checks, branch protection, test reliability, and feedback speed.

AI-assisted engineering: You have hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding and test generation using tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, or similar. You understand where AI-generated tests provide meaningful protection and where they may simply increase coverage without improving confidence.

Leadership: You can grow and mentor engineers without relying on formal line-management authority. You have helped other engineers develop stronger automation skills and can demonstrate this impact. You are comfortable defending quality decisions using data and clearly articulating trade-offs, including when to block a release and when the level of risk is acceptable.

English: Upper-Intermediate or higher.

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
Decile Group ( is transforming venture capital into a force for good in the world. We are working to launch 10,000 next-generation venture capital firms by 2030, fundamentally changing the face of venture capital.

We operate an integrated platform for modern venture capital, spanning education, software, and fund operations. VC Lab trains the next generation of fund managers. Decile Hub provides AI-enabled tools for fund operations. Start Fund enables managers to launch institutional-grade funds in under 24 hours. Decile Capital deploys capital into emerging managers. Together, these offerings make venture capital more accessible to anyone with world-class ideas and execution.

We're looking for a QA Engineer to join the Decile Group product team and own quality across Decile Hub and Start Fund. Read more about how Decile Group builds here:

This is not a role where someone hands you a test script and you follow it. Your job is to anticipate issues before they come up. You will build the QA system: the agents, the test plans, the release checks, and the habits that catch problems before a fund manager or LP ever sees them.

The ideal candidate is agentic from day one. You set up cutting-edge AI agents that test, monitor, and flag problems on their own. You understand our customers well enough to predict where they will get stuck, from a fund manager launching a fund to an LP logging in for the first time to sign documents or wire capital. You still bring the discipline of a classic QA: organized, thorough, and relentless about follow-through.

You don't need to come from a big company. You need to show us that you can catch what others miss.

Basic requirements:

  • You must live and work within a few time zones of Pacific (California) time.
  • You must be actively building with AI agents, not just using chat tools.
  • You must be able to own quality end to end without waiting for instructions.
  • You must be willing to get close to customers (calls, tickets, onboarding sessions) and turn what you learn into tests.

If you want to build the quality system for a platform that thousands of investors use to run their firms, you belong at Decile Group.

And we want to work with you too.

What You'll Do

  • Anticipate issues before release. Study each feature, the customer using it, and the flows around it, and find the problems before they ship. You are measured by what never reaches customers.
  • Build an agentic QA system. Set up and maintain AI agents that run regression tests, explore new features, check customer flows, and flag risks automatically. Keep improving them as the tools get better.
  • Know the customer. Learn how fund managers, LPs, and our internal teams actually use Decile Hub and Start Fund. Read support tickets, shadow onboarding calls, and turn real customer confusion into test cases.
  • Own the onboarding and login flows. Make sure every step a new LP or fund manager takes (invites, login, verification, documents, capital calls) works the first time, every time.
  • Run classic QA with discipline. Write test plans, maintain regression suites, track and triage bugs, and run release checks. Keep it all organized so anyone on the team can see what was tested and what is at risk.
  • Partner across Decile Group teams. Work closely with engineering, product, and customer success. When something breaks or looks risky, escalate early and clearly.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years in QA, test engineering, or a related role on a SaaS product
  • Hands-on experience building with AI agents and automation tools
  • A track record of catching issues before release, not just logging them after
  • Experience with test automation for web applications
  • Strong organization: test plans, bug tracking, and release checklists that other people can follow
  • Clear written communication. Your bug reports tell an engineer exactly what happened and how to reproduce it
  • Customer empathy. You can put yourself in the shoes of a first-time user and see where they will get lost

Nice to Have

  • Experience with venture capital, fund administration, or financial compliance workflows
  • Experience with Ruby on Rails applications
  • Experience testing onboarding, identity verification, or payment flows

How to Apply:

If you don't tick every box above, we'd still encourage you to apply. We're building a diverse team whose skills balance and complement one another.
Please describe why you are uniquely qualified for this position in the competitive field of Venture Capital, including an example of an issue you anticipated and caught before it reached customers, as well as submitting your resume.
Salary and benefits are commensurate with experience.

Scam Warning

VC Lab and Decile Group never conduct hiring interviews via chat, and we will never ask candidates to send money, purchase equipment, or share financial information. Scammers may impersonate real employee names. If you are contacted about a role outside our official channels, do not engage.

Flexigrant is cloud-based grant management software built for organisations that award funding, from community foundations to central government. It replaces spreadsheets and email with a single system covering applications, eligibility, assessment, awards, monitoring, and reporting, with a full audit trail throughout.

The platform replaces disconnected spreadsheets, emails and paper-based processes with one secure, configurable system, giving grant managers a complete and up-to-date view of every programme, application and award. Flexigrant also creates a clear audit trail of actions and decisions, helping organisations maintain transparency and meet their governance and reporting responsibilities.

Trusted by more than 100 organisations worldwide, the platform supports grant programmes of varying sizes and complexity. The Role

As QA Analyst, you will own the quality of what we ship. You will plan and run testing across Flexigrant, from exploratory, functional and regression testing through to building automated tests, working closely with our developers and Product Manager to catch issues early.

This is a hands-on role for a fast learner who enjoys getting to know a complex product in depth. Much of that product knowledge is built on the job, alongside the development team, so a real appetite to learn is essential.

It is also an AI-native role. You will use AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot every day to plan, create and maintain tests, grow our automation and help build quality in as Flexigrant modernises. AI fluency will be explored at interview, so be ready to show how you work.

We are remote-first: you will work with colleagues across locations and are trusted to work wherever you are based.

Key Responsibilities

  • You will plan, design and run manual testing across Flexigrant, including exploratory, functional, regression and edge-case testing.
  • You will build and maintain automated tests and help grow our automated test coverage.
  • You will work with developers and the Product Manager to refine requirements and turn them into clear, testable acceptance criteria.
  • You will reproduce and document issues clearly, giving developers concise, actionable feedback so they can resolve them quickly.
  • You will carry out API testing and use SQL to validate data and investigate issues.
  • You will support releases each sprint, balancing planned testing with reactive support, and take part in refinement, sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
  • You will use AI tooling as a core part of your daily workflow to improve testing processes and speed up delivery.
  • You will share product knowledge across the team and help improve our QA processes and practices.

Key Skills, Knowledge and Abilities

  • 4+ years in a software QA or testing role, ideally within an Agile team.
  • Strong manual testing skills (exploratory, functional, regression and edge-case), including web applications across devices and browsers.
  • Experience with automated testing tools such as Selenium or Cypress.
  • API testing experience (for example Postman) and working knowledge of SQL for data validation.
  • The ability to turn requirements from meetings and conversations into test cases and testable acceptance criteria.
  • Experience with version control and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Daily use of AI tools such as Claude or GitHub Copilot, with the judgement to prompt, steer and critically review their output.
  • Excellent attention to detail and time management, with the ability to prioritise several test items at once.
  • A collaborative, patient communicator who builds trusted relationships with developers and product colleagues.
  • Interest or experience in AI-assisted and agentic testing workflows (desirable).
  • ISTQB Foundation (CTFL) or BCS Foundation Certificate in Software Testing, or a further ISTQB, test automation, API testing or Agile certification (desirable).
  • Familiarity with accessibility testing and WCAG (desirable).

No degree or formal qualification is required. Demonstrable QA experience matters most.

job.title: Customer Quality Engineer
job.description:
About MISUMI Americas

MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.

The Customer Quality Engineer communicates with customers on quality-related issues and coordinates with regional Quality Teams to efficiently and effectively resolve concerns and to drive continual improvements to proactively avoid issues from arising. This is a technical role.

Impact for the Role

As the Customer Quality Engineer you will have a significant impact on maintaining and improving customer satisfaction on our major programs. You will ensure that Quality is recognized as an order-winning proposition by our customers, with early engagement to ensure that their requirements are fully understood, our manufacturing partner capabilities are aligned, and our execution is optimized. Post sale, you will coordinate with the customers on any quality issues, acting as the subject matter expert supporting Program Managers and coordinating with Quality Team members in the regions where parts are being manufactured to ensure quick resolution of problems without unnecessary back and forth with delays resulting from time differences across our regional offices.

What You Will Be Doing

You will report to the Head of Global Quality and will assist from time to time with various duties as needed and assigned.

  • Review customers’ quality requirements, whether formalized through supplier quality manuals, for instance, or by interviews with customers. Integrate these requirements into MISUMI Americas Quality Management System
  • Support APQP and PPAP activities as required by customers, including the implementation of optimized measurement plans for mechanical parts
  • Ensure analytical and manufacturing techniques are consistent from manufacturing partner to manufacturing partner and meet agreed customer specifications through alignment with regional Supplier Quality Engineers
  • Provide subject matter expertise to program managers to both solve problems but also to develop the structured problem solving capabilities within the Program Management team and other MISUMI Americas functional groups
  • Act as the bridge between customers and regional Quality Teams
  • Identify opportunities for improvement in MISUMI Americas Quality Management System and manufacturing partner network, based on observations and involvement with customers
  • Implement performance indicators which tell MISUMI Americas how well we are doing with customer quality
  • Ensure customer-initiated supplier corrective action requests (SCARs) are responded to correctly, completely and in a timely manner
  • Establish a compelling story for MISUMI Americas Quality to be an order-winning proposition not merely an order-qualifying one
  • Serve as a customer advocate for quality issues, but tactfully pushing back when customer demands are unreasonable
  • All employees are expected to maintain and contribute to the QMS.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree in a technical subject (Masters preferred)
  • Fluency in English (Chinese language fluency is a preferred additional skill)
  • Minimum of 3 years Quality Engineering or Program Management experience in mechanical part manufacturing
  • Experience working in a global organization and influencing colleagues in different timezones
  • Fully conversant in GD&T principles
  • Strong Understanding of Injection Molding, 3D printing, or Sheet Metal preferred
  • Strong understanding of quality principles and manufacturing processes (metrology expertise is preferred)
  • Strong foundational mindset in risk identification and mitigation
  • Data-driven, detail-oriented, and pragmatic
  • Structured problem solving with a multi-strategy approach
  • Six Sigma certification preferred
  • Ability to evaluate customer requirements and standards and convert them into executables
  • Understanding of ISO9001:2015 requirements
  • Understanding of other QMS standard requirements e.g. ISO13485, ISO13485, IATF16949 (preferred)
  • Must have strong verbal and written communication skills and possess the ability to interact effectively at all levels in an organization, internal or external

Desired Traits

You’re Collaborative – It is expected that you will partner with various functional groups within MISUMI Americas, in all regions, as well as collaborating with customers and manufacturing partners

  • Excellent collaboration skills and the ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks
  • Ability to build strong trust-based relationships internally and externally
  • Subject Matter Expert for resolving quality issues identified by customers
  • Ability to influence without having direct authority

You will serve as an Advocate – In the role, you will solicit and listen to customer requirements and concerns, and take an active role in avoiding problems wherever possible, but resolving them when they do occur.

  • Strong in identifying customer requirements
  • Adept at shifting priorities while maintaining a strong sense of urgency
  • Good listener who’s comfortable with ambiguity, asking questions, and providing clarity
  • Strong customer service skills with demonstrated service mentality
  • Build and maintain credibility with customers and within MISUMI Americas

You’re Passionate and Empathetic - You have a passionate commitment to people and deep empathy for how supporting individuals leads to a stronger company culture.

  • Exhibit a high level of initiative and integrity
  • Empathetic to the needs of customers, manufacturing partners, and MISUMI Americas. Able to balance the different perspectives
  • Able to make decisions without all the available information and being able to course correct when new information becomes available
  • Learn from situations and drive improvements as a result of thorough lessons learned analysis
  • Able to exercise good judgment within broadly defined practices and policies and work in a self-directed manner

Physical Demands

  • While performing the duties of this job, the employee routinely is required to sit; walk; talk and hear; use hands to keyboard, fingers, handle, and feel; stoop, kneel, crouch, twist, crawl, reach, and stretch.

Travel: Ability to travel up to 50% annually in the US and/or other regions globally

We’re actively seeking teammates who:

  • Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
  • Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
  • Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
  • Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
  • Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates

We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.
