job.title: Quality Engineering Lead / Automation Architect
job.description:
About POMS

POMS develops Manufacturing Execution System (MES) software solutions for the life sciences industry. POMS is investing heavily in automated quality engineering, modern software delivery practices, and AI-assisted testing to further product quality and accelerate delivery.


Position Summary

POMS is seeking a hands-on Quality Engineering Lead / Automation Architect to lead the shift from predominantly manual testing to automation-driven quality engineering. This is a hands-on role: the successful candidate will personally help enhance the automation foundation (Playwright framework, standards, and CI/CD integration) and lead a global QA team to deliver automation at scale, using data to measure outcomes and prioritize investments.


Key Responsibilities


Automation Strategy and Architecture

  • Own POMS' test automation strategy and roadmap, serving as technical lead for the Playwright framework, automation standards, coding guidelines, and review practices.
  • Design and build scalable Playwright suites in TypeScript, making effective use of fixtures, workers, parallelization, test isolation, retries, traces, and reporting.
  • Organize workflow-based testing suites with clear smoke, core regression, and release regression layers across functional, API, integration, and end-to-end testing.
  • Assess the existing manual test inventory and prioritize which tests should be automated, redesigned, consolidated, kept manual, or retired
  • Partner with Development and DevOps to enhance our automated regression pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or similar), with sound environment, test-data, and parallel-execution strategies across TFVC and Git repositories.
  • Apply AI-assisted tools to test generation, maintenance, coverage analysis, and defect identification, and evaluate emerging testing tools and practices.

Team Leadership

  • Build, mentor, and develop a small, high-performing QA team, with particular responsibility for building automation capability
  • Put in place the standards, coaching, delegation, and ownership models that allow the team to scale automation without relying on the lead to author most tests.
  • Set goals, performance expectations, and career development plans, and support hiring, onboarding, and succession planning.
  • Foster quality ownership, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Quality and Release Management

  • Champion shift-left and risk-based testing, and participate in requirements, design, and architecture reviews to identify risks early.
  • Define data-driven release readiness criteria and quality gates, and own QA for all software releases.
  • Build operational and executive dashboards and KPIs covering automation coverage, defect escape rates, release readiness, and team performance, and use them to prioritize investments.
  • Lead root cause analysis of escaped defects and implement preventive improvements.
  • Support validation and compliance activities within a regulated software environment.

Qualifications


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of software quality assurance and testing experience
  • Expert-level experience building enterprise-scale test automation frameworks using Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or comparable tools, with strong TypeScript or JavaScript skills.
  • Strong software engineering skills, preferably in TypeScript and JavaScript, including Git, API testing, SQL, debugging, and code review.
  • Experience integrating automated regression testing into CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins, or comparable platforms.
  • Experience scaling automation capability through coaching, standards, and delegation.
  • Proven use of quality metrics, dashboards, and KPIs to drive decisions and outcomes.
  • Experience testing complex web-based enterprise applications in Agile environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and excellent verbal and written communication.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience building substantial Playwright suites in TypeScript (fixtures, workers, parallelization, test isolation, retries, traces).
  • Experience leading QA teams or large-scale testing initiatives.
  • Experience in regulated industries such as life sciences, pharmaceutical manufacturing, healthcare, or medical devices, including GxP and 21 CFR Part 11.
  • Experience working across mixed TFVC and Git environments, including migration to Git.
  • Demonstrated success transforming a predominantly manual QA organization into an automation-heavy one
  • Experience using AI or machine learning to improve testing efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Knowledge of performance and security testing methodologies.

Success Measures

  • Establish a baseline quality scorecard and show measurable KPI gains within 12 months.
  • Increase automated coverage of core and critical product areas
  • Deliver reliable, fast, and maintainable automated regression running on every build.
  • Enable the QA team to produce automation at scale against consistent standards.
  • Detect defects earlier in the lifecycle and improve release confidence.

job.title: Director - Quality Assurance & Process Improvements
job.description:
Job Description:

PairSoft is looking for a quality leader who sees QA as a strategic function — not a gate at the end of a delivery cycle, but a discipline that runs through how software is designed, built, and operated. You will lead an existing team of 15 -20 members and take ownership of both the quality function and a broader mandate around process improvement across the engineering organization.
We are looking for someone who brings their own point of view on where the friction is and how to reduce it — not someone who waits to be told what to fix.

Location: PAN India ( remote)

Responsibilities / Essential Functions

  • Lead and develop a QA team of 15 -20 across multiple product lines, setting quality standards and building a culture of engineering discipline.
  • Define and own the testing strategy across the portfolio — spanning functional, regression, integration, and non-functional quality dimensions.
  • Identify and drive process improvement initiatives across the engineering organization, with a focus on measurable outcomes over process theater.
  • Establish metrics and reporting that give leadership meaningful visibility into quality trends, not just pass/fail counts.
  • Work across ERP integration surfaces and enterprise deployment contexts to ensure quality standards account for the complexity of the customer environments PairSoft operates in.
  • Build a team capable of scaling with the organization — developing talent, closing skill gaps, and raising the floor across the QA function.

Requirements

The right candidate will have a track record in quality leadership within enterprise software — not consumer applications, not early-stage startups and not consulting projects. The complexity of enterprise environments, long release cycles, and integration-heavy architectures is where this person should feel at home.

  • Significant experience leading QA teams in enterprise software organizations, with direct ownership of quality outcomes across multiple products or platforms.
  • A point of view on process improvement that goes beyond quality — someone who has looked at how engineering organizations work and found better ways to sequence, coordinate, or structure that work.
  • Familiarity with financial software environments — understanding the stakes of defects in systems that touch financial transactions, document integrity, or compliance workflows.
  • Experience working with or around ERP ecosystems, where integration complexity and customer environment variability create non-trivial quality challenges.
  • The ability to operate at both a strategic and a working level — comfortable defining a testing philosophy and equally comfortable getting into the detail when it matters.
  • Strong communication skills across engineering, product, and executive stakeholders — able to translate quality data into business-relevant narrative.

Work and Physical Requirements

This position may work from home and/or office environment. Working in an office environment may require prolonged sitting, work in an air-conditioned environment, ability to work with others at various noise levels and ability to lift up to 30 pounds or 15 kg.

Other Duties

This job description is not intended to be a complete list of responsibilities. Other duties may be assigned by management that may reasonably fit in the scope of job.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

PairSoft is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment including the decision to hire, promote, discipline, or discharge, will be based on merit, competence, performance, and business needs. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical​​​ condition, pregnancy, genetic information, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or ​expression, veteran status, or any other status protected under federal, state, or local law.

About the Company

We are a global team of innovators and advocates transforming how financial data is captured, stored, and manipulated with our comprehensive suite of automation technology. Our platform seamlessly integrates with your existing ERP for an unrivaled end-user experience. We do the heavy lifting so accounting, procurement, and fundraising teams can do their best work.

PairSoft’s aspires to be the strongest procure-to-pay platform for the mid-market and enterprise, with close integration to Microsoft Dynamics, Blackbaud, Oracle, SAP, Acumatica and Sage ERPs.

At PairSoft, we are passionate about innovation, transparency, diversity, and advocating on behalf of our customers and communities we support. We offer exciting career opportunities and a collaborative culture that allows individuals to learn, grow, and create meaningful impact. We are expanding and seeking team players who are eager to jump in and contribute to our rapid growth!

job.description:
Rejoignez nesto – fière lauréate du titre Canadian Rocketship 2025. Propulsée au palmarès Deloitte Fast 50, nesto évolue aux côtés des plus grands innovateurs technologiques du Canada. Nous transformons une industrie hypothécaire de 2,1 billions de dollars à la vitesse de l'éclair en bâtissant l'écosystème hypothécaire du futur.

BÂTISSEZ des technologies de prêt avec les meilleurs développeurs, ingénieurs en IA et experts hypothécaires au pays. Évoluez au sein d'une pile technologique moderne et d'un cadre de développement conçu pour libérer votre plein potentiel et accélérer votre carrière.

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Hypercroissance : Classée au palmarès Deloitte Fast 50 pour une 3e année consécutive.
  • Crédibilité Tech : Nommée Canadian Rocketship 2025 par TechTO.
  • Leader de l'industrie : Élue Lending Company of the Year (CLA) pour une 4e année consécutive.
  • Aimant à talents : Lauréat CMP Top Mortgage Employer 2025.
  • Technologie de confiance : Propulse les plus grandes institutions financières au Canada.
  • Culture entrepreneuriale : Fondée sur la confiance, la rapidité, l'ambition audacieuse et une obsession sans faille pour nos clients.

À propos de l'équipe

Notre équipe de données est le pilier de Nesto Cloud, gérant le flux d'informations qui alimente la plateforme hypothécaire la plus avancée au Canada. En tant que Développeur(euse) Senior en QA de données, vous ne ferez pas que « vérifier les résultats » ; vous serez un(e) ingénieur(e) spécialisé(e) axé(e) sur l'intégrité, la fiabilité et l'évolutivité de nos pipelines de données. Vous collaborerez étroitement avec les développeurs de données pour garantir que nos environnements BigQuery, nos DAG Airflow, nos modèles DBT et nos processus ETL sont infaillibles.

Ce que vous ferez

  • Concevoir des cadres de qualité des données : Concevoir et bâtir des suites de tests automatisées et robustes pour les pipelines de données en utilisant Python et SQL afin de valider l'intégrité des données, la cohérence des schémas et la logique de transformation.
  • Approche « Shift Left » : Faire équipe avec les développeurs de données et les gestionnaires de produits dès la phase de conception pour définir les contrats de données, les barrières de qualité et les critères d'acceptation avant même l'écriture du code.
  • Automatiser à outrance : Développer des moniteurs de « Data-SLA » automatisés et des signaux d'observabilité (ex: Great Expectations, Monte Carlo ou outils Python personnalisés) pour détecter les anomalies dans BigQuery et Airflow avant qu'elles n'affectent les rapports en aval.
  • Validation complexe : Effectuer une validation approfondie des processus ELT/ETL complexes, en veillant à ce que les ensembles de données haute performance optimisés pour Power BI et l'analytique interne soient précis et sécurisés.
  • Intégration CI/CD : Implémenter et maintenir des tests spécifiques aux données au sein de nos flux CI/CD basés sur Git (en utilisant Pulumi/Terraform), garantissant que chaque déploiement est soutenu par une régression automatisée.
  • Amélioration continue : Assumer la responsabilité globale des résultats liés à la qualité des données, en améliorant la documentation, la gouvernance des données et les flux de travail de l'équipe pour rendre notre processus de développement plus fluide et plus fiable.

Profil recherché

  • Expérience : Plus de 5 ans d'expérience en QA de données, avec un accent particulier sur le test d'environnements de données SaaS/cloud complexes.
  • Maîtrise technique : Fortes compétences en Python et SQL. Vous abordez l'assurance qualité avec une mentalité de génie logiciel, en écrivant un code d'automatisation propre et maintenable.
  • Pile technologique moderne : Expérience pratique avec GCP (BigQuery) et les outils d'orchestration comme Airflow.
  • Infrastructure-as-Code : La familiarité avec Pulumi ou Terraform est un atout majeur.
  • Rigueur analytique : Compréhension approfondie de la modélisation des données, de la conception dimensionnelle et capacité à diagnostiquer les goulots d'étranglement de performance dans les plans d'exécution SQL.
  • Mentalité Startup : Vous êtes autonome, vous vous épanouissez dans des environnements au rythme rapide et vous êtes à l'aise avec l'incertitude occasionnelle d'une startup en hyper-croissance.
  • Formation : Baccalauréat ou Maîtrise en informatique, en génie logiciel ou dans un domaine technique connexe.

Ce que nous offrons

  • Programme hypothécaire pour les employés : taux préférentiels exclusifs.
  • Couverture santé complète : couverture étendue de premier ordre (santé, dentaire, vision) avec couverture des médicaments à 100 %.
  • Accès à un régime d'épargne-retraite collectif REER/RPDB avec des contributions de contrepartie compétitives de l'entreprise.
  • Télémédecine et soutien familial (programmes de complément pour les congés de maternité/parentaux).
  • Lieu de travail flexible : entièrement à distance ou dans l'un de nos bureaux (Montréal, Québec, Toronto, etc.).

Pourquoi nous rejoindre

  • Contribuez à moderniser l'industrie hypothécaire canadienne.
  • Entreprise certifiée B Corp, soulignant notre engagement social et environnemental.
  • Nous avons remporté le prix CLA du prêteur hypothécaire de l’année 2023, 2024 et 2025, qui reconnaît notre excellence en matière de services de prêt.

Diversité et Inclusion

Chez nesto, nous croyons que la créativité et la collaboration sont le résultat d'une équipe diversifiée. Nous sommes engagés à favoriser une culture de la diversité, de l'équité, de l'inclusion et de l'appartenance, et nous encourageons fortement les femmes, les personnes de couleur, les membres de la communauté LGBTQIA+ et les personnes en situation de handicap à postuler. Nous nous engageons à créer un environnement de travail inclusif et accueillant pour tous. Ce poste est ouvert à tous les candidats et candidates et peut être occupé à distance depuis n'importe où au Canada.

job.title: NPI Quality Engineer (Hardware)
job.description:
At WHOOP, we're on a mission to unlock and inspire performance for life. WHOOP empowers members to perform at a higher level through a deeper understanding of their bodies and daily lives.

WHOOP is seeking an NPI Quality Engineer II, Hardware to support Product Quality activities for hardware development programs from concept through launch. As a member of the Product Quality organization, you will partner closely with Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supplier Quality, Reliability, Operations, and global manufacturing partners to help ensure products are designed, validated, and launched with exceptional quality.

You will support quality planning, design and manufacturing risk management, validation, and launch-readiness activities while developing technical expertise in Product and NPI Quality.

Responsibilities:

  • Support Product Quality activities for assigned hardware development programs, components, or subsystems throughout development, validation, manufacturing readiness, and product launch.

  • Partner with Product Management and Systems Engineering to help translate Voice of Customer requirements into measurable product and engineering requirements.

  • Work cross-functionally with Hardware Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Supplier Quality, Field Quality, Reliability, Test Engineering, Operations, and manufacturing partners to identify potential failure modes and quality risks early in product development and track them through resolution.

  • Support and facilitate quality planning activities including DFMEA, CTQ definition, reliability planning, validation and verification, process capability, measurement system analysis, and launch-readiness reviews.

  • Analyze engineering and manufacturing data to identify product and process risks and support data-driven decision making.

  • Partner with Supplier Quality to support supplier and contract-manufacturer quality activities, including engineering drawing reviews, design-file reviews, control plans, inspection strategies, and process capability assessments.

  • Apply structured problem-solving methodologies to investigate product and manufacturing failures, support root-cause analysis, and drive corrective and preventive actions.

  • Support engineering builds and NPI activities, including identification, documentation, prioritization, and closure of quality issues.

  • Monitor product and process quality metrics and communicate significant trends, risks, and issues to the Product Quality team and cross-functional stakeholders.

  • Participate in cross-functional program and technical reviews, providing objective quality data and supporting risk and launch-readiness assessments.

  • Document lessons learned and help ensure relevant findings from development, validation, manufacturing, and field performance are incorporated into future product-development activities.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of Product Quality processes, tools, templates, and standards.

  • Willing and able to travel up to 15% internationally to partners, suppliers, and contract manufacturers.

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Quality Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 3–5+ years of experience in Product Quality, NPI Quality, Manufacturing Quality, Product Engineering, or related engineering roles supporting consumer electronics, wearables, medical devices, or similarly complex hardware.

  • Experience supporting hardware products through one or more phases of product development, validation, manufacturing readiness, and/or launch.

  • Working knowledge of quality methodologies including DFMEA, PFMEA, CTQ, DOE, SPC, MSA, GR&R, root-cause analysis, CAPA/8D, and statistical quality methods.

  • Experience analyzing engineering and manufacturing data and applying structured problem-solving techniques.

  • Experience working with suppliers or manufacturing partners, preferably in a high-volume manufacturing environment.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to use objective data to identify and communicate product and manufacturing risks.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across engineering and operations teams.

  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, collaborative environment while managing assigned priorities and deliverables.

job.title: Senior Game Tester, Game Modes, Clash Royale
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Senior Game Tester to join our Shanghai Studio and take ownership of quality for Clash Royale's new game modes.

Clash Royale is expanding well beyond its classic gameplay. New modes are being created in both Shanghai and Helsinki, at a fast cadence and often from rough prototypes rather than finished specs. You will be the QA owner across that portfolio — defining how each mode gets tested, planning and scaling the resources to do it, and making the final call on whether quality is good enough to reach players. That call takes design sense as much as rigour — judging whether a mode delivers the experience it was designed for, not only whether it works as built. (The Royale main mode, its peripheral systems, and the long-standing classic modes are covered by our Helsinki QA peers separately.)

At Supercell, we believe that small teams that find a way to work well together have the potential to create memorable games. It's important that each team member takes pride in their work and knows what it means to take responsibility and deliver quality and fun to players. As a Game Tester at Supercell, you are responsible for making decisions to improve player experience and testing processes, but will need to collaborate with game programmers, game artists and other designers to create a game played for years and remembered forever.

If you think that describes you, then we'd love to hear from you.

 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own end-to-end quality for Clash Royale's new game modes — from early prototype through live release and iteration.

  • Work with Core Tech QA on the technical layer beneath the modes — release, performance, backend and SDK quality are owned there, keeping your focus on gameplay correctness and player experience, and surfacing mode-specific risk on shared systems like matchmaking.

  • Plan and execute tests with no explicit requirements, taking the initiative to analyse the product and goals, and determine the areas of risk and best tests to mitigate those.

  • Work directly with mode teams in both Shanghai and Helsinki to understand test scope early, agree on quality bars, plan resourcing and timelines, and ensure the final delivery meets them.

  • Scale testing coverage by managing onsite QA testers and external QA vendors – briefing, prioritising, quality-checking their output, and flexing capacity as the mode pipeline moves.

  • Design, develop and apply testing processes for our games to improve game quality and player experience.

  • Raise the bar across the wider team – bring proven practices from the Chinese games industry into a global studio, and share them with Helsinki-based colleagues.

  • Stay up to date with new testing tools, test strategies and AI tooling adoption to QA work.

  • Support the development of the game with any additional skills.

     

What You Have

  • At least 8 years of professional experience as a Game Tester, ideally with experience working on both new and live games.

  • Strong hands-on experience in testing games – we want a person who loves to do the hard work.

  • Proven experience owning quality for a feature or game area end-to-end, including the final quality call before release.

  • Experience managing both onsite QA teams and external QA vendors, and scaling test coverage up and down as needed.

  • Fluency in both English and Mandarin. English is the working language with our Helsinki teams and some Shanghai team members, so you will need to be comfortable running test planning and scope discussions in English, in writing and in person.

  • A fast learner, comfortable getting productive in an unfamiliar proprietary codebase – Clash Royale runs on Titan, Supercell's own in-house engine.

  • Practical experience using AI tools to improve QA efficiency, such as AI-aided automated test flows, or a clear appetite and aptitude for building that into how you work.

  • Good knowledge of iOS and Android ecosystems, experience in testing games on both platforms.

  • Good understanding of the quality risks that live competitive systems carry – matchmaking, fairness, progression and reward economies – which modes inherit regardless of genre.

  • Proactive doer who takes responsibility and pride in their own work when given the freedom to work independently.

  • Strong cross-discipline communication skills.

  • Being a great teammate - we believe making games is a team sport.

     

Would Be Nice if You Also Have

  • Leadership or mentoring experience.

  • Hands-on test automation experience, including scripting and CI-integrated test suites.

  • Experience working in a distributed team across time zones.

  • Experience testing across a range of game genres and formats – the mode portfolio is deliberately varied, so breadth adapts better here than depth in any single genre.

     

Why This Role

Most senior QA roles inherit a process. This one doesn't. Clash Royale's mode portfolio is new, growing, and built across two studios, which means the testing practice for it is still being written – and you'd be the one writing it. You'll set the quality bar for modes that reach tens of millions of players, decide how testing scales as the pipeline grows, and shape how QA works between Shanghai and Helsinki rather than fitting into someone else's version of it. If you've built QA practice before and want to do it again with real reach, this is that role.

Where You'll Be

This role is based in our Shanghai office. If you are not local, our relocation team would be excited to help you with your move to Shanghai,China. We provide comprehensive support not only for you, but also for your family!

–––

That's it about the role! Below, we've gathered some things we feel are important for you to know. Totally optional, but a highly recommended read.

Once you're ready to apply, just send us your application through the form on the bottom of the page.

–––

About Supercell
Supercell is a games company from Helsinki, Finland, with offices also in San Francisco, Seoul, Shanghai, and London. You might know us as the makers of Hay Day, Clash of Clans, Boom Beach, Clash Royale, Brawl Stars, and Squad Busters. Our mission is to create great games that as many people as possible play for years and that are remembered forever.

So, how do we make great games? By putting together the best teams and giving them the freedom and independence to succeed. And by taking risks, failing, sharing learnings, and killing lots of projects.

The Shanghai studio
As Supercell’s first international game development studio, the Shanghai studio is one of the most exciting things happening in Supercell and a unique opportunity to join at a relatively early stage to help shape our path. Our vision is to be a world-class international studio, making new global hit games while leveraging the unique advantages of the game development scene in China and broader Asia.

Hey, you Might Love It Here!
Independent cells and trust are at the core of our culture. But it takes more than that to make great games. We take good care of our people, providing them with the compensation, work environment, and resources they need to succeed while having fun along the way.

You Are Not Your Job Title ™
Here, you won’t need to focus on chasing titles or climbing ladders. Internally, our job titles don’t include prefixes like Senior, Junior, Principal, or Director. Recognition isn’t tied to your title, as it doesn't define the impact you can have around here.

Benefits and Compensation
Luring you in with glitter, glamour, and gems isn't what we're about. We want you to enjoy your time here fully, so we structure our compensation and benefits with that in mind. It starts with perceiving you as a human being, not a resource.

Relocation? Yes!
No matter where you’re moving from, our dedicated mobility team and partners will support you throughout your move. We’ll ensure the process is as smooth as possible for you and anyone joining you – whether they’re family members of the human or animal kind!

Not sure if you should apply?
Many candidates with great skills and experience second-guess themselves. The bar is high, but if this role excites you, apply! We’re here to help you succeed. Also, we're happy to learn about any specific accommodations you may need to fully engage in our recruitment process.

Wishing you all the best,
The Supercell Recruitment team

P.S. Here's a video about what we do. (Best enjoyed with salmiakki and rye bread)

job.title: AI QA Trainer – LLM Evaluation
job.description:
Are you an AI QA expert eager to shape the future of AI? Large-scale language models are evolving from clever chatbots into enterprise-grade platforms. With rigorous evaluation data, tomorrow’s AI can democratize world-class education, keep pace with cutting-edge research, and streamline workflows for teams everywhere. That quality begins with you—we need your expertise to harden model reasoning and reliability.

We’re looking for AI QA trainers who live and breathe model evaluation, LLM safety, prompt robustness, data quality assurance, multilingual and domain-specific testing, grounding verification, and compliance/readiness checks. You’ll challenge advanced language models on tasks like hallucination detection, factual consistency, prompt-injection and jailbreak resistance, bias/fairness audits, chain-of-reasoning reliability, tool-use correctness, retrieval-augmentation fidelity, and end-to-end workflow validation—documenting every failure mode so we can raise the bar.

On a typical day, you will converse with the model on real-world scenarios and evaluation prompts, verify factual accuracy and logical soundness, design and run test plans and regression suites, build clear rubrics and pass/fail criteria, capture reproducible error traces with root-cause hypotheses, and suggest improvements to prompt engineering, guardrails, and evaluation metrics (e.g., precision/recall, faithfulness, toxicity, and latency SLOs). You’ll also partner on adversarial red-teaming, automation (Python/SQL), and dashboarding to track quality deltas over time.

A bachelor’s, master’s, or PhD in computer science, data science, computational linguistics, statistics, or a related field is ideal; shipped QA for ML/AI systems, safety/red-team experience, test automation frameworks (e.g., PyTest), and hands-on work with LLM eval tooling (e.g., OpenAI Evals, RAG evaluators, W&B) signal fit. Skills that stand out include: evaluation rubric design, adversarial testing/red-teaming, regression testing at scale, bias/fairness auditing, grounding verification, prompt and system-prompt engineering, test automation (Python/SQL), and high-signal bug reporting. Clear, metacognitive communication—“showing your work”—is essential.

Ready to turn your QA expertise into the quality backbone for tomorrow’s AI? Apply today and start teaching the model that will teach the world.

We offer a pay range of $6-to- $65 per hour, with the exact rate determined after evaluating your experience, expertise, and geographic location. Final offer amounts may vary from the pay range listed above. As a contractor you’ll supply a secure computer and high-speed internet; company-sponsored benefits such as health insurance and PTO do not apply.

You will work closely with developers, product managers, and other teams to ensure that our solutions are seamless, secure, and bug-free. This position allows you to have a direct impact on the user experience, shaping the quality of products that are used by businesses across multiple industries.

Financial & Career Growth

Work-Life Balance

- Paid vacation days and holidays

Extras

How to Apply

If you're passionate about quality, testing, and product excellence and want to be part of a fast-growing tech company, we want to hear from you. Apply now to take the next step in your career with Everglade Works and help us deliver high-quality, innovative products to businesses that need them.

job.title: Senior Quality Assurance Engineer
job.description:
At BusRight, we're transforming an industry that has relied on outdated systems for far too long. School transportation is a critical part of everyday life for millions of students and families, yet much of the industry still depends on fragmented, manual processes.

We’re building a modern transportation platform that makes school buses safer, smarter, and more efficient for students, families, schools, and communities nationwide.

Our product ecosystem spans web, mobile, backend, mapping, real-time systems, and integrations. As a Senior Quality Assurance Engineer, you’ll take a leading role in ensuring the reliability, performance, and overall quality of that ecosystem.

This role goes beyond executing test cases. You’ll help define how we approach quality, identify risks before they become customer problems, investigate complex production issues, improve automation and tooling, and influence engineering practices across teams.

Why This Role Matters

You’ll join an established QA function and help take it to the next level.

We’re looking for someone who can operate independently, make sound quality and risk decisions, and act as a trusted technical partner to engineering and product teams.

You’ll work across the entire development lifecycle—from requirements and technical design through implementation, release, production monitoring, and incident investigation.

You’ll be expected to question assumptions, uncover difficult edge cases, identify systemic quality risks, and improve how we test and ship software.

This is a hands-on senior role. You’ll still test products directly, but you’ll also help shape test strategy, automation, tooling, processes, and quality standards across the organization.

What You’ll Do

Own Quality Across Complex Product Areas

  • Take ownership of quality for complex features and product areas across Web, Android, and Flutter applications.
  • Define appropriate test strategies based on technical complexity, customer impact, risk, and system architecture.
  • Perform exploratory, integration, regression, and end-to-end testing across interconnected systems.
  • Identify edge cases, failure modes, and risks that may not be obvious from product requirements alone.
  • Help teams determine appropriate release confidence and identify gaps before changes reach production.

Investigate Complex Problems

  • Lead investigation of difficult bugs and production issues across frontend, mobile, backend, infrastructure, and third-party integrations.
  • Analyze application logs, network traffic, API requests, database data, monitoring signals, and source code to isolate root causes.
  • Reproduce complex or intermittent issues and provide engineers with clear technical findings.
  • Distinguish symptoms from underlying causes and identify patterns across seemingly unrelated incidents.
  • Build scripts, utilities, or debugging tools when they can accelerate investigation or improve future troubleshooting.

Drive Test Automation and Engineering Quality

  • Design, build, and maintain E2E and integration automation using tools such as Playwright/Maestro/Appium.
  • Identify where automation provides meaningful value and where manual or exploratory testing is more appropriate.
  • Improve automation architecture, reliability, maintainability, and execution speed.
  • Work with engineers to improve testability at the application and system level.
  • Improve automated quality checks on CI/CD workflows.

Influence Engineering and Product Decisions

  • Partner with engineers and product managers during planning and technical design to identify risks early.
  • Challenge unclear requirements, assumptions, and implementation decisions when they introduce unnecessary quality risk.
  • Communicate tradeoffs clearly and help teams make informed release decisions.
  • Represent the customer and operational perspective during technical discussions.
  • Collaborate closely with Support and other customer-facing teams when investigating reported issues.

Improve QA Processes and Quality Culture

  • Identify weaknesses in existing QA processes and propose practical improvements.
  • Improve test documentation, defect reporting, release validation, incident analysis, and quality metrics.
  • Help establish scalable testing practices as the product and engineering organization grow.
  • Share knowledge, provide technical guidance, and help less-experienced QA engineers develop stronger testing and debugging skills.
  • Promote the idea that quality is a shared engineering responsibility rather than something owned only by QA.

Who We’re Looking For

Core Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience in Quality Assurance, Software Engineering in Test, or another strongly technical software quality role.
  • Significant experience testing complex web and mobile applications involving multiple interconnected services.
  • Advanced exploratory testing and risk-analysis skills.
  • Strong experience investigating production issues using logs, APIs, databases, monitoring tools, and other technical signals.
  • Hands-on experience with automated testing frameworks and methodologies.
  • Strong programming and debugging skills—you should be comfortable reading, understanding, and navigating production codebases.
  • Ability to write automation, debugging utilities, scripts, data-analysis tools, or other engineering support tooling when needed.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, client-server architecture, and data flows between services.
  • Strong understanding of the full Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), from requirements analysis and test design through execution, release validation, and production monitoring.
  • Experience working with defect tracking systems and test management practices.
  • Understanding of software security and privacy considerations, including authentication, authorization, data handling, access control, and common OWASP risks.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Experience with mapping, GPS/location systems, real-time applications, or transportation technology is a strong plus.

Technical Background

Experience with some of the following technologies is useful, but expertise in every technology listed is not required. We value strong fundamentals and the ability to quickly understand unfamiliar systems.

  • Web: React, TypeScript
  • APIs & Backend: REST APIs, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Firebase
  • Mobile: Android, Flutter
  • Automation: Playwright, Maestro, Appium
  • Observability & Debugging: Datadog, Sentry, Google Cloud Platform, Proxyman
  • Data & Infrastructure: PostgreSQL, Redis, Firebase Firestore, Google Cloud Platform
  • API tooling: Postman or similar tools
  • Security: OWASP, authentication/authorization concepts, privacy and data-handling practices
  • Delivery: CI/CD pipelines, Agile software development practices
  • Mapping / Location: GPS, geospatial systems, mapping SDKs, routing, or other location-based technologies

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • You naturally think in terms of risk, failure modes, and customer impact, not just expected behavior.
  • You are comfortable investigating problems across multiple layers of a system.
  • You can work independently when requirements are incomplete or the problem is poorly understood.
  • You know when deeper investigation is necessary and when additional testing provides diminishing returns.
  • You communicate quality concerns clearly without becoming a bottleneck for delivery.
  • You are comfortable challenging assumptions and advocating for technical improvements.
  • You look for opportunities to eliminate recurring problems rather than repeatedly testing around them.
  • You enjoy building tools and processes that make engineering teams more effective.
  • You balance attention to detail with pragmatic decision-making.

job.description:
Why YOU want this position

At Enverus, we're committed to empowering the global quality of life by helping our customers make energy affordable and accessible to the world.

We are the most trusted energy-dedicated SaaS company, with a platform built to maximize value from generative AI, and our innovative solutions are reshaping the way energy is consumed and managed. By offering anytime, anywhere access to analytics and insights, we're helping our customers make better decisions that help provide communities around the world with clean, affordable energy.

The energy industry is changing fast. But we've continued to lead the way in energy technology, creating intelligent connections across the entire energy ecosystem, from renewables, power and utilities, to oil and gas and financial institutions. Our solutions create more efficient production and distribution, capital allocation, renewable energy development, investment and sourcing, and help reduce costs by automating crucial business operations. Of course, this wouldn't be possible without our people, which is why we have built a team of individuals from a diverse range of backgrounds.

Are you ready to help power the global quality of life? Join Enverus, and be a part of creating a brighter, more sustainable tomorrow.

SBS, an Enverus company, is seeking a Test Automation Engineer to join the Distribution Tools team, reporting to Matthew Rickard, Director of Software Development. This is a dedicated, 100%-automation-focused role: your mandate is to convert our existing manual regression coverage into reliable automated tests, building on our existing investment in T-Plan Robot for image-based desktop and CAD GUI automation.

A core part of this role is applying AI tools to the hardest part of test automation — writing and maintaining the tests themselves — while building in the validation steps needed to keep AI-assisted tests repeatable and trustworthy, not just fast to produce.

This role starts embedded in Distribution Tools, but it is designed to grow: the frameworks, practices, and tooling you build are expected to extend across SBS's broader desktop application portfolio (AUD, ABD, DDS, P4A/P4I, and the SDS suite) as the practice matures, and your remit will expand accordingly over time.

What you will do

Test Automation & Coverage

  • Own automation of existing manual regression test suites for Distribution Tools products, using T-Plan Robot as the primary automation engine for CAD-based desktop GUI testing.
  • Design and implement automated test frameworks and reusable patterns for desktop and Revit-integrated applications.
  • Execute automated test suites, analyze failures, and document defects with clear reproduction steps.
  • Maintain and continuously improve test automation infrastructure and its integration with CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions / Azure DevOps).

AI-Assisted Test

  • Authoring Evaluate and apply AI/LLM tools to accelerate the authoring and maintenance of GUI test scripts.
  • Build generate-then-validate workflows so AI-assisted test creation produces repeatable, trustworthy regression coverage rather than brittle, one-off scripts.
  • Document what works, and what doesn't, so the approach can be adopted by other teams.
  • Collaboration & Process Partner with developers and product owners across Distribution Tools to prioritize the highest-value regression scenarios to automate first.
  • Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives) as an embedded member of the Distribution Tools team.
  • Provide feedback on code quality and testability during code reviews.

Reporting & Growth

  • Track and report on automation coverage, defect trends, and time saved to build the business case for expanding the practice.
  • As the practice matures, extend frameworks and mentorship to test engineers on other desktop product teams (Substation Tools, GTI).

What skills you should have

  • 5+ years of combined experience in manual and automated testing of desktop or engineering software
  • Hands-on experience with T-Plan Robot or a comparable image/OCR-based GUI automation tool for desktop applications
  • Practical, applied experience using AI and LLM tools in a development or QA workflow, able to speak to both productivity gains and repeatability risks
  • Proficiency in at least one general-purpose test automation framework, such as NUnit, Selenium, or WinAppDriver
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines, such as GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps

Skills that stand out

  • Familiarity with Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, or Inventor and their automation APIs
  • Experience standing up a test automation practice from a limited existing base, rather than extending a mature one
  • Background in utility, energy, or infrastructure engineering software

Our Technology Stack

T-Plan Robot, NUnit, Selenium, WinAppDriver, SQL, Postman, Swagger, GitHub Actions, Azure DevOps, Autodesk Revit, AutoCAD, Inventor

Job Title: QA Engineer

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

Required Skills: Automation Testing, QA

We’re looking for a QA Engineer to help ensure the quality, reliability, and overall performance of our products. In this role, you’ll work closely with engineers, product teams, and other stakeholders throughout the development lifecycle. You’ll be responsible for testing new features, identifying and documenting issues, improving test coverage, and helping the team maintain a high standard of quality as we continue to build and ship quickly. The ideal candidate has strong manual testing fundamentals, hands-on experience with test automation, and a solid understanding of modern QA practices and software development lifecycles.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Own testing activities across new features, product improvements, and bug fixes.

  2. Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive manual test cases and test scenarios.

  3. Identify, document, track, and validate bugs throughout the development lifecycle.

  4. Build and maintain automated tests to improve regression coverage and overall testing efficiency.

  5. Perform functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing across the product.

  6. Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand requirements, identify potential risks, and ensure appropriate test coverage.

  7. Participate in Agile development processes, including planning, refinement, and release cycles.

  8. Identify opportunities to improve QA processes, testing practices, and overall product quality.

  9. Manage testing priorities and communicate blockers, risks, and findings throughout the development lifecycle.

Required Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven experience in software quality assurance within agile, fast-paced environments.

  • Strong expertise in manual testing methodologies, test planning, and test execution.

  • Hands-on experience implementing, maintaining, and executing automated tests and testing frameworks.

  • Proven experience performing functional, regression, integration, and exploratory testing.

  • Strong understanding of software development lifecycles, QA processes, and release validation.

  • Solid experience with bug-tracking systems, test management tools, and version control platforms.

  • Proven experience identifying, documenting, reproducing, and validating software defects.

  • Strong understanding of test coverage, regression strategies, and quality assurance best practices.

Description

MWDN is a global IT outstaffing company with 23+ years of experience that connects exceptional tech talent with leading companies across Israel, the USA, Great Britain, and Western Europe. We offer opportunities to work on international products in a stable and professional environment.

Why does MWDN rock?

Here’s what you can expect when you join MWDN:

  • Security: We carefully vet our clients to minimize risks and ensure reliability and timely payments - no fraud or unpleasant surprises.
  • Career support: If a project isn’t the right fit, we support you and actively help find new opportunities that match your skills and career goals.
  • Legal assistance: We provide guidance on legal matters, including opening and managing your independent contractor or sole proprietorship status, taxes, and related processes.
  • Professional development: We offer English courses and professional growth opportunities, as well as team-building events.

Why choose us? MWDN is ranked among the top 5 IT employers in our region according to DOU. We take pride in our transparency and strong commitment to our team. Curious to learn more? See what our employees say about working with us on DOU.

What is your new project?

Domain: Media and Entertainment

Client Location: Israel

Company size: 11-50 employees

Founded in: 2025

What makes this project exciting?

Our new client is something really innovative! This Israel-based startup is building a mobile-first app for micro dramas - a short, scripted series made for smartphones. Think of it as TikTok with short episodes lasting 1 to 1.5 minutes.

The project already has strong support from an investor who believes in its massive potential. As it is still in the early development stage, this job is your chance to be part of a unique entertainment product. Are you ready to work on something fresh and impactful? Check out the opportunity below!

We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to join our founding core team and help us build the future of streaming. As first QA hire, you will own quality across our Android, iOS and web clients from day one - defining how we test, choosing the tools, and building the automation framework from the ground up. You will work closely with our multi-platform engineering team, which leverages Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP), to make sure every release delivers a flawless, cinematic experience to our users.

What makes you a great fit

  • At least 4 years of experience in QA, with 3+ years of hands-on test automation.
  • Must: proven experience testing and automating native mobile apps (Android & iOS) in production at scale, using Appium and/or native frameworks (Espresso, XCUITest).
  • Experience with web automation (Playwright preferred) and API testing (e.g., Postman).
  • Experience running automated tests in CI/CD pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions).
  • Strong coding skills in at least one language - Kotlin, Java, TypeScript/JavaScript, Python or Swift.
  • AI-first mindset: you use AI tools (such as Claude, Cursor or Copilot) every day to write, maintain and scale tests faster, and you're curious about new AI-driven ways to test.
  • Solid understanding of QA methodologies, test design and the full software development life cycle.
  • Experience working in fast-paced, agile environments, preferably in consumer-facing mobile apps, gaming or entertainment.
  • A self-starter who works independently and effectively in a remote setup, and builds processes where none exist.
  • Must: excellent written and verbal English - you'll collaborate with a distributed team and write clear test plans, bug reports and documentation.
  • A strong product sense and a keen eye for user experience.

Huge Advantages

  • Experience as the first or only QA engineer in a startup.
  • Direct experience with streaming platforms or video technologies, including testing video playback (HLS).
  • Experience testing in-app purchases and subscriptions (Google Play Billing, StoreKit).
  • Experience with Maestro for mobile UI testing.
  • Experience with cloud device farms such as BrowserStack or Firebase Test Lab.

Your day-to-day in this position

  • Build QA from Scratch: Define QA strategy, processes, test plans and release criteria for mobile and web.
  • Automation Framework: Design, build and maintain scalable automated test suites (UI, API and integration) for Android, iOS and web.
  • CI/CD Integration: Embed automated tests into our build pipelines to provide fast, reliable feedback on every change.
  • Hands-on Testing: Perform exploratory, regression and release testing on real devices, covering video playback, in-app purchases and A/B test variants.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Engineering, Product and Design to bake quality into the development process from the first spec.
  • Quality Insights: Track and report quality metrics, flaky tests and crash trends, and drive continuous improvement.

Why work with us?

  • People-first management with minimal bureaucracy
  • A friendly company culture, proven by employees who choose to return
  • Flexible working hours
  • 29 days of PTO (18 working days per year pluse all national holidays)
  • 10 paid recovery days
  • Full financial and legal support for independent contractors
  • Free English classes, with native speakers or Ukrainian teachers
  • Dedicated HR support

✅ Intro call with a Recruiter — ✅ Intro with the client — ✅ Tech interview — ✅ Home assignment — ✅ Final client interview— ✅ Offer

job.description:
To help keep everyone safe, we encourage all applicants to pay close attention to protect themselves during their job search. When applying for a position online you are at risk of being targeted by malicious actors looking for personal data. Please be aware we will only reach out via email using the domain quanata.com. Anything that does not match those domains should be ignored and considered a security risk.

About Us

Quanata is on a mission to help ensure a better world through context-based insurance solutions. We are an exceptional, customer centered team with a passion for creating innovative technologies, digital products, and brands. We blend some of the best Silicon Valley talent and cutting-edge thinking with the long-term backing of leading insurer, State Farm.

Learn more about us and our work at quanata.com

Our Team

Quanata, LLC is an insurance technology innovation company that engineers advanced risk prediction and prevention solutions, develops risk-focused acquisition capabilities, and builds/supports a full-stack, flexible, digital & increasingly AI-native insurance platform. This helps our primary clients, State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company, adapt to evolving market needs. Quanata, LLC is wholly owned and funded by State Farm.

As a company that prioritizes an inclusive and positive culture, we believe the core of our success is in hiring talented people — across disciplines — who want to help us make a quantifiable impact.

The Role

We’re looking for an accomplished, well-rounded Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (Sr SDET) to help improve the quality and reliability of services that support insurance products and business workflows.

This hands-on role requires deep backend testing experience, strong programming ability, and ownership of scalable test automation.

The individual will validate service behavior and cross-system interactions, strengthen automated delivery checks, and help teams identify defects early in cloud-hosted, distributed environments.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Design, build, test, and maintain shared automation frameworks, internal services, and developer tools that serve multiple QA and engineering teams.
  • Own test strategy and execution for backend APIs, microservices, and end-to-end business workflows, balancing component, contract, integration, and system-level coverage.
  • Design and extend code-based automation frameworks with reusable setup and cleanup, data-driven scenarios, dependency isolation, and clear failure reporting.
  • Validate business rules, API contracts, data persistence, authorization, error handling, and compatibility across services.
  • Test asynchronous processing and distributed-system failure conditions, including retries, duplicate events, partial failures, and delayed consistency.
  • Establish reliable automated checks in continuous integration and delivery pipelines, improving feedback speed and reducing flaky tests.
  • Validate cloud-hosted services and deployment configurations; troubleshoot failures using application logs, service telemetry, and infrastructure evidence.
  • Assess performance and resilience risks, design targeted tests, and collaborate with engineers to address identified weaknesses.
  • Review requirements and architecture, communicate quality risks, and mentor engineers while independently driving complex testing work.
  • Perform other related duties as assigned.

About You

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience.
  • Typically 6–8 years of software testing or engineering experience, including at least 3 years focused on backend APIs and service-based architectures.
  • Substantial hands-on experience developing test automation frameworks and integrating them into automated delivery pipelines.
  • Strong proficiency in a general-purpose programming language, with the ability to design, review, and debug maintainable test code.
  • Deep understanding of API testing, microservice interactions, service contracts, and distributed application behavior.
  • Advanced automation design skills, including test lifecycle management, parameterized execution, mocking, shared utilities, and parallel execution.
  • Practical experience testing and troubleshooting public-cloud applications, including identity and permissions, networking, compute, storage, and messaging dependencies.
  • Experience with continuous integration and delivery, source control, automated quality checks, and environment configuration.
  • Strong database querying skills and the ability to trace data and failures across multiple services.
  • Ability to turn incomplete requirements into meaningful tests and communicate technical findings clearly.

Bonus Points

  • Property and casualty insurance experience is preferred, including policy administration, billing, rating, claims, or related integrations.
  • Experience testing event-driven architectures and complex third-party integrations.
  • Experience with performance, resilience, and service-level security testing.
  • Demonstrated improvement of automation reliability, execution time, or defect detection.

Salary: $198,000 to $281,000

*Please note that the final salary offered will be determined based on the selected candidate's skills, and experience, as well as the internal salary structure at Quanata. Our aim is to offer a competitive and equitable compensation package that reflects the candidate's expertise and contributions to our organization.

Additional Details:

  • Benefits: We provide a wide variety of health, wellness and other benefits.These include medical, dental, vision, life insurance and supplemental income plans for you and your dependents, a Headspace app subscription, monthly wellness allowance and a 401(k) Plan with a company match.
  • Work from Home Equipment: Given our virtual environment— in order to set you up for success at home, a one-time payment of $2K will be provided to cover the purchase of in-home office equipment and furniture at your discretion. Also, our teams work with MacBook Pros, which we will deliver to you fully provisioned prior to your first day.
  • Paid Time Off: All employees accrue four weeks of PTO in their first year of employment. New parents receive twelve weeks of fully paid parental leave which may be taken within one year after the birth and/or adoption of a child. The twelve weeks is applicable to both birthing and non-birthing parent.
  • Personal and Professional Development: We’re committed to investing in and helping our people grow personally and professionally. All employees receive up to $5000 each year for professional learning, continuing education and career development. All team members also receive LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and access to multiple different coaching opportunities through BetterUp.
  • Location: We are a remote-first company for most positions so you may work from anywhere you like in the U.S, excluding U.S. territories. For most positions, occasional travel may be requested or encouraged but is not required. Some positions might require travel per the job description provided to the employee. Employees based in the San Francisco Bay Area or in Providence, Rhode Island may commute to one of our local offices as desired.
  • Hours: We maintain core meeting hours from 9AM - 2PM Pacific time for collaborating with team members across all time zones.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer
job.description:
Who we are:

Mama Money is a growth stage fintech startup working to help migrant workers in South Africa send money home. Since 2015 we have been providing reliable remittances, at a socially fair price, to those that need it most. Mama HQ is in beautiful Cape Town, South Africa.
We are 131 people strong (and counting) from 19 countries across Africa, Asia, the UK, and Europe. Our culture is built around the well-being of our team membersand making a difference in our communities. “Just be lekker!” personifies our approach to work: we trust the wisdom of our talented and diverse team to do what is best for our customers and get the job done responsibly, without pedantic policies.
We’ve been around since 2015 and have earned a few accolades along the way, made some new friends,and expanded our reach. We've had some great times and some tough times, but we continue to focus on helping people rather than maximizing profit.
We’re seeking a Senior QA Engineer to champion a quality-first approach within our agile development team. In this role, you’ll be deeply involved throughout the entire software development life cycle, helping to ensure our products meet the highest standards.

How you will be working at Mama:

When a new feature is introduced by the product owner and architect during refinement, you’ll help ensure the team fully understands the requirements and system architecture. Using a tester’s critical mindset, you’ll question assumptions, uncover edge cases, and identify areas to improve testability, while forming an initial test strategy.
Once planning begins under the tech lead’s guidance, you’ll formalise this strategy into a document covering test scenarios, key integration points (API, app, queues, etc.), test data, and result verification.
As development progresses, you’ll deploy and configure updates in the QA environment, execute test cases, identify and investigate bugs, and log them with clear reproduction steps.
After development, you’ll verify the complete solution and sign off for production. You’ll also drive automation efforts, both for new and existing features, working with the QE Lead, maintaining test suites, and serving as the team’s automation expert.

Skills & tool experience we’re looking for:

  • Proven experience as a QA tester within an Agile software development environment (5–8+ years).
  • Demonstrable experience in developing test strategies & writing test cases.
  • Extensive experience with back-end systems testing with a variety of methods of interacting with components (i.e. REST, SQS, database, and through front end interfaces.)
  • Strong SQL skills and familiarity with relational database tools such as DBeaver, SQL Server, or MySQL Workbench.
  • Experience seeding databases with test data is a plus.
  • Proficiency with version control systems like Git.
  • Experience working with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP); familiarity with AWS services such as EKS, RDS, SQS, and API Gateway is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience using API tools such as Swagger, Bruno and Postman.
  • Experience with scripting (writing and updating) using JavaScript.
  • Knowledge of configuring mocks for isolated service testing would be a big plus.
  • Skilled in exploratory testing with a sharp eye for identifying bugs and user experience issues.
  • Strong multitasking abilities with the flexibility to manage and reprioritise multiple workstreams in a dynamic environment.
  • Solid troubleshooting skills with the ability to trace and report bugs efficiently and clearly.
  • As a Senior, you will be expected to positively influence software quality beyond the boundary of your team.

In your first 90 days at Mama Money you will:

  • Onboard all our tools and processes, and familiarise yourself with the various teams and departments at Mama Money.
  • Develop a deep understanding of what Mama Money does, and what your team does, from the point of view of our customers.
  • Work in your team, advocating quality, writing and performing tests as needed to deliver functionality.
  • Have one-on-one’s with your line manager, and develop a training and career growth plan based on your personal goals, as well as the needs of the business.
  • Regularly give and receive feedback, and suggest improvements.

Why Mama?

At Mama Money, we’re not just a company—we’re a movement. Everything we do is driven by one purpose: to make life better for our customers and the communities we serve. Our customers are our heartbeat, and they inspire every step we take.
We’re all about making it easy. No red tape, no hassle. Just simple, seamless experiences that put people first, we’re here to make things easier, faster, and better for you.
We believe in giving it a go—and then giving it another go if we have to! We're a team of doers, dreamers, and innovators who aren't afraid to break the mold. We take bold steps, experiment with fresh ideas, and never stop learning.
At Mama Money, we own it—and we mean it. We take responsibility for our actions, our results, and how we show up every day. No passing the buck here. We approach every challenge with grit, passion, and determination.
Here’s the best part: Mama Money is a place that truly cares. We care about the trust our customers place in us. We care about our amazing team who bring their best every day.
When you join Mama Money, you’re joining a community. We’re a passionate, down-to-earth crew that works hard and celebrates wins along the way. We take our work seriously, but we don’t forget to have fun while we do it.
So, if you’re ready to make a real difference, take on exciting challenges, and grow in a place where you’re valued and supported, then Mama Money is the place for you. Let’s make an impact—together.

Mama’s values:

1. Making it easier for our customers
2. Give it a go
3. Just own it

job.title: Senior QA Engineer (Manual & Automation)
job.description:
Salla is looking for a Senior QA Engineer to take ownership of product quality across our platform. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring that every release meets our quality standards, and you will be accountable for making informed go/no-go release decisions based on risk and test results.

You will be expected to define the most suitable QA approach for our product and teams, including the testing strategy, tools, standards, and workflows. This approach should be flexible, not rigid: you will adapt the depth, type, and process of testing to fit each situation, whether it's an urgent hotfix, a major feature launch, or a high-risk change.

This is a hands-on role covering both manual and automated testing. You will work closely with engineering, product, and DevOps teams to review requirements, define test strategies, perform manual and exploratory testing, and build reliable test automation using Playwright.

Beyond identifying and resolving defects, you will analyze their root causes and implement preventive measures to reduce recurring issues.

Responsibilities

  • Own quality end to end, building it in early through requirement reviews, design discussions, and test strategy, through to the final go/no-go call on releases
  • Define and continuously refine the QA approach, including testing standards, workflows, tools, and quality metrics. Adapt testing depth, process, and priorities to risk, timeline, and context rather than applying a one-size-fits-all process
  • Decide what needs testing, how deeply, and with which approach (functional, regression, API, UI, performance, security, usability). Decide what stays manual and what gets automated, and know when enough is enough
  • Perform thorough manual and exploratory testing on new features, finding what scripts miss: edge cases, unexpected user behavior, UX problems, and the UI details users notice (layout, states, responsiveness)
  • Build and maintain Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) automation that runs in CI, catches real issues instead of just adding to a test count, and gives the team fast, trustworthy feedback
  • Review code and pull requests properly: read them, question them, and push back when something isn't right
  • Triage defects and investigate them in depth using browser DevTools (network, console, performance, storage) to find root causes, not just symptoms, and help the team prioritize what matters most
  • Prevent recurring issues by identifying the pattern behind bugs, analyzing defect trends, and putting safeguards in place (tests, checks, process changes). Think ahead about how new features, scale, and changes will affect quality
  • Use AI tools thoughtfully to speed up test creation, analysis, and debugging, and build AI-assisted workflows where they add value, while always validating the output
  • Communicate risks clearly to developers, product managers, and leadership, with a recommendation rather than just a report
  • Take initiative to spot gaps in our processes, tools, or product and drive improvements, while mentoring other QA engineers and raising the quality mindset across the team

Requirements

  • 5+ years of QA experience with real ownership of releases and quality decisions
  • Strong experience in both manual and automated testing, and the judgment to balance the two
  • Solid JavaScript and TypeScript skills, enough to write clean, maintainable Playwright automation and read application code with confidence
  • Hands-on experience with Playwright (or strong experience with a similar framework plus a willingness to go deep on Playwright)
  • Strong command of Git and GitHub: branching, pull requests, code reviews, and working within CI pipelines
  • Deep understanding of testing types, techniques, and test design, and the judgment to choose the right one
  • Flexibility to adjust your approach to different situations, avoiding rigid processes while keeping quality standards high
  • Experience testing web, mobile, and APIs
  • Comfort with browser DevTools for debugging and investigation
  • Practical experience using AI in your work, and the critical thinking to know when to trust it and when not to
  • A preventive mindset: you've fixed problems at their root, not just patched symptoms, and can give examples
