job.title: Software Development Test Engineer (SDET), AI & Automation
job.description:
Description

Keeper Security is hiring a Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), AI & Automation to join our AI team and help build a modern, automated approach to quality across AI-powered products and services. This is a 100% remote position, with an opportunity to work a hybrid schedule for candidates based in the El Dorado Hills, CA or Chicago, IL metro areas.

Keeper’s cybersecurity software is trusted by millions of people and thousands of organizations globally. Keeper is published in 23 languages and sold in over 150 countries. Join one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity companies and help establish scalable quality engineering practices for AI-driven systems operating in security-sensitive environments.

About Keeper

Keeper Security is one of the fastest-growing cybersecurity software companies that protects thousands of organizations and millions of people in over 150 countries. Keeper is a pioneer of zero-knowledge and zero-trust security built for any IT environment. Its core offering, KeeperPAM®, is an AI-enabled, cloud-native platform that protects all users, devices and infrastructure from cyber attacks. Recognized for its innovation in the Gartner Magic Quadrant for Privileged Access Management (PAM), Keeper secures passwords and passkeys, infrastructure secrets, remote connections and endpoints with role-based enforcement policies, least privilege and just-in-time access. Learn why Keeper is trusted by leading organizations to defend against modern adversaries at KeeperSecurity.com.

About the Job

As a Senior SDET, AI & Automation, you will serve as an embedded quality engineering partner within Keeper’s AI team. You will work alongside engineers and Product throughout design and development to define test strategy, establish acceptance criteria and build automated coverage as AI-powered capabilities are being developed.

This role requires experience testing both traditional deterministic software systems and non-deterministic AI/ML systems. Traditional application behavior can often be validated against consistent expected outputs, while AI models may produce different but acceptable results across models, prompts and inputs. You will help design testing approaches that account for this variability while still establishing measurable quality, reliability and safety standards. You will build automation frameworks, develop deterministic and probabilistic validation strategies, integrate testing into CI/CD workflows and help Keeper move toward continuous quality engineering rather than end-of-cycle QA.

Responsibilities

  • Partner directly with AI engineers, Software Engineers and Product Managers during design and development to define test strategy, acceptance criteria and automation requirements
  • Design and maintain automated testing frameworks for AI-powered applications, backend services, APIs and supporting software systems
  • Develop testing strategies for both deterministic software behavior and non-deterministic AI/ML outputs
  • Define measurable evaluation criteria, tolerances and quality thresholds for AI model and LLM-driven functionality
  • Build automated regression, integration, API and end-to-end coverage alongside feature development
  • Develop test harnesses and evaluation workflows for prompts, models, agents, tool-calling workflows and AI-integrated applications
  • Validate AI behavior across different models, prompts, inputs and system configurations
  • Develop automated test utilities using languages such as Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust or similar technologies
  • Integrate automated validation and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar platforms
  • Build and maintain test datasets, mocks, fixtures and synthetic data required for repeatable AI and software validation
  • Analyze model and application failures to distinguish defects, expected model variability, data issues and test instability
  • Evaluate AI outputs for reliability, consistency, safety and alignment with expected product behavior
  • Work with engineering teams to improve application testability, observability and diagnostic capabilities
  • Track test cases, execution results and coverage using TestRail or similar test management platforms
  • Analyze logs, telemetry and system behavior to identify root causes and produce clear, reproducible defect reports
  • Reduce flaky tests and improve the speed, stability and maintainability of automated test suites
  • Contribute to quality engineering standards, AI testing methodologies and automation best practices across Keeper’s AI organization
  • Use AI-assisted tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar platforms to improve automation development, test generation, debugging, analysis and documentation

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in SDET, software development, test automation or another code-intensive quality engineering role
  • Hands-on experience testing AI/ML, LLM-powered or model-integrated software systems
  • Strong understanding of the differences between deterministic software testing and non-deterministic AI/ML validation
  • Experience defining evaluation criteria, expected behaviors, tolerances or scoring approaches for AI-driven functionality
  • Strong programming skills in Python, Java, JavaScript/TypeScript, Rust or another general-purpose programming language
  • Significant experience designing, developing and maintaining automated test frameworks
  • Experience building automated functional, integration, API and end-to-end test coverage
  • Experience testing REST APIs and distributed application workflows using tools such as Postman, REST Assured or similar platforms
  • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, Jenkins, GitLab CI or similar technologies
  • Experience working within an Agile software development team with close collaboration between QA, Engineering and Product
  • Strong understanding of shift-left testing, continuous quality and testability principles
  • Experience with TestRail or similar test management platforms
  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills using logs, APIs, application telemetry and development tools
  • Experience with Git-based development workflows, code review and modern software engineering practices
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted development and testing tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot or similar technologies
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate variable AI behavior without relying solely on exact-match outcomes
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills and ability to collaborate closely with AI engineers, Software Engineers, Product Managers and QA professionals
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Due to this role’s involvement with FedRAMP compliance requirements, qualified candidates must be a U.S. Person, defined as a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience testing LLMs, agentic systems, retrieval-augmented generation, tool calling or prompt-driven workflows
  • Experience building automated model evaluation, benchmarking or regression frameworks
  • Familiarity with AI evaluation metrics and techniques for measuring quality across non-deterministic outputs
  • Experience with Rust in production or test automation environments
  • Experience with performance, reliability, security or adversarial testing of AI-enabled systems
  • Experience with AI-assisted generation of automated tests or synthetic test data
  • Familiarity with Docker, Kubernetes or cloud-based testing environments
  • Experience testing cybersecurity, identity, PAM or other security-sensitive software
  • Experience building shared automation frameworks or internal testing tools used across engineering teams

Benefits

  • Medical, Dental & Vision (inclusive of domestic partnerships
  • Employer Paid Life Insurance & Employee/Spouse/Child Supplemental life
  • Voluntary Short/Long Term Disability Insurance
  • 401K (Roth/Traditional)
  • A generous PTO plan that celebrates your commitment and seniority (including paid Bereavement/Jury Duty, etc)

Keeper Security, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer and participant in the U.S. Federal E-Verify program. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Classification: Exempt

job.title: Platform Tester (Back-end Systems) - Canada
job.description:
As a Platform Tester, you'll safeguard the quality of the core platform behind Intelerad's medical imaging solutions: the services, APIs, integrations, and infrastructure that healthcare providers rely on every day. Building on a strong testing foundation, you'll own test strategy for platform components, expand automated coverage across back-end and integration layers, and partner with Engineering, DevOps, and Product teams. Together you'll make sure every release is stable, scalable, and ready for clinical environments.

Key Responsibilities

  • Platform Test Strategy: Own test planning and execution for assigned platform components and services. Define coverage across functional, integration, regression, and non-functional testing to reduce release risk.

  • Automation & CI/CD Integration: Design, build, and maintain automated test suites for APIs, services, and back-end systems. Integrate them into CI/CD pipelines to shorten feedback cycles and increase release confidence.

  • Integration & Non-Functional Testing: Validate platform behaviour across interfaces and deployment environments. This includes interoperability (e.g., DICOM, HL7), performance, scalability, and upgrade and migration scenarios.

  • Defect Analysis & Resolution: Investigate complex, cross-component issues using logs, data, and system diagnostics to isolate root causes. Partner with engineering teams to drive timely resolution and prevent recurrence.

  • Quality Practice & Mentorship: Contribute to platform testing standards and quality metrics. Guide Software Testers on platform testing approaches, tooling, and best practices.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing or quality assurance, including experience testing integrated, multi-service, or platform-level systems, or equivalent experience.

  • Demonstrated experience building and maintaining test automation frameworks for API and integration testing.

  • Working knowledge of SQL, test management tooling (e.g., qTest, Zephyr), and CI/CD pipelines.

  • Experience testing within containerized or cloud-based environments (e.g., AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).

  • Demonstrated ability to lead test strategy for complex releases with minimal supervision.

Preferred Qualifications & Special Requirements

  • Experience with performance and load testing tools for distributed systems.

  • Healthcare IT or medical imaging domain knowledge (e.g., PACS, RIS, DICOM) is a plus.

  • ISTQB certification or equivalent.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer
job.description:
Description

Vi Operate puts AI agents into the daily operations of large health systems, providers, and pharma organizations. Augment is the voice capability underneath it: the agents that call patients and providers, hold a real conversation, and take action in the systems where the work actually lives. This is a dedicated quality role for that work.

Testing a voice agent is not like testing software that returns the same answer twice. A similar call can go three different ways. A model update can quietly change behavior that nothing in a unit test would catch. When a call goes badly, the cause could be the speech recognition, the model, the voice synthesis, the telephony layer, or the integration underneath, and the transcript alone won't tell you which. Making that testable, repeatable, and catchable before a client hears it is the job.

You will own quality for agents that call real patients, providers, and caregivers. That means building the test and evaluation systems our engineers develop against, deciding what has to pass before something ships, and being the person who can take a bad call recording and say what actually went wrong. We need someone who has done classical QA properly and has since tested voice and LLM systems in production, because this role needs all three.

What You'll Own

  • Voice testing and debugging. Call recordings, transcripts, latency traces, and logs. Isolating which layer failed: speech to text, the model, text to speech, telephony, or the integration behind it. Turning a vague "the call went badly" into a reproducible ticket an engineer can act on.
  • Evaluation and regression testing. Golden test sets, simulated calls, judged transcripts, accuracy on classification and extraction, and structured output validation. Regression coverage that still holds when the underlying model changes.
  • Testing things that aren't deterministic. Deciding what "passing" means when the output varies run to run. Setting tolerances, handling flake honestly rather than by rerunning until green, and keeping the suite trustworthy enough that engineers act on a failure.
  • Release criteria. What has to be true before an agent goes live for a client, and what has to stay true afterward. You set the bar and you hold it, including when a deployment date is pushing on it.
  • Classical QA for the rest of the product. Test plans, regression suites, bug triage, reproductions, and CI integration for everything around the agent.
  • Quality in production. Sampling live calls after release, spotting drift and degradation, and getting it in front of the right engineer before the client raises it.
  • Breaking it on purpose. Red-teaming the agent before someone outside does. Prompt injection through the documents it reads, callers who talk it off script or push it toward giving medical advice, people claiming to be someone they aren't to get patient information out of it. You test that the guardrails and access controls actually hold under pressure, not just that they exist.

What We're Looking For

  • QA on production voice agents. You have tested a system that talks to people on the phone, and you can walk through a real failure you diagnosed: what you heard, where you looked, and which layer turned out to be at fault. This is required and it's what we screen hardest on.
  • QA on LLM systems. You have tested something built on a language model in production, not as a side project, and you can describe how you decided whether it was working.
  • Real classical QA depth. Test strategy, test planning, regression suites, bug triage, and release process. You have worked somewhere QA had teeth.
  • Testing non-deterministic systems. You have dealt with output that varies and made it testable anyway, and you can explain the tradeoffs you made to get there.
  • Python and test automation. You write your own tooling and wire it into CI rather than filing a ticket for someone else to.
  • Judgment about severity. You can tell the difference between a cosmetic defect and something that will mislead a patient on a phone call, and you can defend that call to an engineer who disagrees.
  • A system mindset. You look at the whole system rather than one piece, and your first instinct is to find where it comes apart. You think about the seams between components, the inputs nobody planned for, and the person on the other end trying to get something out of it that they shouldn't.

Nice To Have

  • Background in IVR, contact center, or CCaaS quality (Genesys, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect, Twilio, or similar)
  • Audio and network condition testing: codecs, jitter, packet loss, barge-in and interruption handling
  • Familiarity with evaluation tooling such as LLM-as-judge harnesses, prompt regression frameworks, or simulated conversation testing
  • Healthcare or pharma experience, and comfort working under HIPAA
  • Experience standing up a QA function rather than joining one
  • Load and performance testing on real-time systems
  • Spanish proficiency, enough to listen to a call and judge whether the agent handled it

job.title: Software Quality Assurance Manager
job.description:
Overview

World Travel Holdings is seeking an experienced Quality Engineering & Test Automation Manager to lead a blended Quality Engineering team and build an AI-enabled, automation-first quality capability for World Travel Holdings (WTH). In this role, you will modernize testing tools and processes, design scalable automation and agentic quality workflows, mentor engineers across manual, exploratory, and automated testing disciplines, and partner closely with Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, and DevOps teams to improve requirement quality, developer feedback cycles, release readiness, platform resiliency, and business outcomes across the software development lifecycle.

About the Company

World Travel Holdings, headquartered in Fort Lauderdale, FL, is the nation’s largest cruise agency and an award‑winning leisure travel company with nearly 40 travel brands. Through owned brands and private‑label partnerships, we sell cruises, villas, resort day passes, and luxury travel services. With a top-rated franchise, a UK cruise division, and a strong commitment to employee engagement and remote work, World Travel Holdings offers a people-focused culture. Learn more: WorldTravelHoldings.com

Responsibilities

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a blended Quality Engineering team spanning manual, exploratory, regression, API, performance, accessibility, and automated testing.
  • Manage Quality Engineering team capacity, priorities, and delivery across active initiatives while simplifying, standardizing, and modernizing team processes.
  • Establish an onboarding process that helps Quality Engineering team members ramp quickly and consistently.
  • Build strong working partnerships across Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Quality Engineering to establish shared ownership of quality throughout planning, design, development, delivery, and operation.

Automation Framework Strategy

  • Own the design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a modern, scalable automation framework supporting web, mobile, accessibility, API, integration, performance, and regression testing.
  • Define the automation framework architecture, technical standards, tool selection criteria, coding patterns, and governance practices needed to create a consistent enterprise Quality Engineering approach.
  • Assess existing Quality Engineering tools, test suites, environments, and processes to identify modernization, consolidation, and automation opportunities.
  • Build a roadmap for migrating current testing practices into the future-state automation framework, balancing near-term delivery needs with long-term scalability and maintainability.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture teams to ensure Quality Engineering strategies, automation frameworks, test environments, and quality controls support modernization initiatives, cloud readiness, platform resiliency, and long-term technical health.

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering Transformation

  • Develop responsible adoption standards, measurement practices, and team skills for applying AI across Quality Engineering.
  • Design and evolve agentic Quality Engineering workflows that improve consistency, accelerate feedback, and reduce repetitive work while maintaining appropriate engineering oversight.
  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted test generation, execution, maintenance, optimization, coverage analysis, and quality insight capabilities.
  • Establish and communicate an AI-first Quality Engineering vision aligned with the broader Software Engineering transformation strategy.

Delivery Integration and Shift-Left Quality

  • Partner with Product Management and Business Analysts to improve requirement quality, acceptance criteria, maturity, testability, and shared understanding of business risk before development begins.
  • Advance shift-left quality practices by involving Quality Engineering earlier in discovery, refinement, solution design, and delivery planning.
  • Work across Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, and DevOps to define risk-based quality strategies that connect business expectations, technical design, test coverage, operational readiness, and release decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering and DevOps teams to embed reliable automated test execution, quality gates, environment readiness checks, and actionable reporting into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Ensure appropriate test coverage across functional, regression, performance, load, accessibility, API, and integration testing.
  • Drive adoption of automation-first quality practices that reduce reliance on repetitive manual regression testing while preserving the value of exploratory, risk-based, and customer-focused testing.

Engineering Productivity and Business Outcomes

  • Connect Quality Engineering priorities and reporting to customer experience, franchise experience, agent productivity, release confidence, and platform stability and reliability.
  • Partner with engineering leaders to identify quality improvements that increase development throughput and support faster, more confident release cycles.
  • Reduce developer feedback cycles by improving quality visibility earlier in the software development lifecycle and making results timely, reliable, and actionable.

Quality Metrics and Continuous Improvement

  • Establish quality metrics and framework health reporting to track automation coverage, test effectiveness, execution reliability, defect trends, and release readiness.
  • Develop quality insights that help teams evaluate requirement readiness, acceptance criteria for maturity, automation effectiveness, release confidence, platform resiliency, and recurring indicators of technical health.
  • Evaluate emerging Quality Engineering and AI technologies to improve test creation, execution, maintenance, coverage analysis, developer experience, and quality reporting.
  • Manage resource allocation, planning, and delivery of automation framework initiatives, test modernization, and Quality Engineering improvements.
  • Advocate for modern, AI-first Quality Engineering practices across every stage of the software development lifecycle, and help engineering teams build the skills and operating practices needed to adopt them responsibly.
  • Use quality, productivity, and technical-health insights to identify improvement opportunities, communicate progress, and guide investment decisions across Product and Software Engineering.
  • Define transformation-oriented measures, including manual testing effort, automation adoption, AI testing adoption, engineering throughput, defect escape trends, release cycle speed, and deployment confidence.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science, engineering, related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 7+ years of experience in Quality Engineering, software testing, or test automation, including 2+ years in a leadership or management role.
  • Deep hands-on experience designing, implementing, maintaining, and scaling test automation frameworks, including framework architecture, reusable components, coding standards, governance practices, and the practical application of AI-assisted Quality Engineering capabilities.
  • Proficiency in Java, Python, JavaScript, or a similar programming language, with the ability to guide automation of code quality, maintainability, and reusable framework design.
  • Experience integrating automated tests, quality gates, framework health checks, and reporting into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated ability to modernize legacy Quality Engineering tools, consolidate fragmented testing approaches, and guide teams toward a future-state automation framework.
  • Demonstrated experience advancing shift-left quality practices through early collaboration on requirements, acceptance criteria, solution design, testability, and delivery risk.
  • Strong understanding of Agile/Scrum delivery, the software testing lifecycle, and how Quality Engineering practices support product delivery and release readiness.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to influence technical direction, explain framework and quality tradeoffs, and align Product Management, Business Analysis, Engineering, Architecture, DevOps, and Quality Engineering stakeholders around modernization priorities, business risk, and quality outcomes.
  • Experience evaluating or implementing AI-assisted software engineering or Quality Engineering capabilities, including test generation, test maintenance, coverage analysis, release readiness, or agentic workflows preferred.
  • Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP and containerization technologies such as Docker or Kubernetes a plus.
  • Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter, Gatling, or Locust; security testing practices; test management platforms such as TestRail or Zephyr; API mocking; service-level API testing; SQL queries; and database testing across SQL and NoSQL databases preferred.
  • Travel industry experience ideal.

Brief Overview

The Senior Manager, QA Engineering is a Quality Engineering leader responsible for developing people, advancing engineering quality practices, and driving scalable quality capabilities across the organization. This leader owns the strategy, roadmap, and outcomes of the QA Tools practice, including automation frameworks, CI/CD quality enablement, and quality insights, while leading and developing Quality Engineers supporting product teams.

Through strong technical leadership, data-driven decision making, and cross-functional partnership, this role helps build shared ownership of quality and enables teams to deliver reliable, high-quality experiences for our customers.

You are a strategic, proactive leader who creates clarity from ambiguity and takes ownership of outcomes. You understand technology deeply enough to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions, and guide experienced engineers without needing to be the person writing the code.

You build strong relationships and know how to garner buy-in without requiring consensus. You communicate the “why,” listen to different perspectives, make thoughtful trade-offs, and move teams toward clear decisions.

You are pragmatic and adaptable. You favor simple, scalable, and standardized solutions over unnecessary complexity while recognizing where innovation, including AI, can meaningfully improve how teams work.

Core Responsibilities

job.title: SDET Intern
job.description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

QUALITY ASSURANCE

What We Do

The Quality Assurance team owns the testing process, risk management, and quality evaluation of all products and functions across Epic. Our team works closely with developers and production to ensure the best possible user experience for our community and customers.

SDET INTERN

What You'll Do

Epic Games Art Ops team is looking for a smart, creative Software Development Engineer in Test Intern. Art Ops is the team that builds the tools, pipelines, and Al workflows our artists use for game development and emerging tech every day. This role focuses on testing those internal tools and frameworks; you'll embed with our team of engineers and technical artists to help design and build everything from Cl pipelines, test plans, and integration tests for our web apps to checks that tell us how well our Al tools are performing.

In this role, you will

  • Write test plans for new tools and features, then turn them into automated tests
  • Help design and build the test framework our team will use going forward, with our engineers reviewing your code
  • Write unit, integration, and end-to-end tests for our web apps and pipeline tools
  • Test how Al tools and workflows perform when new models are released, and help build ways to measure their performance
  • Support weekly release testing and turn repeated manual checks into automated tests
  • Investigate test failures, determine why a test broke, and share results with the team
  • Use Al-assisted tools to help run, write, and triage tests, and review what they produce

What we're looking for

  • Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science or a related field
  • Comfortable writing code in at least one modern OOP language such as Python, C++, or C#, through coursework or personal projects
  • Basic understanding of software testing, such as unit and integration testing
  • Familiarity with a version control system
  • Interest in Al for content and code generation
  • Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to confidently collaborate with senior team members and take feedback on technical topics and features
  • Willingness to dive into new things and drive them forward
  • A personal project repository or demo portfolio is required
  • Some experience with test frameworks like Jest, Pytest, or Playwright, Cl systems like GitHub Actions, or Al evaluation tools like LangChain or DeepEval is desired
  • Exposure to art tools such as Unreal Engine, Maya, or Houdini, or interest in how artists work is highly desired

This internship has a flexible start date in 2027. Recruitment will be ongoing until teams find an ideal match. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the posting location for the duration of the internship. For more information about Epic’s Early Career Program, visit epicgames.com/earlycareers. This is going to be Epic!

ABOUT US

Epic Games​ ​is a leading interactive entertainment company. For over 30 years we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

job.description:
Description

﻿Who We Are - Motivated by Purpose. Powered by Clinical Expertise.

Founded in 1983, we’re a clinically-driven, tech-enabled utilization management company offering expert clinical reviews, regulatory guidance, and actionable insights to healthcare organizations.

Excellence starts with our people.

WE OFFER

  • A competitive compensation package
  • Benefits include healthcare, vision, and dental insurance
  • A generous 401(k) match
  • Paid vacation, PTO, and holidays
  • Growth and training opportunities
  • An award-winning remote work environment

﻿POSITION OVERVIEW

Quality Assurance Engineer is a corporate function within the Engineering organization responsible for the quality, reliability, and release-readiness of software products built on modern technologies, including cloud-native applications hosted on Microsoft Azure and AI/ML-enabled features.

Roles:

  • Primary role is testing software applications created or updated by the Application Development team.
  • Conduct structured peer and code reviews of test artifacts to ensure adherence to standards and best practices.
  • Design, create, and maintain realistic and compliant test data sets, including synthetic data for healthcare (PHI-safe) scenarios.
  • Design and execute validation strategies for AI/ML and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) features, including model quality, grounding, and safety evaluation.

Major Responsibilities or Assigned Duties:

  • Participate in the test management lifecycle, including test planning, execution tracking, defect management and reporting.
  • Provide input on release readiness criteria to Engineering and Product stakeholders.
  • Maintain the regression suite after every release.
  • Develop and maintain automated test suites in Python (e.g., pytest) and JavaScript/Node.js, integrated into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Write and review complex SQL queries, joins, and aggregations to validate data accuracy, completeness, and reconciliation across systems.
  • Validate data flows across source systems, transformation layers, and reporting/consumption layers.
  • Ensure test data supports both functional automation and AI/ML / RAG evaluation needs.
  • Design and execute test strategies for AI/ML and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines and AI-assisted features, including retrieval accuracy, grounding, hallucination, output quality, bias/safety, and drift (regression) checks.
  • Build and maintain automated evaluation harnesses and datasets for AI/ML features, including prompt/response scoring and metric tracking.
  • Validate applications, APIs, and test environments deployed on on-prem data center, Microsoft Azure, including Azure-hosted services, data stores, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Read and interpret React / Node.js / Python / ColdFusion source code, pull requests, and technical designs to identify testable conditions, edge cases, and regression risk.
  • Write detailed test cases and test plans that trace directly to code paths, business rules, and acceptance criteria.
  • Partner with developers during code review to flag insufficient test coverage, untested branches, and high-risk changes before merge.
  • Perform post-deployment validation to confirm application, API, and AI feature stability in production.
  • •Investigate production defects and data issues, perform root cause analysis, and drive resolution with Engineering.

Requirements

Skills and Experience:

  • 5+ years of experience in automated software testing
  • 5+ years of experience in manual software testing
  • 5+ years of experience in component-level testing
  • 5+ years of experience in end-to-end testing
  • At least 5 years of experience in SQL
  • At least 3 years of experience in React
  • At least 3 years of experience in Node.js
  • At least 3 years of experience with Python source code in GitLab
  • At least 2 years of experience testing AI/ML
  • At least 2 years of experience evaluating AI/ML
  • At least 2 years of experience testing Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)
  • At least 2 years of experience testing generative AI features
  • At least 2 years of experience testing workloads on Microsoft Azure

﻿Education:

  • High School Diploma required
  • Bachelor’s degree (Advantage)

Work Environment:

Ability to sit at a desk, utilize a computer, telephone, and other basic office equipment is required. This role is designed to be a remote position (work-from-home).

Diversity Statement:

Diversity creates a healthier atmosphere: All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, protected veteran status, disability status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, marital status, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law.

﻿

Drug-Free Workplace:

This company is a drug-free workplace. All candidates are required to pass a Background Screen before beginning employment. All newly hired employees will take a Drug Screen, as well as agreeing to all necessary Compliance Regulations on their first day of employment. Employees are required to adhere to all applicable HIPAA regulations and company policies and procedures regarding the confidentiality, privacy, and security of sensitive health information.

California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Information (California Residents Only):

  • Sensitive Personal Info: MRIoA may collect sensitive personal info such as real name, nickname or alias, postal address, telephone number, email address, Social Security number, signature, online identifier, Internet Protocol address, driver’s license number, or state identification card number, and passport number.

job.title: Senior QA Engineer - AI
job.description:
About the Company

At Delta, we are reimagining and rebuilding the financial system. Join our team to make a positive impact on the future of finance.

🎯 Mission Driven: Re-imagine and rebuild the future of finance.

💡 Most innovative cryptocurrency derivatives exchange. With a daily traded volume of ~$ 10 billion, and increasing. Delta is bigger than all the Indian crypto exchanges combined.

📈 Offer the widest range of derivative products and have been serving traders all over the globe since 2018 and growing fast.

💪🏻 The founding team is comprised of IIT and ISB graduates. Business co-founders have previously worked with Citibank, UBS and GIC; and our tech co-founder is a serial entrepreneur who previously co-founded TinyOwl andHousing.com.

💰 Funded by top crypto funds (Sino Global Capital, CoinFund, Gumi Cryptos) and crypto projects (Aave and Kyber Network).

Senior QA Engineer - AI

🎯 Role Overview

Delta operates three AI products used by live traders: a customer support chatbot, an API Copilot that generates and executes trading scripts, and an MCP server. This role owns the quality of those products and is responsible for measuring it objectively.

Testing probabilistic systems differs fundamentally from testing deterministic ones. The same input produces different output on every run, an incorrect answer can be entirely fluent, and a prompt change in one flow can degrade another without any visible signal. The core of this role is establishing what correct means for these systems, building the datasets and scoring that measure it, and operating the release gate that prevents a regression from reaching customers.

This is an emerging discipline with no established playbook. We are defining the methodology as we build it, and the role carries a high degree of autonomy and ownership.

🔬 What Sets This Role Apart

Most QA roles that mention AI mean using AI to do testing faster: generating test cases from a PRD, healing flaky selectors, exploring an app with an agent. Those are useful and we do them.

This role is the other thing. The system under test is itself an AI, and the hard problem is deciding whether its output is correct when the same question produces a different answer every time and a wrong answer reads as convincingly as a right one. That means building evaluation datasets, defining what correct looks like, scoring against it, and defending a number that decides whether a release ships.

If you have spent time on the second problem, this role is built for you.

🛠 Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain golden datasets for our AI products, trace mined from production or generated, and verified against a documented source of truth.
  • Design layered scoring for AI outputs: deterministic rules where behaviour can be asserted, and model-graded evaluation where it cannot.
  • Manage evaluation runs end to end: schedule and execute them against release candidates, compare results against prior baselines, and triage failures into product defects, incorrect expectations, and platform issues.
  • Own and operate the release gate that determines whether a prompt or model change is approved for production.
  • Identify failure modes ahead of customers, including hallucination, incorrect tool selection, loss of context across conversation turns, and PII exposure.
  • Investigate production traces to distinguish retrieval failures from generation failures from tool failures.
  • Convert findings into actionable engineering evidence and into permanent regression coverage.
  • Define and report quality metrics for AI surfaces, and drive improvement against them.

✅ Requirements

Non-negotiable

  • At least 1 year owning quality for AI products in a lead or primary-owner capacity. This includes chatbots and conversational assistants, code or content generation products, and agentic systems. You should have worked directly with prompts, tool and function schemas, and model behaviour, rather than testing around them.
  • Demonstrated hands-on experience building or operating an evaluation harness for an AI system, whether in-house or using a framework such as DeepEval, RAGAS or Promptfoo. You should be able to describe what the harness measured, the results it produced, and the decisions those results informed.

Also required

  • 4-6 years of QA / SDET experience.
  • Working proficiency in Python. Our evaluation platform, trace analysis and internal tooling are Python-based.
  • Ability to analyse traces and tool calls, using observability tooling such as Opik, Langfuse or LangSmith or an equivalent, to determine root cause rather than reporting the symptom.
  • Strong API testing experience. The majority of the surface under test is API-level.
  • Sufficient engineering ability to build your own tooling and automation.
  • Clear written communication. Findings must be documented in a form engineering can act on directly.

Bonus

  • Experience with trading or exchange platforms, including familiarity with futures and options, crypto derivatives, margin, or settlement flows. Domain knowledge can be picked up on the job, but arriving with it shortens the ramp considerably.

🚀 Why Join Us?

  • Play a pivotal role in shaping the regulatory landscape for digital assets and Web3 in India.
  • Work directly with founders and senior leadership on high-impact strategic initiatives.
  • Be part of a mission-driven, fast-growing organisation at the forefront of financial innovation.
  • Competitive compensation, leadership exposure, and significant growth opportunities.

You will be expected to independently run QA for your area—from understanding requirements and designing test approaches, to executing tests, coordinating with global engineering teams, and providing clear, timely updates to management.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end QA for one or more modules/projects, from understanding requirements and defining test strategy through to final sign-off on release readiness.

job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (m/w/d) - remote DE
job.description:
kurzbeschreibung

Als Quality Assurance Engineer (m/w/d) bist Du ein zentraler Bestandteil unseres SAP-Entwicklungsteams und stellst sicher, dass unsere Softwarelösungen entlang des gesamten Entwicklungszyklus höchsten Qualitätsstandards entsprechen. Dabei liegt Dein Fokus auf technischer Qualitätssicherung und Testautomatisierung. Du gestaltest Qualität aktiv mit, identifizierst Risiken frühzeitig und entwickelst unsere QA-Strategie und Qualitätsprozesse kontinuierlich weiter.

deine aufgaben

Du entwickelst und verantwortest ganzheitliche Teststrategien - von automatisierten Tests über exploratives Testen bis hin zu UI-, API- und Integrationstests. Dabei stellst Du sicher, dass Qualität von Anfang an mitgedacht wird, indem Du nach dem Shift-Left-Prinzip arbeitest und dieses durch gezielte Shift-Right-Ansätze wie Monitoring und Observability ergänzt.

Ein wesentlicher Schwerpunkt Deiner Rolle ist die Testautomatisierung. Du entwickelst, erweiterst und wartest automatisierte Tests und Testautomatisierungs-Frameworks und setzt dabei gängige Automatisierungsframeworks für UI- und API-Tests ein.

Du bewegst Dich sicher in technischen Testumgebungen und führst Tests nicht ausschließlich über die Benutzeroberfläche durch. Dazu gehören beispielsweise der Umgang mit Konsole und Developer Tools, das Erstellen und Manipulieren von technischen Testdaten und Stammdaten sowie die technische Eingrenzung und Analyse von Fehlern. Auch API- und Schnittstellentests gehören zu Deinem Aufgabenbereich.

Im Austausch mit Anforderungsstellern und der Entwicklung begleitest Du den gesamten agilen Entwicklungsprozess - von Refinements bis hin zu Abnahmetests. Dabei bringst Du deine QA-Perspektive frühzeitig ein, hinterfragst Anforderungen hinsichtlich Testbarkeit und Vollständigkeit und identifizierst selbstständig Risiken und Edge Cases.

Darüber hinaus bist Du verantwortlich für den Aufbau und die Pflege von Testrepositories und Testdaten und führst regelmäßig Regressionstests durch. Du treibst die Weiterentwicklung unserer QA-Prozesse aktiv voran und stellst sicher, dass technische Qualitätsanforderungen nachhaltig berücksichtigt werden.

Du bringst Dich auch über klassische funktionale Tests hinaus in moderne QA-Themen ein. Dazu gehören ein grundlegendes Verständnis für Performance- und Security-Tests sowie moderne Security-Ansätze wie Threat Modelling.

Als Qualitätsbotschafter innerhalb des Teams teilst Du Best Practices und förderst aktiv eine nachhaltige Qualitätskultur. KI-gestützte Ansätze wie automatisierte Testfallgenerierung oder Self-Healing-Tests behältst Du dabei als mögliche Weiterentwicklung unserer QA-Landschaft im Blick.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und mindestens Englisch Kenntnisse auf B2 Niveau runden dein Profil ab und machen dich zur idealen Verstärkung für unser Team.

dein profil

Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Quality Assurance Engineer (m/w/d) oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle und bringst fundierte Kenntnisse in modernen Testmethoden und Softwareentwicklungsprozessen mit. Eine ISTQB-Zertifizierung (mindestens Foundation Level) ist für diese Position erforderlich, weiterführende Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus.

Praktische Erfahrung mit Testautomatisierung ist eine zentrale Voraussetzung für diese Position. Du hast Erfahrung mit gängigen Automatisierungsframeworks und kannst automatisierte Tests für UI und APIs eigenständig erstellen, weiterentwickeln und warten.

Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis und kannst Dich selbstständig in technischen Umgebungen bewegen. Der Umgang mit Konsole und Developer Tools, das Erstellen und Manipulieren technischer Test- und Stammdaten sowie die technische Fehleranalyse und -eingrenzung sind für Dich selbstverständlich. Auch mit API- und Schnittstellentests bist Du vertraut.

Du verstehst QA nicht als reine Testausführung, sondern als aktive Mitgestaltung von Qualität. Du hinterfragst Anforderungen, erkennst selbstständig Risiken und Edge Cases und bringst Dich bereits in Refinements ein, um Testbarkeit, Vollständigkeit und Qualitätsrisiken frühzeitig zu berücksichtigen.

Du bist mit agilen Arbeitsweisen wie Scrum oder Kanban vertraut und hast ein gutes Verständnis für Softwareentwicklungsprozesse. Deine Arbeitsweise ist analytisch, strukturiert und eigenständig und Du kommunizierst sicher mit unterschiedlichen Anforderungsstellern und der Entwicklung.

Idealerweise bringst Du zusätzlich grundlegende SAP-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Performance- oder Security-Tests sowie mit Monitoring- und Observability-Ansätzen mit. Ein grundlegendes Verständnis moderner Security-Ansätze, beispielsweise Threat Modelling, ist ein Plus.

Du interessierst Dich für die Weiterentwicklung moderner QA-Methoden und hast ein Interesse daran, KI-gestützte Testansätze perspektivisch weiterzuentwickeln.

job.title: Salesforce Automated Test Engineer
job.description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Automated Test Engineer to design, implement, and maintain a scalable automated testing capability for Salesforce environments. This role is ideal for a hands-on QA Automation professional who has previously built an automation framework from the ground up, including selecting and configuring testing platforms, establishing standards, creating reusable components, and integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

You will work closely with Salesforce Developers, Administrators, Business Analysts, Product Owners, and DevOps teams to transition from predominantly manual testing to a mature, reliable, and highly automated testing environment.

About the Client

You will be working with a technology-driven organisation that relies on Salesforce and enterprise applications to support critical business operations. The organisation is focused on strengthening software quality, release confidence, and delivery efficiency through modern testing and automation practices.

The team values technical excellence, collaboration, continuous improvement, and robust quality assurance practices, providing an opportunity to establish and shape a scalable Salesforce test automation capability.

Ideal Profile

Salesforce & Test Automation

  • Strong commercial experience as an Automation Test Engineer, QA Automation Engineer, or Salesforce Test Engineer.
  • Significant hands-on experience testing Salesforce applications.
  • Demonstrated experience building an automated testing framework or environment from scratch.
  • Strong understanding of Salesforce configuration and application architecture.
  • Experience developing automated functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test suites.
  • Experience testing complex Salesforce workflows, configurations, and integrations.

Automation Platforms

  • Strong hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca, TestRail, or comparable enterprise testing platforms.
  • Experience implementing and configuring testing platforms rather than simply operating an existing framework.
  • Experience creating reusable test automation components, libraries, and test suites.
  • Practical experience with automation technologies such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Provar is highly desirable.

Salesforce Testing

  • Experience testing Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Salesforce Flows, Lightning Web Components, and Apex.
  • Experience testing validation rules, approval processes, reports, dashboards, profiles, roles, permission sets, custom objects, and Salesforce applications.
  • Experience validating Salesforce APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Strong understanding of testing across different user profiles, permissions, and business workflows.

API, CI/CD & DevOps

  • Experience with REST and SOAP API testing and external system integrations.
  • Familiarity with Postman, REST clients, or automated API testing frameworks.
  • Understanding of CI/CD concepts and automated testing pipelines.
  • Experience with tools such as GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps, Jenkins, Bitbucket, Gearset, Copado, or Salesforce DevOps Center is advantageous.
  • Strong understanding of Agile development and QA methodologies.

Personal Attributes

  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause analysis skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to software quality.
  • Ability to work collaboratively with technical and business stakeholders.
  • Proactive approach to identifying test coverage gaps and improving QA practices.

Responsibilities

Automated Testing Framework Development

  • Design and implement a Salesforce automated testing framework from the ground up.
  • Establish automation architecture, standards, naming conventions, reusable components, and governance practices.
  • Configure and implement platforms such as Tricentis Tosca, TestRail with integrated automation, or equivalent enterprise testing tools.
  • Develop automated functional, regression, integration, and end-to-end test suites.
  • Build reusable automation components that can support multiple Salesforce applications and releases.
  • Identify opportunities to replace repetitive manual testing with reliable automation.
  • Establish effective processes for test data, environments, dependencies, and automation maintenance.

Salesforce Testing

  • Develop and execute automated tests across Salesforce functionality including Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Flows, Lightning Web Components, Apex, validation rules, approval processes, reports, dashboards, and custom applications.
  • Validate Salesforce APIs, integrations, third-party applications, and connected business systems.
  • Develop automated regression suites to ensure configuration and release changes do not negatively impact existing functionality.
  • Validate functionality across different user profiles, permission models, and business workflows.

Test Platform Implementation

  • Take ownership of establishing the organisation's automated testing environment.
  • Configure automation platforms, repositories, test-suite structures, access controls, and reusable test libraries.
  • Establish test-data management processes and automation workflows.
  • Integrate automated testing into development and deployment processes.
  • Implement reporting and dashboards to provide visibility into test outcomes and quality metrics.
  • Document the automation framework and train team members on the testing platform and processes.

TestRail & Tricentis

  • Establish TestRail projects, repositories, test-case structures, and regression suites where applicable.
  • Integrate automated test execution results with TestRail.
  • Develop and maintain Tosca modules, test cases, execution lists, and distributed execution where applicable.
  • Support test-data management, regression testing, API testing, reporting, and CI/CD integration.

API & Integration Testing

  • Develop automated tests for Salesforce APIs and external integrations.
  • Validate REST and SOAP API functionality and data integrity.
  • Automate integration scenarios, exception handling, and error processes.

CI/CD & Quality Assurance

Defect Management & Continuous Improvement

We will help you unlock the best version of yourself, achieve growth in your career whilst making a real difference to people and communities. 

Why you'll love this role as Data Tester at Civica

As a Data Tester at Civica, you’ll play a pivotal role in ensuring the success of multiple data migration projects by safeguarding the accuracy and integrity of financial data. You’ll design and execute test cases, validate reconciliations, and apply SQL expertise to verify data across legacy and target systems. Working hand‑in‑hand with Data Engineers, Analysts, and UK stakeholders, you’ll be at the heart of complex migrations — identifying and resolving defects, supporting root cause analysis, and ensuring readiness for go‑live. This is your chance to make a tangible impact on mission‑critical systems, grow your expertise in ETL and financial data validation, and thrive in a collaborative, structured environment where your work directly contributes to smoother transitions and trusted outcomes.

Requirements

  • Cutover support: Participate in go‑live activities and post‑migration checks.

Apply if you have

  • ERP familiarity: Prior exposure to SAP, Oracle Financials, Workday Financials, or similar systems.

  • Attention to detail: Methodical approach with strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Communication skills: Clear written and verbal communication for defect reporting and stakeholder updates.
  • Collaboration: Comfortable working with UK‑based stakeholders across time zones.
  • Resilience: Ability to manage competing priorities during test cycles and cutover periods.
  • Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Computer Science, or related field; 1–4 years of experience in data testing/QA; offshore/onshore delivery model exposure preferred.

Benefits

job.title: Performance Engineer, Kernel and Memory
job.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations

  • Austin, US
  • New York, NY
  • Washington DC
  • European Cloudflare Hubs

About the Role

At Cloudflare, we have our eyes set on an ambitious goal: to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers approximately 25 million Internet properties, for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company. 

We realize people do not fit into neat boxes. We are looking for curious and empathetic individuals who are committed to developing themselves and learning new skills, and we are ready to help you do that. We cannot complete our mission without building a diverse and inclusive team. We hire the best people based on an evaluation of their potential and support them throughout their time at Cloudflare. Come join us! 

About the Department

Cloudflare’s engineering teams build and maintain the systems and products that power our global platform. A global platform which is within approximately 50 milliseconds of about 95% of the Internet connected population, serving on average, over 46 million HTTP requests per second.

About the Team

Delivering this platform with high performance and efficiency depends on advanced Linux kernel and hardware capabilities, and that is where this team works.

The Performance Team owns overall system and application performance across that fleet: resource optimization, instrumentation, and the tooling that lets us see what the hardware is actually doing. System memory sits alongside CPU cycles, network processing, and storage IOPS as a first-class resource, and how the kernel manages it is increasingly the thing that decides how hot we can safely run every machine we own.

We work upstream first. Several of us maintain or regularly contribute to the Linux kernel, and our default is to fix problems in mainline rather than carry private patches. This role is built on that principle.

The problem you would own

Using memory efficiently is one of the highest-leverage problems we have. At our scale, how the kernel's memory-management subsystem behaves under pressure has direct consequences for both performance and cost. As DRAM prices climb, getting more out of the memory we already own is a real lever on infrastructure spend.

Using custom low-overhead instrumentation on production servers, we have identified several scalability bottlenecks in the kernel memory layer that show up under real workloads. We are looking for an expert to take on these problems, fix them against production workloads, and drive the changes upstream. Solving them lifts efficiency and latency across the entire fleet rather than in one place.

What you will do

  • Diagnose and fix performance and scalability bottlenecks in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem, informed by real production telemetry at a scale few environments can offer.
  • Land your work upstream. We expect MM changes to go to mainline first and want you to keep doing the maintainership and review work that earns standing in the community.
  • Build and extend low-overhead kernel instrumentation (tracepoints, BPF, perf) so we keep measuring before we change, and prove the impact afterwards.
  • Partner with kernel, networking, storage, and product engineers across the company to turn observed system behavior into concrete MM improvements.
  • Set technical direction for how Cloudflare uses, tunes, and evolves kernel memory management as we push utilization higher.

Requirements

  • Deep expertise in the Linux kernel memory-management subsystem: the page allocator, virtual memory and memory mapping, reclaim, and the locking and concurrency that hold it together.
  • A track record of upstream Linux contribution, ideally including maintainership or sustained work in MM or an adjacent subsystem.
  • Strong systems programming in C, with the judgement to make high-risk changes to shared infrastructure safely.
  • Ability to dive deep into a complex codebase while keeping the fleet-wide picture in mind, and to own a problem and its outcome rather than a single patch.
  • Clear communication with engineers across many teams, since the symptoms of an MM problem usually show up far from the MM code.

Bonuses

  • Strong understanding of Linux kernel internals pertaining to memory management
  • Experience troubleshooting and resolving performance issues in large-scale distributed systems.
  • Experience with large scale configuration/deployment management.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

This position may require access to information protected under U.S. export control laws, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations. Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

Cloudflare is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.  We are committed to providing equal employment opportunity for all people and place great value in both diversity and inclusiveness.  All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to their, or any other person's, perceived or actual race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, family care status, or any other basis protected by law. We are an AA/Veterans/Disabled Employer.

Cloudflare provides reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities.  Please tell us if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job. Examples of reasonable accommodations include, but are not limited to, changing the application process, providing documents in an alternate format, using a sign language interpreter, or using specialized equipment.  If you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job, please contact us via e-mail at hr@cloudflare.com or via mail at 101 Townsend St. San Francisco, CA 94107.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Developer, Integrations
job.description:
About Us

Founded in Montreal in 2018, nesto is a Canadian fintech company on a mission to make property financing positive, empowering, and transparent from start to finish. We began as a digital mortgage broker and became Canada's leading direct-to-consumer online lending platform. Why Join Us

The mortgage industry runs on legacy systems, slow processes, and information nobody can see. We are changing that by building better technology. nesto is a place for builders, problem-solvers, and curious minds – people who move fast, embrace innovation, and believe we're stronger together. This is the place for you if you trust your skills and want to build technology that reshapes an entire industry. An entrepreneurial culture built on trust, speed, uncomfortable ambition, being stronger together, and a relentless obsession with our clients. We also do not think building with AI belongs to engineers. Every function here is expected to automate its own repetitive work, and you will have support to do it.

Work Location and Time Zone

This is a remote-first role open to candidates anywhere in Canada. We strongly prefer candidates who can work Eastern Time hours. If you are based elsewhere in Canada and have worked Eastern hours before, we still want to hear from you.

Why This Role Exists

We're delivering major platform programs for our large enterprise partners. This role is focused on building automation coverage for these initiatives, shaping end-to-end quality as the programs scale.

We already have a strong automation suite and deep in-house expertise at the staff level. This is not a rebuild from zero. It's about taking what works, adapting it to a platform being reshaped for these programs, and wiring it into CI/CD so quality keeps pace with delivery speed. We move fast and iterate, but we don't ship manual workarounds – we invest in repeatable, scalable structure.

You'd be the automation specialist within our delivery team, working closely with our staff automation developers as expert sounding boards, setting the approach and advising us on how this should be done. You can expect roughly a 80/20 split between hands-on coding and collaboration, depending on the project stage.

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 90 days, a working test automation framework is running, with 60–80% of critical test scenarios automated, running, and actively relied on by the team.
  • Within six months, automation runs in the CI/CD pipeline on pull requests, mirroring what exists for our core platform.
  • You've adapted and extended the existing automation framework rather than rebuilding from scratch – leveraging the suite and expertise already in place.
  • You make sure quality is understood beyond sprint-by-sprint testing, with a focus on ensuring all the pieces work together end to end.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable automated test suites in Playwright, using design patterns that keep them maintainable over time.
  • Partner with architects, developers, product managers, and our Staff QA Automation Developers across the SDLC – to clarify requirements and define clear acceptance criteria early, and to raise QA practices across the organization.
  • Drive quality across UI and API testing, using monitoring signals, incident reviews, and customer feedback to find improvements.
  • Work with Delivery leadership, stakeholders, and partners to prioritize automation coverage.
  • Integrate automated testing into the CI/CD pipeline so coverage runs continuously.
  • Work with product managers to define comprehensive test plans from product and design specifications (URDs, PRDs, HLDs).
  • Play a key role in supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for key projects, for example when we integrate new partners or clients.
  • Leverage AI to speed up how you build and maintain automated tests, then share what works with the team.
  • Own quality beyond test execution – improve processes, documentation, and team workflows, and standardize what works into repeatable practices.
  • Review and run manual test cases in our test management tooling, validate features against test plans, and fold the right scenarios into the automated regression suite.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of QA experience testing SaaS or cloud applications, with a deep understanding of the full SDLC and how Quality Engineering fits into development.
  • 2+ years of hands-on test automation framework experience with Playwright, Cypress, or similar, including authoring and maintaining end-to-end (E2E) test suites.
  • A strong background in TypeScript and/or Go is required, and experience with MySQL or similar relational databases is a plus.
  • An automation-first track record: automated coverage over manual-only QA, with reliability built into the CI/CD pipeline rather than bolted on.
  • Full-stack testing across UI and API layers, including API validation with tools like Postman.
  • Test architecture and scalable design expertise, using patterns such as Page Object Model, data factories, and separation of concerns.
  • Agile fluency, comfort with rapid release cycles, and familiarity with test management platforms like Allure TestOps.
  • Initiative and a point of view. You arrive with a plan rather than waiting to be told what to do.

Nice-to-Have

  • Hands-on AI initiative: you have built agents or applications that made testing meaningfully faster
  • You turn requirements into genuinely useful test coverage, not checkbox test cases
  • Experience with MySQL or similar relational databases
  • Familiarity with test management platforms like Allure TestOps
  • Experience in SaaS, fintech, banking, insurance, or other financial services environments

This Role Might Fit You If

  • You have stood up automation from nothing on a program already in flight, and found that energizing rather than daunting
  • You would rather adapt and evolve a working system than rebuild it to your own taste
  • You are comfortable telling leadership "here is what we should do and here is how" early on, not a year in
  • You enjoy being in the room with business and delivery people, not only engineers, and can explain why a test gap matters in business terms
  • You want to shape quality strategy, not only write test code

What This Role Is Not

  • This is not a heads-down coding role. If you want to stay out of product and business conversations, this will frustrate you.
  • This is not a role focused mainly on executing manual test cases.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers a reactive, waterfall approach and waits for development to finish before getting involved.
  • This is not a role for someone who prefers to work in isolation and doesn't want to improve broader team workflows, documentation, or quality processes.
  • This is not a role for someone who isn't ready to bring AI tools into their daily work.


Interview Process

  • Recruiter Screen (30 min): An intro call to learn about your background and give you a real picture of the role.
  • Discovery Call (45 min): A conversation with the hiring manager to dig into your experience and assess mutual fit.
  • Take-Home Assignment: A chance to showcase your skills through a practical exercise relevant to the role.
  • Case Study Interview (60 min): A deep dive into your submission, with time to get to know some team members and ask about the role and company.
  • Final Interview (60 min): You'll meet with the recruiter and two additional stakeholders for a final conversation before a decision is made.
  • Offer Stage: Pending successful background, criminal, and reference checks, you'll receive a formal offer to join the team.


What We Offer

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Top-tier extended health, dental, and vision coverage, featuring 100% drug coverage.
  • Health & Wellness Spending Account: A $1,500 combined annual flex fund for things like gym memberships or extra medical needs.
  • Generous Paid Time Off: 4 weeks of vacation plus 8 personal floater days.
  • Retirement Savings: Access to a group RRSP/DPSP plan featuring competitive company-matching contributions.
  • Telemedicine Services: Access via Dialogue and coverage for licensed practitioner services.
  • Family Support: Robust Maternity and Parental Leave Top-Up programs.

Diversity and Inclusion
At nesto, we believe that creativity and collaboration are the result of a diverse team. We are committed to fostering a culture of diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging, and we strongly encourage women, people of color, LGBTQIA+ individuals, and individuals with disabilities to apply. We are committed to creating a workplace that is inclusive and welcoming to all.

job.title: SDET / Engineer in Test
job.description:
We’re modernizing our enterprise integration landscape and are looking for a hands-on SDET / Engineer in Test to build a robust automated regression testing framework for an Event-Driven Architecture (EDA) environment.

This is not a UI testing role. You will write code to validate asynchronous message flows and integration logic, ensuring regressions are caught automatically on every deployment.

Contract

Contractor / Project-based (extension potential)

Core Tech Stack

Solace PubSub+ (or equivalent broker), Boomi (or MuleSoft/Tibco), Python (preferred) or Node.js, Docker, CI/CD (Jenkins/Azure DevOps), Git

What you will build / own

  • A headless test harness that can act as both Publisher and Subscriber to validate message flows.

  • Automated regression strategies for asynchronous patterns:

    • fire-and-forget

    • request-reply

    • event chaining

  • Test data generation to create complex payloads programmatically and cover edge cases.

  • CI/CD integration so tests run automatically (containerized via Docker) on every deployment.

Key responsibilities

  • Build an automation framework (Python or Node.js) to publish/subscribe and validate end-to-end flows through a message broker.

  • Validate EDA regressions (e.g., messages sent to Topic A produce expected outcomes on Topic B), including:

    • correlation IDs, timeouts, retries, ordering, idempotency

  • Generate JSON test payloads from schemas to cover boundary values, invalid cases, and load scenarios.

  • Containerize tests with Docker and integrate into Jenkins / Azure DevOps pipelines.

  • Troubleshoot failures across distributed systems using logs (e.g., Boomi process logs + broker events) to isolate root causes.

Must-have requirements

  • Strong coding skills in Python (preferred) or Node.js for backend test automation (not Selenium-only).

  • Experience testing APIs and integration flows (integration/system/contract testing).

  • Solid understanding of EDA / PubSub concepts (topics/queues, acknowledgments, retries, correlation IDs, etc.).

  • Experience with Docker, Git, and CI/CD (Jenkins or Azure DevOps).

  • Strong troubleshooting skills in distributed environments (log-driven debugging, root-cause analysis).

Nice to have

  • Hands-on with Solace PubSub+ (or Kafka/RabbitMQ/ActiveMQ).

  • Familiarity with Boomi (or MuleSoft/Tibco).

  • Experience building testing tooling for asynchronous/event-driven systems.

  • Comfortable using AI coding assistants (Copilot, etc.) for accelerating boilerplate/test-data generation.
