job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
About Huzzle

At Huzzle, we connect exceptional talent with top opportunities at leading companies across the UK, US, Canada, Europe, and Australia. Our clients include fast-growing startups, SaaS platforms, and digital-first businesses. Unlike traditional outsourcing models, you are placed directly with a client as an in-house team member, contributing to impactful, real-world products.

Role Type: Full-time

Engagement: Independent Contractor

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing performance marketing agency that helps direct-to-consumer (DTC) brands scale profitably through Paid Media, Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO), creative strategy, and conversion-focused publisher networks. Acting as an extension of their clients’ in-house growth teams, they specialize in rapid testing, high-converting funnels, and data-driven experimentation to drive measurable revenue growth.

Job Summary

We're looking for a detail-oriented QA Engineer to join one of our growing client teams. This is an excellent opportunity for someone passionate about software quality, testing best practices, and delivering exceptional user experiences. You'll work closely with developers, product managers, and designers to ensure applications meet the highest standards before release.

Whether you specialize in manual testing, automated testing, or both, you'll play a key role in identifying issues, improving product reliability, and helping build software that customers love.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, execute, and maintain comprehensive test plans and test cases.
  • Perform manual functional, regression, integration, exploratory, and user acceptance testing.
  • Develop and maintain automated test scripts where applicable.
  • Identify, document, prioritize, and track software defects.
  • Work closely with software engineers to reproduce and resolve bugs.
  • Participate in sprint planning, backlog grooming, and release planning.
  • Validate new features, enhancements, and bug fixes before deployment.
  • Perform API testing and verify backend functionality.
  • Test web, mobile, and cloud-based applications across multiple browsers and devices.
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to improve overall software quality.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of QA processes, documentation, and testing standards.
  • Monitor application performance and usability during testing.
  • Support production releases and perform post-release validation.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of experience in Software Quality Assurance (QA) or Software Testing.
  • Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC), and Agile/Scrum methodologies.
  • Experience performing both manual and automated testing across web, mobile, or SaaS applications.
  • Proficiency with QA and testing tools such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, Postman, Swagger, JMeter, TestRail, Zephyr, Xray, Jira, Azure DevOps, Git, GitHub, GitLab, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, Docker, BrowserStack, and similar industry-standard platforms.
  • Familiarity with programming or scripting languages such as JavaScript, TypeScript, Java, Python, C#, or SQL.
  • Experience testing APIs, databases, cross-browser functionality, performance, and cloud-based applications using modern QA tools and frameworks.
  • Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional engineering and product teams.
  • Comfortable working independently in a fully remote, fast-paced environment.
  • Nice to have: experience testing SaaS or mobile applications (iOS/Android), accessibility (WCAG), security or penetration testing, AI-assisted testing tools, distributed remote teams, and an ISTQB certification.

Benefits

💰 Competitive salary based on experience and seniority

🚀 Work on impactful, user-facing products with a global reach

📈 Clear career progression in a high-growth tech environment

🌎 Fully remote role with an international team.

🎓 Access to ongoing learning and professional development.

🤝 Collaborative engineering culture with modern development practices.

  • Legacy & Innovation: We were created more than 260 years ago as the world’s first marine classification society to improve and set standards for the safety of ships.

Technology context: Our systems involve REST and real-time APIs, geospatial data, vessel communication protocols, event-driven architectures and cloud-based data streaming.   • Proven experience in a software testing role with hands-on test case design and execution

job.description:
Mashreq Bank

JOB DESCRIPTION

1

Job Title

Assistant Manager–QA & Proofing Unit

Department

Operations GRC

Direct Supervisor

AVP -Lead, QA & Proofing Unit

Job Number

2

Job Purpose

To support the QA & Proofing function by executing day-to-day quality assurance activities, validating reconciliation proofing submissions, tracking escalations, and identifying gaps in data or process adherence. The role ensures consistent implementation of the control framework across group operations and contributes to continuous process improvements, working closely with first-line ops and GRC.

3

Dimensions

Scope of work

  • Covers proofing and quality assurance for reconciliation and control breaks across all group operations verticals.

  • Scope includes review of monthly reconciliation proofing, aging validation, and QA sampling in UAE and IBG operations.

Service Level Management

  • Track adherence to reconciliation closure timelines (T+3, etc.)

  • Maintain performance dashboards with metrics across divisions and platforms

  • Identify breaches to the QA KPIs aligned with ERF and Group Operations KRIs

  • Monitor early warning triggers for high-risk or aging items

Quality Review

  • Monthly quality assurance sampling of reconciled items

  • Tracking accuracy, timeliness, and completeness of proofing controls

  • Raising exceptions to the CRU head and relevant BU operations for resolution

  • Conducting periodic health-checks aligned with audit and GRC guidelines
  • Supports standardization of QA templates, monthly packs, and internal MIS submissions.

Key Interfaces

  • Works with a cross-functional team of operations units, reconciliation SMEs, internal control leads, and CRU members.

4

Key Result Areas

  • Validate and review monthly proofing data submitted by operations teams, identify gaps, and ensure action closure.
  • Support QA testing protocols for reconciliation, governance, aging, and exception handling.
  • Ensure proper documentation and audit trail of validations, issues, and escalations.
  • Support training sessions and awareness programs for reconciliation hygiene and first-line QA.
  • Track compliance with control SLAs and highlight non-adherence trends to the lead.
  • Contribute to thematic reviews and sample-based testing cycles.

5

Operating Environment, Framework and Boundaries, Working Relationships

  • Operates independently from the CRU but in close coordination
  • Enterprise-wide scope across Group Operations and Business Units
  • Covers both UAE and international operations including Egypt, Pakistan, India, and IBG branches
  • Maintains reporting line into GRC – not embedded within the CRU to preserve independent assurance role
  • Aligned with ERF governance manual, APPM, ORM Guidelines and reporting templates.
  • Works within a cross-functional, multi-country environment.
  • Expected to define and enforce centralized standards and controls while balancing local branch needs.
  • Works with constrained resources in a transformation phase and must effectively build team capacity.

Working Relationships

Directly interfaces with:

  • Head of CRU and his leadership team
  • Matrix relationships with - Audit, Risk, Compliance, CAD & Tax teams
  • Operations GRC leads in Egypt, India, Pakistan

6

Problem Solving

  • Escalate unapproved or recurring exceptions and support the team in suggesting remediation.
  • Identify inconsistencies in reconciliation practices and proofing submission
  • Analyze patterns of QA failures to support process improvements and SOP updates.

7

Decision Making Authority & Responsibility

  • Responsible for recommending items for escalation based on QA checks and materiality thresholds.

  • Supports the AVP in defining testing protocols, sampling sizes, and QA cycles.

  • Cannot take final decisions on risk ratings but provides validated data to support them.

8

Knowledge, Skills and Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in banking operations, internal controls, or QA/audit functions.
  • Good understanding of reconciliation principles, control break classifications, and regulatory expectations.
  • Strong analytical skills, with ability to review large datasets and detect anomalies.
  • Proficient in Excel, QA tracking tools, and reconciliation platforms (e.g., TLM).
  • Clear and structured communication skills; documentation rigor is essential.
  • Exposure to operational risk, audit processes, and cross-country governance preferred.

job.title: QA and DevOps Engineer
job.description:
About KloudMate

KloudMate is an Observability platform for Developers and Businesses, building applications on distributed systems.

KloudMate detects performance bottlenecks in modern distributed applications, identifies errors and boosts developer productivity by reducing Mean-Time-To Resolve (MTTR), helping businesses improve application performance, shrink operating costs, increase customer satisfaction and grow revenues.

Job Overview: We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Quality Assurance Engineer to join our growing team. As a QA Engineer at KloudMate, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the quality and reliability of our innovative observability platform. You will be responsible for designing, executing, and analyzing tests to identify defects and ensure our software meets the highest standards of quality and performance. You will collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and DevOps engineers throughout the software development lifecycle.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts based on product requirements and technical specifications.

  • Perform various types of testing, including functional, regression, integration, system, and performance testing.

  • Identify, document, and track software defects using our bug tracking system, ensuring clear and concise reporting.

  • Collaborate closely with development and product teams to understand product features and provide timely feedback on potential issues.

  • Participate in agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives.

  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of our QA processes and methodologies.

  • Potentially contribute to the development and maintenance of automated test scripts (depending on experience and skills).

  • Analyze test results, identify root causes of failures, and work with the development team to ensure timely resolution.

  • Stay up-to-date with the latest testing tools and techniques.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

  • Minimum of 1 year of professional experience in software quality assurance.

  • Solid understanding of software testing methodologies, concepts, and the software development lifecycle (SDLC).

  • Experience in creating and executing test plans and test cases for web-based applications.

  • Familiarity with bug tracking systems (e.g., Jira, Bugzilla).

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a keen attention to detail.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience testing observability platforms or monitoring tools.

  • Exposure to cloud environments (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP).

  • Experience with performance testing tools (e.g., JMeter, LoadRunner).

  • Experience with Monitoring tools (e.g. Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, New Relic, Zabbix, Nagios)

  • Experience with any cloud provider’s monitoring service (AWS CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, GCP Monitoring)

  • Experience with metrics, logs, or traces in QA role

  • Familiarity with OpenTelemetry, Jaeger, Zipkin

  • Familiarity with test automation frameworks and tools (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright).

  • Basic scripting skills (e.g., Python, JavaScript).

  • Experience working in an Agile development environment.

What We OfferCompensation: Competitive salary in the range of 2 to 4 LPA CTC annually.
Location: Remote-first with the flexibility to work from anywhere. We have offices in Bangalore, India, and occasional visits are encouraged to foster team connections. We also host annual off-sites at beautiful locations (beaches or mountains!).

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive health insurance.

  • Generous PTO (20 days) + National/Regional holidays + Compensation Day off.

  • Remote-friendly work environment.

  • Professional development opportunities.

  • Fun and engaging company events.

  • Strong emphasis on work-life balance (including celebrating birthdays and anniversaries!).

  • Opportunity to work from home.

Cutting-edge Technologies: Work with the latest and greatest technologies on a brand new codebase.
Growth and Impact: As an early-stage employee, you'll have significant ownership and the chance to make a real difference.
Healthy Work Culture: We value a 40-hour workweek and asynchronous communication.
Investment Day: Similar to Google's 20% time, we encourage employees to dedicate Fridays to explore and develop ideas that benefit KloudMate.

Hiring Process

  1. Quick Intro Chat (30 min): Get to know you and your QA background.

  2. Technical Deep Dive (2 hours): Assess your hands-on QA skills.

  3. Vision & Fit Talk (30 min): Chat with founders about our goals and your potential.

Ready to join a passionate team and build the future of cloud observability? We look forward to hearing from you!

o Participate in document standardization meetings to drive variation reduction and process consistency.

Consumer Licensing Enquiry Online – Test Analyst

Scope:

Scope of Work – Testing Analyst (CLEO)

The Testing Analyst will provide testing, business readiness, training, and AI-enabled quality assurance services in support of the Consumer Licensing Enquiry Outreach (CLEO) initiative. The resource will support User Acceptance Testing (UAT), enhancement testing, defect management, training material development, deployment readiness, post-implementation stabilization activities, and the responsible use of Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools to improve testing, documentation, and knowledge transfer processes.

Services will be delivered in accordance with approved project requirements, ServiceNow stories, acceptance criteria, project schedules, Government of Alberta governance processes, and responsible AI principles. The resource will work collaboratively with Product Owners, Subject Matter Experts (SMEs), business stakeholders, and project team members to validate the CLEO solution, support business readiness activities, and ensure users are prepared for operational readiness.

The Testing Analyst will be responsible for developing and executing testing activities, validating business and technical requirements, supporting defect resolution, and creating training and readiness materials that enable successful user adoption. The resource will also identify opportunities to leverage approved AI-enabled tools to improve testing efficiency, documentation quality, training development, knowledge management, and readiness activities while maintaining appropriate human oversight and quality assurance. The resource will support the development and validation of training materials, user guides, job aids, FAQs, training scenarios, and knowledge transfer content, including AI-assisted content creation where appropriate. All AI-generated outputs must be reviewed and validated to ensure accuracy, completeness, accessibility, alignment to approved business processes, and compliance with Government of Alberta standards.

The Testing Analyst will contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by assessing opportunities to use AI-assisted tools to support test case development, test coverage analysis, defect investigation, reporting, documentation, and training preparation. Work is deliverable-based and aligned with approved CLEO testing, training, business readiness, knowledge transfer, and deployment readiness artifacts.

Services are performed within established Government of Alberta project management, testing, quality assurance, privacy, security, accessibility, and governance frameworks. The resource is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing testing and readiness activities required to support successful CLEO implementation and user adoption. This includes supporting the responsible use of approved AI-enabled tools and ensuring all AI-assisted outputs are appropriately reviewed and validated before use.

The resource has no authority for project scope approval, budget approval, solution design decisions, procurement decisions, operational policy decisions, AI governance decisions, or production release sign-off. Engagement is time-bound to CLEO project delivery, testing cycles, training development, business readiness activities, deployment readiness, transition to operations, go-live support, and post-implementation stabilization.

The Testing Analyst is expected to promote continuous improvement and innovation by identifying opportunities to leverage approved AI capabilities to enhance testing effectiveness, training development, knowledge transfer, and operational readiness while ensuring compliance with Government of Alberta policies, governance requirements, privacy obligations, and responsible AI practices.

Duties:

  • Develop, update, and execute test scenarios, test scripts, and test cases aligned with approved business requirements, ServiceNow stories, and acceptance criteria, leveraging approved AI-assisted tools where appropriate to improve test coverage, traceability, and efficiency.
  • Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT), including functional testing, enhancement testing, regression testing, end-to-end process testing, and retesting activities to validate system functionality and business outcomes.
  • Identify, document, track, and validate defects, including severity assessment, supporting evidence, root cause analysis support, and verification of defect resolution. Utilize AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to support defect analysis, pattern identification, and documentation activities.
  • Maintain testing documentation, execution records, traceability information, and testing status reports using approved project tools and repositories, while leveraging AI-assisted productivity tools to improve documentation quality and consistency.
  • Support integration testing, data migration validation, and business process validation activities, including the use of AI-enabled tools, where appropriate, to assist in identifying data inconsistencies, process gaps, or testing opportunities.
  • Monitor testing progress and communicate testing risks, issues, dependencies, constraints, and blockers that may impact project timelines or deliverables, utilizing available reporting and analytical tools to support decision-making.
  • Participate in sprint-based and release-based testing activities, including test planning, test execution, defect triage, deployment validation, smoke testing, post-deployment verification, and continuous improvement of testing practices.
  • Develop, update, and maintain training materials and business readiness artifacts, including user guides, quick reference guides, job aids, training presentations, process documentation, knowledge articles, and frequently asked questions (FAQ) content. Leverage approved AI tools, where appropriate, to accelerate content development while ensuring accuracy and quality.

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

Successful candidates will be ambitious, self-driven, and organized, deeply invested in both the user experience and the real-world functionality of our products.

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

  • Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and developers to shape quality from the ground up.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it

job.title: Quality Assurance Analyst I
job.description:
Job Summary

The individual in this role will create test documentation, perform end-to-end testing, and build and execute automated test cases for our payments platform, including web-based applications, APIs, and physical payment terminals. Competitive candidates have 2+ years of experience in a QA function, including executing test scenarios for transaction-processing systems and providing comprehensive results. We have an opening for an on-site QA in Ft Wayne, In and an opening for a remote position.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Translate business requirements and payment processes (authorization, capture, void, refund, settlement, reconciliation) into test requirements and configuration settings for web, API, and terminal solutions.
  • Identify and assess risks to programs or projects, especially those affecting transaction accuracy, funds movement, and data security, and recommend and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Create test strategies that ensure solutions meet standards of functionality, performance, reliability, and payment industry requirements.
  • Collaborate with team leads and engineering resources to plan the testing approach across web, API, and terminal layers.
  • Execute end-to-end testing of the full transaction lifecycle, from card presentment at the terminal through processor response, settlement, reporting, and reconciliation, according to set deadlines.
  • Test terminal behavior across entry methods (chip, contactless/NFC, swipe, manual entry), PIN entry, receipt generation, and error handling.
  • Test device-specific scenarios such as connectivity loss, offline or store-and-forward modes, power interruption, and firmware and application updates.
  • Perform API testing of payment, webhook, and reporting endpoints, validating request/response accuracy, error codes, and idempotency.
  • Verify web components, including merchant portal, hosted checkout, and admin tools, across browsers and devices.
  • Support and complete test orchestration across environments, test cards, sandbox and processor simulators, and device fleets, using analysis, experience, and sound decision-making.
  • Record, log, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, logs, and transaction IDs, and coordinate resolutions with the development team and functional leads.
  • Assess test results to quickly identify and document defects, including discrepancies in transaction amounts, statuses, fees, or settlement data.
  • Support certification and compliance testing, such as card brand, EMV, acquirer/processor, and PCI-related requirements.
  • Direct projects from a quality assurance perspective, keeping both the merchant and the cardholder experience in mind.
  • Independently own a workstream or product line (for example, terminal software, merchant portal, or payment APIs), covering review and testing activities throughout the project life cycle.
  • Maintain the device test lab, including terminals, peripherals, test cards, and firmware versions.
  • Participate in daily engineering meetings to update teammates and management on status.
  • Assist the in-house support team with product defect exploration, as needed, including:
    • High-level technical assistance and escalations for merchants, partners, and internal staff.
    • Troubleshooting and analyzing issues related to transactions, terminals, reports, and data.
  • Present product expertise in training and implementation environments.
  • Build and execute automated test cases for web and API layers and identify opportunities to automate terminal testing.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Education and Experience

  • 2-5 years of experience in a QA role, including:
    • System, integration, and user acceptance testing
    • Test plans, documentation, and execution across multiple development deliverables
    • Testing web applications and REST APIs (e.g., Postman or similar tools)
  • At least 2 years of Azure Table or relevant database experience, including querying transaction data to validate results
  • Preferred: experience in payments, fintech, or financial services
  • Preferred: experience testing POS terminals or other physical devices (e.g., Verifone, Ingenico, PAX)
  • Preferred: familiarity with EMV, contactless standards, card brand certification, ISO 8583, or payment gateway and processor integrations

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end payment flows, including authorization, settlement, chargebacks, refunds, and reconciliation.
  • Working knowledge of payment concepts such as tokenization, encryption, and PCI DSS, along with secure testing practices for sensitive cardholder data.
  • Knowledge of the technical aspects of business systems and infrastructure, including networks, terminal connectivity, and device management.
  • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with particular care where money movement is involved.
  • Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
  • Well-versed in test automation, end-user desktop tools, and information security.
  • Ability to maintain a positive and professional attitude in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to take initiative in prioritizing, coordinating, and multitasking with composure.
  • Ability to work independently and as a contributing member of a team.

Work Environment

The noise level is usually moderate. The employee works in an office setting at an individual workstation using a telephone and computer, and may spend time in a device test lab handling payment terminals and peripherals.

Physical Demands

  • Must be able to remain in a stationary position for most of the day.
  • Constantly operates a computer and other office productivity machinery.
  • Occasionally handles, sets up, and moves payment terminals and related hardware.

Neumo Summary:

With the backing of four decades of public sector expertise and corporate capability, Neumo has successfully supported government services. Neumo was honored and recognized for four (4) consecutive years as a GovTech 100 Company representing the top 100 companies focused on making a difference in and selling to state and local government agencies across the United States.

Neumo is committed to helping communities thrive and brings a wealth of experience combined with innovation. Today, Neumo offers more administrative and financial support to government officials than any other organization. And with a responsive, client-focused approach, we foster partnerships that give our customers the certainty they need to accomplish more.

Neumo offers a competitive benefits and compensation package and are looking for team members who will thrive in our dynamic environment.

Neumo is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Selection for a position will be made without regard to race, religion, national origin, sex, political affiliation, marital status, non-disqualifying physical handicap, and age.

job.description:
To help keep everyone safe, we encourage all applicants to pay close attention to protect themselves during their job search. When applying for a position online you are at risk of being targeted by malicious actors looking for personal data. Please be aware we will only reach out via email using the domain quanata.com. Anything that does not match those domains should be ignored and considered a security risk.

About Us

Quanata is on a mission to help ensure a better world through context-based insurance solutions. We are an exceptional, customer centered team with a passion for creating innovative technologies, digital products, and brands. We blend some of the best Silicon Valley talent and cutting-edge thinking with the long-term backing of leading insurer, State Farm.

Learn more about us and our work at quanata.com

Our Team

Quanata, LLC is an insurance technology innovation company that engineers advanced risk prediction and prevention solutions, develops risk-focused acquisition capabilities, and builds/supports a full-stack, flexible, digital & increasingly AI-native insurance platform. This helps our primary clients, State Farm and HiRoad Assurance Company, adapt to evolving market needs. Quanata, LLC is wholly owned and funded by State Farm.

As a company that prioritizes an inclusive and positive culture, we believe the core of our success is in hiring talented people — across disciplines — who want to help us make a quantifiable impact.

The Role

Join our Data Platform QA team as a hands-on engineer focused on ensuring the quality, reliability, and performance of complex data platforms and machine learning workflows.

In this individual contributor role, you’ll design scalable approaches to automated testing and quality assurance across data and ML systems. You’ll partner closely with Data Engineers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and DevOps teams to identify risks early, strengthen quality throughout the development lifecycle, and ensure data and model outputs can be trusted.

You’ll also help shape testing practices across teams, troubleshoot complex production issues, and mentor other quality engineers while remaining actively involved in hands-on engineering.

Your Day-to-Day

  • Design and implement scalable automated testing frameworks for complex data pipelines, processing workflows, and machine learning models.
  • Develop comprehensive testing strategies that address data quality, schema integrity, data drift, model accuracy, bias, and regression.
  • Validate large-scale distributed data systems for accuracy, reliability, performance, and resilience.
  • Partner across engineering, data science, and operations teams to embed quality throughout the software development and delivery lifecycle.
  • Conduct exploratory testing to identify edge cases and risks in new features, data outputs, and machine learning workflows.
  • Build continuous validation into automated development and deployment processes.
  • Investigate production data and model failures, identify root causes, and help drive effective resolutions.
  • Mentor junior SDETs and contribute to broader testing strategies, standards, and quality engineering best practices.

About You

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • Typically 6–8 years of software testing experience, including at least 3 years focused on data platform or machine learning testing.
  • Strong programming skills with experience building and maintaining automated testing frameworks.
  • Hands-on experience testing complex data platforms, pipelines, and distributed data processing systems.
  • Strong understanding of data validation approaches, including data quality, integrity, consistency, and schema validation.
  • Understanding of machine learning concepts, workflows, and model evaluation methods.
  • Experience developing automated validation approaches for data and machine learning systems.
  • Deep understanding of continuous integration, continuous delivery, and infrastructure automation practices.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex data and model failures and contribute effectively to root cause analysis.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively across engineering, data science, and operations teams.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify risks and edge cases in complex systems.
  • Ability to mentor other quality engineers and contribute to shared testing standards and best practices.

Bonus Points

  • Experience evaluating machine learning models for interpretability, fairness, and bias.
  • Familiarity with machine learning operations and model lifecycle practices.
  • Experience monitoring the health and performance of production data pipelines and machine learning systems.
  • Knowledge of data governance and compliance practices.

Salary: $198,000 to $281,000

*Please note that the final salary offered will be determined based on the selected candidate's skills, and experience, as well as the internal salary structure at Quanata. Our aim is to offer a competitive and equitable compensation package that reflects the candidate's expertise and contributions to our organization.

Additional Details:

  • Benefits: We provide a wide variety of health, wellness and other benefits.These include medical, dental, vision, life insurance and supplemental income plans for you and your dependents, a Headspace app subscription, monthly wellness allowance and a 401(k) Plan with a company match.

Also, our teams work with MacBook Pros, which we will deliver to you fully provisioned prior to your first day.

New parents receive twelve weeks of fully paid parental leave which may be taken within one year after the birth and/or adoption of a child. The twelve weeks is applicable to both birthing and non-birthing parent.

All employees receive up to $5000 each year for professional learning, continuing education and career development. All team members also receive LinkedIn Learning subscriptions and access to multiple different coaching opportunities through BetterUp.

For most positions, occasional travel may be requested or encouraged but is not required. Some positions might require travel per the job description provided to the employee. Employees based in the San Francisco Bay Area or in Providence, Rhode Island may commute to one of our local offices as desired.

job.title: Hardware Field Quality Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
job.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. Lyft Urban Solutions designs, builds, and operates bikeshare systems in more than 50 cities worldwide, including New York, Chicago, London, Barcelona, Mexico City, Rio de Janeiro, and Montréal. Our Longueuil facility is the birthplace of BIXI, North America's first automated bikeshare system, and today builds the bikes and stations behind some of the world's largest bikeshare networks.

We are looking for a Hardware Field Quality Engineer Intern to join our Field Quality team at our Longueuil facility. Once our bikes, e-bikes, batteries, and stations leave the factory, Field Quality owns how they hold up in the real world: millions of rides, all four seasons, in cities across the globe. You will work alongside field quality engineers to help spot emerging hardware issues, investigate their root cause, and support fixes with engineering, manufacturing, and market operations teams. You will spend time hands-on with failed parts in the lab, and just as much time in the data working out how big a problem really is.

Responsibilities:

  • Support failure analysis on parts returned from the field, including requests from enterprise customers, by helping with teardown, inspection, and electrical testing and documenting findings with photos.
  • Help monitor field data, such as vehicle and station alerts and repair records, and flag emerging issues to the team.
  • Build and update dashboards and queries that track reliability metrics and retrofit progress.
  • Assist with field retrofit campaigns by helping identify affected units and tracking progress.
  • Help review repair SOPs and troubleshooting guides used by market mechanics, and suggest improvements.
  • Contribute to field failure investigations in Jira, working with engineers on root cause and corrective actions.

Experience:

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering, or a related field, at a Canadian university, graduating between December 2027 and summer 2028 (required). Master's students who worked between degrees should have less than 2 years of full-time experience.
  • Professional proficiency in French and English, written and spoken (required)
  • Hands-on comfort with electromechanical hardware, including disassembly, inspection, and basic electrical troubleshooting with tools like a multimeter
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large, imperfect datasets to reach clear conclusions
  • Familiarity with structured problem-solving methods (5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, 8D, FMEA)
  • Curious and detail-oriented, with clear written communication
  • Previous internship or co-op in quality, reliability, test, or failure analysis is a plus
  • SQL or Python, and experience with Mode, Hex, Tableau, or Power BI, is a plus
  • Familiarity with Jira or similar ticketing tools is a plus
  • Exposure to e-bikes, batteries, automotive, or other electromechanical products, or to reading wiring diagrams, is a plus

Benefits:

  • Mental health benefits
  • In addition to holidays, interns receive 2 days paid time off and 3 days sick time off
  • Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

Lyft also strives for a healthy and safe workplace and strictly prohibits harassment of any kind.  Accommodation for persons with disabilities will be provided upon request in accordance with applicable law during the application and hiring process. Please contact your recruiter if you wish to make such a request.

job.title: Senior Quality Assurance (QA) Automation Engineer
job.description:
About Terawatt Infrastructure

The once in a century transition to autonomous and electric vehicles is underway and will require a multi-trillion-dollar investment in energy and charging infrastructure, and the real estate to site it on. Terawatt is the leader in delivering large scale, turnkey charging solutions for companies rapidly deploying AV and EV fleets. Whether it’s an urban mobility hub, or a carefully located multi-fleet hub for semi-trucks, Terawatt brings the talent, capabilities, and capital to create reliable, cost-effective solutions for customers on the leading edge of the transition to the next generation of transport.

With a growing portfolio of sites across the US in urban hubs and along key logistics and transportation corridors. Terawatt is building the permanent transportation and logistics infrastructure of tomorrow through a robust combination of capital, real estate, development, and site operations solutions. The company develops, finances, owns, and operates charging solutions that take the cost and complexity out of electrifying fleets.

Our Values

Six core values guide how we work: commitments we make to each other. Our pace is set by a simple conviction: imperfect action beats perfect inaction, so we move with purpose, adapt without ego, and measure ourselves by progress rather than activity. Ownership travels with autonomy. Your name is on the work, and the best answer wins the conversation, wherever it lives. That candor works because of what surrounds it: people who show up with intention and have each other's back, tough on ideas and generous with people. Our customers feel this as reliability earned daily, every interaction treated as a chance to build something lasting. And underneath it all is why the work matters. The climate doesn't wait, and the stakes are also human: behind every checklist and every inspection is a person going home safely. We call it "This work has a heartbeat” — it's what the other five rest on.

Our Technology

Terawatt is not a traditional infrastructure operator. Our technology platform transforms a portfolio of sites into a reliable, intelligent network — through advanced power management, operational optimization, and data-driven systems that back our customers with hard performance guarantees. That's what makes us a de-risked operator and a category-defining company.

We sit at a rare intersection: software, hardware, real estate, energy systems, and live site operations. The work is concrete and the stakes are real. The code you write today runs physical infrastructure tomorrow. You'll build systems that orchestrate megawatts of power across hundreds of chargers, ingest millions of telemetry events per day, and keep autonomous fleets, rideshare vehicles, and heavy-duty trucks moving — in real time.

Role Description

    You are enthusiastic about joining a transformative organization that sits at the intersection of climate impact, electric vehicle charging infrastructure, exceptional customer experiences, and technological innovation in a rapidly evolving industry.

    Your commitment to quality and to customer-centric products will shape how our solutions meet the specific needs of our customers, while upholding the reliability that is synonymous with the Terawatt brand.

    This role is built for a QA automation specialist who treats test infrastructure as a first-class engineering problem: someone equally comfortable designing test coverage and building the CI/CD pipelines, containerized environments, and orchestration that run it. You’re also curious about where AI-assisted tooling — self-healing test automation, LLM-assisted test authoring, visual AI regression — can responsibly expand coverage and cut maintenance load, and be disciplined enough to validate that output rather than take it on faith.

    You will own the framework for comprehensive testing, automation, and quality across our product ecosystem, working closely with a highly skilled software, hardware, and product development team and directly with our technology leadership.

Core Responsibilities

  • Own and extend the test automation framework across UI, API, and hardware-in-the-loop test surfaces, validating the larger design decisions with technology leadership, to enable high development velocity.

  • Build and maintain the CI/CD test infrastructure — pipeline orchestration, containerized/ephemeral test environments, environment provisioning, and test parallelization — partnering with DevOps/SRE to keep it scalable, observable, and maintainable.

  • Develop comprehensive test plans for software and hardware-in-the-loop product features; identify test scenarios, cases, and test data to ensure coverage for new and existing features.

  • Maintain test cases and scripts in the Test Management System; analyze test results to help developers address underlying issues.

  • Monitor production bugs to identify root causes, expand test coverage to minimize escapes and provide reports on product quality metrics.

  • Triage automation failures, identify gaps between existing tests and the automation framework, and implement solutions to keep the system reliable and performant.

  • Design and execute performance and scale testing, security testing, and user experience testing as requirements demand.

  • Evaluate, pilot, and introduce AI-assisted testing tools — e.g., self-healing test automation, visual AI regression testing, LLM-assisted test authoring — to increase coverage and cut maintenance overhead, while validating that their output actually meets Terawatt’s quality bar rather than accepting it uncritically.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship to software engineers on best practices for building and enhancing test suites, fostering a culture of quality and continuous improvement.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams — Developers, SREs, Product Managers, and Operations — to validate end-to-end functionality.

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or above in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • 7+ years of experience in a Quality Assurance role, delivering high-quality, reliable products to market.

  • 4+ years of demonstrable experience designing automation frameworks and developing test automation software and tools.

  • Demonstrable experience leading QA projects and initiatives.

  • Working knowledge of test methodologies, processes, and tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Appium, JIRA, STLC, and test management tools like TestRail, ALM, or Zephyr; and automation frameworks or tools such as Karate, Requests, HttpRunner, TestNG, or Fiddler.

  • Hands-on experience designing, building, and maintaining CI/CD pipelines-as-code (e.g., GitHub Actions) — not just consuming pipelines someone else built.

  • Experience containerizing test environments (Docker required; Kubernetes a plus) and provisioning ephemeral or on-demand test infrastructure.

  • Coding skills: proficiency in Python required; shell scripting for pipeline and infrastructure tooling is a plus.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills, technical aptitude, attention to detail; self-motivated and quick to learn new concepts, technologies, and products.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills; highly detail-oriented.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (e.g., Terraform, Ansible, or similar) for building reproducible test environments.

  • Familiarity with performance, security, and accessibility testing.

  • Familiarity with ETL testing, data quality frameworks, and advanced SQL is a plus.

  • A plus: hands-on curiosity with AI-assisted QA tooling — self-healing locators, visual AI regression testing, or using LLMs to help generate and maintain test scripts and test data.

Compensation for this role is determined by several factors, including the cost of labor in specific geographic markets, and these ranges are intended to provide a helpful reference. The actual compensation offer will be based on the candidate’s location, skills, level of expertise and experience, and internal equity considerations. In addition to base salary, we offer a comprehensive benefits package and, where applicable, performance-based incentives.
We are building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. At Terawatt, we continuously strive to foster inclusion, humility, energizing relationships, and belonging, and welcome new ideas. We're growing and want you to grow with us. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply.

job.title: QA Architect
job.description:
Ready to accelerate your career?

Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We’re a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions.

Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we’re building toward that vision every single day.

Join us and you’ll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them.

We're searching for a QA Architect to own quality strategy, automation, and CI enforcement across engineering. This role sets the standard for how we build, test, and ship software, not just execute test cases.

You'll lead the design of our test infrastructure, push automation-first practices across Engineering and Product, and make quality gates part of every stage of the SDLC, from planning to production. This role has the authority to block a release over quality concerns.

We need someone who can architect quality frameworks, create department-wide quality plans, wire automated tests into CI/CD, and shift the team's default from catching bugs late to preventing them early.

What You'll Do

  • Own the end-to-end quality strategy across web, APIs, and data layers, including standards, test coverage expectations, and release criteria
  • Assess existing products and features, identify quality gaps, and establish prioritized test plans based on risk and business impact
  • Build and scale automated testing frameworks across unit, integration, end-to-end, and regression testing
  • Define the tooling, architecture, and shared testing patterns used across engineering squads
  • Embed automated quality gates into CI/CD pipelines to catch regressions before they reach production
  • Establish release-readiness standards, testing thresholds, and coverage expectations across teams
  • Improve test reliability, pipeline health, automation coverage, and flakiness across critical user flows
  • Partner with DevOps/Platform to ensure test environments are stable, fast, and representative of production
  • Define and monitor engineering quality metrics that surface trends, risks, and areas for improvement
  • Partner with Engineering and Product to build testability into requirements, design, and technical planning
  • Drive shift-left practices so quality is considered earlier in the development lifecycle, not just before release
  • Mentor engineers and QA team members on automation, testing practices, and quality ownership
  • Participate in incident reviews and post-mortems and turn recurring quality gaps into systemic improvements
  • Act as a quality authority on releases, including holding releases when critical standards are not met

What You Bring

  • 7–10+ years in software quality, including senior ownership of QA strategy, architecture, or automation
  • Experience as a QA Architect, Staff/Principal SDET, Principal QA Engineer, or similar
  • Proven experience building and scaling test automation frameworks
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Playwright, Cypress, Selenium, Jest, Postman, or similar
  • Strong experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD platforms such as GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or Jenkins
  • Experience with TypeScript/JavaScript testing environments, REST APIs, and relational databases
  • Strong understanding of modern web application architecture and quality engineering practices
  • Experience with performance/load testing tools such as k6, Locust, or JMeter is a plus
  • Experience using AI development tools such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot to improve testing and automation
  • Interest in applying AI to areas such as test generation, defect detection, and pipeline optimization

Compensation

In line with Ontario’s Pay Transparency legislation, the salary range for this role is $130,000 – $160,000 CAD annually, based on experience, skills, and alignment with the role requirements. This is a vacant position, and we are hiring with intention and seeking someone who will bring new perspective, contribute meaningfully to the team, and grow with the organization.

Why you’ll love working at Cardata:

We’ll be honest — Cardata isn’t for everyone. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment, take extreme ownership, and constantly push yourself (and your work) to be the best, you’ll fit right in.

You’ll be surrounded by driven teammates who genuinely care — about the work, about our customers, and about helping each other succeed. Together, we take on ambitious goals and celebrate the wins along the way.

What we offer in return for you bringing your best:

  • Remote work and flexible working hours

  • Healthcare spending account
  • $3,000 annual Health and Wellness Spending Account to support your overall wellbeing
  • Employee assistance program (EAP)
  • Flexible (Unlimited) Time Off: No annual cap on vacation, supported by a trust-based, flexible approach to time away.

About the Role

Zyte is looking for a Quality Engineer to join our unified Quality Engineering function. This is an automation-first, AI-native role embedded directly within our engineering squads.

You will be responsible for designing risk-based test strategies, rapidly converting them into automated checks using AI-assisted development workflows, and continuously improving the quality, speed, and reliability of software delivery. Quality at Zyte is not a gatekeeping function. It is an engineering discipline focused on preventing defects, accelerating delivery, and increasing confidence in every release.

AI coding agents are a core part of how we work. You will be expected to use Claude Code or equivalent AI-assisted development environments as your primary development partner for generating, reviewing, debugging, refactoring, and maintaining automation code.

What You Will Do

  • Design risk-based test strategies for new features and releases, then rapidly convert those strategies into automated coverage using AI-assisted development workflows
  • Use Claude Code within VS Code or equivalent AI coding agents as your primary development environment to generate, scale, and maintain automated test coverage
  • Build and maintain automated test suites using Playwright, integrated within GitHub CI/CD pipelines, ensuring quality gates are embedded throughout the software development lifecycle
  • Design and implement agentic testing workflows that generate, adapt, and maintain automated tests using AI models and APIs
  • Build reusable frameworks, utilities, shared libraries, and AI-powered tools that increase test authoring velocity across engineering teams
  • Partner closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to shift quality left, influencing requirements, design decisions, observability, and deployment strategies
  • Continuously improve test suite health by reducing flakiness, increasing execution speed, and ensuring reliable quality signals for every release
  • Drive quality upstream by identifying risks early and implementing preventative quality practices
  • Own and improve quality metrics including automated coverage growth, escaped defects, test execution performance, flakiness rates, and release confidence
  • Enable developers to write, execute, and maintain automated tests as part of their daily workflow

Requirements

What We Are Looking For

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals, with the ability to review, validate and debug code across any modern programming language
  • Strong experience with modern test automation frameworks, preferably Playwright
  • Demonstrated ability to use AI coding agents as a primary development partner for generating, reviewing, debugging, refactoring, and maintaining code
  • Comfortable delegating significant portions of implementation work to AI agents while maintaining high engineering and quality standards
  • Experience building and maintaining scalable automation frameworks
  • Experience integrating automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions or similar platforms
  • Experience with agentic testing frameworks, AI-powered testing tools, or LLM API integrations within engineering workflows
  • Proven track record of increasing automation coverage, reducing manual effort, and improving software quality outcomes
  • Strong understanding of quality engineering principles, test strategy, risk analysis, and defect prevention
  • Comfortable working as an embedded engineer within cross-functional product squads

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with prompt engineering, AI quality assessment, and AI observability
  • Experience with performance, load, or resilience testing
  • Experience with test management platforms integrated with Jira
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, testing tools, or engineering productivity solutions

Success in This Role

Within your first six months, you will:

  • Increase automated regression coverage for your squad
  • Reduce manual testing effort sprint over sprint
  • Build reusable automation components adopted by multiple teams
  • Demonstrate effective use of AI agents to accelerate automation development and maintenance
  • Improve release confidence while supporting fast, reliable software delivery

Ready to Make a Real Impact? Join e-STORAGE!

Who We Are

Welcome to e-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone.

With our innovative SolBank lithium-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide.

Role Overview for Senior Performance Engineer

In this role, you’ll bring together the sharp analytical mindset of a controls engineer and the hands‑on problem‑solving instincts of a commissioning engineer to efficiently troubleshoot complex issues and pinpoint root causes on operating systems.

You’ll take ownership of diagnosing performance challenges and work closely with internal teams and external vendors to drive solutions, validating and evaluating firmware and software updates to ensure system security and reliability, minimizing downtime. Your insights will feed back to internal teams and product improvements to drive a cycle of continuous improvement.

If you thrive on tackling new challenges, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and love the satisfaction of solving problems that matter, this role keeps you continuously engaged and at the center of meaningful, hands‑on innovation.

What You’ll Be Doing as a Senior Performance Controls Engineer

  • Prioritize, investigate, and drive the corrective action for performance issues identified during facility operation.
  • Troubleshooting and root cause analysis using data analysis, first principles, on site investigation, or other means as needed.
  • Validate software/firmware updates in coordination with vendors, the site service team, and relevant stakeholders to confirm documented changes and no unintended consequences are introduced. Coordinate subsequent rollouts with the appropriate site service teams.
  • Effectively communicate issues to the appropriate vendor and stakeholders to ensure resolutions are identified and implemented.
  • Support performance testing as required under individual contracts for each facility.
  • Contribute to fleet wide efforts for improving the efficacy of monitoring and analysis processes and tools.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to provide input to improve performance across the business from applications and design to project execution and commissioning to service.
  • Provide documentation of issues and resolutions for tracking, knowledge sharing, and internal and external communications.
  • Ensure all activities are performed in compliance with safety protocols, engineering standards, and company policies.

What You’ll Bring to the Position

  • Demonstrated experience in customer-focused problem solving
  • Ability to execute projects and tasks in parallel, self-directed, highly detail-oriented, organized and flexible
  • Experience troubleshooting using data analytics
  • Experience in commissioning, performance testing, maintenance, and/or design of BESS or other power generating facilities
  • Knowledge and experience with SCADA protocols (i.e. DNP3 and Modbus)
  • Familiarity with industrial communication networks (fiber optics, network switches, TCP/IP, etc.)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of time. Travel may be on short notice
  • Demonstrated experience in problem solving

What It’s Like to Work Here

At e-STORAGE, you’re more than just an employee—you’re part of a team that values your ideas, your background, and your unique perspective. We believe that a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s the secret to our success. Here, you’ll find:

  • Integrity: We do what’s right, always.
  • Innovation: We encourage fresh thinking and bold ideas.
  • Quality: We take pride in delivering excellence, every time.
  • Customer Focus: We listen, we care, and we deliver.
  • Sustainability: We’re passionate about protecting our planet for future generations.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Join a global leader in renewable energy, backed by over 23 years of Canadian Solar experience.
  • Work on projects that matter—helping to build a cleaner, greener world.
  • Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority.
  • Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package.

Want to join here is what we are looking For

  • The right mix of education, experience, and skills for the role.
  • Great communication, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.
  • A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability.

Your Rewards

We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package—including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and more.

Our Commitment to Equality & Diversity

“At e-STORAGE, we know that diverse teams drive innovation and better results. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered—regardless of age, race, gender, ability, or background. When you join us, you’re joining a community that celebrates your uniqueness and supports your success.”

— Libby, Sr. Global HR Manager

job.description:
Position Description

Valiant Solutions is seeking a Quality Engineering & Testing Lead to join our rapidly growing and innovative team!

The Quality Engineering & Testing Lead develops and executes the enterprise testing strategy for AirHub. This individual leads all functional, integration, system, regression, automation, performance, user acceptance, and external stakeholder testing activities.

The role manages contractor testing staff, coordinates testing with the client's testing resources, and establishes the testing framework supporting Agile development and phased releases.

Named one of the Best Places to Work in the Washington DC area for 12 consecutive years, Valiant is proud of our employee-centric culture and commitment to excellence. If you are interested in learning more about Valiant and this opportunity, we invite you to apply now!

This position allows for 100% remote work. Remote work requires a high level of trust in our employees, and we strictly adhere to the details outlined in our Remote Work Policy below.

Required Experience

  • 12+ years of software testing experience.
  • 8+ years of experience leading enterprise QA or Quality Engineering organizations.
  • Experience implementing automated testing frameworks.
  • Experience with TestRail and Agile testing practices.
  • Experience leading UAT programs and coordinating business-user testing.
  • Experience testing APIs, databases, cloud applications, and integrated enterprise systems.
  • Strong leadership, facilitation, and communication skills.
  • Experience supporting Federal software delivery preferred.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain the AirHub Test Strategy.
  • Establish and lead the AirHub Quality Engineering practice.
  • Manage contractor test engineers.
  • Coordinate EPA testing resources.
  • Own UAT test planning, execution governance, defect management, results, and quality exit criteria in coordination with the Implementation Lead and EPA business stakeholders.
  • Provide testing results and quality criteria to support Beta and Production release readiness decisions.
  • Establish and mature the automated testing framework.
  • Oversee TestRail governance.
  • Define release quality metrics.
  • Coordinate external stakeholder testing activities.

About Valiant Solutions

Valiant Solutions is a security-focused IT solutions provider with public clients nationwide. Named one of the fastest growing privately held companies by Inc. 5000, Washington Technology’s Fast 50, and Washington Business Journal’s Best Places to Work in the D.C. area, Valiant Solutions prides itself on providing its employees with great benefits and career development opportunities. As a company, we are just as committed to growing careers as we are to building world-class IT solutions, all while enjoying an unparalleled work-life balance. We are in a phase of tremendous growth and building the team that will take us to the next level. We seek people whose talents and accomplishments will contribute to a thriving company, who have the character to support their capacity, and can make a positive impact on our culture. Alongside our talented team, you’ll learn to think quickly on your feet and expand your own personal and professional skill set. Our management team will inspire you to consider new perspectives and challenge you to become a better practitioner in the fast-paced industry of IT security. We hire people we respect – and we trust them to deliver results leveraging their expertise. If you would enjoy working in a dynamic environment as part of a stellar team of professionals, then we invite you to apply online today.

Benefits Snapshot (includes, but not limited to)Valiant pays 99% of the Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage for Full-time EmployeesValiant contributes 25% towards Health Coverage for Family and Dependents100% Paid Short Term Disability and Life Insurance Policy for Full-time Employees100% Paid Certifications401K Matching up to 4%Paid Time OffPaid Federal HolidaysWellness & Fitness ProgramValiant University – Online Education and Training PortalFSA programs for: Medical Costs, Dependent Care, Transit, and ParkingReferral Bonuses

The salary range for this position is a general guideline and not a guarantee of compensation or salary. It has been benchmarked in relation to the scope of the role, market rate, and internal equity. The salary for this role is expected to be in the $120,000- $140,000 range. Where a candidate falls within the band can be determined based on one or more of the following: skillset, experience level, achievements, education, geographic location, security clearance, involvement in corporate tasks, and other non-discriminatory factors. In addition to the base salary, this role will include benefits as described above. Valiant reserves the right to adjust the salary range, experience requirements, and position responsibilities at any time without prior notice.

Remote Work Policy

Remote work necessitates a high level of trust in our employees. To ensure that employee performance does not suffer in a remote work environment, all employees who telecommute are expected to have a quiet and distraction-free workspace with adequate internet, dedicate their full attention and availability to their job duties during working hours, and maintain a schedule during core business hours that align with those of their coworkers and Valiant's clients. In alignment with Valiant's inclusive and engaging environment, cameras are encouraged and can be required to be on during virtual video conferences. Additionally, in alignment with the Office of the Inspector General’s effort to eliminate conflicting employment, all Valiant employees are required to disclose any current or future outside employment engagements. During onboarding and throughout employment, employees must disclose any current activities or intent to engage in outside employment or other professional activities and obtain written approval. Employees may not solicit or conduct any outside business during core business hours for Valiant Solutions and our clients.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Valiant Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, or veteran status, in accordance with applicable law.

Physical Demands

Sitting or standing at a desk for prolonged periods of time and consistent operation of a computer. Frequent communication and exchanging of accurate information via electronic communication, phones, and in person. Occasionally lift and/or move moderate amounts of weight, typically less than 20 pounds. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the job.

Authorization to Share Resume and Personal Information

By submitting your resume for this position, you authorize Valiant Solutions to share your resume, as well as, personal information included on the resume, with its subsidiaries, affiliates and teaming partners for the purpose of considering you for this position and other available positions requiring comparable skills, education and experience. Should Valiant Solutions or its affiliates and teaming partners wish to initiate pre-employment discussions, you will be asked to complete an employment application and related employment documents.

job.description:
About Lovepop

Lovepop is on a mission to create one billion magical moments. We combine art x engineering to create the most magical paper art cards & gifts. Featured on Shark Tank in 2015, Lovepop has become one of the top 10 Shark Tank investments with over $300m in lifetime sales ($30m+ annually). Lovepop consistently ranks in the top Google results for cards online, enjoys 29% national brand awareness in the category, and has helped its customers create over 65 million magical moments (30 million+ units sold). We live by our four values: engineering, hunger, magic, and connection. The opportunity ahead of us is large, exciting, and meaningful. We seek A+ talent to help us become the #1 online card destination in the US.

About the role

Review and quality-check customer interactions handled by Lovepop’s Happiness team across the app and social media channels to ensure customers receive accurate, helpful, and consistent support that reflects the Lovepop experience.

Accountabilities

  • Review customer interactions daily across the app and social media channels, including both written conversations and recorded interactions.

  • Check if the agent:

  • Understands the customer’s problem correctly.

  • Gives the right solution.

  • Responds in a friendly, caring, and natural Lovepop style.

  • Follows Lovepop’s rules and process.

  • Points out mistakes and explains how they should be improved.

  • Find repeated problems from agents or from the current process.

  • Suggest simple ways to improve replies, FAQs, instructions, and the working process.

  • Check again after feedback to make sure the same mistakes are reduced.

  • Prepare a short weekly report with:

  • Main mistakes found.

  • Repeated customer problems.

  • Actions that should be improved.

  • Progress from previous weeks.

Qualifications

  • Excellent English proficiency, particularly in reading, listening, and written communication
  • Strong operational and execution skills - able to identify issues, follow through on actions, and make sure improvements are implemented.

  • Experience in Customer Service or Quality Checking is preferred.

  • Careful and detail-oriented.

  • Good at finding problems and understanding why they happen.

  • Comfortable giving clear and constructive feedback.

  • Strong service mindset, genuinely cares about helping customers and always thinks about what would make their experience awesome.

  • Able to look at a situation from the customer’s point of view, not only follow rules or check boxes.

What Success Looks Like

    The goal is not only to find mistakes, but to help the team make fewer repeated mistakes, give customers better support, and improve the overall Lovepop customer experience.

Lovepop Values

Engineering: Curiosity to discover how the world works
Hunger: Desire to take on more than is expected
Magic: Delivering unexpected experiences
Connection: Building relationships with each other

Lovepop Operating Philosophies

A+ talent loves working with A+ talent. A+ talent delivers 10x outcomes.
Growth mindset. We believe people develop over time, that capability increases through belief and hard work. Most increases in productivity come from leveling up and applying more leverage and focus over time rather than by applying more resources or hours.
The team I’m on is more important than the team I lead. From Patrick Lencioni’s “The Advantage”: leaders need to put their working team’s objectives ahead of the objectives of the team they themselves lead for an organization to be effective.
Executive leadership team commitments: We value our time together, Create a safe space, Get everything on the table, Make clean agreements, Set the standard.
