job.title: AI Quality Engineer
job.description:
About xCures

Lots of data, little understanding. Medical records for a single patient live scattered across dozens of providers, and critical data is buried in unstructured faxes, PDFs, and notes that no one has time to read. Access to health data is no longer the problem. Getting a clear, structured, trusted piece of information out of that mess is. That’s the problem xCures® exists to solve.

The xCures Clinical Clarity Engine turns fragmented records into validated, source-linked answers built for the next decision. Every extracted data point traces back to the exact document and page it came from. Automatically get the patient history you need, so you can make decisions based on more accurate information without digging through documents.

We work with anyone that needs information from medical data for their next decision: diagnostic labs, providers, telehealth providers, health systems, payers, consumer health platforms, and more. Wherever a decision is stuck behind 200 scattered documents no one has time to read, that’s our problem to solve. We’re a remote-first, Series B, venture-backed team that holds itself to the same standard as our product: trustworthy, precise, and purposeful. If you like solving problems that are genuinely hard and useful, you’ll feel at home here.

Here’s Where You’ll Make An Impact:

As xCures scales its clinical extractors across new clients and clinical domains, every structured output has to hold up to scientific and regulatory scrutiny. As our AI Quality Engineer, reporting to the Vice President of Scientific and Medical Affairs, you own that standard.

You run the quality control that keeps our extractors trustworthy. You lead the regulatory alignment that lets clients rely on our outputs. You translate extractor performance into clear, evidence-backed reporting that clients and internal teams act on. Working closely with Data Science, Engineering, and Clinical Informatics, you help turn messy medical text into source-linked clinical data that stands up to review.

If you want your scientific rigor to shape a platform used for real clinical decisions, this is where it lands.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Lead ongoing quality control of clinical extractor outputs, running systematic accuracy and consistency analyses across detection, data-set composition, and value extraction, and resolving discrepancies before they reach clients
  • Lead regulatory alignment for the extraction and validation program, keeping quality processes, methodology, and documentation consistent with applicable privacy, de-identification, and clinical-data standards
  • Lead client-facing performance reporting, translating validation metrics and extractor capabilities and limitations into clear, evidence-backed reports for client and internal audiences
  • Serve as an internal subject-matter expert for clinical domains, with an emphasis on oncology and real-world evidence, guiding the Data Science team on interpretation, clinical relevance, and the limits of current extraction methods
  • Partner with Data Science to prototype and refine extraction logic, inferred variables, normalization, and binning, contributing domain expertise on the nuances of medical text
  • Define and monitor clinical quality KPIs, track extractor performance drift over time, and recommend retraining or recalibration when the data warrants it
  • Work with Engineering and Clinical Informatics to ensure accurate export of structured clinical data into downstream formats such as FHIR bundles and CSV tables
  • Support data governance and dataset integrity, contributing to data-dictionary alignment, de-identification, and the quality of clinical datasets used for development and delivery
  • Serve as a clinical reviewer in internal quality reviews, client demos, and QA events, and support business development with feasibility analysis for prospective and current clients

Qualifications:

Required:

  • Strong background in computational biology, bioinformatics, or a related life sciences discipline, whether through formal education or hands-on experience
  • Strong clinical knowledge across major disease areas, including diagnostic criteria, staging or severity classifications, and standard-of-care treatment patterns
  • Demonstrated experience with electronic medical records and the current healthcare data landscape, including Health Information Exchanges (HIE) and Qualified Health Information Networks (QHIN)
  • Demonstrated experience with structured clinical data and real-world data analysis
  • Strong grasp of data quality principles, data validation processes, and the ability to assess the provenance and limitations of real-world data
  • Proficiency in Python, R, or SQL for data manipulation and analysis
  • Ability to translate complex scientific concepts into clear, actionable findings for technical and non-technical audiences
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Proven ability to manage multiple complex, unrelated projects at once, with strong organization and time management
  • Comfort working remotely with virtual collaboration tools

Bonus Points:

  • 4+ years of relevant industry experience
  • Master's degree in computational biology, bioinformatics, or a life sciences discipline
  • Experience with medical coding ontologies (SNOMED, LOINC, RxNorm, OMOP)
  • Familiarity with version control (Git/GitHub) and collaborative code workflows
  • Comfort in a command-line environment and cloud development tools (AWS, GCP, or similar)
  • Experience defining or reporting quality and performance metrics for AI or data-extraction systems
  • Familiarity with de-identification (HIPAA Safe Harbor or Expert Determination) and clinical data governance

Location

xCures operates in a distributed, remote-first environment, with occasional travel to company offsites or key meetings throughout the year. Candidates may be located anywhere in the United States. The successful candidate must already have authorization to work in the United States. At this time, xCures does not offer sponsorship. All candidate information will be held in confidence and in accordance with EEOC guidelines.

Additional Considerations

We recognize that people bring a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the requirements listed in a job description. Diversity of experience and skills, combined with a shared passion for healthcare, is what drives us to innovate. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification listed. xCures is an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

Benefits

Great work deserves great support. We believe our people are our greatest asset, and we’re committed to supporting them with a strong, competitive benefits package. Our goal is to be a place where people genuinely want to build their careers, and our benefits are designed to support our team in the ways that matter most.

  • Remote-First
  • Paid Time Off and 13 Company Holidays
  • Equity Package
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Medical, Vision, and Dental
  • Employer HSA Contribution
  • Employer 401(k) Match
  • STD, LTD, Life Insurance and Critical Illness Plans
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Adoption Assistance
  • Company Offsites
  • Monthly Internet Allowance
  • Professional Development Funds
  • And more!

Compensation

The anticipated base salary range for this role is $100,000 to $130,000.

job.title: Engineering Manager II, SDET
job.description:
About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.

About the Role:

    We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager II to lead and scale our SDET team at HighLevel.

    This is a leadership role responsible for driving our test automation strategy, quality processes, and engineering excellence across our products. You will lead a high-performing team of SDETs and play a crucial role in building a culture of quality-first, shift-left testing, and continuous improvement.

    You will be responsible for strengthening our automation frameworks, improving productivity through GenAI tools, and partnering closely with development and release teams to deliver world-class software with speed and reliability.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of SDETs focused on automation, performance, and reliability.
  • Define and execute the end-to-end test automation strategy across web, mobile, and API layers.
  • Champion Shift-Left Testing and ensure integration of automated tests into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Collaborate closely with Dev Managers and Leads to improve release quality, coverage, and speed.
  • Establish benchmarks for automation quality, performance, and code standards across teams.
  • Build and optimize frameworks in TypeScript/Playwright, enabling scalable test suites and maintainable automation infrastructure.
  • Oversee release readiness, test planning, and quality gates for major product launches.
  • Drive initiatives to improve test productivity using GenAI/AI tools, including intelligent test generation and analysis.
  • Ensure strong coverage across functional, non-functional, performance, and security testing areas.
  • Provide architectural guidance on testing strategy, tooling, and infrastructure.
  • Inspire a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and accountability within the SDET sub-department.

Requirements:

  • 9+ years of overall experience in Quality Engineering.
  • Proven experience managing and mentoring a large SDET team.
  • Strong hands-on background as a Test Automation Architect, ideally in TypeScript and Playwright.
  • Excellent understanding of test automation design patterns, CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments (AWS/GCP), and development workflows.
  • Hands-on expertise with API testing, Performance testing (e.g., JMeter, k6, Gatling), and Mobile Test Automation (Appium or equivalent).
  • Strong believer in Shift-Left Testing, enabling early quality validation in SDLC.
  • Demonstrated ability to set up scalable automation frameworks and increase automation coverage.
  • Experience building testing infrastructure and pipelines for microservices or cloud-native applications.
  • Track record of scaling teams and processes in fast-paced product organizations.
  • Passion for mentoring engineers, fostering technical growth, and promoting a culture of continuous learning.
  • Enthusiasm for leveraging GenAI and AI agents to enhance testing productivity, efficiency, and intelligence.

job.description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.

About the Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team

The Legal, Compliance, and Public Affairs team is a group of dedicated professionals committed to helping Affirm scale, innovate, and provide outstanding products for consumers, merchants, and key partners. We combine legal, compliance, and policy expertise to guide growth, shape products, and build trust across our ecosystem. Our work spans multiple professional disciplines and provides the foundation for Affirm’s mission to deliver honest financial products.

About the role

Affirm’s Compliance team implements a compliance program that enables Affirm to proactively adhere to regulatory requirements while also identifying and addressing potential regulatory issues that may arise. As a second line of defense, Compliance proactively partners with the business to support new products, markets, initiatives, change management, issue identification and remediation plans, and assessment/monitoring of third parties.

Affirm is actively seeking a Compliance Lead to support certain critical compliance management program elements. In this role, the Compliance Lead will help to administer Compliance’s Testing Program. This includes completing reviews to ensure compliance with federal/state regulations, identifying gaps and deficiencies with regulatory compliance concerns, collaborate with cross functional partners including Legal, Operations, Product, Engineering and senior management to resolve identified issues and further build out our compliance program. This role will report to the Senior Compliance Manager and will be required to work independently and cross-functionally.

What you'll do

  • Perform ongoing compliance testing and reporting on adherence to compliance program and federal/state regulatory requirements.

  • Work closely and cross-functionally with multiple departments (Compliance, Legal, Risk, Product, etc.) while completing reviews.

  • Support a very fast paced business with tight deadlines while providing diligent and detailed work product.

  • Collaborate with management to identify improvements to current processes or propose new processes to strengthen internal controls.

  • Coordinate the execution of the compliance risk assessment and control inventory, including collecting and documenting results.

  • Serve as an expert in the area of regulatory compliance and how it applies to new and/or revised products and services.

  • Continuously improve internal compliance processes relating to the Compliance Testing Program.

What we look for

  • 5+ years of professional work experience in Compliance Testing, or Audit.

  • Knowledge of applicable laws, regulations, financial services, and regulatory trends that impact Affirm’s business.

  • Experience in completing end-to-end compliance testing activities.

  • Strong communication and relationship management skills.

  • Inquisitive and proactive in proposing creative and effective solutions and ability to learn and adapt in a fast-paced environment.

  • Strong project management, critical thinking and analytical skills.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to clearly present complex and sensitive issues.

  • Proficient computer navigation skills using a variety of software packages, including Google docs, word processing, spreadsheets, and presentations.

  • Must be detail oriented, thorough, and well organized.

Base Pay Grade - J

Equity Grade - 5

Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills. Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include equity rewards, monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents.)

USA base pay range (CA, WA, NY, NJ, CT) per year: $130,000 - $180,000

USA base pay range (all other U.S. states) per year: $115,000 - $165,000

Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Remote-first with flexibility built inAffirm is proud to be a remote-first company. Most roles can be done from almost anywhere within the country of employment. Some positions may occasionally require in-person work at an Affirm office, and a few are office-based due to the nature of the work. All new hires will be invited to attend an in-person onboarding experience.

Benefits designed for youOur benefits reflect our commitment to care, transparency, and flexibility. Here are a few highlights:

  • Health coverage at no cost: We cover 100% of premiums for employees and their dependents.

We’re committed to providing an inclusive interview process, including accommodations for candidates with disabilities. If you need support, we’re happy to help.

ACU-Serve delivers billing solutions to DME, (Durable Medical Equipment) HME (Home Medical Equipment) and Home Infusion providers, giving them the freedom to grow their business while collecting more, faster. ACU-Serve has helped many businesses cut through the complexity of an ever-transitioning billing process while becoming a trusted partner for continued growth. The result is faster payments, higher revenue collection rates, and less management and staffing headaches, results matter! Unlike traditional billing service models, ACU-Serve provides our clients with a new level of control, flexibility, information access, and billing expertise. ACU-Serve functions as an integral part of the HME office staff, not a remote third party billing vendor.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Claims Analyst is responsible to perform quality reviews for both pre-pay and post-pay audits as well as Quality Assurance reviews of orders prior to delivery and/or confirmation according to established guidelines that assist management in monitoring the quality, consistency, and effectiveness of business processes, procedures and related SOP’s. Address ongoing questions, issues and escalations from both ACU-Serve employees as well as our clients and provide clear answers and easy access to training and other resources and educational material that can answer these issues. Help to develop and organize a database of information and resources to ensure ease of navigation and interpretation and maximum clarity for both ACU-Serve employees and our clients.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES:

Perform quality reviews for both Pre-Pay and Post-Pay audits as well as the client’s orders prior to and/or confirmation, according to established guidelines, that assist management in monitoring the quality, consistency and effectiveness of business processes, procedures and related tools.

Specifically:

  • Follow defined audit processes in conducting quality reviews;
  • Keep current on new coding and billing guidelines, federal and state initiatives.
  • Ensure the consistent use of current codes, correct information, documentation and departmental procedures by monitoring their use and identifying any deficiencies;
  • Prepare summaries for management of quality review results, including basic analysis of identified deficiencies.
  • Reduce quality related errors by making recommendations to increase the efficiency of operations.

Assist with policy, procedure development and implementation as it relates to the claim review processes.

Review coding variances including supporting documentation, review of old and new procedure codes, consult and collaborate Director of Compliance as necessary.

Prepare supporting documentation as necessary.

Based on audits and claims reviews, prepare supporting documentation requests for configuration changes to ensure that configuration mirrors provider contract.

Keep current on new coding and billing guidelines, federal and state initiatives. Educate other departments on new/changes to regulations as necessary.

Coordinate recoupment efforts with Director of Compliance due to billing errors and over payments.

Respond to provider inquiries regarding recoupments in writing and/or verbally when necessary.

Perform departmental quality audits.

Produce and deliver monthly a summary report of changes to the Director of Compliance; include relevant source documents.

QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:

  • Durable Medical Equipment experience is required
  • Must have knowledge of payor requirements for billing, auditing, and/or contracting with a strong background of Medicare LCD requirements; and
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; and
  • Must have knowledge of word, excel, and power point; and
  • Demonstrated ability to develop strong business partnerships and relationships with payors; and
  • Work closely with other internal customers.

PHYSICAL EFFORT:

Work time will be spent sitting approximately 90% of the time, standing and walking approximately 10% of work time. PC Keyboarding will constitute approximately 80% of work time. May require some travel.

job.title: Sr. Performance Engineer
job.description:
At Canadian Solar, our vision is to make lives better by bringing electricity powered by the sun to millions of people worldwide. As a leading manufacturer of solar panels, inverters, and energy storage solutions, we've been an industry front-runner since our founding in 2001. Our commitment to sustainability is reflected in all parts of our organization as we navigate the complexities of a booming industry.

Throughout Canadian Solar's subsidiaries, e-Storage, Recurrent Energy, MSS and CSI Solar Co., we invest in our employees' growth. Our training programs and promotional opportunities ensure we all can continue to learn. We understand the importance of work-life balance and provide various flexible work options to support our employees' well-being. Join our team to "Make the Difference" by creating a lasting positive impact on the world and the communities where we operate.

Senior Performance Controls Engineer - UK

Ready to Make a Real Impact? Join e-STORAGE!

Who We Are

Welcome to e-STORAGE, a proud member of the Canadian Solar Inc. (NASDAQ: CSIQ) family! We’re leading the way in designing, building, and integrating advanced battery energy storage systems for utility-scale projects. Our mission? To accelerate the world’s renewable energy transition and create a more sustainable, resilient energy future for everyone.

With our innovative SolBank lithium-iron phosphate battery technology and comprehensive project services, we’re not just building products we’re powering communities and making a difference worldwide.

Role Overview for Senior Performance Engineer

In this role, you’ll bring together the sharp analytical mindset of a controls engineer and the hands‑on problem‑solving instincts of a commissioning engineer to efficiently troubleshoot complex issues and pinpoint root causes on operating systems.

You’ll take ownership of diagnosing performance challenges and work closely with internal teams and external vendors to drive solutions, validating and evaluating firmware and software updates to ensure system security and reliability, minimizing downtime. Your insights will feed back to internal teams and product improvements to drive a cycle of continuous improvement.

If you thrive on tackling new challenges, enjoy rolling up your sleeves, and love the satisfaction of solving problems that matter, this role keeps you continuously engaged and at the center of meaningful, hands‑on innovation.

What You’ll Be Doing as a Senior Performance Controls Engineer

  • Prioritize, investigate, and drive the corrective action for performance issues identified during facility operation.
  • Troubleshooting and root cause analysis using data analysis, first principles, on site investigation, or other means as needed.
  • Validate software/firmware updates in coordination with vendors, the site service team, and relevant stakeholders to confirm documented changes and no unintended consequences are introduced. Coordinate subsequent rollouts with the appropriate site service teams.
  • Effectively communicate issues to the appropriate vendor and stakeholders to ensure resolutions are identified and implemented.
  • Support performance testing as required under individual contracts for each facility.
  • Contribute to fleet wide efforts for improving the efficacy of monitoring and analysis processes and tools.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to provide input to improve performance across the business from applications and design to project execution and commissioning to service.
  • Provide documentation of issues and resolutions for tracking, knowledge sharing, and internal and external communications.
  • Ensure all activities are performed in compliance with safety protocols, engineering standards, and company policies.

What You’ll Bring to the Position

  • Demonstrated experience in customer-focused problem solving
  • Ability to execute projects and tasks in parallel, self-directed, highly detail-oriented, organized and flexible
  • Experience troubleshooting using data analytics
  • Experience in commissioning, performance testing, maintenance, and/or design of BESS or other power generating facilities
  • Knowledge and experience with SCADA protocols (i.e. DNP3 and Modbus)
  • Familiarity with industrial communication networks (fiber optics, network switches, TCP/IP, etc.)
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to travel up to 20% of time. Travel may be on short notice
  • Demonstrated experience in problem solving

What It’s Like to Work Here

At e-STORAGE, you’re more than just an employee—you’re part of a team that values your ideas, your background, and your unique perspective. We believe that a culture of equity, diversity, and inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s the secret to our success. Here, you’ll find:

  • Integrity: We do what’s right, always.
  • Innovation: We encourage fresh thinking and bold ideas.
  • Quality: We take pride in delivering excellence, every time.
  • Customer Focus: We listen, we care, and we deliver.
  • Sustainability: We’re passionate about protecting our planet for future generations.

Why You’ll Love Working With Us

  • Join a global leader in renewable energy, backed by over 23 years of Canadian Solar experience.
  • Work on projects that matter—helping to build a cleaner, greener world.
  • Thrive in a supportive, collaborative environment where your growth is our priority.
  • Enjoy a competitive salary and a generous benefits package.

Want to join here is what we are looking For

  • The right mix of education, experience, and skills for the role.
  • Great communication, teamwork, and problem-solving abilities.
  • A true commitment to safety, ethics, and sustainability.

Your Rewards

We offer a competitive salary, performance bonuses, and a comprehensive benefits package—including health coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and more.

Our Commitment to Equality & Diversity

“At e-STORAGE, we know that diverse teams drive innovation and better results. We’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered—regardless of age, race, gender, ability, or background. When you join us, you’re joining a community that celebrates your uniqueness and supports your success.”

— Libby, Sr. Global HR Manager

job.title: Senior Testing Engineer
job.description:
Intro

At MO, we challenge the status quo and help government leaders shape the future. We engineer scalable, human-centered solutions that help agencies deliver their mission faster and better. Our teams blend product, design, AI, data, and modern software practices to modernize legacy systems, build new digital platforms, and deliver mission-ready products that drive sustainable change.

We live by our values—Integrity, Excellence, Courage and Curiosity. They guide how we build, collaborate, and lead. From cloud infrastructure and data engineering to AI integration and service design, we connect technology and experience to deliver outcomes that scale.

We’re building a company where technologists, designers, and builders can serve the mission, grow their craft, and help shape the future of digital government. At MO, your work doesn’t just make a difference, it advances the mission and helps build a more capable, trusted, and human government.

We believe AI is fundamentally changing how we build solutions and drive outcomes for our clients. We thoughtfully leverage AI tools to accelerate discovery, improve decision-making, reduce manual work, and produce higher-quality deliverables. We value curiosity, experimentation, and a willingness to continuously evolve how we work as AI capabilities advance.

Overview

We are looking for a Senior Testing Engineer to support MO’s federal government customers, initially within our Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) business. In this role, you will work with cross-functional teams to ensure digital products and services meet high standards for quality, accessibility, usability, and policy compliance. You will own testing and quality assurance across complex projects, proactively identify risks and opportunities for improvement, and help teams deliver better outcomes for customers and end users.

At the Senior level, you will operate with minimal guidance, bringing strong technical expertise, sound judgment, and a proactive approach to both delivery and client relationships. You will also contribute beyond your assigned work by improving team practices, participating in company and growth initiatives, and identifying opportunities to use AI and automation to improve quality, efficiency, and scalability.

If you have experience as a Senior Testing/QA Engineer, we’d love to hear from you.

This role is remote and anticipates approximately 5% travel.

What You'll Do

    Testing & Delivery

  • Own testing and quality assurance for assigned projects, developing and executing comprehensive test strategies that ensure quality, accessibility, functionality, and policy compliance

  • Design and execute functional, workflow-driven, performance, and accessibility testing across mobile products and services

  • Develop and maintain automated tests and testing workflows that improve coverage, reliability, and delivery effectiveness

  • Work with product managers, developers, designers, and stakeholders to understand requirements and acceptance criteria, identify risks, and translate them into effective testing approaches

  • Conduct testing using assistive technologies and automated tools to validate compliance with government accessibility standards

  • Verify fixes and validate functionality throughout the product lifecycle across development and production environments

  • Proactively identify quality risks, gaps, and opportunities to improve testing approaches, processes, and technical workflows

  • Integrate AI and automation into daily testing workflows to reduce manual effort, improve coverage and quality, and increase delivery effectiveness

    • Client Impact & Collaboration

  • Build strong relationships with client stakeholders and serve as a trusted advisor on quality, testing, accessibility, and risk

  • Communicate testing approaches, findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Develop a strong understanding of client needs, objectives, constraints, and priorities and align testing strategies accordingly

  • Educate customers and delivery teams on mobile quality and accessibility best practices, including assistive technologies and testing methods

  • Identify responsible AI-enabled approaches that can improve customer value, quality, or efficiency without compromising trust or rigor

  • Partner with leadership, stakeholders, and accessibility experts to strengthen accessibility practices and advocate for inclusive, high-quality experiences

    • Team & Practice Impact

  • Establish and reinforce QA best practices, including structured test planning, defect triage, documentation, accessibility compliance, and technical workflows

  • Share testing knowledge, tools, approaches, and effective AI practices with teammates to strengthen team capability and consistency

  • Identify and help address delivery or team challenges, proactively surfacing risks and contributing to constructive solutions

  • Contribute to the evolution of MO’s testing and quality practices by identifying opportunities to improve methods, tools, processes, and ways of working

  • Model supportive, inclusive, constructive, curious, and accountable behaviors across teams

    • Company & Growth Impact

  • Contribute meaningfully to company initiatives, communities of practice, and other efforts that improve how MO delivers work

  • Contribute testing and quality expertise to proposals, engagement planning, solution development, and other growth activities as appropriate

  • Identify opportunities to use testing expertise, AI, automation, or emerging technologies to create scalable capabilities, improve efficiency, or strengthen MO’s offerings

  • Share insights from client work and the broader industry to help MO identify new opportunities, improve our approaches, and strengthen our value proposition

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in software testing or quality assurance, with significant experience testing mobile applications

  • Experience working with the federal government, with prior VA experience preferred

  • Proven delivery: track record of independently owning testing and quality assurance for complex projects and delivering high-quality results with minimal guidance

  • Technical expertise: strong understanding of software testing methodologies, automated testing, mobile application development, and iterative delivery practices

  • Mobile testing: experience with cross-platform and cross-browser testing across iOS and Android

  • Accessibility expertise: strong understanding of mobile accessibility standards, guidelines, and testing approaches, including use of assistive technologies such as screen readers, keyboard navigation, and speech recognition

  • Systems thinking: experience testing complex, rules-heavy systems while considering technical implementation, accessibility, compliance, business processes, and operational realities

  • Client leadership: ability to build trust with clients, communicate technical information clearly, understand stakeholder needs, and provide thoughtful recommendations

  • Problem-solving: ability to navigate ambiguity, identify risks proactively, make sound decisions, and adapt testing approaches as requirements and priorities evolve

  • Consulting mindset: ability to work collaboratively with clients and cross-functional teams while maintaining ownership of quality and testing outcomes

  • AI & automation: demonstrated ability to use AI and automation to improve testing workflows, reduce manual effort, increase quality, or improve delivery effectiveness

  • Commitment to excellence: consistently high standards for quality, accessibility, documentation, and follow-through

  • Growth mindset: willingness to contribute beyond assigned project work through company initiatives, knowledge sharing, practice development, and growth activities

    • Nice to Have

  • Experience testing complex applications in regulated or highly controlled environments

  • Experience with React Native

  • Experience developing automated mobile testing frameworks or CI/CD testing workflows

  • Experience contributing to accessibility strategy or remediation

  • Experience using AI-enabled testing tools or developing AI-assisted testing approaches

Perks

  • Competitive compensation commensurate with experience

  • Meaningful opportunities for career growth and learning

  • Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, and vision)

  • 401(k) with company match

  • Unlimited Paid Time Off (PTO)

  • Company-sponsored short- and long-term disability, plus life insurance

  • Company-sponsored parental leave

We build with purpose, deliver with precision, and measure success by the impact we create — for our clients, our teams, and the mission. All MO leaders are expected to lead with humility, embody our core values in their leadership, and to hold their team accountable to the same. MO leaders are expected to ensure we are always growing by tackling hard problems, being strategic, and learning from others.

If you’re excited to work with us but not sure you check every box, apply anyway! You may be just right for this role or another one.

MO is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. job.title: Lead SDET
job.description:
Sprinto is an Autonomous Trust Platform that centralizes trust requirements across security frameworks, vendors, and customers.

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve raised$31.8M in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over 4,000 organizations across 75 countries, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With 300+ native integrations and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports 200+ global security standards natively, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

Founded in 2020 by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

Life as a Sprinter -

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

The mission -

Where you'll leave your mark?

  • Own quality outcomes, not activities — the question is never "how many test cases did you write this sprint," it's "what quality metric moved and what did you build to move it."
  • Drive CI pass rate to 90%+ and keep it there — the percentage of pipeline runs that pass without manual intervention.
  • Own bug leakage rate — target under 2–3% of bugs escaping QA to staging or production, with a root cause analysis you own for every bug that gets through.
  • Build the system that keeps flaky tests out of the suite — preventing flakiness from entering and quarantining it when it does.
  • Shape automation coverage at the right layer — E2E where it matters, API where it's faster and more reliable, unit where developers should own it — not just chasing a coverage percentage.
  • Stay 50–60% hands-on — writing Playwright TypeScript to evolve the framework, building diagnostic tools that analyse test-run data for flakiness patterns, and reviewing PRs to catch structural problems in AI-generated test code.
  • Build AI-native quality infrastructure — systems that use LLMs, agents, and AI tooling to solve quality problems at scale, like pipelines that auto-analyse every PR for risk across security, product, and UX dimensions.
  • Deliver engineering-wide quality impact — at least one initiative per quarter that changes how developers or PMs ship, not just how QA tests. Our current guardrail system prevents 90 bugs per month without manual QA; that's the bar.
  • Partner and present — sit with product engineers to define quality gates before features ship, and present quality metrics (CI pass rate, bug leakage, flaky test trends) to engineering leadership.

The kind of builder we're looking for -

  • An engineer who has chosen quality as their specialisation — this is not a pure coding role and not a management role; it lives exactly in between (~40–50% strategy, cross-functional collaboration, and mentoring).
  • Engineering-wide in scope, not QA-internal — you want to improve how the entire engineering organisation thinks about quality, not just how the QA team works.
  • AI-native, not AI-assisted — you don't just use Copilot for test authoring; you build quality systems on LLMs and agents, and you can test AI features themselves — validating agent behaviour, checking LLM output quality, and handling non-deterministic systems.
  • A test pyramid thinker, not just an E2E automator — with developers now writing feature automation themselves, you push testing responsibility to the developer layer while QA owns integration, workflow, and AI feature quality. A candidate who only thinks Playwright and E2E is too narrow.
  • Fluent in the modern stack — Playwright, TypeScript, CI pipelines, and the data behind them.
  • Comfortable influencing without authority — defining quality gates with product engineers and changing developer behaviour through systems, not mandates.

How we care for our Sprinters?

  • Work wherever you are: We are 100% remote, so you get to choose if you want to work from home, a cafe, the hills, or the beach.
  • Co-working, on the house: If co-working is your jam, we offer a generous annual allowance.
  • We care about your learning: We are invested in seeing you grow and commit USD 1,000 annually to help you level up your skills.
  • We count your spark, not your leaves: Unlimited leave so you can reset when you need to.
  • Your Safety Net, Woven In: Health insurance with coverage up to INR 10 lakh for you and your family, accident protection of an additional INR 10 lakh, and life insurance worth 3x your annual salary.
  • Workspace setup of your dreams: We chip in INR 35,000 to help you build a setup that works for you.


Inclusion & Diversity -

At Sprinto, talent, curiosity, and ownership matter more than where you come from. We hire people for the problems they can solve, the impact they create, and the way they help others succeed—not their background, identity, or personal circumstances. We believe the best teams are built when people with different perspectives come together around a shared ambition to build something meaningful.

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating a fair, inclusive, and accessible hiring process for everyone.

These values help us recruit the right talent to join our rapidly expanding team of around the globe. It is important to us that each and every Spherion is not only eager to challenge themselves and knows how to get work done but is an awesome addition to our company culture.

Sphera is seeking a QA Manager to lead quality assurance across multiple product lines and concurrent projects. This role owns QA execution and team leadership, ensuring high-quality releases while driving consistent testing practices and continuous improvement across squads.

This is a hands-on management role: you'll lead a team of QA engineers, coordinate closely with Engineering Managers, Product Owners, and cross-functional stakeholders, and be accountable for the quality outcomes of your product lines' releases.

Key Responsibilities:

Team Leadership

  • Manage and mentor a team of QA engineers across multiple product lines, providing coaching, performance feedback, and career development
  • Allocate QA resources across concurrent projects and sprints based on release priorities and risk
  • Foster a culture of quality ownership and continuous improvement within the team

Quality Strategy & Execution

  • Own the QA strategy and test planning across your assigned product lines, including functional, regression, and release testing
  • Define and maintain risk-based test coverage that balances thoroughness with delivery speed
  • Ensure test automation is appropriately invested in and maintained, avoiding over-reliance on UI/E2E tests where lower-level coverage is more effective
  • Drive clarity on QA vs. Engineering ownership boundaries within squads

Automation & AI-Driven Quality Transformation

  • Lead the transition from manual to automated testing across your teams, building automation into sprint delivery rather than treating it as a post-sprint add-on
  • Assess, prioritize, and manage automation investment across squads with differing tech stacks and maturity levels
  • Build and grow team capability in automation practices through coaching, upskilling, and hands-on guidance
  • Champion the organization's move toward an AI-driven development lifecycle (AI DLC), identifying where AI-assisted testing, test generation, and quality tooling can accelerate coverage and reduce manual effort
  • Partner with QA leadership to pilot and scale AI-assisted QA practices within your product lines, balancing innovation with reliability and maintainability

Release & Process Management

  • Manage QA activities across the full release lifecycle for your product lines, including regression cycles and release sign-off
  • Partner with Engineering Managers to ensure developer involvement in testing activities, particularly during regression windows
  • Identify and address structural gaps in QA process (e.g., automation tasks planned as sprint deliverables, not post-sprint additions)
  • Support incident and defect triage, ensuring timely resolution and root-cause follow-up

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Act as the primary QA point of contact for your product lines, working closely with Product Owners, Engineering Managers, and other stakeholders
  • Communicate quality status, risks, and release readiness clearly to stakeholders at varying levels of technical depth
  • Collaborate with QA leadership on company-wide initiatives (e.g., automation standards, shift-left practices) and ensure consistent adoption across your product lines

Reporting & Metrics

  • Track and report on quality metrics (defect trends, test coverage, regression outcomes) for your product lines
  • Escalate risks and blockers proactively, with clear, non-blaming, solution-oriented communication

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years of experience in software QA, including 2+ years in a QA leadership or team management role
  • Experience managing QA across multiple products or projects simultaneously
  • Demonstrated experience leading a team's transition from manual to automated testing, including planning, tooling decisions, and change management
  • Strong understanding of test automation principles and the test pyramid; ability to guide teams away from over-indexing on UI/E2E automation
  • Working knowledge of or genuine interest in AI-assisted development and testing practices, with an eye toward adopting AI DLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) approaches
  • Experience working with heterogeneous or legacy tech stacks (a plus, given Sphera's mix of acquired-company platforms)
  • Familiarity with risk-based testing and regression planning for enterprise SaaS products
  • Excellent stakeholder communication skills — comfortable presenting quality status to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Experience with Azure DevOps or similar test/work management tooling
  • Domain familiarity with risk management or compliance software is a plus, but not required

What Sets This Role Apart

  • Direct ownership of quality outcomes across multiple active, evolving product lines
  • Close collaboration with senior QA leadership driving a broader shift-left quality transformation across Sphera
  • Opportunity to shape team structure, automation direction, and testing practices for growing squads

job.title: Systems Engineer - Armament Control System Testing
job.description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams, and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

You will own the verification and validation of our Armament Control System (ACS), the safety-critical system that governs how weapons are commanded and released. Working alongside systems, software and hardware engineers, you will shape the testing roadmap, build the software- and hardware-in-the-loop environments the programme depends on, and qualify the ACS against its requirements. You will decide what good evidence looks like, how it is gathered, and when the system is ready. Your test rigs and automated test suites will become shared infrastructure for the wider team, shortening the loop between design change and proven behaviour, and giving our partners confidence that the system performs safely every time.

The day-to-day

  • Develop and maintain the ACS testing roadmap across the full development cycle, so that verification keeps pace with design maturity and programme milestones.

  • Specify, design and commission ACS test rigs, working with internal teams and external suppliers on mechanics, electronics, harnesses, interfaces and data acquisition.

  • Write test plans and test procedures that trace every system requirement to verifiable evidence.

  • Run SIL and HIL test campaigns, investigate anomalies, produce test reports and feed findings back into design so that defects are resolved before integration.

  • Automate regression and qualification testing with MATLAB/Simulink and real-time targets such as Speedgoat, measurably reducing manual test effort and cycle time.

You should apply if you

  • Have qualified complex, safety-critical systems in aerospace, defence, automotive or a comparable domain.

  • Have built and operated software-in-the-loop and hardware-in-the-loop test environments, from architecture through to commissioning.

  • Model and automate testing in MATLAB/Simulink and have worked with real-time test hardware such as Speedgoat.

  • Translate system requirements into structured test plans and procedures, and document results clearly enough for qualification and customer review.

  • Communicate technical reasoning clearly in written and spoken in English and German, to customers as well as engineering colleagues.

  • Hold, or are willing and able to obtain, an extended German security clearance (erweiterte Sicherheitsüberprüfung, Ü2 or Ü3).

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to have

  • Apply industry qualification standards such as DO-160, ARP-4754, DO-178C or DO-254 in your testing work.

  • Ensured regulatory compliance with CS-23, CS-25, or STANAG-4671 standards for high-criticality aerospace systems.

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and VSOP options

  • Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

  • Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

  • Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

  • Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances

  • Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

  • Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

 

These are the core benefits across all locations; there may be additional benefits in specific sites.

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

job.title: Systems Engineer - Low Observability Testing
job.description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards.

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously.

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications.

The role

You will own how we prove that our aircraft are hard to detect. While design teams shape geometry and materials, you will show whether those choices hold up under measurement. You will set the low observability (LO) testing roadmap, specify and build our own radar cross-section (RCS) and infrared (IR) test facilities, and define the procedures by which signature performance is verified. You will also scope and supervise the work of external measurement laboratories, then scrutinise the data they return. Your standards will become the reference point for every LO measurement we make, and your evidence will inform design decisions on a flagship aircraft programme.

The day-to-day

  • Build and maintain the multi-year LO testing roadmap, so that measurement capability is in place before each programme milestone requires it

  • Specify, design and commission in-house LO test facilities, such as anechoic chambers, compact or far-field ranges, pylon systems and radar hardware, including calibration regimes that hold measurement uncertainty within agreed limits

  • Write master verification and validation test plans for RCS and IR signature measurement at component, subsystem and full-aircraft level

  • Produce detailed test procedures that deliver consistent, repeatable results across campaigns, sites and suppliers

  • Define statements of work for subcontracted testing, guide those suppliers technically, and accept or reject delivered measurement data on evidence

You should apply if you

  • Have planned and run RCS measurement campaigns, and can trace a signature result back to the physics and the test set-up that produced it

  • Have specified, built or operated antenna or RCS test facilities, including near-field, far-field or compact ranges

  • Work fluently with high-frequency measurement equipment such as vector network analysers, signal generators and spectrum analysers

  • Apply systems engineering practice to verification and validation, from requirements through test plans to signed-off test reports

job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer - India Remote
job.description:
ABOUT QUANTUMLOOPAI

QuantumLoopAI is one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies. Our AI-powered platform, EMMA, is used by hundreds of organisations across the UK to manage communications, automate workflows and deliver better outcomes through intelligent automation. Backed by leading investors and scaling rapidly ahead of our Series A, we are building the infrastructure that will define the next generation of AI-driven service delivery.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Our platform handles real, live conversations — and because those conversations matter, quality is critical. Small errors have real consequences. We are looking for a QA Automation Engineer to own and grow the automated testing that keeps our voice AI platform reliable.

You will build and maintain automated test coverage across backend and frontend, create automation that places and validates real test calls end to end, and measure the accuracy of the speech-to-text (STT) and text-to-speech (TTS) layers that make the platform work. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where your testing directly protects real users.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Backend and Frontend Test Automation

  • Build and maintain automated test coverage across backend services and the frontend, ensuring new features ship without breaking existing behaviour.
  • Integrate tests into CI pipelines so quality checks run automatically on every change.
  • Work with engineers to turn real-world failures into permanent regression tests.

Voice Pipeline and Call Automation

  • Build and run outbound-call automation that places test calls through the live voice pipeline, simulates realistic caller scenarios, and validates the platform's behaviour from start to finish.
  • Test the speech-to-text (STT) layer — measuring transcription accuracy and how reliably the platform understands callers.
  • Test the text-to-speech (TTS) layer — validating pronunciation, naturalness, and that the voice output behaves correctly.
  • Run regression testing across multiple conversation flows and catch behavioural drift after changes.

Quality Evaluation and Defect Management

  • Evaluate calls against conversational quality dimensions — accuracy, tone, flow adherence, understanding, hand-off between stages, summaries, outcome handling, call control, and avoiding unnecessary repetition.
  • Reproduce, document, and track defects through to resolution, writing clear reproduction steps from real call examples.
  • Work with engineers, prompt authors, and the operations team to identify quality issues and build permanent test coverage around them.

Requirements

ESSENTIAL

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in QA automation or software testing with a strong automation focus.
  • Strong hands-on Python — you write, debug and maintain test scripts daily, not occasionally.
  • Experience writing and maintaining automated test suites across both API and UI layers.
  • Comfortable testing REST APIs and working with structured data (JSON).
  • Experience with automated web and UI testing frameworks.
  • Familiarity with version-control workflows (Git) and continuous-integration pipelines — you have integrated automated tests into CI/CD.
  • Solid grasp of QA methodology — test design, regression strategy, and the defect lifecycle.
  • Excellent attention to detail and clear written communication.
  • Comfortable working remotely and aligning to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).

DESIRABLE

  • Exposure to voice or conversational AI testing — metrics such as transcription accuracy (WER), naturalness scoring, or response latency.
  • Experience with automated or AI-assisted response evaluation.
  • Telephony or real-time audio and voice testing experience.
  • Experience working with data to gather and verify test evidence programmatically.
  • Experience in regulated software environments where quality assurance and compliance processes are important.
  • Experience working with distributed or remote teams across multiple time zones.

LOGISTICS

  1. Education: We value skills and experience over formal qualifications.
  2. Working arrangements: Fully remote from India, aligned to UK business hours (9:00 AM to 6:00 PM GMT/BST).
  3. Start date: Flexible.

Benefits

WHAT WE OFFER

  • Competitive package depending on experience
  • Potential share options
  • Professional development including conference attendance and CPD support
  • The opportunity to own test automation for a live voice AI platform at one of the UK's fastest-growing healthtech companies
  • Remote working with a collaborative, high-ownership engineering culture
  • Direct collaboration with engineering, AI/ML and product teams

HOW WE ARE DIFFERENT

At QuantumLoopAI, you will join a team that is building AI-powered products used by hundreds of organisations across the UK. We move fast, take ownership, and celebrate wins together. Our culture values:

  • Impact over optics. We measure success by real outcomes, not busy work
  • Transparency. Open communication, honest feedback, shared context
  • Ownership. You will have real autonomy to shape your work and our platform
  • Learning. We are building something new, and we learn from every experiment

This is a QA role where your work has direct, visible impact. Every test you build protects real users in real conversations. You will not be writing test scripts in isolation — you will be listening to real calls, diagnosing real failures, and building the automation that prevents them from happening again.

DIVERSITY AND INCLUSION

We believe diverse teams build better products. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can do their best work. If you are excited about this role but do not meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you.

RECRUITMENT SAFETY NOTICE

QuantumLoopAI will never ask candidates for payment or sensitive financial information during the recruitment process. All official communications come from @quantumloopai.com email addresses.

COME WORK WITH US

Ready to own quality for a live voice AI platform? We would love to hear from you. Questions about this role? Contact

job.title: Experimental Fluid Mechanics: Two-Phase Flow & Nozzle Testing (Contract)
job.description:
Overview

Roadrunner Venture Studios is seeking a contract Subject Matter Expert (SME) to develop and execute an experimental test program for a proprietary nozzle for the generation of two-phase flow targeting intermediate-temperature energy systems. The primary objective is to establish a reliable, repeatable methodology for thrust measurement, characterize the two-phase flow exiting the nozzle, and reduce system variables so testing is focused on nozzle performance.

Scope of Work

The contractor will:

  • Develop and execute a test plan for a two-phase nozzle operating with geothermal working fluids and experimental refrigerants.

  • Design and validate a reliable thrust measurement system.

  • Characterize the spray leaving the nozzle, including gas-to-liquid ratio, droplet concentration, droplet distribution, and mixed-phase flow behavior.

  • Measure and analyze flow characteristics, pressure, temperature, and other critical performance parameters.

  • Reduce experimental variables to isolate nozzle performance and improve test repeatability.

  • Recommend and implement instrumentation and test fixtures required to produce high-confidence data.

  • Analyze results and provide recommendations to improve nozzle performance and overall test methodology.

Preferred Qualifications

  • M.S. or Ph.D. in Mechanical Engineering or related field preferred.

  • Hands-on experience with two-phase flow, organic rankine cycle systems, refrigerant testing, or nozzle/thrust measurement.

  • Strong experimental background with fluid systems, instrumentation, and test development.

  • Experience with compressor and refrigerant line design, HVAC or process engineering, or propulsion testing is highly desirable.

  • Ability to travel to Albuquerque, New Mexico, to support testing.

The Quality Assurance Analyst will develop test plans, test cases, scripts, and traceability artifacts to validate grants lifecycle workflows, integrations, data migrations, security controls, and accessibility requirements. This role will perform functional, regression, integration, and release testing; document and manage defects through resolution; support automated testing; and coordinate user acceptance testing with business analysts, developers, product owners, and government stakeholders. The Quality Assurance Analyst will help confirm that each release meets acceptance criteria and is ready for secure, reliable production deployment.

*If you accept this position, you should note that ICF does monitor employee work locations blocks access from foreign locations/foreign IP addresses and prohibits personal VPN connections. 


What You Will Do:

  • Develop, document, and execute comprehensive test plans, test cases, and test scripts to validate Salesforce application functionality, workflows, configuration changes, integrations, reports, dashboards, and user experience.
  • Perform functional, integration, regression, smoke, accessibility, and release validation testing across Salesforce environments, including Integration, Stage, and Production readiness activities.
  • Support testing for major releases, minor releases, hotfixes, modernization activities, and platform-wide Salesforce changes.

  • Support user acceptance testing by preparing test scenarios, coordinating with business users, documenting outcomes, and validating that delivered functionality meets stakeholder needs.

job.title: Manager, FCC Monitoring & Testing, ANZ
job.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.

We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.

We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.

 

About the Team

The Financial Crime Compliance (FCC) team at Airwallex is a strategically vital function operating under a clear Three Lines of Defence model. As the independent second line, FCC owns the global AML/CTF programme, sanctions framework, risk assessment methodology, and governance infrastructure across all global entities. As Airwallex scales into new markets and deepens its engagement with global regulatory bodies, we are building a world-class compliance organization capable of managing complex financial crime risks at scale. This is an environment where you will tackle high-impact challenges, shape global fintech risk strategies, and help establish foundations for long-term growth.

What you'll do

As Manager, FCC Monitoring & Testing, ANZ you will shape and scale Airwallex’s global financial crime compliance monitoring and testing framework, establishing a rigorous, data-driven second-line assurance function. You will independently validate the design and operating effectiveness of AML, Sanctions, and KYC/KYB controls across all production environments and establish a monitoring framework and associated metrics to support executive decisioning and ongoing maintenance of program and control operating effectiveness. You will work closely with the broader FCC organization, Product, Engineering, Operations, and regional leadership to turn testing insights into operational accountability, robust remediation, and a defensible compliance posture before global regulators and institutional banking partners.

This role covers ANZ and is based in Australia. In this role, you will be a key part of a global team, collaborating closely across regions to drive consistent FCC Monitoring & Testing standards.

Responsibilities:

  • Contribute to the strategic development, execution, and continuous evolution of Airwallex’s Global FCC Monitoring & Testing Programme, establishing robust, risk-based testing methodologies and annual plans for independent second-line assurance.

  • Design comprehensive testing frameworks to validate core compliance controls across customer onboarding, periodic reviews, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and regulatory reporting workflows, ensuring coverage keeps pace with product and market expansion.

  • Oversee the ongoing FCC monitoring program for ANZ, including establishment of KPIs and operating effectiveness metrics.

  • Advance the transition from traditional sample reviews toward continuous, data-enabled assurance by leveraging data analytics, system logs, and automated testing scripts to evaluate compliance control performance at the population level.

  • Oversee the independent validation of system-encoded controls, including transaction monitoring thresholds, screening logic, and customer risk-rating models, ensuring systems function as intended without logic drift or hidden control gaps.

  • Translate complex testing outcomes and thematic trends into clear, decision-useful reporting for executive leadership and governance forums, providing constructive challenge to stakeholders and tracking the root-cause remediation of control deficiencies.

  • Represent the FCC monitoring and testing function during regulatory examinations, internal or external audits, and banking partner reviews, confidently defending testing methodologies and control evidence.

Who you are

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Law, Information Systems, Business Administration, or a related quantitative/analytical discipline.

  • CAMS certification or an ICA International Diploma in Governance, Risk, and Compliance (or equivalent professional credential).

  • 6+ years of experience within FCC quality assurance, compliance monitoring, internal audit, or a related second/third-line control function inside a fintech, payments, or highly regulated banking environment.

  • Strong technical knowledge of financial crime controls across transaction monitoring, sanctions/PEP screening, customer due diligence, and digital KYC/KYB workflows.

  • Proven mastery of risk-based testing methodologies, including scoping, sampling, design and operating effectiveness assessments, issue writing, and remediation validation.

  • A high-ownership, pragmatic approach, with excellent written communication and stakeholder management skills to challenge senior partners constructively and drive operational accountability.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Advanced degree such as an MBA, Master’s in Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management, or a related field.

  • Professional assurance or audit certifications such as CAMS-Audit, CISA, or CIA.

  • Strong fintech and platforms experience, including exposure to cloud-native, API-driven, high-growth global environments with significant cross-border transaction volume.

  • Strong data literacy, including comfort using SQL, Python, BI dashboards, or automated tools to support continuous control validation and population-based testing.

  • Experience partnering directly with Product, Data Science, and Engineering teams to validate automated rules, model-driven controls, and rapid deployments within an agile product lifecycle.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.
