job.title: Test Engineer - Environment
job.description:
Who we are

Helsing is a defence AI company. Our mission is to protect our democracies. We aim to achieve technological leadership, so that open societies can continue to make sovereign decisions and control their ethical standards. 

As democracies, we believe we have a special responsibility to be thoughtful about the development and deployment of powerful technologies like AI. We take this responsibility seriously. 

We are an ambitious and committed team of engineers, AI specialists and customer-facing programme managers. We are looking for mission-driven people to join our European teams – and apply their skills to solve the most complex and impactful problems. We embrace an open and transparent culture that welcomes healthy debates on the use of technology in defence, its benefits, and its ethical implications. 

The role

As an Environment Test Engineer, you will be responsible for the design, execution, and analysis of environmental stress test campaigns across the full range of drone sub-systems and Ground Support Equipment (GSE). As a generalist within the Environmental Cluster, you will apply your knowledge to mechanical, thermal, and environmental qualification—across multiple hardware domains. The Environmental Cluster is the "Physical Reality" team within the Test Department. Where other clusters validate functionality, the Environmental Cluster validates survivability and performance under real-world stress.

The cluster is organized around domain specialists—Launch Systems, Ground Communication Systems—but requires a generalist backbone to ensure test coverage continuity across all sub-systems, absorb campaign overflows from specialist engineers, and extend the cluster's capability into emerging and sensitive hardware domains.

The day-to-day

  • Vibration & Shock Campaigns: Designing and executing vibration test campaigns (sine sweep, random vibration, shock) on drone sub-systems and GSE hardware to simulate transport, operational, and launch-induced dynamic environments.
  • Thermal Soak & Cycling: Executing controlled thermal exposure tests across the full operational temperature range on any sub-system assigned by the Head of Testing or cluster lead.
  • IP & Ingress Testing: Executing dust and water ingress tests on drone enclosures, connectors, and GSE hardware to validate field survivability.
  • Humidity, Salt Spray & Corrosion: Running humidity-controlled and salt-spray campaigns to identify corrosion risks in connectors, structural joints, and electronic housings.
  • Altitude Simulation: Validating component behaviour under simulated low-pressure conditions relevant to the operational altitude range of the drone.
  • Fatigue & Endurance: Running high-cycle mechanical campaigns to characterize material and joint fatigue over the required operational life of any assigned sub-system.
  • Failure Mode Boundary Testing: Deliberately pushing hardware beyond its design limits to physically map the failure envelope and validate safety margins across all assigned sub-systems.

You should apply if you

  • Environmental Standards Literacy: Working knowledge of applicable standards as the primary frameworks for environmental test campaign design and execution.
  • Instrumentation & DAQ: Expert in physical instrumentation—strain gauges, accelerometers, thermocouples, pressure transducers, and load cells. Ability to configure and operate DAQ systems across a wide range of test scenarios.
  • Mechanical Systems Understanding: Solid understanding of structural mechanics, material fatigue, vibration dynamics, and shock response for both metallic and composite structures.
  • Thermal Testing: Experience with thermal chambers, thermal cycling rigs, IR cameras, and thermocouple mapping.
  • Environmental Test Equipment Operation: Hands-on experience operating vibration tables, shock rigs, thermal chambers, IP spray equipment, and salt-spray cabinets.
  • Metrology: Proficient with precision measurement tools (load frames, calipers, torque meters, dimensional gauges) for pre- and post-test validation.
  • Basic Familiarity with Weapons Hardware Constraints: Understanding of the physical and regulatory constraints that govern the environmental testing of defense-related hardware. Specifically:
  • Awareness of ITAR/EAR export control obligations when handling test data and reports related to lethality hardware.

Note: We operate in an industry where women, as well as other minority groups, are systematically under-represented. We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarised in a few bullet points.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor's degree (B.Sc. or B.Eng.) in a relevant engineering discipline.
  • Direct experience with environmental chamber operation, vibration testing, and physical instrumentation is mandatory.
  • Prior exposure to defense, dual-use, or regulated hardware in a test context is strongly preferred.
  • Experience in an aerospace or defense environment operating under ITAR/EAR or equivalent national defense export control frameworks is an advantage.

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 

  • Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defence industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practise responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

  • Competitive salary and VSOP options

  • Relocation support: up to €2,500 and 4 weeks temporary accommodation

  • Learning: €500/£450 yearly allowance

  • Health & wellness: gym membership and mental health support (Nilo.health)

  • Social: regular company events and monthly social allowances

  • Enhanced parental leave: 22 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers & 6 weeks for secondary caregivers

  • Family support: 5 days of paid family emergency leave, 100% remote work option during pregnancy and phased return to work

  • A hands-on onboarding program (affectionately labelled “Infraduction”), in which you will be building tooling and applications to be used across the company. This is your opportunity to learn our tech stack, explore the company, and learn how we get things done - all whilst working with other engineering teams from day one 

 

Helsing is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, religion, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability or gender identity. Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

job.title: Research Engineer / Performance Engineer, RL Distributed Systems
job.location: San Francisco, CA | New York City, NY | Seattle, WA
job.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

Reinforcement learning is how Claude learns to reason, write code, and act autonomously over long horizons. At frontier scale, an RL run is an unusually demanding distributed system. Training, sampling, and environment execution run concurrently across a large fleet of accelerators and hosts, exchange data continuously, and have to keep making progress while hardware fails, load shifts, and the research changes underneath them. How well that system holds together determines how much of our compute turns into learning, and how quickly the team can try the next idea.

As a Research Engineer on the Distributed Systems team within RL Engineering, you'll work on whatever part of that system is the current limit. That might be scheduling and placement, data movement between components, running large numbers of sandboxed environments, storage and checkpointing, networking, fault tolerance, autoscaling, or the observability that tells us what a run is actually doing. We're looking for generalists: engineers who can move between these layers, reason from first principles about a system they haven't seen before, and pick the problem that matters most rather than the one closest to their prior experience.

Our system changes as fast as the research does, correctness under failure matters as much as throughput, and the best solutions often come from understanding the ML workload well enough to know which guarantees it actually needs. Strong candidates have built and run large distributed systems, care about getting the details right, and want to apply that experience to a workload that is very large, very heterogeneous, and changing quickly.

Key responsibilities

  • Design, build, and operate the distributed systems that run RL at scale, across training, sampling, and environment execution
  • Find and remove whatever currently limits the system, whether it's scheduling, data movement, storage, networking, or coordination
  • Build fault tolerance into every layer: failure detection, isolation, and recovery that keep long-running jobs making progress without human intervention
  • Design resource management and autoscaling so that compute follows demand as a run's needs shift
  • Build observability that makes it possible to understand what a run is doing and why it slowed down, stalled, or produced unexpected results
  • Build automation that detects and remediates common problems, and design interfaces that let engineers and automated tools operate runs safely
  • Work with researchers and performance engineers to make sure systems changes preserve training correctness and don't introduce subtle nondeterminism
  • Remove classes of failure at their source through incident review, testing, and redesign, and write clear design documents for what you build

Minimum qualifications

  • Strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one systems language such as Rust, C++, or Go
  • Experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems in production
  • Deep understanding of distributed systems fundamentals, including consistency, coordination, consensus, failure modes, and recovery
  • Ability to reason quantitatively about throughput, latency, and resource costs across compute, memory, storage, and network
  • Experience debugging complex failures across many hosts and services, including failures you can't reproduce locally
  • Strong written communication, including design documents and incident writeups

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience running ML training or inference infrastructure at scale
  • Experience across several layers of the stack, such as scheduling, storage, networking, and orchestration
  • Experience building schedulers, autoscalers, or resource management systems
  • Experience with container orchestration such as Kubernetes, and with sandboxed or virtualized code execution at scale
  • Experience with high-performance networking, RDMA, or collective communication libraries
  • Experience building observability or automated remediation for large fleets
  • Experience with async Python frameworks such as Trio or asyncio
  • Familiarity with reinforcement learning or large language model training workloads

Representative projects

  • Design a scheduler that places training, sampling, and environment work across a heterogeneous cluster while respecting network topology and failure domains
  • Build a failure detection and recovery system that lets a long-running job survive host and network failures with minimal lost work
  • Scale environment execution substantially without increasing tail latency for the training step
  • Design an autoscaling policy that rebalances compute across components as a run's bottleneck shifts
  • Build a diagnostics system that explains why a run's throughput dropped and proposes a fix
  • Trace a rare data corruption bug across many services to a race condition in a recovery path, and redesign the path so the class of bug can't recur
  • Design the operational interface for a run so that automated tools can safely diagnose and adjust it under human oversight

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. 

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary:
$500,000—$850,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.  Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

job.title: Principal System and Solution Test Engineer
job.description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal System and Solution Test Engineer to join our team. This is a hybrid role based in Santa Clara,CA, reporting to the Architect, Software Development Engineering in the Zero Trust Branch department. You will drive the quality strategy for our Zero Trust Networking Services, validating complex network security architectures and end-to-end interactions between branch networking devices and global SASE cloud services through customer-centric scenarios.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and maintain cloud-based software solutions
  • Leverage your deep expertise in L2-L7 technology to test cloud-delivered security and SD-WAN technologies
  • Build repeatable, robust system-level automation suites to validate L2-L7 technologies
  • Provide critical insights and recommendations to the development team to enhance RASS, debugging capabilities, and overall product usability
  • Design and execute scenarios mimicking real-world production environments to proactively expose critical gaps, ensuring the stability required for seamless customer deployments

Who You Are (Success Profile)

  • You thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment, viewing ambiguity as a canvas for innovation and high-impact problem solving.
  • You operate with a deep sense of ownership and personal integrity, driven by a genuine passion for the engineering mission.
  • You are energized by complex technical puzzles, proactively seeking out challenging scenarios to deliver robust, scalable outcomes.
  • You build strong empathy for the end-user, placing customer needs at the center of your architecture and design validation strategy.
  • You maintain a high sense of urgency and relentless focus on execution, balancing speed and quality to win for the team and our customers.

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

  • Foundational understanding of AI/ML technologies and experience leveraging, securing, or positioning AI-driven solutions to optimize outcomes within your functional domain
  • 12+ years of overall experience in Network Security, SD-WAN, or Networking Infrastructure testing with strong proficiency in Python for tool development
  • Proven expertise in building and maintaining Test Automation Frameworks from the ground up, utilizing Terraform or CloudFormation for complex cloud test environments
  • Deep understanding of L2-L7 networking, TCP/IP stack internals, and performance testing methodologies using industry-standard traffic generators
  • Strong exposure to SD-WAN technologies, VPNs, and Cloud Security architectures combined with advanced knowledge of Linux networking concepts
  • Solid understanding of modern tunneling methods like IPSEC or GRE and hands-on experience with Public Cloud networking in AWS or GCP

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

  • Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency
  • Demonstrated ability to translate a holistic view of the product into complex test scenarios that accurately simulate real-world deployment environments
  • Experience with industry-standard traffic generation tools and methodologies

job.title: Senior Quality Engineer
job.description:
Who we are

Helsing develops artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities to protect and defend democracies. We are growing our US operations, cultivating an ambitious and committed team of mission-driven professionals to apply their skills to solve challenging problems. 

The role

We are seeking an experienced Senior Quality Engineer to help stand up our brand-new manufacturing facility in Martinsburg, West Virginia, and to help write the next chapter of our company's growth story. 

This is more than a job; it's a rare opportunity to build a quality management system from the ground up. As a founding member of our quality engineering team, you'll own the design and implementation of quality processes, control plans, and supplier quality programs that will ensure our products meet the highest standards working hands-on from concept through startup and steady-state production. 

The day-to-day

Quality Process & Control Development 

  • Lead and support PFMEA studies to identify process risks and translate findings into robust control plans. 
  • Develop and implement receiving inspection plans to ensure incoming materials and components meet quality requirements. 
  • Specify, procure, and qualify inspection equipment needed to support in-process and final inspection activities. 
  • Establish in-process controls, inspection points, and validation steps that meet product and regulatory requirements. 
  • Build and maintain corrective action reporting processes (CAPA) to drive root cause analysis and effective, sustainable resolutions. 

Factory Standup & Production Support 

  • Manage the timeline and budget for quality engineering workstreams as part of the broader factory standup effort. 
  • Set up and configure MES (Manufacturing Execution System) processes from a quality data and process control perspective, including quality data capture, traceability, and reporting. 
  • Support the startup, ramp, and stabilization of production lines, including troubleshooting quality issues in real time. 
  • Partner with Supply Chain and suppliers to establish supplier quality control programs, including supplier audits, qualification, and ongoing performance monitoring. 
  • Support AS9100 documentation, implementation, and internal/external auditing to ensure the site achieves and maintains certification. 
  • Work closely with Manufacturing Engineering and Production to ensure quality requirements are built into process designs and translate into safe, efficient, and scalable operations on the floor. 

Cross-Functional Collaboration 

  • Serve as a key technical point of contact between Quality, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production teams throughout the factory standup. 
  • Support continuous improvement initiatives (Lean, Six Sigma, or similar methodologies) as the factory matures from startup to full-rate production. 
  • Document quality processes, control plans, and lessons learned to build institutional knowledge as the site scales. 

You should apply if you

  • BS degree in Mechanical Engineering, Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field 
  • 5-10 years of experience in quality engineering, ideally within aviation or automotive manufacturing environments 
  • Demonstrated experience supporting PFMEA studies and developing control plans 
  • Experience developing receiving inspection plans and procuring inspection equipment 
  • Hands-on experience with supplier quality control and support, including supplier audits and qualification 
  • AS9100 experience, including documentation support and auditing 
  • Experience setting up MES systems from a quality data and process control perspective 
  • Strong project management skills, with experience managing timelines and budgets in a fast-paced environment 
  • Comfortable working cross-functionally with Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, and Production teams 
  • Excellent problem-solving, communication, and organizational skills 
  • U.S. citizenship required 

Note: We encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all the listed qualifications; ability and impact cannot be summarized in a few bullet points. 

Nice to Have

  • Prior experience in drone, UAS, or aerospace/defense manufacturing 
  • Experience standing up quality management systems at a greenfield manufacturing facility 
  • Lean Manufacturing, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement certifications 
  • CAD proficiency (SolidWorks, CATIA, or similar) for reviewing part prints and inspection criteria 
  • Familiarity with IATF 16949 quality systems in addition to AS9100 
  • ASQ certifications (CQE, CMQ/OE, or similar) 

 

Join Helsing and work with world-leading experts in their fields 

  • Helsing’s work is important. You’ll be directly contributing to the protection of democratic countries while balancing both ethical and geopolitical concerns

  • The work is unique. We operate in a domain that has highly unusual technical requirements and constraints, and where robustness, safety, and ethical considerations are vital. You will face unique Engineering and AI challenges that make a meaningful impact in the world

  • Our work frequently takes us right up to the state of the art in technical innovation, be it reinforcement learning, distributed systems, generative AI, or deployment infrastructure. The defense industry is entering the most exciting phase of the technological development curve. Advances in our field of world are not incremental: Helsing is part of, and often leading, historic leaps forward

  • In our domain, success is a matter of order-of-magnitude improvements and novel capabilities. This means we take bets, aim high, and focus on big opportunities. Despite being a relatively young company, Helsing has already been selected for multiple significant government contracts

  • We actively encourage healthy, proactive, and diverse debate internally about what we do and how we choose to do it. Teams and individual engineers are trusted (and encouraged) to practice responsible autonomy and critical thinking, and to focus on outcomes, not conformity. At Helsing you will have a say in how we (and you!) work, the opportunity to engage on what does and doesn’t work, and to take ownership of aspects of our culture that you care deeply about

What we offer

  • A focus on outcomes, not time-tracking

  • A generous compensation and benefits package (in addition to base salary) that includes, but may not be limited to, insurance coverage (medical and travel), flexible paid time off, paid holidays, and remote and/or hybrid work available depending on position. All compensation and benefits are subject to the terms and conditions of the underlying plans or programs, as applicable and as may be amended, terminated or superseded from time to time.

The base salary offered to the successful candidate will be determined by a variety of factors including relevant experience, qualifications, education, skill level, interview performance, and the level and scope of the position.   

Helsing is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, genetics, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.  Please do not submit personal data revealing racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religious or philosophical beliefs, trade union membership, data concerning your health, or data concerning your sexual orientation.

 
Helsing's Candidate Privacy and Confidentiality Regime can be found here.

job.title: Senior QA Automation Developer (HELOC)
job.description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Developer to join our team who has end-to-end ownership to build a new quality product. Through automation and functional testing, they validate a variety of products to offer our customers a seamless banking experience. As a Senior QA Engineer, you will work directly with our product teams and will participate in application specification reviews and architectural design sessions by providing input from a quality standpoint. You will also identify testing strategies for various features and functionalities. Within your first year, you will develop an understanding of how to deliver high performing software at pace of development. You will work in an environment that promotes ownership at all levels including configuring and monitoring apps in production.

This is a fully remote position to candidates who are based in Canada.Our Core Technologies Include:Java, Selenium Webdriver, Playwright, Claude Code, TestNG, Maven, Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, SQL, REST Assured, OkHttp, SumoLogic, Docker, Kubernetes, Gatling, Linux etc

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop test automation at the pace of feature development utilizing AI tools and our functional and performance test frameworks
  • Utilize LLMs to create feature test plans and internal knowledge stores for streamlining AI tools usage for Automation and Deep testing efforts
  • Define custom AI workflows to enable all developers to test new features using existing automation tests, evaluate test failures, and troubleshoot environment issues
  • Execute functional/performance tests by spinning up disposable environments on demand to deploy microservices with different versions and configurations, and customize database content
  • Customize, configure, patch services, and deploy infrastructure and code changes all the way through to production

  • Passion for automating tests and delivering high quality features in a fast paced environment
  • Comfortable working in Agile methodology

What We Offer You:

  • Competitive salary and stock option plan
  • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Paid parental leave
  • Health & wellness initiatives

Environmental & Working Conditions

  • Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.
  • Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.
  • The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.
  • Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.
  • Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.
  • Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement. English is required for all positions, as it involves interacting with staff at Upgrade's offices worldwide.

job.title: Senior Quality Engineer
job.description:
The role

This is not a testing role in the traditional sense. We're not looking for someone to catch bugs at the end of the pipeline and hand them back. We're looking for someone to own how quality happens across the entire product. As we like to put it: QA owns the testing strategy, not product quality. Product quality is shared by Product and Engineering.

Your job is to make sure the whole system is set up so that everyone can build confidence in what we ship, from the moment a feature is designed to the moment it's released. That means enabling engineers to test effectively, driving a quality mindset across teams, and building the systems and processes that support it, not just writing and running test cases.

We think about quality the way our users experience the product: as complete journeys, not as a checklist of acceptance criteria. If you read this and think "quality is someone else's problem once I've logged the bug," this role isn't for you. If you think in terms of "can the user actually achieve their goal here, and how do I make the whole team confident that they can," keep reading.

This is a senior role because it demands ownership. Not the word, the behavior: seeing what needs to happen and making it happen without being told, working across Product, Engineering, Data as a matter of course, and taking responsibility for the testing strategy of a feature end to end.

Core responsibilities

  • Own the testing strategy for the features and areas you work on. Decide how confidence gets built, which validation happens at which layer (unit, component, integration, API, golden, E2E, accessibility, performance, security, manual, exploratory), rather than defaulting everything to end-to-end testing.
  • Get involved early. Join discovery and specification reviews before development starts: clarify assumptions, surface edge cases, identify risks and dependencies, and ask the hard questions ("what happens if the API fails, if permissions are denied, if the user abandons the flow?").
  • Design test cases as part of feature development, not after it. Covering user journeys, happy paths, edge cases, error handling, recovery, and regression.
  • Enable engineers to own their part of quality. Give developers the test suites, regression packs, environments, and mock data they need to validate their own work before it reaches you, and help build a culture where they do.
  • Do the testing that matters. Structured execution of prepared cases plus mandatory exploratory testing to find what predefined cases can't predict, like usability issues, cross-feature interactions, and wrong assumptions.
  • Maintain a living view of test coverage per feature. So release decisions are based on measurable confidence rather than "the ticket is closed."
  • Continuously improve the automation strategy and the process itself. Reduce flakiness, close coverage gaps, cut repetitive manual regression, and free up time for exploratory, accessibility, security, and performance work.
  • Bring AI/LLM tools into the workflow. Use them to speed up test case design, automation scripting, and exploratory testing, and keep pushing the team's QA practices forward as new tools emerge.

Requirements:

  • A minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Senior level experience in QA. You've owned quality for real features or products, made your own calls on testing strategy, and been accountable for the outcome, not just executed test plans someone else wrote.
  • A genuine ownership and proactivity mindset. You spot gaps and close them, you drive things rather than wait to be assigned, and you don't treat quality as "done" the moment a bug is filed.
  • A user- and product-first way of thinking. You test journeys and business outcomes, not just acceptance criteria, and you keep the user at the center of every decision about what and how to test.
  • Security mindset.
  • Comfort with the "shift-left" idea: quality is built throughout development, not verified at the end.
  • Hands-on experience with automation tools such as WebdriverIO, Patrol, Selenium, Cypress, Appium, or Playwright.
  • Experience writing backend tests (API, unit, database) and testing RESTful services with tools such as Postman or similar
  • Experience with CI/CD platforms such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions.
  • We prioritise strong automation skills, but if your background is mostly manual, a proactive attitude, a solid technical base, and a real drive to pick up automation quickly - will still get our attention.

Nice to have:

  • Experience in web3 or fintech, or anywhere you've tested products that handle real money. When money is on the line, there's no room for "probably fine," so it sharpens your attention to detail and your instinct for edge cases in a way that carries over well here.
  • Experience with testing across multiple layers (API, integration, golden/screenshot, performance, accessibility).
  • Experience with security testing

Personality Traits We Value

  • Problem-solvers: You see roadblocks as opportunities and don’t wait around for someone else to fix things.
  • Self-starters: You take initiative, follow through, and deliver with pride – no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Team players: You thrive in a “we, not me” culture, lifting others up while sharing the load.
  • Adaptable minds: You embrace change, question how things are done, and constantly look for better ways.
  • Ownership mindset: You own your work end-to-end, communicate openly, and learn from every challenge.

Why Solflare?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly shape how people interact with and understand crypto wallets, empowering users around the globe.
  • Work with the best: Collaborate with a talented, driven team across design, engineering, and product to build innovative, user-first experiences.
  • Flexibility: Remote or office – up to you. Enjoy a flexible work environment based on trust that supports your well-being and fosters creativity, as well as flexible work time – work when you are most productive, with no micromanagement.
  • Perks & benefits: individual education budget, cool team buildings, private health insurance, to name a few.
  • Learn about Crypto: No crypto experience? No problem! You’ll be part of a team that will teach you the ropes and help you grow into an expert.

Join us at Solflare and be part of something bigger than yourself. We’re not just reacting to trends; we’re building the future. If you’re ready to push boundaries, challenge assumptions, and make an impact, we want to hear from you.

Apply now and help us shape the future of decentralized finance.

About us

Solflare is one of the fastest-growing crypto wallets in the world. With around 4 million monthly active users and over $20 billion in digital assets secured through our platform, we’re building a powerful gateway to Web3. Founded in 2021, Solflare now has a team of nearly 140 people, with offices in Zagreb, Belgrade, and Novi Sad, plus remote teams across the globe. Our vision is simple but bold: a world where everyone uses a Web3 wallet and has full control over their assets – achieving true financial independence.

Our culture

At Solflare, we’re on a mission to empower people to truly own and thrive – starting with our own team. We take on bold challenges with curiosity, grit, and a deep sense of accountability. Here, progress means learning fast, solving smart, and showing up for each other without ego. You’ll join a team where we question the status quo, celebrate shared wins, and never settle for “just good enough.” If you’re excited by growth – yours, ours, and society’s – you’ll feel right at home.

job.title: Test Engineer
job.description:
Lyntris is a defense technology company that connects sensing to action across the connected battlespace. Lyntris brings together the talents of Accelint and Vitesse teams under one mission, with each contributing deep expertise within their domain. Combining differentiated hardware, software and mission expertise, Lyntris helps customers sense threats, make sense of complex conditions and act with greater speed, precision and confidence in contested environments.

Lyntris supports U.S. and allied defense organizations across every branch — including Navy, Army, Air Force, Space Force and allied partners — spanning strategic, operational and tactical missions and every domain: Space, Air, Land, Sea and Cyber. With more than 200 active defense programs, Lyntris works at every level of the mission, from national command authority to the tactical edge.

Solutions are designed by operators who understand the mission, engineered for the conditions that degrade or defeat standard systems, and built on an open, modular architecture that integrates into existing programs without requiring them to start over. Lyntris moves faster than the traditional defense cycle — with integrated design, build and test capabilities in-house — and delivers systems that sustain and endure long after initial fielding.

Job Description

  • Test Engineer
  • Full Time
  • Remote

The Test Engineer plays a critical role in software validation by designing, executing, and assisting with the maintenance of test cases to ensure the system meets defined requirements, perform as intended, and is free of defects prior to deployments. This position is responsible for software verification and validation (V&V) activities, ensuring that enterprise systems meet functional performance, and compliance requirements – particularly for U.S. Department of Defense (DoD) programs. The Test Engineer will support formal and informal testing while ensuring the collection of Objective Quality Evidence (OQE) to support system certification and accreditation. The ideal candidate brings at least 2 years of relevant experience in software testing, validation and test automation within complex IT enterprise systems such as Product Lifecycle Management (PLM), Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP), or similar platforms in regulated settings – and possesses hands-on experience developing and maintaining automated test scripts.

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and execute test cases to validate system functionality, data integrity, and end-to-end business processes.
  • Maintain and refine automated test scripts using approved automation tools (e.g., Eggplant, Selenium, Katalon, or equivalent automated testing tools).
  • Support end-to-end validation efforts across integrated systems, including PLM, ERP, and interface/data exchange processes.
  • Support in the coordination and completion of internal testing activities (e.g., smoke, system, functional and regression testing) to ensure timely development completion and quality devlivery of software.
  • Ensure all testing activities produce appropriate OQE artifacts in support of DoD compliance requirements.
  • Identify, document, and track defects, working closely with development and functional teams to support resolution and retesting.
  • Analyze test results and provide clear, concise status updates and report to the Test Lead.
  • Ensure traceability between requirements, test cases, and defects to align with DoD validation requirements.
  • Assist in building and expanding the regression test suite to support ongoing releases and system changes.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (e.g., QA, IT, business users) to ensure alignment of testing scope, data, and expected outcomes.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, and methodologies to increase efficiency and quality.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field required; advanced degree, relevant internship experience, or equivalent hands-on industry experience may be considered in lieu of traditional qualifications.
  • 2+ years of experience with test automation frameworks, scripting languages, and tools (e.g., Selenium, Katalon, Eggplant, Python, XML, JSON).
  • Experience with PLM platforms (e.g., Windchill, Teamcenter, Enovia) or other enterprise systems.
  • Strong working knowledge of test planning, execution, and documentation aligned with DoD standards.
  • Experience producing OQE artifacts to support system certification/accreditation or acceptance reviews.
  • Proficient with tools such as Microsoft Office, Jira, Confluence, and SharePoint.
  • Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interface effectively across technical and non-technical teams.
  • Currently holds an active U.S. national security clearance or be able to receive and maintain one.

Preferred Qualifications (Not Required)

  • Familiarity with DoD or federal system development lifecycle (SDLC) processes and compliance requirements.
  • Knowledge of DoD software documentation standards, including SDD, IDD, SDP, ICD, and CDRL requirements.
  • Understanding of RMF, ATO, and Cybersecurity Testing/Validation (e.g., STIG compliance).
  • Exposure to Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE) and Model-Based Testing (MBT) practices.
  • Experience in Agile or hybrid Agile/Waterfall environments, and use of tools like Zephyr, TestRail, or qTest.
  • Security+ or other DoD 8570-compliant certification preferred.

Physical Requirements

  • Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
  • Must be able to lift up to 15 pounds at times.
  • This position may require the ability to travel up to 5%.

Clearance Requirements

Some positions will require access to U.S. National Security information. Positions that require this access will be required to receive and maintain a U.S. government personnel security clearance (PCL). In order to qualify for this position, the candidate must be a US Citizen and either currently possess this National Security eligibility or be able to complete the investigation application process with a favorable determination and maintain that eligibility throughout their employment.

Overview

LMI is seeking a Test Team Lead who will serve as the technical authority for test planning, execution, system integration, and verification supporting the F-35 Logistics Information Technology (LogIT) solution. Reporting to program leadership, the Test Team Lead will be responsible for architecting, executing, and governing all test and evaluation (T&E) activities to ensure delivery of a robust, mission-capable system. This includes driving disciplined verification processes across Systems Integration, User Acceptance, and System-of-Systems testing, with accountability for meeting Limited Deployment objectives in addition to subsequent capability releases. The successful candidate will demonstrate deep systems engineering expertise, leadership in test strategy, and a track record of Agile test execution within complex defense environments.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Architect and maintain an enterprise test strategy encompassing the full system lifecycle, including requirements traceability matrix (RTM), test coverage analysis, and test architecture artifacts.
  • Ensure alignment between system testing plans and enterprise-level program milestones.
  • Govern all Agile quality gates, defining clear entry/exit criteria and defect severity standards for all test phases.
  • Validate test artifacts—including test cases, scripts, and procedures—against DoDAF architectural views (OV-1, SV-1, OV-5b), performing test readiness reviews that demonstrate linkage between technical requirements and architecture products.
  • Ensure comprehensive test coverage of integration points across legacy and modernized systems, assessing impacts to interoperability and data fidelity.
  • Lead the formal execution of full-spectrum testing, including systems integration, user acceptance, and system-of-systems verification for F-35 LogIT.
  • Develop methodologies and coordinate resources for planning, scheduling, and executing integration tests across multiple platforms, environments (e.g., IL2/4/5/6), and stakeholders.
  • Plan and conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT), collaborating with end-users to validate mission requirements and operational suitability.
  • Establish and maintain an automated regression testing framework, supporting continuous integration/continuous delivery (CI/CD) practices.
  • Monitor and manage technical risk throughout the testing lifecycle, including proactive identification and mitigation of risks related to performance, security, and system interoperability.
  • Track issues and defects, providing regular reporting to leadership on status, trends, and corrective actions.
  • Lead recurring test readiness reviews, test execution meetings, and defect triage with internal teams, program management offices, prime contractors, and external certification agencies.
  • Facilitate joint reviews with external DOD/OSW agencies in preparation for formal acceptance and interoperability certification.
  • Maintain robust documentation of test results, findings, and verification evidence to support audits, certifications, and accreditation.
  • Collaborate with product owners, scrum teams, and program leadership to integrate T&E activities into sprint and Program Increment (PI) planning.
  • Provide architectural and technical guidance to ensure the test effort supports evolving program priorities, contract deliverables, and incremental capability releases.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in systems engineering, computer science, software engineering, information systems, or a related technical field.
  • 10 or more years of relevant experience in systems engineering, software quality engineering, or test and evaluation leadership supporting defense, federal, or large-scale enterprise software systems.
  • Demonstrated experience leading multidisciplinary engineering and test teams in U.S. military services (e.g., USAF, USN) or multi-agency (Joint/OSW) Enterprise environments.
  • Proven track record architecting, planning, and governing complex system integration and verification activities, including alignment to technical reviews and compliance milestones.
  • Deep understanding of systems engineering practices, including DoDAF architectural views, interface control verification, requirements traceability, and system-of-systems integration.
  • Proficient in software development and Agile methodologies, including practical experience with Agile delivery frameworks (SAFe, Scrum), test automation, and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Demonstrated proficiency with automated test management tools, defect tracking systems (e.g., Jira), and cloud-native architectures operating across multiple security enclaves.
  • Active SECRET security clearance or ability to obtain and maintain one.
  • Preferred: DAWIA Practitioner or Advanced credentials in Test & Evaluation or Systems Engineering, INCOSE CSEP, and/or certifications in Agile methods (e.g., SAFe Agilist, Scrum Master).

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with formal acceptance testing and joint interoperability certification processes involving external DOD or OSW agencies, including interfacing with the Joint Interoperability Test Command (JITC).
  • Familiarity with DoD logistics data structures, Defense Logistics Management Standards (DLMS) transactions, and Defense Automatic Addressing System (DAAS) routing.
  • Experience integrating test artifacts and workflows with cross-domain DoD environments (e.g., NIPR/SIPR, Cross Domain Solutions) and understanding of associated security overlays.
  • Working knowledge of enterprise analytics and test reporting within environments such as Advana, Jupiter, or comparable mission analytics platforms.
  • Experience supporting aviation sustainment, weapon system logistics, or similar defense modernization programs.

job.description:
Job Description

NetImpact Strategies is seeking a ServiceNow Business Analyst & Quality Engineer to provide independent analysis and release assurance for a Federal Agency's ServiceNow platform. This role owns requirements gathering, automated and regression testing, test evidence, defect analysis, release-readiness validation, and post-production verification so delivery speed can increase without weakening platform reliability, security, or upgradeability.

This position is requires U.S. citizenship and a post-award Government background investigation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business needs, process flows, data requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria for ServiceNow enhancements, operational improvements, integrations, and data changes.
  • Maintain themes, epics, features, stories, dependencies, backlog, sprint/release artifacts, and planning data in ServiceNow SPM/Agile capabilities or the Agency-approved work-management structure.
  • Support prioritization using Agency-assigned business value, time criticality, risk reduction, dependencies, and effort/capacity; make tradeoffs visible rather than independently deciding Government priorities.
  • Facilitate requirements clarification among product owners, users, administrators, developers, implementation specialists, architects, testers, and external teams so work enters delivery ready and testable.
  • Own the platform test strategy, regression baseline, release-quality evidence, and repeatable testing standards used by the Platform Team.
  • Design, build, maintain, and execute ServiceNow Automated Test Framework (ATF) suites covering critical platform forms, lists, ACLs, workflows/flows, notifications, catalog functions, integrations, and reusable capabilities.
  • Create and execute functional, integration, regression, exploratory, performance, and release-validation test scenarios proportionate to change risk.
  • Coordinate UAT with product owners, and stakeholders; ensure acceptance criteria, expected outcomes, defects, and approvals remain traceable to the release.
  • Analyze defects, establish severity and reproducibility, distinguish pre-release findings from production issues, track remediation/retest, and identify recurring escaped-defect patterns.
  • Prepare release evidence including test plans, cases, automated scripts, execution results, defect status, exceptions, and readiness recommendations for governance and go/no-go decisions.
  • Validate upgrade and patch readiness through regression packs, pre/post comparisons, and targeted testing of platform-level integrations and critical shared capabilities.
  • Perform post-production validation and rollback verification; ensure a change is not declared successful until agreed technical and user outcomes are demonstrated.
  • Measure automation coverage, regression effectiveness, escaped defects, test-cycle time, and repeat-failure trends; recommend improvements that increase confidence and reduce manual effort.
  • Maintain reusable testing guidance and coach implementation/product teams on approved ServiceNow testing practices without assuming ownership for product-team-specific application testing.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications and Certifications

  • Three or more years of business analysis and software quality engineering or test automation experience, including enterprise web/application testing.
  • Two or more years of hands-on ServiceNow testing experience, including Automated Test Framework (ATF), regression testing, and validation of platform configuration and integrations.
  • Experience designing risk-based test plans, test cases, traceability, defect workflows, release evidence, and post-production validation.
  • Experience testing REST/SOAP or IntegrationHub integrations, workflows/flows, security/ACL behavior, catalog capabilities, and cross-system transactions.
  • Working knowledge of ServiceNow release/change processes and the ability to evaluate readiness independently from the engineer who built the change.
  • ServiceNow CSA and ATF-related training/micro-certifications strongly preferred; additional testing certification such as ISTQB is a plus.
  • U.S. citizenship and ability to satisfy High Risk IT background-investigation and sensitive-information requirements.

Preferred Qualifications and Certifications

  • Federal consulting or financial-regulatory experience.
  • Experience with ServiceNow family-upgrade testing, Performance Analytics, performance testing, and CI/CD-triggered automated tests.
  • Experience building reusable enterprise regression suites and test-evidence dashboards.

About Us

At NetImpact Strategies, we post salary ranges in compliance with the specific labor laws and regulations of each county and state, ensuring transparency and fairness in our hiring practices. This approach reflects our commitment to adhering to legal requirements and promoting equitable pay standards across all regions where we operate. The posted salary range for this role is $90,000-105,000. The posted salary range is not an exact indication of the actual compensation offered and is instead a range of what NetImpact, in good faith, could compensate at the lowest and most high end of the salary market.   • Pawsitively pawesome – Pet Insurance (because our little critters are part of our families, too!)

  • Be part of a dynamic and collaborative work environment recently ranked by The Washington Post as a Top Work Place in 2019, 2021,2022, 2023, & 2024!
  • Have fun and celebrate and give back – Team building activities, community volunteering, quarterly HQ days, wellness events, happy hours, family fun events, and more!

ABOUT US

NetImpact Strategies Inc. (NetImpact) has been a Trusted Advisor driving impact through digital transformation for the Federal Government for over a decade. We solve complex problems with innovation and agility to create meaningful, transformative, and enduring change. As Trusted Advisors, NetImpact professionals partner with customer agencies to deliver solutions that empower them to not only meet their missions but also realize their strategic vision through agile, outcome-focused solutions addressing both strategic and tactical requirements. We design and implement comprehensive, tailored solutions that are both mindful of the client's culture and organizational dynamics. NetImpact’s core values and commitment to a customer and results-oriented delivery approach has propelled our growth and enabled us to deliver impactful value across Strategic Consulting, Process Automation, Cloud, DevSecOps, Data and Analytics, and Cyber Security for the Federal Government.

Guided by a council of 2000+ trusted HCP advisors, we ensure every interaction is clinically meaningful, ethically grounded and leads to better patient care.

Your leadership will strengthen our testing lifecycle, elevate automation maturity, and promote a culture where every employee advocates for quality—directly contributing to innovation and exceptional user experiences across Impiricus products.

Duties / Responsibilities:

Testing and Team Management

Automation Leadership

job.title: QA & Training Supervisor
job.description:
QA & Training Supervisor (Bilingual – English/Spanish) – Remote

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S. Business Hours (CST)
Language Requirement: Fluent English & Spanish

About the Role

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a QA & Training Supervisor to lead quality assurance, coaching, training, and performance development across their Patient Concierge team.

This is not a passive call-monitoring role. You’ll take direct ownership of improving agent performance, communication quality, onboarding effectiveness, and overall customer experience.

The ideal candidate has experience in high-volume customer service environments, knows how to evaluate calls objectively, and can turn performance gaps into actionable coaching and measurable improvement.

What You’ll Own

Quality Assurance & Performance Monitoring

  • Review and evaluate agent calls and customer interactions.
  • Assess performance against established:
    • Service standards
    • Communication expectations
    • QA benchmarks
    • Customer experience standards
  • Maintain consistent QA scoring and evaluation processes.
  • Identify recurring performance issues, communication gaps, and coaching opportunities.
  • Ensure quality standards are applied consistently across the team.

Coaching & Performance Development

  • Conduct structured one-on-one coaching sessions with agents.
  • Deliver clear, actionable, and performance-focused feedback.
  • Coach agents on:
    • Communication
    • Confidence
    • Professionalism
    • Call handling
    • Consistency
  • Create improvement plans where necessary.
  • Track progress and ensure coaching translates into measurable performance improvements.

Training & New-Hire Onboarding

  • Own training and onboarding programs for new Patient Concierge team members.
  • Develop and continuously improve:
    • SOPs
    • Training materials
    • QA documentation
    • Learning paths
    • Coaching resources
  • Help new hires ramp quickly and confidently.
  • Identify onboarding gaps and improve training based on actual agent performance.

Reporting & Performance Insights

  • Prepare regular:
    • QA reports
    • Coaching summaries
    • Trend analyses
    • Performance dashboards
  • Track QA scores, training effectiveness, and agent improvement over time.
  • Identify patterns across the team and recommend corrective actions.
  • Provide leadership with clear visibility into quality and performance trends.

QA & Training Operations

  • Manage QA review cycles independently.
  • Maintain organized coaching and training schedules.
  • Keep QA records and training documentation accurate and up to date.
  • Ensure consistent execution of quality, coaching, and training processes.
  • Collaborate with operations leadership to improve overall team performance.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Experience in one or more of the following:
    • Quality Assurance
    • Training
    • Coaching
    • Call Center Operations
    • Customer Service Leadership
  • Experience working in a high-volume customer service environment.
  • Fully bilingual in English and Spanish.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proven ability to provide constructive feedback and coach employees effectively.
  • Strong organizational, reporting, and documentation skills.
  • Comfortable holding team members accountable to performance standards.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment during CST hours.

Preferred Experience

  • Previous Supervisor, Team Lead, QA Lead, or Training Lead experience.
  • Experience in:
    • Healthcare
    • Patient services
    • Appointment scheduling
    • Concierge services
  • Familiarity with:
    • QA scorecards
    • Call-scoring frameworks
    • CRM platforms
    • Customer service KPIs
    • Coaching and performance improvement plans

What Makes You a Great Fit

  • You have a strong ear for communication quality and quickly recognize performance gaps.
  • You enjoy coaching and helping people improve.
  • You balance accountability with constructive support.
  • You are highly organized and consistent in how you evaluate performance.
  • You remain calm and professional during difficult coaching or escalation conversations.
  • You take ownership without requiring constant oversight.
  • You care about building a quality-driven, high-performing service culture.

What a Typical Day Looks Like

You may:

  • Review recorded calls and score agent performance.
  • Conduct coaching and feedback sessions.
  • Analyze QA trends and identify recurring performance gaps.
  • Track agent progress following coaching.
  • Train and onboard new Patient Concierge team members.
  • Update SOPs, training materials, and QA documentation.
  • Prepare performance reports for leadership.
  • Collaborate with operations leaders on quality improvements.

In short: you ensure agents consistently deliver high-quality customer experiences while helping the team continuously improve.

Key Metrics for Success (KPIs)

  • Improvement in overall QA scores.
  • Increased consistency in customer service quality.
  • Measurable agent improvement following coaching.
  • Faster and more effective new-hire ramp-up.
  • Training completion and effectiveness.
  • Accurate and consistent QA evaluations.
  • Reduction in recurring communication and service issues.
  • Clear and reliable quality reporting for leadership.

Interview Process

Step 1: Initial Screening

  • Communication skills
  • QA and training experience
  • English and Spanish proficiency

Step 2: Client Interview

  • Coaching methodology
  • QA evaluation approach
  • Real-world performance scenarios

Step 3: Final Interview

  • Leadership and accountability style
  • Ownership and problem-solving
  • Team and operational alignment

What Happens After You Apply

Right after you apply, you’ll receive an email invitation from Spark Hire to record your Intro Video. This short, self-recorded video completes your application and can be recorded whenever it’s convenient.

Instead of repeating yourself across multiple screening calls, you’ll introduce yourself once, and your video will be shared with the hiring team. You can record your video as many times as you’d like before submitting it—only your final submission will be reviewed.

Please keep an eye on both your inbox and spam folder for your Spark Hire invitation.

Apply Now

If you’re bilingual in English and Spanish, have strong QA, training, or coaching experience, and enjoy developing high-performing customer service teams, we’d love to hear from you.

Apply today and help build a consistent, quality-focused Patient Concierge experience.

job.title: QA Engineer
job.description:
Overview

Quest Software is looking for an experienced QA Engineer to help define and advance AI-first quality engineering practices across a diverse portfolio of Identity Recovery products, ranging from cloud-native SaaS solutions built on Microsoft Azure to enterprise on-premises Windows applications.

This role is intended for a quality engineer who combines strong hands-on testing, automation, troubleshooting, and cloud technology experience with practical use of AI-assisted development and testing tools.

The successful candidate will contribute directly to product quality while helping the team adopt repeatable AI-assisted approaches that improve test design, automation coverage, exploratory testing, defect investigation, release confidence, and technical documentation. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of quality throughout the development lifecycle and collaborates closely with software engineers, product owners, and other members of an Agile feature team.

Responsibilities

  • Champion AI-first quality engineering practices, leveraging AI-powered tools and agents to accelerate testing, improve coverage, and enhance software quality.
  • Develop and maintain automated testing frameworks and quality validation solutions across API, integration, end-to-end, performance, security, and scalability testing layers.
  • Define and execute risk-based testing strategies for cloud-native SaaS applications built on C#/.NET and Microsoft Azure technologies.
  • Partner closely with engineers, product managers, and architects throughout the development lifecycle to embed quality into design, implementation, and release decisions.
  • Create reusable AI-assisted testing workflows, prompts, and quality guardrails that drive consistent, efficient, and responsible engineering practices.
  • Validate enterprise software solutions that integrate with Microsoft technologies, including Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Exchange, SharePoint, and related services.
  • Drive continuous improvement of product quality by contributing to CI/CD pipelines, quality gates, test environments, observability, defect prevention, and Agile delivery processes.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 4+ years of experience in Software Quality Engineering, Test Automation, or Software Development within Agile product teams.
  • Experience owning quality outcomes throughout the software development lifecycle, from requirements and design through release and post-release validation.
  • Strong programming or scripting skills using technologies such as C#, .NET, PowerShell, Python, TypeScript, or similar.
  • Experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks and integrating quality validation into CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience designing and executing testing strategies across multiple quality domains, including functional, API, integration, performance, reliability, and security testing.
  • Experience testing cloud-native applications deployed on Microsoft Azure or comparable cloud platforms.
  • Practical experience leveraging AI-assisted development tools, coding agents, or agentic workflows to improve testing, automation, troubleshooting, and engineering productivity.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to investigate complex issues across distributed systems.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with experience working effectively in cross-functional Agile teams.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Microsoft technologies such as Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory, Exchange, SharePoint, or related services.
  • Experience with modern automation frameworks and tools such as Playwright, Selenium, SpecFlow, Postman, REST Assured, or equivalent technologies.
  • Experience working with AI-powered engineering platforms such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, or similar tools.
  • Experience validating enterprise SaaS, identity management, cybersecurity, backup and recovery, or systems administration products.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD platforms, cloud infrastructure, virtualization technologies, and secure software development practices.
  • Working knowledge of application security concepts, OWASP guidance, and common security vulnerabilities.

Company Overview

Quest Software builds the foundation for enterprise AI with solutions in data governance, cybersecurity, and platform modernization. More than 45,000 companies — including 90% of the Fortune 500 — trust Quest to solve their most critical IT challenges. From securing identities and modernizing platforms to preparing data for AI, we help enterprises unlock their full potential.

Why Quest

At Quest, your work makes an impact. You’ll help organizations get AI-ready while building your career with a global team of innovators. We offer:

  • Competitive pay, annual bonuses, and top-performer recognition.
  • Comprehensive health, family, and retirement benefits.
  • Flexible work options, generous PTO, and wellness programs.
  • Professional growth through learning platforms, mentorship, and leadership programs.
  • Inclusive teams that reflect the world we serve, supported by Employee Resource Groups and our Equality & Inclusion Council.

Quest is an Equal Opportunity Employer and Prohibits Discrimination and Harassment of Any Kind:

Quest is committed to the principle of equal employment opportunity for all employees and to providing employees with a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions at Quest are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications, without regard to race, color, religion, or belief, national, social, or ethnic origin, sex (including pregnancy), age, physical, mental, or sensory disability, HIV Status, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, marital, civil union, or domestic partnership status, past or present military service, family medical history or genetic information, family or parental status, or any other status protected by the laws or regulations in the locations where we operate. Quest will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. Quest encourages applicants of all ages

Job seekers should be aware of fraudulent job offers from online scammers and only apply to roles listed on quest.com/careers using our applicant system. Note: We do not use text messaging or third-party messaging apps like Telegram to communicate with applicants, so please exercise caution if you are approached in this way and only interact with people claiming to be Quest employees if they have an email address ending in @quest.com. You can report job scams to the FTC (ReportFraud.ftc.gov) or your state attorney general.
