job.title: QA Engineer: AI-Assisted Testing
job.description:
Join ECFX, a company transforming how the legal industry works through technology. Every day our platform pulls court notices and legal documents from hundreds of court portals and e-filing systems, categorizes them with AI, and delivers them into our customers' document and case management systems. When something is late, dropped, or misfiled, a law firm can miss a deadline.

We're looking for a hands-on QA Engineer who loves finding what others miss, and who uses AI to do it faster and deeper. Our engineers build with AI coding agents, so changes arrive quickly and in volume. You'll be the person who works out what could break and tests it thoroughly by hand, using AI as your co-pilot for test design, test data, investigation, and reporting. This is a testing role first. If you also enjoy building automation, there's room to use AI to create targeted automated checks where they pay off. You will have a real say in how we build, test, and ship software.

What You'll Engage In

  • Test Smarter with AI: Use AI tools (such as Claude, Claude Code, Cursor, or ChatGPT) to read tickets, merge requests, and code diffs; map out risks and edge cases; draft test charters and checklists; and decide where to focus. You bring the judgment about what matters.
  • Explore and Uncover: Run risk-based exploratory, functional, and regression testing across our Vue dashboard, admin tools, email notifications, and integrations. Find defects before customers do.
  • Validate What Matters Most: Make sure documents are retrieved, parsed, categorized, stored, and delivered correctly across many external sources: court portals, 2FA/OTP logins, and integrations such as Clio, Filevine, iManage, and NetDocuments. Hunt for silent failures, where a document is dropped but the run reports success.
  • Test Below the UI: Much of our work has no screen to click. Verify backend and platform changes by hand, using API calls, SQL queries, logs, and dashboards (Grafana/Loki, Sentry), with AI helping you write the queries and make sense of the output.
  • Build Realistic Test Scenarios: Use AI to generate test data, sample court notice emails, and edge-case documents, and drive our simulators and test environments to reproduce hard-to-reach situations.
  • Test Our AI Features: Evaluate our AI document categorization and our LLM-facing tools (an MCP server used by AI assistants). Build sample sets, check accuracy and consistency, try to break them with unusual or hostile inputs, and flag when a model or prompt change makes results worse.
  • Guard Security and Access: Check logins (password, SAML SSO, OAuth), user roles and permissions, and that one firm can never see another firm's data. Verify security fixes without breaking what already works.
  • Reproduce and Triage: Investigate customer-reported and production issues, reproduce them reliably, and write bug reports clear enough that an engineer, or an AI agent, can act on them right away.
  • Automate Where It Pays Off (Optional): If automation is in your toolkit, use AI to create focused automated checks, such as Playwright scripts or API checks, for high-risk flows you find yourself retesting.
  • Agile Collaboration: Work with engineers and product managers in sprint planning, backlog refinement, and retrospectives. Help write testable acceptance criteria and raise quality risks early

What You're Likely to Bring

Professional Experience: 3 to 7 years in software quality assurance for web or SaaS applications, with deep experience in exploratory and manual testing of complex, data-heavy systems.

AI Fluency

  • ·You use AI assistants in your testing every day and can give concrete examples: generating test ideas and edge cases, building test data, writing SQL or log queries, summarizing logs or diffs, reproducing bugs, and drafting clear reports.
  • Skill at prompting and giving context, such as feeding in the ticket, the diff, and the acceptance criteria to get useful output instead of generic answers.
  • Healthy skepticism. You verify what AI tells you, recognize when it is confidently wrong, and never let it replace your own judgment about risk.
  • An understanding of how to test systems that don't always give the same answer, such as AI features, by using repeated trials, sample sets, and "is this answer right?" checks rather than exact matches.
  • Careful handling of data. You use synthetic or masked data with AI tools and never paste customer or court data into unapproved services.

Technical Proficiency

· Comfort with the command line, Git, and reading logs. Some experience with Docker or Kubernetes (such as port-forwarding or checking pod logs) is a plus.

· Experience with defect tracking and test management in Jira.

How You Work

  • Analytical Mindset: Sharp attention to detail, curiosity, and a methodical approach to breaking software and finding root causes.
  • Communication Excellence: Strong written and verbal communication for bug reports, test notes, and status updates. Your reports are precise enough that another person, or an AI agent, can pick them up and act.
  • Ownership: When something seems "untestable," you find a way, whether that's a query, a log search, a simulator, or a question to the right engineer, rather than skipping it.

Requirements

  • Experience writing or maintaining automated tests (for example Playwright, Selenium, or API test scripts), including building them with AI and reviewing and fixing what it produces.
  • Experience testing AI or LLM features, such as checking classification accuracy, spotting hallucinations, or testing for prompt injection.
  • SQL skills for checking data in PostgreSQL.
  • Experience testing APIs directly with tools like Postman, curl, or Bruno, and an understanding of HTTP, REST, and JSON.
  • Experience with web security testing, including authentication and sessions, roles and permissions, OAuth2/SAML, CSRF, and XSS.
  • Experience using AI browser tools (for example Playwright MCP or browser agents) to speed up exploratory testing.
  • Experience testing integrations with third-party systems, email-driven workflows, or browser automation against external sites.
  • Experience with accessibility testing (WCAG 2.2 AA).
  • Knowledge of the legal domain, especially court e-filing, docketing, or legal document management.
  • ISTQB or a similar QA certification.
  • An understanding of or experience with the Lean Startup approach.

Why QA Engineers Like It Here

  • Modern Tooling: Company-provided AI tools, with clear guidelines for using them safely.
  • Real Impact: You'll shape how we test in an AI-assisted team, not follow a fixed script.
  • AI in Production: Hands-on work testing real AI features used by law firms every day.

Benefits

  • Remote Flexibility: A fully remote role open to every US time zone, Hawaii included.
  • Work-Life Harmony: Flexible working hours and a supportive approach to getting work done.
  • Comprehensive Coverage: A range of insurance options covering health, dental, vision, and life.
  • Discretionary Time Off: We know a healthy work-life balance matters. Our discretionary time off (DTO) policy means that, on top of scheduled vacations and holidays, employees can take unplanned time off when needed, with supervisor approval. Life happens, and we trust our team to manage their time well.
  • Employee Stock Options: The opportunity to participate in the company stock option plan.

job.title: Manhattan Tester
job.description:
Role Overview
We are looking for a Manhattan Tester with strong application testing and production support experience to validate complex warehouse management solutions and ensure reliable, high-quality releases.
The role combines Manhattan WMS functional testing, test automation, application support, warehouse operations knowledge, and technical troubleshooting.
The successful candidate will work closely with developers, technical leads, and business stakeholders to design effective test scenarios, identify defects early, improve test coverage, and support quality throughout the software development and release lifecycle.

This is a highly technical testing role requiring strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to understand complex application integrations and technology environments.

Key Responsibilities
Manhattan WMS Testing

  • Execute testing activities for complex programs and projects involving Manhattan WMS applications.
  • Develop a strong understanding of warehouse operations and apply business-domain knowledge when designing test scenarios.
  • Review requirements and solution designs to provide feedback on testability, potential risks, and test coverage.
  • Participate in customer design and requirements discussions and provide testing perspectives that improve solution quality.
  • Act as a subject matter resource for assigned application or functional areas.
  • Facilitate thorough and systematic testing to identify potential issues before production release.
  • Analyze defect patterns and identify gaps in existing test coverage.
  • Apply knowledge of software development and testing processes to identify defects early and improve build quality.

Test Case & Test Script Development

  • Design and develop test cases and test scripts ranging from simple to complex scenarios.
  • Develop test scenarios based on functional requirements, technical specifications, and business processes.
  • Ensure test coverage addresses functional requirements, integrations, data flows, and expected business outcomes.
  • Review test scenarios with technical leads and developers to maximize effective coverage.
  • Maintain and update test documentation in accordance with established standards and procedures.

Test Automation

  • Develop automated test cases for functional and integration testing.
  • Execute automated functional tests and analyze test results.
  • Work with developers and technical leads to establish appropriate automation strategies.
  • Identify opportunities to improve test automation coverage and efficiency.
  • Develop automation reports, metrics, and test results for quality reporting.
  • Maintain test automation assets after release and ensure they remain reusable for future testing cycles.
  • Investigate automation failures and distinguish application defects from test or environment issues.

Application & Technical Support

  • Apply application and production support knowledge to diagnose and investigate complex issues.
  • Collaborate with developers, technical leads, and other technical teams to understand application behavior and dependencies.
  • Analyze technical issues across application, integration, database, messaging, and cloud environments.
  • Support release planning, deployment activities, and change management processes.
  • Participate in post-release validation and support activities when required.
  • Perform ad hoc technical investigations and testing based on changing business priorities.

Integration & Technical Testing

  • Test integrations across applications, APIs, databases, messaging platforms, and cloud services.
  • Work with technologies including MQ, Kafka, APIs, XML, JSON, DB2, Azure databases, and cloud data services.
  • Validate data flows and integration behavior across distributed application environments.
  • Support testing of applications involving Java/Spring Boot, JavaScript/React, and related technologies.
  • Work with technical teams to understand integration architecture and identify potential failure points.

Quality Management & Reporting

  • Prioritize testing activities based on business impact, project requirements, and release schedules.
  • Provide accurate quality status, test progress, and automation metrics.
  • Identify and communicate testing risks, scheduling constraints, and quality issues in a timely manner.
  • Escalate critical quality concerns appropriately and recommend potential solutions.
  • Maintain clear and accurate testing documentation.
  • Ensure documentation and approval processes follow established standards and procedures.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work closely with technical leads, developers, application support teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Contribute ideas for improving testing processes, procedures, automation, and overall quality.
  • Innovate in solving complex testing challenges.
  • Apply analytical and creative problem-solving approaches to difficult testing scenarios.
  • Help improve testing efficiency, coverage, and repeatability across releases.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3–4+ years of experience in application testing, application support, production support, or a closely related technical environment.
  • Hands-on experience with Manhattan WMS application support and/or testing.
  • Strong understanding of warehouse operations and warehouse management processes.
  • Hands-on experience creating test cases and test scripts.
  • Experience with functional and/or automated software testing.
  • Strong technical and analytical troubleshooting skills.
  • Experience supporting release planning, deployment, and change management activities.

job.title: Quality Assurance Engineer (Contractor)
job.description:
About Kadince

Kadince (pronounced cadence) is a fully remote American software company founded in 2013. In a nutshell, we build tools to help financial institutions track and manage the good they do in their communities.

Why We’re Looking for Contractors

As our customer base grows, so does our team. We’re committed to delivering top-notch software quality and ensuring every feature release goes smoothly. To keep up with the growing demand and maintain our high standards, we’re looking for experienced Quality Assurance Engineers in Brazil who can help us scale QA efforts, maintain product integrity, and contribute to a collaborative dev environment.

Who We Want to Hire

To be a QA contractor at Kadince, you should have 5+ years of experience in software development or QA engineering. You know how to plan and execute test strategies, create and maintain robust test suites, perform root cause analysis, and communicate your findings clearly. You don’t just test software—you improve it.

You’re great at spotting issues, solving problems, and helping developers build better code. Your detail-oriented nature, curiosity, and passion for quality assurance set you apart.

Since you’ll be collaborating with our US-based development team, strong English communication skills are important. We’ll occasionally have meetings to align on progress, share feedback, or collaborate in real time.

Let’s Geek Out

If you’re geeky like our QA team (hopefully you are), you’ll probably want to know more about our stack and workflow.

Technologies & Tools

  • Frontend/Backend: Ruby on Rails, React, GraphQL, Postgres, Redis
  • Testing: Cypress, Minitest
  • DevOps: Kubernetes, Helm, Docker, CircleCI
  • Collaboration & QA Tools: Jira, Rubymine, Sentry

You’ll be using these tools to build, execute, and automate tests while helping us maintain and improve QA documentation and practices.

Our Core Values

Our values aren’t just nice words on a wall (we don’t have one). They drive how we work and who we hire:

  • Integrity – We’re honest with ourselves and others.
  • People – We understand that people are the foundation of Kadince.
  • Care – We do our best work with purpose and intention.
  • Remarkability – We provide standout experiences.
  • Growth – We accept yesterday and improve today.

Even as a contractor, you’ll be expected to uphold these values in your work and interactions.

What You’d Work On

As a QA contractor, you’ll work alongside our development and product teams on:

  • Planning, executing, and automating manual and regression tests
  • Writing test cases and acceptance criteria
  • Identifying, triaging, and tracking bugs
  • Monitoring releases using tools like Sentry and Slack
  • Collaborating on documentation and QA process improvements
  • Mentoring junior team members (as needed)

You’ll receive assignments, collaborate through Slack and Jira, and give feedback directly to your Kadince point of contact. We’re open to your ideas—your voice matters.

Flexibility

This is a fully remote contractor role with flexible hours. You’ll need to coordinate occasionally with our US-based team, but we value asynchronous work and understand time zone differences. You’ll be free to manage your schedule as long as you deliver consistent, high-quality results.

Compensation

Kadince offers competitive USD-based compensation, above typical rates in the Brazilian market. Here’s what you can expect based on your experience and skills:

  • Tier 2: Mid Level (2–5 years): $5–$10/hour
  • Tier 3: Senior Level (5+ years): $10–$20/hour

Compensation depends on experience, technical ability, and English communication. Exceptional performance may lead to higher rates over time.

How to Apply

If you’re excited to work with Kadince, we want to hear from you. When applying, send us:

  • A PDF resume
  • A brief cover letter (max 300 words) explaining why you’d be a great fit

Show us that you’ve taken the time to understand who we are. (Seriously, if you don’t know our name during the interview… that’s a red flag.)

This position is open to candidates living in Brazil.

Salary: $5 - $20 / hour

job.title: Senior QA Automation Engineer (HELOC)
job.description:
Upgrade helps customers move in the right direction with affordable and responsible financial products. Since 2017, we’ve helped over 7.5 million customers access over $42 billion in consumer credit. With a relentless focus on improving our customers' financial well-being, we build products that put more money in their pocket and support their journey toward a better financial future. We’re backed by some of the most prominent technology investors and were most recently valued at $7.3B.

We’re consistently recognized for our collaborative and inclusive culture. Most recently, we were named one of the World’s Top Fintech Companies by CNBC, Best Places to Work by Built In, Best Places to Work by the San Francisco Business Times, America’s Greatest Workplaces by Newsweek, Best Startup Employer by Forbes, and Healthiest Employers by Phoenix Business Journal.

We’re looking for new team members who get excited about designing and delivering new and better products. Come join us and help build a better financial future for millions of people.

About the Role:We are seeking a Senior QA Automation Engineer to join our team who has end-to-end ownership to build a new quality product. Through automation and functional testing, they validate a variety of products to offer our customers a seamless banking experience. As a Senior QA Engineer, you will work directly with our product teams and will participate in application specification reviews and architectural design sessions by providing input from a quality standpoint. You will also identify testing strategies for various features and functionalities. Within your first year, you will develop an understanding of how to deliver high performing software at pace of development. You will work in an environment that promotes ownership at all levels including configuring and monitoring apps in production.

This is a fully remote position to candidates who are based in the US.

Our Core Technologies Include:Java, Selenium Webdriver, Playwright, Claude Code, TestNG, Maven, Git, Jenkins, ArgoCD, SQL, REST Assured, OkHttp, SumoLogic, Docker, Kubernetes, Gatling, Linux etc

What You’ll Do:

  • Develop test automation at the pace of feature development utilizing AI tools and our functional and performance test frameworks
  • Utilize LLMs to create feature test plans and internal knowledge stores for streamlining AI tools usage for Automation and Deep testing efforts
  • Define custom AI workflows to enable all developers to test new features using existing automation tests, evaluate test failures, and troubleshoot environment issues
  • Execute functional/performance tests by spinning up disposable environments on demand to deploy microservices with different versions and configurations, and customize database content
  • Customize, configure, patch services, and deploy infrastructure and code changes all the way through to production
  • Analyze log files and troubleshoot production issues by automating and reproducing them in a non-production environment
  • Collaborate with QA platform to create solutions for feature validations and test automation for your product

What We Look For:

  • Ability to develop test automation in Java using Selenium/Playwright to utilize Integrated Development environments (IDE) such as IntelliJ or Eclipse, with and without Coding assistants
  • Experience in deploying services in various environments such as Kubernetes, using deployment tools like ArgoCD and Jenkins
  • Capability to improve efficiency of existing test infrastructure using Docker, Playwright and headless browser executions
  • Familiarity with log aggregators such as SumoLogic or Kibana, and app monitoring tools such as Honeycomb or Grafana
  • Passion for automating tests and delivering high quality features in a fast paced environment
  • Comfortable working in Agile methodology

What We Offer You:

  • Competitive salary and stock option plan
  • Paid coverage of medical, dental and vision insurance
  • Flexible PTO
  • Opportunities for professional growth and development
  • Paid parental leave
  • Health & wellness initiatives

Environmental & Working Conditions

  • Work is performed indoors in a fast-paced environment that requires the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet established workflows, schedules, and service expectations.
  • Employees regularly input, retrieve, and exchange information accurately using digital systems and applications to support operational and customer service objectives.
  • The role requires the ability to receive and exchange information with customers, peers, supervisors, and cross-functional partners through available communication channels, which may include meetings, email, phone, and digital collaboration tools, and may involve real-time, verbal, or in-person exchanges depending on business need.
  • Job duties may involve managing a high volume of inbound and/or outbound customer interactions and work activities using telecommunications and computer systems. The role requires the ability to read, analyze, and interpret information displayed on computer screens and remain in a working posture for extended periods, consistent with the demands of the position.
  • Work may be performed in a contact center, office, or remote environment, depending on business needs and the nature of the role. Onsite work environments may include shared workspaces, standard office lighting, and moderate background noise typical of customer service or operational settings.
  • Employees working remotely are responsible for maintaining a secure and productive workspace with reliable internet connectivity that supports company systems and safeguards the confidentiality of company and customer information.

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) and applicable state and local laws.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Upgrade does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms, or any third parties. Any resume submitted to any employee of Upgrade without a prior written agreement in place will be considered the property of Upgrade, and Upgrade will not be obligated to pay any referral or placement fee. Agencies must obtain advance written approval from Upgrade's Talent Acquisition department to submit resumes and only in conjunction with a valid, fully executed agreement. English is required for all positions, as it involves interacting with staff at Upgrade's offices worldwide.

job.title: Quality Assurance Manager - Senior
job.description:
Quality Assurance Manager - Senior
  • Clearance: Secret Clearance
  • Certifications: DoD Approved 8570 Baseline Certification, Category IAT Level II.

Position Summary
Nationwide IT Services, NIS, is seeking a Senior Quality Assurance Manager to establish and maintain processes to evaluate IT systems, software, and associated documentation for a potential opportunity.

This role plans and directs quality assurance and quality control activities across the software lifecycle, applies verification and validation, testing, integration, and software metrics to assess quality, and determines the resources needed for IT quality control.

The manager provides subject matter expertise to resolve complex technical problems across all task areas. This is a full-time, fully remote opportunity supporting a federal customer.


Key Responsibilities
  • Establish and maintain processes for evaluating software and its associated documentation.
  • Develop software quality assurance plans and identify the resources needed to perform IT quality control.
  • Maintain the required level of quality throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Conduct formal and informal reviews at predetermined lifecycle points, document findings, and support resolution of quality issues.
  • Apply verification and validation, software testing and integration, and software metrics to assess software quality.
  • Apply subject matter knowledge to high-level analysis, design, development, modeling, simulation, integration, installation, documentation, and implementation.
  • Resolve specialized technical problems using a detailed understanding of the relevant subject matter and its principles and methods.
  • Support specialized solutions in areas such as environmental, scientific, maintenance and repair processes, and logistical support activities, as applicable.

Required Qualifications
  • At least five years of relevant experience in quality assurance and quality control of IT systems.
  • Experience with verification and validation, software testing and integration, and software metrics used to assess software quality.
  • Ability to establish and maintain software and documentation evaluation processes, develop quality assurance plans, determine quality control resources, and conduct lifecycle reviews.
  • Ability to apply technical subject matter knowledge to specialized solutions and resolve complex problems.
  • Relevant certification from a nationally recognized technical authority.
  • DoD Approved 8570 Baseline Certification, Category IAT Level II.

Security Requirements
IT-II security clearance or a current National Agency Check with Local Agency Check and Credit Check (NACLC) at the time of proposal submission.


About Nationwide IT Services
NIS is a CVE-verified Service-Disabled Veteran-Owned Small Business and an IT and management consulting company. Our mission is to deliver value-added services to our customers, leveraging technology, people, and industry best practices to implement innovative solutions through our trusted employees and team members.  

Our benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision insurance, life and disability insurance, a 401(k) plan with employer match, paid holidays, PTO (sick/vacation), commuter benefits, employee assistance program (EAP), and educational reimbursement, along with Pet Insurance.

Salary range $120,000 to $165,000 annually
The salary range is a general guideline. We consider several factors when determining base salary offers, including the position's scope and responsibilities, the candidate's experience, education, and skills, and current market conditions.

job.title: Engineer, Quality Assurance
job.description:
About AGent Energy

AGent is building the leading software platform to optimize distributed generation resources — turning energy liabilities into reliable, monetizable assets. We bring AI to the aggregation, orchestration, and monetization of distributed generation in wholesale and retail power markets, delivering meaningful reliability, economic, and sustainability benefits to commercial, institutional, and industrial energy users, utilities, and grid operators.

We move fast, think big, and operate with a lean, high-trust team. Every hire matters here.

About the role

AGent is seeking a skilled Quality Assurance Engineer to own testing and quality across our entire technology stack — from cloud backend and IoT device communication to embedded firmware and customer-facing applications. This is a mission-critical role at a company where reliability isn't a nice-to-have: when our platform tells a generator to run, it has to run. Every time.

You'll work at the intersection of cloud infrastructure, embedded systems, and real-time energy operations — designing and executing test strategies that ensure our platform performs flawlessly across all layers. You'll partner closely with our Cloud Backend, Application Engineering, and Embedded teams to catch issues early, build robust automated test coverage, and raise the quality bar across everything AGent ships.

This is a hands-on, end-to-end QA role for someone who takes pride in being the last line of defense before code reaches production — and who understands that in critical energy infrastructure, quality is never negotiable.

Responsibilities

End-to-End Test Strategy & Execution

  • Design, build, and maintain comprehensive test strategies that cover the full AGent platform — cloud backend, IoT device communication, embedded firmware, and customer-facing application layers
  • Develop and execute functional, integration, regression, and end-to-end test suites across all platform components
  • Own test planning for new features and releases, working closely with engineering leads to ensure quality is built in from the start — not bolted on at the end
  • Maintain clear documentation of test coverage, results, and known issues across the platform

Cloud & Backend Testing

  • Test AWS infrastructure components including IoT Core device provisioning, Lambda functions, and data ingestion pipelines
  • Validate TimescaleDB schema performance and data integrity under high-volume, high-frequency telemetry loads
  • Test API integrations, data pipelines, and backend services for reliability, accuracy, and performance at scale

IoT & Embedded Testing

  • Develop and execute test protocols for IoT device communication, provisioning workflows, and command handling between cloud and embedded systems
  • Partner with the Embedded Engineering team to validate firmware behavior, device-to-cloud messaging, and real-time control event accuracy
  • Build test environments and simulation frameworks that replicate real-world generator behavior and edge conditions

Automation & CI/CD Integration

  • Build and maintain automated test suites integrated into AGent's CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions
  • Implement automated regression coverage that catches issues before they reach production
  • Continuously improve test efficiency, coverage, and reliability through automation and tooling

Quality Advocacy & Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Cloud Backend, Application, and Embedded Engineering teams throughout the development lifecycle — not just at the end
  • Identify, document, and track bugs with clear reproduction steps and prioritization recommendations
  • Contribute to post-incident reviews and help drive process improvements that prevent recurrence
  • Actively use Claude AI and other AI tools to accelerate test case generation, documentation, and defect analysis — and bring a continuous improvement mindset to how AI can raise quality across the team

Qualifications

Required

  • 3–5 years of QA engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of end-to-end test strategy and execution
  • Hands-on experience testing cloud-based systems — AWS experience strongly preferred
  • Familiarity with IoT systems, device communication protocols, and embedded or firmware testing
  • Experience building and maintaining automated test frameworks and integrating them into CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong SQL skills for data validation and backend testing
  • Experience with Claude AI or other AI tools in a professional context, or a demonstrated eagerness to integrate AI into your QA workflow
  • Detail-oriented with strong written communication skills — you document clearly and advocate for quality convincingly
  • Ability to work cross-functionally across cloud, embedded, and application engineering teams

Preferred

  • Experience testing mission-critical or real-time industrial systems where reliability requirements are non-negotiable
  • Familiarity with time-series databases (TimescaleDB or similar) and high-volume data pipeline testing
  • Exposure to distributed energy resources, generator technologies, backup power systems (big plus!), or grid-edge infrastructure
  • Experience with performance and load testing at scale
  • Proficiency with Python or .NET (C#) for test automation

Benefits

  • Competitive base salary, performance bonus, and early-stage equity
  • 100% employer-paid Health, Dental, and Vision premiums for full-time employees
  • Two health plan options: traditional plan with FSA, or HDHP with company-funded HSA
  • Basic Term Life Insurance + voluntary insurance options
  • Flexible PTO
  • Fully remote — work from anywhere in the U.S.
  • The opportunity to build quality into a platform that directly impacts grid reliability and the clean energy transition
